title: [ESP-ING] Reliving the Passion of Soccer ⚽️
body: > Antes de que comenzará esta tragedia en Venezuela yo estaba muy pendiente de casi todos los partidos de Fútbol ⚽️, el mundial es algo que llama mucho la atención y aunque no soy fanática, este mundial quería verlo completo, aunque mi país ni fue al mundial quería apoyar o quiero apoyar otros paises por eso no perdía ningún partidos, aun no tengo un país en particular ya me decidiré en los finales. El miercoles 24 el día del terremoto me encontraba en casa viendo el partido de Brasil apenas comenzando, desde allí hasta hoy no vi más partidos, realmente con todos de Venuno lo que hace es ver noticias y llorar, pero hoy fuimos hacer una diligencia a un centro comercial de mi ciudad el cual estaba muy lindo decorado con cosas alusivas del fútbol y mi sorpresa no fue menos al ver la copa del mundo, claro una réplica muy original.

> Me gustó que esta ubicado en toda la entrada del área techada del centro comercial, la copa está allí para vivir el mundial, aquí se ponen pantallas para que las personas disfruten de un rato viendo el mundial de fútbol con amigos, se ve muy real y tiene una alfombra verde que lleva hasta ella.

> Por otro lado en la parte de afuera, no techada, se encuentra el balón del mundial, este balón me gusta mucho los colores que le dieron este año, Así que aproveche de tomarme una foto con el balón, me encanta como se ve esa parte para tomarse la foto ya que se ve el estadio atrás y se ve hasta real.

>


Hoy me volví a activar en el partido de México y Ecuador, gracias a todos esos países que apoyan y gritaron que Venezuela no está sola, gracias por tanto apoyo es bonito escuchar eso; difícil ponerse de un bando cuando ambos países me encantan, por eso digo que ya veré a la final a cual país voy apoyar, no había visto que eliminaron a Alemania y es un país que había comenzado muy bie , por lo que uno no sabe que pueda pasar, esto me sirve mucho de distracción, para olvidar un poco los problemas actuales.









 




</center>


<div class=\

width=472 height=49 border=0>
--- >! [ENGLISH] > >Before this tragedy began in Venezuela, I was really into almost every soccer game ⚽️. The World Cup is something that really grabs your attention, and even though I’m not a die-hard fan, I wanted to watch this entire World Cup—even though my country didn’t even make it to the tournament. I wanted to support other countries, so I didn’t miss a single game. I still don’t have a specific country I’m rooting for; I’ll decide during the finals. > >On Wednesday the 24th, the day of the earthquake, I was at home watching the Brazil game just as it was starting. From then until today, I haven’t watched any more games. Honestly, with everything going on in Venezuela, all I do is watch the news and cry. But today we went to run an errand at a shopping mall in my city, which was beautifully decorated with soccer-themed decorations, and I was quite surprised to see the World Cup trophy—of course, a very original replica. > >I liked that it’s located right at the entrance to the mall’s covered area; the goal is there so you can experience the World Cup. They set up screens here so people can enjoy watching the World Cup with friends—it looks very realistic, and there’s a green carpet leading up to it. > >On the other hand, outside in the uncovered area, there’s the World Cup ball. I really like the colors they chose for it this year, so I took the opportunity to take a photo with it. I love how that photo spot looks—you can see the stadium in the background, and it looks so real. > >Today I got back into the game between Mexico and Ecuador. Thanks to all those countries that showed their support and shouted that Venezuela isn’t alone—thank you for all the support; it’s nice to hear that. It’s hard to pick a side when I love both countries, which is why I say I’ll wait until the final to see which country I’ll root for. I hadn’t realized Germany had been eliminated—and they were a team that had started off so well—so you never know what might happen. This is a great distraction for me, helping me forget my current problems for a little while. > ---

links.body:

> Han comenzado los dieciseisavos de final en la Copa del Mundo; una etapa que nunca había experimentando, pero la necesidad FIFA en cambiar para bien y para mal a ese hermoso deporte, era de esperar que por ahora exista la suma de un encuentro más. A causa de esta nueva etapa en la segunda fase del torneo, era de esperar que existiera enfrentamientos que serán considerando como dispares con respecto al nivel de las selecciones; uno de esos encuentros deberían enfrentarse la selección paraguaya, que su participación comenzó cayendo goleado contra uno de los anfitriones, pero a pesar de ese mal resultado, se supo reponer para ser uno de los mejores terceros; esa posición lo llevaría a enfrentar a la multicampeona del mundo, a la siempre favorita selección alemana que en mi opinión su actuación en fase de grupo fue de más a menos.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

The Round of 32 in the World Cup has begun; a stage I had never experienced before, but given FIFA’s need to change this beautiful sport—for better or for worse—it was to be expected that there would be one more match at this point. Because of this new stage in the tournament’s second round, it was to be expected that there would be matchups considered lopsided in terms of the teams’ skill levels; In one of those matches, the Paraguayan national team is set to face off against the German national team. Paraguay began its campaign with a crushing defeat against one of the host nations, but despite that poor result, it managed to bounce back to become one of the best third-place finishers; that position will pit them against the multiple World Cup champions, the ever-favorite German national team, which, in my opinion, saw its performance in the group stage go from strong to weak.


![1000328342.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/Eopr4eVfAYtuv3qoDKxVftqWzbFsZYw1Hp2QQjfh3WVBn1RyXGVHX69mzFFyVq886ge.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2071733682650439751)

Alemania se proclamó campeona del mundo por cuarta ocasión en el torneo disputado en Brasil 2014, ese título fue la culminación de un proyecto que comenzó en el 2006 en dónde hizo aparición una generación de futbolistas que deslumbraron al mundo y abrió las puertas a otra camada de jugadores que brindaron al mundo un estilo de juego de alta calidad y lo cual generó grandes expectativas e hizo pensar que dominarían por completo el fútbol mundial, pero en el momento en fallar en obtener el título de la Eurocopa del 2016, lo cual comenzó una ola de críticas hacia jugadores, cuerpo técnico y directiva, convirtiendo ese trayecto victorioso que se esperaba que transitara Alemania, en uno lleno de espinas y dolor.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

Germany was crowned world champion for the fourth time at the 2014 World Cup in Brazil; that title was the culmination of a project that began in 2006, when a generation of soccer players emerged that dazzled the world and paved the way for another group of players who brought a high-quality style of play, which generated high expectations and led many to believe they would completely dominate world soccer, but when they failed to win the 2016 European Championship, it sparked a wave of criticism directed at the players, coaching staff, and management, turning what was expected to be Germany’s victorious journey into one fraught with thorns and pain.


![1000328343.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/Eoke1Vcnh6D5iCxfAVsNDgCrgXgjipCY7CDorQPAnQ16FgTZwRXPhPkFdRKicLZAHBj.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2071776703764898024)

Seguramente los alemanes tenían cierta esperanza en que su selección pudiera ser competitiva en este torneo a pesar de las dificultades presentadas, específicamente en la portería en dónde por sorpresa, nuevamente se decidió por el muy experimentado Manuel Neuer como titular; esa idea de convocar al todavía portero del Bayern Múnich me hizo pensar que Julian Nagelsmann necesitaba conformar un equipo tanto con experimentados jugadores como con otros jóvenes, los cuales tendrían su primera experiencia mundialista, pero más que nada necesitaba la imagen o la presencia de un jugador que es campeón del mundo; esta idea, que puede ser considerada como válida, de igual manera pensaba que pudiera generar cierto problema porque así como Neuer será recordado como campeón, también debería ser sinónimo de los fracasos de su selección en las últimas competiciones.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

The Germans surely had some hope that their national team could be competitive in this tournament despite the challenges they faced, specifically in goal, where—surprisingly—they once again opted for the highly experienced Manuel Neuer as the starter; that decision to call up the still-active Bayern Munich goalkeeper made me think that Julian Nagelsmann needed to build a team with both experienced players and younger ones—who would be making their World Cup debuts—but more than anything, he needed the image or presence of a player who is a world champion; While this idea may be considered valid, I also thought it could create a certain problem because, just as Neuer will be remembered as a champion, he should also be seen as synonymous with his national team’s failures in recent competitions.


![1000328344.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/Eo6K1APXXG8hbo9e85QRA8RwQsSL45Z8p9jQmBAbepx8G3MVQUaEgvWG8seV5QGBNV9.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2071740387287343123)

Como dije anteriormente, Alemania, en los cuatro encuentros disputados en este torneo, fue de más a menos; golear a la selección de Curazao era algo más que lógico que sucedería; la diferencia entre ambas selecciones es más que evidente y, de igual manera, la selección caribeña podrá decir que su primer gol en un mundial se lo anotó a un tetracampeón del mundo. Ahora, la actuación de los dirigidos por Nagelsmann contra Costa de Marfil como Ecuador fue trágica; la nula humildad de cómo los jugadores enfrentaron a ambas selecciones pudo costar su participación en la segunda fase a pesar de golear en su primer encuentro, por ejemplo, contra los africanos pudieron recibir uno o más goles después de ir abajo en el marcador, y recordemos que ese juego lo ganan con un gol en el último minuto del tiempo añadido y, más que demostrar convicción en obtener la victoria, en mi opinión, demostraron desesperación, ya que después del gol anotado, su entrenador y demás cuerpo técnico demostró una actitud temerosa, seguramente pensando que se les escaparía una importante victoria.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

As I mentioned earlier, Germany’s performance in the four matches played in this tournament went from strong to weak; thrashing the Curaçao national team was only to be expected; the difference between the two teams is more than evident, and likewise, the Caribbean team can say that it scored its first World Cup goal against a four-time world champion. Now, the performance of Nagelsmann’s team against both Ivory Coast and Ecuador was disastrous; the players’ complete lack of humility in facing both teams could have cost them a spot in the second round, despite their rout in their first match. For example, against the Africans, they could have conceded one or more goals after falling behind, and let’s remember that they won that game with a goal in the final minute of stoppage time. Rather than showing conviction in securing the victory, in my opinion, they showed desperation, since after the goal was scored, their coach and the rest of the coaching staff displayed a fearful attitude, surely thinking that an important victory would slip away from them.


![1000328345.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/EoyQvFrESmzbtCLArMogCKRH1KmmHg4D2GhWsdNxS1xDGoGgRbBGqkHkboAagHB1GrZ.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2071939388032848142)

Alemania contra Ecuador, también se vio superada por la desesperación de no poder alcanzar de manera rápida la victoria; el nulo juego ofensivo en sus dos últimas presentaciones en la fase de grupo era algo que ya debería levantar una justificada crítica con respecto al desempeño de su entrenador y, por supuesto, los jugadores que son reconocidos como parte de la élite del fútbol europeo, pero la problemática en generar ocasiones ofensivas era algo sumamente evidente. Los alemanes anotaron tan solo 3 goles en los dos últimos encuentros de fase de grupo y recibieron 3 goles; ya con esa estadística se notaba una muy clara problemática en el juego en conjunto, porque no solamente había un problema en generar juego, sino también en la defensa y tener lo que ya es una señal de mal juego y que no se puede superar; fue lo que creo que condenó a esa selección.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

As I mentioned earlier, Germany’s performance in the four matches played in this tournament went from strong to weak; thrashing the Curaçao national team was only to be expected; the difference between the two teams is more than evident, and likewise, the Caribbean team can say that it scored its first World Cup goal against a four-time world champion. Now, the performance of Nagelsmann’s team against both Ivory Coast and Ecuador was disastrous; the players’ complete lack of humility in facing both teams could have cost them a spot in the second round, despite their rout in their first match. For example, against the Africans, they could have conceded one or more goals after falling behind, and let’s remember that they won that game with a goal in the final minute of stoppage time. Rather than showing conviction in securing the victory, in my opinion, they showed desperation, since after the goal was scored, their coach and the rest of the coaching staff displayed a fearful attitude, surely thinking that an important victory would slip away from them.


![1000328346.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/EowHUE2PHtF3LkHzL3ziq2m7Ck4qGyj6H9rRtbNpLj42Pg2hg6vKwdaJbtACJsRX1rT.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2071868601355673605)

Sorpresivamente para todos, Paraguay se convirtió en los verdugos de los europeos; la selección sudamericana ofreció una actuación contundente en la defensiva, fue fiel a lo que es su historia y estilo de jugar; el equipo dirigido por Alfaro demostró una alta convicción a sabiendas a quien iban a enfrentar, fueron humildes, pero también fueron al enfrentamiento sin demostrar ni una pizca de miedo, jugaron como un equipo que tenía la convicción de que estaba ante una oportunidad única y justamente la historia de Alemania como selección en los dos mundiales anteriores, brindaban esa posibilidad para que Paraguay hiciera historia, así como en años anteriores tanto Corea del Sur y México lo hicieron, con la gran diferencia en que está vez sería en un encuentro de eliminación directa. No puedo decir que Alemania fue dominada o hasta perjudicada; si observamos las estadísticas, veremos que la alta posesión de balón, la gran cantidad de pases realizados, córners contados, chutes con peligro, en todas esas características superaron a su rival, pero también hay que decir que chocaron una y otra vez con un equipo que defendió mejor, que su portero realizó una actuación memorable y que sus jugadores ofensivos tuvieron una oportunidad y la aprovecharon, y justamente ese sacrificio tuvo una gran recompensa al querer superar la instancia de los penales; justamente esa palabra, \

, fue la gran diferencia entre las dos selecciones, ya que Alemania titubeó y en esa disyuntiva en ser protagonista o no, fue que perdieron nuevamente y por tercer mundial consecutivo no alcanzan la instancia de los octavos de final, lo cual, en mi opinión, le resta prestigio a una generación que está de salida y puede marcar a la próxima.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

To everyone’s surprise, Paraguay became the Europeans’ nemesis; the South American team put on a strong defensive performance, staying true to its history and style of play; the team led by Alfaro showed great conviction, knowing exactly who they were up against; they were humble, but they also went into the match without showing even a hint of fear. They played like a team convinced that they were facing a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity—and Germany’s history as a national team in the two previous World Cups provided precisely that chance for Paraguay to make history, just as South Korea and Mexico had done in previous years, with the major difference being that this time it would be in a single-elimination match. I can’t say that Germany was dominated or even at a disadvantage; if we look at the statistics, we’ll see that in terms of high ball possession, the large number of passes made, corner kicks, and dangerous shots, they outperformed their opponent in all those areas, but it must also be said that they came up against, time and again, a team that defended better, whose goalkeeper put in a memorable performance, and whose offensive players had one opportunity and capitalized on it—and it was precisely that sacrifice that paid off handsomely as they sought to advance past the penalty shootout; It was precisely that word—“believe”—that made the difference between the two teams, as Germany faltered. At that critical juncture—whether to take the initiative or not—they lost once again and, for the third consecutive World Cup, failed to reach the round of 16. In my opinion, this diminishes the prestige of a generation that is on its way out and could have left its mark on the next one.

中，女主主動發起了未同化者的聚會，因為心理因素，不想藉助同化者的翻譯，所以自然的只找上了會說英文的人，之後沒被找的人，則心懷不滿。

而這場會英文的聚會，也因為跟其他人想法不同不歡而散，有的人想維持同化後的世界，有的人則是壓根搞不清楚狀況，家人都好好的在身旁就好了，即便他的精神已經與人同化。後來其餘倖存者在之後都還有透過視訊聯繫，唯獨排擠了女主。

倖存的13人中，只有一位男性也是對這種外星病毒產生的狀況不滿，但他也是不屬於懂英文的這群，加上他本來就拒絕與這些同化者溝通，所以一直蝸居在他工作的地方。

直到有天收到女主錄製的錄影帶，才知道世界上只剩下13人保有個體思想，而女主是想把世界恢復原樣的，於是他決定從家鄉巴拉圭，一路開車北上到美國的新墨西哥州，商討如何拯救世界。

我猜未來這位應該是男主? 暫時就稱他為男主吧😂 男主想法有些古板，堅決拒絕同化者的任何協助。而女主雖然同樣排斥同化者，但在召開第一次聚會的時候，還是藉助了同化者，甚至男主收到的錄影帶，也是同化者幫忙拷貝上翻譯字幕的。聽起來有點詭異對吧，這些同化者也不知道什麼原因，不能殺生，不能說謊，又對這些倖存者極為友善，有求必應，這也是整部劇的驚悚元素之一。

男主的古板行為，換個方面想就是極有原則，他在路途中抽取其他車輛的汽油，都會在雨刷上夾上鈔票，這樣做在末日其實很沒意義，但他求的是一個心安理得，不知道後面根女主相遇時，又會碰出什麼火花，感覺兩人的個性非常不一樣。

links.body: > Seeking answers and a way to contact Peter, Miles entered a room filled with hunters who cheered him toward a guarded exit. Walking through, he found himself trapped in a massive arena with Martin Li. Orchestrated by Kraven, a fierce battle commenced, ending with Li unleashing an even darker inner demon. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRtQZfhJFPgrxiZxTzM6pA17HkzagnRAyPqvx7ELrNnhd/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVZKwCmzBUnee99R2TsgfxXK149TQN5JpMhmRBaYn3sMo/screenshot_2_.png) Miles decided to find out why Kraven brought him here. And he just had to get out of here and call Spider-Man if he is okay, and I had to look for a way for him to escape the devil's lair. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYkZMuMyUrZEyZCkVwCni4WQRunKRsP8GGpLq5efdnCpL/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRNvVo65QjCbBEWWiasqgVpx5iPes7ZdMW6pUH8xUyHZM/screenshot_4_.png) But after getting to the other room, Miles found the whole room was full with various types of hunters, along with multiple shield bearers and heavy brutes in the same room. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmewNddE9tWwrmUeSuu7N2WhXMRw6Yt81fcWkzNrsMWqqu/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmViwdFrZpeoYYLCWG3CJEsZMb9y8NRAYJEZ7yyuREoQnf/screenshot_6_.png) When both Miles and I understood it won't be an easy fight for him, we noticed they were not actually attacking. They were like cheering Miles up while I started walking toward the next door that was guarded by two shield bearers. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXfB231ps4NKx927KQdq9KP2Jwn47GYcuZpSrckjxGe4a/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfZjzPczfuD3iUPGcNay3hzo3GTHNUWdR5vLhArhbLkP6/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPDtXEk1ZA3YpNgKFyZnyioeXjMYL9L5YFTCW9en14FvJ/screenshot_9_.png) But right after getting there, the shield bearers moved and opened the gate for Miles, and Miles just walked out casually, being so confused, crossing the threshold. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXdbNFv4LrX5YEA8o779Zj81RZr657kf6VGs9Pe6pDf6z/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXFxbXVdMNy6nTFCcZTu1F2UnaYxvxYgKZn13e5NLHdDM/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXxNLa9y2JX4MBbDE8gDSRf6dA5xrNJm916Qt2Mtc7baT/screenshot_12_.png) After getting out of that room, Miles found himself inside a fight arena, full of hunters cheering around. And the gate behind Miles just got closed, locking him into the center of the arena. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTPvkmw2YW8jbfiPSDXitTacexzKF1J5jF4TkBGmourVy/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaJPdg5xnfx6yxgzHgbzPq1yguVg31orc83QVDU1eTHcx/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmULy4cLPDAH9hRzsdLKTsxH8WW13Tk7tiBoeGykf8gaKJ/screenshot_15_.png) While Miles was checking on the hunters cheering around, he noticed it was not himself alone, as there was also Li in the arena, standing opposite him with dark energy already beginning to crackle around his fingertips. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYzK6HbVE18MQQt8aYosPzi5EyHsp17CeRAN9piizryGi/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWtdyFethtkGSsz7UKoLGycr7DkVAKqgRAGBwZnoFoj58/screenshot_17_.png) Then I was shown Kraven, who looked like he was in a good mood, and he was like prepared a battle in between Spider-Man and Martin Li, watching down with a satisfied grin. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYx62NjS1FaQcbCcBSJqe7Wp6wJejz4k5G5PhWahHtQAd/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPfW13zLzsCPnAB2uci7q26iQJdmRWnafz95nfXjs8LB2/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSjscjaYWfvzMV5Zyc3P3t6q5Ah2P5uZmVXNCyKDjaoNj/screenshot_20_.png) Li mentioned there was no escape from that place, as he already understood the consequences, because he tried. And Miles was more than ready to fight his father's killer. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRycem2Wr2XohRZ3etTJgtrKJGBDKzHtiuL3pyMXqXTP8/screenshot_21_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaenUvQUtM8M4pNtDprxXJDx6sjSMzAydabPnQyLEcMF6/screenshot_22_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRmVM5bFcuvrc6akfEcqD1JsFZBiXvrotsXfrfgJ4JBve/screenshot_23_.png) Now I had to defeat Mister Negative, while he started attacking me with low horizontal waves at first that I had to jump over. And then I went to him directly to beat him up for a moment before dodging his next wave of attacks. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQJ42h8MvqcwSBLpEhBeS3cHjvUKDvyb59j1Q8robHVax/screenshot_24_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQUHMoaEGqaMEkFzsY4CfuNxLnTVw6VDFs7gfAA26T2r4/screenshot_25_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXBnSyz89KfHPjV5uTGAaRVa77U5pZf7ZfuJwc1PWG1wj/screenshot_26_.png) Well, I started unleashing every power I had against him. But it looked like Mister Negative has become more powerful than before, sweeping across the arena floor with increased speed and devastating energy. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ8rs1orbKYk7Sz2HYbxTLghfvot7FgxWGYccnYid3mXN/screenshot_27_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVcsvW1xaYKfp8CAGfzGoHbMb59L532T1qHsR9ak94WUH/screenshot_28_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT3KHeo84A3Z4tcmWA7TekpZnfbBG3BbpYSZSCV9LJzbf/screenshot_29_.png) I understood I had to dodge most of his incoming attacks, otherwise I'd be gone. But still, Mister Negative pinned me down with a massive blast of negative resonance when I actually drained his full health bar. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmas9vE2x3cecCj3ryTDZdiUcs8wc5LmASwLv2HpwJ318F/screenshot_30_.png) Actually, I won because I drained his full health bar. But it looked like the health bar was just to get into another cutscene, where Miles was completely pinned down by Mister Negative. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYXkZ1E2gQ1kKGDjZH13EZgXnNYxSXbzny5ZXg7NeVutr/screenshot_31_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbZwetvPs7RziHo8SsrhRAzvsP8wz46pD1ggmXoY4c5Dx/screenshot_32_.png) Li mentioned Miles will never defeat him, as a Spider-Man doesn't kill. But Miles replied that Li has never fought this Spider-Man. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZqVpnTKwvu87iPMsoKhDuJDUxtrbv2EJXwEgKyiwiFni/screenshot_33_.png) Then Miles pushed Li over, and it looked like Li has unleashed a more powerful demon out of him that I would have to fight next. https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png That's all for now. I'll write about more of this story again soon. Be safe till we meet again. Au revoir/Goodbye. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gamingphoto/23tRvMuLRERuPePNhyEjtaKt46FiKwDBgwVqqAberwmEFA36fPkh2ad6wvB1RYNKTVezR.png ***All the screenshots are my takes from my play using the in-game photo mode, and I tried Canva to edit the thumbnail.*** --- ▶ [Watch on 3speak.tv](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=rashed.ifte/fighting-mister-negative-990)

links.title: 서귀포시에서만 보이는 남극노인성 카노푸스
links.body: 당분간 계속 비소식이 있어서 퇴근 후 운동은 어려울 것 같습니다. 서귀포는 비가 오면 부슬부슬이 아니라 한여름 소나기 같은 비가 하루 종일 내리거든요. 얼마전 도서관에 갔다가 도서관 산책길에서 남성정이라는 정자를 발견했습니다.
/>그냥 여느 정자처럼 산 위에서 쉼터 인줄 알았습니다. 주위에 맨발로 걷는 길도 있구요.\n\n
/> 그런데 정자 위에 올라가니 우와! 하는 사실을 발견했습니다.
/>대한민국에서 이곳 서귀포에서만 볼 수 있는 별에 대한 설명이었습니다. 그리고 이곳에서만 보이는 노인성에 대해서 쓴 시들도 있었습니다.
/>여러작품들이 있었지만 추사 김정희 선생도 노인성에 대해서 시를 썼네요.\n\n
/> 남쪽으론 서귀포 앞바다가 보이고, 북쪽으론 한라산 정상이 보입니다.
/>밤하늘에서 두번째로 밝은 노인성을 볼 수 있는 계절이 빨리 왔으면 좋겠습니다.

links.title: Grilled sirloin steaks with rustic potatoes with garlic and oregano [Esp-Eng]
links.body:
<center> 

### ❣️_Hola amigos de hive!_❣️ 

>### ❣️_Hello friends of hive!_❣️ 
</center>
<hr>
<div class=\

>
Hoy voy a compartir esta receta para un delicioso almuerzo a base de bidtec de solomo frito con papas rústicas al ajo y orégano: una combinación fantástica para el paladar. Te aseguro que el bistec queda muy jugoso y tierno, y las papas, crujientes y llenas de sabor; seguro que querrás volver a prepararlo. Espero que me sigas; te lo explicaré paso a paso.

> ``` Today I’m sharing this recipe for a delicious lunch of pan-fried sirloin steak with rustic garlic and oregano potatoes—a fantastic combination for the palate. I’ll tell you, the steak turns out very juicy and tender, and the potatoes are crispy and full of flavor—you’ll definitely want to make this again. I hope you’ll follow along; I’ll walk you through it step by step. ```
![Añadir un subtítulo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23z7NWZYpi8Vptdu46q63sJd48pWv8VSLzPV6L4Fbpq5yARHo1JNkerNfYfoLxczVBXzG.jpg)

> ![700 gr de pechuga de pollo, 01 limón, 01 cucharada de ajo en polvo, 03 cucharada de paprika ahumada, 02 cucharadas de aceite de oliva, 01 cucharada de maicena, 01 cucharadita de miel, 34 taza de a.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23zm3c7n5EEwx4LspdFXYhvihbcD7VEgcjnoj4fRmtqxFc4GZW9KBopgYgWV1yGytBCdq.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48YA3dVucGUQ3j5STqMX3enFGLhvzgymiszf9aqeZzxzyW8oooVgCVPH9wwS7LPMkv.png)

>
En primer lugar, lava bien los trozos de solomo, escúrrelos y sazónalos con sal, ajo machacado, vinagre, mostaza, orégano y aceite de oliva; déjalos marinar.

> ``` First, wash the tenderloin pieces thoroughly, drain them, and season them with salt, crushed garlic, vinegar, mustard, oregano, and olive oil; let them marinate. ```
![IMG_2969.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Ep3dqY7XNaTmUMZCTsmFTAPeFzKPYt491wmd7jg5xqnbYQTbwkP1zEtTFkMQefCpU1F.jpeg)|![IMG_2970.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Ep7ntjfdDWxG5xJx7XiZ41JjFad8vBJQFF8SG78s4osaK7foNfQjtTqmVvTVUEwWuwK.jpeg)|![IMG_2971.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EpQtnE6tCwdyLVZe1dNc9SRyDE2bT55oA6tSW7xRfb53k934eZ4h9qPvbb8pVetrryf.jpeg)|![IMG_2972.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EqFjKPf1Hb7T85rwy13tSCRVicyPcp1etJwUtHBYVstfMSGYPAZgEFg8t5iNUqmjibm.jpeg) -|-|-|- ![IMG_2973.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EpQvHh5tCWv2qxTAGBzwjXniXqcn3RxoeL4vGTu4gkti559WvJkrZHXRi6tDbXGu1br.jpeg)|![IMG_2974.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EpEAaPuHZUQUbm3mo6dDp1xKRBALVTHHeDm8BEH8zNvqU97atiiZWnfjLbob6ucNiFE.jpeg)|![IMG_2975.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGriAVGKJsx3pin3wgHmHQnQiCYsBrYt8S3xSg6iQhyJxKWig99a9uxscMe1kByEMR.jpeg) -|-|-

>
A continuación, lava las papas, córtalas por la mitad y, después, en trozos. Cuécelas al vapor hasta que estén al dente.

> ``` Next, wash the potatoes, cut them in half, and then into chunks. Steam them until they're al dente. ```
![IMG_2966.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAZFLJEQbeyTzwTEj7NnMMucLt9C5oYPYG9eEiGCndyWXzw44SRQxXmhmnVLCx5BYT.jpeg)|![IMG_2968.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAaAWdE8NYNhjaTVLJdchsK5J7yc4VTAYKa1kEcxyvWs13WzmGNcfQ34bAiQCjNya3.jpeg)|![IMG_2976.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGwuDxkDWERKcPuoy82DUR99Y88AAeBE8uMaDMVuucgzL99CWHkBsHTijwQ2caSNS2.jpeg) -|-|-

>
Echa aceite en una sartén y, cuando esté caliente, añade las papas y fríelas; cuando estén doradas, añade el ajo picado, la sal, la pimienta, la paprika y el orégano; cocina durante tres minutos más, removiendo constantemente para que todos los sabores se mezclen bien. Pásalas a papel de cocina para que absorba el exceso de aceite.

> ``` Pour oil into a skillet, and when it’s hot, add the potatoes and fry them; when they’re golden brown, add the crushed garlic, salt, pepper, paprika, and oregano; cook for three more minutes, stirring constantly so that all the flavors blend together. Transfer them to paper towels to absorb the excess oil. ```
![IMG_2979.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eo46K5ikcAAQPgG33h64aivP4ZLeezsr4ZK39z3PHJ13QuW4tFzWnRGsEVmEoTS6sN1.jpeg)|![IMG_2981.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAYo7hDHHdXtguwenKtmHbcHhpWo9rBNLC4pzhPftHiZB7pe4JXZebj9N5bBi5xXvt.jpeg)|![IMG_2983.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoEhsHxfxV1stKGyCXLq3P6gA19754NzXQTbYdsiSeV4GKpG9DmboBcdqSHWueJtvr4.jpeg)|![IMG_2984.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoJw882QM6EywwMTQozjrwX6f9VvtFsE8s1MeFV9iSf2M4k47vgRY8ddTomMzcJWKz8.jpeg)|![IMG_2985.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGr84wDVL8DtKFa55tqWcMZepC5hAWwLq1SUBYZ7kMExB6o8xJeCbBLNusLXbGRCfR.jpeg) -|-|-|-|- ![IMG_2987.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eoni86iwo19Z9t5Dg5iEmnxr2k9Y15wSadf6wt8vyet3zssTPfJUZFUJReeV2LQCmMq.jpeg)|![IMG_2988.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EprT5u14Ej31TzXjgMQcyADMDM8hxjMmmb8ZdPEzeoipX6Vjt7fDh18ARNXgq8zmfCH.jpeg)|![IMG_2990.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eo8SsKaHjNxKsqELn7QxTXJQV48k5RTJvANNPMn7ZzbgttF9FP7j16hZSvF6NWjrHu9.jpeg)|![IMG_2999.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EpVCU7eGpdN8s3dyVnV6TB1LegL8MdmYcNRda7yNSE1HF2c6Rmoo5jW99A1uKrKSVwF.jpeg) -|-|-|- ![IMG_3007.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoK7JQbbjsXCpDtxExYmupSYiKDJCnNjqhKDksGs3w4q6RkRVzhCbsLUAkoUxp9viTd.jpeg) ![IMG_3003.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EppMZbUHankx19NExR5e5xmbCZbJZrKZKYZdzsYRxKx9FTBQenDzvCeNnNLbohfZSuB.jpeg)

>
Ahora vamos a freír los filetes de solomo en una sartén; echa aceite suficiente y, cuando esté caliente, añade los filetes y cocínalos durante dos o tres minutos, hasta que estén dorados y jugosos. Colócalos sobre papel de cocina para eliminar el exceso de aceite.

> ``` Now let's fry the sirloin steaks in a skillet; pour in enough oil, and when it's hot, add the sirloin steaks and cook them for two or three minutes, until they're golden brown and juicy. Place them on paper towels to remove the excess oil. ```
![IMG_2977.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eo8RvqvjQ3g63NR5qHSATYxSCo2QYStH7A3uBJzY95ci7eUC342uqLe9irqPkPB5D8p.jpeg)|![IMG_2980.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eo8RTs8zhTAYcmzyWeaAmc8L4QssAam2D7Ej5DpvAiiBCvqFg4g6LmGQBzDLjLq8bjY.jpeg)|![IMG_2989.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAZjWFBBANqENXqxEtqpnRdgSkWVGfsVqnJQVQfoDQCDCoatG71euycoxwB1rZCaQ3.jpeg) -|-|- ![IMG_2992.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eoke7QrLdmLQrHHrw5MnL5Pp8BbWEPrboi2JtMas8QZcCkqPu2tC9pHjpgy31FZA43h.jpeg) ![IMG_2995.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EpCBoiccKyhwJ721UVzbK5p2p87q3pjsC9ziCu3TytLAU39jQyMEwhaVGjemJpFeBiz.jpeg)

>
Sirve una ración generosa de papas en un lado del plato y el solomo frito en el otro, y disfruta de un plato rebosante de sabores. ¡Buen provecho!

> ``` Serve a generous portion of potatoes on one side of the plate and the fried sirloin on the other, and enjoy a dish bursting with flavors. Bon appétit! ```
![IMG_3009.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Ep1YQ244xww6HQR2zmixjxncTB7ndtC3j6BQKx6eZNXNU6b9DTuVxNR9RmDFkrfcGSy.jpeg) ![IMG_3011.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EpNrCbKFmbNzy9PWbjigM9y3BArGBDdF1gxDxTWdjZk2pRydMyZZBkYULZwXmbxdV5C.jpeg) --- ![ggifupdate.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/SD9NuiQZ-g-gif-update.gif)

links.title: Obsession (film):  It's as good as you have been hearing
links.body:
Every now and then a film comes by that was made with very little money, without the help of the large studios, and is so creatively made that it absolutely kills it at the box office anyway.   *Obsession* is one of these films.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/netflixr/23uFHAr3udbftCkoocdLQ6GyYjbLs2SJxEYSEuZgyhKKqYtTwhMJ2Jr7aawt69JkXdNkH.png)
[src](https://cdn.taposapp.com/poster/600x900/F9UN2lsL6X5frZ4ApVRmk50OJ_ipCE7ijJ3br44SmGw.jpg)</center> 

This one might end up breaking some records because I knew that their budget was low but I didn't realize that their ROI was as high as it is.  It was made for less than $1 million, got almost zero promotional budget, but made waves very quickly by solid social media and word-of-mouth exposure.   Once you watch the film for a little while, and especially after you are finished watching it, it is really easy to understand how this happened organically.  To date, it has made $375,000,000  WOW!

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/netflixr/23tGVdQFgrnXM9suWqNHuKUJWdUrqk7FmwxnK3xf2Z2Zro4h64HT4s6MHdQwTsWRECcHK.png)
[src](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt37287335/mediaviewer/rm94687234/)</center> 

The story here is something I think that most people can relate to from their childhood in high school or young adult life:  Bear Bailey has a crush on a girl he has known for a very long time, but while the two of them are great friends, he fails to move this relationship over to some sort of romantic one.  He has \

himself to a rather torturous position and even though he hangs out with and works with Nikki, he never manages to move it beyond that point and it is very torturous for him.   I can relate to this because there was a girl that I knew in high school that I hung out with all the time but there was nothing more to our relationship (in her mind) outside of things being platonic.  \n\nBear is incapable of moving past thins and one day he picks up a trinket in a hippie store filled with supposed supernatural things and one of them is a product called a \

which he knows is stupid, but is intrigued by it anyway.  Then on that night he is dropping Nikki off at home and has a chance to confess his feelings for her, but chickens out, just like he always does.  As she walks towards her house to leave him, he is upset with himself for not stepping up and telling her the truth. \n\nHe uses the silly prank gag gift Wish Willow and asks it to make Nikki \

and suddenly Nikki's attitude to him starts to change dramatically.  She is rather relentless at the car in pursuing having him stay over with her, which he eventually relents and does so.  

Because I don't want to spoil this film and seriously think you should go and see it, I am not going to be very specific about anything else that happens.   Let's just say that as the title would suggest, Nikki starts to care about Bear a *HUGE amount* and to the point of, well, *Obsession*.   

This initially really delights Bear, but her devotion to Bear starts out pleasant and slowly but surely devolves into something crazy.  The love of his life does in fact love him, but in a way that he cannot possibly reciprocate.  She starts to take on the personality of an extremely jealous lover and wants to be around him literally all the time.   

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/netflixr/23tkn4ecUQrmzJWNLfgKih8G9RhyPuv65cceQEczurWdeXfjsdzvnJdke1WAZPGCgP9jK.png)
[src](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt37287335/mediaviewer/rm61132802/)</center>

Bear cannot simply go and use the phone or the bathroom without being followed by Nikki, who becomes extremely angry in a sort of loving and childlike way that shows, just like the name would suggest, not just being in love with him, but that he is the only thing in the world that matters to her at all.   

Sound like a power that would be absolutely wonderful right?  Well, the movie is a horror film for a reason, and you will only understand why that is once you watch it, which you definitely should do.  

Now, not all the performances by the various actors and actresses are good, but the absolutely outstanding acting of the main two characters are fantastic.  In particular, the woman playing Nikki whose name is Inde Navarrette is just out of this world and I see good things happening for her in the future if she can transcend this into other films.   She has been in some things before but I had to look them up and so will most other people.  

To me this movie has a very \

aspect to it and it is incredibly original in its script and overall design. The beginning, middle, and end of this film are outstanding and better than almost anything I have seen in a long time, certainly from the United States where massive budgets and huge marketing campaigns without even worrying so much about actually having a decent film to do so with, has kind of become the norm. I hope that the success of this film can inspire other writers and directors to pursue actual good stories instead of just cranking out the usual crap, most of which isn't actually worth seeing. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gMC8kkwbIQQ

Should I watch it?

This is one of the most profound \

reactions that I have ever given on a film not just recently, but ever.   Everything about this movie save a few rather poorly cast and not-so-talented side-characters, this film is absolutely flawless.  It is haunting, it will hold your attention from start to finish, it will genuinely scare you and not just with the usual jump-scare tactics that are overused in films anyway.   

This movie is quite graphic and scary though, so if you are not down with the horror genre you might want to be a bit hesitant.  You definitely do not want to watch this with kids.

We often look at the world’s most successful people and think they have a \

Mindset\n\n* **The Buggy Mindset:** Focuses on the crashes, the errors, and the red flags. It sees a market dip or a failed project and triggers a \

* **The Optimized Mindset:** Views every error as a debugging session. It understands that failure is just data—valuable information on what *doesn't* work, so you can optimize what *does*.

### 💡 Why Your Consistency is Your Greatest Feature

You don't need to be perfect to succeed. You just need to be **persistent**. 
* **Small Commits:** Just like in software development, massive progress is made through thousands of small, steady commits, not one single, impossible release.
* **The Power of Iteration:** Every day you wake up and put in the work—on your content, your investments, or your witness nodes—you are iterating. You are versioning up.

### 🚀 Mission: Update Your Internal Version
Stop comparing your current \

Instead, focus on shipping your daily improvements.

:** Se enfoca en las caídas, los errores y las alertas rojas. Ve una caída en el mercado o un proyecto fallido y dispara un \

.

### 💡 Por qué tu constancia es tu mejor característica

No necesitas ser perfecto para tener éxito. Solo necesitas ser **persistente**.
* **Pequeños \

:** Al igual que en el desarrollo de software, el progreso masivo se logra a través de miles de pequeños y constantes aportes, no con una sola versión imposible.

links.title: Коли нерв стає мішенню: військова хірургія на межі фізики та людяності
links.body: >Вітаю, друзі. Продовжуємо об'єднувати науку з медичним та воєнним досвідом заради боротьби за життя. Коли до нас на стабілізаційний пункт привозять бійця після прильоту артилерійського снаряда, ми звикли концентрувати всю увагу на фонтанах крові з магістральних судин і напруженому пневмотораксі. Це абсолютно логічно, це рятує життя тут і зараз. Але периферичні нерви пошкоджуються в цій м'ясорубці набагато частіше, ніж ми встигаємо фіксувати в суматосі первинного медичного сортування. І хоча перебитий сідничний нерв сам по собі не вб'є пацієнта на операційному столі, саме він у результаті перетворює солдата на глибокого інваліда. Багато посібників скромно і політкоректно нарікають на те, що в «країнах з низьким рівнем доходів», до яких, на жаль, належить і Україна, це чинить негативний соціально-економічний вплив. І з цим важко не погодитися: для економіки та медичної системи держави, що веде важку війну на виснаження, армія молодих хлопців із повислими кистями та паралізованими стопами — колосальний удар. Це не просто виплата пенсій з інвалідності, це роки болісної реабілітації з вельми примарною надією на повернення до нормального життя.

>Чому так відбувається? Забудьте про акуратні розрізи скальпелем, які ви бачили в атласах з топографічної анатомії. У військовій хірургії ми маємо справу з жахливою високоенергетичною кінетикою. Куля чи осколок, що летять на надзвуковій швидкості, створюють у тканинах тимчасову пульсуючу порожнину. Навіть якщо шматок розпеченого металу пройшов у кількох сантиметрах від нервового стовбура, потужний гідродинамічний удар рве аксони всередині зовні абсолютно цілого нерва. А тепер додайте сюди специфіку сучасних бойових дій, а саме, запреградну травму. Засоби індивідуального бронезахисту можуть утримати кулю, але кінетична енергія нікуди не зникає. Запреградна дія деформує тканини під плитоноскою з такою силою, що плечове сплетіння може перетворитися на внутрішньотканинну гематому з розмозженими волокнами без єдиного проникаючого отвору на шкірі.

>І заради всього святого, якщо ви бачите такого пацієнта, що корчиться від болю на ношах, не пишіть у супровідних картках дичину про «больовий шок». Залишимо цей безглуздий термін для безграмотних інструкторів із соціальних мереж. Ті, хто працює на передових етапах надання медичної допомоги, зобов'язані розуміти, що тут запускається найскладніша патофізіологія болю. Пошкоджений нерв починає генерувати патологічні ектопічні імпульси, зводячи з розуму центральну нервову систему, викликаючи найтяжчий нейропатичний біль і стрімко виснажуючи фізіологічні резерви пораненого.

>Що стосується результатів відновлення, про які автори деяких робіт пишуть як про «посередні». Будемо реалістами — на етапі евакуації вони просто нульові. Хірургічне лікування на передовій зводиться до одного: не відрізати зайвого при проведенні первинної хірургічної обробки рани. Шукати в кривавому місиві, щедро перемішаному з осколками кісток, фрагментами форми та чорноземом, анатомічні структури, щоб акуратно зшити епіневрій — це небезпечна утопія. Первинний шов нерва при високоенергетичному вогнепальному або мінно-вибуховому пораненні — це хірургічний злочин проти здорового глузду через неминучий вторинний некроз контужених тканин. Подавляюча більшість таких випадків вимагає відстроченої, філігранної реконструкції в тилових спеціалізованих центрах. Це мікрохірургія, пересадка аутотрансплантатів і тривала боротьба за кожен міліметр. І навіть в ідеальних умовах нерв буде рости зі швидкістю приблизно 1 міліметр на добу. Якщо пощастить. А щастить, на жаль, лише небагатьом.

>Джерело

Ми повинні зафіксувати в пам'яті головне: периферичний нерв — це не ізольований електричний кабель, який можна нашвидкуруч скрутити ізолентою. Це неймовірно тендітна анатомічна структура, яка одночасно рветься вторинними осколками, розтягується гідродинамічним ударом, плавиться в лещатах тканинної ішемії і запускає ту саму виснажливу патофізіологію болю, що висмоктує з пораненого останні резерви виживання. На етапі масового надходження та проведення первинної хірургічної обробки рани наш головний інструмент — це холодний, цинічний розум хірурга. Не намагайтеся грати в мікрохірургію в стабілізаційному пункті, стіни якого трясуться від роботи артилерії. Ваша задача — стабілізувати гемодинаміку, зупинити магістральну кровотечу, не відсікти зайві тканини при санації ранового каналу і, що критично важливо, вчасно розпізнати компартмент-синдром. Виконуйте широку декомпресійну фасціотомію до того, як нервові стовбури незворотно загинуть від задухи у власних фасціальних футлярах. Оберіть консерватизм — це вищий пілотаж виживання для пораненого бійця. Війна не прощає помилок, але вона вчить нас бути точними, холодними та розважливими. Знання — наш щит, вміння — наша зброя.

links.title: Ground Beef Stew (Eng/Esp)
links.body:
> For lunch today, I made ground beef stew. I wanted to use the same technique from the chicken recipe in my previous post but with a different protein to see how it turned out, so I blended the seasonings but left some noticeable chunks of tomato and bell pepper for better flavor. Then I added sautéed onion pieces to the mixture to combine the ingredients and give it a different texture.
![1000123827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zGcXDEeCBudh68UvvogMAQwma9qbHhQN7VDaQQprMxrWRATeUGuxzyiGi2Q7Z5y4zSC.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 400 grams ground beef - 1 onion - 1 tomato - 12 sweet peppers - 1 bell pepper - Pinch of salt - 1/2 tablespoon adobo seasoning - 1 cup water - Oil - Butter - Cheese for grating
![1000123815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23y8siyo5cyqk9kejMxswQNgVdMtKUrgfZ4uayneM93GXm36Jcd1qBVxMgAJktwzWEVqU.jpg)
## Preparation: I washed the vegetables, removed the seeds from the sweet peppers and the bell pepper, and also removed the seeds from the tomatoes. Then I put them in the blender with a cup of water. I peeled the onion and cut it into small pieces. I sautéed it in a skillet with the ground beef, mixing it in thoroughly. I also decided to add half a tablespoon of adobo seasoning and a pinch of salt. I like the flavor of ground beef with adobo, so I added this extra touch to make the dish even more delicious.
![1000123819.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vhwNN3sivPPeyff45YKVoMQDmDDvkRTdYfXQYYhyYJEgANLRAmYjmc9RhreBHDAbPHY.jpg)
![1000123822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tSYTgb5c3LkCyyY4fQNCxGxDFReHBc7gM9m2c7ZYN5nycTcUpmauYnVYA8Pxrhgr5NG.jpg)
Then I added the blended seasoning mixture and continued stirring. The meat cooked for twenty minutes over medium heat and turned out delicious—you could taste the seasoning in every bite, and it was perfectly seasoned to my liking.
![1000123825.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tH9ro9HBPvf4orVeF3Hf63pYnznH7uFwAAmoj6ncRaVEuqzxstFd9ycL8AdJd7rNQZZ.jpg)
Then I made spaghetti to recreate the classic recipe with grated cheese. It was the perfect balance for a satisfying lunch. I tweaked the recipe slightly to give it a different flavor, and it worked—I loved the result. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Para el almuerzo de hoy preparé carne molida guisada, quise aplicar la misma técnica de la receta del pollo del post anterior pero con otra proteína para analizar los resultados, así que licué los aliños, pero dejé grumos acentuados de tomate y pimentón para un mejor sabor. Luego incorporé pedazos sofritos de cebolla a la mezcla para integrar los ingredientes y ofrecer una textura diferente.
![1000123827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zGcXDEeCBudh68UvvogMAQwma9qbHhQN7VDaQQprMxrWRATeUGuxzyiGi2Q7Z5y4zSC.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 400 gramos de carne molida - 1 Cebolla - 1 Tomate - 12 ajíes dulces - 1 pimentón - Pizca de sal - 1/2 cucharada de adobo - 1 taza de agua - Aceite -Mantequilla - Queso para rallar
![1000123815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23y8siyo5cyqk9kejMxswQNgVdMtKUrgfZ4uayneM93GXm36Jcd1qBVxMgAJktwzWEVqU.jpg)
## Preparación: Lavé los aliños, eliminé las semillas de los ajíes dulces y del pimentón. También retiré las pepas de los tomates. Luego llevé a la licuadora con una taza de agua. Desconché la cebolla y dividí en pedazos pequeños. Sofreí en un sartén con la carne molida, mezclé muy bien. También decidí agregar media cucharada de adobo y una pizca de sal. Me agrada el sabor de la carne molida con adobo, de allí que le di este toque extra para un platillo más delicioso.
![1000123819.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vhwNN3sivPPeyff45YKVoMQDmDDvkRTdYfXQYYhyYJEgANLRAmYjmc9RhreBHDAbPHY.jpg)
![1000123822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tSYTgb5c3LkCyyY4fQNCxGxDFReHBc7gM9m2c7ZYN5nycTcUpmauYnVYA8Pxrhgr5NG.jpg)
Luego añadí los aliños licuados y continúe mezclando. La carne se cocinó por veinte minutos a fuego medio y quedó muy rica, se podía sentir el aliño en cada bocado, además tenía el punto exacto de condimentos para mi gusto.
![1000123825.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tH9ro9HBPvf4orVeF3Hf63pYnznH7uFwAAmoj6ncRaVEuqzxstFd9ycL8AdJd7rNQZZ.jpg)
Luego preparé espaguetis para recrear la receta clásica con queso rallado. El equilibrio perfecto para disfrutar un almuerzo completo. Varié ligeramente la preparación para tener un sabor distinto y lo logré, me encantó el resultado. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

links.title: Why delegating unused Hive Power can help Holozing grow
links.body:
![2e2be88d-a1f9-4fef-8146-455987775272.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vhqLvyXEiBckdVewfBDeZVo1kEBpUNz4uYCEDLUYt5CKKx1skrhMkZxbTpiBY4RZtK6.png)

---

I Think one of the biggest strengths of Hive is that users have several ways to contribute to the ecosystem beyond simply creating content. (that's cool!)

While writing articles, curating posts, and participating in discussions are all important, I believe there is another tool that many people overlook: delegating Hive Power that they are not actively using.

many many Hive users have accumulated HP, but not everyone uses its full potential. Some people no longer publish regularly, others vote only a few times each week, and many have enough HP that a portion of it simply sits idle. 


That unused influence could become a valuable resource for projects like Holozing if more people considered delegation.

For anyone unfamiliar with the feature, delegating Hive Power is much simpler than it sounds. When you delegate HP, you are temporarily allowing another account to use the voting influence associated with that Hive Power. The important part is that you never lose ownership of your HP. 

---



![c9afefec-0933-41f7-990e-3588dac459e0.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23x1HydtFKbwXF7pxSgutMGypmS9MbnHrFYjbbWqKwNUzCxg4qjx8TfxT7KgMiuADfh5A.png)



---

It always remains in your account, cannot be sold by the receiving account, and can be recovered whenever you decide to end the delegation. After requesting the undelegation, Hive applies the standard return period before the HP becomes available to you again.

This makes delegation one of the safest ways to support a project because you are not transferring your assets permanently. Instead, you are allowing your Hive Power to become productive while it would otherwise remain unused. Think of it as lending someone a tool that is sitting in your garage instead of letting it collect dust. 

The tool still belongs to you, but while someone else is using it, it can produce value.

---


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23u5XEZUQy741zpanTmkYLHgaTDV1BgtPQST4KsEuXJCfqQ5ru4mEAMyTATHgF65aLMjQ.png)




---

If more community members delegated unused HP to accounts dedicated to supporting Holozing, those accounts would have greater voting power to reward quality content. Better curation means that authors producing guides, news, tutorials, development discussions, and other valuable posts can receive stronger rewards for the time they invest in helping the community grow.

This creates a positive cycle that benefits everyone. When good content receives meaningful support, creators are encouraged to remain active. 

---



![d802dff0-24bc-44f8-b521-54a522f6419a.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tviN3uM7vPC25mPhB4Hg6axVcBTTisLNBphyJv8dg3yfGgxtgR9EXbKikMaPoLVMwj7.png)



---

As more quality articles are published, Holozing becomes more visible across Hive. Greater visibility attracts curious readers, some of whom may become long-term members of the community. A larger and more active community ultimately helps strengthen the project itself.

One of the best things about delegation is that it does not require spending additional money. Many people may not be in a position to buy more HIVE, especially during periods of market uncertainty. However, they may already have Hive Power that they rarely use. 


Instead of leaving that influence inactive, they can put it to work supporting a project they believe in while still maintaining ownership of their assets.

---


![rtrthrthr.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23x1Hfo6v9b5j3zBydif5pKUupCP2L3v7EoyEGhy8s2WfKB1kuWWUjnn5ZNaC8hDm7aDi.png)



---

Another advantage is that this is something almost everyone can participate in. The contribution does not have to be enormous to make a difference. If hundreds of users delegated even a small amount of unused HP, the combined voting influence could become substantial. Decentralized communities often grow through many small contributions rather than relying on a handful of large stakeholders.

Of course, delegation should always be a personal decision. Everyone should evaluate how much Hive Power they actively use before deciding whether to delegate any portion of it. The goal is not to encourage people to give away voting influence they need, but rather to make better use of HP that would otherwise remain inactive.

---



![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wCSejGG5oZadCUhm1a7uys37xDsNsUwk9zTXda6khbezoqdmb6EmFHnVELsTRYeeNkE.png)



---

Holozing is still growing, and communities often become stronger when their members look for practical ways to help each other. Delegating unused Hive Power may not seem like a dramatic action, but its long-term impact could be significant. 


By allowing idle voting power to support the people creating valuable content around the project, the community can strengthen both engagement and visibility without requiring additional financial investment.

Sometimes the resources we already have are enough to make a meaningful difference. I mean the key is simply putting them to work.

links.title: TXOne Networks Expands the Element Portfolio with Virtual Portable Inspector, Extending Operational Inspection Across Modern OT Environments
links.body:
The operations-first OT security partner advances the Discover. Assess. Protect. framework by extending trusted, agentless inspection into OT environments where physical inspection workflows are difficult to scale.

![](https://www.globalnewslines.com/uploads/2026/06/c02f280820e5779317507d174b4df6dc.jpg)

**Taipei – June 30th, 2026 –** TXOne Networks today announced Virtual Portable Inspector (vPI), a software-based addition to the Element inspection portfolio designed to extend OT inspection into environments where physical inspection is difficult to scale — including geographically distributed sites, assets without accessible USB interfaces or HMIs, and facilities where on-site inspection creates significant deployment overhead.

As industrial organizations expand operations across more sites, physical inspection workflows face increasing pressure to scale. Organizations need practical ways to validate device integrity, collect asset intelligence, and inspect for malware across distributed assets without requiring persistent software deployment or production disruption.

Regulatory frameworks are compounding the challenge. SEMI E187 raises expectations for asset inventory accuracy, device integrity validation, and inspection auditability across OT environments. These are requirements that are difficult to meet through periodic, manually coordinated inspection.

Like all Element inspection products, vPI requires no installation, no system reboot, and no system configuration changes — enabling organizations to inspect OT assets without triggering revalidation requirements, voiding vendor warranties, or impacting production workloads.

vPI builds on the same inspection technology that has been deployed in semiconductor manufacturing environments for more than two years through TXOne’s Fab Tool Scan program. In real-world deployments, this approach has reduced inspection cycle time — including malware scanning and asset intelligence collection — by 50% across high-throughput OT environments.

Through vPI, organizations can perform these inspection activities across connected and distributed environments — without installing software or interrupting production. Distributed and managed through ElementOne, vPI scales across hundreds of endpoints from a single console. Built on the same trusted inspection technology that powers Portable Inspector, vPI extends TXOne’s proven inspection model into the connected and distributed parts of the OT environment.

The Element portfolio is designed around inspection, validation, and integrity assessment workflows for environments where persistent endpoint deployment may not be operationally feasible. vPI extends this model across distributed OT environments. For organizations on TXOne Complete, vPI’s inspection data also flows into SenninOne — TXOne’s cross-product governance platform that aggregates security intelligence across the broader OT environment, alongside ElementOne’s per-product management.

“For most OT environments today, inspection happens once a year during scheduled maintenance — or once a quarter at best,” said Dr. Terence Liu, CEO of TXOne Networks. “vPI lets organizations run that same trusted inspection across every connected OT asset weekly, or even daily, without dispatching technicians or disrupting production. That’s a step change in how often we know our OT environment is still trustworthy.”

**Purpose-built for production-critical OT environments**

vPI is purpose-built for environments where production continuity and deployment flexibility are critical — its software-only design extends inspection into scenarios where physical inspection is difficult to scale.

By reducing dependency on physical logistics and on-site inspection, vPI shifts inspection from periodic, event-driven cycles — annual maintenance outages or quarterly inspection windows — to recurring, software-driven validation that can run weekly or daily without additional headcount. The result is a step change in inspection coverage: from a handful of cycles per year to continuous validation across the asset inventory, narrowing the window in which a compromised or drifted asset can go undetected.

With vPI, industrial organizations gain a complete operational inspection strategy that advances the Discover. Assess. Protect. framework across the OT environment — from periodic asset onboarding through to recurring operational visibility and continuous device integrity assessment across connected, distributed environments.

**Availability:** TXOne Virtual Portable Inspector will be available in mid-July 2026 through TXOne Networks and its global partner network.

**About TXOne Networks**

TXOne Networks is the operations-first OT security partner. Since its founding, TXOne has focused exclusively on operational technology, helping organizations protect critical infrastructure while keeping production running. Purpose-built for industrial environments, TXOne enables organizations to discover their assets, assess risks in context, and protect operations without compromising productivity or safety.

[www.txone.com](http://www.txone.com/)

body.title: Cuando la mente se convierte en cómplice de la crisis
body.body:
Publicado en Español, Inglés y Portugués.

---


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRdrQjZPAB96S25Gutzd129uJpzjD1GuRM2RGiNtD95ag/1782873659951.jpg) *Editado en PhotoCollage*

---


Buenas noches, les deseo un buen descanso y una buena jornada.

He estado pensando en las formas de autodestrucción del ser humano, he buscado bibliografía autorizada y leído bastante por estos días. Es realmente impresionante lo que somos capaces de hacernos a nosotros y claro está, la mayoría de las veces es influido por factores externos. Teniendo en cuenta que me vi reflejada varias veces en mi vida en lo que les propongo reflexionar. Quiero, desde mi perspectiva y apoyada en la realidad que nos rodea intentar mostrar a moda de ejemplo lo que les digo. Cada uno de ustedes por favor siga conmigo.

Piensa en un trabajador que cada mañana abre los ojos y lo primero que calcula no es qué tiempo hará o qué comerá, sino cuántos días faltan para cobrar y si los números cuadran. Ese instante antes de levantarse, ese nudo en el estómago al revisar el saldo deja de ser solo estrés, se convierte en el principio de un mecanismo mucho más profundo que la ciencia ha comenzado a desentrañar con inquietante precisión. Creame no estoy siendo aprensiva, soy realista.

Vamos a ponerle un nombre a ese trabajador, le llamaremos Carlos. 
Carlos trabaja, tiene dos hijos y un alquiler que se lleva medio sueldo. No es pobreza extrema, pero vive con el agua al cuello. Y aquí ocurre lo paradójico, su mente, en lugar de ayudarle a salir, se convierte en su peor enemiga.
Los estudios sobre escasez cognitiva, de los cuales leí algunos en estos días, revelan que cuando los recursos económicos se tensan, nuestra capacidad de razonar disminuye equivalente a perder diez puntos de nuestro coeficiente de inteligencia. No porque seamos menos inteligentes, no, es porque la preocupación constante seca la gasolina del cerebro. Así que Carlos no puede planificar a largo plazo porque su atención está secuestrada por el próximo vencimiento.

Pero el verdadero problema germina en la noche. Cuando Carlos se acuesta, su cerebro no descansa. Ahi comienza la rumiación, un bucle repetitivo donde revive discusiones con su jefe, reproches por no haber ahorrado, miedos sobre el futuro de sus hijos. Esta rumiación no es reflexión productiva, es un disco rayado que amplifica cada error y magnifica cada amenaza.

La desesperanza no llega de golpe, se instala como una niebla que va enturbiando la percepción de salidas posibles. Carlos deja de abrir los sobres con las cuentas, evita hacer cálculos, posterga decisiones importantes porque cada elección parece condenada al fracaso. Los psicólogos llaman a esto evitación financiera, y funciona como una profecía que se cumple sola, al no actuar, las deudas crecen, confirmando su creencia de que todo está perdido.

Lo más cruel de este ciclo es que la mente comienza a distorsionar la realidad. Carlos se convence de que es una carga para su familia, de que sus hijos estarían mejor sin él, de que no merece ayuda. Estos pensamientos no son debilidad de carácter, son el resultado de un cerebro agotado que ha perdido perspectiva. ¿Te ha pasado en algún momento? A mi sí.

Recordemos la pandemia, que nos dejó evidencia dolorosa de este fenómeno. Durante el confinamiento, los servicios de atención a la salud mental registraron picos de ideación suicida entre trabajadores precarios que, antes de la crisis, habrían rechazado cualquier etiqueta depresiva. El miedo al contagio se mezcló con el terror al desahucio, y la rumiación encontró terreno fértil.

Pero hay una vuelta de tuerca más inquietante, según los especialistas, y es la parálisis por análisis. Cuando Carlos está atrapado en este torbellino, su capacidad para encontrar soluciones prácticas se bloquea. No es porque no existan opciones, sino porque su mente ha clasificado todas las alternativas como insuficientes o peligrosas. Pedir un préstamo parece una condena, buscar otro empleo, una quimera y hasta hablar con su pareja se convierte en una fuente de conflicto.

Los investigadores han identificado que esta trampa cognitiva se retroalimenta con el aislamiento social. Carlos deja de quedar con sus amigos porque no tiene dinero para una cerveza, pero esa desconexión elimina precisamente el colchón emocional que necesitaría para soportar la presión. Solo, sus pensamientos encuentran eco en el silencio de su casa, multiplicándose sin contrapeso.

Romper este círculo no exige soluciones imposibles, sino reconocer que la batalla no es solo económica, es también cognitiva y emocional. Carlos necesita espacios donde sus preocupaciones sean validadas sin juicio, donde pueda nombrar su miedo sin que se convierta en profecía. Necesita ejercicios prácticos para interrumpir la rumiación, como por ejemplo, se habla de escribir las preocupaciones en un papel y cerrarlo en un cajón durante unas horas. Y sobre todo, se necesita recuperar la noción de que el valor como persona no se mide en ceros en una cuenta bancaria.

La sociedad tiende a culpar al trabajador que vive al día por no \

. Pero la ciencia nos dice lo contrario, su mente ya está esforzándose demasiado, solo que en dirección equivocada. Quizás el primer paso para salir del pozo sea dejar de cavar, aunque solo sea por unos minutos al día, y permitirse mirar hacia arriba sin juzgarse por hacerlo.

Esto me ha rayado el alma pero necesitaba exorcisar el demonio.

---
---


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)

---
---

# *ENGLISH*

---
---



Good evening. I wish you all a good rest and a good day ahead.

I've been thinking about the ways human beings self-destruct. I've searched for authoritative bibliography and read quite a bit these past few days. It's truly impressive what we are capable of doing to ourselves—and of course, most of the time it's influenced by external factors. Bearing in mind that I saw myself reflected several times in my life in what I propose we reflect upon. I want, from my perspective and supported by the reality that surrounds us, to try to show, by way of example, what I'm telling you. Please, each of you, follow along with me.

Think of a worker who every morning opens his eyes and the first thing he calculates is not what the weather will be like or what he'll eat, but how many days are left until payday and whether the numbers add up. That instant before getting up, that knot in his stomach when checking the balance, stops being just stress; it becomes the beginning of a much deeper mechanism that science has begun to unravel with unsettling precision. Believe me, I'm not being apprehensive—I'm being realistic.

Let's give that worker a name; let's call him Carlos. Carlos works, has two children, and rent that takes half his salary. It's not extreme poverty, but he lives with his head barely above water. And here's the paradox: his mind, instead of helping him get out, becomes his worst enemy.

Studies on cognitive scarcity, some of which I read these days, reveal that when financial resources get tight, our ability to reason decreases—equivalent to losing ten points of our IQ. Not because we're less intelligent, no; it's because constant worry drains the brain's fuel. So Carlos cannot plan long-term because his attention is hijacked by the next due date.

But the real problem takes root at night. When Carlos goes to bed, his brain doesn't rest. That's when rumination begins—a repetitive loop where he relives arguments with his boss, self-reproach for not having saved, fears about his children's future. This rumination isn't productive reflection; it's a broken record that amplifies every mistake and magnifies every threat.

Hopelessness doesn't arrive all at once; it settles in like a fog that gradually clouds the perception of possible ways out. Carlos stops opening envelopes with bills, avoids doing the math, postpones important decisions because every choice seems doomed to fail. Psychologists call this financial avoidance, and it works like a self-fulfilling prophecy: by not acting, debts grow, confirming his belief that all is lost.

The cruelest part of this cycle is that the mind begins to distort reality. Carlos becomes convinced that he's a burden to his family, that his children would be better off without him, that he doesn't deserve help. These thoughts aren't character flaws; they're the result of an exhausted brain that has lost perspective. Has this ever happened to you? It has to me.

Let's remember the pandemic, which left us with painful evidence of this phenomenon. During lockdown, mental health services recorded spikes in suicidal ideation among precarious workers who, before the crisis, would have rejected any depressive label. The fear of contagion mixed with the terror of eviction, and rumination found fertile ground.

But there's an even more unsettling twist, according to specialists: analysis paralysis. When Carlos is caught in this whirlwind, his ability to find practical solutions becomes blocked. Not because options don't exist, but because his mind has classified all alternatives as insufficient or dangerous. Taking out a loan seems like a death sentence, finding another job a pipe dream, and even talking to his partner becomes a source of conflict.

Researchers have identified that this cognitive trap feeds on social isolation. Carlos stops meeting up with friends because he doesn't have money for a beer, but that disconnection removes precisely the emotional cushion he would need to withstand the pressure. Alone, his thoughts find an echo in the silence of his home, multiplying without counterbalance.

Breaking this circle doesn't require impossible solutions, but rather recognizing that the battle is not only economic—it's also cognitive and emotional. Carlos needs spaces where his concerns are validated without judgment, where he can name his fear without it becoming a prophecy. He needs practical exercises to interrupt rumination—for example, it's suggested to write down worries on a piece of paper and lock them in a drawer for a few hours. And above all, he needs to recover the notion that his worth as a person is not measured in zeros on a bank account.

Society tends to blame the worker who lives paycheck to paycheck for not \

But science tells us the opposite: his mind is already trying too hard, just in the wrong direction. Perhaps the first step out of the hole is to stop digging—even if only for a few minutes a day—and allow himself to look up without judging himself for doing so.

This has scratched my soul, but I needed to exorcise the demon.

# *PORTUGUÊS*

---
---

Boa noite, desejo a todos um bom descanso e uma boa jornada.

Tenho pensado sobre as formas de autodestruição do ser humano, busquei bibliografia autorizada e li bastante nestes dias. É realmente impressionante o que somos capazes de fazer a nós mesmos e, claro, na maioria das vezes é influenciado por fatores externos. Tendo em conta que me vi refletida várias vezes na minha vida no que proponho refletirmos. Quero, da minha perspetiva e apoiada na realidade que nos rodeia, tentar mostrar, a modo de exemplo, o que estou a dizer. Cada um de vocês, por favor, continue comigo.

Pense num trabalhador que todas as manhãs abre os olhos e a primeira coisa que calcula não é o tempo que vai fazer ou o que vai comer, mas quantos dias faltam para receber e se os números fecham. Aquele instante antes de se levantar, aquele nó no estômago ao verificar o saldo deixa de ser apenas stress, torna-se o princípio de um mecanismo muito mais profundo que a ciência começou a desvendar com uma precisão inquietante. Acredite, não estou a ser apreensiva, sou realista.

Vamos dar um nome a esse trabalhador, vamos chamar-lhe Carlos. Carlos trabalha, tem dois filhos e uma renda que leva metade do salário. Não é pobreza extrema, mas vive com a água pelo pescoço. E aqui ocorre o paradoxo: a sua mente, em vez de o ajudar a sair, torna-se no seu pior inimigo.

Os estudos sobre escassez cognitiva, dos quais li alguns nestes dias, revelam que quando os recursos financeiros se apertam, a nossa capacidade de raciocinar diminui — o equivalente a perder dez pontos de QI. Não porque sejamos menos inteligentes, não, é porque a preocupação constante seca o combustível do cérebro. Assim, Carlos não consegue planear a longo prazo porque a sua atenção está sequestrada pelo próximo vencimento.

Mas o verdadeiro problema germina à noite. Quando Carlos se deita, o seu cérebro não descansa. Aí começa a ruminação, um ciclo repetitivo onde ele revive discussões com o chefe, censuras por não ter poupado, medos sobre o futuro dos filhos. Essa ruminação não é reflexão produtiva, é um disco riscado que amplifica cada erro e magnifica cada ameaça.

A desesperança não chega de uma vez, instala-se como um nevoeiro que vai turvando a perceção das saídas possíveis. Carlos deixa de abrir os envelopes com as contas, evita fazer cálculos, adia decisões importantes porque cada escolha parece condenada ao fracasso. Os psicólogos chamam a isso evitação financeira, e funciona como uma profecia autorrealizável: ao não agir, as dívidas crescem, confirmando a sua crença de que tudo está perdido.

O mais cruel neste ciclo é que a mente começa a distorcer a realidade. Carlos convence-se de que é um fardo para a família, de que os seus filhos estariam melhor sem ele, de que não merece ajuda. Estes pensamentos não são fraqueza de caráter, são o resultado de um cérebro exausto que perdeu a perspetiva. Já te aconteceu alguma vez? A mim, sim.

Recordemos a pandemia, que nos deixou evidências dolorosas deste fenómeno. Durante o confinamento, os serviços de saúde mental registaram picos de ideação suicida entre trabalhadores precários que, antes da crise, teriam rejeitado qualquer rótulo depressivo. O medo do contágio misturou-se com o terror do despejo, e a ruminação encontrou terreno fértil.

Mas há uma reviravolta ainda mais inquietante, segundo os especialistas: a paralisia por análise. Quando Carlos está preso neste turbilhão, a sua capacidade para encontrar soluções práticas fica bloqueada. Não porque não existam opções, mas porque a sua mente classificou todas as alternativas como insuficientes ou perigosas. Pedir um empréstimo parece uma sentença, procurar outro emprego, uma quimera, e até falar com a parceira torna-se uma fonte de conflito.

Os investigadores identificaram que esta armadilha cognitiva se retroalimenta com o isolamento social. Carlos deixa de sair com os amigos porque não tem dinheiro para uma cerveja, mas essa desconexão elimina precisamente a almofada emocional que ele precisaria para suportar a pressão. Sozinho, os seus pensamentos encontram eco no silêncio da sua casa, multiplicando-se sem contrapeso.

Romper este círculo não exige soluções impossíveis, mas sim reconhecer que a batalha não é apenas económica, é também cognitiva e emocional. Carlos precisa de espaços onde as suas preocupações sejam validadas sem julgamento, onde ele possa nomear o seu medo sem que ele se torne profecia. Precisa de exercícios práticos para interromper a ruminação — por exemplo, fala-se em escrever as preocupações num papel e guardá-lo numa gaveta durante algumas horas. E, acima de tudo, precisa de recuperar a noção de que o seu valor como pessoa não se mede em zeros numa conta bancária.

A sociedade tende a culpar o trabalhador que vive no limite por não \

. Mas a ciência diz-nos o contrário: a sua mente já está a esforçar-se demasiado, apenas na direção errada. Talvez o primeiro passo para sair do buraco seja parar de cavar — mesmo que sejam apenas alguns minutos por dia — e permitir-se olhar para cima sem se julgar por isso.
