body.title: [EN/PT] Better Late Than Never: Learning How to Use the Avatar Exemplar
body.body:
> # [EN] ![capa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23ywq1pNm62yZd61rwHviBw8GTpo5b9Asgm5cCs97VPixY4NTKJzwXABpSXKkAMGEXKx4.png) # Hello, Splinter Fans! Better late than never! Some time ago, Splinterlands introduced an update whose true importance I completely overlooked at the time. I'm talking about the **Avatar Exemplar**, which I initially thought was nothing more than a cosmetic feature for customizing the player's avatar displayed during battles. However, with the arrival of the new **Rise of the Exemplar** ruleset, I realized I had been missing out on a very interesting game mechanic.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/AJhUSx9vbK4BnFJfs1o3TkSdwWCpzZAsy2cZSLC37urdjXanfqVKEHyJGTYvumt.png)
Besides customizing your avatar however you like, you can also transform it into a playable card for battles. Simply click on your player avatar in the upper-right corner of the game screen to configure and customize your Exemplar. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23uEua3m6PpW73vVn4AdbncEDozb9oDBtEXPSTi4trvZgwxBCUBmhqiq4e6dfU4reA9Ck.png) Every Exemplar starts at Level 1 with 16 points available for customization. The first step is choosing the Splinter you want. In my case, I selected the Life Splinter, which has always been my favorite. After that, you can spend your points to increase Health, Speed, Armor, or even unlock abilities. In fact, I was only experimenting with different builds and haven't spent any of my points yet. As a result, I still don't have an Exemplar ready to deploy in battle. My goal is to level it up, earn more customization points, and unlock additional features, but that will require a huge amount of Glints. At the end of this season, I earned just over **230,000 Glints**, and I seriously considered investing everything into my Exemplar. In the end, though, I decided to prioritize buying Reward cards since they're only available in the Shop for a limited time. Considering the current state of my collection, upgrading those cards seems like the smarter investment for now. Going back to the Exemplar, I tested several different builds. At first, I tried creating a highly offensive version, but I quickly noticed that its mana cost became quite high. Then I switched to a support-oriented build, adding abilities that better fit the Life Splinter and my preferred playstyle. I eventually concluded that I want an Avatar capable of supporting my team while weakening my opponents through debuffs. That's the direction I plan to take with my Exemplar, but first I need to level it up significantly—hopefully enough to eventually reach Epic or even Legendary rarity. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23vhTqz7WZGnUp8T46dWBzR8cm33Wubfb6u3M7DefBWJxJ86ABkpAqLi3A5L1FVR5gSwX.png) At Level 36, your Exemplar reaches **Wood Legendary**, which is equivalent to the Legendary level of Foundation cards. For me, a more ambitious long-term goal would be reaching Levels 72 or even 84. That will require a tremendous amount of Glints. One day I plan to save exclusively for that purpose, but for now my priority remains upgrading my Reward cards.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23swe9e1CpaybFJ3sSM78niFhXiWqLzGmwFNpW7eSMZPGU2goaYYD7u981JSzgmUcnVfG.png)
The battle that sparked my interest in the Exemplar mechanic is the one I'm about to show you. Watching how my opponent used this feature made me realize just how powerful it can be. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/Eos2oFCFQuCPre9KPBfq4hLUc63pxzvbfRdYgxgC5LPJf9NQFn7zaamEcYwRNx2b82p.png) The rulesets for this battle were **Rise of the Exemplar** and **Reverse Speed**. Every Splinter was available except Earth, and the mana cap was 52. Up until this battle, I didn't even know how to unlock my own Exemplar.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/EoATVNT5fTCTGMXc7mKNgJoJ5gxfuVTj4YofSdLy64NGqi9zhdgwVmifbYFt7K8utvv.png)
My strategy was to build a team of slow monsters to take advantage of the **Reverse Speed** ruleset. I chose the Life Splinter and used **Captain Frankie** as my Archon, granting **Inspire** to all allied monsters of the same Bloodline. In addition, two monsters could receive the tactical abilities **Piercing** and **True Strike**. My opponent selected a Dragon Archon that grants **Scavenger** to monsters of the same Bloodline. However, since their Archon was only Level 2, the strength of their monsters was somewhat limited. # [Click Here to Watch the Full Battle!](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_2ec0c4bbf50a6fb666c7acfb3cb4f6f6) What impressed me the most was my opponent's Exemplar. It had an incredible number of abilities, many of which are extremely powerful. The best part is that an Exemplar is **not restricted by the Archon's level**, making it even more valuable. ![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/241tbUPzqnBPpErjEddLjDpC2YYCb2pp9VbH3emotxeYiUu73HTzZXNFRtrDDHVx1jZfm.png) Right from the first round, even though my opponent's monsters were at lower levels than mine, they still fielded a remarkably strong team. I'd even say that if all of their monsters had been maxed out, they might have won this battle. The highlight was definitely their Exemplar. During the very first round, it attacked four of my monsters and, thanks to the **Halving** ability, reduced their attack power by half. ![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/242hYf6oL2D8iaUSpj2nR6jszWUninTYHJY7xwNyTmMqX5m7ajWWZgSSHqz1uD1gsgMXr.png) By the second round, my opponent was still holding up surprisingly well. Having my monsters' attack power cut in half made a significant difference throughout the battle. On top of that, their Archon is one of the strongest in the **Conclave** set, so I have no doubt that under equal conditions they could have won this match. ![F.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/242hYVviHLM37LWGoqHxBsdNpcR7SNZJpGSh1D91iz814HPdiR1YdsaLMG25WTvwnQRBf.png) In the end, I managed to eliminate almost my opponent's entire team, leaving only one monster and, of course, their powerful Exemplar, which had **Camouflage** along with several other abilities. This battle helped me decide exactly what kind of Avatar I want to build. I plan to create a support-oriented Exemplar with strategic abilities and, if possible, eventually add **Mimic** as well. My opponent had also incorporated two tactical abilities granted by their Archon, making their Exemplar absolutely insane.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23u5tiZ5Hex7c6zTraK4nx1LUxt6MQvDe77RgkypPdjdkcQDFf35perYsPtWaeYkZiVyD.png)
**If you enjoyed this post, please consider leaving an upvote, sharing your thoughts in the comments, and reblogging it. Thank you very much for your support!** --- **Images:** @splinterlands ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tGvyDT7ASwcw8K6yCRtkHFf7wLshNrkTrgKytk1atFUboxso73BsMUSQBtk5qozjXAM.png) # [PT] ![capa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23ywq1pNm62yZd61rwHviBw8GTpo5b9Asgm5cCs97VPixY4NTKJzwXABpSXKkAMGEXKx4.png) # Olá, Splinter Fanáticos! Antes tarde do que nunca! Há algum tempo o Splinterlands lançou uma atualização que, na época, eu não havia percebido o quão importante ela realmente era. Estou falando do **Exemplar de Avatar**, que para mim era apenas uma forma de personalizar o avatar do jogador exibido durante as batalhas. Porém, com a chegada do novo ruleset **Rise of the Exemplar**, percebi que estava deixando passar uma funcionalidade muito interessante.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/AJhUSx9vbK4BnFJfs1o3TkSdwWCpzZAsy2cZSLC37urdjXanfqVKEHyJGTYvumt.png)
Além de personalizar seu avatar da maneira que preferir, o jogador pode transformá-lo em uma carta utilizável nas batalhas. Basta clicar na imagem do jogador, localizada no canto superior direito da tela do jogo, para configurar e personalizar o seu Exemplar. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23uEua3m6PpW73vVn4AdbncEDozb9oDBtEXPSTi4trvZgwxBCUBmhqiq4e6dfU4reA9Ck.png) Todo Exemplar começa no nível 1 e possui inicialmente 16 pontos para serem distribuídos na sua personalização. Primeiro você escolhe o Splinter desejado. No meu caso, optei por analisar o Splinter Vida, que é o meu favorito. Depois disso, é possível investir os pontos para aumentar HP, Velocidade, Armadura ou até mesmo desbloquear habilidades. Na realidade, eu apenas estava fazendo algumas simulações e ainda não investi nenhum dos meus pontos. Portanto, ainda não possuo um Exemplar pronto para utilizar nas batalhas. Meu objetivo é aumentar seu nível, conquistar mais pontos e desbloquear novas funcionalidades, mas para isso serão necessários muitos Glints. No final desta temporada recebi pouco mais de **230 mil Glints** e fiquei bastante tentado a investir tudo no meu Exemplar. Entretanto, decidi priorizar a compra das cartas Rewards, já que elas possuem tempo limitado na loja. Considerando o estágio atual da minha coleção, acredito que fortalecer essas cartas será mais vantajoso neste momento. Voltando ao Exemplar, fiz algumas simulações. Inicialmente tentei criar uma versão bastante ofensiva, mas percebi que o custo de mana aumentava consideravelmente. Depois resolvi montar uma configuração voltada para suporte, adicionando habilidades que considero mais úteis para o Splinter Vida e para o estilo de jogo que costumo utilizar. Cheguei à conclusão de que quero um Avatar capaz de fortalecer minha equipe enquanto enfraquece os adversários com debuffs. Esse será meu objetivo para o Exemplar, mas antes preciso elevar bastante seu nível, quem sabe até alcançar as raridades Épica ou Lendária. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23vhTqz7WZGnUp8T46dWBzR8cm33Wubfb6u3M7DefBWJxJ86ABkpAqLi3A5L1FVR5gSwX.png) No nível 36 é possível alcançar a categoria **Wood Legendary**, equivalente ao nível Lendário das cartas Foundation. Para mim, um objetivo menos realista seria chegar aos níveis 72 ou até mesmo 84. Até lá serão necessários muitos Glints. Um dia pretendo economizar exclusivamente para isso, mas por enquanto minha prioridade continua sendo evoluir minhas cartas Rewards.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23swe9e1CpaybFJ3sSM78niFhXiWqLzGmwFNpW7eSMZPGU2goaYYD7u981JSzgmUcnVfG.png)
A batalha que despertou meu interesse pelo Exemplar será apresentada a seguir. Foi justamente a forma como meu adversário utilizou essa mecânica que me fez perceber todo o seu potencial. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/Eos2oFCFQuCPre9KPBfq4hLUc63pxzvbfRdYgxgC5LPJf9NQFn7zaamEcYwRNx2b82p.png) Nesta batalha os rulesets eram **Rise of the Exemplar** e **Reverse Speed**. Todos os Splinters estavam disponíveis, com exceção do Terra, e o limite de mana era de 52 pontos. Até esse momento eu sequer sabia como desbloquear meu próprio Exemplar.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/EoATVNT5fTCTGMXc7mKNgJoJ5gxfuVTj4YofSdLy64NGqi9zhdgwVmifbYFt7K8utvv.png)
Minha estratégia foi montar uma equipe composta por monstros de baixa velocidade para aproveitar o **Reverse Speed**. Escolhi o Splinter Vida e utilizei o Archon **Captain Frankie**, que concede a habilidade **Inspire** para todos os monstros aliados da mesma linhagem sanguínea. Além disso, dois monstros podem receber as habilidades táticas **Piercing** e **True Strike**. Meu adversário escolheu um Archon do Splinter Dragão, que concede **Scavenger** aos monstros da mesma linhagem. Entretanto, seu Archon estava apenas no nível 2, limitando o potencial dos seus monstros. # [Clique Aqui para Assistir à Batalha Completa!](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_2ec0c4bbf50a6fb666c7acfb3cb4f6f6) O que mais me chamou atenção foi o Exemplar utilizado pelo meu adversário. A quantidade de habilidades que ele possuía era impressionante, e muitas delas são extremamente úteis. O melhor de tudo é que o Exemplar não sofre limitação pelo nível do Archon. ![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/241tbUPzqnBPpErjEddLjDpC2YYCb2pp9VbH3emotxeYiUu73HTzZXNFRtrDDHVx1jZfm.png) Já na primeira rodada, mesmo com seus monstros em níveis inferiores aos meus, o adversário conseguiu apresentar uma equipe bastante forte. Arrisco dizer que, se todos estivessem no nível máximo, talvez ele até tivesse vencido a batalha. O destaque foi seu Exemplar, que logo no primeiro turno atacou quatro dos meus monstros e, graças à habilidade **Halving**, reduziu pela metade o ataque deles. ![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/242hYf6oL2D8iaUSpj2nR6jszWUninTYHJY7xwNyTmMqX5m7ajWWZgSSHqz1uD1gsgMXr.png) Na segunda rodada o adversário continuava resistindo muito bem. A redução do poder de ataque dos meus monstros fez bastante diferença durante a batalha. Além disso, seu Archon é um dos mais fortes da coleção **Conclave**, então não tenho dúvidas de que, em condições iguais, poderia ter vencido esse confronto. ![F.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/242hYVviHLM37LWGoqHxBsdNpcR7SNZJpGSh1D91iz814HPdiR1YdsaLMG25WTvwnQRBf.png) Ao final conseguimos eliminar praticamente toda a equipe adversária, restando apenas um monstro e, é claro, seu poderoso Exemplar, que possuía **Camouflage** e diversas outras habilidades. Foi justamente esse combate que me fez decidir qual caminho quero seguir com o meu Avatar. Pretendo construir um Exemplar voltado para suporte, com habilidades estratégicas e, se possível, adicionar também a habilidade **Mimic**. No caso do meu adversário, ele ainda conseguiu incorporar duas habilidades táticas concedidas pelo Archon, tornando seu Exemplar simplesmente insano.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23u5tiZ5Hex7c6zTraK4nx1LUxt6MQvDe77RgkypPdjdkcQDFf35perYsPtWaeYkZiVyD.png)
**Se este post foi útil para você, considere deixar seu upvote, compartilhar sua opinião nos comentários e fazer um reblog. Muito obrigado pelo apoio!** --- **Imagens:** @splinterlands ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tGvyDT7ASwcw8K6yCRtkHFf7wLshNrkTrgKytk1atFUboxso73BsMUSQBtk5qozjXAM.png) [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tw426MWpq8fAr4TjRAatv8RwXWtzcP357eShoipfuxkE1BHsWcWEbp8254ifYYmqBjS.png)](https://discord.gg/zYcJfq7tdQ) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@elderdark/enpt-better-late-than-never-learning-how-to-use-the-avatar-exemplar-lgw)

title.title: Un minuto para mí  (Es –En)
title.body:
<center>

![Audifonos para mi Gamer favorito (12).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mafalda2018/48UJ4rgeS9rsKJHakZnEchxgUJeNGL2GSBKgvmokJ5XyJNfhgMmpvMEpXmZpUwKMew.png)

</center>



# 
<center>
##  “Nuestras únicas limitaciones son las que establecemos en nuestra propia mente.” 
(Napoleón Hill)
</center>



<div class=\

> **¡Hola, comunidad #EmpowerTalent, les saludo desde la distancia, espero estén bien y dejo mis buenas vibras. Recuerden hacer un tiempo, tan solo un minuto, para hacer lo que desean. Aprovechen este regalo que les da la vida.** **¡Abrazos apretaditos y radiantes de luz!**

> >![ English] > >“Our only limitations are those we set in our own minds.” (Napoleon Hill) Hello, #EmpowerTalent community! I’m sending you my greetings from afar. I hope you’re all doing well, and I’m sending you my positive vibes. Remember to take a moment—just one minute—to do what you want. Make the most of this gift that life has given you. Big hugs filled with radiant light!
![Romantic and unforgettable melodies from the movies (4).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mafalda2018/Eqb5TEyS7esUDocsMK3FRUro4f3iM7ibkTcshdBURGtFKAGdGFjQZANWQnkx1JwWzwT.png)

>

No crean que soy una rebelde social, no es así, solo para algunas cosas. Sobre todo cuando se trata de los tabúes, paradigmas y estereotipos que se les inculcan a las personas y a veces hacen dudar sobre lo que es correcto. Lo cual, a estas alturas, está obsoleto y atenta contra la autoestima, el amor propio, la individualidad y la manera de ver la vida. Desde que somos niños nos cargan el chip y nos ponen “antojeras”, al igual que los caballos de carrera. 

Toda la información que queda guardada marca el destino; de ella dependerá el comportamiento y la conducta en la sociedad. Es todo un trabajo en equipo: padres, sociedad, educación, medios de comunicación, redes sociales, que se confabulan para hacer de las personas individuos miedosos, egoístas, competidores, entre otros. Si lo analizas, te darás cuenta de que es un complot y que la limitación más radical se refiere a “vivir para otras personas”.

Aunque no lo crean, siempre colocamos a los demás por encima de nuestros intereses y de lo que deseamos. Algunos no buscan un tiempo para sí mismos ni disfrutan de la vida. Solo se preocupan por satisfacer a “Perencejo”. En este grupo no me incluyo porque me gusta tener mi espacio, mí tiempo y decido qué hacer con ello. Por esto siempre digo:

—Un minuto para mí.

Considero que soy prioridad en mi vida. Quizás esté equivocada, pero a estas alturas no voy a cambiar. Ni por un minuto pensar en anteponer a otros por encima de mí; ¡qué va! Eso no es conmigo. Aunque muchos me llamen exagerada, dense cuenta de que cuando abres los ojos al mundo, ya tu subconsciente está programado. Todo quedó fijado y ni cuenta te diste; a partir de allí percibirás la vida y esto forma parte de un proceso mental, muy bien ejecutado. 

Después cuesta sustituirlo y algunas veces esto incide directamente en nuestra vida de adultos. Algunos especialistas indican que desde los cuatro años hasta los siete años, es la etapa crucial para cargar la información en los seres humanos. Por esta razón, hay que tener cuidado con los niños. A veces sus antenas capturan y perciben todo a su alrededor; lo que oyen, lo que ven. 

Según la página peru.unir.net, en un artículo titulado **“Principales procesos psicológicos y sus características”**, donde indica lo siguiente:

>”Los procesos psicológicos, conocidos también como procesos mentales o cognitivos, son mecanismos que se desarrollan a nivel cerebral y determinan la conducta y el comportamiento de las personas, así como la forma en que se adaptan y reaccionan a lo que sucede en su entorno…” Para más información visite <a href=\

> La sociedad impone y envía mensajes subliminales que afectan los procesos mentales de los seres humanos. El porqué de ellos, no lo sé, pero para mí no tienen sentido. La sociedad, en lugar de guiarnos y adoctrinarnos para ser felices y prósperos, por el contrario, nos inculca mantenernos angustiados, a tenerle miedo al dinero y al éxito, a no valorarnos. Sobre todo, a creer que no merecemos ser felices. Según los especialistas y estudiosos del cerebro y de la mente, sus procesos expresan que es la niñez donde los seres humanos son más susceptibles y son capaces de almacenar mucha información. Como digo, que más tarde es usada en nuestra contra. Sin embargo, lo más importante es que esos tabúes, paradigmas y estereotipos con trabajo y dedicación se pueden modificar. Hay que intentar reiniciar el chip para cambiar la manera de ver la vida y dejar de ser oveja que va detrás de otras al matadero. Pensar, cuestionar la sensibilidad, la empatía y buscar las cinco patas al gato hace que seas catalogado como “oveja negra” o diferente. Esto en realidad siempre ha sido un peligro y da miedo las personas que constantemente cuestionan el modelo, ya que ellos pueden cambiar el mundo lanzando la primera piedra en contra del sistema impuesto. A la sociedad no le importa el amor ni la felicidad, sino que consumas bienes y servicios. Mientras más trabajes y gastes, más manipulables somos los seres humanos. En definitiva, hay que aprender a borrar toda la información del chip, reiniciar los procesos mentales para poder fortalecernos y asumir los desafíos que nos impone la vida. Y la buena noticia es que sí se puede lograr con dedicación y práctica.

>

>![ English]
>
> Don’t think I’m a social rebel—I’m not. It’s just in certain areas. Especially when it comes to the taboos, paradigms, and stereotypes that are instilled in people and sometimes make them doubt what’s right. Which, at this point, is obsolete and undermines self-esteem, self-respect, individuality, and one’s outlook on life. From the time we’re children, they implant that “chip” in us and put “blinders” on us, just like racehorses. 
All the information that gets stored shapes our destiny; our behavior and conduct in society will depend on it. It’s a true team effort: parents, society, the education system, the media, and social media all conspire to turn people into fearful, selfish, and competitive individuals, among other things. If you analyze it, you’ll realize that it’s a conspiracy and that the most radical limitation is “living for other people.”
Believe it or not, we always put others before our own interests and desires. Some people don’t make time for themselves or enjoy life. They only worry about pleasing “Perencejo.” I don’t count myself among this group because I like having my own space and time, and I decide what to do with it. That’s why I always say:
—A minute for me.
I consider myself a priority in my life. Maybe I’m wrong, but at this point, I’m not going to change. Not even for a minute would I think about putting others before myself—no way! That’s just not me. Even though many call me dramatic, realize that when you open your eyes to the world, your subconscious is already programmed. Everything was set in stone without you even realizing it; from that point on, you’ll perceive life, and this is part of a mental process—one that’s executed very well.
It’s difficult to replace it later, and sometimes this has a direct impact on our adult lives. Some experts indicate that the period from age four to seven is a crucial stage for information retention in humans. For this reason, we must be careful with children. Sometimes their “antennas” pick up and perceive everything around them—what they hear, what they see. 
According to the website peru.unir.net, in an article titled “Major Psychological Processes and Their Characteristics,” the following is stated:
>“Psychological processes, also known as mental or cognitive processes, are mechanisms that take place in the brain and determine people’s conduct and behavior, as well as the way they adapt to and react to what is happening in their environment…” For more information, visit <a href=\

>aquí Society imposes and sends subliminal messages that affect human mental processes. I don’t know why it does this, but to me, it makes no sense. Instead of guiding and teaching us to be happy and prosperous, society, on the contrary, instills in us a sense of anxiety, a fear of money and success, and a lack of self-worth. Above all, it teaches us to believe that we don’t deserve to be happy. According to experts and scholars of the brain and mind, their research shows that childhood is when human beings are most susceptible and capable of storing a great deal of information. As I said, this information is later used against us. However, the most important thing is that these taboos, paradigms, and stereotypes can be changed through hard work and dedication. Thinking, questioning sensitivity and empathy, and looking for the catch in everything leads to being labeled a “black sheep” or “different.” This has actually always been a danger, and people who constantly question the status quo are frightening, since they can change the world by being the first to cast a stone against the imposed system. Society doesn’t care about love or happiness; it cares only that you consume goods and services. The more you work and spend, the more easily we humans can be manipulated. Ultimately, we must learn to erase all the information from the chip and reset our mental processes so we can strengthen ourselves and take on the challenges life throws at us. And the good news is that it can be achieved with dedication and practice.
![Audifonos para mi Gamer favorito (13).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mafalda2018/48WhrcvM9RUse4gHR3PX1uXrejZv5h15TpjMFGKwJndUWuoWMJkK5USXBUvgXUUmQR.jpg)

>

##  Un minuto para mí 

Uno de los tantos paradigmas que considero muy relevante como individuos es que vivimos para otras personas y lo que sentimos no importa. Hay que dejar de lado muchas cosas para satisfacer a otras personas. Difiero de esto y nunca me ha importado lo que digan los demás. Quisieron hacerme creer que es egoísmo pensar solo en mí y que tengo que anteponer mis deseos; pues no lo acepto, siempre busco momentos para mí y para hacer lo que me gusta. 

Considero sumamente importante dedicar tiempo para mí y hacer las cosas a mi manera. En toda mi vida, sobre todo de casada, nunca he dejado de ir a la playa o de shopping porque tengo que limpiar o lavar. Ya que eso puede esperar, pero la persona que me invitó quizás después no lo haga.

—Un minuto para mí.

Todo el tiempo que yo decida pues soy la única que puedo disponer de él.  Así soy para todo y, sobre este tema en mi país, son muy arcaicos. Tengo amigas a las que dejé de preguntarles cómo les fue el fin de semana porque siempre respondían lo mismo: “lavando, limpiando y cocinando”. Otro punto es que, si nos atrevemos a nombrarnos en primer lugar, siempre dicen: 

\

Cabe destacar que la Real Academia estableció que la primera persona es el “yo”, y se conjuga primero. Una cosa es una cosa, y es entendible que hay que ser educados, y otra muy diferente es pretender que toda la vida seamos pendejos y los últimos. El bienestar de los demás esté primero que mi tranquilidad. Quizás es un proceso que no se entiende, pero yo tengo que estar bien y en equilibrio para ayudar a otras personas. 

Otro aspecto que llama la atención es que inculcan que no nos merecemos lo que tenemos y lo que logramos. Si nos elogian, enseguida dicen: \

. Pues, no es así, como que es “nada”. Se trabajó con dedicación, noches de sueños para conseguir el éxito. Desde cualquier punto de vista, nos merecemos lograr las metas, objetivos y proyectos de vida. En cuanto a la abundancia y la prosperidad, es el caso más patético. Nos inculcan que el dinero es malo y que tenemos que ser humildes. Pues les diré que el dinero no tiene que ver con la humildad y ni siquiera son sinónimos. Por otro lado, ser pobre es una condición que, con estudios, preparación, habilidades y destrezas, cualquier ser humano puede cambiar. No es pecado ser una persona próspera y tener dinero. Mi reflexión de hoy, sobre el ser humano y los procesos mentales. Destaco que nada está dicho a ciencia cierta; cada día aparecen nuevos avances en la tecnología, psicología, la medicina y otros, que pueden en un momento dado cambiar la vida de los seres humanos. Es necesario que desde nuestro interior bloqueemos lo que nos impide crecer y ser felices. Pues la sociedad siempre será la misma y esto no se puede cambiar. Pero sí podemos modificar nuestra manera de pensar. Considero que no hay que sentirse culpables por darnos “un minuto de nuestra vida” para nuestro bienestar, atendernos, mimarnos, abrazarnos, hablarnos amablemente. Sobre todo tener amor propio. ¡Ahí se las dejo! #
## “No vemos las cosas como son, las vemos como somos nosotros.” (Anaïs Nin)

> >![ English] > >A Minute for Myself One of the many paradigms I consider very relevant to us as individuals is that we live for other people and what we feel doesn’t matter. We have to put a lot of things aside to please others. I disagree with this, and I’ve never cared what others say. They tried to make me believe that it’s selfish to think only of myself and that I have to put my own desires first; well, I don’t accept that—I always make time for myself and to do what I enjoy. I think it’s extremely important to set aside time for myself and do things my way. In my entire life—especially since getting married—I’ve never stopped going to the beach or shopping just because I have to clean or do laundry. Those things can wait, but the person who invited me might not do so again later. —A minute for myself. As much time as I decide, because I’m the only one who can decide how to spend it. That’s how I am about everything, and in my country, people are very old-fashioned when it comes to this issue. I have friends I stopped asking how their weekend went because they always gave the same answer: “doing laundry, cleaning, and cooking.” Another thing is that, if we dare to put ourselves first, they always say: “The Donkey in Front” It’s worth noting that the Royal Academy established that the first-person pronoun is “yo,” and it is conjugated first. It’s one thing to be polite—and that’s understandable—but it’s quite another to expect us to be idiots and always come in last our whole lives. The well-being of others comes before my own peace of mind. Perhaps it’s a process that isn’t understood, but I have to be well and in balance to help other people. Another striking aspect is that they instill in us the idea that we don’t deserve what we have and what we’ve achieved. If we’re praised, they immediately say, “You’re welcome.” Well, that’s not how it is—as if it were “nothing.” We worked with dedication, sacrificing nights of sleep to achieve success. From any point of view, we deserve to achieve our goals, objectives, and life projects. As for abundance and prosperity, that’s the most pathetic case of all. We’re taught that money is bad and that we have to be humble. Well, let me tell you that money has nothing to do with humility—they aren’t even synonyms. On the other hand, being poor is a condition that any human being can change through education, training, and skills. It’s not a sin to be prosperous and have money. My reflection today is on human beings and mental processes. I want to emphasize that nothing is set in stone; every day, new advances emerge in technology, psychology, medicine, and other fields that can, at any given moment, change people’s lives. We need to block out from within ourselves whatever prevents us from growing and being happy. Society will always be the same, and that cannot be changed. But we can change the way we think. I believe we shouldn't feel guilty about taking “a minute of our lives” for our well-being—to take care of ourselves, pamper ourselves, hug ourselves, and speak kindly to ourselves. Above all, we need to have self-love. There you go! “We don’t see things as they are; we see them as we are.” (Anaïs Nin)
![Audifonos para mi Gamer favorito (14).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mafalda2018/48b39Bds2avfyoHiq2iemX78TH6p311y8JTSD4Aie3H22wXD3x9oKU4tRH5XXYCL3h.png)

> En la actualidad, algunos seres humanos han cambiado su manera de pensar y se preguntan qué es verdad y qué es mentira. En realidad, no es significativo porque no se puede cambiar la sociedad, solo adaptarse. Sin embargo, sí es fundamental aprender a quererse y entender que merecemos lo que tenemos y mucho más. Sobre todo hay que aprender a observar para saber identificar: ¿quién es el manipulador? Todo lo anterior para sacar a esas personas manipuladoras, controladoras y tóxicas de nuestra vida. Así proteger nuestra salud mental, lograr el equilibrio y el bienestar. Recuerden decir: primero yo, segundo yo y tercero yo, y después vienen los demás. Abracito de luz y gracias por visitar el blog en #Hive. ## Namasté #
## “La mente que se abre a una nueva idea, jamás volverá a su tamaño original.” (Albert Einstein)

> >![ English] > > These days, some people have changed their way of thinking and are asking themselves what is true and what is a lie. In reality, it doesn’t really matter because we can’t change society—we can only adapt to it. However, it is essential to learn to love ourselves and understand that we deserve what we have—and much more. Above all, we must learn to observe so we can identify: Who is the manipulator? All of this is to remove those manipulative, controlling, and toxic people from our lives. That way, we can protect our mental health and achieve balance and well-being. Remember to say: first me, second me, and third me—and then come the others. A little hug of light, and thank you for visiting the blog on #Hive. title.title: En un mundo de Pinochos y jueces, ¿la verdad se oculta tras una mentira? [esp-eng]
title.body:
<center>![1000034233.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/1000034233.png)</center>

En algunas instancias pasadas planteé mi punto de vista ante la percepción de las cosas y las perspectivas de las mismas, pero leer a mi buen amigo y familia a la distancia, @amigoponc, me llevó a una arista fuerte y muchas veces minimizada.

​Hoy en día vivimos en un mundo abierto, es decir, todos saben “todo” de todos, cuando esto ni siquiera es realmente verdadero. Anteriormente había planteado cómo muchos caen ante la IA con fotos editadas que parecen realmente fidedignas; no obstante, hay muchas de estas ediciones que pasan de lo normal, haciendo caricaturas de la vida real. Es como si el manipulador de la herramienta creara fábulas cotidianas, dando roles humanos a los animales.

​En este ámbito, habíamos vislumbrado que son los adultos mayores quienes más caen y son los niños los más perspicaces, pero este rol se invertía al momento de la interacción en línea, ya que el adulto “sospecha” mientras el niño “confía”.

​Y es ahí donde @amigoponc dice: [«Nos vendieron el cuento de que \
… mentira. Hoy, una imagen vale más que mil \

»](https://ecency.com/@amigoponc/esp-eng-el-laberinto-de).

​Y es que la manipulación digital es una fuente extensa que pareciera inagotable —un recurso sobreusado, diría yo—, porque al final de cuentas, tras la imagen o el video ni siquiera sabemos cuánta humanidad real hay allí. No obstante, muchos prefieren confiar, no porque no duden de si es real o no, sino porque más bien asienten por temor a la “exclusión” de la verdad absoluta que alguien más creó para ellos a través de una fría pantalla.

<center>![1000034234.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uQnHkk5XHnm9ksBnLjus5Uczyd95dBg3LEJA8FgJiGMzbPoxUcNpoXanVdb2rZwzPmR.png)</center>


​Podríamos decir que el mundo de un escritor escapa de su mente a sus páginas, y de las páginas al mundo real, donde en cada párrafo algo nace: conflictos, amores y desamores. Pero, ¿y dónde queda el libre albedrío entonces? Porque nadie puede manipular el pensamiento a menos que nosotros mismos dejemos que esto ocurra y, peor aún, cuando somos nosotros mismos quienes tergiversamos la realidad para que no nos duela tanto.

​Lamentablemente, en este sentido, muchas veces no deambulamos por el punto medio, y de tanto en tanto saltamos a los extremos:

**​Confianza ciega**: Aquí no cuestionamos nada y, aunque nos mientan en las narices, vamos confiando de manera absurda y dañina. 
Creamos una vulnerabilidad que se convierte en repetitiva y, ante eventos de traumas y malas vivencias, pasamos a la arista siguiente: una desconfianza extrema.

**​Desconfianza extrema**: En este punto suponemos que todo tiene una segunda intención, donde todo y todos son malos para nosotros, creando personas cerradas y carentes de confianza.
***
En un mundo que mayormente grita que aquello que nos han dicho es la verdad absoluta, prefiero pecar de incrédula y desconfiar; porque es más fácil sorprendernos de la realidad y pedir disculpas, que creer y confiar a ciegas para caer en un pozo sin salida segura.

***​No siempre el cielo es azul y no siempre Pinocho dice mentiras.***

​A mi modo de ver, prefiero mirar con mis propios ojos, analizar la situación, escuchar hipótesis y sacar mis conclusiones. No siempre tendré la verdad o la razón, pero muy pocas veces me encontrarán una mentira, porque ¿para qué inventar algo que tiene patas cortas y se sabrá más temprano que tarde?

<center>![1000034235.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xyZ11bwViXdDSKPr9tbN4isS6VLSMTWuJqYZkzMi9wxQjTP6xXuLEt9Ae2zm4wDpFMU.png)</center>

***
### <center>English</center>
***

<center>![1000034233.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/1000034233.png)</center> 

On a few previous occasions, I’ve set out my point of view regarding how we perceive things and the perspectives we hold on them, but reading the posts of my good friend and family member from afar, @amigoponc, brought home a significant aspect that is often overlooked.

​Nowadays we live in an open world; in other words, everyone knows ‘everything’ about everyone else, when this isn’t even really true. I had previously discussed how many people are taken in by AI-generated, edited photos that appear genuinely authentic; however, many of these edits go beyond the norm, turning real life into caricatures. It is as if the person using the tool were creating everyday fables, assigning human roles to animals.

​In this context, we had observed that it is older adults who are most likely to be taken in, whilst children are the most perceptive; yet this dynamic is reversed when it comes to online interaction, as adults tend to be ‘suspicious’ whilst children tend to ‘trust’.

​And that’s where @amigoponc says: [‘They sold us the line that “a picture is worth a thousand words”… a lie. Today, a picture is worth a thousand “manipulations”’](https://ecency.com/@amigoponc/esp-eng-el-laberinto-de).

​The fact is that digital manipulation is a vast and seemingly inexhaustible source — an overused resource, I would say — because, at the end of the day, behind the image or video, we don’t even know how much real humanity there actually is. Nevertheless, many prefer to trust it, not because they don’t doubt whether it’s real or not, but rather because they go along with it out of fear of being ‘excluded’ from the absolute truth that someone else has created for them via a cold screen.

<center>![1000034234.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uQnHkk5XHnm9ksBnLjus5Uczyd95dBg3LEJA8FgJiGMzbPoxUcNpoXanVdb2rZwzPmR.png)</center> 

We could say that a writer’s world escapes from their mind onto the page, and from the page into the real world, where something is born in every paragraph: conflicts, loves and heartbreaks. But where, then, does free will fit in? Because no one can manipulate our thoughts unless we ourselves allow it to happen – and, worse still, when we are the ones who distort reality so that it doesn’t hurt us so much.

​Unfortunately, in this regard, we often fail to tread the middle ground, and from time to time we swing to the extremes:

**​Blind trust**: Here we question nothing and, even when we’re being lied to right to our faces, we continue to trust in an absurd and harmful way. 
We create a vulnerability that becomes a recurring pattern and, when faced with trauma or bad experiences, we move on to the next extreme: extreme mistrust.

**Extreme mistrust**: At this point, we assume that everything has an ulterior motive, that everything and everyone is out to get us, turning us into closed-off, untrusting people.
***
In a world that largely proclaims that what we’ve been told is the absolute truth, I prefer to err on the side of scepticism and mistrust; because it’s easier to be surprised by reality and apologise, than to believe and trust blindly, only to fall into a pit with no safe way out.

***​The sky isn’t always blue, and Pinocchio doesn’t always tell lies.***

​As I see it, I prefer to see things with my own eyes, analyse the situation, listen to hypotheses and draw my own conclusions. I won’t always have the truth or be in the right, but you’ll very rarely catch me in a lie, because why make something up that won’t hold water and will be found out sooner rather than later?

<center>![1000034235.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xyZ11bwViXdDSKPr9tbN4isS6VLSMTWuJqYZkzMi9wxQjTP6xXuLEt9Ae2zm4wDpFMU.png)</center> 
***
<center>![1000009838.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tbikLyE8Cv6ctyG8KyiR6HZ7Hd2JSAq7evbE5rrDfvjuHR5TcPBY4D8Jy2bToBZP5R4.png)</center>

title.title: The Face of the Indian and The Sun of the Deer - A Venezuelan Legend that reveals the Mountain Itself- (EN/ES)
title.body:
<center>![inglés 5660784f-17d3-4510-bfcf-ebe8e5de223e.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/Eqd7bQP3ks88gr95X8yMJKQuAFPkBqcK2W3gp7WDP7Hxgym96QppmWcax58uprZbe6q.jpg)</center>

###### <center>*5 days ago our dear friend @damarysvibra from whom we have received so many life lessons many of the content creators that here on #Hive we publish, gave us **[a beautiful article](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/los-verdaderos-lujosoror-true-luxuries)** that tells us about the true luxuries of life, because, despite the misfortune that Venezuela has suffered, we still have reasons to be grateful for, such as time, health, good company, mental tranquility, emotional control and, above all, the internal freedom to make each of our decisions.*</center>
 
###### <center>*She also gives us a wonderful image of nature that makes us happy, and which, even if it seems taken out of context at a moment when what we are observing is destruction, There are details that our beautiful land of **Venezuela** gives us and that spur us to keep hope and to remind ourselves that we are bound to a greater will and the universe.*</center>


<center>![ae0766bc-4c46-4039-a27d-d83a38fa7880.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/245Svii7edph5PmQHVKCSrong4Y4ectZTmT2YYtYudmZXUTVvoNHjDJRpKMCbaWawPrZH.jpg)</center>
> ***<center>The Mountain The Face of the Indian illuminated by the Sun of the Deer, from the kitchen of my friend Inés Salazar’s house in the city of Mérida; a city of legends.</center>***

<div class=\

>

### Clinging to the beautiful

*These images show an area of the Sierra Nevada de Mérida in our country, Venezuela.*

This is a mountain range with mountainous formations that since the ancient inhabitants have carried by names that allude to stories, myths and legends.

In this case, this mountain formation is called **\

**, and is located in the Sierra de la Culata National Park in the beautiful state of Mérida. A formation that is very photographed at sunsets, as it offers a characteristic golden, orange or red coloration like the one we see in the photographs. There are moments when this mountain formation is illuminated with golden colors, a product of the sun and that people call: **The sun of deer.** These mountain colors are appreciated in regions like the Venezuelan plains and at that time of the afternoon they are illuminated with this tonality. *In this case, on this mountain of the Sierra Nevada, the deer sun, between 4:30 p.m. and 6 p.m., which lowers the temperature, deer come out to graze while the sun illuminates the large cliffs.* Thus, the face of the Indian is illuminated and we see the shape of a man who, according to Venezuelan indigenous legends, is the profile of a warrior.
![5660784f-17d3-4510-bfcf-ebe8e5de223e (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/245wB9E5j8BDy5Gxfx2pTRkRktysGew2tYM5jhFkY1Znckv3tf9eEJPj8JpL6k8GAjbjk.jpg)
*
The Face of the Indian illuminated by the Sun of the Deer: In Mérida, Venezuela. This is a photo for the contest: **[Around The World: Challenge - #8/7](https://peakd.com/hive-184437/@bucipuci/around-the-world-challenge-87)** By @bucipuci on @TravelFeed
* ### The sleeping Indians But in the mountains of Merida there is not only this sleeping Indian warrior; another nearby mountain, which is also illuminated in this way, called The Face of India, to the south, is part of the same legend. *They are the two sleeping lovers, the warrior and the Indian princess, punished by a forbidden love of eternal sleep, and will wake up when the lovers can kiss.* The spell has put them to sleep, they are not dead, only condemned to eternal sleep for having defied the laws of their tribes and the suggestions of their parents.
![ae1a499a-3fc1-447c-90f1-fbd4f38ad70c.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/243BZxwcHEibdjiweUCbvxstm12LtLDbgVjfgLbD4VhmY2rzyG346c59xKVsoSTiPy1jb.jpg)
### A seismic zone In fact, this mountain range is a seismic zone due to geological faults that often offer tremors to the inhabitants of that area. *People say that when this happens it’s not tremors or earthquakes, it’s the two lovers, the Warrior and the Princess trying to wake up, moving to meet again in a kiss.* The legend claims that when the face of the Indian and the face of the Indian, due to a tremor, finally unite in a kiss, the spell will break, waking up those two Andean giants.
![ae0766bc-4c46-4039-a27d-d83a38fa7880.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/245Sw9LaLTd44rDVCQu7QXagDB56k2reGWmPWog2Y6mY7rSdE7kM8Cidi5B2reniPWyEX.jpg)
### Venezuela is a country of pain, legend and hope *Today, as the text @damarysvibra says, when the children of Venezuela mourn a tragedy and pray to God to give us resilience, mercy and strength to understand and endure what we cannot change, we also ask for faith and hope to rebuild this beautiful country.* A country that we love so much and which also, with its landscapes and its stories, reminds us that many of us still have health today, the possibility to serve and work for those who suffer, to have peace of mind and also allow us to appreciate the wonderful environment in which we live.
![0c03b332-2ddd-461a-9e78-030c3089264c.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/2449vDbJ53mWX3TtiP8BzfwXLeNy25b5xgv6JeRC82TDvrKkBqfZRpShzkwedMr8y4sjD.jpg)
### I know we will succeed in building a better country and a better destiny I know we will continue to fight to stay together and recover all the years that we have not been able to enjoy together. *The phrase @damarysvibra gives us five fundamental pillars of life, such as health, good company, time, peace of mind and freedom of choice.* Today they are much more valuable in the face of tragedy and the wonder of nature that reminds us that we can always move forward.
*That today we unite to support all those who suffer in this beautiful country.*
***And that all of us, at some point, can bet on a better future and for a stronger and more beautiful community to live in.***
![línea azul Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/246a5qLEPyuzfoPXf9x464sPUzemkfM1SU44tvENYZ8R2u9n9XcpS2W7p8ZMECyXESpxh.png)
![español .png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/Eo1utJaU7NTfyfbuh2V2KL1xMwLfAiBaT2TqykgQLsjBFUy7zkhCQB4KEKSL8ADJGDP.png)
#
La Cara del Indio y El Sol de los Venados -Una leyenda Venezolana que nos revela la Montaña-
![español 5660784f-17d3-4510-bfcf-ebe8e5de223e.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/Eqd7bQP3ks88gr95X8yMJKQuAFPkBqcJxx2dyyubrn4UHHhqQs6HJVGfruebMho2R9n.jpg)
######
*Hace 5 días nuestra querida amiga @damarysvibra de quien hemos obtenido tantas lecciones de vida muchos de los creadores de contenido que aquí en #Hive publicamos, nos regaló **[un hermoso artículo](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/los-verdaderos-lujosoror-true-luxuries)** que nos habla de los verdaderos lujos de la vida, ya que a pesar de la desgracia que ha sufrido Venezuela, aún nos quedan razones por las cuales estar agradecidos, como el tiempo, la salud, la buena compañía, la tranquilidad mental, el control emocional y, sobre todo, la libertad interna de tomar cada una de nuestras decisiones.*
######
*Ella, además, nos regala una imagen maravillosa de la naturaleza que nos alegra, y que, aunque parezca sacado de contexto en un momento donde lo que observamos es destrucción, hay detalles que nos regala nuestra bella tierra de **Venezuela** y que nos impulsan a mantener la esperanza y a recordarnos que estamos ligados a una voluntad mayor y al universo.*
![ae0766bc-4c46-4039-a27d-d83a38fa7880.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/245Svii7edph5PmQHVKCSrong4Y4ectZTmT2YYtYudmZXUTVvoNHjDJRpKMCbaWawPrZH.jpg)
>
***La montaña La Cara del Indio iluminada por el Sol de los Venados, desde la cocina de la casa de mi amiga Inés Salazar en la ciudad de Mérida; una ciudad de leyendas.***

> ### Aferrándonos a lo hermoso *Estas imágenes muestran una zona de la Sierra Nevada de Mérida en nuestro país, Venezuela.* Esta es una cordillera con formaciones montañosas que desde los antiguos habitantes han llevado por nombres los que aluden a historias, mitos y leyendas. En este caso, esta formación montañosa se llama **“La cara del indio”**, y se encuentra en el Parque Nacional Sierra de la Culata en el hermoso estado Mérida. Una formación que es muy fotografiada en los atardeceres, pues ofrece una coloración característica dorada, anaranjada o roja como la que vemos en las fotografías. Es que existen momentos en que esta formación montañosa se ilumina de colores dorados producto del sol y que la gente llama: **El sol de los venados**. Estas coloraciones de las montañas se aprecian en regiones como los llanos venezolanos y a esa hora de la tarde se iluminan con esta tonalidad. *En este caso, en esta montaña de la Sierra Nevada, el sol de los venados, entre las 4:30 y las 6 de la tarde, que baja la temperatura, los venados salen a pastar mientras el sol ilumina los grandes riscos.* Así, la cara del indio se ilumina y vemos la forma de un hombre que, según leyendas indígenas venezolanas, es el perfil de un guerrero.
![5660784f-17d3-4510-bfcf-ebe8e5de223e (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/245wB9E5j8BDy5Gxfx2pTRkRktysGew2tYM5jhFkY1Znckv3tf9eEJPj8JpL6k8GAjbjk.jpg)
*
La Cara del Indio iluminada por el Sol de los Venados: En Mérida, Venezuela. Esta es la fotografía para: **[Around The World: Challenge - #8/7](https://peakd.com/hive-184437/@bucipuci/around-the-world-challenge-87)** realizado por @bucipuci en @TravelFeed
* ### Los indios dormidos Pero en las montañas merideñas no solo existe este indio guerrero dormido; otra montaña cercana, que también se ilumina de esta manera, llamada La cara de la India, al sur, es parte de la misma leyenda. *Son los dos amantes dormidos, el guerrero y la princesa india, castigados por un amor prohibido al sueño eterno, y despertarán, cuando puedan darse el beso de los amantes.* El hechizo los ha dormido, no están muertos, solo condenados al sueño eterno por haber desafiado las leyes de sus tribus y las sugerencias de sus padres.
![ae1a499a-3fc1-447c-90f1-fbd4f38ad70c.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/243BZxwcHEibdjiweUCbvxstm12LtLDbgVjfgLbD4VhmY2rzyG346c59xKVsoSTiPy1jb.jpg)
### Una zona sísmica De hecho, esta cordillera es una zona sísmica por fallas geológicas que con frecuencia ofrecen temblores a los habitantes de esa zona. *La gente dice que cuando esto ocurre no son temblores o terremotos, son los dos amantes, el Guerrero y la Princesa tratando de despertarse, moviéndose para reencontrarse de nuevo en un beso.* La leyenda asegura que cuando la cara del indio y la cara de la india, debido a un temblor, finalmente se unan en un beso, el hechizo se romperá, despertando a esos dos gigantes andinos.
![ae0766bc-4c46-4039-a27d-d83a38fa7880.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/245Sw9LaLTd44rDVCQu7QXagDB56k2reGWmPWog2Y6mY7rSdE7kM8Cidi5B2reniPWyEX.jpg)
### Venezuela es un país de dolor, leyenda y de esperanza *Hoy, como dice el texto que nos regaló @damarysvibra, cuando los hijos de Venezuela lloran una tragedia y ruegan a Dios nos dé resiliencia, misericordia y fuerza para entender y soportar lo que no podemos cambiar, pedimos también por la fe y la esperanza para reconstruir este hermoso país.* Un país que tanto amamos y que también, con sus paisajes y sus historias, nos recuerda que muchos, hoy en día, aún tenemos salud, posibilidad de servir y trabajar por aquellos que sufren, tener paz mental y permitirnos además poder apreciar el entorno tan maravilloso en el que vivimos.
![0c03b332-2ddd-461a-9e78-030c3089264c.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/2449vDbJ53mWX3TtiP8BzfwXLeNy25b5xgv6JeRC82TDvrKkBqfZRpShzkwedMr8y4sjD.jpg)
### Sé que vamos a lograr construir un mejor país y un mejor destino Sé que vamos a seguir luchando para mantenernos unidos y recuperar todos los años que no hemos podido disfrutar juntos. *La frase que nos regala @damarysvibra recoge cinco pilares de vida fundamentales, como son la salud, buena compañía, el tiempo, la mente en paz y la libertad de elección.* Hoy tienen un valor mucho mayor ante la tragedia y ante la maravilla de una naturaleza que nos recuerda que siempre podemos seguir adelante.
*Que hoy nos unamos para apoyar a todos aquellos que sufren en este hermoso país.*
***Y que todos, en un momento determinado, podamos apostar por un mejor futuro y porque tengamos una comunidad más sólida y hermosa en la que vivir.***
![línea azul Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/246a5qLEPyuzfoPXf9x464sPUzemkfM1SU44tvENYZ8R2u9n9XcpS2W7p8ZMECyXESpxh.png)

title.title: The first fully autonomous flight.
title.body:
> While much of the world debates how to train pilots and adapt regulations for flying cars, Chinese engineers chose a radically different path: eliminating the pilot entirely. EHang has established itself as a global leader in autonomous aerial mobility with the EH216-S—the first electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) vehicle to secure all necessary certifications for mass production and commercial operations—and the most impressive feature is that there is no one at the controls.


There are no joysticks, pedals, or traditional instruments; passengers simply step inside, fasten their seatbelts, and select their destination on a screen. From that point on, artificial intelligence algorithms handle all navigation. Throughout the flight, ground control centers monitor the journey in real time via high-speed communication networks, with the ability to take remote control or order an emergency landing should any anomaly be detected.


The vehicle's entire architecture was built around the concept of redundancy. Its structure utilizes 16 propellers driven by 16 independent electric motors distributed across eight dual-arm mounts surrounding the carbon-fiber cabin. The system carries up to two passengers, supports a payload of approximately 220 kg, and reaches speeds of up to 130 km/h, with sufficient range for urban trips of around 30 km; should a motor fail, the others automatically adjust power distribution to maintain flight stability.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y-SqrXr7JAw
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> Reaching this stage, however, required a grueling marathon of testing; over the course of three years, the aircraft was subjected to simulated cyberattacks, deliberate GPS signal loss, and extreme weather scenarios. Engineers put the EHang through its paces in high winds, intense heat, sub-zero temperatures, and even situations involving intentionally induced mechanical failures. In some tests, four of the 16 motors were shut down simultaneously mid-flight; yet, algorithms redistributed power to the remaining rotors in fractions of a second, keeping the aircraft stable.


Unlike many futuristic prototypes, this platform is already generating revenue today. The EHang is sold to operators and government agencies for around $410,000. In cities like Shenzhen and Guangzhou, tourists pay between $40 and $60 for scenic flights lasting approximately 15 minutes. Furthermore, specialized versions are already being used to transport cargo in mountainous regions and even to fight skyscraper fires, deploying foam-launching systems in areas inaccessible to conventional fire trucks.


The progress made by EHang suggests that the future of urban air mobility may not rely on thousands of human pilots; the real challenge will be learning to trust autonomous systems capable of making their own decisions as they transport us through city skies.

Español #### La tierra habla

> Hoy la tierra ha hablado, hoy la tierra ha cambiado, hoy la tierra se llevó a decenas, hoy la tierra destruyó años de esfuerzo. Hoy los escombros son testigos de la catástrofe, que fluyó desde el interior rugiente de la tierra. Las lágrimas corren como ríos caudalosos por la muerte de los amados, por el terror de lo inesperado. Los gritos vuelan al cosmos invocando protección celestial, ante el movimiento mortal. El movimiento que destruye y mata. La vida se va en un suspiro de tiempo. La mujer corre, el niño llora, el hombre trata de proteger, pero la violencia de la tierra es más poderosa. En cada segundo, arranca una sonrisa inocente, unos ojos sinceros, un amor sincero, un cuerpo que se sacrifica. Los edificios caen como naipes frágiles, pero letales para quien resguardan en su interior. El polvo se levanta llevando consigo, el dolor, la muerte y los gritos desesperados de los desafortunados. Mil almas se lleva el movimiento mortal, mil o tal vez más. Volaron al firmamento sin poderse despedir, en un suspiro perdieron su existencia terrenal. Se fueron entre los llantos y la desesperación de quien quedaron sin nada, heridos, atrapados. Ahora todo ha pasado. Ahora queda volver a empezar, desde cero. Ahora la resiliencia humana brota como una cascada incontenible. Reconstruir lo que perdieron en 39 segundos, Tal vez menos, tal vez más. Para los que lo vivieron, una eternidad en sufrimiento. Oramos por aquellas almas perdidas entre escombros, por aquellas almas heridas, por aquellas almas desaparecidas, por aquellas almas que volaron. Oramos por Venezuela y la pronta recuperación de la vida que un 24 de junio cambió para muchos. Siempre en las memorias, quedará como cicatriz de experiencia. *** ![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg) ***
Inglés #### The earth speaks
Today the earth has spoken, today the earth has changed, today the earth took dozens, today the earth destroyed years of effort. The rubble today they are witnesses of the catastrophe, that flowed from the inside roaring of the earth. Tears run like rivers mighty by death of the beloved, by the terror of the unexpected. The screams fly to the cosmos invoking heavenly protection, before the deadly movement. The movement that destroys and kills. Life goes away in a breath of time. The woman runs, the child cries, the man try to protect, but the violence of the earth she's more powerful. In every second, start an innocent smile, sincere eyes, a sincere love, a body that is sacrificed. The buildings are falling as fragile, but lethal playing cards for those who keep inside. The dust rises carrying i get, the pain, the death and the desperate cries of the unfortunate ones. A thousand souls takes the movement deadly, a thousand or maybe more. They flew to the sky without being able to say goodbye, in a breath they have lost their earthly existence. They left among the cries and the despair of the one who they were left with nothing, injured, trapped. Now everything has happened. Now it remains to start again, from scratch. Now for human resilience it gushes like an irrepressible waterfall. Rebuilding what they lost in 39 seconds, Maybe less, maybe more. For those who lived it, an eternity in suffering. We pray for those souls lost in the rubble, for those wounded souls, for those missing souls, for those souls that have flown. We pray for Venezuela and the speedy recovery of the life that a June 24 it changed for many. Always in the memories, it will remain as a scar of experience. *** ![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)

title.title: 红叔翻车
title.body:
![1-2865b8ec04d0.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mr1eoh5q-st5n98fj/1-2865b8ec04d0.webp)

![2-55f8aa2cd6cc.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mr1eoh5q-st5n98fj/2-55f8aa2cd6cc.webp)

![3-f90cc2cfc7e4.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mr1eoh5q-st5n98fj/3-f90cc2cfc7e4.webp)

![4-186a0da22def.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mr1eoh5q-st5n98fj/4-186a0da22def.webp)

![5-71a0087d48b1.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/huigezi/lkt-mr1eoh5q-st5n98fj/5-71a0087d48b1.webp)

这几天，打开了新闻就会收到著名以慈善人设行走娱乐圈的韩红的新闻！红叔基金会遭人病诟！红叔基金会遭人病诟的主要原因是什么呢！她的资金来源一直都是平凡的你我他，普通人的每一次捐款，按时月捐！但是红叔基金会的钱的走向是各大医院，给各大医院送救护车，而且红叔和各大医疗器械平台有所关联！高管的工资达到40万！并且有很多实实在在的苦难人群和病人向红叔基金会求助！遭遇无情拒绝！理由是对公不对私！不对个人进行救助！


红叔利用自己的慈善人设！给著名的外国籍导演冯小刚的割韭菜烂片《抓特务》站台宣传，号召大家给个面，走个面！匪气十足！这话本身没什么问题！谁没有江湖人情世故呢！但是放大到对公众大家的场合，就显示的那么多不合时宜的！全民负债人数达到了9个亿，多少个家庭全面逾期，负债累累，在经历着水深火热的经济下行，你一个以慈善人设行走的公众人物，为一个外国人站台（抓特务）！谁是特务？说得清楚吗！？显得那么的可笑！

做慈善很难，众口难调！红叔翻车了，红叔的采访说，希望大家都节俭过日子！她自己本身穿金戴银的，一身的奢侈品！很多说法和自己的行为自相矛盾！更不要说高档的各种相机360度无死角跟拍了！

红叔的最大问题是，每个人捐助的钱，都给了资本，而真正需要帮助的个体没有受到恩惠和帮助！就好像大家伙捐助的物资，你都给了卖馒头的门市部，大家需要的话，需要再花钱去门市部买馒头！就是把大家的钱又给了资本，资本再次做局收割每一个捐助者和实际需要的被救助者！

用慈善做生意的人很多，但是又当又立就有点看不下去了，所以红叔翻车了！当然不希望红叔翻车，希望她能把好事做好，公开，公平，公正！更透明！更合理！


我想起了另一个人，李亚鹏！也是著名的慈善家！李亚鹏的眼泪和红叔的翻车成了鲜明的对比！李亚鹏的所以慈善捐款都是针对个人！他自己不碰钱，都是直接对个人进行直接捐助和帮扶！而红叔基金会的提成高达百分之13！红叔这是赚大发了！翻车也是必然！相比之下，李亚鹏的做法更值得表扬！看过李亚鹏的眼泪，显得多少有点看不下去的感觉！很好的一个演员！

红叔也好，李亚鹏也罢，希望大家都把慈善做好，做的不要寒了各大家伙的心！毕竟谁的钱也不好是大风刮来的！也希望红叔能反省自己，从哪里跌倒就从哪里爬起来！不忘初心，才能把事情做好！

title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRA33gpA7Bqg2hNYbCyY2NhQLoyGSfebL1XB1YTK6zSiX/1782869987217.jpg)

Germany အသင်းလို ၃၂ သင်း အဆင့်မှာတင် လှည့်ပြန်သွားရသည့် နောက်ထပ် အသင်းကတော့ Netherlands ဖြစ်လေ၏။ Germany လိုပဲ ၁-၁ သရေကျပြီး ပင်နယ်တီ အဆုံးအဖြတ်မှာ ၂-၃ ဖြင့် ရှုံးနိမ့်ကာ အိမ်ပြန်ခဲ့ရလေ၏။ ၇၂ မိနစ်မှာ Netherlands တို့ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး သွင်း၏။ ၉၀+၁ မိနစ်မှာ Morocco က ချေပဂိုး ပြန်လည် သွင်းယူ၏။ အချိန်ပို ၁၅ မိနစ် နှစ်ပိုင်း ကစားပြီးချိန်မှာလည်း ဘယ်အသင်းမှ ဂိုးထပ် မသွင်းနိုင်ခဲ့ကြပေ။ နာမည်ကြီး အသင်း ၂ သင်း အနေဖြင့် ခပ်စောစော နှုတ်ဆက် လှည့်ပြန် သွားရလေတော့၏။

မနေ့ည ၁၁ နာရီခွဲမှာ ကစားသည့် Ivory Coast vs Norway ပွဲစဉ်မှာတော့ Norway အသင်းက ၁-၂ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရပြီး ၁၆ သင်း အဆင့်ကို တက်လှမ်း သွားခဲ့လေတော့၏။ ၃၉ မိနစ်မှာ Norway က ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး သွင်း၏။ ၇၄ မိနစ်မှာ Ivory Coast က ချေပဂိုး ပြန်လည် သွင်းယူ၏။ ၈၆ မိနစ်မှာ Norway က ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး သွင်းယူ၏။ အဆိုပါ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုးကို Haaland က သွင်းယူခဲ့ခြင်း ဖြစ်၏။ Haaland အနေဖြင့် လက်ရှိ ကမ္ဘာ့ဖလားမှာ သွင်းဂိုး ၅ ဂိုးဖြင့် Messi, Mbappe တို့နောက်မှာ ရပ်တည်နေ၏။ 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPpn2cpXp79bkhViGpuZcqrTR8JhA2hiRadGpwy3qk2Ro/1782869987201.jpg)


မနက် ၃ နာရီခွဲမှာ ကစားသည့် France vs Sweden ပွဲစဉ်မှာ France က ၃-၀ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့၏။ France အတွက် ဂိုးတွေကို ၄၅၊ ၅၃ နှင့် ၇၄ မိနစ်တွေမှာ သွင်းယူ သွားခဲ့၏။ အဆိုပါ ၃ ဂိုးမှာ Mbappe က ၂ ဂိုး သွင်း၏။ ထို့ကြောင့် ဂိုးသွင်းအများဆုံး ကစားသမား စာရင်းမှာ ၆ ဂိုးဖြင့် Messi နဲ့အပြိုင် ရပ်တည်နေ၏။ 

Sweden အသင်းပါ ရှုံးနိမ့် သွားခဲ့ရသည်မို့ Group F ကနေ တက်လာသည့် ၃ သင်းလုံး ၃၂ သင်း အဆင့်ကနေတင် နောက်လှည့် ပြန်သွားကြရပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ Netherlands, Japan & Sweden တို့ ဖြစ်၏။ Group E က အသင်းတွေလည်း အခြေအနေ မကောင်းလှပေ။ Germany, Ivory Coast တို့ အနေဖြင့် ၃၂ သင်းအဆင့်မှာတင် ကျေနပ်ခဲ့ရပြီး ဖြစ်၏။ Ecuador အနေဖြင့် Mexico နှင့် ကစားရမည် ဖြစ်၏။ Ecuador သာ Mexico ကို ရှုံးနိမ့်ခဲ့ရင် Group E က အသင်းတွေ အနေဖြင့် ၃၂ သင်းအဆင့်နဲ့တင် ကျေနပ်ရပေလိမ့်မည်။

နောက်တဆင့် တက်မယ် ထင်ထားသည့် အသင်းတွေက မတက်ဘဲ မတက်ဘူး ထင်ထားသည့် အသင်းတွေက တက်နဲ့ ရှုံးထွက် ပွဲစဉ်တွေက အနည်းငယ် မှန်းဆရ ခက်လို့ နေခဲ့၏။ ဒါသည်ပင် ဘောလုံး၏ အနှစ်သာရပင် မဟုတ်ပါလား။ ထင်မှတ် မထားတာတွေ ဖြစ်တတ်တာလည်း လောကသဘာဝပင် မဟုတ်ပါလား။

title.title: Otra noche sin corriente
title.body:
Hay noches en las que el reloj parece avanzar más despacio. Esta es una de ellas.

Otra vez estamos sin electricidad. El silencio se impone en la casa y el calor se vuelve el verdadero protagonista, ese que no necesita presentarse porque se siente en cada rincón.

En Cuba, hablar de los apagones ya no sorprende a nadie. Se han convertido en parte de la rutina. Uno aprende a cargar el teléfono cuando puede, a cocinar rápido cuando regresa la electricidad y a aprovechar cada minuto de corriente como si fuera un recurso demasiado valioso para desperdiciarlo.

Pero hay algo a lo que todavía no logro acostumbrarme: el calor de la madrugada.

Es un calor diferente. Pesado. De esos que no te dejan dormir, que hacen que des vueltas en la cama buscando una posición más fresca, aunque sabes que no la vas a encontrar. Abres las ventanas esperando una brisa que muchas veces nunca llega.

La suerte mía es que tengo un ventilador recargable, y eso me da un poco de alivio en medio de la noche. Pero lo que más me preocupa no soy yo.

![IMG_20260627_150016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/243ftKuPxfShcY7nNokjLa31eeDkL727XzVkGpreS3CsXpoRSZJXc4CudskGWP6yG1jcn.jpg)


Es mi pequeño Lukas.

En noches así uno aprende que el cansancio propio pasa a segundo plano. Solo quieres que el niño esté lo más cómodo posible, que pueda dormir tranquilo aunque el entorno no ayude, aunque el calor no dé tregua.

Y aun así, la vida continúa.

Mañana habrá que levantarse para trabajar, cumplir con las responsabilidades y seguir adelante. Porque detenerse no es una opción, aunque el cansancio se acumule día tras día.

En noches como esta también pienso en todas las personas que están pasando exactamente por lo mismo. Familias enteras tratando de dormir, niños inquietos por el calor, adultos mayores soportando temperaturas difíciles y trabajadores que, después de largas jornadas, solo desean descansar unas horas.

No escribo esto para quejarme. Escribo porque a veces poner en palabras lo que vivimos ayuda a sentir que no estamos solos.

Quizás dentro de algunos años recuerde estas noches como una etapa difícil que finalmente quedó atrás. Ojalá sea así.

Mientras tanto, intento encontrar pequeños motivos para mantener el ánimo. Una conversación con la familia, un mensaje de un amigo, leer algunos comentarios en PeakD o simplemente mirar el cielo cuando las estrellas aparecen con más fuerza gracias a la oscuridad.

Es curioso cómo, incluso en medio de las dificultades, la naturaleza encuentra la manera de recordarnos que todavía existen cosas bonitas.

Hoy no tengo una gran reflexión ni una enseñanza espectacular. Solo quería compartir un pedazo de esta noche, porque sé que muchos entenderán perfectamente lo que significa intentar dormir cuando el calor parece abrazarlo todo.

Espero que, cuando lean estas líneas, estén teniendo una noche un poco más fresca que la mía.

Y si también están atravesando un apagón, les deseo paciencia. A veces eso es lo único que podemos ofrecernos unos a otros.

Solo les puedo decir no sé cómo tengo cobertura en este momento solo se que puedo compartir este pequeño sentimiento 
Gracias por dedicar unos minutos a leerme. Su apoyo y cada comentario hacen que estas noches sean un poco más llevaderas.

![file_0000000077dc720caa1190909b8aaf15.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23uFU9bz4wqdDoX6FKxJ6x8GJ4pHDyCSuStxefWu7avCzirGSxX2tg1zrCm8s9xKwyfWf.png)

Nos leemos en el próximo blog.
No ve voy a cansar de agradecer a la comunidad BBH 💪 a @thebbhfoundation y @thebbhproject
A su creador @brdaleyarrow y a mí mamá de Canadá @cathyarrow
Espero pronto estemos juntos
Gracias por su apoyo y que Dios los bendiga 🙏🙏🙏

Writing Hive Is Not Just Another Blockchain—It's a Digital Nation You Can Actually Own 

Every day, thousands of people search for ways to earn online. They jump from one platform to another, chasing promises that often disappear overnight. 

But what if the biggest opportunity isn't the newest project? 

What if it's the one that has been quietly growing for years? 

That opportunity is Hive. 

MORE THAN A BLOCKCHAIN

Many people introduce Hive as a blockchain. 

Technically, that's true. 

But it misses the bigger picture. 

Hive is an entire digital economy where content creators, developers, entrepreneurs, gamers, investors, and communities work together without depending on a single company. 

No CEO can suddenly delete your account. 

No corporation owns your audience. 

No central authority decides whether your voice deserves to be heard. 

Your account belongs to you. 

Your reputation belongs to you. 

Your assets belong to you. 

That changes everything. 

THE REAL VALUE OF HIVE

Most social media platforms monetize your attention. 

Hive monetizes your contribution. 

Instead of making billion-dollar companies richer while creators receive nothing, Hive allows value to flow back into the community. 

Whether you write articles... 

Create videos... 

Develop games... 

Build decentralized applications... 

Curate quality content... 

Or simply help others... 

There is an opportunity to participate in the ecosystem. 

Hive rewards people who create value instead of merely consuming it. 

HBD: ONE OF MOST CRYPTO'S MOST UNDERRATED INNOVATIONS 

While much of crypto is known for extreme price swings, Hive Backed Dollar (HBD) offers something many people overlook: stability. 

Imagine being able to receive rewards without worrying that tomorrow they could lose half their value. 

For creators, HBD becomes more than just another token. 

It becomes: 

☑️A way to save. 

☑️A medium for payments. 

☑️A tool for long-term planning. 

☑️A bridge between creativity and financial stability. 

In an industry driven by speculation, HBD reminds us that usefulness matters.

HIVE POWER IS ABOUT COMMITMENT

Many newcomers ask: 

\

Because Hive rewards long-term thinking. 

Hive Power isn't just staking. 

It's influence.

It's responsibility. It's voting strength.

 It's supporting quality content. 

It's investing in the future of the ecosystem instead of chasing short-term profits. 

Strong communities are built by people who stay—not those who constantly move to the next trend. 

THE ECOSYSTEM IS THE PRODUCT

People often focus only on token prices. 

But healthy ecosystems aren't built by charts. 

They're built by people. 

Every community. 

Every game. 

Every developer. 

Every witness.

 Every curator. 

Every creator. 

Every investor.

 Each one adds another brick to the foundation.

 The stronger the ecosystem becomes, the stronger Hive becomes. 

Price eventually follows utility. 

Utility follows people. 

WHAT HIVE SHOULD FOCUS ON

 If Hive wants to reach millions more users, the focus should not simply be marketing. 

It should be creating an experience that makes people stay.

That means: 

☑️Better onboarding for complete beginners. 

☑️More educational content in different languages. 

☑️Simpler wallets and account management. 

☑️Stronger support for developers building useful applications. 

☑️More real-world use cases for HBD. 

☑️Encouraging quality over quantity in content creation. 

☑️Building communities that welcome newcomers instead of overwhelming them. 

Technology attracts attention. 

Community creates loyalty. Stop 

THINGKING LIKE A USER. START THINGKING LIKE AN OWNER. 

Most internet platforms treat you like a product. Hive treats you like a participant.

 That mindset changes everything.

 Instead of asking, 

\

Because the people who create lasting value often receive the greatest rewards. 

FINAL THOUGHTS

Hive isn't perfect. 

No ecosystem is. 

But perfection has never built successful communities. 

People do. 

The future of Hive doesn't depend on one developer, one whale, or one application. 

It depends on thousands of ordinary people who continue showing up, creating value, helping newcomers, and believing that the internet can be more open, more rewarding, and more human. 

Every post.

 Every vote. 

Every comment. 

Every new idea. 

They all help shape the future. 

And perhaps that's the greatest lesson Hive teaches us: 

A blockchain isn't powered by computers alone—it is powered by people who believe in building something together.

title.title: (ESP/ENG) ✨❤️‍🩹✍️ Regresando la fé en la humanidad: Unidos en medio de la tragedia / Restoring faith in humanity: United in the midst of tragedy ✨❤️‍🩹✍️
title.body:
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad y amantes de la escritura creativa! Para nadie es un secreto que la vida de los venezolanos dio un giro tremendo y con el pasar de los días, nos encontramos inmersos en la incertidumbre. Al menos en mi caso, me la paso compartiendo información que encuentro en las redes sociales y buscando esperanza en fotografías como la propuesta para el [concurso](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-f9c4058c601a4), en dónde se nota la unión que hay en este país.
![top family imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EqfHND5m13QzbsnNfjtnqRMpeHDzBPVFR1vZDH1FR9EHy7oVadbji1qMwNz1rWwxyhS.png)
Lo ocurrido en Venezuela el pasado 24 de Junio de 2026, sigue pareciendo producto de una pesadilla. Un desastre natural sin precedentes que fue comparado por rescatista con escenarios de guerra y otros con la destrucción masiva que dejaría bombas atómicas. Los días pasan y las cifras de daños materiales y de vidas perdidas, suben... pero del mismo modo, también aumenta el compromiso de muchos por ayudar a un país en crisis.
No sólo los mismos venezolanos se empezaron a movilizar para ofrecer su ayuda, ya fuera para las labores de rescate en la Guaira o con la recolección de donativos; sino también, muchos países se han sumado a la ayuda.
No voy a mentirles, me duele la situación que está pasando mi país, pero en lugar de sentirme abatida y deprimida, mi corazón está lleno de esperanza, pues ver cada video en la redes de rescates exitosos y la ayuda que se está brindado, me hace dar cuenta de que los venezolanos no están solos, que el mundo allá afuera escuchó su lamento y no dudó en prestarle su mano para levantarse.
Nunca pensé que llegaría a ver algo semejante. Cada día que pasa, ocurren eventos increíbles que hace que todo esto, parezca una película, pero de esas en dónde a pesar del caos, surge un sentimiento de lucha que merece ser recompensado en un futuro, quedándote con esa sensación \

en el corazón cuando, a pesar de todo lo malo que hay en el mundo, los seres humanos son capaces de demostrar que no todo está perdido.
Estudiantes de medicina que viajaron de un estado a otro para ayudar, a pesar de las amenazas de perder sus títulos; personas que donan lo poquito que tienen en el momento, pero que \

#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello to all members of this community and lovers of creative writing! It's no secret that the lives of Venezuelans have taken a dramatic turn, and as the days go by, we find ourselves immersed in uncertainty. At least in my case, I spend my time sharing information I find on social media and seeking hope in photographs like the one submitted for the [contest](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-f9c4058c601a4), which highlights the unity that exists in this country.
![top family imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EqfHND5m13QzbsnNfjtnqRMpeHDzBPVFR1vZDH1FR9EHy7oVadbji1qMwNz1rWwxyhS.png)
What happened in Venezuela on June 24, 2026, still seems like something out of a nightmare. An unprecedented natural disaster that rescuers compared to war zones and others to the massive destruction left by atomic bombs. As the days go by, the figures for material damage and lost lives rise... but at the same time, so does the commitment of many to help a country in crisis.
Not only have Venezuelans themselves begun to mobilize to offer their help, whether for rescue efforts in La Guaira or by collecting donations, but many countries have also joined in the relief efforts.
I won't lie to you, the situation my country is going through hurts me, but instead of feeling down and depressed, my heart is full of hope. Seeing every video on social media of successful rescues and the help being provided makes me realize that Venezuelans are not alone, that the world out there heard their cries and didn't hesitate to lend a hand to help them get back on their feet.
I never thought I would see something like this. Every day that passes, incredible events occur that make all of this seem like a movie, but one of those where, despite the chaos, a fighting spirit emerges that deserves to be rewarded in the future, leaving you with that warm feeling in your heart when, despite all the bad things in the world, human beings are capable of showing that all is not lost.
Medical students who traveled from one state to another to help, despite the threat of losing their degrees; People who donate what little they have at the moment, even though they \

; children who give away their favorite toys with words of encouragement for the child who receives them; mothers who donate the clothes they bought with so much love for their babies; men who lift stones with their bare hands to pull their loved ones and strangers from the rubble... the heroes and true influencers are those people who, with their actions, not only save lives but also inspire others to continue believing in humanity ❤️‍🩹

title.body:

![img_20260701_080223-d09355957582.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/evahe/lkt-mr1e6lmv-z7j7bb2h/img_20260701_080223-d09355957582.webp)

真是好，今天一大早就天气好好，阳光明媚。六月就是不是天天下雨就是狂风暴雨，心情都感觉不好了！今天睡醒感觉就很好！必须出门溜达溜达，锻炼锻炼下，毕竟在家呆了一个星期没出门了感觉！今天天气好晴朗，必须出门行运一下！出门我偷偷带个帽子，因为这天气真的晒了！

不过好几天没出门，发现好多新开的店铺啦！就是不是我喜欢的类型，要不多多少少我去探下店！这些店铺开业都是有优惠的，真是好啊！可惜都是不是我喜欢吃的东西！昨天睡眠质量挺好的，可能是昨天我锻炼了一下，做运动太累的原因吧，这是这几天睡得最好的一天，深度睡眠质量是比较长，中间我也没有醒来上厕所！

这手表可以啊，我戴那么多天也不用充电！以前我都不喜欢戴的，我家老头买给我我都不知道，之前有段时间不戴了，懒得戴，现在带着可以检测身体健康，我感觉挺好的了！我看看啥时候再给手表充电下，戴了那么久了！哈哈～果然运动有助于睡眠啊！可能是太累了！做半个小时我都感觉好累啊！

七月啦又是美好的一个月的开始，我要坚持锻炼身体！我要美美哒，早上出去看到好多美女都包的好严实，也有很多叛逆的，不是纹身就是染发的！短视频好多都说80后又开始叛逆啦！我也想叛逆一下，吃个雪糕啥的就好了！
