title.title: Stone is worth it again!
title.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23zS1AVzgZmzLsCYbXyaNbuW422DMBzsHmwHPzbbLDERybKHESMoZ8sVfB19ZVv1ro4Kv.png)</center>

  
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23vhuVwHxn7ynuUbA7tsZmcVvH5QddLoE3gizq8EMRXW2FxjXaZjha4LgiNo6FSDiQfPf.png
  
 #### Prologue
  
It's been a while since I had my stone plots active. I activated them for the cards. But then I pivoted back into grain, mainly, working with a buddy of mine - he provides the cards via delegation, I provide the plot and totem. I calculated the worth of each plot, and we split the profits accordingly. It's more or less 60% for him for the cards, 40% for me for the plot and totem. 

Today, I looked into the BLT and a surprise was waiting - Stone is at 1.09 grain factor! Meaning, it's almost making profit to use quarries and trade the stone for grain! And even Iron is following closely!


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23t72sUDVVLb2kDPmyQWoKjwBssucazqCxHraF6w2AwBvHBVQ7upKWNeWHxbQxorgavSG.png)</center>

Okay, it's not the best news. It's not because those resources went up in price, but because Grain went down dramatically. From 22.22 DEC/1k Grain in December 2025 to 7.76 DEC/1k Grain right now.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23t76tHpUvnxQpbv7znyzEqTMYcmGNfKbt2GBknd2Uk8AMAuP82nTeQphUeSDzGUMh5TW.png)</center>

Meanwhile, the other resources did not lose as much relative value. Hence, the Grainfactor went up for them.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23tRtNDTZfrEnXV3VmkR4LS8dDjahHfo9698F6kb8iwbuQZMpAAAN3bfouZUzjP4vVE3E.png)</center>

  
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tSMrBK495yadzSKriVB9FkEtftyayqE76JDxWPJsATmCdvqi8G8tHKVfT9SQ4p8MEBX.png
  
 #### What does that mean?

It means that all land assets are losing value. Rapidly. For now. 


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23t7572J9q4m19JRoj6JNRdCE3JKDgP66RfuBv4kZiaWq9sMiECBiLGQJExsygcXnZ54f.png)</center>

This is a calculation I made around a month ago, when we were setting up the cooperation-plots, using Beta Rare RF cards. ROI of around 7.5%. [Back in April, the ROI of a very similar plot was around 12%.](https://peakd.com/hive-169191/@beelzael/whats-land-worth-now)

This is what it would look like today:


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23t7572JBGJQ6is3Na8GLFeLeig2k1i86DUsPpvSLmLWGNHMETQc2Ni1ZLmPGjkCMhNEq.png)</center>

ROI dropping another 1.2% - and that is only thanks to the reduction in card costs. If I only changed the DEC price and the DEC/1k grain, it would be 4.5% ROI left on what we established a month ago. 

As mentioned, all Land-Assets have lost value. Not just the resources. 
  
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tSMrBK495yadzSKriVB9FkEtftyayqE76JDxWPJsATmCdvqi8G8tHKVfT9SQ4p8MEBX.png
  
 #### What now?

Praetoria is being worked on. We just got a release of a lot of cards, but unfortunately, I don't quite see the benefit to land resources for now. They will benefit the DAO, re-financing the land endeavor and bring some fancy stuff like skins and custom made cards to the ecosystem. 

Luckily, they won't cause too much resource inflation, either. Grain might suffer a bit as the cards will reduce grain consumption by up to 20% if the plot is under 20k PP (boosted I guess). Same goes for DEC staked. 

It's not really what land needs right now. That would be a sink - like buildings. And more labs and refinement options. Which are coming as far as I know! And those will be the real game changers. 
  
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tSMrBK495yadzSKriVB9FkEtftyayqE76JDxWPJsATmCdvqi8G8tHKVfT9SQ4p8MEBX.png

 #### Conclusion 

The market is doing what it does best. Stone was priced too high, so everybody started producing, the price fell into the unprofitable region. Meanwhile, Grain price soared, so everyone and their grandma pivoted into grain plots. Now grain price is plummeting, meanwhile sinks for other resources and speculation for future use held other resources stable, so they're more worth in relation to grain.

The invisible hand of the market.

Will I pivot back into stone? Not yet, at least not taking cards of my grain plots. There are three \

modifiers in play:

-10% taxes
-10% Resource swap
+10% terrain bonus

Without any other bonuses, I will have to wait for a grain factor of 1.10 or more for stone - then I'll make more of stone than of grain. And given the current card prices, I might just go and buy some more cards for the stone/iron plots. 

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tSMrBK495yadzSKriVB9FkEtftyayqE76JDxWPJsATmCdvqi8G8tHKVfT9SQ4p8MEBX.png

#

ME DUELE EL PECHO 

​Me duele mucho el pecho,
las emociones se acumulan
dolores van y vienen
y el alma desnuda
muestra su esencia
ante tanta angustia.

​Me siento lejos
no sé si vivo o muero
se escapan de mí sentimientos
y se van desvaneciendo
como la niebla en los montes.

​Quizás sea un adiós
una sola despedida
que anuncie el llamado
de un más allá
muy cercano.

#

![gratis-png-corona-de-laurel-laurel-corona-de-olivo-thumbnail.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRyWg8oVXWfsnXy1JQYqXsoyCFP1wpgTdoHZGbXtpmWvx/gratis-png-corona-de-laurel-laurel-corona-de-olivo-thumbnail.png)

#

MY CHEST HURTS

My chest hurts so much,
emotions build up
pains come and go

and my naked soul
reveals its essence
in the face of so much anguish.

I feel far away
I don't know if I'm living or dying
feelings escape me
and fade away
like mist in the mountains.

Perhaps it's a goodbye
a single farewell
announcing the call
of a beyond
very near.

body.title: The First Presidential Dog | A Picture is Worth a Thousand Words
body.body:
<center>
![23tmDdQjHM1joeSeppQkqRda8s5EkzYFQ4pfeKndQPwY8Amh9cvoKcDjh8oJn1BR8vfCg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/23tmDECwty4XwdSkuPL8MaUQpiLo4gVGjB76Cztw1EtiFMN5wCB1XHwethdiABx22bde7.jpg)
 [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/art-painting-master-chief-leader-3117304/)</center>

<hr>

In the grand hall built upon the ruins of an ancient human town hall, excited barks echoed.

Centuries had passed since the \

the cataclysm that extinguished the hairless bipeds once known as the masters of the world. In their absence, dogs not only survived but thrived.

They evolved to learn to farm, to read ancient books, to forge a society based on loyalty.

After thousands of years, the global pack was taking its greatest step yet. Uniting the breeds into a single society, from tiny engineering Chihuahuas to towering construction bulldogs, all came together to build something much bigger. What was once the United States was now the land of the free, flags bearing the golden paw symbol waving in the evening breeze.

On the oak dais, carved with bites and chisel, sat old Rufus, a pug with gray fur and a wise gaze. He had guided the united tribes through dark times, and now the council had elected him by popular vote.

A Siberian husky, the Supreme Judge, stepped forward solemnly, carrying the Presidential Collar, adorned with gleaming dog tags.

***\

*** Rufus replied, bowing his head to receive the collar.

Deafening howls erupted in the plaza. Tails waving incessantly marked the beginning of a new era. Humanity was history; the reign of man's best friend had begun.

body.body: >Greetings, dear friends at Feathered Friends. I am back to participate in [Feathered Friends - Show Me A Photo Contest Round 277](https://hive.blog/hive-106444/@nelinoeva/feathered-friends-show-me-a-d5736d1d3002a). This week's star is a rather wary pigeon; I came across it while visiting the supermarket with a friend. There is a small plaza there where people, children, and pigeons all gather._

>When the area isn't too busy, you can enjoy a front-row view of the spectacle—watching a large gathering of pigeons walking about, foraging for grain, and interacting with one another. On the day I went to the supermarket, however, there were many children playing in the small plaza, so no pigeons were in sight. I could spot a few high up in the trees, looking as if to say, \

—he knows I enjoy photographing birds. So, we watched it without getting too close and took a few photos; the first one is the one I chose for this contest, as it was the one I liked best.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXeCFY5kPJhdW1sb2KVz85QD5mN6Y5sWVbxgWMt8XstA3/image.png)
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQgS1UVBCowR1b3WXLoRT612vGvJJLcfBPuAAdy4m7LxK/image.png)

>It turned out great! This time, I took the photo using my friend's phone, which has a better zoom than mine. The pigeon suspected we were following it; it would stop and stare right at us, as if wondering, \

We had to wait a couple more minutes so it wouldn't fly off, and there it was, just watching us. Then it started walking, and I managed to get another shot that I thought was really lovely—it looked so pensive.

>That's all from me. I hope you enjoyed it. See you next time.
# Thank you for reading
The photos are original, taken with a Samsung Galaxy S24 phone
## @hylene74
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRfFdp4SbhXhg3TkrQukN2S2wjR6gMdLvVaAmcNPsweB6/image.png)
#

>Saludos estimados amigos de amigos emplumados. Aquí estoy de vuelta para participar en [Amigos emplumados - Concurso de fotos, ronda 277](https://hive.blog/hive-106444/@nelinoeva/feathered-friends-show-me-a-d5736d1d3002a). La protagonista de esta semana es una paloma, algo precavida ella, la encontré cuando fui al supermercado con un amigo. En ese lugar hay una pequeña plazoleta donde se reúnen personas, niños y también las palomas._

>Cuando el lugar no está muy transitado, se puede disfrutar en primera fila el espectáculo, ver a muchas palomas reunidas, caminado, buscando granos para comer y conversando entre ellas. Ese día que fui al súper muchos niños estaban jugando en la plazoleta y por eso no se veían palomas por allí. Pude divisar a algunas en lo alto de los árboles, como diciendo “no podemos bajar”, pero de pronto, mi amigo me dijo “mira, ahí está una”, él sabe que me gusta fotografiar aves. Así que la estuvimos observando, sin acercarnos mucho, le tomamos unas fotos, la primera, es la elegida para participar en este concurso, fue la que más me gustó.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXeCFY5kPJhdW1sb2KVz85QD5mN6Y5sWVbxgWMt8XstA3/image.png)

>Quedó linda!, esta vez tomé la foto con el teléfono de mi amigo que tiene un mejor zoom que el mío. La paloma sospechaba que la estábamos siguiendo, se detenía y nos miraba fijo, como preguntándose: que le pasa a esta gente?. Tuvimos que esperar un par de minutos más para que no se escapara, y ella, ahí, mirándonos. Después comenzó a caminar y logré otra toma que me pareció muy bonita, se le veía pensativa.

>Esta ha sido mi participación, espero les haya gustado, hasta la próxima.

body.title: Nuestro Héroe Tsunami
body.body:
>

<center>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/Ep7x1qYEw1tAzq5btd5XkK7LYxqk9yuVgb4dFfrUuXkuSM1gKeHmKfoZNaGmnzqbxBA.jpg
</center>

Saludos querida comunidad, el pasado 24 de junio en mi país Venezuela ocurrió un fenómeno natural de dimensiones catastróficas “un doblete sísmico”, algo que incluso no sabía que existía hasta ahora, pues se trata de dos terremotos que ocurrieron con escasos segundos de diferencia, el primero de 7.2 y el segundo de 7.5 en la escala, siendo los estados centrales como el Distrito Capital y La Guaira los más afectados, pues se cayeron cientos de edificio y son miles las personas heridas y fallecidas, por lo que para todos los venezolanos ha sido un golpe muy duro, aun hoy 6 días después siguen las labores de rescate, se han presenciado milagros de personas vivas que han sido encontradas bajo los escombros, pero la gran mayoría no pudieron salir con vida, por lo que los rescates de cuerpos continúan, en medio de todo este caos y dolor hay pequeñas luces que han llegado a iluminarnos en medio de tanta penumbra, tal como es el caso de nuestro héroe Tsunami.

Tsunami es un pero venezolano de raza Border Collie de 9 años de edad, quien fue rescatado del maltrato y entrenado para servir como perro de búsqueda y rescate por parte del señor Jorge Beens del Centro de Formación y Equipos Caninos e Intervención en Desastres (K-SAR ECID), este hermoso ángel de 4 patas ha prestado su servicio en muchas oportunidades dentro y fuera del país ayudando a muchas personas, en este terremoto estuvo trabajando hasta el día de ayer 29 siendo su ultima misión para pasar a retiro, dejando en esta oportunidad el logro maravilloso de haber señalado exitosamente en donde se encontraba un señor de 60 años con vida quien fue rescatada de los escombros gracias a su señal.

Esta semana ha sido muy dura para todos, a mi me afectado mucho a nivel emocional, también tengo familia en la Guaira que afortunadamente están vivos aunque sin pertenecías, entre ayer y hoy ya se han podido venir luego de toda una odisea por los transportes para reencontrarse con la familia de aquí, pero aun con mi mente mal después de días sin trabajar me dispuse a tejer, inspirada en este hermoso perrito quien se ha ganado el corazón de todos y que aunque sé que hay muchos otros perritos que vinieron de otros países a prestar ayuda , creo que hacer a Tsunami versión amigurumi también  homenajea a todos los héroes caninos.

Por otro lado, esta publicación que hoy comparto no es con la finalidad de lucrar con la imagen de nuestro héroe, sino también motivada por la idea de apoyar a miembros de la comunidad que han sido afectadas por el terremoto, en este caso las recompensas irán directamente como beneficio a las cuentas de @carisma77 y natalimcr27 quienes perdieron sus casas y sus pertenencias y por fortuna físicamente están ilesas, deseando que lo que pueda aportar se aun grano de arena que contribuya a mejorar un poco la situación difícil por la que están atravesando. Por otro lado he estado pensado que si hay personas interesadas en un amigurumi de Tsunami también se los podría hacer con el compromiso de donar mis ganancias a los damnificados de este terremoto, solo deben escribirme por privado a mi Instagram o Discord.

> Greetings, dear community. On June 24th, a catastrophic natural phenomenon occurred in my country, Venezuela: a \

I wasn't even aware of the existence of such a phenomenon until now. It consisted of two earthquakes that struck just seconds apart, the first registering 7.2 and the second 7.5 on the seismic scale. The central states, such as the Capital District and La Guaira, were the most affected, with hundreds of buildings collapsing and thousands of people injured and killed. This has been a devastating blow to all Venezuelans. Even today, six days later, rescue efforts continue. Miracles have been witnessed, with people found alive under the rubble, but the vast majority did not survive. The recovery of bodies continues. Amidst all this chaos and pain, small lights have emerged to illuminate our lives in the midst of such darkness, as is the case with our hero, Tsunami. > > Tsunami is a 9-year-old Venezuelan Border Collie who was rescued from abuse and trained as a search and rescue dog by Jorge Beens of the Canine Training and Equipment Center for Disaster Intervention (K-SAR ECID). This beautiful four-legged angel has served on numerous occasions both within and outside the country, helping many people. During this earthquake, he worked until yesterday, the 29th, his last mission before retiring. He achieved the remarkable feat of successfully locating a 60-year-old man who was rescued from the rubble thanks to his signal. > > This week has been very difficult for everyone. It has affected me deeply on an emotional level. I also have family in La Guaira who, thankfully, are alive, although without their belongings. Between yesterday and today, they were finally able to return after a long ordeal with transportation to reunite with their family here. But even with my mind still reeling after days without work, I decided to crochet, inspired by this beautiful little dog who has won everyone's hearts. And although I know there are many other dogs who came from other countries to help, I believe that making an amigurumi version of Tsunami also pays tribute to all the canine heroes. > > On the other hand, this post I'm sharing today isn't intended to profit from our hero's image, but is also motivated by the idea of supporting community members affected by the earthquake. In this case, the rewards will go directly to the accounts of @carisma77 and natalicmcr27, who lost their homes and belongings but are thankfully physically unharmed. I hope that whatever I can contribute will be a small step towards easing the difficult situation they're going through. I've also been thinking that if anyone is interested in a Tsunami amigurumi, I could make one for them with the commitment to donate my earnings to the earthquake victims. Just send me a private message on Instagram or Discord.
https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Proceso / Process

Si les soy sincera no tengo aún muy clara mi cabeza como para detallarles el paso a paso con exactitud, pero puedo decirles que trabajé con lana acrílica y ganchillo de 3.5mm, tenia la idea de hacer al perrito sentado por lo que comencé primero con la cabeza con 6 puntos bajos en un anillo y con 6 aumentos por 3 hileras, con color blanco la mayor parte pero haciendo la mancha negra que parece un diamante en la cabeza, hice 6 hileras de altura y luego 6 disminuciones por 2 hileras, a partir del cuello hice aumentos la lograr el ancho del lomo y el pecho y de allí mismo poder dejar los agujeros por los cuales hacer las patas delanteras, en esta parte del proceso trabaje las puntadas del pecho con blanco y la espalda con negro. Por supuesto en la cabeza puse los ojos de dos colores tal como es la característica de heterocromía del perrito. > To be honest, I don't have a clear enough head yet to give you an exact step-by-step guide, but I can tell you that I worked with acrylic yarn and a 3.5mm crochet hook. I had the idea of making the dog sitting down, so I started with the head, using 6 single crochet stitches in a ring and 6 increases for 3 rows, mostly in white, but making the black diamond-shaped patch on the head. I worked 6 rows for height and then 6 decreases for 2 rows. From the neck, I increased stitches to achieve the width of the back and chest, and from there I could make the holes for the front legs. In this part of the process, I worked the chest stitches in white and the back stitches in black. Of course, I added two-colored eyes to the head, as is characteristic of the dog's heterochromia.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK3ex2Rb86vVrakeUiJY1hvRvKQQqVDBjwBEaQ2vYxwhg76EtNgpVpQYmhvpdut.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
A partir de los agujeros hice las patas con 6 puntadas de ancho, hice el hocico y le coloqué también una nariz de plástico, hice una oreja negra y la otra blanca, empezando con 4 puntos en un anillo, 1 aumento por 2 hileras, 6 puntos bajos y luego uní con 3 puntos bajos. > Starting from the holes I made the legs with 6 stitches wide, I made the snout and also placed a plastic nose on it, I made one black ear and the other white, starting with 4 stitches in a ring, 1 increase for 2 rows, 6 single crochet stitches and then joined with 3 single crochet stitches.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK3fFmq1jmAqjwxQr4NS8kZVZqbNZRk8UXS13PXahYgXoWTxKJLQuiXAyDVHH9K.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Para las patas usé blanco y negro, pero para la pata izquierda hice mas hileras de negro, hice la cola con blanco solo en la punta, sé que la cola de Tsunami es mas esponjosa pero hacerla con mechones no me gustaba mucho el resultado así que la hice normal con puntos bajos, hice el arnés con hilo naranja, pero tanto en la espalda con en el pecho bordé las franjas de tricolor nacional es decir la bandera de Venezuela 😊 > For the legs I used black and white, but for the left leg I made more rows of black. I made the tail with white only at the tip. I know Tsunami's tail is fluffier, but I didn't really like the result of making it with tufts, so I made it normally with single crochet stitches. I made the harness with orange yarn, but on both the back and chest I embroidered the stripes of the national tricolor, that is, the Venezuelan flag 😊
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK56VQTryHFsXVU5SJoJtaPaMi3HWiSNm289faYUmv7Q55PXwtjvEFbcPx1mt4W.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Resultado / Result

>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AKKTnPzt5d6qcn9g8cGSqX8TTA8yRYZatMeiV5ZJADKaUde7ZbRNnS7LYgkPtB9.jpg https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AKAr3BnsX1mmV9nicKU6UstvyJ7xvnJh6msDLyEfCLJhN3GCzhR32LzpwC9s7rP.jpg https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK3fuCZVwSf4p1Mn6ZfxXarxAtrN2J4zmyyHy8Gkm6JPUEG8236fdzAVjoYSiQg.jpg https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJpkSm8dtuJWC6tNfbrgtTLvbZU9SrhkVFsrCiHNmoL4gQPgN3X68jfUHBAanns.jpg https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/Eoc8wHbKeGxZPZUV18fgDGwSRnd8ScTsZFTEmGE9rQQNu89FFzADUSXjuTDNN3ShGUm.gif https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

body.title: Back to the Stage Rising Star Game
body.body:
I was so happy to return to the Rising Star game, and as soon as I logged in, the familiar interface welcomed me back.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU8MRAx38YLE9n2YcdTKdaWzDwCmh1xd2ygb9rbkaYepm/1782868257215.png)

​Although some pages show a \

message, the game is still being rebuilt, so I don't mind being patient.
​Amidst these changes, seeing my Level 110 account stats—with 87,310 Fans and 110,942 Skill—makes me feel so energized.

​Looking back at my diary, finding discarded pizzas and refilling my energy is such a fun experience.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVovdB56a9CytJNxx47TXze4VmwJ1wAuC8V2RrPenbXTP/1782868268444.png)

​I still find myself excitedly doing \

missions, even though I'm always a little nervous about getting arrested by the police.

​The game rules remain strict as ever regarding bots and multiple accounts, so I want to remind everyone to be careful not to violate them.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQkKeVFqQ3Kq6eJ9rEqoHDCkcso2m7N68ajHT4fs8j69f/1782868277403.png)

​Regardless of everything, continuing to earn Starbits in this game and growing my collection always gives me such a great sense of satisfaction.

Rising Star ဂိမ်းကို ပြန်ရောက်လာတာ အရမ်းဝမ်းသာမိတယ်၊ အရင်ကလိုပဲ ဂိမ်းထဲကို ဝင်လိုက်တာနဲ့ ရင်းနှီးနေတဲ့ ဂိမ်းမျက်နှာပြင်လေးက ကျွန်မကို ကြိုဆိုနေသလိုပဲ။
​တချို့နေရာတွေမှာ Page Not Found ဆိုပြီး ပေါ်လာတာမျိုး ရှိပေမယ့် ဂိမ်းက အခုမှ ပြန်လည်မွမ်းမံနေဆဲ ဖြစ်လို့ စိတ်ရှည်ပေးရမှာပါ။

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNsivcxu2RnXRwpsaPiLxMDGazPuCnDozhoUfVoEuVvGa/1782868289229.png)

​ဒီလို အပြောင်းအလဲတွေကြားထဲမှာပဲ ကျွန်မရဲ့ Level 110 အကောင့်ထဲမှာ ရှိတဲ့ Fans 87,310 နဲ့ Skill 110,942 တို့ကို မြင်လိုက်ရတော့ တက်ကြွလာသလို ခံစားရတယ်။

body.body:

![1000023096-1deb09487ecc.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/sunshinexu/lkt-mr1cfxkp-5x98zsch/1000023096-1deb09487ecc.png)

很久没有写日记了，这段时间过得一言难尽。今天早上跟闺蜜说：我们都是披荆斩棘的姐姐，哈哈。
好像人倒霉的时候，很多事情都是一起来的。
先是从4月下旬开始，我的股票账户一路走低，从我开始玩这个，很少出现一个票我买了之后能腰斩的情况，这次买了两个，而且感觉目前都救不回来，昨天果断清仓了。
再是期货账户，本来6月初还挺开心，做了两年，终于赚钱了，结果一个节奏没踩对，又全部给出去了，截止到昨天，又是亏了1W，也不想做了。
这两个东西太消耗我的时间和精力了，特别是期货，感觉每天一直盯着数字涨涨跌跌，什么都做不进去了，工作上也十分的懒散，因为有夜盘，晚上也没睡好，实在是划不来。
这两个也都算了，最烦的事情是，我大儿子的过敏性紫癜开始复发了。
住了一次院，出院之后休息了三天，疹子没有了就赶紧让他上学了，因为快要期末考试了，结果就上了一天，下肢疹子复发了。赶紧停课打针休息，好不容易第二轮好了，端午节接回家，又爆发第三轮，这两天考试，考完试再看看情况。
每次疹子复发的时候，我就会不停的查原因找资料，最后自己劝自己，心急吃不了热豆腐，他这个病就是免疫系统的慢性病，幸好是暑假，可以休息两个月再看看。
七月开始了，早上跟子紫互发红包，她这个月也是过得兵荒马乱的，今天也是一个美美的天气，收到了转运红包，我们俩都会好起来的。
我们是披荆斩棘的姐姐，加油

body.title: Delicious veal served with vegetables, rice and plantain🥩🍚🍌//Exquisita carne de ternera hecha con verduras, arroz y plátano🥩🍚🍌[ENG/ESP]
body.body:
![1000022697.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/casmar551/EpGU7ZUSPCQjie5XwSmkkbW9kHTkxWxk3eZMm3GXMdo758D8v2C4CTAWdDHruFxnm6h.jpg)<sub>Photo created in canva</sub> | <sub>Foto creada en canva</sub>


---


Happy day to all my fellow chefs in this wonderful community, such as @Hive-Food.

>Feliz día a todos mis compañeros de cocina de esta maravillosa comunidad, como @Hive-Food.

Despite the circumstances we are currently facing in our country, I am back here today. We continue to pray for all our fellow countrymen, but, to take my mind off things a little, I have decided to take a breather and share with you all a delicious lunch of beef and diced vegetables, which I am going to enjoy with my family at lunchtime.
 
As you all know, meat is a very important source of protein for our bodies – that is, for our muscles and overall health – which is why today I’ve decided to prepare a delicious lunch made with pork chops and plenty of vegetables and spinach, which I’ll also serve with rice and boiled plantain, and which my family and I will enjoy at lunchtime.

>A pesar de las circunstancias que estamos viviendo en nuestro país, hoy vuelvo a estar aquí. Seguimos rezando por todos nuestros compatriotas, pero, para distraerme un poco, he decidido tomarme un respiro y compartir con todos vosotros un delicioso almuerzo a base de carne de res verduras cortadas en cubos , que voy a compartir con mi familia a la hora de comer.

>Como sabéis, la carne es una fuente muy importante de proteínas para nuestro organismo, es decir, para nuestros músculos y nuestra salud en general, por eso he decidido preparar un almuerzo delicioso a base de chuletas de cerdo y muchas verduras y espinacas, que también serviré con arroz y plátano macho hervido.

## Ingredients ##

600g beef 
300g rice
1 banana 
1 carrot 
1 potato
1 onion
1 green pepper 
3 sweet chillies
3 cloves of garlic
Additional seasoning (oregano, cumin, paprika and salt to taste).
Ingredientes ##

## Ingredientes ##

600 g de ternera 
300 g de arroz
1 plátano 
1 zanahoria 
1 papa
1 cebolla
1 pimiento verde 
3 chiles dulces
3 dientes de ajo
Condimentos adicionales (orégano, comino, pimentón y sal al gusto).

![1000020984.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/casmar551/23wgRugUHwCQXR8zFV1zZXpMzKKVK5FRCGpJi1xAFDeTb13PQVtU3ej9Wj3v4f5t2r61P.jpg)

## Preparation//Preparación ##

1 Step/Paso

First, I’ll chop and season our beef. Then we’ll place a frying pan over a medium-high heat to sear the meat; I’ll also add the carrots, cut into small pieces, and cover the pan for a few minutes to soften them. 

>Primero, trocearé y sazonaré la carne de ternera. Luego, pondré una sartén a fuego medio-alto para dorar la carne y añadiré las zanahorias cortadas en trozos pequeños. Taparé la sartén durante unos minutos para que se ablanden. 

![1000023042.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/casmar551/23u6Bs4NgC7E116hou62JWsVk8PrUuHKg9j4Bm7KgmaZNsNoSLRrBPLV8zsQQ3A98vRyn.jpg)

2 Step/Paso 

Whilst our beef is cooking with the carrots, we’ll make the most of the time to continue chopping and also put the rice and plantains on to cook.

>Mientras se cocina la ternera con las zanahorias, cortaremos el resto de ingredientes y pondremos a cocer el arroz y los plátanos.

![1000020975.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/casmar551/23u67FtmEQfQ5sg7bMfqx4b4kezSuz7CSMmhSbZHdL3xUJV1iLLRKUwAav7aY3Zig3PfZ.jpg)

3 Step/Paso 

Now that the beef and carrots are tender, I’ll continue by adding the onion and potatoes, already chopped into small pieces. Next, we’ll add the paprika and chillies, and finally I’ll add the tomatoes, also chopped into small pieces. We’ll stir and cover the pan, waiting for all the flavours to blend together and give us a delicious, juicy stew.

>Cuando la carne y las zanahorias estén tiernas, añadiré la cebolla y las patatas, ya cortadas en trozos pequeños. Después, añadiremos el pimentón y los chiles y, por último, los tomates, también cortados en trozos pequeños. Removeré y taparé la sartén, esperando a que todos los sabores se mezclen y nos den un guiso delicioso y jugoso.

![1000020972.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/casmar551/23u69KtbWBbn7T64ssrcgH98STwga8zckcX9Q8yCYnfFC7ydpGZxqRHEPdnAudHrS6HTM.jpg)

## Final rest ##

>Resultado final 

![1000022684.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/casmar551/23vi1wuebbRmKR3NRt9wuq55X9fbPT7hdQQTTuBkWZfaguGXeX93UyFisPAbYwkL8vjJV.jpg)

body.title: Stuck in Traffic, Learning Patience
body.body:
![PSX_20260701_080354.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbqARem3JTdPmBvCVAq1C9tCVY7CBEAL3pvpH6qTkQbrX/PSX_20260701_080354.jpg)

There are moments in life when we have no choice but to stop and wait. This photo captures one of those moments as a long line of motorcycles and cars came to a standstill under the bright afternoon sky. The road was crowded, the engines kept humming, and everyone silently hoped the traffic would move again soon.

At first, traffic jams always feel frustrating. We have places to go, work to finish, and plans that cannot wait. Yet, no matter how impatient we become, the road will only clear when the obstacle ahead is resolved. Sometimes, the only thing we can do is remain calm and make the best of the situation.

As I looked around, I noticed people from different backgrounds sharing the same experience. Some riders chatted with the person beside them, while others simply enjoyed the breeze and admired the clouds above. It reminded me that life's journey is much the same. We all travel at different speeds, but occasionally everyone faces delays beyond their control.

The beautiful blue sky with scattered white clouds created a striking contrast to the busy road below. It was a gentle reminder that even in stressful situations, there is still beauty if we choose to notice it. A traffic jam may slow our movement, but it does not have to ruin our mood.

This experience taught me that patience is not about liking the delay but about choosing a peaceful attitude while waiting. Every journey has unexpected obstacles, and every obstacle eventually passes. What truly matters is how we respond during those moments.

Thank you for taking the time to read my freewrite. I hope your journeys, whether on the road or through life, are always safe and filled with patience. Have a wonderful day!

body.title: Accra Is Under Water — And It Affected Me Too
body.body:
The rain came down hard. Accra is paying for it. And honestly? It hit me personally too.

I was supposed to go home from lectures yesterday. Couldn't. Roads were blocked. Water everywhere. I had to stay put and figure out how to survive the rest of the day.

I also couldn't learn. No studying. No progress on what I had planned.

It's frustrating  but it's also a reminder that nature doesn't care about our


https://i.ecency.com/DQmNx7LQKyxa4vakwkhtqi9agTxtekL1g8iKyhs3rEBkBRG/img_8011.png
What We Know So Far

President Mahama said about 140 millimetres of rain fell in a single day,the highest in years . At least 13 people have died, with more than 470 rescued .

The Ghana National Fire Service is still working. The death toll may rise .

GRIDCo and ECG have temporarily shut down power in parts of the capital because the flooding affected substations .

Some people are trapped at home. Some have lost everything.

And some of us  like me couldn't even get home from school.


https://i.ecency.com/DQmTEZUpp4eY7uP4X4FriqUAaxmpeSPj44deqU16ujj8S5k/img_8019.png
Why Is This Happening?

It's not just the rain. It's a combination of things :

1. Climate change  rainfall has increased year by year. In June 2024, Accra recorded about 85mm. In 2025, it was 172mm. In 2026, it hit 333mm .
2. Poor drainage gutters are clogged. Drains are blocked.
3. Illegal buildings people have built on waterways, blocking the natural flow of water .
4. Rapid urban growth Accra is growing fast. But the city's infrastructure is not keeping up .

President Mahama said it plainly: \

.


https://i.ecency.com/DQmP6wP9659kZCroq1rVFPDA7aQCdkWXdQ5qWGHc7Sb9qEE/img_8013.png
What It Means for Me

Yesterday, I couldn't go home. I couldn't learn. I couldn't do the things I planned.

It's easy to feel stuck when things like this happen. But it also makes you think how many people are going through worse? How many lost their homes, their belongings, their loved ones?

I'm lucky to still have a place to stay and food to eat. But not everyone can say that today. 

Flooding isn't just a Ghana problem it happens all over the world. In the US, hurricanes flood cities. In Europe, rivers burst their banks. In Asia, monsoon rains wash away homes. No matter where you are, water doesn't ask for permission.

If you've ever been affected by floods in your country, your city, your neighborhood drop your experience in the comments. Let's share, learn, and support each other.

body.title: Purpose Strengthening My Cards #33 Witch of Warwick
body.body: /> **_Thirty-three posts._** Thirty-three upgrades. One card that continues to grow stronger every single time I invest in it. When I started this series, my goal was simple: choose one card, improve it step by step, and document the entire journey for the Hive community. I had no idea that this personal challenge would become one of the most rewarding projects I've ever shared. Today, I'm excited to celebrate Chapter 33, which means this same card has received yet another level upgrade. Looking back at where it started compared to where it is now makes me appreciate how powerful consistent progress can be. Small Upgrades Create Massive Results Many players focus on buying new cards or constantly changing strategies. I decided to take a different approach. Instead of expanding in every direction, I've concentrated on maximizing the potential of a single card. Each upgrade may look modest on its own, but after thirty-three consecutive improvements, the difference is remarkable. This card has transformed into one of the strongest pieces of my collection, and every new level unlocks even more potential for future battles. There's something incredibly satisfying about watching months of steady investment turn into real in-game power.

/>

**_Why This Project Keeps Growing_**

Every time I upgrade this card, I'm reminded that long-term planning often beats short-term excitement.

Each new level brings valuable improvements, including:

⚔️ Stronger performance during battles.

⚔️ Better overall stats and greater battlefield impact.

⚔️ Increased Collection Power.

⚔️ Higher long-term value for my Splinterlands collection.

⚔️ One more step toward reaching its maximum level.

More importantly, every chapter tells part of a bigger story. This isn't just about leveling up a card—it's about proving what patience, discipline, and consistency can achieve over time.

Chapter 33 Is Finished... But The Journey Continues

Thirty-three upgrades represent much more than a number.

They represent commitment.

They represent steady progress.

They represent a goal that gets closer with every chapter.

I'm incredibly thankful to everyone who continues reading these posts, leaving comments, and following this adventure. Your support keeps me motivated to continue upgrading this card and sharing every milestone along the way.

Today, another level has been unlocked.

Another chapter has been completed.

And the road to the next upgrade officially begins.

Chapter 33 is complete... now let's see what Chapter 34 will bring!

body.title: Is your post good enough?
body.body:
[Inc. Magazine](https://www.inc.com/bill-murphy-jr/want-to-quiet-self-doubt-and-achieve-your-goals-train-your-brain-to-think-like-this/91291943)
To write or not to write? That is the question. Once that is overcome: what should you write about then? How should you write it? What would be the ideal posting frequency? Where should you do it? These are just some of the most relevant doubts of those who are part of this ecosystem (whether more experienced users or newer users). If on one hand there is the fear of doing something wrong... on the other hand, there is also the fear that even already knowing how everything works, one might make a new batch of mistakes. This is a “shadow” that follows us, because this dynamic changes over time. Curation projects that once existed may no longer exist. Any and all users can change their concepts of what is right and wrong (both in terms of appreciating a post to the point of leaving a comment or clicking the *upvote* button, for example). New guidelines can be created, and eventually affect what everyone already knows. In short, the possibilities are endless. The question is: **Is your post good enough to be relevant?** - We have all asked ourselves this at least once here, and perhaps... We should keep asking ourselves. Certainly, there is no definitive answer to what is considered a quality post... because we are talking about something subjective. Even though there are specific aspects that define (or at least help guide the path toward what - *actually* - has quality and relevance), all users define their own standards when writing (and where they publish) their texts. Who decides whether a post is good enough is the person on the other side, and it is not always purely a matter of merit. What each user should do is remain faithful to their own principles and personal choices regarding matters of particular importance. Once this truth prevails, each person begins to write naturally, and not with a specific focus on impressing others. A blog is a personal page where we share what tends to be interesting to us, so reflect this within what is relevant in your own concepts of appreciation throughout what you aim to achieve. Yes, all posts can be good enough. You need to believe in that truth. ---
**¿Tu publicación es lo suficientemente buena?**
¿Escribir o no escribir? Esa es la cuestión. Una vez superado: ¿Sobre qué escribir entonces? ¿Cómo escribir? ¿Cuál sería la frecuencia ideal para publicar? ¿Dónde hacerlo? Estas son solo algunas de las dudas más pertinentes de quienes forman parte de este ecosistema (sean usuarios más experimentados o usuarios más nuevos). Por un lado existe el miedo de hacer algo mal... Por otro lado, también existe el miedo de que, incluso ya sabiendo cómo funciona todo, cometer una nueva cosecha de errores. Esta es una “sombra” que nos persigue, porque esta dinámica con el tiempo va cambiando. Los proyectos de curaduría que antes existían pueden ya no existir. Todos y cualquier usuario pueden cambiar sus conceptos sobre lo que es correcto e incorrecto (tanto en términos de apreciación de una publicación hasta el punto de hacer algún comentario o hacer clic en el botón de *upvote*, por ejemplo). Se pueden crear nuevas directrices, y eventualmente afectar lo que todo el mundo ya puede conocer. En fin, las posibilidades son innumerables. La cuestión es: **¿Tu publicación es lo suficientemente buena como para ser relevante?** - Todos nos hemos preguntado eso al menos una vez por aquí, y tal vez... Deberíamos seguir preguntándonoslo. Ciertamente no hay una respuesta definitiva para determinar lo que se considera o no una publicación de calidad... Sobre todo porque estamos hablando de un aspecto que es subjetivo. Aunque existan aspectos específicos que definen (o que al menos ayudan a orientar el camino sobre lo que - *de hecho* - tiene calidad y relevancia) esta perspectiva, todos los usuarios definen sus propios estándares cuando escriben (y donde publican) sus textos. Quien define si la publicación es lo suficientemente buena es quien está del otro lado, y no siempre es una cuestión puramente de mérito. Lo que cada usuario debería hacer es mantenerse fiel a sus propios principios y elecciones personales sobre los asuntos de importancia particular. Una vez que esa verdad prevalece, cada persona comienza a escribir naturalmente, y no con un enfoque específico en impresionar a otras personas. Un blog es una página personal donde compartimos lo que tiende a ser interesante para nosotros, entonces, reflejen eso dentro de lo que es relevante dentro de sus conceptos de apreciación a lo largo de lo que pretenden alcanzar. Sí, todas las publicaciones pueden ser lo suficientemente buenas. Necesitas creer en esa verdad. ---
**O seu post é bom o suficiente?**
Escrever ou não escrever? Eis a questão. Uma vez superada: Sobre o que escrever então? Como escrever? Qual seria a frequência ideal para publicar? Onde fazer isso? Essas são apenas algumas das dúvidas mais pertinentes de quem faz parte deste ecossistema (sejam usuários mais experientes ou usuários mais novos). Se por um lado há o receio de fazer algo de errado... Por outro lado, há também o receio de que mesmo já conhecendo como tudo funciona, cometer uma nova colheita de erros. Essa é uma “sombra” que nos persegue, porque essa dinâmica ao longo do tempo vai mudando. Os projetos de curadoria que antes existiam podem não existir mais. Todos e quaisquer usuário podem mudar os seus conceitos sobre o que é certo e errado (tanto em termos de apreciação de post a ponto de fazer algum comentário ou clicar no botão de *upvote*, por exemplo). Novas diretrizes podem ser criadas, e eventualmente afetar o que todo mundo já pode conhecer. Enfim, as possibilidades são inúmeras. A questão é: **O seu post é bom o suficiente para ser relevante?** - Todos nós já nos perguntamos isso ao menos uma vez por aqui, e talvez... Nós devêssemos continuar a nos perguntar. Certamente não há uma resposta definitiva para responder o que é considerado ou não como um post de qualidade... Até porque, estamos falando sobre um aspecto que é subjetivo. Ainda que existam os aspectos específicos que definem (ou que pelos menos ajudam a nortear o caminho sobre o que - *de fato* - tem qualidade e relevância) essa perspectiva, todos os usuários definem os seus próprios padrões quando escrevem (e onde publicam) os seus textos. Quem define se o post é bom o suficiente é quem está do outro lado, e nem sempre é uma questão puramente que envolve mérito. O que cada usuário deveria fazer é se manter fiel aos seus próprios princípios e escolhas pessoas sobre os assuntos de importância particular. Uma vez que essa verdade prevalece, cada pessoa começa a escrever naturalmente, e não com um foco específico em impressionar outras pessoas. Um blog é uma página pessoal onde compartilhamos o que tende a ser interessante para nós, então, reflitam isso dentro do que é relevante dentro dos seus conceitos de apreciação ao longo do que pretende alcançar. Sim, todos os posts podem ser bons o suficiente. Você precisa acreditar nessa verdade. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/is-your-post-good-enough-bcj)

body.title: Mis sobrinos de paseo [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
>  ![428310.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23xydLhXJ5QWMwYARJm1reZig3bBHVMCWZSVhsvAn3u756LTEqR2nAiAZEeSntWWetZMu.png) Hola, ¿qué tal, amigos, cómo están? Porque todo muy bien, gracias a Dios; espero que por allá también un poco mejor después de todo lo que está pasando actualmente en nuestro país, aunque esta semana también ha sido de desastre, pero aquí seguimos adelante. El día de hoy quería compartirles el bonito día que pasó mi sobrino; yo quería ir, pero la verdad es que no me sentía bien para hacerlo. Esto pasó el día sábado. Mis sobrinos fueron invitados a una fiesta de 15 años en una posada que a mí siempre me ha llamado mucho la atención, pues se trata de Villamar. La cual tiene una vista hermosa hacia el mar, y siempre la he visto de lejos y me ha llamado mucho la atención. Mi plan era ir, pero la verdad es que no me sentía tan bien y no iba a disfrutar al momento, y mi sobrina debía ir obligatoriamente, porque ella entregaría la corona y los accesorios de la quinceañera.
Hello, how are you all, friends? Everything’s going very well, thank God; I hope things are a bit better over there too, after everything that’s been happening in our country recently, although this week has been a bit of a disaster as well, but we’re carrying on here. Today I wanted to share with you the lovely day my nephew had; I wanted to go, but to be honest, I wasn’t feeling well enough to do so. This happened on Saturday. My nephews were invited to a quinceañera party at an inn that has always caught my eye – Villamar. It has a beautiful view of the sea, and I’ve always seen it from a distance and found it really striking. I’d planned to go, but to be honest, I wasn’t feeling very well and wouldn’t have been able to enjoy myself, and my niece absolutely had to go, as she was presenting the crown and accessories to the quinceañera.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbZWXFoxsvDLStzeans4TxHm2Tz5J9KYGFs3GC6DiZtwi/1782867496688.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbZhAWHurQosDqgVo9TdcZHsXddMprJ5WbSd8JwUgMgWx/1782867498552.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWhHfNavvhdiGzi8iwP2jVE4bvD8cNafJTGnNQdbhd1Am/1782867500460.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNXsVv8PrQtytW2531gBDGWhxFPwkGTNcFDf74CCin5Th/1782867502467.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeLkhGVPoGAXCHAw7KPvNyAjRBoFFyzCDyMA3XkWX5rcp/1782867504456.jpg) Las cosas son así, que a mi sobrina es muy coqueta y a ella le encanta mucho lo que es el mundo de maquillaje y vestirse, así que ella aprovechó la ocasión para pedirle permiso a su mamá para que yo la maquillara para la ocasión porque ella no quería ir sencilla, así que me puse en manos a la hora y aproveché para tomarle unas fotos muy hermosas. Y también aprovecho para compartirles algunas imágenes sobre cómo se veía la vista y por qué les digo que es tan hermosa. A pesar de que a ellos se nota que disfrutaron mucho ese día, también debo decirles que, debido a la situación que estamos pasando, ya se tenía el lugar alquilado y no se podía echar para atrás. Y para cumplir los sueños, a la quinceañera solo se le colocó un poquitito de música para que bailara el vals y luego apagaron todo solo para que ella disfrutara de su momento, ya que es un momento que toda chica desea.
The thing is, my niece is quite the little fashionista and she absolutely loves the world of make-up and dressing up, so she seized the opportunity to ask her mum for permission for me to do her make-up for the occasion because she didn’t want to go without it. So I got straight to work and took the chance to snap some lovely photos of her. I’d also like to share a few pictures with you to show you what it looked like and why I say she’s so beautiful. Although it’s clear they really enjoyed the day, I must also mention that, given the situation we’re currently in, the venue had already been booked and there was no turning back. And to make her dreams come true, they played just a little bit of music for the quinceañera to dance the waltz, and then turned everything off so she could enjoy her moment in peace – as it’s a moment every girl dreams of.

body.title: Eternal Sunshine Of The Spotless Mind Is One Of The Most Unique Films Of The 2000s. Jim Carrey Proved He Was More Than Just A Comedy Legend. This 2004 Art House Style Film Became A Creative And Emotional Modern Classic.
body.body:
Eternal Sunshine Of The Spotless Mind Is One Of The Most Unique Films Of The 2000s. Jim Carrey Proved He Was More Than Just A Comedy Legend. This 2004 Art House Style Film Became A Creative And Emotional Modern Classic.

![IMG_3941.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQz8itn8aAG3vry5LJsLh7KsxZZ9JgXFCoPCgV8n91fSs/IMG_3941.webp)

Some movies are remembered because they are big and flashy, while others stay with you because of the emotions and ideas they explore. Eternal Sunshine Of The Spotless Mind is one of those films. Released in 2004, it was a completely different type of movie for many audiences and showed a side of Jim Carrey that people had rarely seen before.

The film was directed by Michel Gondry, who brought a very creative and unusual visual style to the story. Gondry used practical effects, unique camera techniques, and dreamlike sequences to create a world that feels like memories coming apart. His direction gives the movie an art house feeling while still keeping the story emotional and relatable.

The movie stars Jim Carrey as Joel Barish, a quiet and introverted man who discovers that his former girlfriend Clementine has erased him from her memory. Carrey was already famous as one of the biggest comedy actors in the world, but this role showed he could deliver a serious and dramatic performance.

This was really Jim Carrey’s first full on dramatic role without relying on his usual comedy style. There were hints of his dramatic ability before this, but Eternal Sunshine Of The Spotless Mind proved he could carry a deeply emotional story. He showed that he was not just the guy from Ace Ventura, The Mask, and Dumb And Dumber.

Kate Winslet stars as Clementine, Joel’s unpredictable and free spirited ex girlfriend. Winslet gives an incredible performance because Clementine feels like a real person rather than just a typical romantic movie character. She is complicated, emotional, and imperfect, which makes the relationship feel more realistic.

The supporting cast is also excellent. Mark Ruffalo, Kirsten Dunst, Elijah Wood, and Tom Wilkinson all add important pieces to the story. Each character helps explore different ideas about memory, relationships, and the choices people make.

The plot follows Joel as he discovers that Clementine has undergone a procedure to erase all memories of their relationship. Heartbroken, Joel decides to do the same. However, while the memories are being removed, he begins to realize he does not want to lose the good moments they shared.

One of the most interesting things about the film is the way it explores memories. Instead of telling a simple breakup story, it asks whether painful experiences are worth keeping if they are also connected to some of the best moments of our lives. It shows that even difficult relationships can shape who we become.

The visual style of the movie is one of its biggest strengths. The film moves through memories in a way that feels confusing but intentional. Rooms change, moments disappear, and reality blends with imagination, creating a feeling that perfectly matches how memories actually work.

The screenplay by Charlie Kaufman is another major reason the movie succeeds. The writing is creative, emotional, and different from most romantic films. It avoids simple answers and shows relationships as complicated experiences filled with both happiness and pain.

What makes Eternal Sunshine Of The Spotless Mind special is that it looks like an unusual art house movie but still has a story anyone can connect with. Beneath the strange visuals and unique structure, it is really about love, regret, and the fear of losing someone important.

For me, this film is a great example of an actor breaking away from what audiences expect. Jim Carrey proved he had serious dramatic talent, and Michel Gondry created something visually unforgettable. The cast, direction, and writing all work together perfectly.

More than twenty years later, Eternal Sunshine Of The Spotless Mind remains one of the most original films of the 2000s. It is strange, emotional, creative, and completely different from the usual Hollywood formula. It showed that Jim Carrey was much more than a comedy legend and created a movie that continues to be appreciated today.

Hello, July! And we overslept, lol! My usual waking hour is around 5 am, but today, I awoke at almost 8, and to a heartwarming sight. I couldn't help but freeze the moment through a snap.😍
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/EokgUzqS8jtcN59zBcq8EWtgnMfvVP9xSHs2xr91dzSrwAEd4Bu9Ck6K1UV9cEZ7jat.jpeg*[The LilGuy snoozing peacefully under dada's hand]*
Another day, another grace! And we are grateful as always. It is a drizzly Wednesday, as most of yesterday and throughout the night. It seems the weather is allowing us to pause and reset. So we might do just that. Thinking about it, we have been spending recent weeks in pursuits of productivity and busyness, of going out and about, constantly moving, and doing something. \

I suggested, and the hubby grinned. He liked the idea, and as of this writing, he is already glued to his screen. 😅

So it is decided, then, that today we are allowing ourselves to shift away from our endless to-do list and do whatever our hearts please.

But before that, I did a small power up. It's the first of the month after all! HP has crossed 29k. Slowly growing.

Meanwhile, the crypto market is mostly in the red, with BTC sliding below $60k. I read that the man whose mantra is \

has authorized the selling of over a billion dollars worth of his company's BTC portfolio to fund its cash reserves, buy back stock, and pay preferred dividends. I guess things didn't turn out the way he intended. Anyway, speaking of numbers, here's how my week 26th savings has progressed—1,322 HIVE in the savings account, an increase of 100 HIVE from 1,222 in the last update. HBD remains the same (32.04) as I haven't made any trades. Perhaps today is the chance (unless we get caught up with other things again). We'll see as the day unfolds, but we surely wouldn't waste it. --- ---
*All photos are my own unless specified. 01072026/08:56ph*

body.title: [EN/PT-BR] Hive Grove: On-chain security and network updates
body.body:
>


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tbCpfKbqNyA4pD5C7VdnCuy7emp7BTABheoPqHj1qvWCGqZiCCT25daRKdfRp73pRJ4.png)[ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/s/m_6a3c251b6a148191b84ad728b5ad0db4)</center>

![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)

You know I love updating and implementing new features in everything I do. Naturally, this time is no exception; I’ve made significant security improvements to the game to prevent \

from exploiting bugs to farm resources and grow without following the rules—new layers of protection have been added!

And chances are, many more will be implemented to ensure the game remains as secure and fair as possible. This is especially important given the game's social focus—which includes optional purchases for more land and trees that others can help maintain—so I need to do my utmost to keep improving everything.

A special thank you today goes to @gwajnberg and @forykw, who helped me greatly with improvements and the implementation of new features for Hive Grove.

___
___

## 🔐 Hive Signature Authentication (Keychain)

Until now, saving player state and recording \
relied solely on a shared secret known as a \

Starting today, the server requires cryptographic proof that the party calling the API is indeed the owner of the Hive account:

- Upon login, the client signs a challenge (`HiveGrove:login:<timestamp>`) using the **Posting key** via Hive Keychain.


- This challenge and signature are stored in the session and re-sent with every sensitive call (`POST /api/state`, `POST /api/help`).


- The server recovers the public key from the signature and verifies it against the account's `posting.key_auths` on the blockchain—only those who actually control the account can proceed.


- Sessions expire after 24 hours, limiting the replay window for a leaked signature.


- A global secret bypass remains available solely for administrative or bot use, requiring no signature.

____
____

## 🛡️ The server no longer trusts anything coming from the client

Several avenues where the client could \

to the server have been closed, thereby enhancing Hive Grove's security against malicious attempts to gain an unfair advantage.


- **Reward cooldown** is now calculated and validated entirely on the server based on the `last_claim` value stored in the database; consequently, the client can no longer force a claim prematurely.


- **Reward mode** (liquid vs. stake) is now read from the database rather than the request body.


- **Initial synchronization**: tree data (type, claims, `last_claim`) can only be created during the initial synchronization (migration from `localStorage`). Thereafter, the client cannot overwrite these fields; they change only through the server's game routes. ____
____

## 🌐 Network: Explore and Chat

The social network page has gained new tabs and features:

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23swc8y28EfyJCV1FNRm931K6JE1kbsYhtQkvz6fvYLe7q1JbpdDBVS2fNVc9WR6GSWbd.png)</center>


- **My Network** and **Explore**: You can now scan the network of any Hive user, not just your own. This allows you to see people outside your immediate network and social circle, helping you discover new individuals and assist with their groves.


- **\

**: Randomly visit the grove of someone in your already-scanned network, or—if you haven't scanned anything yet—find an active player directly from the game's account history. This feature will be improved in the future to make the search for a random user to visit truly random.


- **Grove assistance enters the social graph**: Help given and received (`grove_help`) now carries 8x the weight in the connection score. It is the game's \

interaction and now truly counts within the network, shifting some of the emphasis away from social interactions that occur outside of Hive Grove.



<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23t6zsos6AXgLCGyUbHQu6ypc4KL4oZm7qYmGHdZY4NgaQQQLVCo42iWL5arh53LzkC6H.png)</center>


- A new **\

** block displays the message history exchanged with each connection, including any stickers sent.


- Minor UX adjustments: the tab and scroll position of the network screen are restored upon returning, and the \

modal reopens automatically when you return from visiting a friend's garden.

___
___

## 🧹 Other adjustments

- Fixed a false positive regarding the \

block on the Friends screen; the calculation is now based solely on actually visible stickers, eliminating a scenario where the block appeared even when no emoji was on the screen.


- Added `dotenv` configuration to both the server and the client to organize environment variables.


- Updated the project's internal knowledge graph (graphify) to reflect the new code structure.

---
___

This entire batch of changes was merged today via the `feat/network-improvement` PR, wrapping up the security work developed over the past few days and delivering the first version of Hive Grove's explorable social network. Of course, I will continue to look for vulnerabilities and patch them as they arise. New features—such as new mechanics and the like—are planned for the future.

A big thank you to everyone using Hive Grove and sharing feedback or ideas for implementation; I’ll keep working to bring you new updates!

![sun_divisor.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXEDLx7R7Jy8fHF1tA7sPyb4A9QBvmj3y4FjFhephcPCS/sun_divisor.webp)

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tbCpfKbqNyA4pD5C7VdnCuy7emp7BTABheoPqHj1qvWCGqZiCCT25daRKdfRp73pRJ4.png)[ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/s/m_6a3c251b6a148191b84ad728b5ad0db4)</center>

![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)

Vocês sabem que eu amo atualizar e aplicar novas coisas em tudo o que faço. Então não poderia ser diferente por agora, já que fiz muitas melhorias de segurança no jogo para evitar que espertinhos se aproveitem de bugs para farmar e crescer sem seguir as regras, novas camadas de proteção foram adicionadas!

E se brincar muitas outras irão ser aplicadas também para que o jogo se torne sempre o mais seguro e justo possível, ainda mais que está voltado mais para a questão social com algumas compras caso você queira mais terras e mais arvores para as pessoas poderem te ajudar com a manutenção delas, então, eu preciso sempre fazer o possível para melhorar tudo.

O meu agradecimento especial hoje vai para o @gwajnberg e @forykw que me ajudaram em muitas coisas para a melhoria e implementação de novidades para o Hive Grove.

___
___

## 🔐 Autenticação por assinatura Hive (Keychain)

Até agora, salvar o estado do jogador e registrar a \
dependia só de um segredo compartilhado, que chamamos de \

. A partir de hoje, o servidor exige uma prova de criptográfica de que quem está chamando a API é realmente o dono da conta Hive:

- No login, o cliente assina um desafio (`HiveGrove:login:<timestamp>`) com a **Posting key** via Hive Keychain.


- Esse desafio + assinatura ficam guardados na sessão e são reenviados em toda chamada sensível (`POST /api/state`, `POST /api/help`).


- O servidor recupera a chave pública da assinatura e confere contra o `posting.key_auths` da conta na blockchain — só passa quem realmente controla a conta.


- Sessões expiram em 24h, limitando a janela de replay de uma assinatura vazada.


- Um bypass por segredo global continua existindo apenas para uso administrativo/bot, sem precisar de assinatura.

____
____

## 🛡️ Servidor não confia mais em nada vindo do cliente

Vários pontos onde o cliente podia \

para o servidor foram fechados, aumentando assim a segurança do Hive Grove contra quem quisesse fazer algo malicioso para obter vantagens.

- **Cooldown de recompensa** agora é calculado e validado inteiramente no servidor, a partir do `last_claim` salvo no banco, sendo assim o cliente não consegue mais forçar um claim antes da hora.


- **Modo de recompensa** (líquido vs. stake) passou a ser lido do banco de dados, não mais do corpo da requisição.


- **Sincronização inicial**: dados de árvore (tipo, claims, last_claim) só podem ser criados na primeira sincronização (migração do localStorage). Depois disso, o cliente não consegue mais sobrescrever esses campos e eles só mudam através das rotas de jogo no servidor.

____
____

## 🌐 Network: explorar e conversar

A página de rede social ganhou abas e novos recursos:

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23swc8y28EfyJCV1FNRm931K6JE1kbsYhtQkvz6fvYLe7q1JbpdDBVS2fNVc9WR6GSWbd.png)</center>


- **Minha Rede** e **Explorar**: agora dá para escanear a rede de qualquer usuário Hive, não só a sua própria. Com isso você pode ver mais pessoas fora da sua rede e circulo social, podendo encontrar novas pessoas que nunca viu na vida e ajuda-las com seu bosque.


- **\

**: visita aleatória a um bosque de alguém da sua rede já escaneada ou busca um jogador ativo direto do histórico da conta do jogo, se você ainda não escaneou nada. Essa função será melhorada no futuro deixando bem mais aleatório essa busca por alguém aleatório para que você possa visitá-lo.


- **Ajudas do Grove entram no grafo social**: ajudas dadas e recebidas (`grove_help`) agora pesam ×8 no score de conexão, é a interação mais \

do jogo e passou a contar de verdade na rede, tirando um pouco  peso apenas de interações sociais fora do Hive Grove.



<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23t6zsos6AXgLCGyUbHQu6ypc4KL4oZm7qYmGHdZY4NgaQQQLVCo42iWL5arh53LzkC6H.png)</center>


- Um novo bloco de **\

** mostra o histórico de mensagens trocadas com cada conexão, junto com os stickers enviados.


- Pequenos ajustes de UX: a aba e a posição de rolagem da tela de rede são restauradas ao voltar, e o modal de \

reabre automaticamente quando você volta de uma visita à horta de um amigo.

___
___

## 🧹 Outros ajustes

- Correção de um falso positivo no bloqueio de \

na tela de Amigos, o cálculo agora se baseia só nos stickers realmente visíveis, eliminando um caso onde o bloqueio aparecia sem nenhum emoji na tela. - Configuração via `dotenv` adicionada ao servidor e ao client, organizando variáveis de ambiente. - Atualização do grafo de conhecimento interno do projeto (graphify) para refletir a nova estrutura de código. --- ___ Esse pacote de mudanças foi todo mesclado hoje através da PR `feat/network-improvement`, fechando a parte de segurança que vinha sendo construída nos últimos dias e entregando a primeira versão da rede social explorável do Hive Grove. Claro que ainda vou continuar procurando por brechas e assim aplicando correção em todas elas. Novas implementações devem vim futuramente, novas mecânicas e coisas do tipo. Sendo assim, muito obrigado a todos que vem utilizando o Hive Grove e já deram algum feedback ou ideia para implementar, vou continuar trabalhando para trazer novidades! ![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)
[![banner_hiver_br_01.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcTb42obRrjKQYdtH2ZXjyQb1pn7HNgFgMpTeC6QKtPu4/banner_hiver_br_01.png)](https://discord.com/invite/kg6ee3vtrp)

body.body: > Hello, fans of great music. Today is Tuesday (or still is for me right now), which means it’s time to bring you my special selection of three songs from one of my favorite Rock bands. That’s right, we’re continuing with more Rock ’N’ Roll bands from the 2000s and 2010s—the era when I first discovered this amazing genre while I was still in middle school. Just a reminder that this special section is brought to you thanks to the weekly contest organized by @ablaze in the Music community, called “Three Tunes Tuesday.” Among the many Rock bands I ignorantly came to know as a teenager thanks to the people I hung out with, only a few names really stuck in my memory because of how influential they were back then. Among them is Papa Roach, a Rock and Metal band that some of you surely know because of how popular they were back in the 2000s. Papa Roach was founded in 1993 in California, United States, and became widely known a decade later for its heavy sound and melancholic lyrics. Below, I’ll share three of my favorite songs by this amazing band.

>
Hola, fanáticos de la buena música. Hoy es martes (o lo sigue siendo para mí ahora mismo) así que eso significa que es momento de traerles mi selección especial de tres canciones de una de mis bandas de Rock favoritas. Así es, seguimos con más bandas rocanroleras de la época de los 2000 y 2010 donde llegué a conocer este gran género cuando apenas estaba en secundaria. Les recuerdo que esta sección especial es traída a ustedes gracias al concurso semanal que nos prepara @ablaze en la comunidad de Music titulado Three Tunes Tuesday. Entre tantas bandas de Rock que ignorantemente llegué a conocer de adolescente gracias a la gente con la que me juntaba, solo pocos nombres llegaron a impregnarse en mi memoria debido a lo influyentes que fueron en aquella época. Entre ellos está Papa Roach, una banda de Rock y Metal que seguramente alguno de ustedes conocen debido a lo populares que fueron en aquella época de los 2000. Papa Roach fue fundada en 1993 en California, Estados Unidos y fue popularmente conocida una década después por su sonido fuerte y sus letras melancólicas. A continuación les presento tres de mis canciones favoritas de esta grandiosa banda.

> We’re kicking things off with a bang—a classic, an anthem for an entire generation, a generation that emerged from a dark era to grow and realize that not everything in life was lost. “Last Resort” is the first single from the second and most popular album by the California band Papa Roach, titled Infest (2000). The song has become very popular for its sound, which draws from Nu Metal and incorporates some Rap elements that are very characteristic of the band. The lyrics of “Last Resort” speak to the heart-wrenching feelings of someone living with depression and suicidal thoughts. Despite having a fairly uplifting rhythm and sound, personally, I believe that the contrast between this and the lyrics of “Last Resort” offers a clear message that certain feelings and thoughts are just as intense and confusing as what we hear all around us. The lyrics of this song repeat the phrases “‘cause I’m losing my sight, losing my mind” and “wish somebody would tell me I’m fine” several times, which we can interpret as a clear cry for help from the speaker. This cry stems from everything the song itself describes. Pain, loneliness, despair, suffocation, numbness, confusion, frustration, disappointment, regret, depression, and finally, the desire to end it all. All of this and more is what the song conveys to us, in a nutshell. Surely more than one person has identified with this song because they’ve likely experienced something similar. That feeling of being completely lost, alone, and with no way out—thinking that “nothing is right” and that it’s impossible to “live like this.” Life sometimes hits us so hard that we even wonder if it’s worth living, and “Last Resort” conveys this very well.

>
Empezamos de lo más fuerte con un clásico, un himno de toda una generación, una generación que trascendió de una época de oscuridad para crecer y darse cuenta de que no todo estaba perdido en esta vida. Last Resort es el primer sencillo del segundo y más popular álbum de la banda californiana, Papa Roach, titulado Infest (2000). La canción se ha vuelto muy popular por su sonido derivado del Nü Metal y algunos elementos del Rap muy característicos de la banda. La letra de Last Resort habla del sentimiento desgarrador de alguien que vive con depresión y pensamientos suicidas. A pesar de tener un ritmo y sonido bastante estimulante, en lo personal, considero que el contraste que tiene esto con la letra de Last Resort nos ofrece un mensaje claro de que ciertos sentimientos y pensamientos son tan fuertes y confusos como lo que escuchamos a nuestro alrededor. La letra de esta canción repite varias veces las frases “‘cause I'm losing my sight, losing my mind” y “wish somebody would tell me I'm fine”, lo cual podemos tomar como un claro llamado de auxilio por parte del interlocutor. Este llamado es debido a todo lo que la misma canción nos describe. Dolor, soledad, desesperación, sofocación, insensibilidad, confusión, frustración, decepción, lamentación, depresión y finalmente deseos de acabar con todo. Todo esto y más es lo que nos habla la canción, en pocas palabras. De seguro a más de uno se habrá identificado con esta canción debido a que probablemente llegó a vivir algo parecido. Esa sensación de estar completamente perdido, solo y sin escapatoria, pensando que “nada está bien” y que es imposible “vivir así”. La vida a veces llega a pegarnos tan fuerte que hasta nos preguntamos si vale la pena vivir y Last Resort transmite esto muy bien.

> Let’s talk now about another great Papa Roach song that’s been in my subconscious ever since I discovered them when I was just starting high school. “Scars” is the second single from their fourth studio album, Getting Away With Murder (2004). The song has a rhythm and sound that the band was already making its own back then. I’m talking about Alternative Rock—a sound less heavy than the Nu Metal that had become their trademark in previous years. The lyrics of “Scars” describe a metaphorical process for healing the heart. The phrase that is constantly repeated from the beginning—“I tear my heart open, and so myself shut”—makes this healing process clear to us. It involves an act of “tearing open” or opening the heart—presumably to feel an emotion—and then “closing” it yourself, as a form of healing and moving forward. “Scars” carries various meanings or messages that apply to anyone in any circumstance where we feel the need to vent and “open up” in order to heal. But from what I gather from the song as a whole, the speaker may be referring to an act of “healing” following a painful breakup. This can be inferred from lines like “I tried to help you once, against my own advice” and “I saw you going down, but you never realized that you’re drowning in the water,” where we realize that the protagonist knows someone who was going through a difficult time in their life or had many flaws to work on—and that, even with his help, that person simply refused to accept it. Then there’s the line that clearly describes me: “I’m sorry, but I’ve got to move on with my own life.”

>
Hablemos ahora de otra gran canción de Papa Roach que llevo en mi subconsciente desde que los conocí cuando apenas estaba entrando en secundaria. Scars es el segundo sencillo del cuarto álbum de estudio titulado Getting Away With Murder (2004). La canción posee un ritmo y sonido que ya en aquella época estaba adoptando la banda como propia. Estoy hablando del Rock Alternativo, un sonido menos pesado que el Nü Metal que los identificó muy bien en años anteriores. La letra de Scars nos habla de un procedimiento gráfico para hacer sanar el corazón. La frase que constantemente se repite desde el principio “I tear my heart open, and so myself shut” nos deja claro dicho procedimiento de curación, el cual implica un acto de “desgarrar” o abrir el corazón, seguramente para así sentir alguna emoción y posteriormente “cerrarlo” tú mismo, como una especie de sanación y superación. Scars posee distintos significados o mensajes que sirven para cualquier persona o circunstancia en la que nos sintamos con necesidades de desahogarnos y “abrirnos” para así luego sanar. Pero por lo que llego a entender de toda la canción como tal, el interlocutor puede que esté hablando de un acto de “curación” posterior a una fuerte ruptura. Esto se puede extraer de frases como “I tried to help you once, against my own advice”, “I saw you going down, but you never realized that you're drowning in the water” donde nos damos cuenta de que nuestro protagonista conoce a alguien que estaba pasando por algo difícil en su vida o tenía muchos defectos que mejorar y que, aún con su ayuda, esa persona simplemente no quiso aceptarla. Luego está la frase que claramente me describe “I'm sorry, but I gotta move on with my own life”.

/>

… To Be Loved - Papa Roach

> To wrap up this special selection, I couldn’t think of a better way to do it than with another song that has easily stuck in my subconscious since I was a teenager and has recently come back stronger than ever. “To Be Loved” is the first single from their fifth studio album, The Paramour Sessions (2006). The song has remained popular ever since thanks to its energetic rhythm, which stems from its blend of Hard Rock and Rap elements. It’s one of my favorites from Papa Roach’s vast repertoire because of all the power and energy it conveys. The lyrics of “To Be Loved” speak to an internal and external struggle faced by the narrator and his constant search for love in his life. The constant repetition of the phrase “Woah, never give in, woah, never give up, woah, never give in, I just wanna be, wanna be loved” in the chorus makes this very clear. The song can also be seen as a declaration of acceptance and a challenge to keep moving forward despite difficulties, with a positive attitude and a winner’s mindset. But I prefer to see it more as that search for love in life, in this world plagued by chaos and injustice. I fell in love with the song the moment I first heard it back when I was just a teenager and was discovering this vast musical genre. I won’t deny that my skepticism about the meaning of this and other songs was completely overshadowed by my fascination with their rhythm and excellent sound. Papa Roach is one of those bands that manages to convey all the emotions described in their lyrics through their sound, and that’s something I really like. In short, “To Be Loved” is the message of a man with a dark heart who is searching for love.

>
Para finalizar esta selección especial no encontré una mejor manera de hacerlo que con otra canción que muy fácilmente se quedó en mi subconsciente desde que era adolescente y que recientemente ha vuelto con más potencia que nunca. To Be Loved es el primer sencillo del quinto álbum de estudio titulado The Paramour Sessions (2006). La canción llegó a popularizarse desde entonces debido a su ritmo enérgico originado de su mezcla de Hard Rock con elementos del Rap. De mis favoritas de todo el enorme repertorio de Papa Roach debido a toda la potencia y energía que transmite. La letra de To Be Loved nos habla de una lucha interna y a la vez externa que tiene el interlocutor y su constante búsqueda del amor en su vida. La repetición constante de la frase “Woah, never give in, woah, never give up, woah, never give in, I just wanna be, wanna be loved” en su coro nos deja esto bien claro. La canción también se puede considerar como una declaración de aceptación y desafío de seguir adelante a pesar de las dificultades con una actitud positiva y una mentalidad de ganador. Pero prefiero tomarlo más como esa búsqueda del amor en la vida, en este mundo plagado de caos e injusticias. La canción me llegó a gustar desde el segundo en que lo llegué a escuchar en su momento cuando apenas era adolescente y estaba conociendo este enorme género musical. No voy a negar que mi incredulidad ante el significado de esta y las demás canciones fueron completamente indiferentes ante mi fascinación por el ritmo y el excelente sonido que poseen. Papa Roach es de esas bandas que logran transmitir todas esas emociones que describen en sus letras con su sonido y eso es algo que me gusta bastante. To Be Loved es en resumen el mensaje de un hombre de corazón negro que busca amor.

>
Tell me, do you know the band Papa Roach, too? Which of their songs is your favorite? Leave your answer in the comments.

>

links.body:
The proof isn't hidden in theory. It's written in Bitcoin's own history.

That's powerful. Bitcoin has already been tested  SegWit, the block wars, the scaling debates. Each time, the community found a way forward, not because it was easy, but because the alternative was stagnation.

The fact that different groups disagreed developers, miners, businesses  and still found consensus is what makes Bitcoin different. It's messy, but it works.

I wasn't around for SegWit, but reading about it makes me appreciate how far Bitcoin has come.

Do you think the next big upgrade will be as contested as SegWit, or has the community matured?

>

Una Más de Tren Inferior. Ayer fue abdomen con mancuerna; y hoy volvemos a activarnos con el tren inferior; siempre poniendo a la disposición otros grupos musculares. La sesión que se presenta a continuación está demasiado poderosa; porque además de tener en llamas el tren inferior, también veremos que el trabajo abdominal y en el tren superior están presentes. Si el abdomen es nuestro centro de gravedad; la zona inferior es el centro de la movilidad, claro está, que la conexión entre núcleo y piernas es vital. Ahora; no se diga más, vamos a la acción y vente conmigo para que le des movimiento a tu vida. >Another Lower Body Workout. Yesterday we did dumbbell ab exercises; today we’re back to working the lower body, always engaging other muscle groups as well. The session below is incredibly intense; not only will your lower body be on fire, but you’ll also engage your abs and upper body. If the abs are our center of gravity, the lower body is the center of mobility—so, of course, the connection between your core and your legs is vital. Now, enough talk—let’s get moving! Join me and bring some movement into your life.
