# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **RODILLAZOS FRONTALES CON MOVIMIENTO DE BRAZOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; codos flexionados con brazos al frente. >[**Warm-up 1**, **FORWARD KNEE LIFTS WITH ARM MOVEMENTS**]() >[Posture]() >Legs hip-width apart; elbows bent with arms in front.
![1000484514.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKZnqsUxPu6rvjtH7K9rb6fs6nBm1JWBCmEoakw9YMag1bYu1B45inYvAkQdXi5.gif)
[Ejecución]() Activos en la postura indicada y durante 3 minutos; rápidamente, propinamos rodillazos alternos frontales, bajando y subiendo brazos, siempre con codos flexionados. >[Execution]() >Hold the position shown for 3 minutes; then, quickly deliver alternating front knee strikes, lowering and raising your arms, keeping your elbows bent at all times.
![1000484516.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKZnqsUxAwPpginkwshQ5XLwwCANizvv6n72ciYtz4rLMgUgqKU9gJa3NDhxyMb.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **SENTADILLAS LATERALES CON PEQUEÑOS SALTOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas juntas, con brazos a los lados extendidos hacia abajo. >[**Warm-up 2**, **SIDE SQUATS WITH SMALL JUMPS**]() >[Posture]() >Legs together, arms at your sides, extended downward.
![1000484518.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKZns3vXpmYnK9rBbeap1as8wpERzQ3YSJPTMoQU33hJj3ZX6JjN1uLyiF5zKSC.gif)
[Ejecución]() Activos en 3 minutos. Damos pequeños saltos lado lado, finalizando con sentadillas y la flexión de codos. >[Execution]() >Get moving in 3 minutes. Do small side-to-side jumps, finishing with squats and elbow bends.
![1000484522.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKZnc6335BE1BAcEBF2vUW3xRg5AvUs5BpHAUG5C2SszMdYonPep68G1HRFhCei.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **SENTADILLA PROFUNDA EN PUNTA DE PIES MÁS RODILLAS JUNTAS Y ALTERNAS AL SUELO**]() [Postura]() Usamos protección para las rodillas. Nos ubicamos de pie, con piernas al ancho de la cadera. Manos en la cintura. >[**Station 1**, **DEEP SQUAT ON TOES WITH KNEES TOGETHER AND ALTERNATING KNEES TO THE FLOOR**]() >[Posture]() >We wear knee pads. We stand with our legs hip-width apart. Hands on our waist.
![1000484524.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKRB8sXu1g7haJsowgR1y5Gi7MDphZfLrrC7QZsL753CwHqcqr1LvZauqMptrbq.gif)
[Ejecución]() Trabajo potente para abdomen y tren inferior; mucho control y equilibrio podemos ganar con este ejercicio. Realizamos la sentadilla profunda, quedando en punta de pies. Rápidamente; llevamos al mismo tiempo las rodillas al suelo y colocamos el cuerpo recto. Tomamos impulso y volvemos a la postura de pie. Nuevamente, sentadilla profunda en punta de pies; pero ahora, las rodillas van al suelo de forma alterna y cuerpo recto; nuevamente regresamos a la postura inicial. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >A powerful workout for the abs and lower body; this exercise helps us develop a lot of control and balance. Perform a deep squat, balancing on your toes. Quickly, bring both knees to the floor at the same time and straighten your body. Push off and return to a standing position. Again, perform a deep squat on your toes; but this time, bring your knees to the floor alternately while keeping your body straight; then return to the starting position. 20 repetitions total in 4 sets.
![1000484526.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKRB9bRRLqooWvb7JB1a1gZF5GoATSKJU3yMfA8j5TMKgJofuggDY6LGs4RDAMk.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **SENTADILLA EN SALTO A PARTIR DE PLANCHA, MÁS RODILLAZOS ALTERNOS, MÁS DOBLE SENTADILLA**]() [Postura]() Adoptamos la postura de plancha o flexiones; brazos al ancho de la cadera y piernas al ancho de hombros. >[**Station 2**, **PLANK JUMP SQUAT, ALTERNATING KNEE LIFTS, AND DOUBLE SQUAT**]() >[Position]() >Assume the plank position; arms hip-width apart and legs shoulder-width apart.
![1000484528.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKPkBM4bDqocZmKQDfLdfAE86vVYAL6FtwavC3Sx9BEYn888qoR6kc3CnxZEVnR.gif)
[Ejecución]() Todo el cuerpo trabajando de manera integral, con énfasis en todo el tren inferior. En primer lugar; piernas al frente en salto quedando en sentadilla en punta de pies. Rápidamente, nos vamos de pie y damos un rodillazo frontal con cada pierna. Luego; Ejecutamos dos sentadillas, en la segunda sentadilla manos en el piso y volvemos a la postura inicial. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >The entire body works in a holistic manner, with an emphasis on the lower body. First, jump forward with your legs and land in a squat on your toes. Quickly stand up and perform a front knee strike with each leg. Next, perform two squats; on the second squat, place your hands on the floor and return to the starting position. 20 total repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000484530.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKPkFUqPSWaxpB8auP3Gnwcj4GVG4sdypEr9ZanaUds8zkhK4ayfbvLALxFGi4R.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **SENTADILLAS LATERALES Y DIAGONALES**]() [Postura]() Piernas juntas con rodillas flexionadas; torso flexionado al frente, codos flexionados con brazos al frente. >[**Station 3**, **SIDE AND DIAGONAL SQUATS**]() [Posture]() Legs together with knees bent; torso bent forward, elbows bent with arms in front.
![1000484548.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKU3eiRKN1iMhmXuAbVwMcET8gdDbb5ANLAaDcdQRWLQStWrZ2JLR9yvq5XET8L.gif)
[Ejecución]() Núcleo y piernas super activas. Realizamos una sentadilla de lado a lado; luego, vienen las sentadillas diagonales. Serían 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >Core and super-active legs. We'll do side-to-side squats, followed by diagonal squats. That's for a total of 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000484550.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKU3cobkCRUXaoJAnq4JrPx9Ep3bnFJszoqDEKNia73KvajuWGsLomHT69qiJwT.gif)
[**Relajación**, **EXTENSIÓN DE CUÁDRICEPS CON MOVIMIENTO DE LADO A LADO**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; brazos a los lados extendidos hacia abajo. >[**Relaxation**, **QUADRICEPS EXTENSION WITH SIDE-TO-SIDE MOVEMENT**]() >[Posture]() >Legs hip-width apart; arms at your sides, extended downward.
![1000484552.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AKbE9GePv1FnDKh4yFU3mo9DELvEQX4txQVfT5icF52X9ZKUk7139Sp1fLRnUix.gif)
[Ejecución]() Respirando y exhalando; durante 3 minutos de relajación y paz corporal, giramos a un lado, flexionamos la rodilla llevando el pie hacia atrás, tomándolo suavemente con la mano. Giramos y hacemos lo mismo con la otra pierna. >[Execution]() >Breathing in and out; after 3 minutes of relaxation and physical calm, we turn to one side, bend the knee, bringing the foot back, and gently hold it with our hand. We turn and do the same with the other leg.
![1000484556.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AKZnsnhhGfLZvWx2CRE8A3dekVC4BHoVP5S22nGSDNqZ9YDUGWpVF7UKoCfCNtx.gif)
Gracias por preferir nuestro canal. Recuerda que debes tomar descansos de calidad, hidratarte y alimentarte sanamente. Hasta la próxima y si deseas una rutina en particular, en los comentarios la puedes solicitar. >Thank you for choosing our channel. Remember to take quality breaks, hydrate and eat healthy. Until next time and if you want a particular routine, you can ask for it in the comments. #

links.title: The town of Sebauh,Bintulu
links.body: Good afternoon, my wonderful friends.. How are you? I am going to introduce you to a place that maybe a lot of people have not even heard of. This is the town of Sebauh, Bintulu. This is the first time that I have visited this town too. This town still has a lot of traditional architecture that still exists today. A lot of the buildings now are modernized, and many have already been redesigned. The different architectural designs here can tell a person which era these buildings were built. One of the most unique things about this place is that there is a temple that used to be on an island, and to get there, you had to use a boat to get to the other side. But after the government recently built a connection bridge to this other side, you just drive there. I wanted to check out this place too. But I was quite hungry, so I was searching for a place to eat lunch. SEBAUH, BINTULU =============== SARAWAK

/> This shop is called Ting Seng Bang This is the owner's name. In the traditional Chinese context in Sarawak, many of the older shops tend to be named after the owner, maybe in the hopes that one day, this shop gets inherited by the next generation. This signboard is still wooden, which is different from the modern plastic and metal signboards that exist today. Why is no lighting needed? The reason is very simple. This town has a population of around 30k, so these are shops that do not need to open late into the day. By around 2 p.m. most of the shops here are closed.
/> I went to a more modern shop to eat because the shop that I visited in the last couple of pictures was closing for the day. I only ordered a drink there.
/> Lots of fish in this shop. Goldfish. So many different types. My favourite type of fish.

/> Ordered a plate of Nasi Lemak Ayam Berempah. What is so special about this dish is that it comes with curry that you can pour onto the rice to add some flavour to the rice. Next, the chicken is fried with a special spice that makes the chicken much crispier than it should be.
/> Overall, at least 9/10 for the dish. A bowl of meatballs with noodles. My wife ordered this. The size of the meatballs is huge. Have you seen such huge meatballs?
/> Ordered a cup of cold coffee with jelly inside. This is a special cup of coffee. Have you tried this type of coffee before?
/> After eating lunch, it was time for me to head to this legendary temple. This temple was in the middle of an island till land slowly came to it.
/> These roads used to be part of the river but have been filled. So, no more ferrying from the other side.
/> After visiting the temple, I drove around a bit to check out the other parts of the city. I was also searching for an area to fly my drone.

/> Some of the wall paintings of famous places in Sarawak. Behold, the painting of NIAH CAVE. This cave is located in Sarawak and at the moment has the UNESCO world heritage site status. This is one of the oldest cave where humans lived dating to at least 50,000 to as early as 65,000 years ago. There are some cave drawings painted by early man. More about this place next itme.

/> The painting of the main cave complex. One of the largest in the entire world at a span of 350 metres in the cave opening, creating a natural shelter from predators. Some of the bones found here have now been displayed at a musuem in Kuching, Sarawak .
/> The real picture of Niah Cave. Not my photo/\n\n
/> Thank you for reading this post. Have a wonderful day ahead. @luueetang YouTube: www.youtube.com/luueejanice Tiktok: www.tiktok.com/@luueejanice

That’s how I play these coin matches now. I just sit back and the moment they misplace one pass or push too high, I hit them with a sharp counter. No building up, no time wasting. First half was slow, boring even. They were dominating but couldn’t break me down. Then it happened — they lost the ball around midfield and I was gone. 3 passes later the ball was at Batistuta’s feet and he just buried it. 1:0. That screamer came out of nowhere but it was exactly what I needed 😕 My only shot on target all game and it went in.
After that goal I just parked the bus. 1 goal was enough for me. I kept dropping deep, making tackles, clearing everything. They kept pushing but my defense was locked in and I made sure not to concede. Final whistle blew and I finally got the W. That 1:0 took me the 50 coins and I completed the event. 
Wasn’t pretty football at all, but in these events you don’t care about style points. Batistuta bailed me out again with that one goal. Now I can finally move on from this World Cup event. You grinding any events this week or you already done?

links.title: A Short Game on Lichess
links.body:
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXhWXT6jW9NyJ7EqCXTyehsMpj4VsDAi4RKGH2dLbvBhB/image.png)</center>

Greetings to all chess fans. I haven't played chess for a while and have missed the Saturday chess tournaments run by @sam.chess. I've been busy lately and sleep early on weekends. Consequently, I wasn't able to join the tournaments because it starts late at night in our country.  I'm practicing blitz again to prepare myself in the next tournaments. I have this short but fun game on lichess.com.

The game started with 1. d4 Nf6 2. Bf4 g6 3. e3 Bg7 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcJFC61XdmnJ813AzRqzXG4BsEjtr3ysKFbhDnRRZwnva/image.png)</center>

The London System known for being solid but simple. I return to familiar territory to save time. I played with this opening so many times, I don't have to think and just make moves automatically. 4. Nf3 d6 5. c4 O-O 6. Nc3 Nbd7 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaumfvYy89W8vfYodVH2YqrHhjyb4ze2GMUXuw1QfzJM1/image.png)</center>

I played the London System against the King's Indian Defense so many times with good results. I intend to meet black's Kingside attack with an attack on the opposite side in conjunction with my dark squared Bishop controlling the h2 to b8 diagonal. 7. h3 c5 8. Be2 cxd4 9. exd4 a6 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNoD8TiXPcfYyT7Bvf1xyBEXM7DVKUTBsxDBUFuTtheAb/image.png)</center>

The game transposed to a Sicilian Dragon with White castling King side. 10. O-O b5 11. b3 Qa5 12. Bd2 Qc7 13. cxb5 Ne8 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeSntEpc2sFzBZhNFxfnZw79CbjAf8tSVhpbGCWQLJpfr/image.png)</center>

My opponent blundered a pawn. He's claiming compensation with pressure on my isolated d4 pawn. 14. bxa6 Bxa6 15. Bxa6 Rxa6 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUcutDCseqQMj6eUzo2vAuxaBLqF8hmzrqW34ZSZDe3JY/image.png)</center>

It's nice to find this simple tactic. The double attack wins another pawn on e7. 16. Qe2 Rc6 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbNN8wUaaDrA9uNnUWyHB7LTnMoM4634n4twkriTVHKR3/image.png)</center>

Huge blunder. Now he loses his the exchange. The Knight will capture the pawn on e7 while forking the King and Rook. 17. Nd5 Qd8 18. Nxe7+ 1-0

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZkRxcMmxPDuzzv7vCUbH6eqNPB4jdwJSo1fvRyZti9AC/image.png)</center>

That was a short and fun game. 

Game link: https://lichess.org/90dSxkhe

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZHVSP1DND7kdWvBkmY3VZQqhFM4pLyhqEJRoYJTuxnjg/image.png)


Playing chess is great for the mind but let's not forget about physical activities. I recently committed to exercise and to keep me motivated, I joined actifit.io

>Veteran Officer Lindsey Hubert had stood on the cracked sidewalk of Malvern Street observing a grim corridor of frayed high-rises and worn duplexes. A neighborhood full of secrets. He was now tasked with interrogating the quirky tenants connected to a fatal shooting of a teen.
>
>*Inside the high-rise building, he spotted Bradley Buford's first-floor apartment unit, knocked, then gained entrance. Between bites of his **garbage sandwich**, Bradley wasted no time filling Officer Hubert in on happenings since his last visit. Officer Hubert's voice rose. \
He stifled the impulse to sneeze at the sauerkraut, then braced himself.*\n>\n>Bradley chuckled. \
Bradley mumbled, his eyes darting around the room as if looking for a camera crew. He continued slowly as if a suspicion of wire tapping was at play. \
*\n>\n>Hubert leaned forward, his shadow swallowing Bradley whole. \
Did you see a real kid exit the high-rise and run toward the alley, then retreat because of someone chasing him? or are you giving me a plot summary from yesterday's TV guide?\
The boy; he didn't have a briefcase. He had a backpack. It was torn. White powder was leaking out of the zipper. And it wasn't Victor who stepped out of the stairwell. It was Rosalinda Torres' kin.\
She lives on the third floor. The one with the big boobs. Oh, and I forgot, the neck tattoo. It wasn't a scene from the episode. The boy was running for his life trying to get home.\
**I'm in trouble**, right? Now, I'm their prime witness. Do you need to take down my information so that I can enter your witness protection program?\
Hubert then lowered his head and kept writing.\n>\n>**\
Bradley jumped up and strolled over to the fridge to get a soda. He turned and asked politely, although he hoped Hubert would refuse. \

**
>
>Hubert declined. He'd no intention of eating anything from Bradley's refrigerator. He left Bradley glued to the television, watching the trashy evening soap opera, blurring the dramas with the grim realities of Malvern Street. In the hallway, he shook his head and briefly wrote on the pad, noting Bradley’s erratic ramblings about backstabbing and secret heirs.
>
>*Next, Officer Hubert crossed the hall to catch the elevator up to Rosalinda Torres' unit. But before he could close the door, Juan approached. He interrupted the elevator with his hand and foot. \
Juan smiled as his eyes directed Hubert to Bradley's apartment. \

*
>
>Juan nodded good day, released the elevator door, and walked off as in a rush as Officer Hubert's ride to the third floor was filled with another twist.

**Now, Part 3: (Interviewing Malvern Street: High-Rise Ambitions-Continued)**

![262866.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23swXV8TTdSfCAMefZgEG2MHmtqq9ibT4QeFL1viVbJRuMz1ESKLDzDm4NkSDENoFbtBM.png)

Officer Lindsey Hubert exited the elevator and immediately took stock of the third floor's layout. The stairwell's proximity to Rosalinda Torres' unit in particular. Cautiously, he approached her apartment. Before he could knock, Rosalinda swung open the door. *\

*

An unusual greeting to say the least, Hubert pondered, as he had yet to speak or introduce himself, let alone accuse her of any wrongdoing.

He walked in. What a transformation! From the hallway, one would never guess the luxuries, to put it mildly, that resided in Apartment 3D alongside its tenant both Bradley and Juan viewed as a suspect.

That Hubert had a difficult time concentrating was an understatement. The thermostat ensured a comfortable respite from the outside heat. However, the temperature in the room seemed to rise the moment he fully assessed Rosalinda Torres.

He watched as Rosalinda stood in the middle of the living room with hands on her hips. With the flip of her wrist, she cocked her head to the side. Cranberry Stiletto Matte Lip Whip invited him to drown in its wearer. Long black tresses covered her shoulders but couldn't hide her wares if they wanted to. She wore a tight, low-cut crimson top exposing the neck tattoo. Jeans that looked painted on rounded out the outfit. But it was the four-inch stilettos that caused his pulse to skip a beat. An alluring female donning an outfit that screamed for attention in a building she obviously couldn't afford. 

Nothing but his knees went weak, so he asked to sit.

Hubert placed his pad over his legs as his gaze involuntarily drop to her exposed bosom. He forced his eyes back up to her face, clearing his throat roughly to mask the momentary lapse in professionalism.

\

Hubert said, his voice tighter than usual. She sat, crossing her legs slowly, fully aware of the effect she had on the room.

Rosalinda's job she mentioned and other information willingly provided clearly didn’t explain how she could afford the exorbitant monthly rent in the high-rise. She watched as Hubert surveyed the interior with a discerning eye. If any conclusion was made, he gave no indication.

She rose suddenly and strode over to the window, peering down at the sidewalk as if expecting to see someone.

\
* she stated matter-of-fact while still looking out the window. *\

*

Hubert watched her from behind as she switched positions, roving her hips in tandem, then bending over on the windowsill.

He rose, bid her goodbye, and left.

Outside in the hallway, Hubert bumped into Juan, sensing their second meeting was no accident. If Juan thought he'd gain information about Rosalinda's conversation, he was sadly mistaken.

\
As well as could be expected,\
I know you're not allowed to say, but she's an eye full, isn't she?\
she likes the attention and thinks she's untouchable, but there are plenty of men who can take her down a notch.\
If you think you're just the fella to do it, then by all means proceed. Don't be surprised if you're slapped with a restraining order.\

links.title: Cosiendo una cartera hecha con retazos de tela,y motivo de snoopy.//Sewing a wallet made from fabric scraps, with a Snoopy motif.[Esp~Eng]
links.body:
>Hola lindo grupo de hive. Después de Varios días del terremoto y aun mucha personas atrapadas y otros que perdieron la vida no es fácil sentir angustia tristeza y preocupación. Yo para ocupar mi mente recolecte varios recortes de mezclilla para ver que coser y vi una imagen y me llego la idea de hacer una cartera decorada con recortes de tela y formar una imagen de snoopy. para esto utilice :** # > Hello lovely hive group. After several days since the earthquake, with so many people still trapped and others who lost their lives, it's not easy to feel anguish, sadness, and worry. To occupy my mind, I collected several denim scraps to see what I could sew, and I saw a picture that gave me the idea to make a decorated purse with fabric scraps to create a Snoopy image. For this, I used: ---
![1000289553.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeUQAzJEQcaLPbV1tNVJYKBTEx6V1qoJE5WFynw3s42MP/1000289553.jpg)
# #
Materiales:/Materials:
 # * **mezclilla** * **Micro duraron rojo,verde, blanco y negro** * **Hilo y pelón** # >* **Denim** >* **Micro-durable in red, green, white, and black** >* **Thread and bald** # #
Elaboración|Elaboration
 #
![1000289554.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWzE8Du7WvnWKAotbKGXLi1ocsASFB8qAhw2nXbdRoCYq/1000289554.jpg)
![1000289555.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeZKaUBgHVtQ8vGcKCWsDsyjzhrDjqCUBXZ2wZ6XZthvB/1000289555.jpg)
![1000289556.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNfVKz2HBrxurqLofgVq7Wr1N3KBQxMgodkSyTAEgxvKM/1000289556.jpg)
# * #### Paso nro 1 **

>Empece por planchar el pelón sobre los recortes del micro durazno verde, rojo,blanco.** > * #### Step nro 1 > I started by ironing the bald patch over the cutouts of the green, red, white micro peach ---
![1000289557.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcppwHPUMqiRF3BY6U6RqawudFntQBWTbAaT3LWZmaNdm/1000289557.jpg)
![1000289560.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNyGTge45nmkPHrkM8fWx488Ao7RXjhhDQeMr4EcGYd6P/1000289560.jpg)
![1000289574.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTFzPoxKdppRc9V71HJEeUs4XQFNgHQVX4A1jiCmJxH5d/1000289574.jpg)
![1000289575.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPuyAQDtXUt14zz2sbraisQXijhTtyvhqTPq6rYzBGvU8/1000289575.jpg)
![1000289573.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYS3dGQedP1XkLWhsVPhsBjyVBgcjRmTMo4UGUMMh6r8o/1000289573.jpg)
![1000289576.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfMbi4MyfyBmp51gD2DFfWH1rmSnzVDy2cGTzJbP5NPzr/1000289576.jpg)
# * #### Paso nro 2 **

>Luego marque cada parte del dibujo en los colores seleccionados para cada pieza,los dibuje de la parte del pelón y recorte cada pieza.Y así empece a coser por todo el contorno de las piezas hasta lograr unir todo el dibujo.** > * #### Step nro 2 > Then I marked each part of the drawing in the colors selected for each piece, drew them on the back of the fabric, and cut out each piece. And so I began to sew along the entire outline of the pieces until I had joined the whole drawing together. ---
![1000289578.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ4Ue8M17y7kWaZiW6Un8aLB2sYn9fVf9vLA66LERUiic/1000289578.jpg)
![1000289564.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmShKQ1y7foGTh9K1CAG4XPZV8AGM8NigetHdaraNUHEwC/1000289564.jpg)
![1000289577.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYwXpdnd8YVHxPBehNyfa97ybZKKC6ygnbdSv7fYcvFpt/1000289577.jpg)

>Para la parte de atrás use tres colores distintos de mezclilla y los cosí para hacer la tapa trasera,y le coloque un bolsillo de pantalón de mezclilla para agregar más detalles.** > * #### Step nro 3 > For the back, I used three different colors of denim and sewed them together to make the back flap, and I added a denim pants pocket to add more detail. ---
![1000289578.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ4Ue8M17y7kWaZiW6Un8aLB2sYn9fVf9vLA66LERUiic/1000289578.jpg)

![1000289569.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZEAQLvL34GqT7qXzzmNsv1wDRgWSZmGrHFwJ7vSnHu9r/1000289569.jpg)
# * #### Paso nro 4 **

>Las asas las corte de mezclilla blanca y las cosí a las dos tapas antes de coserlas juntas.** > * #### Step nro 4 > I cut the handles from white denim and sewed them to the two lids before sewing them together. ---
![1000289570.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYPyN6UtBPJHBqz12osw2mhF21d8TykAYLHRhgPGfRvPB/1000289570.jpg)
# * #### Paso nro 5 **

>Luego corte en las puntas de abajo unos cuadrados pequeños y cosí la parte de abajo y los laterales y luego cosí los cuadrados en forma diagonal,para así cerrar la forma de la cartera.** > * #### Step nro 5 > Then cut small squares at the bottom points and sewed the bottom and sides together, and then sewed the squares diagonally to close the shape of the wallet. --- #
Resultado||Result
 # **

>La verdad no me esperaba este resultado por que no estaba tan concentrada solo iba improvisando cada paso y adaptándome a los recortes que tenía,cuando trabajo con recortes o prendas recicladas pienso en que si se puede dar una siguiente oportunidad a prendas o retazos de tela que damos por desechos.Espero les haya gustado la idea me despido de ustedes lindo grupo enviándole un caluroso abrazo... 🤗** # > I honestly didn't expect this result because I wasn't really focused; I was just improvising each step and adapting to the scraps I had. When I work with scraps or recycled clothing, I think about how we can give a second life to clothes or fabric pieces we usually consider waste. I hope you liked the idea. links.title: The great experience of opening a Glide Pack and the joy of collecting new cards
links.body:
When playing Splinterlands, every new day opens the door to new possibilities. Sometimes you win a battle and get new rewards, and sometimes you get the opportunity to test your luck by buying a Glide Pack using your accumulated Glint. I always believe that the feeling of opening a good pack is not limited to just getting a few cards; it is associated with expectations, excitement and planning for the future. I recently opened a Glide Pack and the cards I found there really made me happy.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcMQ2H1gPhWP3ymdDQeNz7CTFomBPMKsoJX4GyFcXYEcX/1782865330689.jpg)

The moment of opening the pack was quite exciting. Each card was coming out one by one, and I was interested in seeing which one was being added to my collection. The first thing that caught my eye was Katrella Gobson. Although it is a common card, I really liked its artwork. The confident stance and design of the character gave the card a different beauty. I always like such interesting designs in a new card collection.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVFBU8Zt8NiKE34ijj9CMPVckQaxU1MWkkYdcvg3ZTNdD/1782865330804.jpg)

Then comes Witch of Warwick. I found the dark color design and mysterious look of this card quite attractive.  A big feature of Splinterlands' art style is giving each character a different identity, and this card is a great example of that.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNT6eh8nZdNwD2brw3SmR3xWMZRSDi456jdF4smDKCfCt/1782865331049.jpg)

The biggest surprise was Tatiana Blayde. It's a Legendary card, and getting a Legendary from any pack is definitely a special feeling. My excitement increased several times as soon as I saw the card. Because Legendary cards not only increase  value  collection but can also bring tactical advantages in future battles. I have been waiting get a good Legendary for a long time so I am really happy have this card added to my collection.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPRZ3GAxChWDY69cLqy4ZN1ymPe76AaTQ3j7YTFvrW1Eo/1782865330993.jpg)

In addition I also got Rare card called Alfredo. Rare cards are usually very effective at times and can be gradually leveled up and become stronger. So I see this as an important addition for the future.

Another card was Chimney Wallstop. This character's huge hammer and powerful presence gave the card a different personality. Although it's a mediocre card, it will be possible to level up well if you collect multiple copies in the future.

Even after opening the second Glide Pack, luck did not disappoint me. There I got Whistling Damon first.  I found its character design and battle preparation style quite interesting.

Then came Bertrol Gobson. As another member Gobson family, this card also added new diversity to my collection. I always try to collect different types cards so that I have more options when building decks in future.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS6A1bYkpkty9uHGW8tbDUbo6AC3ZjsNsPt1ziL1vYEye/1782865330886.jpg)

Then I got Helmet Kharafax. The defensive properties and beautiful artwork of this card caught my eye. Sometimes such a card can play a very effective role in small mana battles.

The most enjoyable thing about the second pack was Edith Emberstar. This is an Epic card. It is always a special feeling to get Epic cards, because they are usually rare and in many cases are capable of giving extraordinary performance in battle. I am really pleased to have this card added to my collection.

Finally, I got Krash Wanderford. I really liked the aggressive style and design of this card. I intend to use it in different combinations in the future to test new strategies.

My biggest realization after opening the two Glide Packs is that each pack has the potential to surprise.  You never know when a pack will release a Rare, Epic Legendary card. And this uncertainty adds to the joy opening a Glide Pack.

To me Splinterlands is not just a game; its a long journey patience, planning and building a collection. Each new card is another step in that journey. Some of the cards I got today, I might use right away, and some I'll level up and make stronger in the future. This is how I'm slowly moving forward with the goal of building a balanced and powerful deck.

Before buying a Glide Pack, there's always a bit of hesitation—whether I'll get something good or not. But when I open the pack and get the desired quality cards, it's hard to put into words the joy. Especially getting Legendary Tatiana Blayde and Epic Edith Emberstar made this opening even more memorable for me.

I believe that by playing regularly patiently collecting rewards, and opening Glide Packs at right time, you can gradually build a more valuable collection. Todays opening has inspired me anew. I will continue open more packs, collect new cards, and try make my deck stronger.

todays Glide Pack opening was a wonderful experience joy, excitement, and achievement for me. Each card added new value my collection, and getting Legendary and Epic cards made this day a memorable chapter in my Splinterlands journey. I hope that such luck will accompany me in the future and I can take my gaming journey new heights by collecting more powerful and rare cards.

The beauty of humans is not always there and we see the beauty of various natural things along with humans. Among the beauty of various natural things, the beauty of various types of insects is one of the beauties. That is, I enjoy different types of natural beauty in different places at different times. Today I am sharing a very beautiful insect of the natural environment that looks wonderful with the beauty of nature. The name of this beautiful insect is Pentatomomorpha Insect. When I saw this insect, I enjoyed its beauty and because I liked it, I took a few pictures with my own mobile. Now I have presented the pictures above for all my friends to observe.





I saw this beautiful insect sitting on a leaf on the left side of the road while going to my workplace and school in the morning and I liked it very much. I observed this insect from a distance and I saw that its body has a red color combination which makes the insect look very beautiful from a distance. Moreover, it has some hands or legs at the bottom for movement. It is a round-shaped insect and the red color of the body looks very bright. However, because I like it, I am now sharing some pictures that I took with my own mobile phone with Hive community friends. I hope all my friends will see and love these pictures of mine.

links.title: Nuevo equipo de batalla - Squad Busters [ESP-ENG]
links.body:
> ![ddff.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcwSWJGEqpxCfW1FZmu3fRXhiD4coXeKm143n7JHcitUs/ddff.jpg) Saludos amigo, comenzamos una nueva semana y por eso es muy importante poder jugar las partidas que nos corresponde de este gran juego y de esa manera poder seguir enfocado en poder seguir subiendo de nivel en la escala de trofeos que está activo en este juego. Además, con cada una de las paridas que hemos logrado hacer en cada gameplay que les voy compartiendo los números en mi cuenta han ido mejorando, la cual es una gran alegría, ya que primero nos falta muy poco para poder alcanzar al nivel 17 en la cuenta y segundo 43 emojis que nos han dado como recompensa de cada batalla, a pesar de que eso yo no los uso cada uno suma para mi cuenta, donde la idea de esos emojis es mandarlos en plena batalla ya sea como para agradecer o burlarnos del rival, por eso es bueno tener varios. >Hello, friend. We’re starting a new week, so it’s really important to play our share of matches in this great game so we can stay focused on continuing to climb the trophy ladder that’s active in this game. Plus, with every match we’ve managed to play in each gameplay session I’ve been sharing with you, the numbers on my account have been improving—which is a real joy. First, we’re very close to reaching Level 17 on the account, and second, we’ve earned 43 emojis as rewards from each battle, even though I don’t use them, each one adds to my account. The idea behind these emojis is to send them right in the middle of battle—whether to thank someone or to taunt an opponent—so it’s good to have plenty of them. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY7tzNvtdtiKiMPU8NKB45rQjNmdF5gqDZpUMFKE2zbrf/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSUkvyNRALwkbm4pbR1QcTKY5DgAtNhBKExhT2rHxdNFC/image.png) Para cada uno de los modos de juego que están disponible se necesita de un buen equipo para así poder batallar, siendo algo que colocaron en la última actualización de este juego y todavía esta disponible donde la idea es tener un líder acompañado de dos personajes de este juego y con ese equipo es que comenzarás. Mi equipo estaba conformado por el rey bárbaro junto a Maton y chicha tanque, la cual es una gran combinación y con ellos logre ganar muchas partidas por el mismo hecho de que los dos disparan y pueden causar daño a los enemigos, por eso nunca lo cambie. Sin embargo, como estamos bastante activo en el juego ya he logrado ir mejorando otros personajes que superan las tres estrellas y ahorita eso son lo que más hacen daño, era momento de hacer un cambio en el equipo para ver si es bueno o malo. Por ende dejé al rey bárbaro, ya que ese es fijo acompañado del montapuerco siendo un personaje clásico junto a Colt que con sus pistolas y las balas infinitas nos puede servir y quizás marcar la diferencia con respecto al equipo que tenía anteriormente, lo bueno de esto es que es gratis y si no me gusta la combinación la quito y dejo la que siempre he tenido. >For each of the available game modes, you need a good team to be able to battle—a feature that was added in the game’s latest update and is still available. The idea is to have a leader accompanied by two characters from the game, and you’ll start with that team. My team consisted of the Barbarian King alongside Maton and Chicha Tank—a great combination—and with them I managed to win many matches simply because both of them shoot and can deal damage to enemies, which is why I never changed it. # >However, since we’re pretty active in the game, I’ve managed to level up other characters beyond three stars, and right now they’re the ones dealing the most damage. It was time to make a change to the team to see if it would be good or bad. So I dropped the Barbarian King, since he’s a staple paired with the Pig Rider—a classic combo—along with Colt, who, with his pistols and infinite ammo, can be a real asset and might make a difference compared to my previous team. The good thing about this is that it’s free, and if I don’t like the combination, I’ll just switch back to the one I’ve always used. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcSrkwBQUK29uQcsDWRaVTYJpVtvygbdUDcnJFXX4moVY/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYwDM5zyhnVWBYhJHRDVwvkVkbbgysnn5Hv9rSrmVJCsH/image.png) Para poder probar a mi equipo me fui para el modo más difícil de este juego, la cual consiste en batallas auto duelo y las pocas veces que he jugado el resultado nunca ha sido el mejor, ya que siempre me toca un rival fuerte o simplemente se termina el tiempo se queda en empate. Esta vez comencé con el rey bárbaro, pero el rival que me toco era nivel 5 siendo una gran diferencia y su rey es muchísimo más alto y de mejor calidad, sin embargo, yo me fui moviendo por todo el campo de batalla para así poder abrir los respectivos cofres y allí fue donde me tocaron los personajes que había colocado, pero mi vida ya estaba bastante baja y mientras que yo me movía en el campo de batalla para darle más dificultad colocaron pequeños esqueletos por eso toda la partida fue en batalla hasta que no logre resistir y perdí. >To test my team, I switched to the game’s hardest mode, which consists of auto-duel battles. The few times I’ve played it, the results haven’t been great—I always end up facing a strong opponent, or the match simply ends in a tie when time runs out. This time I started with the Barbarian King, but my opponent was level 5—a huge difference—and his king was much taller and of higher quality. However, I moved all over the battlefield to open the chests, and that’s where I got the characters I’d placed. But my health was already pretty low, and as I moved around the battlefield to make it harder, they placed little skeletons there, so the whole match was a battle until I couldn’t hold out anymore and lost. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSQtZbqqYEdUhKXYFb77QdjaV4rxE4mLBAm8WRaib7b6N/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXNrg8eAuPZnEM9oDev1JtAkKz45PQjTRPwu7uWFntNt6/image.png) Las misiones semanales de este juego siempre es muy importante poder completarlas, ya que es una manera muy sencilla de poder ganar recursos y recompensas para mi cuenta, donde con la partida que hice en el modo de batalla autoduelo logre completar tres de ellas y es una gran emoción, donde estaba usar 20 supertécnicas, reunir 500 gemas y eliminar a dos personajes del juego, es decir a dos jugadores la cual esta me dio un poco de batalla, pero se logró. Una vez qué pasó eso automáticamente las misiones ya se reiniciaron con nuevas misiones que hacer y lo bueno es qué hay algunas fáciles como otras que se necesita de tiempo para poder lograr todas, donde mi meta es poder completar las seis y poder recibir el cofre que están dando como recompensa. >It’s always very important to complete this game’s weekly missions, since they’re a very easy way to earn resources and rewards for my account. In the match I played in Auto-Duel mode, I managed to complete three of them, which was really exciting. The missions involved using 20 super moves, collecting 500 gems, and eliminating two characters from the game, that is, two players—which gave me a bit of a fight, but I pulled it off. Once that happened, the missions automatically reset with new ones to complete, and the good thing is that some are easy while others take time to finish. My goal is to complete all six and receive the chest they’re giving out as a reward. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaVjgpgHhQJxjMiPzydGT7XbLwJN2Pg5TfiHhAmHX4wMb/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdNtZF3ft5HhHfPzqVGNAjTaSD7VnNcjyfw3PzfC2j1j9/image.png) Seguimos jugando semana tras semana y de esa manera poder llegar lejos en este juego, además sigo probando distintas combinaciones y de esa manera poder estar listo para cualquier batalla que nos toque hacer, como también espero poder seguir reuniendo las cartas de los personajes que me hacen falta, ya que es muy importante poder llevar todos los personajes al nivel tres y así cuando nos toque batallar poder darle guerra y poder ganar. Por eso amigos te pregunto que eral te parece esa combinación de mi equipo para la batalla, como también si alguno de ustedes juega Squad Busters me lo dejo en los comentarios y de esa manera poder hacer varias partidas. >We keep playing week after week so we can go far in this game. I’m also still trying out different combinations so I’ll be ready for whatever battle we face. I also hope to keep collecting the character cards I’m missing, since it’s really important to get all the characters to level three—that way, when it’s time to battle, we can give them a run for their money and win. So, friends, I’m asking you what you think of my team’s battle lineup. Also, if any of you play Squad Busters, let me know in the comments so we can play a few matches together.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

![img_20260627_144216-beeca82de36c.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/snowli/lkt-mr1br70t-fnyl62wy/img_20260627_144216-beeca82de36c.webp)

![img_20260627_144435-53f842dc7765.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/snowli/lkt-mr1br70t-fnyl62wy/img_20260627_144435-53f842dc7765.webp)

我感觉有时候没有吃过一些没见过的东西，就是说明那些东西可能你也不会爱吃。当然这个也要分情况讨论。🤣

以前我没有吃过鸡蛋果，然后有次同事拿了一些来，我发现真的吃不来。还有就是那个释迦果，好像也不便宜，但是我好像也不是很欣赏得来。像西瓜这种平价一点的水果，我感觉怎么吃都吃不腻。

以前在学校的时候，学校湖边就有一颗莲雾树，我记得那个莲雾是黄色的，那时候加入一个社团，那个部门部长还带我们去摘莲雾，当时印象中就是水分比较少，干，但是很甜。

前不久在水果店看到这个红色的大莲雾，我又心动了，没吃过，想买个看看。然后买了三个，好像九块钱一斤。买了之后我就拿了一个出来吃，就感觉味道也是有点与众不同，好像不是太吃得来。但是看着好漂亮。🤣

像榴莲这种吧，好像一开始吃的不新鲜感觉不好吃，但是后面吃到好吃的了，就感觉好好吃，愈发不可收拾。后面就经常买来吃。😂

links.title: Selling bows???
links.body:
>

<center>![Selling Bows... .jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bengy/23xKzifpXGHXYvxzBbGnNySur6PgpYzNSNrKcawbRhz3gYeuUtNETjPXLDMYagsY66TJx.jpg)</center>

So, a while back I was searching around for a good general-purpose Baroque violin bow... and there was a colleague who had a couple of bows sent to him from a Brazilian bowmaker. I think that this colleague had asked for a single bow to be made for him (which he loves...), but the bowmaker sent a few more to try and promote his work. 

It is a sort of a weird gesture... especially when it isn't asked for. And it meant that he had a couple of bows that he was trying to sell whilst living in a remote town and also without commission. Anyway, I wanted to try them... and in the end, I did like the bows, but they weren't the ones that I was looking for at this point in time... they were fast, agile, and responsive... all things that I like and look for in a bow... but the balance wasn't right for general purpose sonata bow, much better for dance... and the tone that they produced was not quite as grounded in the fundamental tone as I would have preferred... again, an offshoot of the preference towards fast response. 

Anyway, I offered to show the bows around as our ensemble was putting on a festival and lots of people would be able to try them... 

... and in the end, we were able to connect a buyer to each bow! 

Which led to the bowmaker contacted us directly and suggesting that we go into an agreement where he sends out a few bows and we would promote and sell them on his behalf for a 10 percent commission. 

Initially, it seemed to a decent enough idea... increasing the variety of revenue sources is always a good thing... but after a bit more thought... well, musicians selling stuff is generally pretty dodgy... sure, there are exceptions... but it doesn't usually mesh well. 

... then the commission would end up being relatively small in absolute terms in comparison to the hassle of showing them around... and all of that... plus any additional costs that might crop up. 

On the plus side, I would have 3 or 4 different bows to play around with until they got sold... 

... but in the end, my wife and I agreed... the amount of money that was there to be potentially made wouldn't be worth the effort and the perception of conflict of interest. So, we've decided to politely decline... we are a performance ensemble... and selling equipment is not something that we are planning to do!

... and more recently, I've talked to a luthier who pointed out things about the international trade and shipping of violins and bows... and it is a WHOLE lot more complicated than I would have thought, with potential expensive pitfalls for the unwary!

So... glad we have passed on this!

title.title: That's urgent...
title.body:
>

Sometimes we doubt that our children understand everything that is happening in our country Venezuela, and that's why we bring you this example: a 2-year-old clearly records what happened during very difficult events such as tragedies, earthquakes, duels. Our children when they are infants because of their evolutionary development do not know of structural failures or emergency protocols, it can even be difficult to fully understand the risks. But they realize that there are changes in their environment, they realize the mood of their parents, their brother, their closest family and based on that they also express themselves, and they do it clearly, I have lived it with my children and my grandchildren. This is why it is key that we as parents and caregivers can self-regulate if we want our children to be able to properly process any experience of tragedy in our families. We regulate ourselves from the outside in order to be able to achieve it internally when we are adults. Calling for calm is not saying to the other: “Shut up.\
Let me listen to you, I am here with you.\

body.title: Hunting Shadows Around Town/SMASH Round 432
body.body: >Hello everyone, and a warm greeting to all Shadow Hunters! This is my entry for this week's Shadow Hunters Community Contest / SMASH Round 432. A huge thank you to @melinda010100 for hosting this wonderful contest through SHADOW HUNTER!\n

>Today I went out to hunt for shadows, and I found some good ones. I started at a building that just got renovated, with new floor tiles and plants still settling in. The roof made nice contrasts of light, white on one side and reddish tile on the other. Under the covered walkway, the shadows fell in long cool lines across the warm tiles, mixed with the loose shade of a palm tree swaying nearby. Then I walked to the parking area, where the trees took over. Their shadows did not fall in neat lines here, they scattered all over the ground like spilled ink, covering the vans and cars parked underneath. Half of everything was in light, half in shade, and it all looked very natural. Out on the street, the hunt got harder because things were moving. Motorbikes passed by, a jeep turned in, and the trees along the road kept casting long shadows across the asphalt. The riders kept passing in and out of the shade as they drove. In the background, a tall white building stood clean and almost shadowless against the sky. The last shot was just the sky. No buildings, no road, only clouds, a bit of treetop at the edges, and a power pole standing in the corner. Even with nothing much in the frame, it still felt like a good shadow hunt, because the shapes and contrast were still there. That was my shadow hunt for today, simple but satisfying.
![IMG_20260610_125722.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/EogLr32dQP3bhzcF8nvzUF3qsjt7hjf2aXv69Quq8wRVGQhBewZKfW9V991CkwihJqV.jpg) ![IMG_20260610_125728.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/EprRfFQkAAKAYiRGeBzVob6jnpgTS6qghycYeqbW1pzFyBQttAyPbNwZHuNsbmjL9Mf.jpg) ![IMG_20260610_125736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/EoprXcqS9jNVEgPFysgTNadqGATRtQ6YYDnuvZffv3btmxu2RaHLqKsrXqRMZmhSuTT.jpg) ![IMG_20260610_125752.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/EorzLBiJHu3PoQhsevxhcjvwVLahZxAwmmDriG6t49iBytmSG3EeHx6mzgdCCWsKfen.jpg) ![IMG20260609141007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/EoyN8WCPJYBBMskU2Mg9tie5hmnHpgaf2Yno7sN4Di9VbruGBtaVgmZuJCpxaT9ow52.jpg) ![IMG20260609141010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/EpEFNn5wi9sn5WQgMEuH54YxGeWGUAz1CZFSGcxKZQYFh6pUWUnBJxHXVJDxgF8tTAY.jpg) ![IMG20260609141016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/Ep3cNoXcPXWpFmGjynM2PNeq2AqsM3jqhfM7cyMLe71acuhmpQB3NMfC3rjU7VvEQzv.jpg) ![IMG20260609141019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/EpC7xaoau9CdnJsE1HhK6ym3H8yrK41erNC6Hf7pHGKGGbMTFDQqLvwTmdnsxXBGgUf.jpg) ![IMG20260609141026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/EopjeGMFqeWNpFvEJGgvG2S5yubk6gYvs2MRj4fR9eP6SvAPaNfr8EFCzPcdJDbd1uV.jpg)

body.title: [Esp./Eng.]   El laberinto de los espejos de un mundo que olvidó cómo dudar.   ||   The labyrinth of mirrors of a world that forgot how to doubt.
body.body:
*** *** #
If you prefer the English version, click on the following link 👉 [**HERE**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
***
>\n\nHay una frase que ronda mi cabeza como un mosquito en una noche de verano, imposible de ignorar: *\

*. Esa frase me golpeó como un balde de agua fría mientras navegaba por el océano digital, ese lugar donde todos gritan y pocos dicen algo... Al principio, parece un acertijo de pasillo, una de esas frases motivacionales para estampar en tazas. Pero si le das vueltas, si le buscas la quinta pata al gato, te das cuenta de que es el epitafio de nuestra realidad.
# ***
El laberinto de los espejos de un mundo que olvidó cómo dudar
*** Me confieso culpable de un delito que en los tiempos modernos se considera herejía, pues dudo y no dudo solo de lo que me cuentan, dudo de mi propia capacidad para no ser engañado. Me siento, a menudo, \
. Mientras la mayoría parece haber encontrado la paz en la certeza de los titulares y los videos de un minuto, yo sigo en la trinchera del \

, cansado de un protagonismo digital que ha convertido el pensamiento en un *reality show*.

En este sentido, me confieso un paria intelectual. Soy de los que contrastan, de los que buscan la fuente original y de los que, incluso tras hallar una respuesta, dudan de ella. Porque, seamos honestos, ¿quién es realmente objetivo? La objetividad es un horizonte que perseguimos pero que nunca tocamos, porque cargamos con nosotros el peso de nuestra propia crianza y miedos. Sin embargo, hay una diferencia abismal entre aceptar la propia subjetividad y tratar de tapar el sol con el pulgar, imponiendo una visión del mundo a golpe de carisma y seducción retórica.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdX2oe2YWg58DfosQmKvYxSx77pBpXJfyBcdX18K9UaHL/1_falsas_verdades.png)
<sup>[](https://gemini.google.com/app)</sup>
</center>

Vivimos en la era de la hiperconectividad, pero nunca habíamos estado tan huérfanos de certezas. El internet, que nació como la gran biblioteca de Alejandría de nuestra era, ha mutado en un mercado de vanidades donde el protagonismo no tiene límites. Somos bombardeados por ráfagas de información: un porcentaje mínimo de realidad, un grueso de manipulación y una capa asfixiante de criterio personal disfrazado de dogma.

***Nos vendieron el cuento de que \
… mentira. Hoy, una imagen vale más que mil \
.***\n\nEl filósofo francés **Guy Debord**, en su obra *La Sociedad del Espectáculo* (1967), ya nos advirtió con una clarividencia aterradora: *\

*. Lo que Debord no podía imaginar es que la representación tendría filtros de Instagram, deepfakes y algoritmos. Hoy, el video no es la verdad; el video es el recorte de la verdad que a alguien le conviene mostrar. Como bien señala el teórico de los medios **Jean Baudrillard**, hemos entrado en la era de los *simulacros*: *\

*.

***Es decir, nos tragan el anzuelo no porque la imagen sea real, sino porque hemos olvidado cómo distinguir el mapa del territorio.***

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPHDMwnVn5XAPiAuepSVjXrFqJRdUGQseQPPyyHSFfrhR/2_muerte_de_la_imagen_real.png)
<sup>[](https://gemini.google.com/app)</sup>
</center>

Me causa un escozor particular el fenómeno del \
. Personas que, amparadas en un título colgado en la pared, pretenden que sus palabras sean recibidas como un \

indiscutible. Es la falacia de autoridad convertida en estrategia de marketing. Como bien señalaba el lingüista y filósofo **Noam Chomsky** en su obra *“Media Control” (1991)*: *“La propaganda es a una democracia lo que la cachiporra es a un estado totalitario”*. Hoy, esa cachiporra no es de madera, es de algoritmos y sesgos cognitivos. La manipulación ya no necesita soldados; solo necesita seguidores que no cuestionen. Ver cómo el sentido crítico se rinde ante la autoridad de un influencer con bata blanca, o un tertuliano con micrófono de oro o un Hivers que cree tener las respuestas correctas.\n\n***Pero ojo, no caigamos en la trampa de cambiar un dogma por otro. Aquí es donde mi propia duda me salva. Porque si yo me creo superior a ellos por \
, ya caí en su mismo juego de ego.***\n\nBertrand Russell, ese gigante del pensamiento lógico, nos dejó una de esas \

*…,  esta frase es mi ancla. Entender que mi duda no es debilidad, sino la única evidencia de que mi cerebro sigue funcionando, es liberador.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZtk59wF8WCqsVyx4qed7avUAikUQcLeRiVgXmmFXVmfw/4_manipulacion.png)
<sup>[](https://gemini.google.com/app)</sup>
</center>

Sin embargo, vivir en la duda es agotador, me cansa. **Byung-Chul Han**, en *La sociedad del cansancio*, describe cómo esta sobrecarga de información y la obligación de tener un criterio (o fingirlo) nos llevan a un infarto psíquico. *\

*, afirma el filósofo. Ya no hay historias que nos cohesionen, solo datos aislados, *likes* y verdades a medias lanzadas por medios que son fábricas de desinformación.

Me siento “fuera del pote”. No encajo en las tribus digitales que se alimentan de certezas prefabricadas. Me aterra tener la razón tanto como me aterra estar equivocado, porque ambos estados conllevan una responsabilidad que pocos están dispuestos a asumir. Estamos cansados de buscar mientras otros, con una seguridad pasmosa y sospechosa, se dedican a imponer.

El sociólogo **Zygmunt Bauman**, en su concepto de *“Modernidad Líquida” (2000)*, describía este caos perfectamente: *“En el mundo de la vida fluida, no hay metas finales, solo paradas temporales; la verdad se vuelve un asunto de consumo rápido”*. Y es ahí donde radica nuestra fatiga: estamos agotados de consumir verdades desechables.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNvq2t56fTGQJRMMBta5u9WRB53epPwnwkQPHta3uNUfr/3_fuera_del_pote.png)
<sup>[](https://gemini.google.com/app)</sup>
</center>

***Entonces, ¿qué nos queda a los que estamos fuera del pote? ¿A los que vemos los hilos de las marionetas?***

Nos queda la autocrítica. Nos queda la humildad de saber que, aunque contrastemos fuentes, nuestra objetividad es un mito. Como decía **Friedrich Nietzsche**: *\
*. Y mi interpretación, la tuya, la mía, la del \

son solo lentes con distintos aumentos.

Busca, en cambio, la coherencia. Busca las grietas en el discurso de quien te quiere imponer su realidad.

No pretendo convencerte de nada… No te pido que creas en mi palabra; faltaba más. Te pido, simplemente, que sospeches. Que cuando alguien se pare frente a ti con la verdad absoluta en la mano, mires con atención qué guarda en la otra espalda. Si este escrito sirve para algo, es para que dejemos de creer en “pajaritos preñados” y en mesías de pantalla táctil. La autocrítica es el único anticuerpo que nos queda contra la manipulación. No se trata de encontrar respuestas definitivas, sino de aprender a vivir en la pregunta. Porque en la duda hay honestidad, y en el cuestionamiento hay libertad. Si buscar la quinta pata al gato me hace un bicho raro, que así sea; prefiero la incomodidad de la incertidumbre al confort de una mentira bien editada.

Quédate fuera del pote si eso te obliga a mantener los ojos abiertos. Porque en un mundo donde todos gritan tener la razón, el acto más revolucionario es susurrar: *\

Because, let's be honest, who is truly objective? Objectivity is a horizon we pursue but never reach, because we carry with us the weight of our own upbringing and fears. We live in the age of hyperconnectivity, but we've never been so bereft of certainties. We are bombarded by bursts of information: a minimal percentage of reality, a thick layer of manipulation, and a suffocating layer of personal opinion disguised as dogma.

What Debord could not have imagined is that this representation would have Instagram filters, deepfakes, and algorithms. Today, video is not the truth; video is the snippets of truth that someone chooses to show. As media theorist **Jean Baudrillard** rightly points out, we have entered the era of *simulacra*: *\

It's the appeal to authority fallacy transformed into a marketing strategy. As the linguist and philosopher Noam Chomsky aptly pointed out in his work \

Today, that truncheon isn't made of wood; it's made of algorithms and cognitive biases. Manipulation no longer needs soldiers; it only needs followers who don't question. It's infuriating to see critical thinking surrender to the authority of an influencer in a white coat, a pundit with a golden microphone, or a social media personality who thinks they have all the right answers.\n\n***But be careful, let's not fall into the trap of replacing one dogma with another. I've already fallen into their same ego game.***\n\nBertrand Russell, that giant of logical thought, left us with one of the most necessary \

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZtk59wF8WCqsVyx4qed7avUAikUQcLeRiVgXmmFXVmfw/4_manipulacion.png)

However, living in doubt is exhausting; it wears me down. Byung-Chul Han, in *The Burnout Society*, describes how this information overload and the obligation to have a criterion (or feign it) lead us to a psychological breakdown. \

the philosopher states. There are no longer any stories that unite us, only isolated facts, likes, and half-truths disseminated by media outlets that are factories of disinformation.

I feel like I belong. I don't fit in with the digital tribes that feed on prefabricated certainties. I'm terrified of being right as much as I am of being wrong, because both states carry a responsibility that few are willing to assume. We are tired of searching while others, with astonishing and suspicious certainty, dedicate themselves to imposing their will.

The sociologist Zygmunt Bauman, in his concept of \

And that is where our fatigue lies: we are exhausted from consuming disposable truths.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNvq2t56fTGQJRMMBta5u9WRB53epPwnwkQPHta3uNUfr/3_fuera_del_pote.png)

***So, what's left for those of us outside the system? For those of us who see the puppet strings?***

We're left with fierce self-criticism. We're left with the humility to know that, even when we compare sources, our objectivity is a myth. As Friedrich Nietzsche said: \
And my interpretation, yours, mine, the \

interpretation—they're all just lenses with different magnifications.

Instead, look for coherence. Look for the cracks in the discourse of those who want to impose their reality on you.

I'm not trying to convince you of anything… I'm not asking you to believe my word; far from it. I'm simply asking you to be suspicious. That is when someone stands before you with the absolute truth in one hand, and you look closely at what they're hiding behind the other. If this writing serves any purpose, it's to make us stop believing in empty promises and touchscreen messiahs. Self-criticism is the only antibody we have left against manipulation. It's not about finding definitive answers, but about learning to live with the question. Because in doubt there is honesty, and in questioning there is freedom. If splitting hairs makes me a weirdo, so be it; I prefer the discomfort of uncertainty to the comfort of a well-crafted lie.

body.title: Tuesdays are supposed to be long but today was different
body.body:
by isalifestyle on Girly Isabella 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/girlyisabella [![Tuesdays are supposed to be long but today was different](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/fae1dfb3-c7c9-4862-ad07-add6c05ba803.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/6QfjEugDdaWRAkovFC6cXB) 
 
 Normally my Tuesdays are a mess. I’m used to rolling into school by 9am knowing I won’t catch a break till 3pm. Back-to-back lectures, rushing from one hall to another, barely enough time to even grab water. So today I came in with that same energy, expecting the usual 9 to 3 grind. But from the jump it was off. 9 to 11 got cancelled. I sat there thinking “okay maybe it’s just the first one.” Then 11 to 12 also got cancelled. By this time I was just confused, like what’s even happening? I waited around, checked the group chat, asked people if they knew anything but nobody had a straight answer. 

Then the only lecture that actually ran was from 1 to 3pm. That’s it. Two hours of class and I was done. It felt weird because my body was still prepared for a full day. I had my notes, my pen, my water, everything set for 6 hours and I ended up using like half of it. Usually by 3pm I’m exhausted, head aching from taking notes all day. Today I left school and I still had energy. Didn’t know whether to feel blessed or robbed 😂 Because on one hand, less stress is always good. On the other hand, it’s like... what was the point of coming in so early?

In the end I just took it as a free day. I went home, chilled, and actually got some rest for once. A Tuesday without the full stress? I’ll take that any day. Hope tomorrow doesn’t try to pay me back by doubling the lectures though 😭
THANKS FOR VISITING  
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/6QfjEugDdaWRAkovFC6cXB)

body.title: 30 June 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3150: I’m going to push the button
body.body:
/>

“Yes, you heard right, there are ten of us, and I actually love my wife, so, no, kitchen duties do not belong just to her and the girls, the older of which are eleven and ten, and the younger of which are not old enough to be anything but in the way without supervision. We all eat here, so we all prepare food here.”

Capt. R.E. Ludlow had emerged from his kitchen duties with all nine other Ludlows for a moment, but also so with all the goings-on in there the eight little Ludlows would not hear the hardening of his voice.

“Listen, Max, yes, we grew up together, and we were trained in the same folly, but I already did all that – got a woman who would play along, and she took it out of me in every way unimaginable. Entitlement sets you up for failure. Aren't you divorced twice already?”

The voice on the other end of the phone went into a tirade that Capt. Ludlow, with his far deeper and more powerful voice, just cut off when he was ready.

“You can't marry your grandmother, you're too soft for 1935, and you can't afford the help you would need in today's money, because all Black people have to be paid fairly, too,” the captain said, and the tirade got even louder … whereupon the captain looked at the battery life on his phone, put it down, made a note to block Max's number when he recharged his phone battery, smiled, and returned to his kitchen, where he and Mrs. Ludlow were teaching health, science, math, music, and of course, food prep and cooking, all at the same time.

“But that is kind of deep, though,” ten-year-old Glendella was saying to her big sister eleven-year-old Eleanor while they were carefully filling and packing cups of brown sugar. “Music has scales to measure how far you go, and so do ingredients – like, four cups of sugar can be divided into eight half-cups, like you can divide an octave into eight notes.

“Or, cut a pie, like a whole note, into halves, quarters, and eighths … this stuff just comes up everywhere,” ten-year-old Andrew said as he came to get the packed cups and put their contents carefully into the two mixers Mrs. Ludlow had going while eight-year-old Edwina was getting the spices together.

“So there are sweet spices and savory spices, and we gotta keep them separated, because nobody thinks putting chili powder and cayenne were the cinnamon goes is not it,” she explained to her grandfather as he returned to put the savory spices to the side for the chili he was about to start making.

Meanwhile, seven-year-old Amanda and six-year-old Grayson and five-year-old Lil' Robert were all working on putting berries in for cake filling, with Amanda and Lil' Robert putting strawberries, raspberries, and blackberries in, and Grayson making sure the proportions were roughly right.

“I'mma need you to eat a couple more of those,” he said, looking at Lil' Robert's double handful of raspberries, whereupon Lil' Robert smiled and kept two berries back to put in his reward bowl to the side.

Meanwhile, nine-year-old George was patiently awaiting his moment when Grayson came with the full bowl of mixed berries. George helped his little brother load them into the blender, and then when the blender bowl was full, he grinned and loudly announced, “I'm going to push the button!”

“Push it good, boy,” Capt. Ludlow said.

“Oh, he pushed the mess out of that thing,” Glendella said later.

“Yeah, and our jelly filling was so smooth – George did a great job!” Eleanor said.

“And the smoothies tomorrow are going to be so good, too!” Glendella said.

body.title: El proceso - Hay cosas que necesitan de mi preparación | The Process - There are things that require my preparation
body.body:
![El proceso - Hay cosas que necesitan de mi preparación.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23xenFYe2B6o1bxUyZ7GbhmNetY6r1BJ9UQWYnba9zt4QDXAD3N8njdtwtmkVQSh22c7a.jpg)


<div class=\

>

En Español

Saludos a todos, amigos de la comunidad de #EmpowerTalent , con el tema que nos traen cada semana, especialmente con nuestra querida @angelica7 , para invitarnos a escribir sobre: \

, una invitación para observar cómo ha sido el proceso de cada uno, también si logran identificar los pasos de su proceso de vida y, si tuvieran la oportunidad de cambiar algo, a continuación mi participación: Lamentando la pérdida de vidas humanas en mi país, ante el terrible sismo, con una gran tristeza por todo lo que está pasando, veo la solidaridad que tenemos entre los vecinos, hay personas que han perdido sus viviendas, así como cada uno al aportar nuestro grano de arena, como la preocupación de familiares, de los amigos que están lejos, refleja que estamos juntos en esto.

Pasando ese terrible susto

Junto con mi hija, hemos estado en compañía de mi familia pasando ese terrible susto. Cuando me di a la tarea de leer en las redes, encontré un video en Tiktok, donde nos explica que después de haber vivido una experiencia que amenaza nuestra vida, el cerebro actúa y entra en un estado de hipervigilancia, y lo sé porque es la razón por la que tengo esa sensación de que las cosas a mi alrededor se mueven.

Un proceso para ayudarme a salir del estado de alerta

Entonces es una parte del cerebro encargado de detectar el peligro que se ha vuelto más sensible. La persona que hizo la reflexión, nos indica que es una respuesta de protección de mi cuerpo, por eso decidí con mi hija hacer el ejercicio que nos indica al respecto, pues es como un proceso para ayudar a mi sistema nervioso a salir del estado de alerta que me encuentro en este momento. El ejercicio consiste en cruzar los brazos, como si estuviera abrazándome a mí misma, luego darme palmadas alternando una mano con la otra, a un ritmo lento y por 30 o 60 segundos inhalar y exhalar aire, expresando la frase : \

. ![El proceso - Hay cosas que necesitan de mi preparación (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/244e89artVT6jS9HYN5aAUgwmDHgecsc4e1gLepyNK6W32inrSxB4JRWSF4dEzzayDsig.jpg)

Aprender a recuperar la calma

Creo que es en realidad como un proceso para ayudar poco a poco a recordarme que no necesito estar preparada para la huida en todo momento, pues si mi cuerpo aprendió a protegerme, puede aprender a recuperar la calma. Agradezco este tipo de contenido de Elizabeth Rosad, de bienestar emocional (Emocolor), ya que con este proceso de cuidado y con el tiempo, seguramente mi cuerpo aprenderá a sentirse seguro otra vez y a relajar mi sistema nervioso.

Hay cosas que necesitan de mi preparación

Por otra parte, creo que si decidimos estar abiertas a todo lo que la vida tiene que ofrecernos, es una manera de vivir nuestras vidas como un proceso, porque hay cosas que necesitan de mi preparación, porque no todo se da de manera inmediata. Sabemos que como personas tenemos días buenos por los cuales sentir gratitud y otros no tan buenos, donde no es de extrañar que en esos momentos salgan a flote los malos recuerdos, pues son esos momentos en los que vale la pena pensar que soy protagonista de mi vida, por eso debo tratar de vivirla de la mejor manera posible. Así pues si he pasado por algún proceso como muchos de mis amigos lectores, por la ruptura de una relación, ya sea de pareja, de algún familiar o de amistades, donde hemos visto que sí se puede superar. ![El proceso - Hay cosas que necesitan de mi preparación (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23ywwnEBvg9GCpPU39W1vytZZmbuUZi4ya4ZYc8vzVAKMmJKHSJKB2ceg5Gu7M57JUv8a.jpg)

Transformar una pérdida en una ganancia

A veces, necesitamos cerrar un ciclo anterior y si es necesario de manera brusca, para darnos permiso de disfrutar lo que viene sin culpas, pensando que si esa persona que no estaba más físicamente, ya no merecía estar en mis pensamientos, en mi vida. Así como también, me ayudó la consciencia del cambio de perspectiva, ya que pude pasar de la incertidumbre de la desvinculación laboral a la libertad de la jubilación, como un proceso de transformar una pérdida en una ganancia de tiempo y vida. Como otros, hubo un proceso que tuve que vivir para una preparación con un propósito de llevarme al lugar donde Dios quiere que esté, porque eso que veía difícil me ayudo para bien, para mirar hoy que lo único verdadero que existe es un presente con fe y esperanza en ese poder más grande que nosotros, el de nuestro creador. Si desean unirse a la iniciativa y al encuentro de Talentos, deben hacer [Click aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-el-proceso). ![HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23uFeSQM6xDrDb7y7LHKxZju22v1aLmzmqmbCBsbDCKQoTVz13Y2bM2eGiuKHFMjDEsiB.jpg) Los diseños y las imágenes en Canva. Las fotografías en mi galería tomadas de mi teléfono Honor Magic6 y editadas en canva Traducido con www.DeepL.com/Translator (versión gratuita) ![El proceso - Hay cosas que necesitan de mi preparación (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23xenFYe2ChqBpaQFeTh6aUMK1WuPHKiLq4ZRgiD4MguVZ6Y1X48sLbMfu7NCp4MYjEFc.jpg)

In English

Greetings to everyone, friends of the #EmpowerTalent community. With the topic you bring us each week—especially our dear @angelica7, inviting us to write about: “The Process”—an invitation to reflect on what each of our own processes has been like, to see if we can identify the steps in our life’s journey, and to consider what we would change if we had the chance—here is my contribution: Mourning the loss of human lives in my country due to the terrible earthquake, and filled with great sadness over everything that is happening, I see the solidarity we have among neighbors. There are people who have lost their homes, and as each of us does our part—whether through concern for family members or friends who are far away—it shows that we’re in this together.

Getting Through That Terrible Scare

My daughter and I have been with my family, getting through that terrible scare. When I took the time to read up on social media, I found a video on TikTok that explains how, after going through a life-threatening experience, the brain reacts and enters a state of hypervigilance—and I know this because it’s the reason I have that sensation that things around me are moving.

A process to help me come out of a state of alert

So it’s a part of the brain responsible for detecting danger that has become more sensitive. The person who shared this insight explains that it’s my body’s protective response, so I decided, along with my daughter, to do the exercise they recommend, since it’s a process to help my nervous system come out of the state of alert I’m in right now. The exercise consists of crossing my arms, as if I were hugging myself, then patting myself, alternating one hand with the other, at a slow pace for 30 to 60 seconds while breathing in and out, repeating the phrase: “This is my body’s memory, not a sign of real danger.” ![El proceso - Hay cosas que necesitan de mi preparación (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/244e89artVT6jS9HYN5aAUgwmDHgecsc4e1gLepyNK6W32inrSxB4JRWSF4dEzzayDsig.jpg)

Learning to Regain My Calm

I think it’s really a process to help me gradually remember that I don’t need to be ready to flee at all times, because if my body learned to protect me, it can learn to regain its calm. I appreciate this kind of content from Elizabeth Rosad, from Emotional Well-being (Emocolor), because with this process of self-care and over time, my body will surely learn to feel safe again and to relax my nervous system.

There are things that require me to prepare

On the other hand, I believe that if we decide to be open to everything life has to offer, it’s a way of living our lives as a process, because there are things that require me to prepare—not everything happens right away. We know that as people we have good days for which to feel grateful and other days that aren’t so good, when it’s not surprising that bad memories resurface—for it is in those moments that it’s worth remembering that I am the protagonist of my life, which is why I must try to live it in the best way possible. So, if I’ve gone through a process like many of my readers—such as the end of a relationship, whether with a partner, a family member, or a friend—we’ve seen that it is possible to move past it. ![El proceso - Hay cosas que necesitan de mi preparación (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23ywwnEBvg9GCpPU39W1vytZZmbuUZi4ya4ZYc8vzVAKMmJKHSJKB2ceg5Gu7M57JUv8a.jpg)

Turning a Loss into a Gain

Sometimes, we need to close a previous chapter—even abruptly, if necessary—to give ourselves permission to enjoy what’s coming without guilt, realizing that if that person is no longer physically present, they no longer deserve a place in my thoughts or in my life. It also helped me to become aware of this shift in perspective, as I was able to move from the uncertainty of leaving my job to the freedom of retirement—a process of transforming a loss into a gain of time and life. Like others, I had to go through a process of preparation designed to lead me to where God wants me to be, because what I once saw as difficult ultimately helped me for the better—so that today I can see that the only true reality is the present, with faith and hope in that power greater than ourselves: the power of our Creator. If you wish to join the initiative and the Talents meeting, you should do the following [Click here](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-el-proceso). ![HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23uFeSQM6xDrDb7y7LHKxZju22v1aLmzmqmbCBsbDCKQoTVz13Y2bM2eGiuKHFMjDEsiB.jpg) The designs and images in canva The pictures in my gallery taken from my Honor Magic6 phone and edited in canva Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version) ![@cautiva30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/48GiSTWr5WSgTvFxKvXP6Ch8otHKnPQ8WjMoVet5AZAgPzubefko1YcEdh7C14ZkAp.jpg)
