body.title: Life in Caracas After the Earthquakes
body.body:
> Hello everyone! We are already halfway through the week, specifically, this Wednesday marks exactly one week since the earthquakes that are still shaking our lives, and in my particular case, I am increasingly affected by the amount of dust I have breathed in since the very moment I stepped outside and encountered the clouds of dust from the destruction of the area. A lot has happened over these past few days; we have witnessed the best in people, not just from my own country, but also the many helping hands from abroad that have stepped up, whether in person, digitally, or through generous donations made to assist those going through the worst moments of their lives. Sadly, we have also seen the other side of the coin: individuals with the basest instincts who live only to cause harm, exploit the vulnerability of others, and commit crimes without a shred of shame. In my own case, after a day spent sheltering at home in fear, and stocking up on food, we began on Friday to offer whatever humble assistance was within our reach at the time.
![IMG_20260628_133146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23w2gkJEYAXj7vgnSN3gx8quhYMuBAUfghoYbV9wqdbPgwhZcfNYFZ8Fq1hzsdUSXigzi.jpg)
¡Hola a todos!. Ya estamos a mitad de semana, y hoy Miércoles, a una semana exactamente de los terremotos que aún sacuden nuestras vidas, y en mi caso particular, cada vez más afectado por la cantidad de polvo que he respirado desde el primer momento que salí a la calle y me encontré con las nubes de polvo de la destrucción de la zona. Ha pasado de todo durante estos días, hemos podido apreciar lo mejor de las personas, y no solo gente de mi país, sino también de tantas manos amigas internacionales que se han hecho presente, ya sea en persona, de forma digital o a través de donativos que hacen despreocupadamente para ayudar a gente que está viviendo el peor momento de sus vidas. Tristemente también se ha podido apreciar la otra cara de la moneda, esas personas con los sentimientos más ruines que solo viven para hacer daño, aprovecharse de la situación vulnerable de otros y que comenten delitos sin ninguna vergüenza. En mi caso particular, después de un día de resguardo y temor en casa, además de abastecernos de alimentos, desde el Viernes comenzamos a colaborar humildemente con lo que podíamos hacer a nuestro alcance en ese momento.
![IMG_20260628_150524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xVFDn6z8WxUdMgSKn1b31ug4k7PVs1wKen76hDPwBaZ7PUmdSobgTDrw59e4qSv2WoZ.jpg)
Venezuela has received a great deal of help; as you have likely seen on the news, rescue teams from various countries have arrived, with the majority stationed in La Guaira State—the area hardest hit by the earthquakes. Last Friday, my wife and I helped prepare food to take to people who are still sleeping in Caracas’s public squares because their buildings are no longer habitable, or because no one has inspected them yet and they are afraid to return home. As you may know, credit isn't easily accessible to everyone in Venezuela, and this tragedy caught me with very little cash on hand; however, there is Cashea, a company that offers credit for purchases paid in installments. They happened to have a special promotion running through June 30th at select stores, allowing customers to make purchases with no down payment and pay later in three convenient installments. We used this option to donate medicine and some food at various collection centers. Even so, I am naturally wary and need assurance that aid actually reaches the intended recipients, so over the weekend, we decided to handle the effort through our own music company—a trusted source, given that it has been our workplace for over ten years. The photos I’m sharing today are from Sunday, when a special relief operation took place; I felt comfortable taking a few pictures of our work.
![IMG_20260630_191639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23tvVmn3eX7P7qhFMMCRec2U3ER1rNxfUdAD25NdXww8552GBh8fVaM4Uq5AD5yz28b94.jpg)
Venezuela ha tenido mucha ayuda; como ya han podido ver en las noticias, han llegado rescatistas de diversos países y la mayoría de ellos se encuentran en el Estado La Guaira, el más afectado por los terremotos. Mi esposa y yo participamos en la elaboración de comida el pasado Viernes para llevar a las personas que aún se encuentran durmiendo en las plazas de Caracas porque sus edificios ya no pueden ser habitables, o porque aún nadie ha ido a revisarlos y tienen miedo de volver a casa. Como sabrán, el crédito en Venezuela no es para todo el mundo, y a mí esta tragedia me tomó con poco dinero en el bolsillo, pero, existe Cashea, una empresa que te brinda créditos para compras y pagar por cuotas, y casualmente tenían una ventaja especial para compras hasta el 30 de Junio sin pagar la inicial en algunas tiendas seleccionadas, y solo pagar luego en tres cómodas cuotas, y esta fue la opción que usamos para poder donar medicamentos y algo de comida en algunos centros de acopio. Aún así, soy una persona muy desconfiada, necesito seguridad de que la ayuda llegue a quien tenga que llegar, así que el fin de semana decidimos hacerlo con nuestra misma empresa musical, una fuente confiable al ser nuestro lugar de trabajo por más de 10 años. Las fotografías que les comparto hoy son del Domingo que hubo un operativo especial y no me dio pena tomar algunas fotos de nuestro trabajo.
![IMG_20260628_133454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23vi6275izigSiqtC6jUHcJzUf3zu9TA5bg6PCsHDSCnTajpr7kKEftyAmYQuy2WpFa5m.jpg)
Our music organization has centers and hubs throughout the country, stretching from the capital to Venezuela's most remote indigenous areas. Our motto is \

and since music is currently on hold, our only option is to unite in the struggle—upholding our original mission of helping those in need. While we usually do this through music, we are currently facing an emergency situation. The day I took these photos was particularly intense; several trucks arrived simultaneously from Lara and the Andean region carrying donations of clothing, food, and medicine. The volume of donations was so great that the more of us from the orchestras and choirs who participated, the better. I noticed that our center had sustained some damage, yet it remained a safe place where we could carry out this work without fear—save for the thick dust still lingering there, a problem I managed by wearing a face mask again, just as we did in 2020. We men play a crucial role in loading and unloading the trucks bound for La Guaira with these donations. The best part is the sense of mutual support; whether they are from the orchestras or choirs, or work as teachers, secretaries, or security staff, we practically all know one another, creating a safe, family-like atmosphere. For me, my musical home has served as the best possible collection center.

> ![IMG_20260628_135250.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23wC9i1RNSZwcmuELYFkJnXTkgGtJPDqKB95MmyXxTJBtVnZYZKFect1zzfeN8aiTJypC.jpg)
*Jhoxiris, Leonardo and Kimberly*

Nuestra empresa musical tiene sedes y núcleos en todo el país, desde la capital hasta las zonas indígenas más remotas de Venezuela. Nuestro lema es Tocar, Cantar y Luchar, y ya que la música se encuentra en falta, solo nos queda unirnos en la lucha nuestra razón social original, que es ayudar a quien lo necesita, generalmente desde la música, pero estamos en un caso de contingencia. El día que tomé estas fotos fue particularmente más fuerte porque llegaron varios camiones a la vez camiones desde Lara y los andes con donaciones de ropa, comida y medicinas, eran tantas donaciones que mientras más participemos de las orquestas y los coros era mejor. Noté que la sede también sufrió daños, pero es un lugar seguro donde podíamos hacer este trabajo sin miedos, más que la gran cantidad de polvo que aún se encuentra ahí,, pero resolví el momento volviendo a usar cubre bocas como en 2020. Nosotros los hombres somos cruciales para bajar y montar cargas a los camiones que van a La Guaira con las donaciones, y lo mejor es que nos sentimos en apoyo, ya que la mayoría de las personas, ya sean de las orquestas, los coros, los profesores, las secretarias, los de seguridad, todos prácticamente nos conocemos y nos sentimos seguros y en familia. Para mí, mi propia casa musical ha sido el mejor centro de acopio.
![IMG_20260628_135210.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23u62suBjhvauGxfyXdapiGcMN2VPeEFacEyMDHNc217SgGDjqTPkrfz4YZxgt2NfKqnt.jpg)

Six days after the earthquakes, people—and even pets—are still being found alive beneath the rubble; however, I also know from a reliable source that the entire state of La Guaira reeks of death. As a company, we have already lost a young woman of just 19—a singing student from the very place where we are running our relief collection center. As I mentioned at the start, while there is the beauty of people and nations uniting to help, there are also criminals taking the opportunity to steal; the government is making things harder for those who want to assist; there are sexual predators who have tried to abduct minors; and some have even managed to commit crimes in the Caracas parks where people are sleeping in tents. Heavy rain fell last night, making the situation even worse for those people. It is almost impossible not to feel terrible—and helpless—and we really need our paychecks to come through so we can handle so many things, including helping and visiting our families in the interior of the country; I have wanted to go see my mom and brother ever since that day, but I haven't been able to yet. I know things will gradually get sorted out—we have to be patient regarding the aid, the rescue efforts, the money, the internet, phone signals, hospitals... EVERYTHING!. The atmosphere here in Caracas is incredibly sad, but we cannot stop. I believe the best way to get through these days is to keep volunteering however we can to help those affected, because everyone can do something—even just making *arepas* for a family sleeping on mattresses in the nearest public square makes a huge difference. I thought more issues would be resolved within these first seven days, but that hasn't been the case... This scar on Venezuela's history won't heal anytime soon 💔 I’ve read comments from many acquaintances here on Hive—from Africa, Asia, Europe, and Oceania—and I know they were deeply struck by some of the things I wrote in my previous post; but yes, our reality is harsh. The most unjust things have happened here over the last 27 years, and this is part of the aftermath. Everything here is unbelievable—even the sheer coincidence of two earthquakes striking just seconds apart, while in the same week, fires and rains are leaving families in another part of the country homeless 🤦‍♂️ Thanks anyway to those who read my vents; writing does me a world of good—it helps me release all that stress 🙏
![IMG_20260628_145829.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23yd3v7UwMML2cqPKs9ZE8Kxe1RaQTjxpskBaJnsHewknm5fkPhHJ5kRbV4ox4qDfKFPG.jpg)
El día seis después de los terremotos se siguen encontrando personas vivas debajo de los escombros, incluso mascotas, pero también sé de buena fuente que todo el Estado La Guaira tiene un fuerte olor a muerte. Como empresa ya sufrimos la muerte de una muchacha de apenas 19 años, estudiante de canto de aquí mismo donde estamos haciendo nuestro centro de acopio. Como les dije al inicio, no solo es la belleza de la gente y las naciones que se unen para ayudar, sino que muchos criminales aprovechan de robar, el gobierno pone más difícil las cosas para la gente que quiere ayudar, hay depredadores sexuales que han querido llevarse menores de edad, y algunos han podido cometer delitos en los mismos parques de Caracas donde la gente está durmiendo en carpas. Anoche cayó una lluvia fuerte que hizo la noche peor para esa gente. Es casi imposible no sentirse mal, además de impotente, y particularmente necesitamos que nuestro salario se haga efectivo para resolver tantas cosas, incluso ayudar a nuestras familias en el interior y visitarlas, porque algo que he deseado desde ese día es ir a ver a mi mamá y mi hermano, pero aún no he podido. Sé que todo se irá resolviendo poco a poco, hay que ser paciente con la ayuda, los rescates, el dinero, el internet, la señal telefónica, los hospitales, TODO!. Aquí en Caracas el ambiente es muy, muy triste, pero no podemos detenernos. Creo que la mejor manera de pasar los días es seguir siendo voluntario en lo que podamos para ayudar a los afectados, porque todos lo podemos hacer, así sea haciéndole arepas a una familia que está durmiendo en colchones en la plaza más cercana, eso ya es mucho. Pensé que estos primeros siete días habrían más cosas resueltas, pero no... Esta marca en la historia de Venezuela no sanará tan pronto 💔 He leído los comentarios de muchos de mis conocidos aquí en Hive de África, Asia, Europa y Oceanía, y sé que están muy impresionados con algunas cosas que escribí en mi anterior post, pero sí, nuestra realidad es fuerte, aquí han pasado las cosas más injustas los últimos 27 años y esto son parte de las consecuencias. Todo aquí es increíble, incluso la gran casualidad de que ocurran dos terremotos con pocos segundos de diferencia y que la misma semana, otra zona del país esté dejando a familia sin hogares a causa de incendios y lluvias 🤦‍♂️ Gracias igual a los que leen mis desahogos, a mí me hace mucho bien escribir, me ayuda a drenar todo el estrés 🙏
![IMG-20260628-WA0014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23wqnamyhxEdtYdwzsQintNx45YF4P9KEGwkQsm82o9fa158tjSeLPFniojKnByCYkFb1.jpg)

body.title: Dortmund vs Netherlands Legend
body.body:
by Khing Addy on Adrians Lifestyle 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/adrianslifestyle [![Dortmund vs Netherlands Legend](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/50a23bd5-f753-4509-a136-305bfc0aca11.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/79nVBQvW4qCFxjBoBLp7uv) 
 
 Dortmund vs Netherlands Legend 
Bro this World Cup event match was stressing me. It was Borussia Dortmund vs Netherlands Legend and the only reason I even cared was for the 50 coins reward 😂 You know how efootball events be. If I didn’t win, no coins, and the whole event wouldn’t be complete. So I went into it knowing I had to win by any means. From kickoff I wasn’t trying to do too much fancy stuff. I just relaxed in my own half, kept my shape tight and waited. Netherlands Legend had all the possession and they were trying to play that tikitaka nonsense, but I was just watching for one mistake.
That’s how I play these coin matches now. I just sit back and the moment they misplace one pass or push too high, I hit them with a sharp counter. No building up, no time wasting. First half was slow, boring even. They were dominating but couldn’t break me down. Then it happened — they lost the ball around midfield and I was gone. 3 passes later the ball was at Batistuta’s feet and he just buried it. 1:0. That screamer came out of nowhere but it was exactly what I needed 😕 My only shot on target all game and it went in.
After that goal I just parked the bus. 1 goal was enough for me. I kept dropping deep, making tackles, clearing everything. They kept pushing but my defense was locked in and I made sure not to concede. Final whistle blew and I finally got the W. That 1:0 took me the 50 coins and I completed the event. 
Wasn’t pretty football at all, but in these events you don’t care about style points. Batistuta bailed me out again with that one goal. Now I can finally move on from this World Cup event. 
THANKS For VISITING  
 ***

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdJNXtncXqJNSXCqUDNpD5uTz3YUi7Bngzk11NLP2hPc1/image.png)

>U.S. President Donald Trump earned at least $1.4 billion (about 2.1665 trillion won) last year in cryptocurrency and meme coin-related businesses, Bloomberg reported on the 30th (local time).

>According to Bloomberg, the U.S. Office of Government Ethics released a total of 927 pages of President Trump's property disclosure report on the same day.
The cryptocurrency business has grown to surpass real estate businesses such as hotels and golf resorts that President Trump has built over the decades. The cryptocurrency revenue is well above the $77 million earned at the Mar-a-Lago resort or $25 million earned at a golf club in northern Virginia.
The report reported more than $588 million in sales for Trump's cryptocurrency company, World Liberty Financial. World Liberty Financial began selling governance tokens in October 2024.
Co-founders of the company include President Trump, his son Eric Trump, and the current president's special envoy to the Middle East, Stephen Witkoff. Witkoff's son, Jack Witkoff, is currently the CEO.
CIC Digital LLC, which sells meme coins with President Trump's face on them, has earned $636 million. The cryptocurrency that CIC Digital holds in its digital wallet is estimated to be worth at least $60 million.
President Trump also made about $197 million in profits from the sale of his stake in Stablecoin Holdco.

>The document also states that Trump received 10 tickets to the World Cup finals (worth $15,000), 10 tickets to the U.S. Open tennis tournament (worth $25,000) from Rolex and 10 tickets to the Super Bowl LIX (worth about $50,000) in New Orleans.

>According to Bloomberg Billionaires Index, Trump has assets worth about 7.6 billion dollars. The assets of some 20 companies including real estate companies such as Mar-a-Lago and Turnberry Golf Resort in Scotland and shares of Trump Media and Technology Group, which owns Truth Social platform, were valued at more than 50 million dollars.

>When the document was released, foreign media raised the possibility of a conflict of interest one after another.
\
\nThe cryptocurrency business grew rapidly last year, signing license agreements in several countries as part of its overseas expansion, the Associated Press said. \

Reporter Baek So-hee (white22@mt.co.kr )

It is astonishing that a president can do such things.
I wonder whether this will not become an issue after his retirement.
The many policies he is openly implementing in areas where he has vested interests make me question what legitimacy they truly have.
For the sake of America’s future, proper measures regarding this matter must be taken, even if only afterward.

body.title: El Pueblo salva al Pueblo Venezolano en La Tragedia
body.body:
> Saludos amigos de Hive y de @catarsis, , hoy martes 30 de junio van seis días después de la tragedia del terremoto en nuestro país , Venezuela, han sido días de mucha tristeza y también de mucha esperanza al ver en las redes sociales, toda esas personas que han rescatado con vida.
Cabe destacar que desde que sucedió este doble terremoto, pudimos observar en las redes sociales como las personas pedían ayudan porque escuchaban gritos debajo de los escombros, es impresionante, como la respuesta del gobierno ha sido ineficiente ya que no actuaron con premura para salvar a muchas personas que lo requieren con urgencia. ![GridArt_20260630_194416325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/243fvNde5N3wCaS9pafZpUXbtxjCXRcFuvYwnugkRk37eaSBKkPEznb7ucAKFxYohtGuB.jpg) - Asimismo, el pueblo, ellos mismos, salvaron a sus familiares, amigos y vecinos, con sus propios medios, sin embargo la gran mayoría estaban con las manos atadas debido a la gran magnitud del grandes escombros que requerían maquinaria pesadas para poder mover esas grandes paredes, vigas y columnas donde están atrapado muchas personas, que todavía están con vidas. A pesar de estos, los organismos como los bomberos, y defensa civil han estado trabajando pero sin ningún tipo de recursos materiales necesarios. Gracias a Dios, llegaron rescatistas de diferentes partes como de Colombia, Perú, México, España, Estados Unidos, con equipo especializado y perros entrenados para este tipo de situación, que requieren de precisión y mucho cuidado para poder sacar a las personas con vida. ![GridArt_20260630_194351070.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23w2uruDNtj7LexAHPBHM93YbdkJ1mCqGHct5f2rvemYazXP4Y2XfqjtAwxZ4FzBQdwEP.jpg) Una de las cosas que he visto negativas es el comportamiento del mismo gobierno de impedir el avance de las personas hacia la zona del desastre como lo es en La Guaira, donde los funcionarios detuvieron un vehículo, con un capitán de bomberos, que llevaban maquinaria para ser utilizada en los espacios derrumbados. Así como ha habido una gran ayuda del mismo pueblo venezolano, también están otras personas que se quieren aprovechar de este momento de dolor. En estos momentos que son cruciales, unos dicen que después de las 72 horas, es difícil encontrar personas con vida debajo de los escombros, pero los rescatistas mexicanos manifiestan que esto puede durar hasta semanas donde pueden conseguir personas con vida como ha sucedido en otras tragedias en diferentes países. Estos rescatistas tienen de verdad una muy buena preparación física y también psicológica con la forma de hablar con las personas que están debajo de los escombros, con una gran calidad humana para lograr que los rescates sean un éxito y las personas salgan con vida. ![GridArt_20260630_194341153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23ynJD59pjMYbFhrfTborEp3PCpMudD4VoetrYWCJcenhkmwfFsJCFKDJDduTtocnmE4b.jpg) En estos momentos deseo que todas estas personas que están con vida debajo de los escombros deseo que sean rescatados y que vuelvan junto a sus familiares y los que no pudieron salvarse que sus cuerpos sean entregados a sus familiares para que le den su cristiana sepultura. Para finalizar el gobierno ha quedado al descubierto como sino le importara el pueblo que está sufriendo está gran tragedia, en vez de apoyar toda esta ayuda recibida por parte de los países pareciera que no desean que estén aquí ayudando a todo el pueblo. # Chasing Sunsets: My Journey Through the Best Sunset Spots in National Parks

As a passionate hiker and traveler, I've always been captivated by the beauty of nature, especially during those magical moments when the sun dips below the horizon. There's something truly enchanting about sunsets that can transform even the most familiar landscapes into breathtaking vistas. Over the years, I've made it a mission to visit some of the best national parks in the United States to capture these fleeting moments. Here’s a glimpse into my journey through some of the most stunning sunset spots.

## 1. **Yosemite National Park, California**

![Yosemite Sunset](https://example.com/yosemite-sunset.jpg)

Yosemite is renowned for its towering cliffs and majestic waterfalls, but it’s the sunsets that really steal the show. Head to **Glacier Point** for a panoramic view of Half Dome bathed in warm, golden hues. The contrast of the granite against the vibrant sky is nothing short of awe-inspiring.

## 2. **Grand Canyon National Park, Arizona**

![Grand Canyon Sunset](https://example.com/grand-canyon-sunset.jpg)

The Grand Canyon is a natural wonder that offers some of the most spectacular sunsets. **Mather Point** is a popular spot where you can witness the way the sun's rays illuminate the canyon walls, creating a stunning array of colors that change by the minute. Don’t forget your camera!

## 3. **Zion National Park, Utah**

![Zion Sunset](https://example.com/zion-sunset.jpg)

Zion’s towering sandstone cliffs provide a dramatic backdrop for sunset viewing. **Canyon Junction Bridge** is a favorite location where you can capture the sun setting behind the iconic Watchman mountain. The glow of the rocks in the evening light is a sight you won’t want to miss.

## 4. **Acadia National Park, Maine**

![Acadia Sunset](https://example.com/acadia-sunset.jpg)

For those who love coastal views, Acadia offers a unique sunset experience. **Cadillac Mountain** is the first place to see the sunrise in the U.S., but it’s equally stunning at sunset. The view of the ocean and islands as the sun sets is simply magical, with the sky reflecting off the water.

## 5. **Badlands National Park, South Dakota**

![Badlands Sunset](https://example.com/badlands-sunset.jpg)

The rugged beauty of Badlands is accentuated during sunset. **Big Badlands Overlook** provides a breathtaking view of the layered rock formations and vast prairies. The changing colors of the sky against the stark landscape create a surreal atmosphere.

## 6. **Joshua Tree National Park, California**

![Joshua Tree Sunset](https://example.com/joshua-tree-sunset.jpg)

Joshua Tree is famous for its unique Joshua trees and striking rock formations. **Keys View** offers an expansive view of the Coachella Valley, where you can watch the sun sink behind the mountains, casting a warm glow over the desert landscape.

## Conclusion

Chasing sunsets in national parks has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my travels. Each location offers its own unique beauty and atmosphere, making every sunset a special moment to cherish. Whether you’re an avid hiker or just looking for a peaceful escape into nature, I encourage you to explore these stunning parks and witness the magic of sunsets for yourself. 

Happy hiking and sunset chasing! 🌅

body.title: 三年级家长会
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![5nEPGSPasoSHNIqn_wx13.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/5nEPGSPasoSHNIqn_wx13/5nEPGSPasoSHNIqn_wx13.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今天是6月30号这学期家长会，我原本以为家长会安排在7月初几天内，没想到安排到了6月最后一天。早上8点40分到达学校，孩子班级在4楼，爬楼梯好累。首先要在班级门口签到，然后进入教室找孩子的座位。桌椅板凳都是按照小学生的身材尺寸，大人坐下来非常拥挤，我的腿都没地方放。好在班里开了空调，感觉很凉爽。9点钟家长会正式开始，首先是班主任语文老师讲话，老师回顾上学期班里取得的成绩。

正在讲的时候，数学老师进来了。因为数学老师带好几个班，讲完一个班要赶下一个班比较赶，因此语文老师就把讲台让给数学老师。整个小学阶段最重要的就是数学课了，并且小升初分班考试最看重的就是数学成绩，当然语文和英语也会作为参考，不过相对而言数学的重要程度不言而喻。数学老师说了三年级的数学明显比一二年级稍微难一些，但是进入四年级会更难，而且内容也更多。虽然数学老师没有明着说，不过话里话外能听出来如果想抓成绩最好报课外补习班，想冲刺好的中学就要开始刷题了。

数学老师讲完，英语老师正好也过来了。小学阶段英语算是三门课里最简单的，不过这个简单只是暂时的，到了高年级尤其是初中高中阶段，难度会突然骤增，所以要提前学习，老师也指出了这一点。家长会开完后老师把暑假作业发到QQ群里，我看了下没有项目式作业，都是语文，数学，英语的卷子，和平常周末卷类型一模一样，明天打印出来让孩子做，正常的暑假生活开始了。

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@alpha-omega/3g5tdn)

Good evening everyone, today I would like to rate a game I've been seeing on playstore. I saw this game months ago but neglected it because it looked boring since it's kind off pixel. But today I didn’t want to judge a book by its cover so I downloaded it to check it out. At first glance the cover of the game is a photo of Wukong (Monkey King 🐒👑) in action, I had two thoughts if the game was a shooting game or Wukong.
As I opened it I saw a short tutorial on how to play, I did as instructed and was directed to where i would picked guns and test my aim. I passed every stage and the last game play you saw is my first match in the game and yes I dominated. Normally I'm supposed to dominate, everyone is supposed to dominate because every first match in a game would be easy since you're going to play with easy bots.
Currently I've played alot of game and im still dominating, I'm a sniper user in the game because at first trial only the sniper felt smooth and easy to control but the only part I hate about the game is that when you ADS your gun stay at ADS position even when you leave the button and that is not good for a sniper player. I don't know if the problem is from the game or I've not just discovered the setting but I'd check it before entering the game later in order to enjoy the game to the fullest.
This game is lag free as it does not take alot if power for phone to handle, the graphic is pixel which makes the graphic very low and supports your phone fps. My phone currently runs on 120 fps on that game and it doesn't even know what lag is, so if you feel like you love this game and would like to play it but your phone is trash, don't be scared your phone is even more capable than you think on this game. Thanks for visiting and if you do test the game you can drop your review on what to think or feel about this game, goodnight 😴.

body.title: The BeerSaturday Challenge Week -469 \
body.body:
> Blessings and greetings to all my Hivers friends! I'm grateful to share a new post here in the #beer community for weekly challenge number -469 sponsored by my friend @detlev. I'll be sharing some great photos I took this afternoon when I accompanied my younger brother to do some shopping for the house. We went to a supermarket I'm not used to going to, so when I saw the liquor section and the huge variety of beer they had, I was impressed. I must say, though, that there was one that really caught my eye, and I'll definitely buy some later to try it.

>Bendiciones y saludos para todos los amigos Hivers agradecido por compartir una nueva publicación aquí en la comunidad #beer para el desafío semanal número -469 el cuál es patrocinado por el amigo @detlev dónde les compartiré unas excelentes fotografías qué tomé en la tarde de hoy cuándo acompañe a mí hermano menor a realizar algunas compras para la casa fuimos a un supermercado a el cuál no estoy acostumbrado a ir por lo cuál al ver la parte de los licores así cómo la gran variedad de ese tipo (cerveza🍺) qué había quedé impresionado aunque debo decir primero hubo una muy llamativa la cuál más adelante sin duda compraré alguna para probarla.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXeZz1ZJv1iQ5YxcmAabtDbEu2bKrE6Lg4Zz8GmxjJ3jm/1782862727987.jpg)


When I saw them on that shelf, I told myself I wasn't going to buy them right now (they weren't in our budget). Besides, they were quite expensive; the can was almost $3 and a slightly larger bottle was almost $4, which far exceeded what we had in cash for basic necessities. But now I know where I can buy them as soon as I can afford them, because they're pricey compared to the local brands. If you can, let me know in the comments what they would cost in your countries.

>Cuándo las ví en ese anaquel me dije ahora mismo no las voy a comprar (no estaba presupuestada) en nuestras compras además su precio algo elevado la de lata casi los $3 y una de botella quizás más grande eran casi los $4 qué sobrepasaba y por mucho lo que llevábamos en efectivo para comprar productos de primera necesidad, pero ya sé dónde las puedo adquirir en cuánto tenga la posibilidad económica porqué es costoso si la comparamos von las nacionales. Si pueden me dejan en los comentarios cuál sería su valor en sus países.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbxMw7ygopHEC3NbHdujkL3JqrxA9prmnUHdg1cijmrUc/1782862747863.jpg)


I knew it was a US brand, \

but what I didn't know, and after doing some research, I found out that its creators were of German origin, but they used a recipe from Bohemia, which is now the Czech Republic. They say that its best feature is undoubtedly its flavor. An extra detail is that it contains rice, which I find curious, but also makes me want to try it.\n\n>Sabía qué era una marca de los Estados Unidos \

pero lo qué no conocía y buscando un poco me encontré con la información de qué eran sus creadores de origen Alemán pero utilizando una receta de Bohemia lo qué hoy sería la República Checa y dicen qué lo mejor sin duda es su sabor, además un detalle extra es qué entre sus ingredientes posee Arroz lo cuál para mí es curioso pero a la vez me resulta interesante probarla. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf5kQy9yoDqnT1oPbyUV9fhEWX3f3Wi5mPfpyZYHZsvmo/1782862763703.jpg) There are undoubtedly so many beers 🍻 from different cultures, and it would be a pleasure to have the opportunity to enjoy them and compare them with Venezuelan beers to see if we could truly aspire to be among the best. I'll sign off by thanking you for the opportunity to participate in these challenges, which I love, and I invite my sister @mariarodriguez to participate in the next ones so she can show us her best photos, but with the requirement you already know. >Sin duda hay tantas Cervezas🍻de diferentes culturas las cuáles sería un gusto el poder tener la posibilidad de disfrutar y compararlas con las Venezolanas para quizás saber realmente si podríamos optar a ser de las mejores. Me despido no sin antes agradecer por la oportunidad de participar en estos desafíos qué me encantan e invito a participar a mí hermana @mariarodriguez en los siguientes para qué nos muestren sus mejores fotografías pero con el requisito qué ya conocen.

The United Kingdom government has officially structured a comprehensive legislation package targeting digital assets, establishing explicit capital market abuse rules within a landmark crypto framework. This regulatory framework addresses a critical, historical systemic friction point: the proliferation of unmonitored market manipulation, insider trading execution, and synthetic volume inflation (commonly deployed via wash-trading algorithms) that have fundamentally plagued public distributed ledger environments across previous market cycles.

From a rigorous systems-thinking perspective, the primary structural objective of the UK’s Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and HM Treasury is to completely eliminate the asymmetric information advantages historically weaponized by highly concentrated token holders, or \

against retail market participants. The lack of standard capital market oversight in the Web3 sector has operated as the baseline root cause preventing global, institutional-grade liquidity syndicates from executing long-term asset allocations on-chain. By codifying precise legal parameters regarding what constitutes illicit execution behavior, algorithmic manipulation, and administrative disclosure failures, the United Kingdom is attempting to transition the crypto asset class out of its speculative infancy and into an institutional-grade asset vertical.

However, conducting an empirical anomaly analysis of this legislative rollout reveals profound operational trade-offs and structural compliance bottlenecks that retail investors and protocol developers fail to properly calculate. The introduction of traditional, centralized capital market surveillance mechanisms inherently fractures the foundational ethos of censorship-resistant, non-custodial software ecosystems. Under the newly structured guidelines, any corporate entity, digital asset exchange, or decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) interfacing with the UK economic zone must programmatically deploy real-time transaction monitoring data pipelines. This requires extensive tracking of cryptographic wallet addresses, counterparty identity verification, and strict reporting protocols for anomalous network telemetry.

Furthermore, this sweeping legal infrastructure introduces severe compliance laggard risks for early-stage decentralized applications (dApps). The economic cost of maintaining continuous, multi-jurisdictional legal compliance will systematically drain treasury resources from smaller developer teams, effectively concentrating market share into highly capitalized, legacy-backed custodial platforms. While the narrative surrounding this bill promises absolute market stabilization and retail capital protection, the mathematical reality dictates an intensifying trend toward network centralization.

Investors must decouple optimistic institutional-adoption sentiment from the operational reality of capital tracking. The enactment of these market abuse protocols signals that sovereign states will no longer tolerate private capital routing channels that operate outside global financial tracking networks. For a portfolio to remain sustainable through this regulatory transition, one must recognize that high-throughput, unmonitored speculation is nearing its structural end within developed economies. Relying on blind momentum strategies without auditing how a protocol handles jurisdictional compliance limits is a catastrophic risk management oversight. Institutional integration does not preserve the sovereign anomalies of early crypto; it fundamentally overwrites them.

body.title: 默默的祝福
body.body:
早上，魏老师又把孩子们的图片发出来，他们今天去另外一个学校参加生物和地理考试,看着孩子们的背影，感慨很多，因为这几个小时，考出来成绩，却可以决定他的命运，

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf4jVNEBAGbJbn5U7t7WQ9x3xnkfrJ5gX3W6yWahSUJKk/1782861943463.jpg)

我有点担心欢仔，但是却也没有办法，只有默默的祝福他，但愿今天地理和生物，能取得好成绩，家长群里也都在不断发信息，祝孩子们今天考试顺利， 取得优异好成绩，还挺热闹的，可怜天下父母心，做家长都是这么担心孩子。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ4V4641nCwgDnT4vbhGdErEr3kywydkQ6f6qtD2PKT5X/1782861943482.jpg)

 
梯子坏了几天，本想找电脑部人修修，可惜今天又没有看到他，不过，神奇的是，这梯子既然自己悄悄的恢复了，今天还是可以用，可以看看文，生活又充实很多， 0今天上班， 大老板又发一个通告出来，老板C又要管另外一个部，香港老板也是，看来他们的工作任务越来越强了，做老板也不是件容易的事。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSHC444CQKcuobtUXQ6EsTJTErrocUdr7ZhXsRCXWJPN9/1782861943496.jpg)

 
今天太阳很大，我下午四点多去拿了一个快递，突然感觉这太阳晒在人的身上很舒服，能出来走走也是好， 看着蓝天白云，真的好美呀，这几天工作也是很累，还好能准时下班， 很是好， 老板也没有天天来找我，工作还算安逸吧。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTekx11jXp37pT1CCTJ9F3ML3h34pECMdPjhTLiHBQ7Te/1782861983280.jpg)

只是外国客人来这边还是很多，天天在不断的发邮件过来，订酒店安排车，我今天大概数了一下来我们部门来这边的客人了，今年都快一百个人了，现在是看到这样的邮件就觉得累， 都有点不想帮他们安排了，既然有这样心里，我也是服了自己，其实平时我很喜欢跟他们聊天的。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRhSvRfYvBdZM4b9qfVaDYY7nYv4SxEeUD2CPbRq3Ev5Z/1782861983244.jpg)

跟培训老师问了下暑假补课的事情，欢欢说愿是愿意补课，不过，还没有认真的跟他谈，还到两周放假了，所以还得好好谈谈，欢欢明年就初三了，我是很想让他努力一把，中考考个好成绩吧。

body.title: Street Art #898 Tchekon, Montreal
body.body: I'd been looking for these two garage doors last year because they were painted during the 2024 edition of the [Mural Festival](https://muralfestival.com) in **Montreal**. I thought this raccoon and squirrel, by [**Tchekon**](https://www.instagram.com/tchekon/), were closer to the festival area. But they were hidden much further north. I stumbled upon them while going to the Mexican bakery [**Carlota**](https://carlota-boulangerie.square.site/). What a lovely surprise!\n\n> *J'avais cherché ces deux portes de garage l'année dernière car elles avaient été peintes durant l'édition 2024 du [Mural Festival](https://muralfestival.com) à **Montréal**. Je pensais que ce raton laveur et cet écureuil, fait par [**Tchekon**](https://www.instagram.com/tchekon/) se trouvaient plus près de la zone du festival. Mais ils étaient cachés bien plus au \

. C'est en allant à la boulangerie mexicaine [**Carlota**](https://carlota-boulangerie.square.site/) que j'y suis tombé dessus. Une belle surprise...*

![Tchekon](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/EpNqHjM4vPJhYKfqnoC16PD8tpuaqtoGrMBgvwiGiN4ZtMRoGrNGf5N8ZG7zTuARY5d.jpg)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴇʀᴇ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

This double garage door is located in the alley parallel to Saint Urbain Street near Villeneuve Street in Montreal. If you're in the area, I recommend a visit to the [**Carlota**](https://carlota-boulangerie.square.site/) bakery; their cakes are truly delicious, like the Tres Leches, the dulce de leche roll... and if you prefer savory, they even have tamales.

![Carte.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tHUivcxAApTA9scmA1spyf5KzUf9xyWjNiFKskNT1ghogoA9uH96GXZ35JGps1RcXv1.jpg)

> *Cette double porte de garage se trouve dans la ruelle parallèle à la rue Saint Urbain près de la rue Villeneuve à Montréal. Si vous êtes dans le coin, je vous conseille un détour par la boulangerie [**Carlota**](https://carlota-boulangerie.square.site/), les gâteaux y sont vraiment très bon comme Tres leches, roulé au dulce de leche... et si vous préférez le salé, il y a même des tamales.*

🗺️ Position on [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/#map=18/45.519929/-73.590100)

[//]:# (!worldmappin 45.51968 lat -73.59023 long Great work on 2 garage doors by Tchekon in 2024 d3scr)

![063 - Tchekon sur Clark.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/Eou9ciFouma1hvTVudCe6dShxsFc1RpPaBEGt5m67jLusTuVLS7P6CH2DNZFhyFbUAq.jpg)

On the garage wall, there's this ROSAR lettering... or maybe it's two artists who put their tags side by side. The style and color of the letters aren't the same between ROS and AR. What do you think?
> *Sur le mur du garage, il y a ce lettrage de ROSAR... ou alors ce sont deux artiste qui ont posé leur blaze l'un à côté de l'autre. Le style et la couleur des lettres ne sont pas identiques entre ROS et AR. Votre avis...* 

# ෴ ᴡʜᴏ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

## Tchekon

![064 - Tchekon sur Clark.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/EptabCmd5cvKfUmT5FbQy1UzmNqgoAsuQy4DFGc1SHy6YpbQY6XnGDjdX85hWYy6yo4.jpg)

[**Tchekon**](https://www.instagram.com/tchekon/) aka **Vania Tchekon** is an artist based in Montreal and also in Bordeaux, France. He has been active in the streets of Montreal for many years. He launched his concept \
(I'LL GO GRAFFE AT YOUR PLACE), somewhat like the French television show [\

(Wiki in french)](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%27irai_dormir_chez_vous). This was episode 1: **Le Soulèvement Des Indésirables** (The Uprising of the Undesirables).\n\n> *[**Tchekon**](https://www.instagram.com/tchekon/) aka **Vania Tchekon** est un artiste basé à Montréal et aussi à Bordeaux en France. Il est actif depuis de nombreuses années dans les rues de Montréal. Il avait lancé son concept \
, un peu comme l'émission de télévision française [\

(Wiki)](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%27irai_dormir_chez_vous). C'était l'épisode 1 : **Le Soulèvement Des Indésirables**.*

![065 - Tchekon sur Clark.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/EokeWrzceA19gYtoi8VXYv9CQ4B5q6ZgvpTEYdugXvBMfyrRjY6qeT6s3rY3HxWuL6Q.jpg)

On his Instagram account, [**Tchekon**](https://www.instagram.com/tchekon/) shares a little anecdote about this project that I really like. / **FR** : *Sur son compte Instagram, [**Tchekon**](https://www.instagram.com/tchekon/) livre une petite anecdote sur cette réalisation que j'aime beaucoup* : 

<div class=\

> I painted without the man's permission. The man arrived, unhappy. So, since I was scared, I was unhappy too. So he was surprised that I was unhappy. So he became happy. He offered me a drink, some paint, and he paid me. The man's name was Tonio. He's nice, Tonio. Now, Tonio is my friend.

> J’ai peinturé sans l’accord du monsieur Le monsieur est arrivé pas content Alors, comme j’avais peur, j’ai été pas content aussi Alors il était étonné que j’étais pas content Alors il est devenu content Il m’a offert à boire, de la peinture et il m’a payé Le monsieur s’appelait Tonio Il est sympa, Tonio Maintenant, Tonio, c’est mon copain *** A great encounter... And the message of the work is interesting too. In Montreal, raccoons and squirrels are considered undesirable by some people. They like to rummage through garbage and make a mess 😀. **Tchekon** compares himself \

as Tonio understood.\n\n>*Une belle rencontre... Et le message de l'oeuvre aussi est intéressant. Sur Montréal, les raton-laveurs et les écureuils sont considérés comme indésirables par certaines personnes. Ils aiment bien fouiller dans les poubelles et en mettre partout* 😀. ***Tchekon** se compare \

comme Tonio l'a compris.*

![066 - Tchekon sur Clark.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/Ep5p6BDfg2LuytBivG6kgJ7Wp6ScXETcD3U99bp6jTSScf3oguYhqrm8CUz2ZKZmn2w.jpg)

body.title: Hive Seeing It For What It Is
body.body:
![Screenshot 2026-06-30 at 7.18.54 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/23wCb4apewVe9EwaksYYBrJbGB1KUDdDbkSxAHVc6GDW1guZkoxEGPDG1nX82JF21w5aU.png)


Like many I’ve been thinking about Hive again. Not the next bull run is going to save everything version of Hive or the we’re early narrative anymore. I’m talking about the version you see when you zoom out both on the chart and in the community.

If you’ve been around long enough, you start to notice something. The energy isn’t gone, but it’s definitely different. I think I've written about this is past bear markets, but there is a part nobody really wants to say out loud that's been weighing on me. Hive has not collapse, but it has bled out slowly right in front of our eyes. You can see it in the activity. You can feel it in the engagement. You can definitely see it in the price action.

![Screenshot 2026-06-30 at 7.18.15 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/23tHbr9DcXuophpm42syft1AHPTg3xQ2ge6v61G9wN6rfShEErMMThYkkgz4coP9Cv4nT.png)

Pull up the chart and it tells the same story the platform does. Lower highs, weak bounces, no real sustained momentum and every rally gets sold. That’s not bullish behavior. Hive has basically been stuck in a long-term downtrend structure since the last real cycle peak. Technically, right now Hive feels like it’s sitting in that awkward zone as it's not cheap enough to spark real accumulation, not strong enough to attract momentum traders and not growing fast enough to bring in new users. So what do you get? Stagnation.

That same stagnation shows up in the platform itself. The chart and the community are mirroring each other. It’s a feedback loop and unless something fundamentally shifts, that loop doesn’t just fix itself.


![Screenshot 2026-06-30 at 7.21.38 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/23tvgeoyukJWqC1BzyBdFMvyumFpZCX36ZfqFfNkiFh9NUdgDqcfSVcQC88BNbXrDkAwU.png)


My friend @bozz had an interesting [post](https://peakd.com/hive-178138/@bozz/life-after-hive) that sparked this one. So what does “life after Hive” actually mean? For most people, it means they quietly stop posting. They don’t make a big exit post. They don’t rage quit. They just fade out.Maybe they move to other platforms. Maybe they stop writing altogether. Maybe they just get tired of forcing content into a system that isn’t giving much back anymore. Honestly, that’s a rational response. 

I keep asking myself what does that look like for me? I talk about stagnation yet I'm still here. Not because I think Hive is about to explode.Not because I’m expecting some miracle reversal, but because Hive still does something most platforms don’t. It's an outlet to be creative where I own my content. I'm increasingly frustrated by the proliferation of the algorithms curating my every move. Telling me which friends posts to see or what to think. Hive still has that advantage and it still matters to me. The mistake is treating Hive like it’s still in a growth phase. It’s not, it's a platform with a core group of users that need to support each other through tough times. It's that combination of dedication and freedom that makes this place great. So drop in on old friends leave a comment, re blog and lets bring this place back to life one post at a time! I'll be here until the lights get turned off.

body.title: ¿Es malo tener secretos? | Is it bad to have secrets?
body.body: > Primeramente, le envío un abrazo a todos mis hermanos venezolanos que están pasando por una situación difícil en este momento y agradezco a todos los que están ayudando, tanto de forma internacional como la nacional.

> Desde pequeña, me dijeron que jamás debía tener un secreto porque era malo ocultar cosas porque eso me convertía directamente en una persona deshonesta, por eso pasé años sintiendo culpa por ocultar ciertos acontecimientos de mi vida. Luego, mientras crecía, veía cómo todos ocultaban secretos y al mismo tiempo me reprendían por hacer lo mismo, así que no tenía una idea clara sobre cómo enfrentar eso.
\n\n

> Luego, con el tiempo, entendí que existen secretos que está bien ocultar y otros que no lo están. En cuanto a aquellos que está bien ocultar, son todos aquellos que no afectan o lastiman a un tercero, y no me refiero a ese fugaz pensamiento de que el maquillaje le queda mal o ese color de camisa no va con su tono de piel, sino aquellos que causan un gran daño y conflictos. La cuestión es que, si todos contáramos lo que nos pasara por la mente, no tendríamos autonomía ni desarrollaríamos nuestra identidad; no seríamos más que un libro abierto.
\n\n

> Además, la transparencia absoluta no es buena en las relaciones, de hecho, llega a ser destructiva y hasta cruel. Creo que todos nos hemos sentido mal o incómodos cuando alguien sin filtros hizo algún comentario innecesario. Yo considero que esos pensamientos momentáneos deberían guardarse como una muestra de consideración hacia la otra persona.
https://images.pexels.com/photos/6284254/pexels-photo-6284254.jpeg
Imagen de

> Existen secretos que yo considero totalmente necesarios por experiencia propia y son aquellos relacionados con proyectos personales. Con esto me refiero a algún emprendimiento, la compra de algo grande que necesites, un viaje, entre otros. La razón por la cual considero que debe ser un secreto es porque existen muchas personas malintencionadas (especialmente personas cercanas). Por eso es mejor ser discreto y no es que se oculte del mundo, sino que se cuente solo a los necesarios. Yo he tenido muchos proyectos fallidos, principalmente por terceros que hicieron malos comentarios, me engañaron o estafaron. Cuando algo es muy importante, debemos saber bien a quién decirle y a quién no.
\n\n

> Ahora, en cuanto a los secretos malos, mencioné que son aquellos que dañan a un tercero, como una infidelidad, un fraude, traición o cualquier otro que viole los derechos de otros, pero también están aquellos que nos dañan a nosotros mismos. Con esto me refiero a los secretos de vergüenza o trauma, por ejemplo, aquellos relacionados con abusos, adicciones o enfermedades mentales, que al ocultarlos terminan causando estrés y ansiedad.
\n\n

> El constante miedo de ser descubierta y terminar obteniendo una mala reacción, a la larga, termina aislando a las personas. No es que se tenga que gritar a los cuatro vientos, pero decirles a las personas necesarias quitaría ese gran peso sobre los hombros; además, difícilmente un secreto dura toda la vida, por eso es mejor contarlo antes de que se enteren por alguien más.
\n\n

> Tener secretos no tiene nada de malo siempre y cuando no dañe a otros o a nosotros mismos. Lo importante es saber qué decir y qué no, además de aprender a distinguir a quién debemos decirle y a quién no.

Gracias por leer

https://images.hive.blog/DQmcbWiLfXdQC69eQCsnyduRBZPQct12Fwh1iXv1wLx7hHP/11.png

English

![usuario ssmn (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/s-alvarez/23tvgNNaKBH7ESJuVm6pvwaW85yFVbRR5cMGT5aegQSa952VD1uU2d3YXp17FB92GvAB5.png)

> First of all, I send my warmest regards to all my Venezuelan brothers and sisters who are going through a difficult time right now, and I thank everyone who is helping, both internationally and nationally.

> Ever since I was little, I was told that I should never keep a secret because it was wrong to hide things—that doing so automatically made me a dishonest person. That’s why I spent years feeling guilty about hiding certain events in my life. Then, as I grew up, I saw how everyone kept secrets while at the same time scolding me for doing the same thing, so I didn’t have a clear idea of how to deal with it.
\n\n

> Then, over time, I came to understand that there are secrets it’s okay to keep and others that aren’t. As for the ones it’s okay to keep, they’re all those that don’t affect or hurt a third party—and I’m not referring to that fleeting thought that someone’s makeup doesn’t suit them or that the color of their shirt doesn’t match their skin tone, but rather those that cause great harm and conflict. The point is that if we all said everything that crossed our minds, we wouldn’t have any autonomy or be able to develop our own identities; we’d be nothing more than an open book.
\n\n

> Furthermore, absolute transparency isn’t good in relationships; in fact, it can be destructive and even cruel. I think we’ve all felt bad or uncomfortable when someone who doesn’t hold back has made an unnecessary comment. I believe those fleeting thoughts should be kept to oneself as a sign of consideration for the other person.
https://images.pexels.com/photos/6284254/pexels-photo-6284254.jpeg
Image by

> There are secrets that I consider absolutely necessary based on my own experience, and these are the ones related to personal projects. By this I mean a business venture, the purchase of something big you need, a trip, among other things. The reason I believe it should be kept secret is because there are many malicious people out there (especially those close to you). That’s why it’s best to be discreet—not to hide it from the world, but to share it only with those who need to know. I’ve had many failed projects, mainly because of third parties who made negative comments, deceived me, or scammed me. When something is very important, we need to know exactly who to tell and who not to tell.
\n\n

> Now, as for bad secrets, I mentioned that they are those that harm a third party—such as infidelity, fraud, betrayal, or anything else that violates the rights of others—but there are also those that harm ourselves. By this I mean secrets involving shame or trauma—such as those related to abuse, addiction, or mental illness—which, when kept hidden, end up causing stress and anxiety.
\n\n

> The constant fear of being found out and facing a negative reaction eventually leads people to isolate themselves. It’s not that you have to shout it from the rooftops, but telling the right people would lift that heavy burden off your shoulders; besides, secrets rarely last a lifetime, so it’s better to share them before someone else finds out.
\n\n

> There's nothing wrong with having secrets as long as they don't hurt others or ourselves. The important thing is to know what to say and what not to say, as well as to learn to distinguish who we should tell and who we shouldn't.

body.title: Peline… a story of resilience and learning / Peline... una historia de resiliencia y aprendizaje
body.body:
<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmSzbDTnzVHqpNcaYVGvFFMYEF5YsGKoWqF2n9NDzMbqfT/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb gallery](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0168362/mediaviewer/rm3117078530/)

As a child, every afternoon I would look forward to the time when the episodes of *Peline* were broadcast on free-to-air television – the story of a little girl who, together with her mother and her donkey, was trying to return to her father’s family home, in the hope of building a relationship with her paternal grandfather, who had fallen out with her father for deciding to marry her mother.

Back then, watching this animated series didn’t mean becoming an otaku or anything to do with the world of anime as we know it today on this side of the world; rather, it was a window onto other cultures and a children’s story that broke the mould of happy endings.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQme7eD2iqGaD5CZjJc7pPuUtocAyP7CwJJZ7Dn4kAsNN6m/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb gallery](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0168362/mediaviewer/rm3918172929/)

In *Peline*, (The anime is originally known as *Perrine* or by the title of the French book on which the story is based, *En famille*) we meet this young girl who sets off on a journey with her mother to find a grandfather she has never met, following her father’s death in Bosnia. Travelling by cart, with a donkey and her little dog, she aims to reach France, facing many situations that will test her resilience.

Back then, the very idea of me undertaking a similar feat was unthinkable – for how could a 13-year-old girl possibly have the mental strength to endure such tragedy without losing faith?

Throughout the story, we see how she must learn to develop the skills to stand firm in the face of adversity, taking responsibility for her ailing mother and picking up tools along the way that enable her to press on towards her intended destination, even whilst fearing rejection by a grandfather she knows only by name.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmdgSJ1M4QMGegWhUEnThzdpAEe1kj9YunRSSTdyCBKQwr/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb gallery](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0168362/mediaviewer/rm3767177985/)

One of the funny things I remember from the series was when, at one point, Peline’s shoes broke and she looked for a way to fix them, but as she found it too expensive, she decided to make them herself using braided hemp, creating some beautiful sandals that I wanted to replicate at home.

The story is, in some respects, similar to the tale of Marco, in which children are trying to survive in an adult world, set mainly in the post-war period, when many were displaced by the circumstances of that time.

As time goes by, Peline manages to reach the town where her grandfather lives, but her fear of telling him who she is outweighs her desire to feel part of a family again. She therefore decides to ask for work in the household, so that she can get to know him and learn how to treat him; and it was through her kindness and nobility that she managed to soften the hard heart of a man whom everyone considered an ogre.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmPsU5mwhS4AiQgM12tk8f1NVnuQsPNvDMtWn7fCtV2LT5/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb gallery](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0168362/mediaviewer/rm3985281793/)

At this point, she has nothing left to lose; she has lived for a long time without a family and has lost her sense of belonging, so this search for her origins is all she has left. And although it may seem incredible, her spirits have not been dampened despite everything she has been through; rather, she sees it as part of the learning process and the necessary journey towards maturity.

Peline offers a glimpse into that world we know so little about as children—the world of displaced people and orphans—and teaches us how kindness can open even the heaviest of doors.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmX9V7fyimJktQwH9Ns3iuPt97A5ieiq897qWRyp9Pz86J/image.png</center>

De niña, cada tarde esperaba la hora cuando transmitían en la televisión abierta los capítulos de Peline, la historia de una niña que junto a su madre y su burro, buscaban regresar a la casa materna de su padre, con la esperanza de tener una relación con su abuelo paterno, quien se enemistó con su padre por decidir casarse con su madre.

Para esos días, ver esta serie animada no era convertirse en otaku ni nada relacionado con el mundo anime como lo conocemos hoy en día de este lado del mundo, sino que era una ventana hacia otras culturas y en una historia infantil que rompía con el paradigma de las tramas felices.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQme7eD2iqGaD5CZjJc7pPuUtocAyP7CwJJZ7Dn4kAsNN6m/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb gallery](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0168362/mediaviewer/rm3918172929/)

En Peline, (originalmente el anime se conoce como Perrine o también con el nombre del libro que da pie a la historia que es de origen francés \

) conocemos a esta niña que se embarca en un viaje junto a su madre, para buscar a un abuelo que no conoce, luego de que su padre falleciera en Bosnia, tomando una carreta, un burro y su perrito, con la idea de llegar hasta Francia, pasando por muchas situaciones que pondrán a prueba su templanza.

En aquellos días, imaginarme haciendo una hazaña similar era inadmisible, pues ¿Cómo podía ser posible que una niña de 13 años tuviera la fuerza mental para atravesar por la tragedia sin perder la fe?

Durante la trama, vemos como ella debe aprender a desarrollar habilidades para mantenerse de pie en las adversidades, pasando a ser la responsable por su madre enferma, aprendiendo en el camino herramientas que le permitan seguir adelante para llegar al destino trazado, aún con el temor que tiene de ser rechazada por un abuelo a quien solo conoce por nombre.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmdgSJ1M4QMGegWhUEnThzdpAEe1kj9YunRSSTdyCBKQwr/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb gallery](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0168362/mediaviewer/rm3767177985/)

Una de las cosas graciosas que recuerdo de la serie, fue cuando en algún punto, a Peline se le rompen los zapatos y busca la manera de arreglarlos, pero como le resulta un gasto imposible, decide hacerlos por cuenta propia con cáñamo trenzado, logrando unas hermosas sandalias que yo quería replicar en casa.

La historia es en algunos aspectos, similar al cuento de Marco, en el cual son niños tratando de sobrevivir en un mundo de adultos, sobre todo ambientado en la post guerra, cuando muchos son desplazados por las condiciones propias de esta situación.

Con el paso del tiempo, Peline logra llegar a la ciudad donde vive su abuelo, pero el temor de decirle quien es puede más que las ganas de sentirse nuevamente parte de una familia, por lo que decide pedir trabajo en la casa, para así poder conocerlo e ir aprendiendo cómo tratarlo, y fue con su bondad y su nobleza que logró ablandar el duro corazón de un señor al que todos consideraban un ogro.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmPsU5mwhS4AiQgM12tk8f1NVnuQsPNvDMtWn7fCtV2LT5/image.png</center>

[Screenshot from Imdb gallery](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0168362/mediaviewer/rm3985281793/)

En este punto, ella no tiene ya nada que perder, ha vivido mucho tiempo sin familia, y perdido el sentido de pertenencia, por lo que esa búsqueda de su origen es lo único que le queda,  y aunque parezca increíble, su ánimo no ha disminuido a pesar de todo lo vivido, más bien lo toma como parte del aprendizaje y del proceso de madurez necesario.

Peline, es una muestra de ese mundo que poco conocemos siendo niños, con respecto a los desplazados, los huérfanos, y es una enseñanza sobre cómo la bondad abre inclusive las puertas más pesadas.

***

Foto/Photo by: Screenshot from [Imdb gallery](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0168362/?ref_=mv_close)
Banner de portada: Cortesía de @palabras1
Edición/Edited by @mamaemigrante using canva
Translated and formatted with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

body.title: Paraguay hoy — martes 30 de junio de 2026
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmennFt1McrHDvfhu64wvW9WbWKnqNmhMasGyBesewfDbT/1782861248047.jpg)

### ⚽ FERIADO NACIONAL — La Albirroja hizo historia

El dato que lo explica todo: el presidente Santiago Peña decretó feriado nacional por la victoria de la Selección paraguaya ante Alemania para pasar a los octavos de final de la Copa Mundial 2026. 

Paraguay derrotó a Alemania en la tanda de penales 4-3 tras igualar 1-1 en tiempo regular, en el Gillette Stadium de Boston. Orlando Gill fue el héroe de la tanda, en la primera definición por penales del Mundial 2026. [Diario HOY](https://www.hoy.com.py/nacionales/2026/06/24/pena-promulga-leyes-para-conmemorar-el-centenario-de-la-paz-del-chaco)

Unas 60.000 personas llegaron al centro de Asunción para festejar la hazaña. La Policía reportó un joven detenido, 34 cuidacoches demorados y 34 adolescentes verificados en medio de los festejos. [Diario HOY](https://www.hoy.com.py/nacionales/punto-caliente-causa-sorpresa-en-concepcion-agua-hierve-bajo-la-tierra) La calle Palma se llenó de camisetas albirrojas. La gran comunidad paraguaya en el exterior también festejó desde distintas partes del mundo. [Diario HOY](https://www.hoy.com.py/nacionales/punto-caliente-causa-sorpresa-en-concepcion-agua-hierve-bajo-la-tierra)

Del otro lado, la eliminación desencadenó una tormenta mediática en Alemania, con el seleccionador Julian Nagelsmann respondiendo de manera tensa a preguntas sobre su continuidad, y Jürgen Klopp repartiendo críticas públicas a diestro y siniestro. [Diario HOY](https://www.hoy.com.py/nacionales/2026/06/24/pena-promulga-leyes-para-conmemorar-el-centenario-de-la-paz-del-chaco)

---

### 🌎 Cumbre del Mercosur — con el gran ausente

La cumbre presidencial arrancó hoy en Luque con una silla vacía muy notoria. Milei decidió de última hora no asistir, alegando los preparativos para la jura de su nuevo jefe de Gabinete, Diego Santilli. La decisión coincidió con su reunión en Olivos con Flavio Bolsonaro, hijo del expresidente brasileño y candidato opositor a Lula en las elecciones de octubre. [Agence IP](https://www.ip.gov.py/ip/2026/06/25/gobierno-del-paraguay-establece-un-periodo-de-diez-anos-para-conmemorar-centenario-de-la-paz-del-chaco/) No es la primera vez: ya había faltado a la cumbre de julio de 2024 en Asunción, también con tensiones con Brasil como telón de fondo. [Secretaria Nacional de Cultura Paraguay](https://cultura.gov.py/marcolegal/ley-que-crea-el-premio-nacional-de-musica-n%C2%BA-34894/)

El presidente Peña dio las palabras de bienvenida y no ocultó su disconformidad con la distribución del acuerdo Mercosur-UE, afirmando que Paraguay se quedó con un \

, recalcó. [Última Hora](https://www.ultimahora.com/pena-promulga-leyes-para-homenajear-a-los-heroes-del-chaco-y-fortalecer-cultura)

Lula da Silva llegó esta mañana completando el listado de seis mandatarios presentes. Paraguay traspasará hoy la presidencia pro tempore a Uruguay. [Última Hora](https://www.ultimahora.com/pena-promulga-leyes-para-homenajear-a-los-heroes-del-chaco-y-fortalecer-cultura)

---

### 💰 BCP baja comisiones de tarjetas

El Banco Central del Paraguay dispuso una nueva reducción en el porcentaje máximo de comisiones que cobran las entidades emisoras y operadoras por la intermediación de pagos realizados con tarjeta. [Presidencia de la República del Paraguay](https://www.presidencia.gov.py/noticias/presidente-pena-promulga-leyes-sobre-el-centenario-de-la-paz-del-chaco-y-el-premio-nacional-de-musica/) Una medida que pasa desapercibida en día de feriado pero que afecta directamente al bolsillo.

---

### 🏥 IPS en estado crítico

Con un fondo de salud en estado crítico, el IPS pedirá G. 1 billón más para el presupuesto de 2027. [Corte Suprema de Justicia](https://www.pj.gov.py/ebook/libros_files/Digesto_normativo_de_Extranjer%C3%ADa_Tomo_II_Vol_I.pdf) El Consejo priorizó el área salud como la más sensible de la previsional.

---

**Resumen del día en una línea:** Paraguay amanece de feriado, con resaca de gloria mundialista, seis presidentes reunidos en Luque y el séptimo brillando por su ausencia — todo en el mismo martes.

body.title: [Retrogaming] Chpt 3 / Story 3: Through the Thorny Maze! | Warioland II (Game Boy Color)
body.body:
>**My 3Speaking Today**   Hey, what's up, players! I truly hope you are all doing wonderfully well. As always, allow me to send you my most cordial greeting in order to welcome you once again to another Warioland II gameplay. In this Story 3, we will have to face a truly thorny forest, as in this section of the Maze Woods we will encounter at every turn the very annoying enemies known as the Kotsuheri, those helicopter-like and spiked skull shaped enemies which tend to be quite bothersome since, although some move with trajectories that are easy to predict, there are truly others that do not, with some of these having circular trajectories and a great speed that slows down our path towards the goal. Luckily we will have the help of the Owls for a large part of the journey, which will carry us flying towards the end of the goal and will help us collect a large amount of coins for Wario : )   ***Knowing How to Use the Mechanics.*** If we truly wish to take away as many coins as possible for Wario's loot in this level, then we will have to know how to make very good use of Wario's movement mechanics. For example, if we watch the gameplay starting from minute **02:45**, we begin to make use of the downward sliding movement mechanic, and we can do this every time we find a descending surface where we can utilize the great momentum that Wario builds up in order to access areas of the level that we would not be able to reach using Wario's normal movements. This for example in this level is very necessary to use if we wish to reach the door where the mini-game is located to obtain the additional treasure of the level, as we can see at around minute **05:05**. However, this truly was not an easy task for us as it took us several attempts to achieve it, ha ha!   ***The Owls Helped Us Again.*** In this level the Owls appeared once again to help us cross enormous sections of the map that we can only cross through the air and with the aerial assistance of these Owls, which turn out to be of great use for Wario's endeavor, since without their help it would be impossible for us to complete the level. Although the speed of the Owls can feel somewhat slow, it turns out to be helpful at the same time, since by not being so fast we will be able to better calculate the route and the next move to use with Wario, especially taking into account that we will have to cross areas infested with Kotsuheris.   ***The Owls vs Kotsuheris.*** The high durability of the Owls is of great help, but the trick lies in knowing how to use it, since what is truly difficult at the beginning is learning to detect the **'hitbox'** of the Owls, because these are immune to damage from the Kotsuheris. Therefore we should not worry if the Kotsuheris touch the Owls. By the way, in this level we also managed to obtain the fragment of Wario's final portrait. I think that is enough for today, friends. <div class=text-justify>
I have had many embarrassing moment throughout my life. Some of them happened privately while some very public. But the one that I can recall at this time happened when I was still a little child. 

![IMG-20260630-WA0113.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyinye-chi/23xVMPUsyMbjGFAWr9VBwtHLxQphJ5hBKPNmy75rUYArhVMHzi46mAbmQLuiKiPC24YeK.jpg)

I think it's around 2006 or 2007. One morning, I was brushing my teeth outside which is a norm is a lot of Nigerian homes, especially in ghettos or suburbs. And the way our house was then, there was a gutter just in front, about 5 metres from our front gate. While I was brushing, a relative of mine that had travelled for months arrived just at the front of our house where I was with a vehicle. In excitement that they had returned I was running to go and embrace them without minding where I was. The next thing I realised was that I was sitting almost comfortably in the narrow gutter. You needed to hear how the place erupted with laughter. Of course they confirmed if I was okay before they let out the laughter. 

When it happened I wasn't sure how I felt. But after a while I too started laugh at myself, and I still do even as an adult. 

Another time just came to mind now. Let me share it. Though it's similar to the previous one. But this time it was a much bigger gutter and the components were much more serious. 

One Monday morning, I was dressed for school with my new sandals and very white \

socks. I was ready to show them off to my primary school class mates. Then my grandma gave me money to go and buy bread that I would eat before going to school. Me feeling fly about my new foot accessories, I wasn't paying too much attention to where I stepped. Our house was the second on our street, and there was a much bigger gutter that rounded the corner leading to our street. The place I was supposed to buy the bread was in the other street, so I had to take the bend. Upon crossing the slab that was placed across the big gutter, I didn't realise that I had not completely crossed the slab, I took a sharp right turn and the next thing I saw was that my right leg was inside the gutter. And the road was busy. I immediately lost my appetite and just turned and went back home to wash my leg. That was how I had to go to school that day with an empty stomach and old socks. Thanks for stopping by my blog. See you soon. 🤗 ### peace out ✌️ ##### ALL PICTURES ARE MINE
