body.title: [ES/EN] My Collection of Conclave Arcana reward cards – June 2026 - Season 162
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPdsXwFaqYsuGWGQJVUx4ieWZfk9Fva4LxNbXengrg6W1/Portada%20-%20My%20Collection%20of%20Conclave%20Arcana%20-%20Junio%20-%20Season%20162%20.png</center>

<center>Yesterday, season number **162** of **Splinterlands** concluded, and to avoid further delays and confusion when opening the league promotion rewards and to have a more exact count, I am uploading it today just as the new season started; this way, I can reflect the growth of my **Conclave Arcana** **reward** card collection with the **500.000** **SPS** rented for the season, having opened the **30 Ultimate Chests** of the first batch and **50 Major Chests** of the first batch that I could by obtaining more **Glints** when changing my strategy; however, this new season I won't be able to buy as many **Draws** due to not reaching the goal of **3.680 points** in **Wild** and having been playing **Survival** in **Bracket IV** where they do not give as many rewards, plus the league rewards.</center>

><center>Ayer terminó la temporada número **162** de **Splinterlands** y, para evitar más retrasos y confusiones al abrir las recompensas de subir de liga y tener un conteo más exacto, la subo hoy apenas empezó la nueva temporada; así puedo reflejar el crecimiento de mi colección de tarjetas de **recompensa** del conjunto **Conclave Arcana** con los **500.000** **SPS** rentados por la temporada, habiendo abierto los **30 Ultimate Chest** del primer batch y **50 Major Chest** del primer batch que pude al obtener más **Glints** al cambiar mi estrategia. Aunque esta temporada nueva no pueda comprar tantos **Draw** al no llegar al objetivo de **3.680 puntos** en **Wild** y al haber estado jugando **Survival** en el **Bracket IV**, donde no dan tantas recompensas, además de las recompensas de liga.</center>

### <center>Commons | Comunes</center>

<center>This season I was finally able to obtain more copies of cards of **Common** rarities to be able to have **220** copies of some cards in order to bring them to level **8**, at least for **3** of them, and bringing others close enough to that amount so that in this new season I can bring another **3** cards to Level **8**.</center>

><center>Esta temporada al fin pude obtener más copias de tarjetas de rareza **Común** para poder tener **220** copies de algunas tarjetas y así llevarlas al nivel **8**, por lo menos a **3** de ellas, y acercando otras a esa cantidad lo suficiente para que en esta nueva temporada pueda llevar a Nivel **8** a otras **3** tarjetas.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRVCk2U6b3VjHcQ1d42znmcj4byufHUMwLVFzbv7Lm6gL/Comunes%20-%20Season%20162%20V2.png</center>

<center>Although I still maintain my strategy of not upgrading the cards to their maximum possible levels so I can use them in **Survival** and back up the battles, I am hoping to be able to use them in my battles in **Wild**.</center>

><center>Aunque todavía mantengo mi estrategia de no subir las tarjetas a sus niveles máximos posibles para poder usarlas en **Survival** y rellenar las batallas, espero poder usarlas también en mi batallas en **Wild**.</center>


### <center>Rares | Raras</center>

<center>This season, regarding **Rare** cards, I got few copies, remaining almost equal to last season's amount, with only **2** cards being able to reach level **6** and the others between level **4** and **5**, but moving closer to having the cards at level **6**.</center>

><center>Esta temporada, en lo que se refería a las tarjetas **Raras**, tuve pocas copias, quedando casi igual a la cantidad de la temporada pasada; solo con **2** tarjetas pude llegar al nivel **6** y las demás se mantuvieron entre nivel **4** y **5**, pero acercándome más a tener las tarjetas a nivel **6**.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmW9sprAouGMfZETd8SvgevLjZLT7MG7xw7n7Becnz9FFq/Raras%20-%20Season%20162%20V2.png</center>

<center>Although I expected to increase the pace of copies I obtained per card this past season, this new one will surely be slower, but it will still bring me closer with every copy.</center>

><center>Aunque esperaba aumentar el ritmo de copias que obtenía por tarjeta esta temporada pasada, esta nueva seguramente sea más lenta, pero igual me acercará con cada copia.</center>


### <center>Epics | Epicas</center>

<center>This season, cards of **Epic** rarity break the trend I experienced in recent seasons where I did not obtain any copies; this time I finally obtained a few more, in this case just **2** copies of **Tandi Janda**, which seems like a small amount, but with those copies I can bring it to Level **2**, meaning I can bring almost all of them to level **2**.</center>

><center>Esta temporada, las tarjetas de rareza **Épicas** rompen la tendencia que he tenido en las últimas temporadas donde no obtenía ninguna copia; en esta al fin obtuve algunas más, en este caso solo **2** copias de **Tandi Janda**, que parece poco, pero con esas copias puedo llevarla al Nivel **2**, haciendo que casi todas puedan llegar a nivel **2**.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWZBrZVn7kG7B5ohXe5Jt8gVmTcDucHssiD4jVcJXD21c/Epicas%20-%20Season%20162%20V2.png</center>

<center>I hope upcoming seasons continue like this so I can obtain more copies and be able to upgrade all the epics, as they are the most difficult to complete.</center>

><center>Espero que las demás temporadas sigan así y pueda obtener más copias para poder subir todas las épicas, ya que son las más difíciles de completar.</center>


### <center>Legendaries | Legendarias</center>

<center>For now, **Legendary** cards remain the same with **0** copies just like past seasons, despite having opened **Ultimate Chests** and receiving higher quality league rewards.</center>

><center>Por ahora, las tarjetas **Legendarias** siguen igual con **0** copias como las temporadas pasadas, a pesar de haber abierto **Ultimate Chest** y de contar con recompensas de liga de mejor calidad.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZuZjrfVjJfVS4NbW4FZF86SvHvofWV2NbhJki7vEZfvL/Legendarias%20-%20Season%20162%20V2.png</center>

<center>I still have to maintain my strategy of selling legendary cards to maintain rents, but prices are already balancing out to preserve them; however, I hope with my new strategy to have more **Glints** and buy the **Legendary Draws**.</center>

><center>Todavía tengo que mantener mi estrategia de vender las tarjetas legendarias para poder costear las rentas. Ya se están balanceando los precios para conservarlas, pero espero que con mi nueva estrategia pueda tener más **Glints** y comprar los **Legendary Draw**.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNwFSBnZTjSx1E2JaXXc2pjJGvjqipX8ffExe79jMEY3B/Barra%20-%20Opinion.png</center>

<center>This season was quite difficult to meet the goals with things like completing the **250** battles in **Survival** due to the [**Splinterlands Survival Mode Stress Testing Next Season**](https://hive.blog/splinterlands/@splinterlands/announcement-splinterlands-survival-mode-stress-testing-next-season), although it might have been in vain; in this new season I am thinking between playing in **Bracket XI** as always or whether to enter and test the new [**Survival Bracket Testing Continues**](https://hive.blog/splinterlands/@splinterlands/survival-bracket-testing-continues) but focused on the **Modern** format across several **Brackets**, which can be very complicated to finish considering that I do not have that many cards from the **Modern** sets nor at very high levels; this caused me to miss out on entering the **Diamond** leaderboard of the **Wild** format, which would make it a very difficult bet between securing the **Glints** I usually win normally in the seasons or risking to obtain a better reward and accelerate the acquisition of copies to complete the collection.</center>

><center>Esta temporada fue bastante difícil para poder cumplir las metas con cosas como hacer las **250** batallas en **Survival** por el [**Splinterlands Survival Mode Stress Testing Next Season**](https://hive.blog/splinterlands/@splinterlands/announcement-splinterlands-survival-mode-stress-testing-next-season), aunque puede que haya sido en vano; en esta temporada nueva estoy pensando entre jugar en el **Bracket XI** como siempre o si entrar a probar los nuevos [**Survival Bracket Testing Continues**](https://hive.blog/splinterlands/@splinterlands/survival-bracket-testing-continues) pero enfocados en el formato **Modern** en varios **Brackets**, lo que puede ser muy complicado terminar teniendo en cuenta que no tengo tantas tarjetas de los conjuntos **Modern** ni en niveles muy altos. Esto hizo que no pudiera entrar a la leaderboard de **Diamond** del formato **Wild**, por lo que sería una apuesta muy difícil entre asegurar los **Glints** que suelo ganar normalmente en las temporadas o arriesgar para obtener una mejor recompensa y poder acelerar la obtención de copias y completar la colección.</center>

At this stage, the plant has seeds that look very unique and very flower-like. When it rains or is blown by the wind, the seeds fly and disperse. Look at its appearance, isn't it very unique? However, despite its beauty, this plant often disturbs and pollutes plantations, so many people consider it a pest,even I often cut this plant growing in my plantation. body.title: Splinterlands: End Of Season Report & Rewards!
body.body:
Hi Splinterlands community! This is @zusi78.

The season has come to an end! This is one of my best seasons since I started grinding. Getting to Diamond II in the nick of time was so satisfying.


During the season, my focus was solely on Modern Ranked and Frontier Ranked. I reached a count of **3,100** in Modern Ranked and **3,340** in Frontier Ranked. The great thing is that when a new season starts and the counts reset, you don’t drop down in rank too far. Instead, you start just behind the highest level you attained that season.


For Modern Ranked, I’m starting at Gold I, while for Frontier Ranked it’s also Gold I — as usual, for almost four months now.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTxDjtSvvFbtSSf2Sxw38Tnj3mqERDUHnhMD5NUTFRzdR/1782807333825.jpg)![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmahHztNsaXaUPY5oU1JMrzBkop7ZyhJjKFvzTQBWvadcF/1782812576836.jpg)As shown above I was rewarded with a total of **72,961** glints in modern ranked and below I collected a total of 20 chests 🧰,that is exactly 100 foundation cards in frontier ranked.


**20 CHESTS REWARD(100 Foundation Cards)**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfVQaRRnzmZFnB69V2EQhVwQoX8arGFjEyXQ4BucYgvX2/1782812474299.jpg)

**Splinterlands is no walk in the park,but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building.Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)



Like I said earlier,it was a satisfying season. A new one has began and counts are already resetted across the various leagues.

**MODERN RANKED RESET TO 2,600 COUNTS**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXHMUR2F5miGbNPgdwupGgG4HourVJycuTTDFMoFiUSWx/1782807333891.jpg)

**FRONTIER RANKED RESET TO 2,500 COUNTS**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaHQnh3rR2xx4RQ9BGFTkfPEMuExKmrBtuSP5pauvAREr/1782807333938.jpg)

**Here is how I spent my 72,961 glints**:
**Three Epic Cards From The Epic Draw @45,000 glints**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUPNtyJWpV5SJxFFh5HdB5ygj7y9eANo2uYECAEv2Gdgb/1782822574385.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVHr7wKFTPBPV9JhERKHkV5S8VWdBPVFpqR6EXw5oKVde/1782822574327.jpg)
**The epic cards revealed were: one copy of Tandi Janda and two copies of Joraki Venshiro**.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVNBCJn98u25K2XkFX1Exin2xQkvaB8gEn5MQfaj4cwkx/1782824330933.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR8eJDotsvq8JfvD2NNGMP4Bj9mn1eY2CL9RESNsDKQVU/1782824330975.jpg)






**Fifteen Rare Cards From The Rare Draw @22,500 glints**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRfb6CnxPDbmGacrAR2oFf6T749irHLuqSxGncJ6i2i9i/1782822782675.jpg)

Not to bore you with the screenshots, but the cards I got were very satisfying to me. Moving forward, I opened the 20 packs I got from playing Frontier Ranked, which gave me 100 Foundation cards. There were lots of epic, rare, and common cards and just one Legendary card. The season was so productive for me.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)

**SPS & MERITS**. After I am done with exhausting my glints in cards purchase,I went to check what I have staked in SPS,for I am targeting 1,000 STAKED SPS before the year ends.I found out I had a total of **90.41** Staked SPS yet unclaimed from brawl fight which I was involved in with my Guild.After reclaiming my total staked SPS,now stands at

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)


Moving I went to check the Merits I have the GUILD STORE. Because my GUILD came first in a just concluded brawl fights.I saw a total of **2,152**.Afer adding the **2012** I got from Brawl.

body.title: The Purpose Of Our Existence//Mcgi Topic Review.
body.body:
Bro. Eli's teaching on the purpose of our existence offers a meaningful reminder that life is far more than the pursuit of wealth, success, or personal ambition. He explains that God created every human being with a purpose; to know him, obey his commandments, and live in a way that reflects his love and righteousness. True fulfillment cannot be found in temporary pleasures or material possessions because these things eventually pass away instead, a life centered on God gives lasting peace, direction, and hope. This perspective encourages us to see every blessing, challenge, and opportunity as part of God's plan to shape our character and strengthen our faith. It reminds us that our time on earth is precious and should be used wisely to prepare for the eternal life God has promised to those who remain faithful.

https://youtu.be/--URoQAbHR8?si=uUSIn7B_RZeP6ipk

 Understanding our purpose should influence how we treat others, make decisions, and respond to life's difficulties. Loving our neighbors, showing kindness, being honest, forgiving those who offend us, and remaining humble are not just good qualities; they are practical ways of fulfilling God's purpose for our lives. Bro Eli reminds us that every sincere act of obedience, no matter how small it may seem, is valuable in God's sight. His message challenges believers to move beyond merely professing faith and instead live each day with the desire to honor God through their words and actions. It is a powerful reminder that a life devoted to God's will is a life filled with meaning, purpose, and eternal value.

**Thanks for your support**

body.title: The blessing you should remember about forgiveness! | Cómo sufrir cambia tu modo de enfrentar pruebas!
body.body:
La vida cristiana no es una carrera de velocidad, es una carrera de resistencia. No se trata de cuán rápido llegás, sino de cuán firme te mantenés en medio de la tormenta.

Pablo dijo: todo lo puedo en Cristo que me fortalece. Y no hablaba de tener una vida perfecta, sino de atravesar cualquier circunstancia con la certeza de que Dios está con él.

Pero allí es donde debemos recordar esta verdad: la luz de Cristo no compite con la oscuridad, la vence. La oscuridad no puede frenar la luz de Cristo, ni mucho menos apagarla.
  
> El SEñOR será rey sobre toda la tierra. En aquel día el SEñOR será el único Dios y su nombre será el único nombre.

Zechariah 14:9 (Zacarías 14:9)

## Dios te bendiga hoy y siempre!!!

<center>![](https://images.pexels.com/photos/110854/pexels-photo-110854.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)</center>

*Image: [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/) | Word: [Bible Gateway](https://www.biblegateway.com/)*

Today I want to leave you with this truth: God is never late, He never fails, He never makes mistakes. His timing is perfect and His love is endless. Trust Him.

Don't give up. Not now. God is working in the shadows, moving pieces you can't see. But soon you'll see His hand move in a way that will surprise you.

God isn't looking for perfect people, He's looking for willing hearts. People who say: Lord, I don't know how, but I trust You.
  
> The LORD will be king over the whole earth. On that day there will be one LORD, and his name the only name.

Zechariah 14:9 (Zacarías 14:9)

## God bless you today and always!!!

body.title: Chapter V: Consensus Was Never Just a Theory
body.body:
## ***Bitcoin Already Proved It Could Change Without Losing Its Soul***

By **@yordan96**

At the end of **Chapter IV**, I left one important question.

***Could the global Bitcoin community really coordinate such a historic upgrade?***

Some people might think that's just a theoretical discussion.

A \

scenario.

But the truth is...

**Bitcoin has already answered that question.**

Not once.

But multiple times.

***The proof isn't hidden in theory. It's written in Bitcoin's own history.***

---

## **The First Major Test: SegWit**

In **2017**, Bitcoin faced one of the biggest debates in its history.

The network was becoming congested.

Transaction fees were rising.

Scalability had become a serious concern.

Different groups proposed different solutions.

Developers disagreed.

Miners disagreed.

Businesses disagreed.

The community was divided.

For a moment...

It looked as if Bitcoin itself might split apart.

Then came **Segregated Witness**, better known as **SegWit**.

SegWit wasn't just another software update.

It fundamentally changed how transaction data was stored, improving scalability while fixing transaction malleability—an issue that had limited future innovation.

More importantly...

It proved something far greater.

**A decentralized network could coordinate a complex upgrade without a central authority giving orders.**

No CEO.

No government.

No headquarters.

Only consensus.

***That moment became one of the strongest demonstrations that decentralization could actually work—not just as an idea, but in practice.***

---

## **Another Milestone: Taproot**

Four years later...

Bitcoin faced another opportunity to evolve.

In **2021**, the network activated **Taproot**.

Unlike SegWit, Taproot wasn't driven by an emergency.

It was driven by progress.

The upgrade improved privacy.

It made complex transactions more efficient.

It expanded Bitcoin's scripting capabilities.

And once again...

Thousands of independent participants around the world agreed to move forward together.

That achievement is often overlooked.

People celebrate the technology.

I admire the coordination behind it.

Because technology alone cannot upgrade itself.

**People do.**

---

## **The Bigger Lesson**

When critics ask...

***Can Bitcoin survive if SHA-256 ever becomes obsolete?***

History quietly answers:

**Bitcoin has already shown that it can evolve when evolution becomes necessary.**

Not because change is easy.

But because consensus is possible.

That doesn't mean every future upgrade will be simple.

Far from it.

It will require discussion.

Debate.

Patience.

And cooperation on a global scale.

But that's exactly what Bitcoin has demonstrated before.

The network doesn't fear change.

It studies it.

It debates it.

Then...

When enough people agree...

It moves forward together.

---

## **My Perspective**

People often think Bitcoin's greatest innovation is blockchain technology.

I think it's something even more remarkable.

It's the ability of millions of strangers to protect a shared system without relying on a single ruler.

That isn't just engineering.

That's coordination at a global scale.

---

## **Yordan96 Thought**

> *Code secures today's Bitcoin.*

> ***Consensus secures tomorrow's Bitcoin.***

> *SegWit proved it.*

> *Taproot proved it again.*

> ***Perhaps the greatest security Bitcoin has ever built...***

> ***...was never written in code.***

--- 

This single illustration summarizes what history has already proven: Bitcoin evolves through consensus—not through a single algorithm.https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcF6wd58BG7tKX9dzU9cqesb4mgTkeqW7iWDfWuFM968M/1000744984.png 

---

**To be continued...**

*In the final chapter, we'll explore why Bitcoin may outlive any algorithm—and why Satoshi Nakamoto's greatest invention was never SHA-256, but a system capable of evolving through consensus.*

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@yordan96/chapter-v-consensus-was-never-just-a-theory-7rn)

body.title: A Brief Return Of Sunshine || SMASh Contest #432
body.body:
For the past few weeks, we've been experiencing rainy days all through in this part of the world where I reside, and frankly, I’m quite surprised that the weather is back on cue because last year's was very unpredictable. At different points, we waited for the rainy season to show up, but our environment retained its dryness. Other times, we looked forward to welcoming the brief harmattan season, but it kept being windy. So I’m glad that we’re finally experiencing the weather seasons as it should be again.

Like I mentioned earlier, the previous week was filled with so much rain, and even though I enjoy the gloomy weather when I’m not stepping out for any reason at all, I did want a bit of sunshine. I mean, we humans are never satisfied, are we? Thankfully, the sun smiled on me this evening, and I think I was one of the happiest because I got to take some shadow photos.

I visited my friend in her student apartment, and while we were together in the room, my eyes searched for some shadows. Unfortunately, there was none in sight. I had already given up when I stood to take my leave, and just at the front of the door, I saw some wonderful shadows lying on the floor and the walls of the exterior part of the building.

<div class=\

/> These shadows felt very original, raw, and just interesting to look at because I kept going over the photos on my mobile device until I got home. I think I love how they turned out and I hope you do too. Have a lovely rest of your week, friends. 🥰

![1m0a3347-56dcf5fe312f.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/mortezayousefi/lkt-mr18k7mu-aztbeb70/1m0a3347-56dcf5fe312f.webp)

![1m0a3351-559bcdb378d1.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/mortezayousefi/lkt-mr18k7mu-aztbeb70/1m0a3351-559bcdb378d1.webp)

Walking through Bali's famous rice fields is like a journey into another world. 

Their beauty is world-renowned, and countless tourists come daily to catch a glimpse of this lush green landscape. 

While the tourists are eager to take pictures, the locals work tirelessly. 

They are incredibly friendly and patient. Although they are surrounded by so many strangers, they show no signs of irritation or fatigue. 

They are always smiling, and some even pose for photos. 

The man I met was one of them was just as he finished with the souvenir photos with the tourists, he hoisted a large basket on his shoulders and continued into the rice fields. 

The interplay of his movements and the light falling through the fields. I was much more touched by a simple but sincere insight into everyday life in Bali that I will never forget I am so glad I could share this story with you 

Think about it: aren't the best photos often the accidental snapshots you stumble across instead of planned ones? 
I look forward to your thoughts on this

I love you all ❤ ️ Morteza Youssef

> Hello, my friends at #Hive. A special greeting to the #aliveandthriving community. I want to share with you an update on my progress toward my #hive goals in the third month of the year: my progress in publishing, Power Up, and becoming a network dolphin. In addition to what I am adding up during this year. Thank you very much for the tokens to the #aliveandthriving community, they help me in the progress of some goals. ---
![](https://steemitimages.com/786x432/https://images.ecency.com/DQmNsi9Zf1pvUUoQeGTXCpxbysanHABWEpaT2CisdgjvStU/hive_focus_2026_freed99.png)
In the #hivefocus I set my goal of publications. This is my 179th post of the year; unfortunately, I missed a day. But I’ll keep going—with this post included, I’m now at 180/365. I’m going to work on getting all 184 posts for this new semester done without fail. 😁
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma5HFcBergwr3yMZGMDHpWrxMQZiULn7ZGxGfpjoo5Yaz/image.png)
---- My power-up and get to the dolphin level. I am participating in PowerUpDay and PowerUpMonth; the goal is to complete all of them this year. I continue with my streak completing a Power Up every day and I send some posts 100% to HP as an additional boost. I've completed the June daily power-up, and I've already set aside the amount of Hive I'll be using to participate in Power-up Day.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP9Qzfp6z4i5mbgvmjrGPbjZDTByF2xQMeaWDFK39TVmA/image.png)
By doing these Power Ups, added to the rewards of publications and healing, I am heading towards my basic goal of being a dolphin. The graphs of [HiveStats](https://hivestats.io/@freed99 ) they show the progress of my account in the last 30 days.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdvyCzkmy17SGgELT6Ghnb6mK54CcMTQGMoehio9Gujue/image.png)
My balance last week was 3,764.46 HP; for this latest report in June, it was 3,822.66 HP—an increase of 58.2 Hive over the week. The following table is my growth record for each month and the individual increase per week for the current month. (It's not what I added up, it's just the total amount at the moment).
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb5aAeRmb5TESVEsTqYWzNpGioRS4M2Py8u1dD3MVcGGJ/image.png)

I have as reference the amount of 6,123 HP. Yes, I take into account the amount of vests for dolphin = 10 million. I'm halfway there.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZAB4sWza94KpkqQY3pvzo6qtrAjs7hpznW8oN39DkjDd/image.png)
---- I complete my first goal at $ALIVE; I'm working towards the next one. My balance this week is 2,211.69 Alive in Stake and I keep increasing the amount of tokens I own on **Tuesday. Let's stake and be ALIVE!**.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmavb8x2SYBMfEbKkguiYycLomNdgBU7HCAPJ2m3NPfwtD/image.png)

One of them was to use the #ecency points to acquire a 90-day delegation. To sustain the delegation for a long period of time, I set myself to reach the goal of 17,000 points by the time the delegation ends. I started this new delegation quarter with a surplus of 4,575.68 points. By participating in various contests, I’ve earned points that have been adding up; in addition, my activity on the platform (delegation, comments, posts, etc.) allows me to earn more points that I claim at the end of the month. My current delegation is 1,800 Hive a #ecency. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZtwTr37sAeAxqJpXhaS7Eo23xtuXUeyoTZu5rHmzvJ4Q/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR8hVtbyKL1pbPpyhfQxJTbrG1jmDqLS8M4fKm8YrTm4v/image.png) The following table will only take into account the points in my balance; I will not take into account the balance I claim at the end of the month. | Points | July 1 | July 2 | July 3 | July 4 | | ---|--- | --- | --- | --- | | 4,575.68 | - | - | - | - | The points I am missing for the goal (not counting the unclaimed ones). |Puntos | Goal Diff. (17,000) | |------------|---------| | 4,575.68 |12,424.32 | I haven't requested the delegation yet, but I know that, as I've mentioned, I can easily reach the point goal; I know that by using the delegation I've set up, my activity, and the contests, I can reach the goal on #ecency. My deadline for reaching it is September 30, 2026. ---- This is my latest update for the month of June. My plans for reaching my main goal have been changing over the past few months, and I know they’ll continue to change in the coming months as well to help me achieve it. For now, my basic strategy is to increase my Hive by 3 daily and by 50 on Power Up Day. I’ll stick with this for the next two or three months; based on my analysis of what I still need, I’ll make the necessary adjustments. I hope you’ll continue to join me on this journey, and thank you for everything. I wish you all the best in achieving your goals this new semester. ---- ----

Quiero compartirles la actualización de mi progreso en mis metas de #hive en el tercer mes del año: mi avance en publicaciones, Power Up y ser un delfín de la red. Además de lo que estoy sumando durante este año. Muchas gracias por los tokens a la comunidad de #aliveandthriving; me ayudan en el progreso de algunas metas. ---

body.title: Twisted.(Fiction).
body.body:
I really love the topic, and I think I will write a story about it, because it involves Life.
‎
‎It's story time;
‎
‎***The price of winning is always high; that's why it's called winning. You have to fight for it, work for it and maybe cry for it. Life never feels easy; we grow stronger every day by day***.
‎
![tarikul-raana-Gx9W1e6WwjI-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/favour20045/23w2ktxgS7E2sC3arzmHGCEhvMEjfo6Pkg78tgLJ56NydFfYDqqWBjW64yQYZNoHXJT5S.jpg)[img sur](https://unsplash.com/photos/young-boy-looking-down-at-his-hands-Gx9W1e6WwjI)

‎Once upon a time, there lived a family who were mocked because they had nothing because they were not money-educated, so they missed a lot of money opportunities and a lot of money. That didn't hurt them alone, but also gave concerns to the Little Richy, (Richard), his name is Richard, but they called him Richy.
‎Now, Richy is the youngest in the family, he's 15 years old, not yet through with his school.
‎
‎He had to drop out because of his family's financial status; it was a really heartbreaking moment for him because he wanted to be a doctor, but life had planned something else for him.
‎Sometimes, he hears how people talk about his family and becomes dissatisfied with everything going on.
‎One of his friends told him to get a laptop, and he would show him how to work for others and get paid.
‎He saved up some money and bought a laptop and some other tools he needed.
‎
‎After that, his friend brought him to an office, where there were lots of people working. And he introduced him to the manager of the company. Now, the main problem wasn't working for the company; the main problem was that the company participated in fraud, and that is what the company was all about.
‎
‎Ricky wanted to be rich and change his family status, and at the same time, he didn't want to participate in something illegal. But the pay was very high, he thought about it for some days and accepted the job.
‎In his first week of work, he began to spend thousands of dollars and made his family live better.
‎
![roman-bilik-pQ-wvNpLHhs-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/favour20045/23x1FkSKVpbgQNKszV5F7oib6nFQccMd8WBTjmPLXEQDAQSiCUt1vALwnvCoAX1jsHpuX.jpg)[img sur](https://unsplash.com/photos/boy-with-black-framed-eyeglasses-holding-face-pQ-wvNpLHhs)

‎One day, Richy was doing his stuff at work, then he accidentally showed his face to someone they are about to scam, but he never explained this to his boss or anyone. And eventually, they scammed the person out of millions of dollars. Richy felt guilty and wanted to run away in a few weeks.
‎
‎But it was too late for him because he was tracked and captured by the police. They asked him about the money he stole, and he directed them to the company where he works. He lost all his assets, and his family returned to a worse state. He was sentenced to 15 years in prison, and the company was closed for good.
‎
*‎He had a right zeal, but actually channeled it in a bad direction*. 
‎
‎Thank you for reading.

body.title: Coinbase Bitcoin Mortgage Loans/ Préstamos hipotecarios de Coinbase respaldados por Bitcoin
body.body:
### Coinbase Bitcoin Mortgage Loans

I just read an article by @lalai and it was regarding bitcoin backed mortgage loans. 
I was excited and read the short article right away. But it was different situation then I expected. 
The bitcoin backed loan is for the downpayment. 
The buyer still needs a conventional or regular mortgage for the balance of the mortgage. 
This was disappointing, but one must always see a silver lining as Americans say, or the good side of the situation. 

And when I read the rest of the article I found the silver lining. 
The bitcoin loan for the downpayment has no margin requirement or margin call risk! 
Wow! 
That is wonderful. 
So that is an improvement for bitcoiners. 
So I am announcing the good news!

#### These are the exact details from the Coinbase website:

>The first Bitcoin-backed mortgage loans in the U.S. are now a reality thanks to a partnership between Coinbase and Better Home & Finance. This program allows you to use Bitcoin (BTC) or USDC as collateral to fund your home's down payment without having to sell your assets or trigger capital gains taxes. Key benefits of the program include: No liquidation due to market drops (if the Bitcoin price falls, mortgage terms remain unchanged and there are no margin calls); no need to sell (you retain ownership and the long-term appreciation potential of your Bitcoin); USDC benefits (if using USDC as collateral, it can continue generating rewards that help offset mortgage payments, effectively lowering the net interest rate); advantages for Coinbase members (Coinbase One members may be eligible for up to $10,000 in closing cost credits covered by Better Mortgage); and competitive rates (while rates tend to be 0.5% to 1.5% higher than traditional loans, Fannie Mae backing makes them more cost-effective than other private crypto-credit products). Note: Liquidation occurs if you are 60 days delinquent on payments. To learn more about the specific requirements for this new loan option, you can visit the official Better Mortgage website.

#
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWLyEoyEBUPFSTPbi3JTNkHA3eSjWtcb6uJ62RwwHa5tb/Screenshot%202026-06-30%20at%2012.27.02%E2%80%AFPM.png 



## Préstamos hipotecarios de Coinbase respaldados por Bitcoin


Acabo de leer un artículo de @lalai sobre préstamos hipotecarios respaldados por bitcoin. 
Me entusiasmé y leí el breve artículo de inmediato, pero la situación era distinta a lo que esperaba. 
El préstamo respaldado por bitcoin es para cubrir el pago inicial; el comprador sigue necesitando una hipoteca convencional o estándar para el resto del importe. 
Fue algo decepcionante, pero siempre hay que buscar el lado positivo —como dicen los estadounidenses— o ver la parte buena de la situación. 

Y, al leer el resto del artículo, encontré ese lado positivo: ¡el préstamo en bitcoin para el pago inicial no conlleva requisitos de margen ni riesgo de llamadas de margen! ¡Guau! Es maravilloso. 
Sin duda, supone una mejora para los entusiastas del bitcoin.

¡Así que aquí comparto la buena noticia!

#

## Estos son los exactos deLos primeros préstamos hipotecarios respaldados por Bitcoin en EE.UU.

> Los primeros préstamos hipotecarios respaldados por Bitcoin en EE. UU. son una realidad gracias a la asociación entre Coinbase y Better Home & Finance. Este programa le permite utilizar Bitcoin (BTC) o USDC como garantía para financiar el pago inicial de su casa (down payment), sin tener que vender sus activos ni generar impuestos por ganancias de capital.¿Cómo funcionan estos préstamos hipotecarios?El programa consta de dos partes estructurales:La hipoteca principal: Recibe un préstamo hipotecario tradicional totalmente estándar respaldado por Fannie Mae (conforme a los requisitos habituales del mercado).Préstamo para el pago inicial: Se le otorga un segundo préstamo para cubrir el pago inicial de la casa, el cual está garantizado por sus criptoactivos en Coinbase.Beneficios clave del programaSin liquidaciones por caídas de mercado: Si el precio de Bitcoin cae, los términos de la hipoteca se mantienen inalterados y no existen llamadas de margen (margin calls).No requiere vender: Conserva la propiedad y el potencial de revalorización a largo plazo de su Bitcoin.Beneficios de USDC: Si utiliza USDC como garantía, estos pueden seguir generando recompensas que ayudan a compensar sus pagos hipotecarios, reduciendo efectivamente la tasa de interés neta.Ventajas para miembros de Coinbase: Si es miembro de Coinbase One, puede ser elegible para obtener hasta $10,000 en créditos para los costos de cierre cubiertos por Better Mortgage.Tasas competitivas: Aunque las tasas de la hipoteca tienden a ser entre un 0.5% y un 1.5% más altas que los préstamos tradicionales, contar con el respaldo de Fannie Mae le permite ser más económico que otros productos de crédito cripto privado.Riesgo a considerarSu garantía cripto transferida al monedero de custodia de Better solo estaría en riesgo de liquidación si usted presenta una morosidad de pago de 60 días.Para conocer más sobre los requisitos exactos de esta nueva modalidad de préstamo, puede consultar la página oficial de Better Mortgage.

> ☁️ **Materials:** Crochet thread in light blue and white. Size 2 hook. Scissors. ☁️ **Stitches used:** Standard double crochet stitches. Single crochet stitches. Treble crochet stitches. >☁️ **Materiales:** >Hilos de crochet en colores, celeste y blanco. Aguja numero 2. Tijeras. >☁️ **Puntos utilizados:** Puntos altos normales. Puntos bajos. Puntos altos doble lazada.

![1001133931.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maricrochets/1001133931.jpg)

> >☁️ **Elaboracion:** >Comenzamos con el hilo color celeste: >1. Hacemos un anillo magico y dentro de este 24 puntos altos normales. >2. abanicos de 12 puntos altos normales, saltar dos espacios, 1 punto bajo, saltamos 2 espacios y elaboramos el otro abanico, hasta obtener 4 grupos. >3. Cambiamos al color blanco, sobre cada punto bajo elaboramos un abanico de 7 puntos altos separados por 1 cadena, un punto bajo en el centro del abanico anterior, igual elaboramos 4 grupos, osea 4 lados. >4. De nuevo colocamos el color celeste y hacemos una fila de punto sobre punto altos normales inclusive en las cadenas, y en las esquinas abanicos 4 puntos separados por 2 cadenas. >5. body.title: I’m so over this weather…
body.body: Afternoon everyone…. Today feels like I’m down south. The humidity is getting worse and worse by the day. Tomorrow’s high is supposed to be one hundred and two. With the humidity I don’t even want to think about it. On a different note. This is a silver bar that I picked up at Archangel coins while in Vegas with the gang at our final meet up. I’m not a huge silver bar guy, I actually prefer rounds over bars. I think it’s a coin collector thing. This bar grabbed me right off the bat because of the ship on it. It’s a “Christopher Columbus Discovers America” bar. I don’t know what mint produced it, but I’m doing what little research I could. I found one currently listed on eBay. I wax quite shocked at the asking price, considering that I paid $28 for it back then. Spot was just over $25 an ounce at that time. I checked four different auction sites. None had current or sold listing for this bar in the last six months. **_Here is the bar…._**
/> It’s a cool looking bar. Here is the eBay listing that I found.

/>

I know we’ve all been taught in school that Columbus discovered America but that’s bullshit evidently.

Explorer Christopher Columbus (1451–1506) is known for his 1492 ‘discovery’ of the 'new world' of the Americas on board his ship Santa Maria.  
In actual fact, Columbus did not discover North America. He was the first European to sight the Bahamas archipelago and then the island later named Hispaniola, now split into Haiti and the Dominican Republic. On his subsequent voyages he went farther south, to Central and South America. He never got close to what is now called the United States.

I wasn’t alive so I’ll have to trust the experts.

body.title: 99 Good, One Bad
body.body:
You know that thing where they say that most people never remember all the good you've done for them, just because you did one wrong? Well, something like that happened today, not to me, but to a friend of mine.

To be honest, I might be exaggerating the whole issue a bit, but just listen to the story.

A friend of mine who came to visit today was telling the story of the last time he visited his barber. This was the same barber that always cut my hair and that I had introduced him to for close to a year now.

Well apparently, the last time he visited her shop, she had gotten so carried away with the conversation she was having with other people that she had messed up his hair. According to him, he said it was so bad that he had to wear a hat every day to work for weeks, and when he finally grew out some hair, he quickly asked his colleague for a different barber and had changed his barber.

In as much as his reason was valid, I couldn't help but feel like maybe one mistake shouldn't have been enough reason for him to cut her off. I get it that it's his hair and his money and he can do whatever he wants, but if we were to give it some thought, this is a lady that has been cutting his hair for over a year with no mistake, and yet the first time she makes one, he decides to leave her for a new barber.

Of course it's not a big deal; people change barbers all the time, but I just couldn't help but think about the phrase 99 good and one bad, which basically tells us about how people ignore all the good we've done for them the moment we do one bad thing.

body.title: Préstamos hipotecarios de Coinbase respaldados por Bitcoin/   Coinbase Bitcoin Mortgage Loans
body.body:
## Préstamos hipotecarios de Coinbase respaldados por Bitcoin


Acabo de leer un artículo de @lalai sobre préstamos hipotecarios respaldados por bitcoin. 
Me entusiasmé y leí el breve artículo de inmediato, pero la situación era distinta a lo que esperaba. 
El préstamo respaldado por bitcoin es para cubrir el pago inicial; el comprador sigue necesitando una hipoteca convencional o estándar para el resto del importe. 
Fue algo decepcionante, pero siempre hay que buscar el lado positivo —como dicen los estadounidenses— o ver la parte buena de la situación. 

Y, al leer el resto del artículo, encontré ese lado positivo: ¡el préstamo en bitcoin para el pago inicial no conlleva requisitos de margen ni riesgo de llamadas de margen! ¡Guau! Es maravilloso. 
Sin duda, supone una mejora para los entusiastas del bitcoin.

¡Así que aquí comparto la buena noticia!

#
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWLyEoyEBUPFSTPbi3JTNkHA3eSjWtcb6uJ62RwwHa5tb/Screenshot%202026-06-30%20at%2012.27.02%E2%80%AFPM.png 


## Estos son los exactos deLos primeros préstamos hipotecarios respaldados por Bitcoin en EE.UU.

> Los primeros préstamos hipotecarios respaldados por Bitcoin en EE. UU. son una realidad gracias a la asociación entre Coinbase y Better Home & Finance. Este programa le permite utilizar Bitcoin (BTC) o USDC como garantía para financiar el pago inicial de su casa (down payment), sin tener que vender sus activos ni generar impuestos por ganancias de capital.¿Cómo funcionan estos préstamos hipotecarios?El programa consta de dos partes estructurales:La hipoteca principal: Recibe un préstamo hipotecario tradicional totalmente estándar respaldado por Fannie Mae (conforme a los requisitos habituales del mercado).Préstamo para el pago inicial: Se le otorga un segundo préstamo para cubrir el pago inicial de la casa, el cual está garantizado por sus criptoactivos en Coinbase.Beneficios clave del programaSin liquidaciones por caídas de mercado: Si el precio de Bitcoin cae, los términos de la hipoteca se mantienen inalterados y no existen llamadas de margen (margin calls).No requiere vender: Conserva la propiedad y el potencial de revalorización a largo plazo de su Bitcoin.Beneficios de USDC: Si utiliza USDC como garantía, estos pueden seguir generando recompensas que ayudan a compensar sus pagos hipotecarios, reduciendo efectivamente la tasa de interés neta.Ventajas para miembros de Coinbase: Si es miembro de Coinbase One, puede ser elegible para obtener hasta $10,000 en créditos para los costos de cierre cubiertos por Better Mortgage.Tasas competitivas: Aunque las tasas de la hipoteca tienden a ser entre un 0.5% y un 1.5% más altas que los préstamos tradicionales, contar con el respaldo de Fannie Mae le permite ser más económico que otros productos de crédito cripto privado.Riesgo a considerarSu garantía cripto transferida al monedero de custodia de Better solo estaría en riesgo de liquidación si usted presenta una morosidad de pago de 60 días.Para conocer más sobre los requisitos exactos de esta nueva modalidad de préstamo, puede consultar la página oficial de Better Mortgage.


 
## Inglés

### Coinbase Bitcoin Mortgage Loans



I just read an article by @lalai and it was regarding bitcoin backed mortgage loans. 
I was excited and read the short article right away. But it was different situation then I expected. 
The bitcoin backed loan is for the downpayment. 
The buyer still needs a conventional or regular mortgage for the balance of the mortgage. 
This was disappointing, but one must always see a silver lining as Americans say, or the good side of the situation. 

And when I read the rest of the article I found the silver lining. 
The bitcoin loan for the downpayment has no margin requirement or margin call risk! 
Wow! 
That is wonderful. 
So that is an improvement for bitcoiners. 
So I am announcing the good news!

#### These are the exact details from the Coinbase website:

>The first Bitcoin-backed mortgage loans in the U.S. are now a reality thanks to a partnership between Coinbase and Better Home & Finance. This program allows you to use Bitcoin (BTC) or USDC as collateral to fund your home's down payment without having to sell your assets or trigger capital gains taxes. Key benefits of the program include: No liquidation due to market drops (if the Bitcoin price falls, mortgage terms remain unchanged and there are no margin calls); no need to sell (you retain ownership and the long-term appreciation potential of your Bitcoin); USDC benefits (if using USDC as collateral, it can continue generating rewards that help offset mortgage payments, effectively lowering the net interest rate); advantages for Coinbase members (Coinbase One members may be eligible for up to $10,000 in closing cost credits covered by Better Mortgage); and competitive rates (while rates tend to be 0.5% to 1.5% higher than traditional loans, Fannie Mae backing makes them more cost-effective than other private crypto-credit products). Note: Liquidation occurs if you are 60 days delinquent on payments. To learn more about the specific requirements for this new loan option, you can visit the official Better Mortgage website.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@smallbites/prstamos-hipotecarios-de-coinbase-respaldados-por-bitcoin-coinbase-bitcoin-mortgage-loans-lnd)

body.title: The architecture of yesterday
body.body:
<center>
I found an old hour sleeping in the cabinet
Tucked beneath the once  cherish frame
A fragment of a smile we wore
Before the passig of time redefined the line


We used to be a family of one
Where the day seem short and we long to see the night break
The tickling of clock was our only fear
Afraid it may steal the peace before its sunrise


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV1WuKCV2ZBpDGMYNJijAo6XRA8x2BQ3pFGpyQfLtTGoQ/1782858214994.png)


**Image gnerated using Gemini AI**

We wished the season wouldn't pass
But time is quiet when it robs a room
It doesn't smash a glass or breaks the door
It simply trades the color and leave a dust we haven't seen before

Yet in the quiet space of a mind
The room still holds memories of the past
We keep the rusted years behind
But holds the blueprint of the joy and pain</center>

body.title: Stepping Out of My Comfort Zone Turned Into the Best Part of My Day
body.body:
![IMG_20260630_123826.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRtdohisgMHZgWQJpvrosvfT86htP882hY6EGQUeUgEM5/IMG_20260630_123826.jpg)

Hello everyone. Trust today has been beautiful and favorable for you. I hope the weather in your area has been pleasant and everything is working out just as you expected. As for me today was really enjoyable. The weather was exactly the way I like it. It wasn't raining and the sun wasn't harsh. Everything felt balanced. It wasn't cold and it wasn't hot which made the day perfect for moving around.

I woke up very early in the morning. After taking my bath and getting dressed I decided to go shopping. There were a few things I needed to buy but one item was at the top of my list. I bought a chocolate cake because lately I've realized that I'm becoming more and more attracted to chocolate cakes. Getting one today wasn't just part of my shopping. It was also a way to satisfy that craving.

After buying everything I needed I left the shopping mall and headed to a company where I wanted to submit an application. Thankfully I met some kind people there and the experience was a pleasant one. From there I continued to another location to take care of a few other things.

One of the highlights of my day was simply walking through the busy streets. I enjoyed using the pedestrian walkway while observing everything happening around me. I also visited a fashion shop and a skincare business center. Every place I visited gave me the opportunity to understand more about how things work in those environments.

One thing I truly enjoyed today was leaving the comfort of my home to explore somewhere different. I almost decided to remain at home and sleep but I'm glad I chose to step outside instead. Looking back now I believe I made the right decision because I learned something valuable from today's experience.

I discovered that it's a wonderful habit to take yourself out once in a while even if you don't have anyone to accompany you. Going out alone gives you the opportunity to meet different people and sometimes you come across individuals who inspire you in unexpected ways.

That was exactly what happened to me today. I met someone whose words left a positive impression on me. Although we haven't exchanged contacts yet I believe some things are better when they happen naturally. Time will tell what comes next and for now I'm simply grateful for the experience.

Thank you so much for stopping by to read my post. I truly appreciate your time and I hope to see you again in my next publication.

Bye for now.

body.body:
Currently,  my favorite mode of transport is relative. It depends on the situation, mood, and finances at that moment. I'm yet to experience air travel. 

When I was pregnant, I enjoyed motorcycles and tricycles. It sounds weird, but the breeze and air made it relaxing and calming for me.

Now, I prefer the bus. It’s affordable, and I love that it allows interaction with other commuters. I can easily see the road, buy things of interest along the way, and just experience the journey especially the different boundary reception that reads \

. 

One memorable travel experience was my NYSC 2018 journey to Kaduna. 

I was hoping to be posted to the south east.
When I saw the call up letter, it was Kaduna. 
I was sad because it was miles away from my state.  
We boarded the second bus unknown to us, our driver had not been to the north before. 
We only found out when he missed his way thrice. 

And we ended up somewhere else. He spent a lot of money on fuel. By this time, it was getting dark. 

We had to use our phone GPS to find our way back. Our situation was already like the blind leading the blind, so we became fully dependent on the GPS guidance.  

We were lucky that the bus was in a good condition. We closed the windows and put on the air conditioning set.

 Hunger and thirst was lost to fear, panic and anxiety. The driver stopped by a fuel station to refill and bought us some fruits to appreciate and apologize as well. 

We continued the journey because there was no where to rest. We held unto each other singing and praying for safety. Our parents called almost hourly to know the situation.

That was the longest travel I have had by bus yet. We finally arrived at almost dawn of the next day.

 The soldiers checked us in and allocated mattresses for the hostel. My bunk number was 92, in Friendship Hostel.  We ate some food. While we laid on the bed, our backs and waists ached from pain after  more than 24 hours on the road. But that bunk still felt like victory and comfort.

The next morning, we were served bread, tea and a boiled egg. After which we started proper documentation. I enjoyed their indigenous meal \

.
I still look forward to having it any day 🙂.

Whenever I take a walk down the memory lane, I'm 💯 percent always grateful to God for his protection. 

*That trip taught me that bus travel can make strangers become family. It is more of survival, adaptation and journey.*

body.title: Improving Hive: building better tools, in the open
body.body:
Hive works because people kept building on it, through bull markets, bear markets, and the quiet years. FreeBeings.io is here to keep doing that, deliberately. This is a standing project to research and build what makes Hive better: for the people who use it, and the developers who build on it.

![improving-hive-cover](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvpJ7h9knUfYQFTs4FTU6VUPUnudA3MHQdkykUeoYvVj/improving-hive-cover-art-preview.png)

We have history on Hive. FreeBeings.io founder (@imwatsi) built HAF Plug & Play, the Global Notification System, Hive DEX, and early work on Hive Attention Tokens here years ago. After a quieter stretch, we're back to building, and this project is part of that. Our Hive tools are open source on [GitHub](https://github.com/FreeBeings-io).

Here's how this project works: in the discussion room, you tell us your ideas, what's broken or missing and we bring ideas of our own. We prioritize together, in polls, what gets built next. Then we build it in the open and post the progress here. Surface, prioritize, build, repeat.

So, what would make Hive better for you?

Join the discussion, at [dao.freebeings.io](https://dao.freebeings.io).

*Live and let live, freely.*

Aber in dem Fall zwingt einen ja keiner das Gespräch noch länger weiterzuführen.
Die Gewinnchancen durch Offenheit übersteigen in galaktischem Maßstab jegliches denkbares Risiko.

body.title: July 1st Challenge Starts Now!!!
body.body:
Hello, dear growers and garden lovers!  

### Here's your Official Reminder about this special time of the month..

Each month on the 1st, we invite YOU to share YOUR gardens - no matter if you're only in the planning & dreaming stage or whether you're harvesting a bounty. 

You can even post a community garden or your grandmother's balcony flowers - we love seeing it all! Cactus, eggplant, mushroom farming, compost, landscape design, irrigation - it's all welcome. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gardenhive/Eokf56PhpmGiLuJij5235vSGZAm4WqsrwP6LuA5pAv2noEydngg6tMWKVoUhEJ5zpaL.png)

Whilst we can't offer prizes, sometimes we share a tip and nearly always upvote and reblog your posts. Many find that they get good engagement from other gardeners for their #gardenjournal posts too - the best reward! 

If anyone wants to lend a hand doing a monthly curation wrap up post, please feel free. @riverflows would be grateful for the help! 

*We do have to be a little tough though - remember, we want to keep this community a worthwhile place to be. No AI slop please - and we ask you to post in English first, and then you're welcome to write in your main language second. This isn't because we don't love global gardeners, it's just that curators find it easier to read if it's just in one language, plus it can be confusing for outsiders to see a multilingual post! Also, please don't post ten photos of the one plant - it's so tedious to scroll through so many similiar photos!* 

I'm sorry we've stopped the weekly challenges for now. I'm stretched a little thin and was finding it hard to find time, especially when there was only one or two responses each week. As usual, unless these things are taken up by the community with great enthusiasm, it's hard to find a reason to keep them going. I would be super happy for help though so let me know if this is something you'd like to do in the community.

body.title: Ignored trust.😖 Misplaced trust
body.body:
You and I are different. I had my dad for about five years. After that, I had people who would tell me what he used to say and that it was wise saying.

 Some examples are...
* it's not a mistake if you learned something.
* chalk it up to education.
* start all the bolts before tightening any.
* you might not have time to do it right.
* but you always have time to do it again.

I treasure every little bit I know about my father because I don't know that much about him.

You, on the other hand, had to deal with only seeing your dad on the weekends. I always gave you guys priority and rarely scheduled any meetings or even lunches with anyone while you guys were in my care.  I wanted to give you all the time I had on the weekends.

I opened your little skulls and poured in as much of my experience as I could. Both good and bad, successes and mistakes.  

I told you how I would go out in the middle of the night because my mother was working full-time night shift and I could. 

I told you how I pulled on the door handles of many of the cars in the neighborhood and a lot of them had the keys in the ignition.  I was 12 and I was already doing oil changes on my mother's car, so I knew how they worked and what all the controls did. For that reason, I should be able to drive them.

All that is the logic of a 12 year old who just happened to know how to take apart cars and put them back together.  You chose to copy that one. And because you told me about it before I found out about it, there was no punishment. That was our deal! 

You weren't 12 years old, but you were of age to drive. You were missing my permission.

Another way that we are different is that when I was a kid, I did not have anyone to show me how to do things. So I looked for people who knew how to do things and I asked a lot of questions.

You had me to ask and whenever we did a project, I would always tell you the best way to do it because I had already done the job 16 other ways that didn't work or didn't work well. 

Still, I don't know how you did it, but you would find one of those other 16 ways that you wanted to try.  At times I would talk you out of it and have you do it my way. But as you got bigger you didn't want to listen.  I let you do the job using your 'new' method, which was really an old iffy one.

Then, after we went out to get another new innertube, or whatever the part was that broke, I would explain to you that I had already made that mistake 30 years ago. You would say, \

The way that you push back when we have these difficulties has gotten more aggressive over the last few years. It is as if your main goal is to exercise your right to learn the hard way. It is as if you don't believe that I messed up 16 times before finding the best way. Or maybe you don't believe me when I tell you my way is the best way. The truth is, I either learned it from someone who gave me a tip or I learned it the costly way by injuring myself or buying lots of parts that didn't need to be bought.

The school of hard knocks does fit one of my dad's sayings. Where as long as you learn something it's okay. But it can also be costly.

There is no benefit to you if you choose to repeat all my mistakes. There is, however, a benefit when your father is an ace mechanic, financial whiz, the hell of a good programmer, a decent musician, cook, etc., and he can give you a leg up.

Trustworthy advice is the one thing you can get from your father. You don't seem to value it.  You used to, but now that you are breaking into your third decade of life, the counter-productive, \

stage of development, I feel less comfortable offering you advice.  Sometimes you even yell at me, and most times you interrupt me in order to say you're not interested.

I really tried to accept the fact that you do not want my input. But I was just doing what the Bible says, which is to treat others as you would have them treat you.  

Every time I tried to help you or give you advice, that is exactly what I would want from my father if I were in your situation.

**I also tried to explain the following when we weren't working on anything**

 I was telling youthe manner in which I would approach a new task. If I'm an expert at that task, then I would just simply do it.  If I had never done that kind of task before, I would see if there is anyone around who has, and I would ask, \

The better you know the person, the more valuable their response will be. Fathers will be among the best sources for advice.  

My children continually pull up a YouTube video and show me the person that they are going to trust for information on hard to do this with that job.  The people on YouTube are only interested in keeping your attention long enough for you to see one of their ads. All of them, if they have their way.

All of that said, I'm not an expert in everything. I don't expect myself to be one, and my self-esteem does not drop even one little bit when I think about that.

**Let's reverse rolls**

I did play some games with my kids. That is the world in whichw they have spent the most hours of their lives. When I would start playing a game, the kids would show me the ropes. They would give me advice and I would immediately take it because they're the ones who are experts in that game.  I knew that listening to them would help me avoid pitfalls, mistakes, and that the learning of it would be much quicker.

If by chance I being more experienced on a certain game than they had, they would choose not to listen to any tricks or tips that I had found. And instead, they would stop playing the game and move to another one.

**Efficiency.**

I used to get paid  \

for jobs I had done on people's cars. If booktime was eight hours and I could get it done in four, that was a big win for me. So I have learned how to be efficient.  

It might have taken me 10 hours the first time I did one of those specific jobs, but as I did more of them, I got better at it. I learned new tips and tricks to save time. I also learned others that would make the quality of my work much better.

I jump at the opportunity to pick someone's brain if they have a lot of experience in something that I'm about to undertake.

If I know nothing about a topic and someone asks me about it, I tell them that they're asking the wrong person.

The above is all I've ever expected of my kids. They could watch me apply all of this in real life. They have seen that I am actually practicing what I preach. 

Lastly, I will still take advice on something that I am an expert in, and I will consider it if it has merit, and I have never tried it before. But I will always weigh their suggestion against my experience.  

<center>
![eeba24fd-f600-4c6d-8941-921c9f1c60a7.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPMW63oYtVaaARoi45j43KSgmwveZTo4F5BqviMgBnP2u/eeba24fd-f600-4c6d-8941-921c9f1c60a7.jpg)
</center>

The hardest thing for me is when you ignore my advice and I see the coming consequence. I even name the consequence as a risk.  When it happens, then you blame me as if I wished it on you.

Mistakes are not the way to get an education. They are not the objective.  You should gather information from the most trustworthy sources that you have around you and then attempt to do a job. If you make a mistake, chalk it up to education.  It's okay. 

When one day you finally read this you're welcome to mark all the places where you would have cut me off and interrupted me to say how you don't agree. I said all of this to you in person while tolerating those interruptions. Now I'm writing all of it without them. 

It's all for your own good.

Love Dad

body.title: Public places, private rights where do we draw the lines
body.body:
![file_000000005e4871f491ea7e0c96433249.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/corneliusoke/23vhyvwWsBeD4ghw5Uxp7up8k7S55vGZtecjW9bYwsZtZ76enyXVpJfsH63mPV9TVsfzZ.png) Hello everyone, welcome to my blog. The reality of our living today based on social media and digitalization has made it a necessity for content creators and filmmakers to shoot videos in public spaces. People tend to make videos, maybe when you're shooting content for products and services or based on tourism or recreation. Either way, people are always trying to make videos for an audience, and some of these video shoots have to take place in public places, which makes capturing other people in the background unavoidable. However, if you must take a video of a person in public and they are going to be the primary subjects of the shoot, then you have to take their permission to use them as the subjects for the shoot depending on the purpose of the shoot. Taking photos or videos in public spaces cannot be banned because it will make it difficult for filmmakers and content creators and even tourists to make content and videos. We see cases of some random video creators just taking advantage of the moment and making dehumanizing videos of people because they want to trend. This is totally unacceptable, and laws need to be put in place for such kinds of videos, and they take them for the purpose of humanizing people in order to gain views and engagement. If I ever found myself in a video as the main subject without my consent, I would report it to the authority in charge of such cases no matter what you were using it for, either promotion or anything, because if you are using it for promotion, it means you are going to make money out of it, and I should be a part of it too. However, there should be punishment for and laws to tackle people who go about recording a person with the intent to harass, stalk, or intimidate them. Using another person's image or likeness to impersonate them or facilitate fraud. Publishing or distributing embarrassing, private, or intimate content without their consent. Using someone's face for commercial purposes, such as advertising or promotions, without their permission. If such a law were made that restricted people from making videos in public, then it would affect the ability of filmmakers, content creators, and even tourists from enjoying memorable moments, so what could be done is to make a law that doesn't stop people from making videos but rather checks how those videos and pictures are being used. In the end it's not about making the video or taking the picture but how those pictures and videos are used and the information they communicate. Thanks for stopping by. The image is AI-generated.
Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@corneliusoke/public-places-private-rights-where-do-we-draw-the-lines-am3)

body.title: Coinbase Bitcoin Mortgage Loans
body.body:
I was looking at an article on bitcoin lending and saw this caption, and I got excited to see Coinbase allowing mortgage loans with bitcoin as the collateral for the loan.
I was surprised to hear of this, but disappointed to find it was only for the downpayment and another loan was needed for the actual home mortgage.
But the good news is that the bitcoin loan doesn't have margin requirements and it has no margin call feature, so that is an improvement for bitcoiners.
I thought about it, and while I give Coinbase credit for making this possible, I see that the loan is now backed by the home and bitcoin, so in away it is double collateralized.
So very little risk for Coinbase that they won't get their money back.
A win for the bitcoiner, a win for Coinbase, win wins are good.

Although this has been progressing steadily on it's own, thanks to the 20.4k+ staked BEE on @aliveandsocial, it wasn't going quite quickly enough, so today I made the decision to speed up the process a bit. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260628_105812159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsDraspY37qCoiKBevsWW2snQW8YmttPtrhUz4twAXm9dQxH6WXARor9ycSNBgV6yCX.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260628_105845481_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsDnhaPmxqSx1w8fVKW5BBmirKrSacJyVXVmSDsdXGJkBcnsQ2MjMtXbosKmM4hsdup.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) There were two chunks of BEE in the BEE:LEO and SWAP.HIVE:BEE pools on @aliveandthriving that I removed this morning, and given that the market price of LEO has continued to fall, so the longer that we held it, the less it would be worth, I swapped the LEO for BEE. I also swapped a chunk of unallocated liquid POB that we had sitting in the wallet for BEE as well. After that, and sending all liquid BEE from other community accounts, we had a new total of 320.972 liquid BEE, which means that we still have just over 179 liquid BEE to go to get to 500 liquid BEE. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260628_105911359_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u61B9LwvzqHXKp1m6DYXBq488Rq1sUgDHFbts4YeA2K3uxGmu8DGRh9N3oxoiDn7vVT.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260628_105942444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsDhvWmHRbw2Nn53RSxiEVMtgZy1tkUFCnpUtwdyo43R6VPTFhXoUbR1Xqfz4fJz3zB.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Given that we accumulate approximately 14 liquid BEE per week across all of our accounts (*not counting Ben's community accounts*), it would still take us almost 13 weeks until we had sufficient BEE to create the pool, which is obviously way too long. With that being the case, I've decided to unstake 200 BEE on @aliveandsocial, that will take almost 6 weeks to fully unstake, and although that still isn't great, it's a heck of a lot better than 13 weeks. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260628_110011059_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u63LrWVbNrHxyWXTpeVSjRaL9iHmsGHzZoTGRdbckmJaABS21ZFhwugPyLpKMokNHBj.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260628_110119422.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wMRvfitX7gsCF7c6mV41UqLA2Na8692vfTrgfiCMkmAN9pWLRMQFerB58UDdormZMj1.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Even though that 200 BEE will take almost 6 weeks to fully unstake, we'll still be gaining a good chunk of liquid BEE every week, so it's likely that it will take a little less time than 6 weeks. If we do get enough liquid BEE before that time, then I'll either stop the unstake part way through, or restake the surplus BEE. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260628_110326248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQjqfX43B57T6sehWev2KzKuiczccxoHyJULXGq8Dk11s1jC5AMpCUJ4aEXwxnkxecU.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260628_110423670_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tmDV7thUsoT9cmER3LbxtHjc7jzaaSp7syaE7A8G7o2ChqygTbgcDS1aveZc8Gir3AE.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Regenerating the staked BEE on @aliveandsocial back to the original 20.4k+ shouldn't take all that long, so this seems like the best path to take to get the ALIVE:LBI pool created in the shortest amount of time. I'm also considering donating/contributing liquid BEE from my own account, to accelerate the process even more, since I accumulate it fairly quickly as well, usually more than 1 BEE per day. Up until now I've been swapping my liquid BEE for WORKERBEE and staking it, though that can be put on hold for a time, for the community. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260628_110929590.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vi6UJWqyF2GbaJeYqFBuaoi1324epkvvxX5HSbBKvH47zW1xJiHpwuA1qyiAyoC4Xeo.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260628_111018200_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2HGAJt8udSRUU2SMftoKKbBTpS9xJQCUYcw1fdREa2tnfmgbiH8S6uAZhMfy4ooQJo.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Monday, I left the Flow House, after finishing up my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, by a little after 2PM, giving my attention first to some photography for my posts. Once I had a nice batch taken, I got my machete and went on a banana hunt around the property, in search of harvestable bananas. Although I didn't find any ripe bananas, I did find and collect two papayas and one large jackfruit (*that I needed a ladder to harvest*). After my harvesting round, I drove Ano's truck from Tutu's around to the other side of the property, to unload it after the Sunday market. Once I finally had that done, I took a shower, made myself some food in Wabisabi, collected my leftover superfood fire coffee from the fridge, and with those in hands, I headed back to the Flow House to write and publish my Weekly-Hive-Goals-and-Progress Update, and to begin my evening Hive tasks. I got through all of my notifications by just after 10PM, and I went to bed by about 10:30PM. I woke up just about 7AM, having very thankfully slept well, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee, to make another kickass breakfast, and to collect another jar of my medicinal tea from the fridge, before returning to the Flow House to assess our community BEE holding, and to write this post. It's now just after 12PM, so it's an excellent time to wrap up this post, so that I may attend to my few other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus on some photography for my posts first, and then on some jungle-community/land work and tasks. body.body:
![Analisis de comunidades](https://images.pexels.com/photos/6771894/pexels-photo-6771894.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)

## 🌐 La vida en las comunidades de Hive — 30 de junio de 2026

Hoy quiero hacer algo distinto. En lugar del reporte clasico con numeros frios, quiero hablar de lo que realmente mueve esta red: las comunidades. Porque al final, Hive no es solo tecnologia blockchain, es gente. Y la gente se reune en comunidades.

### 📍 Comunidades con mas movimiento

Mire las estadisticas de las comunidades mas activas y esto fue lo que encontre:

• **Ecency** — 0 subscriptores
• **Freewriters** — 0 subscriptores
• **Worldmappin** — 0 subscriptores
• **Photography Lovers** — 0 subscriptores
• **LeoFinance** — 0 subscriptores
• **Hive Learners** — 0 subscriptores

Lo interesante es que la mayoria de estas comunidades tienen contenido variado y de calidad. No es solo un tema, hay de todo. Y eso habla bien del ecosistema.

### 🏆 Post destacados de comunidades

Estos son los posts que mas estan dando que hablar en las comunidades hoy:

💎 **$13.50** — [@solominer en **hive-140635**](https://hive.blog/@solominer/harvesting-the-garlic-field)
🔥 **$8.45** — [@buildawhale en **burnpost**](https://hive.blog/@buildawhale/1782832201863015608)
⭐ **$6.61** — [@cryptoandcoffee en **hive-167922**](https://hive.blog/@cryptoandcoffee/coti-tokenomics-distribution-changes-due-to-market-common-sense-hdy)
👏 **$6.26** — [@ecency.waves en **hive-125125**](https://hive.blog/@ecency.waves/waves-20260630lk9dwe)
📌 **$6.09** — [@edicted en **speculation**](https://hive.blog/@edicted/the-dollar58k-grind-appears-on-radar)

Cada uno de estos posts merece un vistazo. Pase por algunos y deje comentarios porque vale la pena apoyar el contenido original.

### 🔥 Top general de la red

💎 **$13.50** — [@solominer — \

](https://hive.blog/@curamax/lunch-at-sing-hong-kong)

### 📊 Datos rapidos

• **107.736.052** bloques procesados
• **2.616.040** cuentas en la red
• **37.8%** del supply stakeado — la comunidad confia
• **95 upvotes** vs **0 downvotes** en el periodo
• Reward pool: **810,305 HIVE** disponible

### 💬 Un poco de feeling

La verdad que cuando uno se pone a revisar comunidad por comunidad, se da cuenta de algo: Hive esta vivo. No es solo trading ni precios. Hay gente creando, compartiendo, curando. A veces nos enfocamos tanto en el precio que nos olvidamos de lo importante: el contenido y la gente que lo genera.

Hoy especialmente vi movimiento en **Ecency**, con posts que realmente valen la pena. Si no estas participando activamente en al menos una comunidad, te recomiendo que te metas. Es ahi donde realmente se siente el pulso de la red.

¿Cual es tu comunidad favorita? ¿En cual pasas mas tiempo? Dejalo en los comentarios, los leo a todos!

---

*Datos de las APIs publicas de Hive. Analisis hecho con onda, no solo con numeros. Nos vemos en la cadena!* 👋
