links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQNbgW95dLiYY5odKjyP5KZA9tLTMrR9pvVmeAx4EV8YC/1782854394318.jpg)

https://youtu.be/U3pGGPJk3iI?is=eYr5s-L-8fA3Hhu9


Hola a todos, hoy voy a interpretar Wave de Antônio Carlos Jobim. Esta es una de las composiciones más conocidas de Jobim después de The Girl from Ipanema y fue escrita a finales de los años sesenta. 

Con el tiempo pasó a formar parte del repertorio de muchísimos músicos de jazz y de música brasileña, así que es una pieza que todavía se sigue tocando en muchos lugares.

En esta ocasión la voy a interpretar con guitarra acústica. Decidí hacerla así porque siento que el sonido de este instrumento combina muy bien con el estilo de la canción. Desde que empecé a estudiarla me di cuenta de que en la acústica la melodía se siente más cómoda y el sonido encaja mejor con la idea de la pieza, así que fue la guitarra que escogí para esta presentación.

Algo que me llamó la atención cuando conocí Wave fue que, aunque parece una canción sencilla al escucharla por primera vez, tiene varios detalles en la armonía que hacen que cada vez encuentres algo diferente. Esa mezcla entre la bossa nova y el jazz es una de las razones por las que tantos músicos la siguen tocando hoy en día.

Además, Wave ha sido grabada por muchísimos artistas, tanto en versiones instrumentales como cantadas, y eso demuestra lo bien que se adapta a distintos formatos sin perder su identidad.

Espero les guste

English 

Hello everyone, today I'm going to perform \
by Antônio Carlos Jobim. This is one of Jobim's most famous compositions after \

and was written in the late 1960s.

Over time, it became part of the repertoire of countless jazz and Brazilian musicians, so it's a piece that's still played in many places.

This time, I'm going to perform it on acoustic guitar. I decided to do it this way because I feel that the sound of this instrument blends very well with the style of the song. Since I started studying it, I realized that the melody feels more comfortable on acoustic guitar and the sound fits better with the idea of ​​the piece, so that's the guitar I chose for this performance.

Something that caught my attention when I first heard \

was that, although it seems like a simple song at first, it has several harmonic details that make you discover something different each time you listen to it. That blend of bossa nova and jazz is one of the reasons why so many musicians continue to play it today. 

Furthermore, Wave has been recorded by numerous artists, both in instrumental and vocal versions, demonstrating how well it adapts to different formats without losing its essence.
 
Hope you enjoy it

// Mi opinión sobre la película \
links.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![1000274976.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23wqnnHM5U8sJV5dMwihVXFzD6LirnCsCeRmHdHsWp2Ur4i3wmQzSaGTh4E8XwWtkk3xY.jpg)



<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?q=fotografias+de+la+pel%C3%ADcula+rusa+novios+de+mentira+y+todo+salio+mal.&client=ms-android-transsion&hs=faAq&sca_esv=d0bb7ae496a9202e&sxsrf=APpeQnuwaxLU2Y7_f_pQTovNwg8fS_pOjA:1782791321908&udm=2&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwifs82bh66VAxWS3PACHTLmLWUQ7Al6BAgWEAM&biw=360&bih=718&dpr=2#sv=CAMSPhoyKhBlLTRKSG92UWtZWF9SZndNMg40SkhvdlFrWVhfUmZ3TToOcE5QTUlsMVhRU2QxZ00gBDgASgQIARACGAcg0J2H5g1KCBACGAEgAigB)</Center>






Hello, #hive friends, and especially to the Movies&TvShows community. I’m stopping by today to tell you about a movie I watched recently called \

a romantic comedy full of twists and turns. It’s really funny and runs about three hours, offering a predictable, but charming one featuring overbearing parents, lies that spiral out of control, and a love that blossoms from a lie.



![1000274978.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23tbkbVU7N2Fay6TXaGKqVkfFbKqoZcvE4aR6ACbZvzmyvng2bauonWUg5uQPMGH9Amsz.jpg)



<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?q=fotografias+de+la+pel%C3%ADcula+rusa+novios+de+mentira+y+todo+salio+mal.&client=ms-android-transsion&hs=faAq&sca_esv=d0bb7ae496a9202e&sxsrf=APpeQnuwaxLU2Y7_f_pQTovNwg8fS_pOjA:1782791321908&udm=2&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwifs82bh66VAxWS3PACHTLmLWUQ7Al6BAgWEAM&biw=360&bih=718&dpr=2#sv=CAMSPhoyKhBlLTRKSG92UWtZWF9SZndNMg40SkhvdlFrWVhfUmZ3TToOcE5QTUlsMVhRU2QxZ00gBDgASgQIARACGAcg0J2H5g1KCBACGAEgAigB)</Center>



The plot revolves around Dima, a young man whose mother, Vera, is extremely demanding and critical of his partners. His current girlfriend, Olga, is no exception to Vera’s harsh opinions; Vera sees her as unsuitable. Meanwhile, Marina suffers under the pressure of her father, a strict man who disapproves of her choices, including an older boyfriend. Exhausted by their families’ interference, Dima and Marina bump into each other by chance during a chaotic moment in an elevator while on their way to rent an apartment, and that’s where they strike a deal: Marina will pretend to be Dima’s terrible girlfriend to make Olga seem ideal in Vera’s eyes, while Dima will pose as Marina’s perfect fiancé in front of her father.



![1000274979.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23wC3d6FWSqZiEd4s6e33PtuGySKYgtqyhqou9y1xviCfNuG3PcmsivC51N8VC4WmjVfh.jpg)



<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?q=fotografias+de+la+pel%C3%ADcula+rusa+novios+de+mentira+y+todo+salio+mal.&client=ms-android-transsion&hs=faAq&sca_esv=d0bb7ae496a9202e&sxsrf=APpeQnuwaxLU2Y7_f_pQTovNwg8fS_pOjA:1782791321908&udm=2&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwifs82bh66VAxWS3PACHTLmLWUQ7Al6BAgWEAM&biw=360&bih=718&dpr=2#sv=CAMSPhoyKhBlLTRKSG92UWtZWF9SZndNMg40SkhvdlFrWVhfUmZ3TToOcE5QTUlsMVhRU2QxZ00gBDgASgQIARACGAcg0J2H5g1KCBACGAEgAigB)</Center>




What begins as a simple act quickly turns into a whirlwind of lies, awkward situations, and misunderstandings. The film shines in its scenes of physical and verbal comedy, which are clearly evident in Marina’s explosive interactions with Vera, the older boyfriend’s confrontations with Marina’s father, and the failed attempts to keep up appearances. The actors effectively convey the initial chemistry of annoyance, which evolves into genuine attraction. Dima’s mother is especially memorable as the archetype of the meddlesome mother-in-law—over-the-top but relatable to many.



![1000274977.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23x172JWMchpi5rTuJEwS9PpuPDfJrZHfHSna9Zk9PEvJHPG37Fka7DCRpgeZsBqP25Hn.jpg)



<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?q=fotografias+de+la+pel%C3%ADcula+rusa+novios+de+mentira+y+todo+salio+mal.&client=ms-android-transsion&hs=faAq&sca_esv=d0bb7ae496a9202e&sxsrf=APpeQnuwaxLU2Y7_f_pQTovNwg8fS_pOjA:1782791321908&udm=2&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwifs82bh66VAxWS3PACHTLmLWUQ7Al6BAgWEAM&biw=360&bih=718&dpr=2#sv=CAMSPhoyKhBlLTRKSG92UWtZWF9SZndNMg40SkhvdlFrWVhfUmZ3TToOcE5QTUlsMVhRU2QxZ00gBDgASgQIARACGAcg0J2H5g1KCBACGAEgAigB)</Center>




The comedy is grounded in universal family entanglements. The pressure from parents to do what’s best for their children is a theme that resonates culturally, and here it’s explored with humor without veering into cruelty. There are tender moments that explore emotional independence and how lies—even when motivated by a desire to avoid conflict—ultimately reveal truths about oneself and one’s true desires. The everyday setting—apartments, families—gives it a fresh, less glamorous feel than Hollywood romantic comedies; moreover, its runtime allows for the development of subplots and supporting characters that enrich the chaos.





![1000274981.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23wC3LFATj2M9GE2tGsZ8e5FfcqA5TS8i9eFM8EUJae4YYMGaE2MrTux4FeVWrLm9MX83.jpg)




<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?q=fotografias+de+la+pel%C3%ADcula+rusa+novios+de+mentira+y+todo+salio+mal.&client=ms-android-transsion&hs=faAq&sca_esv=d0bb7ae496a9202e&sxsrf=APpeQnuwaxLU2Y7_f_pQTovNwg8fS_pOjA:1782791321908&udm=2&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwifs82bh66VAxWS3PACHTLmLWUQ7Al6BAgWEAM&biw=360&bih=718&dpr=2#sv=CAMSPhoyKhBlLTRKSG92UWtZWF9SZndNMg40SkhvdlFrWVhfUmZ3TToOcE5QTUlsMVhRU2QxZ00gBDgASgQIARACGAcg0J2H5g1KCBACGAEgAigB)</Center>





Like many films of this genre, it doesn’t break any new ground—the script makes it clear exactly how the story will end from the very first minutes. Some jokes are repeated or dragged out too long, and the editing in the extended version can feel sluggish. The romantic storyline is sweet but somewhat superficial; the transition from fake to real happens more for narrative convenience than through deep character development. It’s not an ambitious film, nor does it feature standout performances, but it fulfills its role as light entertainment.





![1000274982.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/EoEoAxaSWudEC1WiLCSZxDM7iLoKPFNigsGLivRDtv3eMP8KozKYgs2gSS3pnmLSckq.jpg)




<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?q=fotografias+de+la+pel%C3%ADcula+rusa+novios+de+mentira+y+todo+salio+mal.&client=ms-android-transsion&hs=faAq&sca_esv=d0bb7ae496a9202e&sxsrf=APpeQnuwaxLU2Y7_f_pQTovNwg8fS_pOjA:1782791321908&udm=2&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwifs82bh66VAxWS3PACHTLmLWUQ7Al6BAgWEAM&biw=360&bih=718&dpr=2#sv=CAMSPhoyKhBlLTRKSG92UWtZWF9SZndNMg40SkhvdlFrWVhfUmZ3TToOcE5QTUlsMVhRU2QxZ00gBDgASgQIARACGAcg0J2H5g1KCBACGAEgAigB)</Center>





In short, friends, *Fake Boyfriend* is an ideal choice for an afternoon of unpretentious laughter, as it delivers laughs with absurd situations, gently critiques parental control, and celebrates the fact that, sometimes, the best relationships are born from the worst ideas, so if you like films like “The Fake Wife” or romantic comedies with family entanglements, this one will leave you with a smile. It’s not the kind of movie you’ll remember years later, but it entertains and relaxes perfectly. As for me, I’ll say goodbye for now, and I’ll see you at the next movie. Thousands 
of blessings.

‎VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí!)

‎ Hola amigos de #hive y en especial a la comunidad de Movies&TvShows, en el día de hoy paso por acá para hablarles de una película que vi por estos días titulada \

,una comedia romántica llena de enredados, la cual es muy divertida y tiene una duración aproximada de tres horas, la cual ofrece una historia predecible, pero encantadora dónde vemospadres controladores, mentiras que se complican y un amor que surge de lo falso.





La trama gira en torno a Dima, un joven cuya madre, Vera, es extremadamente exigente y crítica con sus parejas. Su actual novia, Olga, no escapa de las duras opiniones de Vera, quien la ve como inadecuada. Por otro lado, Marina sufre la presión de su padre, un hombre estricto que desaprueba sus elecciones, incluyendo un novio mayor. Agotados por la interferencia familiar, Dima y Marina se encuentran por casualidad en un momento caótico en un ascensor cuando se dirigían a alquilando un apartamento, y es ahí donde se ponen de acuerdo, así que Marina fingirá ser la novia terrible de Dima para hacer que Olga parezca ideal ante Vera, mientras Dima se hace pasar por el prometido perfecto de Marina frente a su padre.






Lo que empieza como una simple actuación se convierte rápidamente en un torbellino de mentiras, situaciones incómodas y malentendidos. La película brilla en las escenas de comedia física y verbal y se ve claramente en las interacciones explosivas de Marina con Vera, las confrontaciones del novio viejo con el padre de Marina, y los intentos fallidos de mantener las apariencias. Los actores transmiten bien la química inicial de fastidio, que evoluciona hacia atracción genuina. La madre de Dima es especialmente memorable como el arquetipo de suegra entrometida, exagerada pero relatable para muchos.






La comedia se sostiene en los enredos familiares universales. La presión de los padres por lo mejor para sus hijos es un tema que resuena culturalmente, y aquí se explota con humor sin caer en lo cruel. Hay momentos tiernos que exploran la independencia emocional y cómo las mentiras, aunque motivadas por evitar conflictos, terminan revelando verdades sobre uno mismo y los deseos reales. La ambientación cotidiana, pisos, familias, le da un toque fresco y menos glamoroso que las comedias románticas de Hollywood, por otra parte, su tiempo de duración permite desarrollar subtramas y secundarios que enriquecen el caos.







Como muchas producciones de este estilo, no reinventa nada, ya que con el guion sabes exactamente cómo terminará la historia desde los primeros minutos. Algunos chistes se repiten o se extienden demasiado, y la edición en la versión larga puede sentirse pausada. El desarrollo romántico es dulce, pero algo superficial, la transición de falso a real ocurre más por conveniencia narrativa que por una construcción profunda de personajes. No es una película ambiciosa ni con grandes actuaciones, pero cumple su función de entretenimiento ligero.




En resumen, amigos \

es una opción ideal para una tarde de risas sin pretensiones, ya que ofrece carcajadas con situaciones absurdas, critica suavemente el control parental y celebra que, a veces, las mejores relaciones nacen de las peores ideas, así que si te gustan filmes como \

o comedias románticas de enredos familiares, esta entrega te dejará con una sonrisa. No es cine para recordar años después, pero entretiene y relaja perfectamente. Yo por mi parte me despido de ustedes y nos vemos hasta la próxima peli. Bendiciones 
miles.

When you get to be in the same space with some fashion enthusiasts, you begin to wonder how far you still need to go with your fashion sense and that's mostly me in that picture.

![1000791427.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/AKcfK9QvagsT8ViwNVac4J1odMZmdBexXRR7waW5yMWrgFU9D1JFMGkP16dPUeu.jpg)

It is not really because I feel intimidated by what others wear but the combination of how they couple up their dresses to make outstanding outfits with what I couldn't have ever thought about putting together to wear makes me wonder if they actually brought their fashion sense from heaven.

Sometimes it may be the problem of combining colors, deciding what color to put on the not very common color of a top I just got and this has actually cost me the price of leaving some dresses I see in stores or market generally that I love, because the thought of how to combine it becomes an issue. But then, internet became a saving grace for that later on as I just have to search on how and what to combine the colours I have with.

At the end of it all, my whole aim and objective is not to impress anyone or to prove that I am in any way a fashionista but to ensure that whatever I am wearing, I am confident in it and I can carry it with no side distraction of not dressing well.

![1000791423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23tbyVxVTNQSycEF6awW8rtK72W4NDWB41UjiMNb9SxF9PgPasJT6ZZN95dNY5JgZNdFK.jpg)

I won't combine my dress same as you just because you're a fashionista or because it looks okay on you. First reason is because we don't have same body structure or stature and that's a very big part to think about when trying to replicate an outfit you saw someone wear. It may fit her and I would look like a masquerade in an ancestry costume wearing same.

In summary, I'm not a fashionista and I may have little fashion sense but one thing is certain that I ensure to be confident in whatever I put on and at that point in time, my whole conclusion in my head is that it's the best anyone could see in that space.

I'll be dropping my 🖊️ here on the Ladiesofhive community prompt 

Thanks for reading through 🤗

links.title: What It Feels Like When Your Cravings Finally Fade
links.body:
Cravings can feel overwhelming, persistent, and difficult to ignore. Whether they involve sugar, processed foods, nicotine, alcohol, or other habits, they often seem to take control of daily decisions. Many people describe cravings as a constant mental tug-of-war that consumes attention and energy.

The encouraging news is that cravings rarely stay intense forever. With time, healthy routines, and the right support, they often become less frequent and less powerful. When cravings finally begin to fade, the experience can be both surprising and empowering, opening the door to healthier habits and improved well-being.

## Understanding Why Cravings Happen

Cravings are influenced by far more than simple hunger. They result from a combination of biological signals, emotional triggers, environmental cues, and learned behaviors. The brain forms strong associations between certain activities and feelings of reward, making those behaviors easier to repeat.

Stress, lack of sleep, emotional discomfort, and even familiar surroundings can trigger cravings. Recognizing these influences is an important step because it shifts the focus away from willpower alone and toward understanding the underlying causes.

Many healthcare organizations, including [humana nj](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/humana-insurance-nj/), encourage individuals to focus on sustainable lifestyle changes rather than quick fixes. Learning how cravings develop helps people create realistic strategies that support long-term health instead of relying on temporary motivation.

## The First Signs That Cravings Are Losing Their Grip

One of the earliest changes is that cravings become less urgent. Instead of demanding immediate attention, they begin to feel more like passing thoughts that can be acknowledged without acting on them.

This shift often happens gradually. People may still notice occasional triggers, but the emotional intensity becomes noticeably weaker. What once felt impossible to resist may simply become another choice.

### Physical Changes You May Notice

As cravings decline, many individuals experience more stable energy throughout the day. Blood sugar fluctuations become less dramatic when healthier eating patterns replace impulsive choices.

Sleep quality may also improve, especially when cravings were linked to excessive sugar, caffeine, or alcohol consumption. Better sleep further supports emotional regulation, creating a positive cycle that reinforces healthier habits.

Some people also report improved digestion, fewer energy crashes, and a greater appreciation for natural flavors. Foods that once seemed bland often become more satisfying as taste preferences gradually adapt.

### Emotional Shifts That Come with Reduced Cravings

The emotional benefits are often just as meaningful as the physical ones. Reduced cravings can bring a greater sense of freedom because daily decisions no longer revolve around avoiding temptation.

Many individuals notice increased confidence as they repeatedly make choices that align with their personal goals. This growing trust in themselves often extends beyond nutrition or recovery into other areas of life.

Reduced mental preoccupation also creates more space for hobbies, relationships, work, and personal growth. Instead of constantly negotiating with cravings, attention can be directed toward experiences that provide lasting satisfaction.

## How Daily Life Changes When Cravings Fade

One of the biggest differences is that healthy decisions require less mental effort. Planning meals, shopping for groceries, or declining unhealthy options begins to feel routine rather than stressful.

Social situations often become easier as well. Instead of feeling anxious about every gathering or celebration, many people learn to enjoy the occasion without feeling controlled by food or other temptations.

Financial benefits may also appear over time. Spending less on impulse purchases, convenience foods, cigarettes, or alcohol can contribute to meaningful savings while reinforcing healthier priorities.

Many health plans, including [wellcare of nj](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/wellcare-nj-health-insurance-plan/), emphasize preventive care and wellness programs that help individuals maintain these positive lifestyle changes over the long term. Continued education and regular health checkups often strengthen the progress already made.

## Healthy Habits That Help Maintain Progress

Although cravings become less frequent, maintaining healthy routines remains important. Consistency helps reinforce new behaviors until they become part of everyday life.

Some effective strategies include:

*   Eating balanced meals with adequate protein and fiber.

*   Staying hydrated throughout the day.

*   Prioritizing consistent sleep schedules.

*   Exercising regularly, even through moderate activities like walking.

*   Managing stress through mindfulness, journaling, or relaxation techniques.

*   Building supportive relationships with family, friends, or healthcare professionals.

Rather than aiming for perfection, focusing on gradual improvement tends to produce more sustainable results. Small daily habits often have a greater long-term impact than dramatic short-term changes.

According to research published by the [World Health Organization](https://www.who.int/), healthy lifestyle habits—including balanced nutrition, regular physical activity, and stress management—play a significant role in improving overall health and reducing the risk of chronic disease. These evidence-based recommendations reinforce the importance of maintaining healthy routines even after cravings begin to fade.

## Common Challenges Even After Cravings Improve

Progress does not always follow a straight path. Stressful events, major life transitions, illness, or emotional challenges may temporarily increase cravings again.

Experiencing occasional setbacks does not erase previous progress. In fact, many people find that they recover more quickly because they have already developed healthier coping strategies and greater self-awareness.

Remaining flexible is essential. Instead of viewing setbacks as failures, treating them as learning opportunities often leads to greater resilience and lasting success.

It is also important to remember that everyone's timeline is different. Some people notice improvements within weeks, while others experience gradual change over several months. Comparing progress with others can create unnecessary frustration and distract from personal achievements.

## When Professional Support Can Make a Difference

Some cravings are deeply connected to medical conditions, mental health concerns, or substance dependence. In these situations, professional guidance can provide valuable tools that are difficult to develop independently.

Healthcare providers can identify contributing factors, recommend appropriate treatments, and monitor progress over time. Nutritionists, behavioral therapists, and support groups may also help individuals build personalized strategies for long-term success.

Seeking professional support should be viewed as a proactive decision rather than a sign of weakness. Many people achieve better outcomes when they combine personal commitment with expert guidance.

## Final Thoughts

When cravings finally fade, the experience often feels less dramatic than many people expect. Instead of a single breakthrough moment, it usually arrives through small, consistent improvements that gradually reshape daily life.

Greater emotional balance, improved physical health, increased confidence, and a stronger sense of control all contribute to lasting well-being. While occasional cravings may still appear from time to time, they no longer define everyday decisions.

The journey requires patience, persistence, and self-compassion. Each healthy choice strengthens new habits, making it easier to enjoy life without constantly feeling pulled toward old patterns. Over time, what once seemed like an endless struggle can become a meaningful reminder of how powerful gradual, consistent change truly is.

---

links.body: /> Happy Tuesday foodie friends Lovers, i welcome you all to another week of foodie activities.. this update is covering an over the weekend hangout for movie night, where pizza making was the main event.. We had planned a movie night over the weekend, which we later go to pick pizza making for fun, this was suggested by my friend who is always making one recipe or another and it was successful keep reading below. Feliz martes, amigos amantes de la comida. Les doy la bienvenida a todos a otra semana de actividades gastronómicas... En esta actualización les cuento sobre una reunión que tuvimos el fin de semana para una noche de cine, en la que lo más destacado fue preparar pizza. Habíamos planeado una noche de cine para el fin de semana, pero luego decidimos preparar pizza por diversión; esto lo sugirió mi amiga, que siempre está preparando una receta u otra, y fue todo un éxito. Sigan leyendo a continuación... In the get together we ended up making three varying pizza choices for our movie and it was real exciting, this wasn’t my first time but it was really great for bonding moments with friends. En la reunión terminamos preparando tres tipos diferentes de pizza para ver la película y fue muy emocionante; no era la primera vez que lo hacía, pero fue genial para pasar un rato agradable con los amigos.

/> #Ingredients --------------- Tomato paste/sauce Flour dough Shredded cheese varying toppings (pepperoni, ham, mushroom, olive) Ingredientes ------------ Pasta de tomate Masa de harina Queso rallado Diferentes ingredientes (pepperoni, jamón, champiñones, olives) #Process -----------

>Starting off with flour dough which had already been previously prepared by my friend we didn’t have much work to do. so we went straight into dressing the toppings.

Como partimos de una masa de harina que mi amigo ya había preparado antes, no tuvimos mucho trabajo que hacer. Así que nos pusimos directamente a añadir los ingredientes.

/> The first being a simple Pizza Prosciutto, coating the surface of the now flattened with tomato sauce, i sprinkle some mozzarella shredded cheese onto the surface and the ham which had already cut earlier was also dressed unto the dough.. I preferred a simple basic ham pizza because it is a staple and a classic for me . La primera fue una sencilla pizza de prosciutto: unté la superficie de la masa, ya aplanada, con salsa de tomate; espolvoreé un poco de queso mozzarella rallado por encima y coloqué el prosciutto, que ya había cortado antes, sobre la masa. Preferí una pizza sencilla y básica de prosciutto porque, para mí, es un plato básico y un clásico.

/> Here the rest of the pizza which was pepperoni and Pizza Capricciosa was then prepared in the same fashion and they looked so good at this stage, it was now ready to be heated up in the oven. Aquí, el resto de la pizza —que era de pepperoni y Pizza Capricciosa— se preparó de la misma manera, y se veían tan bien en esta etapa que ya estaban listas para calentarse en el horno

/> placing them in the preheated oven at 100 degrees Celsius for 15minutes they were now ready to be served. Después de meterlos en el horno precalentado a 100 grados Celsius durante 15 minutos, ya estaban listos para servir. Ready and served!! ------------------

/> This was after they were done, and they turned out so beautiful, with vibrant colours to.. this was a fun activity to do with loved ones and friends and a great bites to share in a gathering such as a movie night, what made it further specters that it was made in love from scratch and we share over some drink and other snack that we had for the gathering. Esto fue después de que terminaran, y quedaron tan bonitos, con colores tan vivos... Fue una actividad divertida para hacer con nuestros seres queridos y amigos, y un excelente bocadillo para compartir en una reunión como una noche de cine. Lo que lo hizo aún más especial fue que lo preparamos con mucho cariño desde cero y lo compartimos mientras disfrutábamos de una bebida y otros bocadillos que teníamos para la reunión.

links.title: Off-World Galaxy Map
links.body:
Continuing on from yesterday, the map is looking great and going really well.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVhiZyWFv7bVnXF3gux78B1keLuXW5tDuk9ZMW25qHsC9/image.png)

#### <center> World Borders </center>

I created a circle, filled it, indented it, removed the centre, copied and sized down the second circle to make this shape, then removed centre pieces to make it look interesting.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVf9gxgJ1vJ37265zckbHNJTp4h2VgAaxWXB3yXEJCP4M/image.png)

#### <center> Highlighting Worlds </center>

I turned it into a brush, set the size to 250 pixels, and went around the map dropping the borders on each world.

After that, I sized the brush down to 125 pixels and highlighted the smaller points of interest, signifying space stations, bases, notable objects, etc.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQSqtA94MhbcfBMQDC3NMNbRD8KQgYawNQwHCn358jYd6/image.png)

#### <center> Place Names </center>

I went through the map, marking out certain worlds that have appeared in the stories. 

My main focus was the major worlds, and my secondary focus was the existing smaller locations.

I also named each of the territories. It is clear that The Confederation hasn't had too much world-building, and that's something I would like to rectify.

Post-war Free Space is my main interest, and I like the idea of The Confederation being an ominous presence in the galaxy, without being the main focus of my stories.

I have left a lot of room to create throughout Free Space and The Outer Worlds, as there are plenty more races and worlds to come.

Also, I like having a large portion of space Uncharted, because there could be entire empires unknown to the galaxy.



****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaSLqNH3ZkmTPoNuRERjMaHrM7C3qiaCqQEWB4pTvm5wH/image.png)

#### <center> Jump Lanes </center>

Jump Lanes are fast transit areas between worlds, but hold the risk of ambushes due to the rings that are used to form these lanes.

I wanted to show the difference between post-war Confederation territory and post-war Free Space, and I think it is pretty clear.

Broken links between worlds, as opposed to a network of fast transit, which makes it far easier and faster to exchange goods and travel.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVNTxBM9urtHT54LnSNBfAsUC9ZcpXMF9LCaQTV3HHNj9/off_world_galaxy_map_60_.png)

#### <center> Map Export </center>

I couldn't upload the original, so I had to resize it to upload it here.

I am so happy with how it turned out, and I have the file within Photoshop, so I can update it with new worlds as needed in the future.

Not having a physical map stopped me from creating or doing any more world building, because I was finding it hard to keep track of it all. But with this, I will easily be able to look at it and know where everything is.

I am hoping this will also help to inspire future stories.

****

links.title: The Flood In Our Village
links.body: *\nThese are the words of a song featured in the Soviet film \

I always remember this song when it rains continuously for several days or even a whole week. That's exactly what last week was like. There has not been a single day without rain.

<center>[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbBxVAV8Z55fbrfKiRg8T6b3HD3fP1beYVoKs5ogtGrTd/20220604_071257408_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbBxVAV8Z55fbrfKiRg8T6b3HD3fP1beYVoKs5ogtGrTd/20220604_071257408_ios.jpg)</center>

A large river formed on the central street of our village. The water can even carry down large stones from the side of the road. This can create a real problem for motorists because the stones are sometimes very big.

<center>[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbRhu57n8cKdXx3HpnVx5imLSnvHAAoBS63pzzBhP5YHT/20220604_071834292_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbRhu57n8cKdXx3HpnVx5imLSnvHAAoBS63pzzBhP5YHT/20220604_071834292_ios.jpg)</center>

Bubbles on puddles from raindrops indicate that it will rain for a long time, it does not want to stop, because a hole has formed in the sky and a stream of water has gushed out of it. links.title: Learning, Growing, and Connecting Beyond the Scroll
links.body:
I'm not sure I'll share my thoughts the same way I had wanted to yesterday when I saw the prompt, I decided to go for another prompt and now I have to find the vibe I was going to use. Social media is one part of my life that has experienced change that I had never imagined for it before. Before now, I would spend all day watching reels and short videos on social media to spend time away without realizing how much of my time I'm wasting away. It slowly became a habit that I am still struggling to break out of. But now, I speak of social media with more positivity than before. That is because I've come to understand how social media influence our lives and how we can use that to our advantage and still live life much better. As the prompt ask, *what ways has social media positively influenced my daily life?* In many ways actually, especially in how I see the world. ![1001627600.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/23zGwZTPYv7No5bvRCjp3b2hMQFv8aVLNPxZRG3J7rp1GPrqKNxF2c3tZAjdPmkQ5seHv.jpg) Now, I use social media to teach myself about whatever I want to learn, find out information I need, build connection with people who are shaping me towards a better future and embracing a life that is beyond just scrolling with no action taken. Social media is more than that. This is where I'll share what I think are the best steps to take for a healthy balance between social media and real-life activities. First of all, see social media as a part of your life, not your life. Secondly, have an active life outside of social media and it doesn't have to be a grand life. Simply spending time to enjoy nature, do art, grow a plant, start a small project, being active with community activities or being with family, all that are more than a life to have. Spending too much time on social media will rip all these away from you so it's important to spend time wisely. The one hack I do that I'll always recommend for who wants to utilize social media while living their lives is, be you and don't let what is shared influence you to being less of you or think you're not enough. Comparison is a daily war to fight on social media, get past it and you'll do just fine.

links.title: Not My Lover
links.body: > We went to the movies tonight to see *Michael,* a bio-pic telling the early days of Michael Jackson, and it was *pretty good!* It doesn't get into any of the scandal and focuses on his early career, and I think it was pretty well done all up and the lead (played by his nephew Jaafar Jackson) really worked well for the film. And of course, at least for someone of may age-ish or a bit older who grew up with his music, there is definitely sentimental connection with the soundtrack. --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23uFHNz2gsr4TVa8aFBC2m3GDY295chszNt5qUSNXGGMAEjaDGEfJPw7nN6keVjt7YKQC.png) --- I think that the focus on his brilliance is a good reminder that despite all the rest, he was an incredibly talented individual who shifted the way the world consumes music. And as the movie points toward the eventual trajectory tied to his early childhood and relationship with his father, it is another good reminder that brilliance is often coupled with some kind of offset traits that are well away from the norm. What is a counter-factual argument, is that without the treatment he had when he was young, perhaps he both would have never become the superstar he became, but he might also have not been such a strange and twisted individual either. Maybe he would have just been a normal guy, living out his life in Gary, Indiana - being a nobody. > My wife doesn't agree. She thinks that the sort of treatment (beatings) he would get from his father added no value to his life other than trauma, but I think that there is likely a lot of drive that he had that was there because of that treatment. It seems to me, that a lot of brilliant people tend to have very difficult origin stories with circumstances that they had to overcome in order to achieve what they eventually did. If I remember correctly from something I read some time, a lot of the people who are very successful in some skill, have a parent that drives them hard, and one who supports them. > A pusher and a protector. It is an interesting observation in today's world, where many parents want to be friends with their kids, but also want what is best for them. But if what is best for them isn't a parent who is a friend and instead someone who challenges them to be better, to push harder, to improve themselves, than the parent is actually a hurdle to the child's growth. >The parent is *not what is best* for the child. And no, success isn't just fame and fortune, because it can encompass many different kinds of situations and skillsets. But the thing with learning any skill is that no one can learn it for another person. A parent can't learn for the child, and a child can't learn if they are constantly sheltered from the experiences they need n order to learn. As I was saying to the family that were here the other day, learning to be brilliant at something *isn't fun.* Learning a skill to begin with can be fun and it can get a person up to an okay level, but to be brilliant takes dedication to repetition and often discomfort, pain, boredom, and an acceptance of very slow progress. Because the better we get at something, the harder it becomes to get better again. At some point, no matter how hard one trains, the improvement is miniscule. And maybe to be able to push through into brilliance takes a certain kind of person with a mindset that allows for it. And maybe, while some might be born with that innately, perhaps difficult childhood experiences and people who get pushed hard are able to get into that same frame needed to keep on training, practicing, learning and overcoming day after day. Staying safe and protected by the parents, might run counter to developing certain kinds of brilliance. While I don't think beating children is the way to develop high-level skillsets in most people, hardship can sew the seeds for growth. But, that same hardship can also generate a host of other reactive conditions, which might be the case for many of the brilliant people who excel in one or two areas, but fail hard in others. Michael Jackson might be one of the very public examples of developed brilliance coupled with other broken frameworks that made it difficult for him to navigate his life, especially under the public pressure he faced. Anyway, this all aside, it was a decent movie and what was interesting was after the movie ended and the credits rolled, no one left the cinema. Everyone stayed until the last song finished and the lights came on. Love or hate the person, it is undeniable that Michael Jackson, despite all the many flaws and problems, was an incredibly talented person and made some brilliant music. And while the movie was full of music, it only scraped the surface. I did consider building the game directly on Hive, but I had to ask myself what real value it would bring to the game and to the players.

For me, that choice would make the most sense if the game was designed around NFTs or on-chain assets. After spending a long time in the Splinterlands ecosystem, and especially after my experience with Soulkeep, I became more cautious about that model. I ended up owning many NFTs that lost almost all of their value due to decisions made within a single project.

That experience made me realize that NFTs tied only to one specific game or ecosystem can be very fragile. Even if you technically own them, their real value often depends entirely on the future of that one project.

Because of that, I decided not to add blockchain or NFT features unless they provide clear value to the gameplay and to the players. I do not want to introduce extra complexity just for the sake of saying that the game has NFTs or Web3 elements.

That said, I still think Hive is a great blogging platform. I also really like the way Hive accounts and authentication work, which is why I decided to support login through Hive.

Later on, I also plan to create a utility token, but I chose a network that better fits the intended use case and potential reach of that token. Still, I think the game may indirectly help introduce more people to Hive, because seeing login options like Hive Keychain and HiveAuth may make some players curious about what Hive is and how it works.

links.title: Marca personal para emprendedores/ESP-ENG
links.body: Hola, muy buenas tardes, comunidad de emprendedores. Hoy vengo a escribir sobre un tema de suma importancia que puede ser de gran aprendizaje para ti: **la marca personal para los emprendedores**. ¿Te has preguntado cómo comenzar a crear tu huella digital en las redes sociales? ¿O qué deberías compartir para aportar valor? En este escrito vamos a descubrirlo. ¡Vamos a ello!

/> Una de mis actividades favoritas del día es escribir en Hive, compartir mi contenido y expresar mis pensamientos sobre temas de interés. También disfruto ser creativo y aportar mi propio punto de vista. Desarrollar tu autenticidad es clave. Aquí en Hive me encanta escribir en **@holoslotus**, porque allí puedo hablar sobre todo lo relacionado con el ser humano y otros temas que me apasionan. Tú también puedes elegir un tema que te guste, encontrar tu comunidad favorita y comenzar a desarrollar tus propias ideas. Verás que, al finalizar cada artículo, tendrás algo de lo que sentirte orgulloso al momento de publicarlo. Por eso, algo que debemos evitar es simplemente copiar y pegar contenido o escribir por escribir sin aportar nuestro propio criterio. Eso, en realidad, no ayuda a construir una marca personal. Lo que sí puedes hacer es leer contenido, aprender sobre un tema y luego crear una publicación original basada en tus propios pensamientos e ideas.

/> Además, si eres emprendedor, publicar contenido ayuda a que las personas conozcan cómo piensas, cómo eres como persona y cuáles son tus valores. Por supuesto, también es una excelente oportunidad para dar a conocer tu producto o servicio. Otro aspecto que ayuda mucho a crear una marca personal es saber en qué red social tener mayor presencia. En mi caso, la red en la que más tiempo invierto es Hive. Me gusta leer el contenido de otros hivers, apoyarlos con comentarios donde comparto mis puntos de vista y votar aquellas publicaciones con las que realmente conecto. También me gusta tener presencia en LinkedIn, porque es otra plataforma que me permite mostrar mis habilidades al mundo. Además, disfruto participar en X, donde he realizado charlas junto a **@waralotito** y Sakura. Al final, tú puedes decidir dónde invertir tu tiempo: puedes enfocarte en un solo canal o tener presencia en varias plataformas. Las personas que consumen contenido también buscan autenticidad. Quieren seguir a personas originales con las que puedan sentirse identificadas. Entonces, ¿por qué mostrar que todo es perfecto en las redes sociales? También puedes compartir tus aprendizajes, tus errores y cómo eras antes en comparación con la persona que eres hoy. Te aseguro de que alguien que lea tu historia se sentirá identificado contigo.

/> Eso es precisamente lo bonito de las redes sociales: encontrar historias que inspiran, que hacen creer en la perseverancia, en no rendirse y en seguir adelante. Aquí en Hive he encontrado varias de esas historias. Me gustan especialmente las que escribe Wara Lotito. Los invito a leerla y seguirla; verán que escribe muy bien. Algo que he incorporado en mis publicaciones como parte de mi marca personal es la creación de videos. En Hive los he realizado en la comunidad **@fulldeportes**, con el objetivo de que las personas también me conozcan como soy, sepan quién está detrás de los blogs y puedan sentirse identificadas conmigo. Me gusta que vean que hay una persona detrás de todo el contenido que comparto, ya que eso hace que todo sea mucho más humano. Por supuesto, no todo es perfecto. Cuando decidí comenzar a grabar videos, pensaba que necesitaba tener un nivel muy alto en edición y creación de contenido audiovisual. Sin embargo, al final simplemente decidí grabarme y publicar. Sé que, con el paso del tiempo, iré aprendiendo y mejorando todo lo que hago. También me gusta crear videos para un lugar donde aprendo oratoria llamado Hispanic Network. Allí he desarrollado esta habilidad, la cual considero muy importante para el mundo laboral, y disfruto practicarla constantemente. También pienso que no existe una receta única para construir una marca personal. Cada persona le da su propio toque de originalidad. Muchas personas dicen que hay que ser constantes y publicar todos los días, pero, en mi opinión, si tu tiempo solo te permite escribir tres publicaciones a la semana, eso también está bien. A mí también me sucede que no siempre estoy inspirado para escribir artículos en Hive todos los días. Por eso, prefiero escribir cuando realmente tengo algo interesante que contar, cuando me siento inspirado y cuando las ideas fluyen de forma natural. Algo que también puede ayudarte al crear contenido en Hive es utilizar un calendario de publicaciones. Es una herramienta muy útil. Por ejemplo, si un día me siento inspirado y escribo dos artículos, los preparo ambos, pero publico un artículo por día. De esa manera mantengo una mayor constancia sin sentir presión. Hay otro punto que siempre me he cuestionado: publicar únicamente sobre un solo tema. Eso puede ser lo más habitual en LinkedIn, pero en Hive siento que tengo mucha más libertad para explorar mis ideas. Aquí no solo escribo sobre desarrollo humano o emprendimiento, sino que también he publicado sobre mangas, deportes, emociones y muchos otros temas. Me gusta escribir sobre diferentes áreas porque disfruto experimentar y aprender cosas nuevas. Claro, siempre habrá temas que me apasionen más que otros, pero salir de la zona de confort también forma parte del proceso creativo.

/>

Eso mismo puedes hacer tú: explorar todas las comunidades que existen en Hive. Hay una gran variedad de espacios donde podrás compartir tus ideas, aprender de otros creadores y sentirte muy bien formando parte de esta increíble comunidad.

* * *

Quiero invitarlos a revisar el siguiente enlace sobre una actividad en la que está participando **@waralotito**. Se trata de una encuesta organizada por la comunidad **Ladies of Hive**, en la que se busca reconocer a las mujeres que han compartido contenido de gran calidad.

Me gustaría que la apoyaran con su voto y que, además, se tomaran un momento para explorar las publicaciones que comparte. Estoy seguro de que encontrarán contenido muy interesante, valioso y de gran calidad.

Aquí les dejo el enlace para que puedan participar y conocer su trabajo.

[https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@silversaver888/vote-for-lady-of-the-week-293](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@silversaver888/vote-for-lady-of-the-week-293)

* * *

Read the English version here.

Hello, good afternoon, entrepreneur community. Today I want to write about a very important topic that can be a great learning opportunity for you: **personal branding for entrepreneurs**.

Have you ever wondered how to start building your digital footprint on social media? Or what you should share to provide value? In this post, we're going to explore that. Let's get started!

One of my favorite daily activities is writing on Hive, sharing my content, and expressing my thoughts on topics that interest me. I also enjoy being creative and sharing my own perspective. Developing your authenticity is key.

Here on Hive, I love writing in **@holoslotus** because it allows me to talk about everything related to human development and other topics I'm passionate about. You can also choose a topic you enjoy, find your favorite community, and start developing your own ideas. By the time you finish each article, you'll have something you can truly be proud of when you publish it.

That's why we should avoid simply copying and pasting content or writing without adding our own perspective. That doesn't help you build a personal brand. Instead, you can read content, learn about a topic, and then create an original post based on your own thoughts and ideas.

If you're an entrepreneur, publishing content also helps people understand how you think, who you are as a person, and what your values are. Of course, it's also a great opportunity to showcase your product or service.

Another important aspect of building a personal brand is deciding which social network you want to focus on. In my case, the platform where I invest most of my time is Hive. I enjoy reading other Hivers' content, supporting them with thoughtful comments, and voting for posts that genuinely resonate with me.

I also like being active on LinkedIn because it's another platform that allows me to showcase my skills to the world. In addition, I enjoy participating on X, where I've hosted talks alongside **@waralotito** and Sakura. In the end, you decide where to invest your time. You can focus on one platform or build a presence across several.

People who consume content are also looking for authenticity. They want to follow original people they can relate to. So why pretend that everything is perfect on social media?

You can also share your lessons, your mistakes, and how you've changed over time. I assure you that someone who reads your story will identify with you.

That's exactly what's beautiful about social media: discovering stories that inspire people, encourage perseverance, and remind us never to give up.

Here on Hive, I've found many stories like that. I especially enjoy the posts written by Wara Lotito. I invite you to read and follow her—you'll see that she writes exceptionally well.

One thing I've incorporated into my personal brand is creating videos. On Hive, I've shared them in the **@fulldeportes** community so people can get to know who I am, see the person behind the blogs, and connect with me on a more personal level. I like showing that there's a real person behind everything I create because it makes my content feel much more human.

Of course, nothing is perfect. When I first decided to create videos, I thought I needed advanced video editing and production skills. But in the end, I simply decided to record myself and publish the videos. I know that, over time, I'll continue learning and improving everything I do.

I also enjoy creating videos for a place where I study public speaking called **Hispanic Network**. There, I've developed this skill, which I believe is extremely valuable in the professional world, and I enjoy practicing it regularly.

I also believe there's no single formula for building a personal brand. Everyone adds their own originality to the process. Many people say you need to be consistent and publish every day, but in my opinion, if your schedule only allows you to write three posts a week, that's perfectly fine.

The same thing happens to me. I'm not always inspired to write articles on Hive every day. That's why I prefer writing when I genuinely have something meaningful to share, when I feel inspired, and when my ideas flow naturally.

Another thing that can help you create content on Hive is using a content calendar. It's a very useful tool. For example, if I feel inspired and write two articles in one day, I prepare both of them but publish one article each day. That way, I stay consistent without feeling pressured.

There's another point I've often questioned: publishing about only one topic. That may be the norm on LinkedIn, but on Hive I feel much freer to explore my ideas. Here I don't just write about personal development or entrepreneurship. I've also written about manga, sports, emotions, and many other topics.

I enjoy writing about different subjects because I like experimenting and learning new things. Of course, there will always be topics I'm more passionate about than others, but stepping outside my comfort zone is also part of the creative process.

You can do the same: explore all the communities that exist on Hive. There are many different spaces where you can share your ideas, learn from other creators, and enjoy being part of this amazing community.

* * *

I'd also like to invite you to check out the following link about an activity in which **@waralotito** is participating. It's a poll organized by the **Ladies of Hive** community to recognize women who have consistently shared high-quality content.

I'd really appreciate it if you could support her by voting and also take a few moments to explore the content she shares. I'm sure you'll find many interesting, valuable, and inspiring posts.

body.title: ‎The Comparison Trap: Why I Chose to Focus on My Own Path ‎
body.body:
‎Hello Hives,
‎
‎
‎I think almost everyone has compared themselves to someone else at some point. I know I have. It's hard not to, especially when you see friends, classmates, or even strangers achieving things you have been praying and working for.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTVyUSjafp6VJZGYExfrcKaGieaocThp3Tf6kFXRWmc1U/file_0000000058e071f49bb301a6b4d8a5d1.png 

‎
‎There was a period when I kept asking myself questions like, \

I'd see people getting good jobs, starting businesses, buying cars, or reaching goals that were still on my wish list. Instead of being happy for them, I would quietly wonder if I had made the wrong choices somewhere along the way.
‎
‎That habit did not help me at all. It slowly took away my confidence because I became too focused on what others had accomplished. I forgot to appreciate the little wins in my own life. I was learning, growing, and making progress, but because my journey did not look like someone else's, I felt like I was not doing enough.
‎
‎As time goes on, I realized that comparison is not always fair. We all come from different backgrounds. Some people have opportunities that others don't. While some have stronger support systems, while others have to figure everything out on their own just like me. Everyone is walking a different road, so expecting our stories to unfold the same way doesn't make sense.
‎
‎For me, comparison mainly affected my peace of mind. Instead of celebrating my progress, I was busy worrying about how far ahead someone else was. That only left me feeling discouraged and drained.
‎
‎On the other hand, I don't think comparison is completely bad. Sometimes, seeing someone succeed can give us the push we need to work harder. It reminds us that our goals are achievable if we stay focused and keep putting in the effort. The problem starts when admiration turns into jealousy or when we begin to believe that we are not good enough simply because someone else is ahead.
‎
‎These days, I try to focus on my own journey. I still admire people who are doing well, but I no longer use their success as a reason to doubt myself. But instead, I remind myself that everyone's timing is different.
‎
‎I have learned that real progress is not about competing with others. But it's about becoming a better version of yourself than you were yesterday. As long as I'm improving, learning from my mistakes, and moving forward, I'm on the right path. My story doesn't have to look like anyone else's to be meaningful, and neither does yours too.
‎

‎
‎Thanks for reading!!!!
‎

I’ve tested some features that, as a regular Hive user, I’ll be using frequently. I haven’t tested other features, such as importing EMV accounts. Among the features I’ve tested is creating a functional account (@doscuervos), which I’ve used to publish (this post), vote, and comment without any difficulty.
>Un saludo muy grande a la comunidad Loving HIVE❤️, espero que todas y todas estén bien. >Éste texto está publicado por @enraizar con una cuenta creada desde la nueva Keychain Multichain (Open Beta) desde mi ordenador de mesa. >Es una respuesta al desafío planteado por #Keychain. Dejo aquí el enlace: >[Enlace](https://peakd.com/keychain/@keychain/keychain-multichain-explorer-challenge) >En esta publicación trataré de dejar mis impresiones después de probar la Keychain Multichain (Open Beta) instalada en google chrome desde la Chrome Web Store. >He probado algunas funciones que, como usuario habitual de Hive, voy a utilizar de forma frecuente. Otras funciones no las he probado como la importación de cuentas EMV. >Entre las funciones probadas se encuentra la creación de una cuenta funcional (@doscuervos), con la que he publicado (este post), votado y comentado sin niguna dificultad.

# Import Account // Importar cuenta

> Importing the @enraizar account (my account) was pretty straightforward. First, I created a password after accepting the terms of service, etc. The start menu opens in Google Chrome's default language—in my case, Spanish. This default language can be easily changed, as shown in the screenshot.
>Importar la cuenta de @enraizar (mi cuenta) ha sido bastante sencillo. Primero, he creado una contraseña, depués de aceptar los términos de servicio, etc. El menú de inicio se abre en el idioma principal de google chrome, en mi caso en español. Este idioma predeterminado se puede cambiar se forma sencilla como se puede ver en la captura de pantalla.
#

The next step was to enter the following in the blank fields: *username* and *private key*. The account name (enraizar) and the master password. >Después la importación de las llaves de la cuenta también me ha resultado mmy sencillo.

> So far, everything is working fine and without any problems. Just follow the on-screen instructions, and step by step, in a simple way, you'll have your account set up in Hive Keychain Multichain (Beta).
>Hasta aquí todo funciona bien y sin ningún problema. Sólo hay que seguir las indicaciones que van apareciendo y, paso a paso, de forma sencilla ya tenemos instalada nuestra cuenta en Hive Keychain Multichain (Beta).

# Side Menu // Menú lateral

> If you open the Hive Keychain and tap the top-left corner, a menu with various features will appear: Contacts - Network - Connected dApps - Hive settings - Advanced settings - Preferences and display - Help and information # I’ll try out some of these features later in this post.
>Si abrimos la Hive Keychain y pulsamos en la parte superior izquierda se despliega un menú con diversas funciones; >- Contacts >- Network >- Connected dApps >- Hive settings >- Configuración avanzada >- Preferencias y visualización >- Ayuda e informnación # >Algunas de estas funciones las probaré más adelante en esta misma publicación. #

# Exchanges // Intercambios

> At the bottom of the main screen, I see other features. Among them is one called **swap**. Tapping the swap icon opens a menu that gives me the option to swap. I try it out by swapping 1 Hive for HBD. The transaction results in 0.048 HBD, which immediately appear in my Enraizar account wallet.
>En la parte de abajo de la pantalla principal me encuentro con otras funciones. Entre ellas una que se llama **intercambiar**. >Pulsando sobre el icono de intercambio accedo a un menú que me da la opción de intercambiar. Hago una prueba cambiando 1 Hive por HBD. La operación da como resultado 0,048 HBD que parecen inmediatamente en mi billetera de la cuenta enraizar.
|![Captura de pantalla 2026-06-29 190353.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doscuervos/23yU4GQnEL8ftCdGsw1JBKssh4c5tqfiDJdiizWfYjEXVMHKsyPoGFhXufuta1BiGGk4J.png)||![16.08.33.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doscuervos/23wMyoDzzvNqX1i5t5fcxuotLwdxQ6kGchfb1XqQXASeE3f7ACrY57RUWyM888yCBm3UX.png)| |-|-|-|

# Create a new account // Crear una cuenta nueva

> The next challenge was to create a new, functional Hive account using Hive Keychain Multichain. Clicking on the upper-right corner of the home page brings up a new menu with a feature called **Add Account**. I click the **Add Account** button, and a new screen titled **Setup** appears. I then click the **Create Account** option. Another screen appears showing my username @enraizar, a blank field to enter the new account’s name, and the transaction fee: 3 HIVE. I fill in the blank field with the new username @doscuervos and click **Next**. The next screen displays the new account’s keys and two options: **Copy Keys** and **Create**. The problem I encountered here was that if I copied the keys and pasted them into a document created for them, the Multichain Hive Keychain would crash, and I had to repeat the process. However, by following these steps, I had no issues: copy the keys, click “Create,” and then paste the keys into a secure location.
>El siguiente reto fue crear una cuenta nueva de Hive y funcional con Hive Keychain Multichain. Pulsando sobre la esquina superior derecha de la página principal aparece un nuevo menú con una función que llanada **agregar cuenta**. >Pulso en el botón **agregar cuenta** y aparece una nueva pantalla llamada** instalación**. Entonces pulso la opción crear cuenta. >De nuevo aparece una nueba pantalla en la que aperece mi usuario @enraizar, un campo en blanco para escribir el nombre de la nueva cuenta y el percio de la operación; 3 HIVE. >Relleno el campo en blanco con el nuevo usuario @doscuervos, y pulso; siuiente, >En laa siguiente pantalla aparecen las llaves de la nueva cuenta y dos opciones: copiar las llaves y crear. >Aquí el problema que tuve es que si copiaba las llaves y las pegaba en un documento creado para ellas, la Hive Keychain Multichain se crraba y tenía que volver a repetri la operación. >Sin embargo, siguiendo los siguientes pasos no tuve problemas: copiar las llaves, pulsar crear para después pegar las llaves en un lugar seguro.
**

> In principle, the **contacts** function allows you to create a contact list of users from both Hive and Ethereum. I assume this is to streamline transactions between my account(s) and other Hive or Ethereum users. In my experience, after creating a single-user calendar, I was unable to access that user's profile in Hive. Perhaps I didn’t know how to use this feature properly, or perhaps, since it’s a beta version, some features are still under development.

Supomgo que para agilizar operaciones entre mi cuenta o cuentas y otros usuarios de Hive o Ethereum. >En mi experiencia, después de creada una agenda de un sólo usuario no pude acceder al perfil de ese usuario de Hive. >Quizás no supe supe hacer funcionar eat función o quizás como se trata de una versión Beta hay funciones que todavía están por desarrollar.

# Block // Bloqueo

> From the tab located in the upper-left corner of the app, a menu opens; I tapped the “Auto-Lock” option. On the Auto-Lock page, several options appear. Among them, I chose “Inactive Lock” and set it to 10 minutes. In theory, if the browser remains inactive for 10 minutes, Hive Keychain Multichain should lock. After testing it, this option works—it locks.
>Desde la pestaña situda en la esquina izquierda superior de la app se abre un menú pulsé la opción bloqueo automático. En la pagina bloque automático aparecen varias opciones. Entre ellas elegí el bloqueo inactivo y lo dejé en 10 minutos. En teoría, si el navegador permanece inactivo durante 10 minutos, Hive Keychain Multichain se debería bloquear. >Hecha la prueba, esta opción funciona, se bloquea.

> Exporting the settings is a feature that requires very few steps. I click on the upper-left corner again, and from the options that appear, I select “Export Settings.” When I click that option, a file with the .kc extension is generated and downloaded.

# Shortcuts // Atajos

> I assume that from this feature—which can also be accessed from the tab in the upper-left corner—I should be able to create shortcuts to certain functions. I think I followed the steps correctly; using the key combination 2 + Alt Gr should let me switch accounts. But I wasn't able to do that. Maybe, once again, it's because I don't quite understand how it works, or because the feature is still under development.
>Se supone que desde esta función, a la que accedemos también desde la pestaña situada el parte superior izquierda, se pueden crear accesos rápidos a algunas funciones. >Creo haber seguido los pasos de forma correcta, con la combinación de teclas 2 + alt gr debería poder cambiar de cuenta. Cosa que no logré. Quizás, de nuevo, o por no comprender muy bien como funciona o por ser una función todavía en desarrollo.

![Captura de pantalla 2026-06-27 090105.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doscuervos/23uFu4nAfQpnSAqT2nmckinj4gWUo7MzPAjCp2Yb67hzfehJGFRBAakTKCYWCwEP9SJQs.png)
# Shop // Comprar

> When you open Hive Keychain Multichain, you'll see a series of options at the bottom. Among them is one called **Buy**. Clicking it takes you to a menu with several exchanges; from there, I clicked on Binance. This takes me to the Binance website, where I can log in to my account without any issues after meeting the security requirements.
>Abriendo Hive Keychain Multichain, vemos que en la parte inferior tenemos una serie de opciones. Entre ellas una lalmada **comprar**. Pulsanod nos lleva a un meún con varias exchages, entre ella pulso sobre Binance. >Esta operación me lleva a la página de Binance y desde allí accedo a mi cuenta sin problema después de cumplir con los requisitos de seguridad.
|![Captura de pantalla 2026-06-29 193625.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doscuervos/23uRJ5TSetTS2w4DebuP2RF916Ha7vwgBamR6yubcTqHubkq8aSgaHcCwRq4m1yz4eNyh.png)||![Captura de pantalla 2026-06-29 193859.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doscuervos/23tmjDnZc8qrqV1KLUjzM6ABWDDmgVZwHAZMarFeopD4i5xyw2P7ZNTouddTk1mgoDWvp.png)| |-|-|-|
![Captura de pantalla 2026-06-29 090516.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doscuervos/23t76kWt4VaVAafc8fghvwMeUDkpXdZhmdXcqnhjU4cac3QuDDyy6tNvfsCFJEBVns99a.png)
# Problem // Problema

> I’ve been using Hive Keychain Multichain daily for several days now as a regular Hive user. I’ve only encountered one issue that happens occasionally. At home and at work, I access Hive from two different Wi-Fi networks. When the network changes, Hive asks me for my username and password to log back into Hive. On a few occasions, when I do this, Hive Keychain Multichain freezes. So, I close Chrome, and only on the second try am I able to log into my accounts. For now, I’ll keep using the new Hive Keychain; despite the occasional difficulty I’ve had, it works pretty well for someone who posts on Hive. Whenever I want to access Hivedex.io, I'll use the previous version of Hive Keycahin. I hope these impressions are helpful.
>Llevo usando a diario Hive Keychain Multichain desde hace varios días como un usuario más de Hive. Sólo he encontrado un problema que me ocurre en ocasiones. >En casa y en el trabajo accedo a HIve desde dos redes Wifi diferentes. Cuando la red cambia, Hive me pide el usuario y la clave de acceso para volver a iniciar sesión en Hive. >En unas pocas ocasiones, al efctuar esta operación Hive Keychain Multichain se queda colgado. Entonces, salgo de Chrome y sólo en una segunda oportunidad puedo entrar en mis cuentas. >En principio, seguiré usando la nueva Hive Keychain, a pesar de alguna dificultad que he tenido, funciona bastante bien para un creador de publicaciones en Hive. >Cuando quiera consultar Hivedex.io utilizaré la versión anterior de Hive Keycahin. >Espero que estas impresiones sean de alguna utilidad.

body.title: Mundial de 1978 donde la pasión llegó a la Universidad.
body.body:
>

#### Saludos amigos de hiveargentina.

#
 
*Había escrito para publicar en la iniciativa **Me pasó en un mundial** hace varios dias, pero desde el dia 24 de junio mi cuerpo, mi mente y mi alma, estaban ausentes de Hive y me siento completamente abrumada por los sucesos de mi país. Pero me alegra poder hacerlo hoy. Y es que mis recuerdos futbolísticos son muy gratos y quiero compartirlos con ustedes.* 
 


<center>![1000757526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/AKNK3KZ9RwwmBCoEzUTVutHL8v59vspHh3LuxDEUmGcK8BYEoCyFtwH66gdJPdV.jpg)</center>

***

 
Hace muchos años atrás,  el futbol  no era un deporte muy popular en Venezuela, como lo era el béisbol y el baloncesto. Los venezolanos seguíamos las competencias, apoyando a algunos de los equipos participantes. Y para la mayoría el equipo de Brasil era el gran favorito. 
 
En mi familia, preferíamos al equipo de Alemania, influidos por esa ascendencia que venía de mi abuelo, que era alemán. Así que todas mis hermanas eran fanáticas de Alemania y yo también. Pero esa preferencia cambio en el Campeonato Mundial del año 1978. 


<center>![1000757580.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/Eou8HPYkqwEzNYc4NWHWFandv3VNKmfqryxXgbPdx4ED966TQw2scvjunKcSnWWKquk.jpg)</center><center>[fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/campeonato-europeo-de-futbol-1420475/)</center>


***


 
En ese año yo estaba estudiando en la Universidad, en la Facultad de Agronomía, que quedaba en la ciudad de Maracay. Vivía en una residencia con varias amigas y cuando inicio el campeonato ese año, cuando las clases y los examenes, nos lo permitían,  veíamos los juegos en unos salones de clase que tenían varios televisores. Eran el lugar de reunión, para ver los juegos con permiso de las autoridades. 
 
Aunque eran años difíciles en Argentina, el mundial se dio y con este la pasión que este deporte hace sentir. 
 
Allí comenzó mi interés por el equipo de Argentina, pues mi amiga era súper fanática y en especial admiraba al jugador Mario Kempes, que además de un excelente goleador, le parecía muy atractivo con su cabellera larga, corriendo en el campo detrás del balón. Era su ídolo y terminó siendo también el mío. 



<center>![1000757576.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/EoK5H8vEm2csQ8nqCVk1fwC1fuwtzzTx4sUXKrZpMSZ1NmAWHD7AuVvia8SmXnvRwTD.jpg)</center></center>[fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/copa-mundial-f%C3%BAtbol-pelota-partido-3458003/)</center>

***
 
En ese mundial recuerdo muy bién el juego decisivo para que Argentina fuera a la final.  Jugaba con Perú pero no solo necesitaba ganar, sino que tenía que hacerlo por lo menos con cuatro goles de diferencia, si no lo hacia, Brasil iría a la final. Era Argentina o Brasil. 


 
El salón de clases estaba lleno de estudiantes, la mayoría hombres y fanáticos del equipo de Brasil y allí estábamos mi amiga y yo, sentadas una al lado de la otra, dispuestas a ver a nuestro equipo ganar. Un amigo nuestro estaba en ese momento presentando un examen y no podía ver el juego y nosotras, como acordamos,  le íbamos informando como iba el encuentro y cuando se producía un gol. 

Era muy gracioso porque fueron seis los goles que metió Argentina y seis veces las veces que salimos corriendo del aula hasta la puerta del salón donde estaban presentando examen y gritábamos, ¡gooool de Argentina!. Los profesores se reían. Era una gran diversión.
 
 
Cuando terminó el juego,  los estudiantes que seguían a Brasil, empezaron a gritar que el juego estaba vendido y que el equipo de Perú se había dejado meter los goles. ¡Qué  ofensa para el equipo de Argentina!. Pero nosotras, aunque en un principio defendimos a nuestro equipo, salimos del aula, felices y satisfechas del resultado. 



<center>![1000757579.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23vsSzDqftzFK5Bi7eUpWD8cDDN3kZKxPCBcNSARKawfnbaq2YwgppEcbk2t1WrAfFdvv.jpg)</center><center>[fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/bandera-argentina-mundial-dia-3476845/)</center>



 
Ese campeonato lo ganó Argentina y Mario Kempes fue el máximo goleador y aún hoy,recuerdo a algunos de los jugadores del equipo como Ardiles,  Passarela, Fillol.  Este fue el mundial que mas me ha emocionado, y la final contra Holanda fue apoteósica. 
 
En los siguientes campeonatos  continúe apoyando  a Argentina pero con el tiempo el equipo fue cambiando, como es natural  y ya no eran  los jugadores que yo admiraba. Ahora me gusta apoyar a los equipos que nunca han ganado, los que por primera vez juegan un mundial. Creo que también se merecen esa gloria. 
 
 Con los años seguí disfrutando de  los campeonatos, esta vez con mis hijos,  llenando los álbumes de barajitas, comprándoles franelas de sus equipos favoritos y disfrutando quizás con menos pasión de estos  juegos. 
 
 Nunca he jugado a la quiniela aunque en el lugar donde trabajaba un grupo de empleados se organizaban para hacerla, y muchos participaban. 
 
 Ahora que mis hijos ya no viven conmigo, veo  solo algunos juegos y en otros me conformo con ver los resúmenes., sobre todo en las primeras etapas.  Me emociono mas cuando puedo  ver un  partido al mismo tiempo que con  dos de  mis hijas, que son las mas fanáticas y con mis hermanas, porque a través del teléfono lo vamos comentando. Las maravillas de usar  esta tecnología. 
 
 Dos de mis hijas viven en Buenos Aires y me cuenta que cuando juega Argentina la ciudad se paraliza. \

y la que trabaja como barista en una cafetería,  en días pasados cuando Argentina jugó contra Austria, me envió una fotografía de un café con los colores del equipo y de la bandera , diciéndome Hoy los cafés los hago así. 
 
Me alegra que ellas vivan  esta pasión por el fútbol en uno de los países con mayor tradición futbolística del mundo  y por supuesto manteniendo la esperanza  de que los venezolanos podamos sentir esa alegría y orgullo de ver jugar a nuestro equipo, el que llamamos cariñosamente la Vinotinto, en el próximo mundial. 

<center> 🇻🇪💛💙❤️🙏</center>

***

. Aquí el [enlace]( https://hive.blog/hive-161447/@hiveargentina/div-classtext-justify-nbspn-398). Aunque no se si les dara tiempo invito a @maxjuligf y @katleya. ![17828481038607980073651574537401.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23yJLuSDVwFfxjCTSHxZWiY4o7ZnrwH96deWhqKQeQJDbiJtiAa3WBUFDQifakvWbjsCT.jpg) La imagen de la presentación la edite en Canva.

body.title: From Strategy to Execution: The SpearTrades Journey Begins on Hive
body.body: ## 👋 Hello Hive Every meaningful journey begins with a single step. Today, we are excited to take that step by introducing **SpearTrades** to the Hive community. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVtWwyJm72m5Z2b8sh4CE3n1v2m1vTkb93g2x4dSGBYmy/image.png) This account is more than a new presence on the Hive blockchain. It represents years of experience in financial technology, months of planning, and a shared vision of making market research more accessible, more reliable, and easier to understand. Most importantly, it marks the beginning of a journey that we hope to share with all of you. ## 📖 Every Platform Has a Story The crypto industry is filled with platforms that promise better signals, smarter tools, and more accurate analysis. Behind every platform, however, there is a story. This is ours. Earlier this month, our team gathered for an internal strategy workshop with one simple question. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRVJHNnXxF6ud1XdrxwGXPajMrTCG4L3tK7UV5t6X5tQV/image.png) At workshop in Delhi, India **If we could build the trading platform that we always wished existed, what would it look like?** Ideas covered the whiteboards. Features were debated. Priorities evolved. Roadmaps were created. Every discussion centered around one goal: building a platform that traders could genuinely trust. One milestone from that workshop stood out. We wanted SpearTrades to become part of the Hive blockchain. Today, that vision becomes reality. ## 🎯 Why SpearTrades The financial markets generate an overwhelming amount of information every single day. Some of it is valuable. Much of it is simply noise. For many traders, the biggest challenge is not finding information. It is knowing which information deserves their attention. That challenge inspired the creation of SpearTrades. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZj9GBu3LrRtUTkqKi2DWTR6qh2ALx6e7U4uEBxVQYdUv/image.png) The name reflects the values we want every piece of our work to represent. A spear symbolizes precision, focus, and purpose. Just as a spear reaches its target with accuracy, we strive to deliver market insights that are clear, reliable, and actionable. The word **Trades** represents the foundation of our platform by bringing together research, education, technical analysis, and market intelligence that help traders make informed decisions with confidence. Together, SpearTrades stands for integrity, precision, and purpose. Our mission is simple. We want to make crypto easier to understand so that every trader can approach the market with greater clarity and confidence. ## The Vision Behind SpearTrades ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYEtenUgDrAPg9pVEysVzWXuJSi8HHHAAP4nXVbbqYzti/image.png) Meet the Founder of SpearTrades SpearTrades was founded by **Sumit Arya**, a technology leader whose career has been dedicated to building digital solutions for global financial institutions. After years of leading digital transformation initiatives across commercial banking, treasury services, wealth management, payments, and capital markets, one belief became increasingly clear. Technology should simplify complex financial decisions, not make them more confusing. At the same time, his passion for blockchain technology continued to grow. He recognized the incredible potential of decentralized technologies, but also saw how difficult it could be for many people to separate meaningful insights from market noise. That realization became the foundation of SpearTrades. The goal was never to build another website filled with opinions. The goal was to build a platform where research, education, and data work together to help traders make better decisions. ## 🌍 Learning Beyond the Screen ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVsnbgDJGmGjKgYY5hy2MFSQdNw3jWz5BxJ6cYcyCszPf/image.png) We believe meaningful market insights come from more than charts and price movements. They also come from conversations with builders, developers, founders, investors, and members of the global blockchain community. That is why our team actively participates in major blockchain events, including **The Bitcoin Conference 2026, LAS VEGAS** and the **Blockchain Futurist Conference 2025** that happened in December. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbCdKuhZazXeVNpRxqX2Cn8jahPjWe9qyGVMb1JKqy8sM/image.png) Team Speartrades at The Bitcoin Conference 2026, LAS VEGAS These experiences help us stay connected with the industry's rapid evolution while continuously improving the products and insights we deliver. ## Why Hive ? When we created the roadmap for SpearTrades, joining Hive was never an afterthought. It was one of our earliest goals. Hive is home to people who value thoughtful discussions, detailed research, meaningful conversations, and community driven growth. Those values closely align with our own. Rather than using this account only for announcements, we want it to become a place where we share knowledge, technical analysis, educational content, and the journey of building SpearTrades. ## 📈 What You Can Expect ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWCC3rHrWGMxRwEkjAMr4WzCijZw9vFotJRN9Sbpe9VwS/chatgpt_image_jul_1_2026_01_56_28_am.png) This is only the beginning. In the weeks and months ahead, we will share: • Technical analysis • Educational articles • Market insights • Behind the scenes updates • Product development milestones • Industry observations Whether you are an experienced trader or someone taking your very first steps into digital assets, we hope every visit to this page leaves you with something valuable. ## Explore SpearTrades If you would like to experience everything we are building, you can explore SpearTrades through our website or download our mobile application. ### 💻 Visit Our Website Discover powerful market insights, technical analysis, and trading tools designed to help you make more informed decisions. #
