body.title: Three Tune Tuesday - KEXP
body.body:
## Hello, music lovers! 🎵  

On #threetunestuesday, I reflect on the music I listened to growing up and the music I had access to. And when something reminds me of moments from my youth, I try to relive those memories through music. 

Since I haven’t posted in a while, this entry will be a bit different. I'll share some bands I’ve been listening to frequently lately—on the radio. Yes, KEXP is a Seattle radio station that has been broadcasting since 1972.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVJPWaqk5pfFyKPZjiVdvKZBZ1NtL8Z7bebEffCt2Xv37/ttt88_kexp_logo_novi.webp)

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  
 
For those of you who are not (yet) familiar with #threetunetuesday or #ttt, these are the tags you need to use when you post. 
It's a music initiative started by @ablaze, and with his words, the gist is as follows: 
>*Every Tuesday I'm going to share 3 songs that I like to listen to, and I invite your feedback in the comments below. Better still, why not have a blast of your own Three Tune Tuesday and mention me in the post and I'll come and find the post and upvote it. If you could also use #threetunetuesday tag that would be great, as that is what I use when sifting through all the entries every Wednesday. It'll be a sweet way for us all to discover new music. You'll also be in with a chance of winning the reward.*  
 
<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  


Continuing with KEXP, it’s widely regarded as one of the most influential non-commercial radio stations in the world, specializing in indie, alternative, rock, electronic, hip-hop, and world music. I first discovered it through the show “Live on KEXP,” which launched in 2001. Since 2010, when the show launched its YouTube channel, it has become a global phenomenon, now boasting millions of subscribers and billions of views. One reason for its success is its exceptional sound production; almost every major (and many up-and-coming) musician wants to perform in its studios.

Here are a few live performances on KEXP that I really enjoy. A typical performance lasts about 30 minutes; I hope it won't be too long for you—after all, I'm sharing this with fellow music lovers :)

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  

# BALTHVS 

BALTHVS is a Colombian psychedelic funk/rock trio from Bogotá; they have been performing since 2020 and have released five studio albums. They have gained recognition through performances at international festivals such as SXSW, Lollapalooza, and Austin City Limits.
Track list: Anouk, Ojos Verdes, Johanna's Dream, Turkish Coffee.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DKE7Bb3wjhg

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  

# Kerala Dust

Kerala Dust is a British electronic/psychedelic rock band that blends indie, blues, desert rock, techno, and atmospheric sounds. Formed in 2016 in London, the band currently splits its time between Berlin and Zurich. It has released four studio albums. It is known for its deep, nocturnal, groovy sound, with influences ranging from CAN and the Velvet Underground to the electronic music scene. 
Track list: The Orb TX, How The Light Gets In, Love In The Underground, White Noise.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mY-pIPaZwQg

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  

# Frankie and The Witch Fingers

Frankie and the Witch Fingers is an American band known for its energetic live performances. The band formed in 2013 in Bloomington, Indiana, and is now based in Los Angeles, USA. They have released eight studio albums.
They play psychedelic rock with strong influences from garage, post-punk, krautrock, funk, and new wave elements. Their sound has evolved significantly over the years—from surf/garage to heavy, chaotic psychedelic melodies and, more recently, industrial-tinged punk.
Track list: Empire, Burn Me Down, Mild Davis, Futurephobic.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QRiDjativSY

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  

And as a bonus, **Thievery Corporation**, an American electronic/downtempo duo from Washington, D.C., which has been creating songs for more than 30 years. Tracks: Forgotten People, Le Monde, All That We Perceive, Amerimacka, Culture Of Fear.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5eK6SYVyZRk

<center>🎵 🎧 🎵</center>  

That's all for now - keep enjoying the music and the summer heat!

*This is my 88th post for #threetunetuesday, which @ablaze started. 
I hope what I'm sharing is enjoyable for others, too, because then it makes sense.*

Want to hear more interesting artists? 
Here are all my #ttt posts => **Three Tune Tuesday Forever** 
https://ecency.com/hive-193816/@seckorama/three-tune-tuesday-forever 
 
If you're curious about the fresh music, follow me on #newtunes
https://ecency.com/@seckorama/new-tunes-26-6-2026
 
or, take a look at my alternative and underground live recordings at [3speak channel - video](https://3speak.tv/p/seckorama)

body.title: Massesect E.P. Goon Scrolling Plus Music Video!!!
body.body:
![a-disturbing-horrorcore-album-cover-depi_9ujYz-wgQt-Q-_PP6XJi2A_qdGpk6SCTU2-3_U0XEyEbg.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYeuvZupKw7G9T54ha8DsKBUH6P14KHrLkADGehDK4zQ5/a-disturbing-horrorcore-album-cover-depi_9ujYz-wgQt-Q-_PP6XJi2A_qdGpk6SCTU2-3_U0XEyEbg.png)


*All Art And Music Made With Artificial Intelligence - Art - Ideogram - https://ideogram.ai/ Music made with Suno - https://suno.com/

## I wanted to make some Dark Pop/Hyperpop music. 

I was thinking about this correlation between Toxic Masculinity and Goon Scrolling/Doom Scrolling. I also wanted to make my own kind of Pop in imagining that the Pop was hard edged and brutal. Sometimes those Divas really dig into the men. So I thought perfect!! We will get these tough Pop singers to take on the Toxic Men who degrade themselves and women they goon to online. It can even apply to A.I. fake women who don't exist that are meant to be sexy and listen to whatever the guy says LOL because no one wants to talk to them or be with them in real life.

Here is the title track Goon Scrolling for which there is a music video but for a different version of the song

https://youtu.be/dxWwvBqAUiE?si=qhOFRtOy8xEC177c

Spotify - https://open.spotify.com/track/2O07AwPhHZgxkVCBxvRdRA?si=4d4a0503e104456c



![a-disturbing-surreal-album-cover-in-the-_9ql8uGDzQL6G2z07ixWSFw_azIRmNaLRnm7lpvIlYgl0w.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSiAw3dLbMDdNsGnWGppfbFDSXsaHHfHZGMSSofuYnQEy/a-disturbing-surreal-album-cover-in-the-_9ql8uGDzQL6G2z07ixWSFw_azIRmNaLRnm7lpvIlYgl0w.png)


## I like how these songs came out! Pretty energetic and edgy

I did a few variations and versions of the song, some are the same but different music structure, others are similar but different. The next song I want to show you is called Goon Scroller Sickness. I like this song a lot. These songs do deal with internet addiction and toxic masculinity. I think the lyrics are slick and really dig in. The singer is great. I made the songs a bit Industrial too which ads to the brutal factor

Goon Scroller Sickness YouTube - 

https://youtu.be/ADA1mB7dC00?si=AmsngnYuQikUy2BG

Spotify - https://open.spotify.com/track/7c6parU5DP7D9uQc0iBjoz?si=a19156c1a8f64b0b

![a-surreal-horrorcore-album-cover-depicti_44Rbhz0SRcOoYGD4tMF2aA_PZ2h9kWgQ128rmYw11bzBg_cover.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXJUTTPUHQCvYP3jgeVfFNpLjJUhQ7cg5TJq1SjXGbbbD/a-surreal-horrorcore-album-cover-depicti_44Rbhz0SRcOoYGD4tMF2aA_PZ2h9kWgQ128rmYw11bzBg_cover.png)


## Next I would like to show you the Music Video for Goon Scrolling (Blue Glow Version)

 I made the video using Vidmuse A.I. - https://vidmuse.ai/ The video turned out pretty great! I did it in higher quality so I actually ran out of credits at Vidmuse. Vidmuse is not perfect. I had to repeat some scenes at the end and for the chorus but the music video still had a good effect. I tried to advertise it but it was too controversial. I think the title and imagery were problematic. I still really like the video!! Some backrooms themes, some glitch effects. Pretty cool!!

Here is the music video

https://youtu.be/-vZXZVMuzJg?si=7Im9Ml-X6cSLj2zJ

Here is the song Goon Scrolling (Blue Glow Version) On Spotify - 

https://open.spotify.com/track/1ZtE7PhTayioJPvDlWjYLf?si=16002a46d68846cb


![a-surreal-horrorcore-album-cover-depicti_-wSLtJg5T_qxJyhxuv0E-A_nInNMjfqSQ-JF5lV_9Ln8Q_cover.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYjXCSiKc9mshWUYHmSWsQgKanXRjQtV9f683PXoj31KG/a-surreal-horrorcore-album-cover-depicti_-wSLtJg5T_qxJyhxuv0E-A_nInNMjfqSQ-JF5lV_9Ln8Q_cover.png)

## There Are A Couple Extra Songs Too!

They are not so much Darkpop/Hyperpop yet still fit into the vibe. The next song talks about being treated as a consumer object/project in a culture of overconsumption and hyper individualism. The sentiment rebels against this sort of objectification. The other song that's different also deals with this subject as well. Fits in with the Doom/Goonscrolling theme.

The song is called Plastic In The Blood. It's more fast pace and kinda grungy feeling in an electro sort of way

https://youtu.be/TpkPHJg1HtI?si=BzMkootGnbsKxAYo


![a-disturbing-surreal-album-cover-in-the-_-WhXL8uDQyu1O_xKRjBc1g_-dfDsygNQ1WlXswyB6--sw_cover.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYgC3XZgmtwnsktMsvNNbqn1XxDYFNTbereZDTARX6Uut/a-disturbing-surreal-album-cover-in-the-_-WhXL8uDQyu1O_xKRjBc1g_-dfDsygNQ1WlXswyB6--sw_cover.png)

## The Last Song I Will Show You Is Called Object-Oriented Suffering

The song has a more Industrial Music feel to it. Kinda slams. The lyrics are good. Talks about not being a product or content for online consumption. Like how people get targeted by online propaganda to sell you hype and every time you like or share it makes them more money. Whether it be a news source, a product placement or social media platform the more you engage the more you give virality and profit to bad actors and corruption. Falling prey to propaganda can also harm yourself or your community and give you psychosis and believe things that aren't real if you are not careful. Pretty good song! I was glad to fit a few different songs onto Goon Scrolling E.P.


![a-disturbing-surreal-album-cover-in-the-_rL2d8xC0RCqrskm7XsMkEQ_xJ-avkPrRwa6TTrnI6oiQw.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXK2hPywbv4kYM8KTmrrTgXaJq7kVuaXNyRSLUz5pgD2A/a-disturbing-surreal-album-cover-in-the-_rL2d8xC0RCqrskm7XsMkEQ_xJ-avkPrRwa6TTrnI6oiQw.png)

Thanks for checking out the music! I hope you found the music video interesting. I look forward to making more music and posting again soon! I'm finding it very therapeutic, it's one of those things that make the days better. I've been trying to do more and more self care lately, I need it and it is good for me!!

Here is Massesect Goon Scrolling Full Album on YouTube - https://youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_l7L2p8CHp61YKGzA39FNkaI2QA8PfasAo&si=GZnA4VmhRDc8uVHt

Goon Scrolling Full E.P. Spotify - https://open.spotify.com/album/645OY5kpT3o49A7LgzU8CG?si=SnkGOazpRKKdGR8RjBrxkg

Massesect Goon Scrolling Apple Music - https://music.apple.com/us/album/goon-scrolling/1889182037

// Bienvenidos a un nuevo post para el #monomad challenge de @monochromes y la comunidad de #BlackAnWhite //

>_ Hola amigos y muchas gracias por visitar un post más de fotografía callejera.

Seguimos recorriendo las calles de Tula de Allende y en esta ocasión quisiera compartir con ustedes está pequeña selección de fotos.

Por que hay veces en las que es bastante difícil hacer las cosas, pero para mejorar aunque sea un poco, hay que hacerlas aunque no queramos o tengamos muchas ganas.

Espero que esta selección de fotos les guste.

>
// Welcome to a new post for the #monomad challenge by @monochromes and the #BlackAnWhite community //

>_ Hello friends, and thank you so much for visiting another street photography post.

We continue exploring the streets of Tula de Allende, and this time I'd like to share this small selection of photos with you.

Because sometimes things are quite difficult, but to improve, even just a little, we have to do them even if we don't want to or don't really feel like it.

I hope you enjoy this selection of photos.

>_ Que estén teniendo un excelente día y una excelente semana todos ustedes.

Y recuerden, sigan haciendo sus cosas aunque no tengan muchas ganas.

Que tengan un excelente día.

>

>_ Have a wonderful day and a wonderful week, everyone.

And remember, keep doing your things even if you don't feel like it.

Have a great day.

body.title: 🗳️ Głosowanie na najlepszy post tygodnia w #pl-travelfeed! Tydzień 342
body.body:
>

![PLTF26.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pl-travelfeed/23wWyBwBVKwnqMW8cMUrXZZBfpLoyp8pN6CtvyccUWtSaMTBd3AdpBmYgRnStRj2M9MDH.png)

## Cześć Podróżnicy! 👋

Mijający tydzień w naszym tagu **#pl-travelfeed** był wyjątkowo bogaty – od Beskidu Niskiego i chorwackich wodospadów, przez włoskie zamki i Watykan, aż po prehistoryczne petroglify w Nowym Meksyku i dalej na zachód USA. Jak zwykle nie obyło się bez kilku postów, które szczególnie przykuły moją uwagę i o których chcę Wam dziś opowiedzieć.

Tym razem nie będę niczego oceniał ani ustawiał w jakiejkolwiek kolejności – po prostu prezentuję Wam siedmiu kandydatów do tytułu **najlepszego posta tygodnia**. Zerknijcie na każdego z nich, przeczytajcie, a swój głos zostawcie w komentarzu pod tym wpisem (i oczywiście odwiedźcie same posty – autorzy zawsze są wdzięczni za każdą wizytę i głos!).

Do dzieła! 👇

---

## 🇵🇱 @ladytruckview – *Found Somewhere in the Beskid Niski*

![Beskid Niski](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pl-travelfeed/23zkhxXk94ACmhFX5C9Wx9q7Q5LpmE8kqZ5Vg2VtL3GQFFbzQFuNWkeujdcCcn1fu9iDg.png)

Podróż myślami do Polski, do Beskidu Niskiego – i do prawosławnej cerkwi w Wołowcu, schowanej tak głęboko w terenie, że autorka i jej towarzyszki niemal zawróciły z drogi, zanim ją odnalazły. Drewniana świątynia z trzema kopułami i niemym świadectwem łemkowskiej przeszłości tego regionu.

🔗 [Czytaj cały post](https://hive.blog/hive-163772/@ladytruckview/found-somewhere-in-the-beskid-niski)

---

## 🇭🇷 @rsphotos – *Photo Trip | Croatia – Fort Bourguignon (Fort Monsival) in Pula*

![Fort Bourguignon Pula](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pl-travelfeed/23zGVyi9KdrDuWXLdP9uNgQcN1XGYNG6hzr1LYLxwbZwUTWjqchQqchSoqnCrFahRRuGq.jpg)

Przypadkowe odkrycie poza utartymi szlakami – XIX-wieczny fort austriacki na wzgórzu w Puli, z fosą, armatami i historią rave'owych imprez z przełomu wieków. Autor odwiedził go samotnie, nie napotykając innych turystów.

🔗 [Czytaj cały post](https://hive.blog/hive-163772/@rsphotos/photo-trip-or-croatia-fort-bourguignon-fort-monsival-in-pula)

---

## 🇻🇦 @arsky – *Kartka z Foto Kalendarza – Watykan, Bazylika św. Piotra*

![Watykan](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pl-travelfeed/23ynSNTKQjyRgWx8tGK7Rx8dcSxXn7vf2SdMEi1a6ZaqXdLQu29YA9QiAknqpcvYAtH6f.png)

Czarno-biała odsłona serii „Foto Kalendarza\

jeszcze przed wyjazdem, zafascynowany dronowymi ujęciami z YouTube. Spacer drewnianymi kładkami, punkty widokowe, krystalicznie czysta woda i XIX-wieczna zabudowa na szczycie trasy. 🔗 [Czytaj cały post](https://hive.blog/hive-163772/@rsphotos/photo-trip-or-croatia-waterfalls-in-krka-national-park) --- ## 📋 Zasady głosowania Przypominam zasady głosowania. Każdy głosujący wybiera z zaprezentowanych publikacji trzy i głosuje w następujący sposób (3 pkt, 2 pkt i 1 pkt). **Czas głosowania do godziny 20:00 – 4 lipca 2026 r.** Do głosowania zapraszam wszystkich, w szczególności użytkowników tagu #pl-travelfeed, których posty brały udział w konkursie: @aleximprovement, @alongthetrail, @amadek, @asia-pl, @arsky, @avtandil, @bowess, @browery, @brudnopis, @grecki-bazar-ewy, @grupa-rowerowa, @gryfno.frelka, @gwyddpel, @hallmann, @helcim, @inmyframe, @kadr-pokaze, @kapitanrosomak, @klub-wloczykijow, @kowalscy-team, @ladytruckview, @lukaszolejnik, @marianomariano, @mligeza, @olusiu, @racibo, @rolsonpatison, @rsphotos, @rye.man, @stafhalr, @szejq, @voitaksoutache, @wadera, @waryszak, @wayward-dreams, @willowink @sk1920, @merthin, @ewkaw, @zjawiamsie. --- ## A teraz Wasza kolej! 🙌 Siedmiu publikacji, siedem zupełnie różnych klimatów – drewniane świątynie, chorwackie twierdze i wodospady, czarno-biały Watykan, wulkaniczne pustkowia Nowego Meksyku, włoski zamek nad morzem i czeskie góry w deszczu. Wybierzcie swoją trójkę i rozdajcie punkty (3, 2, 1) w komentarzu pod tym wpisem – i koniecznie zajrzyjcie też do samych autorów, żeby zostawić im głos i kilka miłych słów. 🍻 Publikujcie kolejne posty podróżnicze, niech będzie ich jak najwięcej. Do zobaczenia w kolejnym podsumowaniu!

by @bardsilver on Brave-Smoke's Corner 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/bravesmoke [![WWG English](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/e8124e87-db96-4915-846d-84b015f9d57f.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/5jPYzHYspSKSF981mSraDL) 
 
 Wen Wang Gua (Chinese: 文王卦; pinyin: Wén Wáng Guà) is a method of interpreting the results of I Ching divination that was first described in writing by Jing Fang in Han dynasty China. It is based on correlating trigrams to the Celestial Stems and Earthly Branches of the Chinese calendar, and then using the stem and branch elements to interpret the lines of the trigrams and hexagrams of the I Ching. The method is popular in South East Asia. It is known by various names: (Liu Yao) (six lines divination) refers to the fact that it interprets the meaning of six symbols; the Najia method, indicates its logic of elemental values derived from the Chinese calendar; Huo Zhu Lin (火珠林), or the Fire Pearl Forest method, refers to a classical textual tradition associated with this form of divination; Wu Xing Yi (changes of the five elements); or Wen Wang Ke (Lessons of King Wen).

Despite being the mainstream method of practical IChing divination in China, Wen Wang Gua and the Na Jia system were largely absent from major English-language translations of the I Ching throughout the twentieth century.

body.title: Little  Brother (2026) Movie Review
body.body:
The other day I was looking for a light, happy film (preferably less than 2 hours duration), and as I was too bored to search more - I decided to choose the Little Brother. 

I also have a little brother, so perhaps subconsciously, it was one of the reasons I decided to watch. It was not romcom or other comedy, I did not see any familiar faces; So it was mostly a matter of luck at what I would fall into! 

Little Brother - aired on Netflix recently! 1h 42 minutes!


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNRCrK3N2ctAEoY3ek7C1qQ26K6WdaM83C3wmpBom9XCy/image.png)
https://www.imdb.com/title/tt34888871/

The rating already shows in the picture, but let me provide more insights and you can judge after a short while.

What you will mainly find in this film, is a few scenes of true laughter, some chaotic fun from time to time, some real connection and feelings, but also some annoying (at least for me) scenes.

This is a typical Hollywood style of movies ..

Directed by Matt Spicer and starring John Cena and Eric André, the film is an odd-couple comedy that relies heavily on outrageous situations, and the relationship between its two lead actors

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWQ4Tgfc8kLvo7ZixoVRDpedYVdpfSAQGoD77wUwaduXV/image.png)

Cena plays Rudd, a successful real estate agent whose perfectly organized life is thrown into disarray when Marcus (Eric André), his wildly unpredictable former \

from a mentorship program, unexpectedly returns. What follows is a series of unpredictable and maybe even ridiculous events that force Rudd to change his entire cosmo theory


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQwHVbaMAWJnJzAwrLQGNLnWbLb499p3XaHwUfmZVk3jF/image.png)


The movie's biggest strength is undoubtedly its cast. Their contrasting personalities create several genuinely laugh-out-loud moments, even if some jokes miss the mark. Michelle Monaghan and Christopher Meloni provide solid supporting performances without stealing the spotlight.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVRiZJ7Ebjb2Aws8wtWVQp6dgixPjxbYUKCF17A858JaU/image.png)


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdhWPLrgnc2GfDAaSHokd3PidnkS516czUFAv5GhfmDeU/image.png)
It took me sometime to recognize Meloni!


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWu9MJkaEXBC9tdZ13Jtc3acQmVMT6uphku8ySxtg16LZ/image.png)


That said, this movie isn't particularly original. The plot follows a familiar type of story and struggles to balance heartfelt moments with its over-the-top comedy.  Critics have been divided


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYVhFYT9AFgwHxcQw4yy9H91NH9TwzvGDPDi8FTYvUgjY/image.png)

Please note:


> Motion Picture Rating (MPA)
> Rated R for sexual content, language throughout, some drug use and brief graphic nudity.

Final words: Little Brother is a bit messy, occasionally heartfelt, and often funny enough to justify its runtime. Fans of modern buddy comedies will likely have a good time, even if they won't remember much of it next day. 

I will favor it with a 5, watch it if you are feeling bored and would like a few relaxing moments with a movie, that you could go to the bathroom, without caring to pause it : )

body.title: The potato plants are blooming.
body.body:
The potato plants are blooming.
And at our summer cottage, the potatoes are already blooming. 
We planted them early and watered them. Now the plants have grown and started to bloom. I hope we’ll have a good potato harvest. Because I really love potatoes. You can make lots of delicious things with potatoes. One of the tastiest dishes is pan-fried potatoes—I love them with onions. You can also bake them in the oven, like French-style potatoes. They’re also used to make mashed potatoes. At our house, we make mashed potatoes as a main dish for holidays. Potatoes are added to soup and borscht. Potato pies are delicious, too. 
Potatoes come in different sizes—some are large, and some are small—depending on the harvest. The main thing is to water them regularly. You also need to make sure the Colorado potato beetle doesn’t infest them. The Colorado potato beetle is a striped beetle that eats potatoes. Another pest that affects potatoes is the mole cricket. So you need to keep an eye out to prevent these problems. You need to remove them by hand or use special pesticides. 
Take good care of your potatoes, and they’ll reward you with a bountiful harvest. 
You also need to pull weeds around the potatoes. And when the plant gets bigger, use a hoe to gently move the soil toward the plant so the roots aren’t exposed.

body.body: I remember when we went to the control room of that company. We saw that red sign to find danger. I don't know if it was for alarm or it was for security purposes.\n\nI showed my friend and he jokingly said, \

. We told him not to that this might go to an unbearable consequence. We are afraid so we have to drag him back so that he does not follow his urges and curiosity but we wonder what that may be.

After so many inquiries we find that that was just an emergency button in case of any fire attack in the company.

body.title: Fashion Trends or Personal Style?
body.body: > Fashion has evolved over the years in so many ways. We saw the times when our parents were in baggy to now where everyone is Nikes. Fashion will keep evolving for as long humans exist and that’s what makes like beautiful and colorful. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeTamCmMKsXDwAGoRBGGJrkQK9e3UZgM1Ud5goYT9NBfM/ef8c6d2b_f676_4639_85de_98e4d68f644f.jpeg) We’ve seen fashion trends come and go but some styles stay for as long as they can. I love fashion and I love to look good all the time. But one thing I’ve never been fond of is following fashion trends. First of all, most trends that pop up aren’t really my thing and second of all, I don’t have the time and luxury to be following such trends. I’ve tried following trends but I really didn’t follow it through and through because I couldn’t keep up. And I realized to some extent I can’t keep up with these trends as it’s costly and also needs time and energy. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZP4VH8sta4MacQNFvtfxwDSBygyBfdiyXbHJEzoRs26X/b6e795c8_68aa_4598_805c_5054d311a06b.jpeg) I have my own style and I take pride in that. I prefer to look sleek and comfortable. And when I say comfortable, I mean comfortable. You’d never see me wear something that will make me feel uneasy in public or anywhere. I will always choose my comfort over anything else. And sometimes I like to go simple, nothing extra. I’ve had people tell me they love my style because it’s unique. Sometimes, I can be a bit extra but honestly I prefer my style. Fashion is what you make it and what you feel comfortable. Nothing else matters. - - - all images belong to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)

body.title: It’s not that the politicians cannot do things it is that they will not.
body.body:
![HOP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/23zbYHcTGe8GLotuxnTCTi5WnJTy3FZB1o8dg5pEkeADhTzqV3R9THgAL3EtiPuCytE9z.jpg)



There are both advantages and disadvantages of living in a Unitary State like the United Kingdom as opposed to a Federal State such the United States of America.  The advantage of a Unitary State is that it is nimble, it’s Constitutional settlement that can flex when necessary.  Such as if there was a sudden geopolitical emergency.

In the UK Parliament is literally King.  Parliament is Sovereign, it can basically pass almost any Law it wants. It can’t unilaterally change stuff like the Succession Settlement or decree that a Roman Catholic could become Monarch without consulting the Commonwealth, but apart from stuff like that Parliament can do what it damned well likes.

If Parliament wanted for example to restrict exports in time of geopolitical trouble then it could do that and did in 1939 with the Customs Powers (Defence) Act which was enacted just as War broke out. Britain also imposed ruthless government controls of food production and distribution, clothes, fuel, restricted movement and impressed the public into War Service during World War II.  It could do that so quickly in part because Britain is a Unitary State with supreme power residing in Parliament.

Yes I know that in the USA Federal Laws can be passed that bind all states no matter what, but unless there’s some convulsive national emergency for example the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbour or unless one party has massive majorities in both the House and the Senate, then big changes can be impeded.  Republicans may for example propose Bills that protect the sex barrier in sport in order that only women complete in women’s sports but the bill might be blocked by the Democrats. There’s also the matter of American political parties often being  Big Tent coalitions. Each party has both robust and conciliatory wings that need to be kept on side when proposing or opposing legislation. 

However the trade off in a Federal State is that the average person’s laws are made much closer to them than in a Unitary State.  Nebraskans make laws the are the choice of Nebraskans and in the Nebraskan legislature, Texans make laws that are the choice of Texans with some laws enacted on a Federal Level as per Article VI of the US Constitution. In America it appears that the Law that people interact with every day is more often State Law rather than Federal Law.

A disadvantage of a Unitary State and it is one that is shared by totalitarian regimes run under the Fuhrerprizip, is that what happens when your Parliament is full of madmen and women or your singular leader has lost the plot? We’ve all seen how frighteningly easy it is for a cohort of politicians to be possessed of some new and oddball ideology that ‘feels right’ but might not be right with the issue of Transgenderism.  At the height of this hysteria, when Troons were being celebrated as role models when drag queen storytime was being pushed at children, too many British politicians caught the bug and bought into the ideology of Trans.

This was and is not a phenomenon that is confined to one party, it’s a cross party infection.  It’s in the Labour Party, the Tories and especially in the Liberal Democrat Party I’m afraid the madness of trans is across the board, MP’s across nearly all the parties save probably Reform and some of the Ulster Protestant Parties sing with one voice on this matter although things are slowly changing.

If Parliament wanted and the party that proposed the measure had enough members in the Commons to carry the day we could see legislation that explicitly protected same sex places. The problem is it’s not because Parliament cannot enact such a law but they will not.  The ideological contagion of Trans in Parliament is still quite strong and it will be a while yet before enough MP’s give it up or are replaced at election time before such a law could be passed.  

A similar situation exists with regard to expelling from Britain some of the worst of those that Britain has imported. A good example of which is Shabir Ahmed a man who was the ringleader of one of Britain’s horrific Islamic Rape Gangs. He is due to be released after serving part of a long sentence for rape and other sexual offences connected to gang based child sexual exploitation. The government stripped this man who had migrated to Britain of his British Citizenship after his convictions. However he can’t be deported because of a loophole in the law that said that because he arrived prior to 1973 we cannot get rid of him.

Parliament could change this situation but they don’t.  There’s nothing preventing a government backed Private Members Bill or a Government Bill being put through Parliament that would remove this loophole, but they do not.

Here’s what Christopher Talbot a Law Student writing on X said about this situation (source link below).

“The claim that this grooming gang ringleader “cannot be deported” is not an absolute or constitutional barrier. In the UK, Parliament is sovereign. It can pass, amend, or repeal any law whatsoever. Courts cannot strike down primary legislation passed by Parliament. The current protection comes from a specific provision in the Immigration Act 1971 (section 7) that exempts certain Commonwealth citizens who arrived before 1973 from deportation, even after British citizenship has been stripped. Parliament could repeal or amend that provision, or pass new primary legislation expressly providing for the deportation (or removal) of foreign nationals convicted of serious child sexual offences, notwithstanding any other rule of law. If the Government wanted to deport him, it could introduce a Bill to do exactly that. Parliament could pass it. The current position is a choice under existing law, not an impossibility.”

He’s right.  Parliament could close this loophole or as Mr Talbot says pass specific legislation that deemed deportation or removal of foreign born sex offenders was to be carried out.  Parliament could do this but they do not.  The failure to make legislation that would enable Britons to be free of monsters like Ahmed and those like him is not forced on Parliament by the Courts, by nor international law (which many countries ignore when needed) nor any other reason.  Parliament not enacting laws to enable Britain to be rid of those who harm us is a conscious choice by Parliament.

Britain has a great advantage in its unitary status Parliament can move quickly in response to problems and challenges. A Parliamentary Democracy in a unitary state can do things faster and with more immediate national impact than a Federal system sometimes does.  The problem is that this power that Parliament has is squandered to the detriment of all.  We could have better controlled borders, we could have one law for all, we could have experimental low tax enterprise zones to rebuild our industrial base. We could have all manner of good laws including those that allow the removal of foreign rapists, if Parliament chose to do so.  If these Parliamentarians are addled in the head over issues like transgenderism or being nice to imported rapists then maybe we should replace them with some more suited to our needs and desires?

body.title: The Good, the Bad, and the Reality of Comparison
body.body: Comparison is one thing that has been in existence for years, and we see it plays out in different walks of life and can be done by literally anyone. An individual can compare himself to someone around him in diverse ways; one's parents or friends can compare their children to someone else's kids and so on and so forth, and to be honest, we can't disregard the fact that comparison sometimes can be toxic and dangerous to people being compared to others. Because one thing we won't understand is the fact that our journeys are different and you want to use other people's lives to judge or determine how well or terribly you're doing on your own. ![1000357331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/23wMcb8sVcE5bht7Lp1gNsgWZWrDKsJk5FE1pBQLaoireoe3udbTmEB15SZ42qKmF17Ln.jpg) On several occasions I've personally, on my own, compared myself with people around me, be they friends, neighbors, or someone else entirely. I can remember how during my primary and secondary school days I used to compare my parents to those of my friends or something, classmates. Why? Because some of them have well-to-do parents who can afford to get the best of everything, while I, on the other hand, had to manage things and even used things already used by my uncles or elder siblings. Other times when I'm in the university, I remember comparing my grade with that of my course mate. Also, before I got married, I can vividly remember how my parents would always be on my neck, reminding me of every single childhood friend of mine or neighbor's children who had recently gotten married or given birth to their own children, and that would lead to them asking me when I'd be getting married or moving on to the next stage of my life. Comparison can be bad, and I must say it also has its good. Bad in the sense that it can lead to unnecessary pressure on the individual being compared with someone else. Comparison has its good side in the sense that it can create a sense of awareness and the need to take necessary steps at the right time. Without comparing yourself with someone at times, it'll be difficult for you to know what next you ought to do. Because you thought you might not go to such an aspect, but via the comparison, you'll also use that avenue to better your life or what is being compared to the other person's. *** All photos are mine. ***

body.title: Batman: Arkham Asylum [Let's Play] - 11 - Harley Subdued
body.body:
*Batman finally subdues Harley Quinn and puts her into a cell... That leaves Joker and a few of the greatest villains.*

----

**[Batman: Arkham Asylum](https://store.steampowered.com/sub/320795/)** is *the* superhero game! Set within the walls of Gotham's infamous psychiatric hospital, the game follows Batman as he fights through hordes of escaped inmates and iconic villains to stop Joker's sinister plan. 

**Arkham Asylum**'s [combat system](https://arkhamcity.fandom.com/wiki/Freeflow_Combat) makes you feel like a true martial arts master. The game also introduces stealth mechanics using Batman's full arsenal of gadgets and one of the first games to feature a Detective Mode button.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYdkQELS1qtcr4Q3wtxoMnJt7dijhDrTRFPUsMSQMC1ZQ/batman-arkham-asylum-wallpaper.webp 


I wanted to play this game for years and only got to it now... It's actually my brother who bought it for his Steam account, which made finally experiencing it myself. . Arkham Asylum didn't disappoint! I really love the combat system, and I'm impressed that Arkham Asylum is supposed to have the weakest version of it..., If this is the \

it gets, then I can't wait to see how the sequels refine it further. The game absolutely made me feel like Batman!

While I'd recommend this game to any Batman (or really, any action-adventure game) fan, the stealth missions weren't as easy. As soon as I was found out, I was dead. Still, it makes me feel great when I finally overcome the challenge!! Funnily enough, the Scarecrow missions weren't very bad compared to normal stealth missions with mob enemies...

I love how Batman tools are introduced graudally, giving players a lot of time to adapt to each one. It also made me know what's the most likely tool to use in a puzzle: always the newest aquired tool! It wasn't easy to switch between tools mid-combat, though, so I fought mostly bare-handed~


You can watch my playthrough below:


----

### Watch on YouTube:


https://youtu.be/M_LSDtHbcjo

body.title: I'm going to push the button || Prompt
body.body:
.
Yet I feel tempted to push the button.
I really do not know what will happen if I push the button but my curiosity grew by the day.
I remember asking the engineer what is the result of pressing the button.
He didn't say, he only emphasized not to push the button.
It made me more curious.
One day I decided to push the button, and I did.
The button stopped the engine from working.
I was surprised and afraid I had damaged the engine, but after a while I restarted the engine and it worked well.
I had to preach to others the danger of pushing the button.
Now I know better.
I guess I have answered my own question.
Don't push the button.




You can also participate by clicking [here](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/30-june-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3150-im-going-to-push-the-button)

body.title: Last days
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaT46iyDgnvwr3ap1nQ2tna2WXcNaNHsfXqU5eVBwm8Lc/img_20260402_121515.jpg)

---
The last day of June is already running its course. I couldn’t be as active on Hive as I would have liked, but in recent days I managed a small streak that I’ll try to maintain with much effort.  

A lot has been happening in my country over the past week. A set of economic and social reforms has been launched—reforms many had been asking for, but in which no one has confidence anymore. While all this unfolds, people talk. Incredibly, the polarized sides coincide this time.  

Some because they don’t care about anything coming from the government, and others because they’re simply used to subsidies and living like parasites. Either way, it seems these reforms come too late, and if they take hold, they’ll cost a bit more blood before they have any effect on the lives of Cubans.  

For now, we continue with blackouts, hunger, and a society sinking into crime, corruption, and ignorance. The whole situation makes me uneasy. To the point that I go out walking and sit in a park to watch people pass by and children play soccer.  

Words wouldn’t come to me on paper no matter how hard I tried. Talking with a friend of mine brought back a bit of the desire. By the way, this friend will soon leave for another country as an emigrant, with a pregnant wife included. Good for him. I’m very happy for him. But it makes me sad. Every day I feel more alone, though from afar we’ll still love each other, or at least I hope so.  

Is this what it feels like to be depressed? I hope not. There are people who must feel worse. People who hear bombs falling daily over their heads. People who right now have rubble over their heads. By the way, greetings to Venezuelans. I hope the catastrophe doesn’t get worse, and that they come out of this more united and stronger.  

The curious thing is that I was so alienated, going back and forth from work, that I found out about these events at least two days after they happened. I’ll keep sitting in parks while the situation doesn’t improve. I’ll feed myself only with hope. The idea is to hit rock bottom and then be propelled back to the surface—or at least to shallower waters.  

---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmedBwZf9LDx6XPGNa19jnkfkRJP9YYPAkdY2wp7o1UtAQ/beige_illustrative_call_to_action_blog_banner_20250414_100317_0000.png)

---

body.title: Hidden Moments Close to Home / #monomad challenge / [ING/ESP]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX3TBUujF935avRDQywBLVFCcMXDcoN2pJJzCQpfkhPdW/_7507209_copia.jpg)

* * *

The photos 📸 are my entry to the #monomad contest from @monochromes and @brumest.

* * *

Greetings, Hivers.

It is becoming increasingly difficult to find enough time for what many of us love most: photography. As everyday life becomes more demanding and basic necessities require more time and effort, it is necessary to stay focused and dedicate our energy to solving those priorities first.

On top of that, having only three hours of electricity makes it difficult to decide how to use that precious time after taking care of the most urgent needs, such as storing water, preparing food, and other essential tasks.

Even so, it is still possible to create meaningful photographs right here in my own neighborhood. There are moments unfolding every day that often go unnoticed by those who have grown accustomed to seeing them.

Today I want to share a small selection of those moments. I hope you enjoy them.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZDiVz7jYi5maEbc7sqyvP49uyyBM2awDvLJVpcMRbnzV/_7507238_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNeoMqAWVBHpXRRRJE4Fc9aQ1KhSAcWSWr21y3KcBvVTZ/_7507243_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVsugMrwZu6jL2tBeMGgba6mwRBoXLVNcLnVMEG6NBRUX/_7507259_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcYMtyzzkv4Yy6stbRdXK9DGL327kTnj7EGqXDwMpRXH1/_dsc8963_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWc8BH3Kr5Hhpk7ZPEUzdeBF3JvngMqbctSB7gL4yXxMa/_dsc8964_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfUquk7NcomuB9prZtvTa8Bt4smtRTjXhR8wniUHxwtc5/_7507235_copia.jpg)


Saludos, hivers.

Cada vez se está volviendo más complicado encontrar el tiempo necesario para hacer lo que muchos amamos: la fotografía. Con tantos problemas para resolver las necesidades más básicas, es necesario mantenerse enfocado y dedicar gran parte del tiempo a esas prioridades.

Por otro lado, contar con solo tres horas de corriente hace muy difícil decidir en qué emplearlas después de resolver los asuntos más urgentes, como el agua, la comida y otras necesidades esenciales.

Aun así, aquí mismo, dentro del barrio, es posible hacer un buen trabajo. Hay momentos que suceden todos los días y permanecen ocultos para quienes ya se han acostumbrado a verlos.

Hoy les comparto una pequeña selección de esos momentos. Espero que los disfruten.


* * *

\

* * *

body.title: The $58k Grind Appears on Radar
body.body:
![market-bleeding-blood-red-down-crash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edicted/23zkpkQ4kVVmpo6RxQdvDkFcTJpojGpg7rHENXeByrrop6npKmMU1iEkYcZtXfn1vqvXK.jpg)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edicted/23t76bpzDtGNvAhn4AAbSmgKwSpQreQKQtxMr53s56xtV1UJz4VGXBR21gG1HGStjSCCt.png)

### ITS NOT LOOKING GOOD FAM!
Support near $58k is whittling away right before our very eyes.  Normally we'd expect a quick bounce here at such a hardcore support level, but no such luck.  Considering the timing of the cycle it would be prudent to brace ourselves for yet another lower low.  Annoying! 

I was expecting a third and final dip to this market, and was hoping the latest crash was just that, but it's simply too early to call the bottom, especially now with this grinding on hardcore support levels (a thing you never want to see).  To be fair we are still basically only retesting previous lows.   The first retest was kind of nice.  \

vibes.  Now we are at a triple bottom and a grind with no bounce.  Not good! 

At this point even if number goes up a little it doesn't mean much.  Like we could go up and tap the MA(25) at $63k and that would still be definitively bearish territory.  There's also no way that the contentious soft fork happening in August is in any way bullish for Bitcoin.  No matter what happens there a ton of old schoolers are going to be pissed and will rage sell the bottom no matter what the price is.  It actually has been reminding me of those people who say they're going to move out of the country is such and such wins the presidency.  Obviously 99% of the people who say things like this are absolutely full of shit, but also it's a lot easier to sell Bitcoin than it is to pack up and move out of the country.  Still expecting fireworks in August... not the good kind the ones that flop over sideways and blow up in your face a little bit. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edicted/23swfwJL9impgCAVuSku2mFd64LX9y4MoP4AZ7MyjtFNHmLhALStBL8CvgGDZ9JBfFhaE.png)

### 4-year cycle surprisingly forgiving
If we take a look to what happened four years ago it does offer some solace.  There was a massive buying window last time around (and the time before that for that matter). Any price point between June and March was fine.  Maybe you'd catch the exact bottom at $16k.  Maybe you'd buy the top at $25k.  Either way obviously all of those prices in between are pretty great in the grand scheme of things.  The window to buy during this bear market aftermath could easily last 6 months to even a full year. 

### 2027: year of the maximalist
The one thing that gives me pause this time around is what happens in 2027.  Normally I would be telling everyone that Bitcoin will outperform everything during this year because that's normally what happens during the cycle.  However, we never got an alt market (except for garbage meme coins).  Could Bitcoin going up in 2027 be enough to carry alts further than they would normally go because the market caps are so relatively low?  Unclear, but seeing as the Bitcoin cycle keeps proving itself over and over again I'm going to tentatively conclude that it's going to outperform hard once again in 2027... which is annoying because wen alts dammit! 

### Remember last cycle?
Four years ago Michael Saylor was an absolutely hated man with all the plebs praying for his demise.  \

they squealed.  He didn't.  He's not going to.  He's survived 2 bear markets no problem.  He's fine.  

It's funny because many view Saylor as the villain right now because he's selling BTC or whatever.  Everyone has the memory of a goldfish.  He was way more loathed last cycle and the threat was much higher as well.  Don't forget that there was no system collapse this time around.  There was no FTX.  There was no Terra/Luna.  There was no 3AC.  This entire bear market is just people selling into deeper liquidity pools that BTC has ever had before.  Coinbase is still here.  Blackrock is still here.  MSTR is still here.  And they'll be here for the next bear market as well apparently. 

### AI reversal
I still have to wonder how much thunder AI has taken from crypto and when that liquidity flow will reverse back.  It's interesting because AI and crypto are complimentary technologies.  We can use AI to develop crypto faster.  AI agents can use crypto as a form of currency that doesn't require KYC or permission.  The narratives for the next bull cycle in 2028 are likely going to be very intense.  Don't be surprised if we make up for last cycle with this next one in a year or two. 

### Conclusion
Chart looks like hammered dog shit.  
We still have to slog through 3 more months before it's safe to buy in.
Silver lining: next cycle is primed to be quite good, and could strike alts at any time.

> Hola, mis amigos. Que placer saludarlos nuevamente. El verano en Cuba no es juego de niños. Aquí el sol no da tregua, y cuando digo sol, hablo de ese bicharraco que te besa la nuca desde las siete de la mañana y no te suelta hasta que el ocaso le da la orden. El sol cubano te hace sudar hasta por los codos y te convierte la camisa o la blusa en un trapito que más vale no esprimir porque gotearía como esponja mojada. >Hello, my friends. What a pleasure to greet you again. > >Summer in Cuba is no child's play. Here, the sun gives no quarter, and when I say sun, I'm talking about that pesky critter that kisses the back of your neck from seven in the morning and doesn't let go until sunset gives the order. The Cuban sun makes you sweat even from your elbows and turns your shirt or blouse into a rag that you'd better not wring out because it would drip like a wet sponge.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU6DgvBVq7o2QbnLia27oz2TAKjbVGzvmZqx9Z5uoRAd6/1782848234041.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPMXffDhuWL6hXZV6LmuRxtPvCwdQ6TQVo8tmL6FmFS9K/1782848234205.jpg)

> Siempre se ha dicho que en el oriente del país hay más calor que en el occidente, pero yo que soy oriental, te digo que a estas alturas andamos bastante parejos. En La Habana, el calor se siente doble, el del astro rey y el que rebota contra el asfalto, los edificios viejos y esos carros americanos que echan más humo que vapor de cocina. Caminar por el Malecón a las dos de la tarde es como meterse en un horno criollo, donde las olas no refrescan, sino que devuelven el calor como si el agua del mar estuviera hirviéndose. La gente busca sombra donde puede, bajo los almendros o en los portales, abanicándose con cualquier cartón o periódico viejo. >It's always been said that the east of the country is hotter than the west, but since I'm from the east, I tell you that by now we're pretty much even. In Havana, the heat feels double—the sun's own and the heat that bounces off the asphalt, old buildings, and those American cars that belch more smoke than a kitchen steamer. Walking along the Malecón at two in the afternoon is like stepping into a Creole oven, where the waves don't cool you down but instead throw the heat back at you as if the sea water were boiling. People look for shade wherever they can, under the almond trees or in the doorways, fanning themselves with any piece of cardboard or old newspaper.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeMN44AJuBAf6ud8Y2H8ixZGbxmCFh6cix4UopAfCzjno/1782848328680.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZwVYPguHeN7wejHT5DJaTFJVd3BQDAc4Njr3J3wcFfFQ/1782848328865.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeU6NJiojwkhjapTdEDnWGCNmJvbQRCwB5rc3WTnpVf4k/1782848329020.jpg)

>









El cubano es creativo y al calor no le tiene miedo, a lo que si le teme es a los apagones y eso abunda por acá. Pero el cubano es un \

y si el sol aprieta, para la piscina o la playa es que vamos. Y cuando digo playa, me refiero a cualquier pedazo de costa. Aunque el agua del Caribe este como sopa tibia, uno se tira igual porque el combo calor-playa-cerceza es ley de vida. Nada como una buena cerveza con hielo picado para que el calor se vaya bien lejos. >Cubans are creative and aren't afraid of the heat—what they do fear are blackouts, and there are plenty of those around here. But Cubans are tough as nails, and if the sun really gets to you, off to the pool or the beach we go. And when I say beach, I mean any stretch of coast. Even if the Caribbean water is like lukewarm soup, we jump in anyway because the heat-beer-beach combo is the law of life. Nothing beats a good beer with crushed ice to send the heat far, far away.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaNyAGFhv4EtjARqEy1eQw7oBAKd8crGbvreZ5oPAq68H/1782848399833.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdtyKAgmep22MzDoWPjcmxPSXqjgT3tkMbWtktwiZXnPJ/1782848400003.jpg)

>







Las noches no son mucho mejor. Eso de \

es un cuento chino, porque muchas veces lo que viene es un vientecillo caliente que parece aire de secadora de pelo. Cuando no hay electricidad, que es casi siempre, los abanicos giran como locos pero apenas alivian, y si hay electricidad los aires acondicionado y ventiladores se ponen al máximo. Los más osados se tiran en la azotea mirando las estrellas y contando chistes para olvidarse de todo.\n\n>Nights aren't much better. That whole \

thing is a tall tale, because a lot of the time what comes is a hot little wind that feels like a hairdryer. When there's no electricity—which is almost always—fans spin like crazy but barely help, and if there is electricity, air conditioners and fans get cranked up to the max. The bravest ones lie out on the rooftop looking at the stars and telling jokes to forget about everything.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ1wnwuPZ7Ax3MbXCEVT7MJG1b2S7y8iwiDBUHcPkbaZj/1782848424475.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSBTiHJa2bcNRZsdVHgeAQo329vna8WqYcKnJ3qPkPCG8/1782848424644.jpg)

>







El calor también cambia el ritmo de la vida y la ciudad. De una a cuatro las calles se vacían porque el sol está \

. Los negocios pierden clientes y hasta los perros callejeros buscan la sombra del primer carro estacionado. Es como si el termómetro diera una pausa obligatoria, y el que se atreve a desafiar la hora pico termina con la ropa pegada al cuerpo como segunda piel. >The heat also changes the rhythm of life and the city. From one to four in the afternoon, the streets empty out because the sun is blazing hot. Businesses lose customers, and even stray dogs look for the shade of the first parked car. It's as if the thermometer imposes a mandatory pause, and anyone who dares to challenge rush hour ends up with their clothes stuck to their body like a second skin.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcuaWK1D6WzTuZ5KMX1xNVHD5e27hcufdseYNdZ3Py5kc/1782848518553.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRjVgQW9zkSU7hBjLspK3TK9YiJJbm9Z6aiwytc2LcmTt/1782848518726.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfMAmNn6gBY1y5WPPMFooP2x69JQjCGyMNGuLMJXGjyVi/1782848518838.jpg)

> Y hablando de ropa, aquí no hay mucho misterio, camisetas holgadas y shorts. Las mujeres con sus vestidos ligeros, colores claros, nada de oscuros porque absorben más calor y el sol no perdona. Los sombreros y gorras son el accesorio del verano, porque el cubano sabe que la cabeza caliente no piensa bien y las decisiones malas se toman cuando el sol te frie los sesos. >And speaking of clothes, there's not much mystery here—loose t-shirts and shorts. Women in their light dresses, light colors—nothing dark because dark colors absorb more heat and the sun doesn't forgive. Hats and caps are the accessory of summer, because Cubans know that a hot head doesn't think straight and bad decisions are made when the sun fries your brains.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmchZcFpxYFzNbCpExLFnBrNqTHmiX9yFPcxwFxLX96kZg/1782848752367.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRmfpkgdhj5i8s5NkkcP8bbufSkWkSd9WMomsrgC15yU1/1782848752556.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme3uPDMU7pLoKb8SAFPEsayRPve7AUxY5XQzoCmRHXzfK/1782848752741.jpg)

>







Pero el calor tiene su lado bueno, las frutas tropicales maduran y explotan en sabor. El mango, la papaya, la guayaba y el mamey están en su punto, y un batido bien frío con hielo raspado es la gloria. Los jugos naturales se venden en cada esquina, y la limonada (casi un lujo) es un remedio contra la sed que no falla. El verano en Cuba es una relación tóxica de amor-odio, te quejas del calor, pero en invierno lo extrañas. Algo así  como \

. Porque la vida en esta isla se mueve con ese ritmo tropical, donde el sudor es prueba y certeza de que estás vivo.\n\n>But the heat has its good side: tropical fruits ripen and explode with flavor. Mangoes, papayas, guavas, and mamey are at their peak, and a well-chilled smoothie with shaved ice is pure glory. Natural juices are sold on every corner, and lemonade (almost a luxury) is a fail-safe remedy for thirst. Summer in Cuba is a toxic love-hate relationship; you complain about the heat, but in winter you miss it. It's something like \

Because life on this island moves to that tropical rhythm, where sweat is proof and certainty that you are alive.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbrkeoMScuEPwz7ipAfdMuPnpz3puQinBevTwVAHgvRuJ/1782848820302.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTF5jaBHb16GXqY5Y8aCJiZgRiFVHjbuDm51zPbQjJi9H/1782848820406.jpg)

> Si por casualidad o no, vienes en verano a Cuba, trae bloqueador solar, sombrero, un ecoflow y mucha paciencia. Y si eres de los nuestros sabes que el calor mortifica pero no mata, solo entresa un poco. En definitiva, cuando el sol se pone y la brisa del mar se lleva el cansancio, uno entiende que este calor caribeño es parte de nuestra identidad, intenso, pegajoso y desesperante pero lleno de sabor, como nosotros mismos. >If by chance (or not) you come to Cuba in the summer, bring sunscreen, a hat, an Ecoflow, and lots of patience. And if you're one of us, you know that the heat is mortifying but doesn't kill you—it just gets under your skin a little. In the end, when the sun sets and the sea breeze carries away the exhaustion, you understand that this Caribbean heat is part of our identity—intense, sticky, and exasperating, but full of flavor, just like us.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX1NNotWT7wPyT7ffDeDQnZKVjvd1Kxr1eFNZRs9x2YCp/image_13d12e45_4e7a_4f64_b777_a63d96a304b33428565793531931840.jpg) https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJDibgVv7QpnG7cFRyL8RrNKwrY4Tkx4636U9mec4jSH/img_8206.gif Gracias por visitar mi blog Texto e imágenes de mi propiedad Thanks to visite my blog Text and imagen are my own https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmftReAUFLd1o6yeBP8wg9ths82CW6Fpu7doGEYgCEWV/img_7269.jpg

body.title: The Public Is Free Use!!!
body.body:
![Yelllow and Blue Modern Geometric How To Design Youtube Thumbnail (52).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23wWnibmxoNiAukN7rGukQRWoWrah4ZsMxL7mDwP3cLwbZqYWURXFTikvPteuNGq794YH.png) ***
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtPNZ193z3v9HzUXNRYfNBKpop4B452wXWGAr95ns7Froa3QYr2tHe7aDsDXTJuz6E8PeAV3edWS3NGxHQJHC9xJn9eUpGW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uEz3qUu1cpWPYjmp2LnK1i4RcXoAhocX2Rzpq9uYyMScovNm77MZBozX7i1NM59BnSf.png) The public is free use, and everyone has a right to make videos and take pictures there as long as it does not affect other people who are using the public facilities. You can take all the pictures you want on the road, but as long as it won’t mean that I can’t use that road while you’re taking your pictures or making your videos, then we’re good and fine. Because the road belongs to all of us, we can all use it happily. But then, when it comes to movies, it’s different. This is because movies usually require heavy machinery and studio equipment. Movies almost always have celebrities and activities that could pull crowds. So, when movies are shot in public, these machineries could cause traffic, the celebrities present would draw crowds, and these will hamper the movements of other people. That’s why such projects can only happen with the express permission of the government. ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAxm3nacdB7gLmLiZLuYVhHeNsRgxL6WKJoam3hs2B7ZLAp2jwaLFEwoAbLKzAfpv2DhtyvHbJunTbU58RMbxtkvefNK4qj8EA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQkLUmr2XGp8UpLcdtKeQrWDNnK5jemLpyFynqgRKtzZaqtByEwcX3DoUEyB8Pwi9DN.png) So, if I’m scrolling through TikTok one day and I find myself in someone’s video, taken without my knowledge, how will I react? Honestly, there are two ways this can go. Am I the focus of the video? Is the entire content of the video focused on me? Because then, it would mean that I’m a character in your little show, and I did not agree to that. It would also mean that you purposely targeted me, and my appearing on your video wasn’t by chance. It was calculated. I have a right to privacy, and such a creator could get sued. And the other way this can go is quite the opposite. Maybe I simply walk through the video, just like an extra in a movie. The kind of characters no one really notices, but are important because they add a bit of realism to the shot. If it’s that one, then good and fine. I’d know for sure that appearing in your shot is only by coincidence, and besides, no one will recognize me unless they really know me. ![IMG_20230528_112336~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23xKpFqq93tK4buwEH1xkqeZwmrne7gP8kJxXVXm23W8sDivMi6YNEwCqw6kdcAhAoZhZ.jpg) So, this should not be criminalized. I get that we all have a right to privacy and there are people who avoid cameras like the plague, but the world probably has as many cameras as the number of humans alive. Everywhere you go, from restaurants to airports, to supermarkets to schools… There are cameras everywhere, recording what you do. Not all of them will hit the internet, but one day, something crazy might happen, and a disgruntled employee might leak the CCTV footage, along with your identity, online. It happens. We all love our privacy, that’s why the press can chase you down on the road, shoving cameras in your face and asking you questions. But they won’t dare step even a toe into your compound, because then they’re trespassing. Once it stops being public and becomes private, boundaries go up, and you get to decide what exactly you want. So, yeah, people should be allowed to be creative. If you appear on a random person’s video, good and fine. As long as your appearance there does not harm you in any way. If not, you’ll also be within your right to demand the video be taken down. The public belongs to us all. With time, my stance may change, but for now, this is where I stand. ![IMG_20231202_1154192.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23tbiomqHTE8M1PNdLTCXp3AbkYoe4fBqFSTc1RazUYAnVwhvBzWXJohog27am11LCMtV.jpg) ***
Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, I would love to know what you’re thinking. Till we meet in the next post.
***
Watch My Engaging Stories on: [Facebook](https://web.facebook.com/brunokemaofficial), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@bruno_kema), and [TikTok]( https://www.tiktok.com/@bruno_kema?_r=1&_t=ZN-91fKKHrMpuw).
***
N.B: All images used in this post are mine. The thumbnail was designed using Canva.

body.title: I NEVER LEFT - Time To SPEND SPEND SPEND
body.body:
I admit, it's been a WHILE since I last posted on Hive. And it sucks but here I am. Life has gotten super busy but that doesn't mean I haven't been here. I have just been lurking and doing things here or there but not as active as I would have liked. I am working on changing that though 😅


<center>![Splinterlands-Header-GIF.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23w2HCLWE8P4DMwWH8nnPgogdvM5nJeozRFnC5BaEMktHaPm1geo33EQsHkJ5zKeMQoWr.gif)</center>







https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23w2af5iQrQUx55LTXQNPT8LREreSyXcNya8SFoknaWgf4KZER6aKLfckWw8qmTUVv9S5.png

# Pack Opening

I have been slowly amassing a little army of packs to open. And it is finally time to open my packs once and for all and find what goodies lie inside!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tkk8HVppFaCwDQpo7RyXwT7KCUyUZUzRrPs5ZXiu2oKPpExXSkYx8rMr3gpwKU35t1S.png

It's not much, but it's mine!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/243qDCUzDoFG7hRi9etJ53ce5B7CaEFgoUcZSbUZ9EBYqzHBKiFuwNk774ewVLaFfXbgt.png









https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/EoEqUWtdxebs84FNkFApC67ikh5Qa5AFNNNud77LWLV45fu6WeedroS1hsj9tPW7FcE.png

## Gladius Cases

|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/AK9Q9xvmofzaA1qHq4DzJfnBCLm4voJCGD362j9gcnK1DQUVm1vkid5FQHqnuQP.png| I have 12 Gladius Cases to open!|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/AK9Q9xvmofzaA1qHq4DzJfnBCLm4voJCGD362j9gcnK1DQUVm1vkid5FQHqnuQP.png|
|-|-|-|

I won't bore you with too much talking here:

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23u5bFK43FGUUwVrXFosL7YPaeH6XA7T3nJdL6pAxqukw7LiCH3t8rxrGhTvqAcoM4F49.png

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23uEyugveWmhwiUZwQYQPE7xWYxcGNtTNPAwkRvHnnqvY14bVECEHaKPXhTNhajsfHZ3W.png

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23u5Z9sBxX2dLCPTaHFQmar2dMtf8UakdUQvmve9YogTRvTXdDUewvYxDAweybDDqHNrc.png

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23uQfg4s57kbibfYvXJxQ379NwpnFY4QiyhQCnRwULyFvvXgz3Uj9pBJeWqpVWLXs1zA6.png

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tkmuu7rFtSjxSPS3FGV3S2ZSQfwbwm4XX8bVKZuvJZ5qCtCXcoGDkp88izBpgLbEkNX.png

Nothing AMAZING but still they are all cards I need so its a win I at least got a few Epics in there.

I have a LONG WAY to go in the Gladiator card section.... like a LONG way...

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tbRUkB7h1XrREmTz17SF6W4KemSfBC7zKijkqFQnYTAmF5fmHMSSfpih7PhFRsgUUC8.png








https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/EoEqUWtdxebs84FNkFApC67ikh5Qa5AFNNNud77LWLV45fu6WeedroS1hsj9tPW7FcE.png

## Riftwatchers

|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/AKGUBLa59E8jX7Cqfahri7Ta5pPDTxKpPxZijef2EE1ZExDYRHdeTSTnHMsQK5H.png| I have 5 Riftwatchers Packs to open|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/AKGUBLa59E8jX7Cqfahri7Ta5pPDTxKpPxZijef2EE1ZExDYRHdeTSTnHMsQK5H.png|
|-|-|-|

And yeah, we are doing these 1 by 1 baby! For the suspense of course!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tv6Dk73jyYSNiiUAu62kB9mywegSC1LeyiWgo8UZccfwKWmPjgVF7uk1QnhkNMchq4P.png

I am not sure I remember ever opening up Riftwatcher packs because the back of the cards look new to me (I know they are old). I also know that I must have at some point back when I started playing but yeah, I like the Blue card backs!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/EoGrbbM78tKSJPTNdSNncLb9fXawCMAaEYxXwDD6HpiagVEb3phbVcgGDe6heRLQb75.png

Okay enough of that 1 by 1 bullcrap. Nobody has time for that.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tSKZjbawh2KwJQU2T6r6ptGsKXTFd7bu2xiDHc6A4kSUdu3j5HcVNDD6Pj2uiN9P71z.png

Well color me pink and call me a pig.... 2 Gold Foils! I mean they are worth like $0.63 and $0.14. But I am not opening packs to just sell the cards so I will take them!

I am still missing 5 Legendary cards from the Riftwatchers set. But I guess I will just have to buy them manually eventually.








https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/EoEqUWtdxebs84FNkFApC67ikh5Qa5AFNNNud77LWLV45fu6WeedroS1hsj9tPW7FcE.png

## Chaos Legion

| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/AJhV89cVEv3tA4e2onCK9adNFmt3s5bboMjPhqgGL4wki7bEn6p6eVYBNPcii9z.png |Now onto my 10 Chaos Legion packs | https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/AJhV89cVEv3tA4e2onCK9adNFmt3s5bboMjPhqgGL4wki7bEn6p6eVYBNPcii9z.png |
|-|-|-|

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tbiScDutZNpAFJxpKVf6VsFTtSR3qv8qdZpmcfu8u8B5W7xS3ieQG4dWPBZRQnpeagd.png

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tvVYrL8c3MGSoonwfv8FbSWoa8cQsWxBmamFjPMQzboXnv4N6vbU6ZQo492ZR2PDKDN.png

Oh, I do always like getting Archons... even if it's an Obsidian where I already have a decent GF version of it! 😁

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23u5bfxhMofNN8SbWzf6B5oT4ffeRQxCThhze3G5zkK7CbbdgL8W7y7Zdu7KwLEchYZyJ.png

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tm6xpoUNGAyhQTeRbAZtM5Y6mu5GXAKpDB7hRjcgLDHa35pwP9Vtd6jJRxbQewcmAnn.png

10 packs and 1 Gold Foil.. I guess that is okay. 










https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23w2af5iQrQUx55LTXQNPT8LREreSyXcNya8SFoknaWgf4KZER6aKLfckWw8qmTUVv9S5.png

# Glint Shopping

|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/AK2DLefWv1whb5squyUrr6bYqZ1vVFNC6sP1gnaKZbvkkxtRQxsenBfNr9qQzSj.png| Now to Spend my 188k Glint |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/AK2DLefWv1whb5squyUrr6bYqZ1vVFNC6sP1gnaKZbvkkxtRQxsenBfNr9qQzSj.png|
|-|-|-|

The obvious choice is Legendary Draws since I still need some Legendary Reward Cards.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23t76kUhdCx7543mjsGQ6psjMTPipVz4yPQHHfJEauHAuMGqn9oXmRSkMTkGM3vkpR1G3.png

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/Eokbi9ttCbH9xZVZogCYrhtinpkYeU8ms1YD2Zdu7Q2PZCrbRrWgxoQARY4A6nzGfPS.png

Well the Sira I already had which I thought was bad, until I realized I now had 3 and could level it up! So yeah I am happy with both my Legendarey Cards.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23wgBAYZ6zC96t3HhB5NbdQ6egFMBE867eq6TyBJEU9rNnoRt59Ab7iqRe1Ga9Y5LgjyM.png







https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23w2gwwtjuq6sWT14pDgo42MvxZmVXBszEsooL2iu6MTCnuySULK6H3Tz4QDNhVdmH4qi.jpg


---
That is it really. Just a quick post about me opening Splinterland packs to get my feet wet again and hopefully to get me back into posting more on Hive..


If you want to talk on Discord or vote for my Hive Witness Node... I won't stop you!
|[![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23wM2s18nnjEVEKsZbH8MSdTUxSq8PnAWnGiSxLNgd3v5zcJn4FtcerTYqmZDSPNYRMN3.jpg)](https://vote.hive.uno/@witness4all)|[![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23uQvauCkxRkAp6TE5itJLaRpiQ2wuszUTBp2bdaKSJvS2KP4fpnPDrvaDFWqj2y65vk5.jpg)](https://discord.gg/ujBXNA6S6Y)|
|-|-|

body.title: FOREST HEALER, HEALER OF ANIMALS
body.body:
##### Happy Tuesday, @holozing friends!

![IMG_20260630_083704.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damoclesart/23zSL1k9dhES7bjjhbrMpwEhh3cZV4FsfMxv2oB6iGWaQcYptWywRUFYHMVZyxPV5XZeK.jpg)

#### I hope everyone is doing well. Here in Venezuela—even in the areas less severely affected—there is a pervasive sense of gloom, so I haven't really had the mood or ideas to post creatively on #hive. However, just today, while watching the news and seeing animals being rescued and treated after building collapses, I came up with the idea for this #foresthealer in a chibi style. I think it turned out well, and as always, I’m going to show you the process here.


![IMG_20260630_073804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damoclesart/23tShGofBQGU2Xey2eZufPiAbH37Eh4AMgdzQWbzNFJU5jQ3BcRrfsEdH5QytLxfeJHqT.jpg)

![IMG_20260630_081453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damoclesart/23uFbyHvM5fMCP3fkoVnTCnKhTmbzuJ2rMLmNFsubvD74f5RSS2PsAXHanavzWRM71v3X.jpg)

![IMG_20260630_082727.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damoclesart/23x1DKfRHXuUWwDRvTmcAu3eBR57hEvvjMq9BLBQ2Q1yK4cq4XZinbDRznU2wHtP5ioyK.jpg)

body.title: FRANKENSTEIN (Review) ESP/ENG - 2026 - Ale
body.body:
></center>

Voy a llamar al ¨Mounstruo¨ tal como lo hace del toro… Adan

Le tenía expectativas a este libro pero no pensé que sería lo que fue, siempre he pensado en esta historia como algo de terror pero al leer el libro me di cuenta de lo equivocada que estaba. Si tiene escenas que describen actos horrorosos, pero, más allá de eso podemos ver como la inocencia se vuelve violenta a través de los ojos de un gran personaje. Adan comienza siendo como un bebé, no sabe hablar o como comportarse.

```
I'm going to call the “Monster” just like they do with the bull… Adan
```

```
I had high hopes for this book, but I didn’t think it would turn out the way it did. I’d always thought of this story as a horror tale, but as I read the book, I realized how wrong I was. It does have scenes that describe horrific acts, but beyond that, we can see how innocence turns to violence through the eyes of a remarkable character. Adam starts out like a baby—he doesn’t know how to speak or how to behave.
```

<h3 style=\

>REVIEW Busca ayuda y conocimiento en su creador pero este ahora lo ve como una criatura grande y fea a la que no quiere, lo detesta y se arrepiente de haberlo creado pues ahora que Adan ha cometido atrocidades victor piensa que no es más que un monstruo asesino. El libro tiene fragmentos que me gustaron mucho, como por ejemplo estos >

>Los acontecimientos que influyen decisivamente en nuestros destinos a menudo tienen su origen en sucesos triviales

\n\n>

>¡Dios mío…! ¿Por qué presume el hombre de tener más sensibilidad que las bestias? Eso solo los convierte en seres más necesitados. Si nuestros impulsos se redujeran al hambre, la sed y el deseo, casi podríamos ser libres; pero nos vemos agitados por todos los vientos y por cada palabra pronunciada casi al azar o por cada paisaje que ese viento puede sugerirnos. Dormimos, y un sueño es capaz de envenenar nuestro descanso. Nos levantamos, y un pensamiento pasajero nos amarga el día. Sentimos, imaginamos o razonamos; reímos, o lloramos, abrazamos pesares amados, o apartamos nuestras cuitas; no importa; porque sea alegría o pena, el camino de su partida siempre está abierto. El ayer del hombre jamás puede ser como su mañana; ¡nada puede durar, salvo la mutabilidad!

\n\n>

>Y aunque los afectos no se deban especialmente a cualidades extraordinarias, los compañeros de nuestra infancia siempre poseen cierta influencia en nuestro espíritu: una influencia que difícilmente otro amigo posterior puede conseguir. Ellos conocen nuestros sentimientos de la infancia, los cuales, aunque puedan modificarse más adelante, nunca desaparecen del todo; y pueden juzgar nuestros actos con más ecuanimidad. Una hermana o un hermano nunca puede sospechar que el otro lo engaña o le miente, a no ser que efectivamente esos rasgos se hayan dado en uno de ellos previamente; mientras que otro amigo, aunque nos tenga en gran aprecio, puede sentir, aun a pesar suyo, la punzada de la sospecha.

``` He seeks help and understanding from his creator, but the creator now sees him as a large, ugly creature whom he does not want; he detests him and regrets having created him, for now that Adam has committed atrocities, Victor believes he is nothing more than a murderous monster. ``` ``` The book has passages that I really liked, such as these: ``` ``` The events that decisively influence our destinies often have their origins in trivial occurrences ``` ``` My God…! Why does man boast of having more sensitivity than beasts? That only makes them more needy beings. If our impulses were reduced to hunger, thirst, and desire, we could almost be free; but we find ourselves tossed about by every wind and by every word spoken almost at random or by every landscape that wind might suggest to us. We sleep, and a dream is capable of poisoning our rest. We wake, and a fleeting thought embitters our day. We feel, imagine, or reason; we laugh or weep, embrace cherished sorrows, or cast aside our troubles; it matters not; for whether joy or sorrow, the path of their departure is always open. A person’s yesterday can never be like their tomorrow; nothing can last, except for change itself! ``` ``` And even if our affection for them is not due specifically to extraordinary qualities, our childhood friends always exert a certain influence on our spirit—an influence that a friend we make later in life can hardly match. They know our childhood feelings, which, although they may change over time, never disappear entirely; and they can judge our actions with greater impartiality. A sister or brother can never suspect that the other is deceiving or lying to them, unless such behavior has actually occurred in one of them previously; whereas another friend, even if they hold us in high regard, may feel, even against their will, the pang of suspicion. ```

>OPINION Al terminar el libro me vi la película de Guillermo del toro, y si me gustó en general pero siento que hubieron pequeños cambios que marcaron grandes diferencias, en parte comprendo que lo hayan hecho debido a que la película ya es lo suficientemente larga y si hubieran seguido la historia original sería más larga aún, pero de todas maneras mantengo la frase de ¨Es mejor el libro¨ A pesar de que no creo marcar este libro como uno de mis favorito le doy un 5/5 ``` After finishing the book, I watched Guillermo del Toro’s movie, and while I liked it overall, I feel like there were small changes that made a big difference. I partly understand why they did it—the movie is already long enough, and if they had followed the original story, it would have been even longer—but in any case, I still stand by the saying, “The book is better.” ``` ``` Even though I don’t think I’ll count this book among my favorites, I’m giving it a 5/5. ```

body.body:
![Capa](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/crazyphantombr/23tknNzYZVr2stDGwN8Sv9BpmnRmeRgcZNaC1ZhHFB1U99MTAe5qfGrcsZd4a51PPnRkZ.png)

# Hive BR: Junho/2026 - Evoluindo Juntos, Fortalecendo a Rede!

Prezada comunidade HIVE-BR,

É com grande satisfação que a HIVE-BR apresenta o relatório mensal de Junho de 2026. Este foi um mês de notável progresso e consolidação para o nosso ecossistema Web3. Encerramos Junho com um impressionante total de **41293 HP** sob gestão da comunidade, representando um crescimento líquido de **2909 HP**. Distribuímos um total de **335 votos** em conteúdo valioso e contamos com a ativa participação de **59 delegadores**. A força da nossa presença nacional é evidente, com **40 contas brasileiras ativas** na blockchain nos últimos 30 dias, um testemunho do nosso dinamismo e engajamento.

---

### 🚀 QUEM ESTÁ TURBINANDO (TOP MOVERS)

A força da nossa comunidade reside no engajamento de cada membro. Gostaríamos de celebrar aqueles que fizeram a diferença neste mês, aumentando suas delegações e, consequentemente, o poder de curadoria da Hive BR:

*   **@rimurutempest**: +3631 HP
*   @grafvisionsp: +49 HP
*   @matheusggr: +24 HP


Um destaque especial vai para **@rimurutempest**, cuja contribuição significativa de +3631 HP demonstra um compromisso exemplar com o crescimento de nossa comunidade. Agradecemos imensamente a todos que, com seus aportes, impulsionam nossa missão.

---

### 👋 BOAS-VINDAS AOS NOVATOS

Celebrar novos membros é celebrar o futuro da Hive BR. Damos as boas-vindas calorosas a quem se juntou à nossa família de delegadores:

*   **@suzanne7**: +300 HP

É com especial entusiasmo que destacamos **@suzanne7** como uma nova conta que já iniciou sua jornada conosco. Seu engajamento inicial é um sinal promissor para a expansão da nossa representatividade nacional.

> **@suzanne7** さんが新しいアカウントとして、すでに私たちと共に歩み始めていることを大変うれしく思います。初期段階からの積極的な参加は、私たちの国内での存在感と代表性をさらに広げていく有望な兆しです。


---

### 💪 FORÇA BRASILEIRA (MAIORES HPs PRÓPRIOS)

A base de uma comunidade forte é construída pelo compromisso individual. Reconhecemos e celebramos os Hivers brasileiros que se destacam pelo volume de Hive Power próprio, fortalecendo a rede e o ecossistema nacional:

*   **@wiseagent**: 98014 HP
*   **@michupa**: 51906 HP
*   **@mengao**: 42512 HP 


Cada Hiver desta lista, ao fortalecer sua própria conta, contribui diretamente para a robustez e a sustentabilidade de todo o ecossistema brasileiro na Hive. Agradecemos o compromisso inabalável de todos vocês em edificar esta comunidade.

---

### O TOP 10 (A ELITE)

Agradecemos imensamente a dedicação dos nossos principais delegadores, cuja confiança e suporte são pilares fundamentais para o nosso sucesso coletivo. Estes são os Hivers que lideram em delegações para a comunidade HIVE-BR:

| Rank | Usuário | HP Delegado |
| :--: | :---------- | :----------: |
| 1 | @matheusggr | 10391 HP |
| 2 | @rimurutempest | 7002 HP |
| 3 | @tfranzini | 3166 HP |
| 4 | @michupa | 3028 HP |
| 5 | @wiseagent | 2509 HP |
| 6 | @mengao | 2049 HP |
| 7 | @shiftrox | 1100 HP |
| 8 | @gwajnberg | 1048 HP |
| 9 | @kaibagt | 1037 HP |
| 10 | @elderdark | 1033 HP |

A liderança e o investimento demonstrados por estes membros são cruciais para a capacidade de curadoria e apoio que a Hive BR oferece. Nosso muito obrigado pela confiança e parceria contínua.

---

Até o próximo mês, Hivers! Continuem brilhando e construindo o futuro!

---

The last day of the conference, packing up, and the trip home. Lots of running around and packing. It was still around 30 degrees in Geneva. We arrived in Berlin late in the cool evening. I did manage to take a quick trip to Geneva’s Old Town with a colleague at least once. We did get caught in a full-blown thunderstorm there and got soaked to the bone, but it was warm, and despite the rain, it was a little adventure far away from work in the exhibition halls.
