body.title: Early Season and Unlocked Gold II League!
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXEmbB1NMAR8EdGZ5Rw66n3pUzy3bEg1f5ZuJ1mCHAmXP/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

It's early in the new season and I quickly went to work and unlocked Gold II League in Modern. It's great that I moved to this league early as it increased my SPS rewards earned per win. I was also rewarded with advancement chests that contained cards, among others. Advancing in leagues as you win more battles is part of the fun I find in playing Splinterlands.

***

# Advancement Reward Chests

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbawzfosVg8R5hNyW2XCvtKbHTZvENVUW154cK3o75NQq/image.png)

There are several rewards you can get from chests including legendary cards. The were a lot of rare cards I received today. There were also potions, merits and energy. I like the cards best especially if I can get legendary cards. It's possible to upgrade the cards you have from getting these reward cards.

This is another motivating factor for me to keep playing. The possibility of upgrading my cards and making my deck stronger and competitive. My goal is to have a complete set of reward cards with level five commons, level four rares, level three epics and level two legendaries. It will take a lot of seasons but it will keep me motivated to play.

***

# Featured Battle - Beating Nidhoggr

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSpmewBmygBVFDJW19vT7YQEzysbFjpVSuTMo1F78uHj8/image.png)

After my win against Dragonlord Mancer in this [post](https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@logen9f/beating-dragonlord-mancer), I been using my Water magic speed team in battles. This time, my team beat the great dragon Nidhoggr. This team would give me trouble any other day but my strategy of striking first and hard paid dividends. My advantage in speed and damage defeated his units before he can kill mine. My team was composed of the following.

## Blue Wyrm Travesty

Blue Wyrm Travesty deals seven damage and has excellent defense. He also slows down the enemy with his ability making him an important cog in my strategy.

## Ulundin Overseer

Ulundin Overseer is the second tank that absorbed the blast damage from Nidhoggr's ability. He has no attack by himself but he is given three magic attack courtesy of Shiraza and the archon's buff. 

## Shiraza

Shiraza is my combo unit that I use with Ulundin Overseer. She gives him two magic attack while also dealing two magic of her own. 

## Torrent Sniper

Torrent Sniper deals three magic damage and a good unit to combo with Shock Trooper because of his Painforge ability. His attack will increase as the fight goes on. 

## Mystic Scaleweaver

Mystic Scaleweaver deals four magic damage while also slowing down the enemy. With Blue Wyrm Travesty, that's already two speed stats deducted from the enemy. 

## Shock Trooper

Shock Trooper deals five magic damage while increasing the team's speed. With the debuff to the enemy and my own speed buff, it's guaranteed my team will attack first. The only disadvantage of Shock Trooper is his Electrified debilitation but I took advantage of it by including Torrent Sniper in the team.

The enemy is strong with a level two Nidhoggr. His team had three units with Blast ability. Luckily, I had a beefy tank in second position that absorbed the damage. Having fast and high damage units also guaranteed that I defeated his units before they can be healed by his Arachne Weaver. It was a pleasure seeing my strategy work against a legendary archon.

[Replay the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_76450db8377e470633c2416673b65f6a?ref=logen9f)

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

body.title: Google Joined Dow Jones
body.body:
Alphabet, Google's parent company, officially joined the Dow Jones Industrial Average yesterday. It replaced Verizon and earned a seat alongside some of the biggest names in corporate America. On the surface, it sounds like a major victory. And in many ways, it is.

But there is also a big catch. The same company that has just entered the blue chip index is currently experiencing its worst month in more than a year.

**WHAT HAPPENED?**

Last Tuesday, S&P Global announced that Alphabet would be added to the Dow Jones Industrial Average. The change officially took effect at the start of yesterday's trading session.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXKZyhHXxWpj6ut8KS8gzqPv4WpbjuzD7FJ92hudnPjgd/img_8435.png)

Google now sits alongside technology giants such as Nvidia, Amazon, Apple, and Microsoft. According to S&P Global, adding Alphabet gives the Dow greater exposure to artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and digital advertising, which are some of the most important themes shaping today's market.

Investors welcomed the news. Following Tuesday's announcement, the stock gained about 1%. Then, on the first official trading day as a Dow component, it climbed another 4.9%.

So why was Verizon removed?

The answer is simple. The Dow is a price weighted index, meaning each company's influence depends on its share price rather than its total market value. Stocks with higher share prices have a greater impact on the index. Verizon's relatively low share price meant it contributed only a tiny fraction of the Dow's overall weighting, making its influence minimal.

As impressive as joining the Dow may sound, the move is more symbolic than transformational.

Alphabet was already a member of both the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq 100, which are followed by the vast majority of index funds. That means joining the Dow does not trigger a significant wave of mandatory buying from passive investors. Instead, it is more of a badge of honor than a game changing event.

There is also an interesting historical pattern worth mentioning. The most recent companies added to the Dow, including Nvidia, Salesforce, and Apple, all traded lower sixty days after joining the index. That does not necessarily mean the same thing will happen to Alphabet, but it does show that inclusion alone is far from a guarantee of future gains.

**THE SHADOW BEHIND THE GOOD NEWS**

The timing of this milestone is especially interesting because Google is going through a difficult period in the stock market.

Even after Monday's 4.9% rally, the stock is still on track for its worst monthly performance since February of last year. Six of the past seven weeks have ended in negative territory. What's remarkable is that only a few months ago, in May, Alphabet briefly surpassed Nvidia to become the world's most valuable publicly traded company. In just a matter of weeks, the picture has changed dramatically.

So what is driving the weakness?

Investors are increasingly questioning whether Google's enormous spending on artificial intelligence will ultimately generate the returns they expect. At the same time, lower cost Chinese AI models continue to improve rapidly. DeepSeek has already announced that the next version of its model is expected within the next two weeks. That creates additional pricing pressure just as Google is trying to build a profitable business around Gemini.

The company is also facing talent challenges. Noam Shazeer, the former head of Gemini, left for OpenAI, reportedly citing limited access to computing resources as one of the reasons. Access to computing power has become a growing problem. Reports suggest Alphabet does not currently have enough capacity to fully meet demand from major enterprise customers such as Meta, forcing it to seek additional computing resources from outside providers, including SpaceX.

The financial impact is beginning to show as well. The company's cash cushion has declined, and for the first time in nearly a decade, Alphabet did not repurchase shares during the first quarter. Since October, it has also raised more than $140 billion through debt and other financing as the AI race becomes increasingly expensive.

To be fair, however, the situation is not entirely negative. Despite the recent volatility, the stock remains up more than 10% so far in 2026 and is on track for its fourth consecutive year of gains. So while the challenges are real, the long term picture is far from hopeless.

body.title: When Your Face Becomes Someone Else's Content
body.body:
I remember a time I was reluctantly scrolling through Facebook when I stumbled upon someone I know in the background of a video taken in a popular local market around me. The person actually wasn't the main focus of the video, but she was very visible and never knew she became part of the content of that stranger's video. 


I had to pause and think of how many times my face has surfaced in a picture or video taken randomly by content creators without my knowledge. 

![17828477291732155199209538406999.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/23wWrbD22hrJgbUA8dR8ZjRzYFQM2kkuKUgctNccaCh5MX3ByWHYUAhg78PbQu5gxJyuM.png)

*****

I see how this era is turning a lot of people into content creators including me, and so smartphones are everywhere, and people are targeting pictures or videos that could attract traffic to their pages, so permit me to say that it's almost impossible to avoid this. If I should be sincere, I will confess that I have several times taken random pictures in the market which I use for my post, including the one I posted yesterday, without the consent of these people in my pictures. lol



The question, according to the prompt, is, should taking pictures or videos that capture strangers without their permission become a criminal offence? Well, I think this is somehow a sensitive issue and each side had a valid argument. 

*****

Personally, I will feel uncomfortable when I suddenly find my face trending in a video online which I never knew was taken. It will hurt me if the video in question is negative or being mocked; of course, I wouldn't want to be the topic of discussion without my permission. This era of our world, info spreads so quickly, and not everyone has a good motive for recording videos, just like the ones I do use here on Hive innocently to back up my post. 



People record videos or take pictures with bad intentions, and for sure, privacy is important, including personal safety. However, if we should consider it a criminal offence to record people or take their pictures in public places, it might just create troubles added to the one we are facing as a society.


*****
Come to think of it, some people rely on public recordings to tell their stories, so it seems unavoidable, and I don't think we should make it a crime offence; it's just fair not to use people's images negatively. I know I have attended different events and captured the moments, including many people, and used it for my content. Imagine visiting all those people to seek their consent? That's impossible. 


Maybe a healthy boundary should be created rather than making it a crime; however, if someone intentionally records a person and use it for negative purpose , such as to humiliate the person, expose him or her, make her vulnerable and the like, that one could attract legal punishments. 

*****
Overall, I am of the opinion that laws should focus on those misusing other people's pictures and videos rather than making it a general crime for all creators.

*This is my response to the #hive learners prompt on the topic titled, **YOUR FACE ALONE**


***Image was created using chatgpt***

body.title: Photographing the church of Qara Klisa in the middle of the warm and beautiful deserts.. Thousands of years ago.
body.body:
![IMG_20260630_221722_edit_154956102513334.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRxwe17jHr5B5iSv7qAJc3uNBkQMdEUARRnKbz2XStLWL/IMG_20260630_221722_edit_154956102513334.jpg)



# Photographing the church of Qara Klisa in the middle of the warm and beautiful deserts.. Thousands of years ago.

 Hello friends, I hope you are well.
Today I have prepared new photos of this beautiful church

We had gone on a trip to the northwest of the country and my husband had marked this church on a map and we went there and we were amazed to see it.

 It dates back more than 8,000 years 

I love visiting such historical and cultural places,

 and we used to travel a lot in the past years, but now we don't go anywhere, and it's because of the war.

This damn war has paralyzed us and paralyzed and depressed the people 

We have been thrown out of the circle of life, 

and this war has brought many calamities on us and its ruins are evident in people's lives. The deplorable economic situation of Diveh has become unbearable for us 

How can we go on a trip, how can we be happy?

How do we provide the first means of life? This is the pressure on the people of my country, and everyone is upset and angry about it.  

Life on earth has made it difficult for us to live on earth.

body.title: The Genius of Mark Knopfler and Local Hero
body.body:
### Hello hello silver bloggers, music lovers and Hello hivers!

One of my favourite days because it means a post on Hive will be written by me, and I get to hear other music that Hivers and Hiveians enjoy. Well for the select band that participate in ttt anyway!

***And today will be a wee bit different!***


![ttt local hero.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/243BgAbRvAue6HRH3G6J5nDZu5VrFoxXqnSV2SinJV6TEweP7FvwYAvqNjx3Dj94DBTVu.png)




We are going back to my Silver Chronicles post of a few weeks ago [My Soundtrack for the 80s my favourite decade](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@tengolotodo/my-soundtrack-for-the-80s)

Quite a self-explanatory title and it is my inspiration for the next few posts on ttt!

The year is now 1983 and this was the first entry for that year ...

>📽 Local Hero – The ultimate \

Scottish film, filmed in Pennan and Morar. The village of Pennan and the red telephone box drew visitors from all over. I took Mrs T a couple of times there and it was like some of the fishing villages in the East Neuk that I like! Yes it's a fluffing film and we are having three tunes from the soundtrack! ### 3 tunes from 1983 by Mark Knopfler. * * * It is Tuesday and that of course means that it's #ttt or #threetunetuesday and so it's time to share some tunes with you! * * * @ablaze started #ttt **265** weeks ago! Go check out what it is all about on his latest post [Sunshine Mix for Three Tune Tuesday - Week 266 - win some HBI](https://peakd.com/@ablaze/sunshine-mix-for-three-tune-tuesday-week-266-win-some-hbi) **_Do go support @ablaze as without him we would not have this mental fun musical activity that you can win HSBI from! I am happy to be one of the SIX sponsors and it is kinda fun checking out music from all over this global village of ours!_** He has just released some winners posts, so go support those posts, he gets no support from any whales or even curation trails for these posts that he does. 262 weeks is an incredible amount of time, and I for one love that he runs this, and I appreciate the time and dedication that he puts in, when he could be doing something else. ### Long live #ttt 😁🎼 and #threetunetuesday

/> ### The Genius - Mark Knopfler and Dire Straits. For this week’s ttt, we are merging Glasgow, Newcastle and the North East of Scotland all through Knopfler. The guy is a guitar legend a genius. Did you know he does not use a pick, he is left handed by plays the strings with his right hand. He is so unmistakable. Not only is he the front man for Dire Straits he has scored some fluffing awesome films such as Local Hero. He was born in Glasgow but moved to Newcastle when he was 7... If you look at my lead image, those are the bridges over the river Tyne in Newcastle and yes I transplanted a red telephone box onto it, as anyone you watched the film will remember... The last song is the real Newcastle connection as it is the anthem for The Magpies the wonderful Toon Army or Newcastle United! Here are three incredible tunes Knopfler gave us in that unforgettable filmscore for Local Hero in 1983.

/> ### Tune 1 - Wild Theme https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vh2GFoDae8Y The acoustic, finger-picked soul of the entire film. It perfectly captures the tranquil, atmospheric beauty of the fictional village of Ferness and sets the emotional tone for the whole story.

/> ### Tune 2 - The Way It Always Starts https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SCJRONLzfUM This is the only major vocal track on the album and features a guest appearance... Did you guee who? Kudos if you did, but it is another Scottish legend in Gerry Rafferty.

/> ### Tune 3 - Going Home: Theme of the Local Hero https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3DB-uJ0TxKQ The ultimate soaring finale driven by Michael Brecker's legendary saxophone work. This is one of Knopfler's most famous pieces of music and instantly recognisable. This is the anthem I was talking about earlier and for decades, the players have run out onto the pitch at St James' Park to that very song in front of 50,000 roaring fans. I have seen and heard it live and it is right up there, but not as good as Tina Turner Simply The Best and Rangers running out at Ibrox!

/> ### So there you have it, 3 songs released in 1983 from the music score of the film Local Hero with my [80s Soundtrack post](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@tengolotodo/my-soundtrack-for-the-80s) as the inspiration! Which was your favourite tune? Or have you never heard of them?

/>

**_Note_**_: The 3 YouTube videos that I have shared are not owned by me, I am simply spreading great music on Hive._

I wish that you all have a brilliant happy fun and terrific Tuesday until we meet again enjoy your tunes 🎶🎵🎶

### Thanks for visiting!

The images and ramblings are from me, with some assistance from gemini on the verbage and the lead image, the mad Scotsman TengoLoTodo unless otherwise stated.

@tengolotodo June 30th 2026

DO WHAT YOU LOVE AND DO IT OFTEN
--------------------------------

### HASTE YE BACK

Investing in [office security](https://valmont-security.com/blog/office-reception-security-a-practical-guide-for-london-businesses/) services helps prevent unauthorized access, theft, vandalism, and other security risks while creating a safe and productive environment.

A key part of effective workplace protection is [Reception Security](https://valmont-security.com/blog/office-reception-security-a-practical-guide-for-london-businesses/). Reception security officers are the first point of contact for visitors, contractors, and employees. They verify identities, manage visitor logs, monitor CCTV systems, and ensure only authorised individuals enter the premises. Their professional presence also creates a welcoming atmosphere while maintaining strict access control, making them an important part of any commercial security strategy.

For businesses with multiple locations or larger premises, [mobile patrol London](https://valmont-security.com/blog/mobile-patrol-security-cost-in-london-is-it-worth-it/) services provide an extra layer of protection. Mobile patrol officers conduct scheduled and random inspections of office buildings, parking areas, warehouses, and surrounding grounds. Their visible presence acts as a strong deterrent against trespassing, vandalism, and criminal activity. Mobile patrols can also respond quickly to alarms, lock or unlock premises, and report suspicious incidents before they escalate.

Every business has unique security requirements. A tailored security plan combines trained security personnel, advanced surveillance systems, access control, and regular patrols to minimise risks and ensure business continuity. Whether you operate a corporate headquarters, shared office space, financial institution, or commercial property, professional security services help maintain a secure working environment around the clock.

At Valmont Security, we deliver reliable and professional security solutions designed to meet the needs of modern businesses across London. From experienced reception officers to responsive mobile patrol teams, our highly trained security professionals work proactively to protect your premises, staff, and visitors.

Choosing trusted office security, dependable Reception Security, and reliable mobile patrol London services gives businesses greater confidence, improved safety, and peace of mind. Investing in professional security today helps protect your reputation, assets, and operations for the future.

Также на пути мне удалось увидеть несколько диких животных: стаю белок, которые игриво скакали по деревьям, и одного лося, медленно вы grazing на лужайке. Эти моменты заставили меня почувствовать, что природа действительно прекрасна и полна жизни. body.title: A Special Day
body.body:
The day started with scorching heat. I, on the other hand, slept through the morning. Hehehe! I was supposed to keep a good routine, but previous night, I had to cover up for my job's assignment. However, by the noon time, there was complete silence in the sky. It was indicating some betterment in temperature. And guess what? The dark clouds start to gather around, covering up the sky. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/85042667-7ee6-40a7-a95a-5404fdd4d889.jpg) The very next moment, I asked my friend, if we can roam around the city in this weather (as I am a guest). He said, Yes. And, without any second thought, we started our journey. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ba58d2f0-b3bf-4e91-807c-71864430d285.jpg) It was going well, but clouds were fading away. Nature was playing as game with us. Still, we were not willing to go back. As it was still enjoyable environment. After few minutes, as we were on the road. It started to rain. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b9d17ab1-7b68-4660-af37-032e615c0647.jpg) I should not had gone to the wet road, just for a click though. But still, I did it. Fun part is: we were hiding beneath a tree, during this moment. Drops were quite cold. Moreover, as rain settled for a bit, we were moving beside the fields. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/57391b53-e427-4f05-85ad-c519a77109d6.jpg) It was joyful moments. The dirt had settled down, nature was fully green and post-rain freshness is beyond expression. Every moment was lively. By the time, we reached the sort of hiking side, rain had stopped. And the weather was pleasant. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/89a42bd9-8ae9-4982-9170-f530742b37e8.jpg) We hiked for few minutes, then called it a day. Because, I was tired. As I am not used to these hilly areas. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/cdba8655-c63e-495a-bbde-630771354244.jpg) In the end, I was able to cross my daily limit. I did not only walk; I walked 12K+ steps for the first time. Plus, I have maintained my streak for the tenth-day, and I hope to continue with it. This was the last click, expressing the weather change and ray of hope. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/19533242-ee8a-482d-bcff-0ef7e92baa87.jpg) Regards!

> ## Krowl Brightbane Now let's check out more details about the cards, starting with the common rarity card. In my opinion, among all the arts, Krowl Brightbane's was the best of all, because it's like a warrior with a dragon aura behind him. Notice that his attacks are 2 ranged damage at lv2, which is as if it were his main attack, and it is only at level 8 that the card's second magical damage comes. The interesting thing about this is that the ranged attack is the main one and you can see that the unit has a type of bow in its hand (ranged atk), and in the background there is a magical aura that could be a representation of the magical attack.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUZa8UwNMTsTm4FR5ZCK27zngwcqsjnvXyWvRkQZX6Htx/image.png)
[🐉 Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
The interesting thing is that the combination causes the bow to have some type of ability which is precisely the Dispel that the card receives at level 5, which by the way is one of the best levels of the card, as it will only receive the next ability at the last level. In addition to this, level 2 is also interesting because it receives 2 ranged damage, only changing the card's damage again towards the last levels. The problem with level 2 is that the card doesn't have a good amount of HP and only average speed. From level 5 onwards, when the card starts to have a considerable speed of 4 to 5 and an hp between 6 and 8, it becomes a little more resistant. As the card is an archer, it's worth remembering that a large part of the damage, half, ends up becoming useless when it reaches the first position, so keep that in mind. Furthermore, it is a dual death and dragon card, with a mana cost of 8 and now with the issue of bloodlines it is worth mentioning that it is a Canisan. ## Vethos Spineclaw Next in rare rarity, we have Vethos Spineclaw, a melee dps of the water and earth elements with mana cost of 5. From level 1 it has an average attack of 3 melee damage with 6 and HP and 4 armor which is interesting to withstand a little damage. Furthermore, with the Apex Strike ability it is very likely that it can attack from other positions, even if it is not a melee, which makes it a very versatile card.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRiSwxjGmr57CwJvaAr6RoEmJdPiTDT4xYDVYYXo2SW26/image.png)
[🐉 Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
And as I mentioned now with the issue of bloodlines, being a Rodentian type card and having the ability bloodline pact, it can be a great combo, because it will give extra power to allies of the same bloodline and as it is very resistant, this bonus will be applied for a long time. Finally, the Deflect skill is very useful when the match rule or the opponent uses Blast. ## Taark Nightbloom Now the last card is one with a low mana cost, being only 4 mana. This card is Taark Nightbloom, a melee attacker that has a very unique combination of life and death elements, being complete opposites. This question of opposites is well represented in the skills, where at level 4 you gain Flame Fed, which means that the unit, instead of losing life when entering the burning state, gains +1 HP at the beginning of the turn.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZp2GUULA7BUr1qE6sUzvSMaNcRUpxHN7TfX2DEg6DNLp/image.png)
[🐉 Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
Continuing in this duality, at level 2 with 4 bcx, you gain the shatter ability which, with sneak, allows you to directly attack the last unit and break its shield. But the curious thing is that in addition to breaking, at the last level (6), this Treefolk unit gains Protect, giving armor to allies. This makes it a unit that, while protecting with a shield, attacks by breaking the opponents' shields. --- https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVA8nYfdsJtPHvQ22mgMdhDhpJEiYmuLkjyQFGFtDHnFB/Divider.png ---

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd9gyb7dhiXoN3Qwr4j57kRNJguxdgB1mwcr3fi8mvncF/how_good_are_the_three_new_voucher_cards.jpg) É bem provável que na atualização de hoje do Splinterlands, no dia 30 de Junho, as novas voucher cards cheguem à Exclusive/Voucher Shop. Pensando nisso, é interessante analisar um pouco mais a fundo como vai funcionar essa venda de cartas observando os preços, o custo do voucher e os benefícios. Além disso, antes mesmo de pensar no custo, o mais importante é entender sobre as cartas em si. Por isso, vamos também buscar entender quais são os melhores níveis de cada carta, o famoso custo-benefício, os combos em que elas poderão ser utilizadas e claro os status e habilidades de cada carta não podem faltar. Sobre a venda das cartas já foi divulgado o preço das cartas em voucher e as chances. Para quem ainda não chegou a conferir já que estamos em manutenção e ainda não leu o post com essas informações, pode conferir por aqui. A cartas vendidas serão nas raridades comum, rara e épica, sendo que na venda anterior a última raridade era lendária com o Lorn. A carta comum será o Krowl Brightbane custando 25 vouchers ($0,23), a carta rara será o Vethos Spineclaw custando 100 vouchers ($0,92) e por fim a carta épica será o Taark Nightbloom 250 vouchers ($2,3). ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVznTYHnQnMcuZT2g7j1eXFghQTKGXuiZaNUbJWbu2ZJJ/image.png) Recentemente eu já fiz uma comparação entre comprar no voucher shop e no marketplace, se quiser conferir é clicar no POST. De forma breve, se você tiver o interesse em tentar a sorte em conseguir uma Gold Foil ou uma Black Foil, essa chance você consegue ao comprar as cartas no voucher shop, mas para isso há um custo maior. Já se o seu objetivo é ter apenas algumas cópias das cartas, então pode compensar aguardar elas chegarem no marketplace. O que alguns jogadores fazem é comprar a carta no voucher shop, colocar para vender no marketplace se tiver um preço parecido com o custo do voucher shop, e com isso eles tentam conseguir uma raridade acima, as vezes vendendo um pouco abaixo. Fico agradecido se você puder dar um **Voto**, **Reblogs** ou algum **Tips**. Obrigado e boa leitura! 🍀 ---

Na minha opinião, dentre todas as artes a do Krowl Brightbane foi a melhor de todas, porque é como se fosse um guerreiro com uma aura de dragão atrás. Percebe que os ataque dele são 2 de dano ranged no lv2, que é como se fosse o ataque principal dele, e só no nível 8 que vem o segundo dano mágico da carta. Como a carta é um arqueiro, vale lembrar que uma grande parte do dano, metade, acaba ficando inútil quando chegar na primeira posição, então tenha isso em mente. Além disso, é uma carta dual de death e dragão, de custo de mana 8 e agora com a questão das bloodlines vale mencionar que é um Canisan. ## Vethos Spineclaw Em seguida na raridade raro, temos o Vethos Spineclaw, uma dps melee dos elementos água e terra de custo de mana 5. Por fim a habilidade Deflect é bem útil para quando a regra da partida ou o oponente usam Blast. ## Taark Nightbloom Agora a última carta é uma de custo de mana baixo, sendo apenas 4 de mana. Essa carta é o Taark Nightbloom, um atacante melee que tem uma combinação de elementos bem única life e death, sendo completo opostos. Essa questão de opostos é bem representada nas habilidade, em que no nível 4 ganha o Flame Fed, que faz com que a unidade ao em vez de perder vida ao entrar no estado de burning, ganhe +1 de HP no início do turno.

body.title: The Old Cup on My Table
body.body:
Hello everyone. My name is @emmanuel50 and this is my very first post in this community, @lifestory. I am happy to be here and to share something from my thoughts with you. I enjoy writing about simple moments that can teach us something about life.
‎
‎Today, I want to share a short poem that came to my mind while I was looking at a simple cup on my table. I hope you enjoy reading it, and I would be happy to hear your thoughts.

![IMG-20260630-WA0084.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emmanuel50/244KRFHZFZ27kXVSwvm5PvAB519wNecT7LRnbY8aj36oD9Ayq65xqFohnFpgwuGMGAMfv.jpg)

There is an old cup on our table. It is not beautiful. It is not new. It is just a cup. Every morning someone takes it. Some days it holds tea. Some days it holds water. Some days nobody touches it. One day I looked at it. I saw a small crack. I tried to remember when it happened. Then I smiled to myself. Maybe people are like that too. We all have small cracks that others cannot see. Some of them come from hard times. Some come from mistakes. Some come from losing people we love. Even when nobody knows our story, we carry those moments with us. We still wake up. We still do our best. We still help someone. We still keep going. The cup is still there. Nobody talks about it. It never asks to be noticed. It simply stays where it belongs. Every new morning it is useful again. Looking at it made me think about life. We do not have to be perfect before we can be useful. We do not have to look new before we can make someone smile. Small cracks do not take away our value. Sometimes they remind us how far we have come. That simple cup taught me something I never expected to learn from an ordinary day.
‎

*All image are mine*

body.title: Sistema de Riego con Máquinas de Pivot Central Eléctrico. Plano de Replanteo de la Obra/Electric Center Pivot Irrigation System. As-Built Plan
body.body:
​​Muy buenas tardes Hive.

​Continuando con el proyecto de las 9 máquinas de Pivot Central Eléctrico. Ya en fase de terminación. Les presento el Plano de Replanteo de la Obra.

​**¿Qué es el replanteo?**

​Para explicarlo de forma sencilla, cuando el constructor va a comenzar a construir cualquier cosa, llega al terreno donde va la obra. Ahí tiene una primera ubicación que es de forma general. ​Pero necesita una orientación específica, exacta de dónde va el objeto. Ejemplo: Una vivienda que tiene 4 esquinas, replantearla no es más que ubicar con coordenadas exactas, dónde va cada esquina.

​**En nuestro proyecto, hay varios parámetros a replantear**

1. ​El centro del pivot: muy importante la exactitud, teniendo en cuenta que un mal replanteo puede implicar que choquen las máquinas una con otra y el resultado sería desastroso. En la práctica sí han existido casos. Estos equipos que tienen entre 220 y 500 metros de radio es difícil percibir sin instrumentos si chocarán o no.

2. ​El terraplén de parqueo: Es donde descansará la máquina cuando no esté regando y donde se colocarán los anclajes antihuracanes.

3. ​La caseta de bombeo: que protegerá la electrobomba y la pizarra eléctrica.

4. ​La caseta de fertirriego: Donde irán los depósitos, los mezcladores, el dosificador para la aplicación del fertilizante.

​5. También se replantearán los componentes de la caja de succión y la tubería de impulsión.

De forma general, para el replanteo, los topógrafos construyen dos monumentos cerca del área de la obra. Estos son dos pequeños cuadrados de hormigón rellenos con un pedazo de cabilla en el centro. Deben estar ubicados en un lugar visible donde se pueda observar el área de las máquinas y que no corran peligro de ser arrancados. Tendrán por ubicación coordenadas reales conocidas.

​Para elaborar el plano en cuestión. A partir de los monumentos, se trazan  líneas rectas entre estos y el centro de las máquinas (ubicadas gráficamente en un plano) y así voy refiriendo la distancia y los ángulos para que luego los mismos topógrafos replanteen la obracon el uso de GPS Y Estación Total (Equipos rofesionales de medición topográfica)

​Ya casi terminamos este trabajo

​Hasta la próxima.

------------------------------------------------------------

Good afternoon, Hive.

​Continuing with the project of the 9 Center Pivot Irrigation machines, now in its final phase, I present to you the Site Layout Plan (Staking Plan) of the Project.

​**What is staking out (site layout)?**

​To put it simply, when the builder is about to start constructing anything, they arrive at the land where the project will be built. There, they have an initial location, which is a general setup. However, they need a specific, exact orientation of where the structure will go. Example: For a house that has 4 corners, staking it out is simply locating, with exact coordinates, where each corner goes.

​In our project, there are several parameters to be staked out:

1. ​The center of the pivot: accuracy is crucial, considering that a poor layout could cause the machines to collide with each other, and the result would be disastrous. In practice, such cases have actually occurred. With these equipment units having a radius between 220 and 500 meters, it is difficult to perceive without instruments whether they will collide or not.

2. ​The parking platform (embankment): This is where the machine will rest when it is not irrigating and where the anti-hurricane anchors will be placed.

3. ​The pumping station house: which will protect the electric pump and the electrical control panel.

4. ​The fertigation room: Where the tanks, mixers, and the doser for fertilizer application will be located.

5. ​The components of the suction box and the discharge (impulsion) pipeline will also be staked out.

​Generally speaking, for the layout, surveyors build two monuments near the project area. These are two small concrete squares filled with a piece of rebar in the center. They must be located in a visible spot from which the machines' area can be observed, and where they are not at risk of being torn out. They will have known real coordinates for their location.

​To prepare the plan in question, straight lines are drawn from the monuments to the center of the machines (graphically located on a plan). This way, I reference the distance and angles so that the surveyors can later lay out the project using GPS and a Total Station (professional surveying equipment).

​We are almost done with this work.

​Until next time.

![img_20260627_125200-31b4c4eb26a5.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/crazyphantombr/lkt-mr10xuwm-bp4ko7n2/img_20260627_125200-31b4c4eb26a5.webp)

What a great idea it was to buy the three low-calorie beer labels available at the local market. I immediately thought about doing a blind tasting, which gave me the perfect excuse to buy one bottle of each brand. After all, I was only familiar with one of them, so I created this \

to make a post as justification for buying all three!

Right from the start, we noticed a huge difference in carbonation, with **Imperio Ultra** standing out by keeping its foam for much longer, as you can see in photo 5.

When it came to flavor, we felt like we had arranged the bottles in descending order, so the farther to the right, the lighter the taste (that classic \

feeling). **Amstel Ultra** came out on top with the best overall flavor!

body.title: Mastercard hat Agent Pay for Machines vorgestellt/Mastercard has introduced Agent Pay for Machines
body.body:
Zu den ersten Unterstützern gehören neben Coinbase, Stripe, OKX, Cloudflare und der Solana Foundation auch RippleX.

Die Initiative soll KI-Agenten ermöglichen, Zahlungen programmatisch, schnell und mit klaren Regeln auszuführen. Mastercard spricht von einer neuen Klasse von Zahlungen, die nicht mehr von Menschen ausgelöst werden, sondern kontinuierlich im Hintergrund digitaler Geschäftsprozesse stattfinden.

Für Ripple ist die Mastercard-Initiative ein weiterer Hinweis darauf, dass agentische Zahlungen vom Experimentierfeld in Richtung institutioneller Infrastruktur rücken. Im Mittelpunkt stehen dabei der XRP Ledger (XRPL) und Ripple USD (RLUSD), der Stablecoin des Unternehmens.

**Autonome Agenten würden bereits Rechnungen begleichen und Rechenleistung bezahlen. Institutionen könnten diese Geschwindigkeit aber nur nutzen, wenn die Kontrollmechanismen mithalten.**

“XRPL und RLUSD sind so gebaut, dass Unternehmen Agenten innerhalb von Regeln, die die Chain selbst durchsetzt, mit Maschinengeschwindigkeit transagieren lassen können”, so Infanger. Als Vorteile nannte er Abwicklung in Sekunden, vorhersehbare Kosten, programmierbare Compliance und vollständige Auditierbarkeit.

Damit positioniert Ripple den XRP Ledger als Infrastruktur für einen Markt, in dem KI-Agenten nicht nur Informationen verarbeiten, sondern wirtschaftlich handeln. Die Agenten sollen dabei nicht völlig frei agieren, sondern innerhalb definierter Berechtigungen.

Agent Pay for Machines baut auf Mastercards Agent-Pay-Programm auf, das 2025 vorgestellt wurde. Die neue Lösung richtet sich stärker an automatisierte, kleinteilige und hochfrequente Zahlungen, die im Hintergrund digitaler Dienste stattfinden.

Beispiele nennt Mastercard ebenfalls: Ein KI-Agent könnte für einen Gründer automatisch Domain, Hosting, Bilder und Checkout-Seiten einkaufen. Ein Logistik-Agent könnte Frachtkosten, Lagergebühren oder Daten für Kühlkettenüberwachung eigenständig begleichen.

Ich zitierte aus folgender Quelle...

https://www.btc-echo.de/schlagzeilen/xrp-ripplex-mastercard-initiative-zahlungen-ki-agenten-232239/

Mein Fazit:

Vereinfacht gesagt:
Ein Mensch gibt einer KI oder Maschine ein Budget und Regeln vor.
Die KI darf anschließend selbstständig Einkäufe oder Zahlungen tätigen.
Mastercard stellt die Zahlungsinfrastruktur, Identitätsprüfung und Sicherheitsmechanismen bereit.
Beispiele
Stell dir vor:

🚗 Dein Elektroauto erkennt, dass der Akku fast leer ist, fährt zu einer Ladesäule und bezahlt den Ladevorgang selbst.

🖨️ Ein Drucker bestellt automatisch neue Tonerkartuschen und bezahlt sie.

🏭 Eine Produktionsmaschine bestellt Ersatzteile, sobald Sensoren Verschleiß feststellen.

Ich denke das KI Agenten das nächste Hype Thema in diesem Zyklus ist?

Wie ist deine Meinung?

---


![1000107509.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbtfTXEJvJJfvBFsNAtPACzmtVguA1yjMFcjMb1GFBjLT/1000107509.png)

English 

Early supporters include RippleX, alongside Coinbase, Stripe, OKX, Cloudflare, and the Solana Foundation.

The initiative aims to enable AI agents to execute payments programmatically, rapidly, and according to clear rules. Mastercard describes this as a new class of payments that are no longer triggered by humans but occur continuously in the background of digital business processes.

For Ripple, the Mastercard initiative is further evidence that agentic payments are moving from the experimental stage toward institutional infrastructure. Central to this effort are the XRP Ledger (XRPL) and Ripple USD (RLUSD), the company’s stablecoin.

**Autonomous agents are already settling invoices and paying for computing power. However, institutions can only leverage this speed if control mechanisms keep pace.**

\

said Infanger. He cited benefits such as settlement in seconds, predictable costs, programmable compliance, and full auditability.

In doing so, Ripple positions the XRP Ledger as infrastructure for a market where AI agents not only process information but also engage in economic activity. These agents are not intended to operate with total freedom, but rather within defined authorization parameters.

\

builds upon Mastercard’s Agent Pay program, which was introduced in 2025. The new solution is geared more specifically toward automated, granular, and high-frequency payments occurring in the background of digital services.

Mastercard also provides examples: An AI agent could automatically purchase a domain, hosting, images, and checkout pages for a founder. A logistics agent could independently settle freight costs, storage fees, or charges related to cold-chain monitoring data. I quoted from the following source...

https://www.btc-echo.de/schlagzeilen/xrp-ripplex-mastercard-initiative-zahlungen-ki-agenten-232239/

My conclusion:

Put simply:
A human assigns a budget and a set of rules to an AI or machine.
The AI ​​is then authorized to make purchases or payments independently.
Mastercard provides the payment infrastructure, identity verification, and security mechanisms.
Examples
Imagine:

🚗 Your electric car detects that the battery is running low, drives to a charging station, and pays for the charging process itself.

🖨️ A printer automatically orders and pays for new toner cartridges.

🏭 A production machine orders spare parts as soon as sensors detect wear and tear.

I think AI agents are the next big hype topic of this cycle.

What’s your take?

body.title: The 2000-year-old stone🚩🚙 / La piedra de 2000 anos📸💎
body.body:
>For this contest, I selected a stone that isn't visually appealing or as ancient as the dinosaurs. However, can you imagine touching a piece of stone that was probably used in a Roman house? Let me tell you how this little piece of brick ended up in my hand! Enjoy this experience because you will travel with me back more than 1,500 years!🚙📸 # Para este concurso seleccioné una piedra no tan atractiva visualmente ni tan antigua como los dinosaurios. Sin embargo, ¿te imaginas poder tocar un pedazo de piedra que probablemente fue utilizado en alguna casa romana? ¡Ya te cuento cómo acabó este pequeño pedazo de ladrillo en mi mano! ¡Disfruta de esta experiencia porque viajarás conmigo más de 1500 años!🏞️🗺️ ![0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/AJhZeJtSaeDxftxZ1RQSob8Fedop5P1t2bhJr3vhk7N3Cj3ggQhEKU1QeF2o5uY.jpg)
![1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23uEx4C342cAJDMJQj4aRbxTwRXhe8PGiA2Tk4ApTns3SzCo5Tscdhy8wdbNuX8Di6Py4.gif)
*Coordinates:39.370119, -7.385868🌏🧭 / Coordinadas: 39.370119, -7.385868*📍🌏
![IMG_3402.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23wqieGEoeiKnWJFQM4jFuhk1xGqNDi1Hm8TJrifhqG1EZJkko96RnZ8YwHUZ8Uzw6dZB.JPG)
Today's visit was quick and touristy, but I took advantage of the great opportunity to create something original for the contest! We know that bricks aren't natural; they're a building material created from a mixture of clay, sand, and water! But I think they have more uses than a simple rock, hehe.🚩📍
La visita de hoy fue rapida y turistica, sin embargo aprovecha la gran oportunidad para crear algo original para el concurso! sabemos que los ladrillos no son naturales, son un material de construccion que se crea con la mezcla de arcilla, arena y agua! pero me parece que tiene mas utilidad que una simple roca jeje,📸🚙
![gif6_dorado_shimmer.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23twC3hcw4x8Y1qsCn6goYEV4x9NWf6UVG34R2w6WFF2csuDuQtCy4TdwzfaVVon48NV1.gif)
#
*Que historia cuenta?🌏🧭 / What story does it tell?*📍🌏
![20260627_163659.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EoEqaJn2fXYneSsPhwMaw9BnqwA6H2T2B1P9zAHrkaeKhZpsonG26fs1mDdRo1vxt4b.jpg) ![20260627_163655.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EoEqaJn3GtFcJniJu12ztpL2PdboGrjfXozCeoDbZcoMNTFxK9ikmEp3oEvtNvKK8W9.jpg)
¡Totalmente de acuerdo! Ese enfoque disruptivo es justamente lo que hace que una propuesta destaque en cualquier competencia. Al transformar un objeto arqueológico cotidiano en el centro de un debate geológico, logras que el público y el jurado miren el material con otros ojos. La historia de la humanidad está profundamente ligada a la transformación de la Tierra, y tu \

es el puente perfecto entre ambas disciplinas.📍🗺️
I want to clarify something important: the contest says to find a rock in nature. A brick isn't a rock, since it's not formed by a natural process, so I'll take responsibility if the judges deduct a few points, haha. But hey, in the end, this is for fun and learning too! And I know this is a piece of brick because I'm at an archaeological site. The question is, how do you know if what you have in your hand actually corresponds to your rock? Uh, geology is difficult, haha! Every rock, stone, or building material tells a story! With them and carbon-14 dating, you can estimate the age of what's in the ground.🏞️📸
![gif5_verde_animado.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23tcQwWKu1QjkmYPLdJN15WRfUrWr5Zze8TmQubBPDAMTVRodNmLrtSsE28CqDNnvviZy.gif)
![20260627_170658.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/Eoc83RyAmbCd93ivwqqVzE88JWZQhBatewk4S5BtetQ21YcfzrAvp3vA41CK3KUDNU5.jpg) ![20260627_170700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EoeEvhrPSWb6XNaY2zVBxkZxaT3zkXP2ouAXFnGHdQx1HJLgL9EH5ne8rtLmvBA1t9h.jpg)
If you look closely, the first stone could have been presented as any other rock, but it actually corresponds to a piece from that pile of bricks which, as you can see, doesn't have the normal characteristics and coloring of a modern brick. Although it may seem crazy, they were manufactured in the 1st century AD, in a city called Ammaia. I want to emphasize that I left the rock there; I didn't take it, as that would be a crime! They were widely used to build frames and chimneys, and they adapted well to different types of structures. This is one of the most pristine cities discovered in Europe; practically no civilization ever built on top of it, unlike many others.🚩📍
Si te fijas, la primera piedra pude haberla presentado como cualquier otra roca, pero en realidad corresponde a un pedazo de ese montón de ladrillos que, como puedes ver, no tienen las características normales ni la coloración de un ladrillo moderno. Aunque te parezca una locura, fueron fabricados en el siglo I d. C., en una ciudad llamada Ammaia. ¡Quiero recalcar que dejé la roca allí y no la tomé, ya que eso sería un delito! Fueron muy utilizados para construir marcos y chimeneas, y se adecuaban bien a diferentes tipos de estructuras. Esta es una de las ciudades más vírgenes descubiertas en Europa; prácticamente ninguna civilización construyó encima de ella, a diferencia de muchas otras.🏰🏞️
![20260627_164923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EoZsv1cmogJy6zARPX91PZghwvK2ZSFWFaPQAYw2YPD7FhsALUJQt9aoLh9GTioPrsD.jpg) ![20260627_165153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/Eq9TnHhsapb7neSZ96axUMJU7CNtES9E6z34MqermPBDwZvgqHPQDYzmxSpGYFoLKmE.jpg) ![20260627_165155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/Eq5DXEHWAMg33L48jgVCACAMCah7kAepZEs8yizKS3skbmf3yggJFQsYN9d1JVQPB69.jpg) ![20260627_165159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EnWGbyQPmFqoaWyZfDaDEh7wnmWphsYSve6pYYCBWPybwV8WtrkyU3zTfQX4jb1L9PF.jpg)
There are some records indicating that the city already existed when Augustus was in power, so we can say it was built in the 1st century BC, placing it in the Alentejo region of Portugal, a rather hot area. In total, 25 hectares of construction were discovered! The city was so important that when Lusitania existed, it held administrative power, although the city was mostly famous for its trade route.📸🚩
Hay algunos registros que indican que la ciudad ya existía cuando Augusto estaba en el poder; por lo tanto, podemos decir que fue construida en el siglo I a. C., situándola en el Alentejo de Portugal, una zona bastante calurosa. En total, ¡se descubrieron 25 hectáreas de construcción! La ciudad fue tan importante que, cuando existió Lusitania, ¡esta ciudad ostentaba el poder administrativo, a pesar de que fue más famosa por su ruta comercial!🌏💎

*a Roman shoe print on a stone🌏🧭 / una huella de calzado romano en una piedra*📍🌏
*The rocks are interesting because they tell a story, as I mentioned in the previous text. In this case, this one has an authentic footprint from a Roman who lived in the city. That's why I emphasize that the brick I'm holding in my hand was surely used by a Roman 1,500 years ago.📍🗺️* *Las rocas son interesantes porque cuentan una historia, así como lo mencionaba en el texto anterior. En este caso, esta tiene una auténtica huella de una pisada de algún romano que vivió en la ciudad; por eso hago énfasis en que seguramente el ladrillo que sostengo en mi mano fue usado por algún romano hace 1500 años.📸🚩* ![20260627_170424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EogMJVV4cY6zh2RRs4jShPNKh2v7mgqaKA6Pw3uDRjGNxLF4RD5Qfa52Ptw8QGyHhkx.jpg) ![20260627_170432.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/Eoryq9dka45sU6chN2rL7A3jTQztwn5HhfNDfxvKo3vECcnJw517qMZn5Q7g5azNxRF.jpg) ![20260627_170650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EoiVJcvCkB5gwx7ypgV5DVdujtaCERdvT5J3G85LkhFoGJA8v1Ew11V1DV9oq8zV8z4.jpg) ![20260627_170705.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/EoAaEuHFzd21MpAV7S6JJJn5skNM3RaF5BTDC4NKvnE1GLJHPsQyHHx7aMHjvyWPC1k.jpg) ![20260627_170716.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/Eou8o6wsDzAYky16VQYrMTAwTgu5arLwD5VNNsG4YJRwQW7LZ25KAn5sWcLhM5Yg5Eo.jpg) #

body.title: In Virgin Territories- A Monomad Challenge
body.body:
My very first black and white session took place in the bushes, and I had no idea what I was doing. I fumbled around fiddling with the camera settings because stuff didn't look so hot when I took the shots. So, I was not too happy with the results for most of the images, but a few turned out well and helped me learn about the art of black and white alchemy. I'm sharing these images for the *Monomad challenge*.

Grayscale has a way of altering the mood of a photo. During the photographic hike, I used an Olympus TG6 cam set to the Monochrome setting. The forest is usually full of green and brown hues with dashes of other colours from flowers. Without them, it turns into a mysterious place with various shades of darkness that have a striking effect on the scene.

<center>![Forest in BW21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EpEGnSKyaCWe5votN9vWCqW3D6rGQ6KNam2NvAeYUyFqEUJ59FxSfjYp5ps32U1CTtc.jpg)</center>

In the following image, I liked the way the sunlight struck the wispy lichen on the branch while still leaving deep shadows in the forest.

<center>![Forest in BW02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EoEoaRuV6ddWA2MSeSWiKDBR7WtH5H5xvquzs3cAqpHEJwW1BcUSsMbaqPXdvaaKD8q.jpg)</center>

For strong contrast between dark and light, scenes like the next one were the best. The towering trees create a dark contrast against the bright sky with added depth from the leaves at the base.

<center>![Forest in BW06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/245mwHrNg5QqwwHRFDCcSLNjqGZdLJfkCgKMQxjjbKkV7Pnmo7emiGRL8jTtvP9sryToH.jpg)</center>

After seeing the next shot, I realized that I should've taken more bark photos.

<center>![Forest in BW11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EonkVQkwoDHjdfkdK8Jp4YurU1smEFF1rcyyPNTEutB6AqJnSk3FhtcywZii8EXaPSD.jpg)</center>

It was a variable cloudy day and sometimes the light came out and bathed the plants. In this photo, you can see the contrast between the foreground foliage and the darker background of the woods.

<center>![Forest in BW04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EonjUdQSZuKhCy4MUdM1QBvL3H6Dhd8UiaPbJcenq7pazeehXhBNeQmGuN8uNe2fNvH.jpg)</center>

<center>![Forest in BW18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EouA9qqoXKiFn4bp8AbMdN5b4YQQgzCj7zw9Gieod7R12cHHqggTV1KMiPRY2K5K9Q1.jpg)</center>

Some of these trees are hundreds of years old.

I like how this next shot came out because it captured the range of light variation in a balanced way with a bright focal center.

<center>![Forest in BW14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Eoc6YvRiPofhFxMgL4RG5j5wKtPkLiXb9oU26FvFjVArCoibENM4fZauZonD1kWYCKH.jpg)</center>

At the edge of the forest, the Pacific ocean stretches towards the west.

<center>![Forest in BW19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EptaXG7z8tyrdZCF7pGNvYSSfTm2rw45p4waxRjLkEJSj8otGsomUrTwSrsfCkeDpfr.jpg)</center>

<center>![Forest in BW22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EpJXDSdUCsRfvBfTQa3xPAMkWgzbg9GC8rSzqfsN7mpc6iS7LgLmqKjWprDAmoshaNr.jpg)</center>

I think urban photography is easier to work with in black and white than natural environments, but I enjoy a good challenge. I have a better sense now of what works and what doesn't in a forested area.

Thank you for hiking with me.

<center>![Forest in BW01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EorzJRnw3EZACz7e6h5Twyb1tzmt7Pfw21xT4gzpEzjLsyyRGhSegQGWy66tj4kQ6ss.jpg)</center>

<center>![Forest in BW17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EpNnuakcxZTSscxSyymmmN5chCVHTUhqeTPwsWKFb8y8P2iKN4qRAw5B6FCVejo4Cpj.jpg)</center>

body.title: I don't mind as long as I am not the main focus
body.body:
>

We are living in a digital world and all of us have smartphone. Thinking about life without a smartphone is nearly impossible because it became a part and parcel of our daily life. At least I can't imagine a life without a smartphone. Camera feature is the most interesting feature of smartphone and most of us give priority to the camera feature while buying a smartphone. I think all of us love to capture pictures and many of us share it in social media. The young generation is very easy going in this case. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSjYYqK4Y82BN9pmafmb63cEHifohHeb3pcDfDhTJL8o6/image.png) [ImgSrc](https://unsplash.com/photos/selective-focus-photography-of-person-taking-photo-of-crowd-during-daytime-pmZTSj29k6E) We have camera or smartphone camera and we are allowed to capture any pictures as we want because those devices belong to us. It's true that we are allowed to capture pictures anywhere, even if it's the public places, but it does not mean that we can take picture of anyone. We are not allowed to intentionally take pictures of any random person without their permission because it's not ethical. Before taking pictures of anyone, it's advisable to take permission of the person. In my country, it is a crime to take the picture of anyone without their permission. If the person as well as the victim may complain to the police station, the person who captured picture will be punished by law because of harassment. But it does not mean that we will be punished because of capturing the picture of our friends, even if it is taken without their permission. I don't think it's anything serious in that case and friends is not also going to make a complaint against us either. Let's talk about a different scenario. We capture pictures in public places. And many times we take picture of others people unintentionally. In such a case, most of the people don't even understand that they are pictured are being taken in someone else frame. They can understand each one. We upload the picture in social media. It's because in recent days we can detect ourselves if we are found in anyone else's frame easily. I'm quite sure that most of the people owned mind if they are not the main focus of the picture as I already said most of the young generation are easy going. Will I mind if I found myself in the social media picture in anyone else frame? To be honest, I don't mind to find myself in anyone else's frame unless I am the main focus of the picture and I won't complain about it in that case. But if I am the main focus of the picture obviously I will mind for sure and I will tell the person to remove the picture otherwise I will take legal action against the user for sure. It's because I think that persons don't deserve the right to publish my picture without my permission and it's a serious crime to upload it. It's better for that person to apologize to me otherwise he will face serious consequences for it does not matter if I face any difficulties for uploading the picture or not.

body.title: Hiking trip to Vida peak
body.body:
![vida (160 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/244oSgGycsGsTpqvXq9duS6uDUugZfcAD53aQCQMmjg3Kgh3heyyTmcdhxu7hmQYV5YxG.jpg)

This weekend my friends and I were in the Kotel Balkan and decided to hike to Vida Peak on Saturday.

The peak is located near the town of Kotel and there are several marked routes to it, but we took the one that starts from the main road south of the town.

![vida (130 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EqYsDVRGMU5Gc69mVJTkbPe4cJYLJs78iqJHU5Hv2khJAaGEd3YJEwhF49Bn33U6PZf.jpg)

We crossed a bridge and at the beginning of the route we started seeing beautiful plants and herbs.

![vida (132 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EpGRF2yrsCRLeqJQo41NhYkAFj3Tx2cHE8kHMEpKPkkkz6fdvcSUyMD9egs83BCPEAf.jpg)

![vida (133 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EoyPzkVKergLk5qm6qceg4TLpfho5nxY2bfyUfhXbJ3e2C85XowfFRnVE6yEMxAZMum.jpg)

![vida (134 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EpQvNbabhaf8UNwr6GHmeFt1xdQGdbPcy5gwKfssf5rUp4EeYP8yDcPQV57J7aXeoBm.jpg)

![vida (131 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/Ep5kkZvALsgNzMecDTEAECyqH25VPzPoXfowqxsZJYzR9Mec9Q5wxXNNrGCe1KyrWYu.jpg)

We continued along a rocky path near the river.

![vida (135 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EonjadvybnfkLe4gkrb4vfcfBdEf8Aj7SEAtsCTpMdbEfEwv5CRmx3c9cYbWYSZe8xX.jpg)

<div class=\

> ![vida (138 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/Eonk2BcMW53joJEpo48jez398g7NxEpQfZbTGGdTmPsC9rAr7mM9W9yKmrukUq6NFiS.jpg) The beautiful plants around us became more and more numerous and diverse. ![vida (139 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EoK3qTZnzyeiPcQGZD4apDpfmb5yJDoL6CEHWVoBRYomro9Jo4PmQBBKEJAspwn5JNZ.jpg) ![vida (140 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/Eo6HYS2Y1bCJUUhUNoN5CxSkstjhronMdmGqgo3iHfNkosu14vFekCk46xDgvb3zNAs.jpg) ![vida (141 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/Ep3cJ62KEPymL3yieJa6tPerWCGnojFHhB3gEJ2X4xkt119afT7wFaeMpEC1qpHPRzU.jpg) The campanula was especially prevalent - so delicate and beautiful. ![vida (143 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/Ep5jhHFSVefEsKEHvDrAuiXMszeUz4s4BJXgvyDf1ndsYH1vBZ1dPyeJLtLB8BHByui.jpg)

> ![vida (145 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EorzHSxjs87YYswz5p5GVDffEBqnTqiCUmUZhrLk93nasHvB1KLm7hZpcSSYbeEs4Tc.jpg) ![vida (148 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EoGxQQtoThPpJGBUPFe624mNwrbFtijJJFFy2erPv3SYMBRa7XnxxBKcq9krBsXM2bW.jpg) We also found mushrooms along the trail. ![vida (29 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/Eo4AdPbkD4mj71JsQ7GRQ7h5EK8MCwL69RP2Y46JECKgTd5rBMRu1JDvA22ZJ33VugH.jpg) ![vida (150 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EoK5uiML3ypmxoEaYRmVw3tuJJWwYiRgzYf7b2fo8Q1CGHrURYRx9uHfiYa37MmRxum.jpg) After a sharp turn on the rocky road, we headed through the forest following the red markings. ![vida (151 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/Ep7rj69D3Xgr6AHt8PogNV1ezM38JSVSq4zH59RJZGVaiTh5J9ysnYY36LC9GxQzGf7.jpg) ![vida (154 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EoK4Skmkah6maBuvhs8ghgWcVhfdqp43bfHzYHaYFbu3rSjLrGuYhYagwMvaRzeNdR1.jpg) The path was overgrown with tall grass and missing in places, but the markings showed us that we were in the right direction. ![vida (155 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/Ep7shE6UWa34X3GU5Ymd6iK2SXsakWNS5DadHodCY6neWJ9BdbzCLAZPEb5r8QoJZCK.jpg) There was a section that was steeper, but after that we reached the top and the view there was stunning.

> ![vida (4 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EpJW9JeN7S6BNrxM4rhVW9WLJYeuhZAAHfA6yfp4REhAjkPDa4H7rBAizBknGTAaCoA.jpg) ![vida (7 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EoeEtkJbWd4sUXP3whRcGo85ueAyoM8GY9J6E53QF3LBGhnH6NoH4tsZE5B1LRVWwM9.jpg) ![vida (8 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EnqRb78KynYkZvyWZyCdnhAxxji6WXgUvB8ALNRUYpSXeJhDnZpEVAw3W3aYeZnetSx.jpg) ![vida (9 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/Enm9Sr5tPMoQzL1iibEhyRXU7UzgacrSjz7U9gizskn8ihkpF3q2mwqZtnrTGCwxyMw.jpg) The rocks were covered with yellow and white yarrow and wildflowers. ![vida (159 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/243fkQD4YL2MJFnTUkC7NgZDRDuE4axzJXbHzZnCSe2mEicFkTHLUvSQKp2uhmyGQT5uk.jpg) ![vida (164 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/23uQvaLKBE8kTuwEyaJJpFeqWad9m9upTBiAmtwXD7iPejxoak5N1duXUTkXp6dpDDdxk.jpg) ![vida (167 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/23zvDNLksD97xjEh84mdzzn3qoBVVyvkU63Tdza5DgbHYNEUqd6EzPtJc1NGX2uTTmaFe.jpg) Vida Peak is 861 meters high and offers panoramic views in all directions as it stands out above the surrounding countryside. [//]:# (!worldmappin -88.65160 lat 157.50000 long d3scr) ![vida (161 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/244dwsF26aep3gYTqgwHQKF9Gu9RUp52E6EtSHcrAKZSUyBtCPuPiMWJy1M8zPBnjnN67.jpg) ![vida (22 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EqjUh15m5WUei4JNVCBRvhRG34a6qDM9AJzP7p4MgiG3Q8xx7YBg7N3dcccyVuhwQec.jpg) There used to be a fortress on the top, but the high vegetation did not allow us to find any remains. ![vida (16 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EoTbvrGwDDR5LwrKMFNku3Xzm43vjsJAsgAxbasyZmXa6fN9KqmbTWiF4gXN8WQjKVf.jpg) ![vida (19 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EpdgHToXv1mnonBpvQXWX9B3xSVELYfATARmPxL6aUcmoYX2wZ6HZuSF2gPysC5r8zy.jpg) ![vida (24 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EqhNpHWKzS6QGRAxQMSLLL5eZWAVfQaLQVgpq9hyLzspbu3YQUoJfFHLRFoPMnbrvuE.jpg) On my way back I picked up a gorgeous bouquet of mini daisies to which I added a campanula. ![vida (27 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/EoiUEUngWt4v8EmZfiFLy4koNjk6MG1hCmYsKUTcKRUFaEJVqeEmxZbe4vbGAuEBjta.jpg) ![vida (34 of 177).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vesytz/Eoc718HRsBKoAi2JVQTqVQ9WeCQDMPGFxwNcGYW4m2AGwVGxD5deQc3Yz6h5tNEBGmJ.jpg) My friends and I had a great day in nature.
**Thank you for stopping by!**

body.title: AN EMBARRASSING MOMENT
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

I am someone who does not like drama. Anything that puts me in the spotlight unintentionally are things I try as much as possible to avoid, but then there are things you can not just avoid and must come face to face with. Life can be dramatic at times and we just have to dance to the music. If we are shamed, well, it is what it is, we dance regardless, covering our hands in shame. The fact that I hardly get into these kinds of situations is something I am always grateful for, but hardly doesn’t mean totally. I can remember one that is very hard to forget.

links.body:
What Gives the Lumy Coin Real World Value in the

Crypto Market

The digital asset industry is currently going through a massive intellectual purge.

During the previous market cycles, investors were perfectly willing to assign billions

of dollars in valuation to projects that existed solely as a joke on an internet forum.

That speculative fever has completely broken. The institutional capital entering the

market today demands to see the underlying math. They want to see exactly how a

token generates revenue, how it interacts with physical infrastructure, and why

anyone outside of the cryptocurrency bubble would ever need to purchase it.

As the narrative shifts away from pure speculation and toward decentralized physical

infrastructure networks, the artificial intelligence sector has become the primary

battleground. In the middle of this technological arms race is an ecosystem that is

fundamentally changing how autonomous digital agents operate. That ecosystem is

Lumy AI.

If you are evaluating the Lumy coin for your long term portfolio, the most important

question you must answer is where its value actually comes from. This deep dive will

dissect the core economic engine of the network, explain how the Language Model

Operating System generates real world revenue, and demonstrate why the $LUMY

asset is positioned to become the ultimate settlement layer for the Internet of Agents.

The Problem with Pure Speculation

Before we can understand real value, we must define fake value. Most

cryptocurrencies operate on the greater fool theory. You buy a digital asset with no

underlying utility, hoping that someone else will come along tomorrow and pay a

higher price for it simply because the chart is trending upward. When the influx of

new buyers inevitably stops, the price collapses to zero because there is no

fundamental business model to support the market cap.

To truly understand how utility based assets differ from speculative assets, interact

with the economic dashboard below. You can adjust the parameters to see exactly

how real world commercial usage protects an asset from market crashes.

The Language Model Operating System
To find the intrinsic value of the Lumy token, you have to look at the technology
driving the network. The protocol has developed the Language Model Operating
System, abbreviated as LMOS. This is not a simple smart contract or a decentralized
exchange. It is a highly sophisticated, cloud native operating system built specifically
for artificial intelligence.
The technology world is rapidly moving toward an economy driven by autonomous
digital agents. These are intelligent programs that can book flights, analyze complex
corporate datasets, manage supply chains, and execute trades without any human
intervention. However, these agents need an environment to live in, communicate,
and process data.

LMOS provides that exact environment. It serves as the foundational architecture
where developers can build and deploy intelligent agents. By utilizing a decentralized
grid, the protocol ensures that these agents can operate securely, privately, and at a
fraction of the cost associated with legacy corporate cloud providers. This
infrastructure is what the developers refer to as the Internet of Agents.
The Enterprise Demand Loop
When we ask what gives a digital asset value, the answer must always be commercial
demand. If businesses are not willing to pay for a service, the token powering that
service is worthless.
The Language Model Operating System solves massive financial and operational
problems for enterprise companies. Training and executing artificial intelligence
algorithms requires unbelievable amounts of computational power. Traditional tech
monopolies charge astronomical fees to access their server farms, effectively locking
smaller businesses out of the artificial intelligence revolution.
By migrating their AI workloads to the decentralized LMOS network, enterprise
clients can drastically reduce their operational overhead. But here is the critical
economic mechanism that gives the digital asset its value. When an enterprise wants
to deploy an agent or process data on this network, they cannot pay their invoice
using standard fiat currency.
They are contractually required by the protocol architecture to purchase and spend
the Lumy coin.
Every single computation, every single agent to agent transaction, and every single
data retrieval command requires a micro transaction settled in the native asset. This
means the token is not a speculative trading vehicle. It is digital oil. As the Internet of
Agents scales and thousands of businesses deploy their automated solutions onto the
network, the daily baseline demand for the token will skyrocket, driven entirely by
verifiable commercial usage.
The Physical Foundation of the Lumy Node
Demand is only half of the valuation equation. Supply is the other half. The value of
the asset is structurally reinforced by the physical infrastructure required to keep the
network operational.

links.title: Three Tune Tuesday with Some Lesser Known Alternative Rock!
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUJq6iaSTbLTHaWMTHUoF65APVgcpYZJKWSnjLrgKEhG1/image.png)

Tuesday is here once again, it seems to come faster and faster every week. I guess that means we are one day closer to Friday, or if you live in the United States, Thursday as Friday is a national holiday! For a very long time now I've been putting together Three Tune Tuesday  posts on pretty much a weekly basis. Why? Because it's fun! My music will tend to vary week to week, but I to tend to share a lot of heavy metal being a metal head at heart...

But I also really enjoy other music genres from almost every era,  today's songs are probably more alternative rock/ new wave from the 1980's. And today's tunes will be pretty much obscure songs most may have never heard of, it makes it all the more fun!

First up, as a silver stacker I have long been trying to collect the entire line of Silver Strike tokens produced by the Hard Rock Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada. The establishment is now long defunct, but it was a great place in it's day. Being off the main Las Vegas strip probably was what killed it in the end, but now their Silver Strike tokens are valuable as pieces of Las Vegas history.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYtUQG8QkyaXNHTwmbFSPv1MMEN4dCSkzEEMJcSz2JD4A/screenshot_5299_.png)
From eBay.com

I found this one on eBay recently, but they want more than $80 for it. I used to be able to pick these up for less than $20... The good old days... These were tokens that could be won by playing certain slot machines in casinos around the US, Caribbean, and on cruise ships for many years. Now those machines are also becoming extinct making these tokens all the more valuable. The tokens contain just about 0.6 Troy ounces of pure silver surrounded by a brass ring, and being silver they've always been right up my alley and I have a bunch of them collected! Just not many from the Hard Rock...

I like this particular one as it's uncommon from the Hard Rock, it was a rather short production so they are pricey. If I can find one for less than $50 I may pull the trigger, it just hasn't happened yet... Now onto the music!







However, before we get going, I want to say thank you to @ablaze for starting and continuing to sponsor this fun weekly event where you can share three songs that you enjoy. One lucky participant will win some HSBI units, you can't have too many of those! So if you don't already participate feel free to jump in, just use the tag #ttt or #threetunetuesday and it's never a bad idea to do a shoutout to @ablaze .







![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcPCSeqD3NTC16qxdVudsSNuecmyNZrVRBvrrPPHRPV93/image.png)

## **The Icicle Works**

This band from Liverpool, England is probably best known for their one big hit,  \

, from 1984. But they continued to record albums for several years without the same success they initially enjoyed. In 1987 they released If You Want To Defeat Your Enemy Sing His Song which is probably my favorite album they put out. It's has a few great songs, but my favorite has always been this one: \

:

https://youtu.be/AXm12KFuEZM?si=4eAWc1lqu_SNAoCA


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcPCSeqD3NTC16qxdVudsSNuecmyNZrVRBvrrPPHRPV93/image.png)

## **Stan Ridgeway**

Stan Ridgeway is probably most famous for his song \

with the band Wall of Voodoo from 1982. They emerged from a punk club in Los Angeles, California and were an underground band for most of their existence. He then went solo producing some great songs, although most people never will have heard of them. This one is called \

off his album The Big Heat from 1986.

https://youtu.be/p7iARb-JpaY?si=t0LiFlRlBdvJdOGF





![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcPCSeqD3NTC16qxdVudsSNuecmyNZrVRBvrrPPHRPV93/image.png)

## **Fred Schneider**

If you are a fan of the band the B-52's I'm sure you already know who this artist is. He does the lead vocals for the band, but has done some solo work over the years. This is one of his more popular solo songs that most people will most likely never have ever heard about. It's a hilarious song and backed by vocalist Kate Pierson also from the B-52's. To be honest it almost sounds more like a B-52's song than anything but always made me laugh! This song is called \

:


https://youtu.be/KUnO4gK_56g?si=6YPL28Mk1eV9fy2p






![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcPCSeqD3NTC16qxdVudsSNuecmyNZrVRBvrrPPHRPV93/image.png)

That will do it for this Three Tune Tuesday, yes much more obscure songs for sure than normal. But sometimes that's fun! Please feel free to leave any comments or questions below, and as always thank you for all of your support. It really is deeply appreciated. Have a great day everyone!
