body.title: 🇵🇱 Weekend za mną. Wracam do treningów. 🏃‍♂️💪 / 🇬🇧 Weekend's Over. Back to Training. 🏃‍♂️💪: June 29 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/665b3294-2d99-458c-b379-da0810ffecf2.jpg)
🇵🇱 ### Kilka dni przerwy Przez ostatnie kilka dni było tu trochę ciszej. Weekend spędziłem na objazdowej wycieczce autokarowej, a pogoda nie oszczędzała – każdego dnia towarzyszyły nam upały przekraczające 30°C. Kilka dni intensywnego zwiedzania skutecznie odciągnęło mnie od treningów i publikowania postów. Po powrocie organizm wyraźnie domagał się odpoczynku, ale czas wrócić do codziennej rutyny. Zaczynam spokojnie, krok po kroku, odbudowując regularność zarówno w treningach, jak i tutaj. --- 🇬🇧 ### A Few Quiet Days It's been a little quieter here over the last few days. I spent the weekend on a coach sightseeing trip, with temperatures above 30°C almost every day. A few days of intense sightseeing kept me away from both training and posting. After getting back, my body clearly needed some recovery, but now it's time to return to the daily routine. I'm taking it one step at a time, rebuilding consistency both in training and here with you.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c02fc2d8-9038-4827-87b3-a33c8f0f667e.jpg)
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/73794155-2e42-47bc-ae7a-4fb774e3d1ba.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/056910c2-fb68-4979-8b13-370f5050a6a7.jpg)
🇵🇱 ### Powrót na bieżnię Pierwszym treningiem po powrocie był spokojny bieg na bieżni. Nogi były jeszcze ciężkie po kilku dniach podróży, długim siedzeniu w autokarze i zwiedzaniu w wysokich temperaturach, dlatego od początku założyłem, że będzie to wyłącznie trening regeneracyjny. Mimo zmęczenia tętno pozostało bardzo niskie, a wysiłek oceniłem jedynie na 3/10. To pokazuje, że układ krążenia wraca do normy szybciej niż same mięśnie. Czasem właśnie takie spokojne jednostki są najlepszym sposobem na ponowne wejście w treningowy rytm. 📊 30:00 • 4,66 km • 6:27/km • 132 bpm • RPE 3/10 --- 🇬🇧 ### Back on the Treadmill My first workout after returning was an easy treadmill run. My legs still felt heavy after several days of travelling, long hours on the coach and sightseeing in the heat, so from the start the goal was simply an easy recovery session. Despite the fatigue, my heart rate stayed very low and the perceived effort was only 3/10. It shows that my cardiovascular system is recovering faster than my muscles. Sometimes, these easy sessions are exactly what's needed to get back into a consistent training routine. 📊 30:00 • 4.66 km • 6:27/km • 132 bpm • RPE 3/10
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f72e5994-8bf3-41e9-994e-2ee6b889ea6b.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8fb9c94f-71ca-4de2-bb03-bd3de895574f.jpg)
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d581c557-1114-4803-86a3-f68139620f3a.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ba73a387-5059-4960-a906-04b75cf762b8.jpg)
🇵🇱 ### Trening siłowy Po biegu przyszedł czas na siłownię. W porównaniu z poprzednim tygodniem podniosłem ciężary praktycznie we wszystkich ćwiczeniach o kilka kilogramów. Mimo większego obciążenia cały trening wszedł bardzo płynnie – bez wymuszonych powtórzeń i bez walki o ostatnie ruchy. To dla mnie ważniejszy sygnał niż same liczby. Organizm zaczyna adaptować się do regularnych treningów, a siła wraca szybciej, niż się spodziewałem. 📊 32 min • 18 serii • 197 powtórzeń • 3108 kg łącznej objętości --- 🇬🇧 ### Strength Training After the run, it was time for the gym. Compared to last week, I increased the weights by a few kilograms in almost every exercise. Despite the heavier loads, the entire session felt smooth, with no forced reps and no grinding through the final repetitions. To me, that's more important than the numbers themselves. My body is adapting to consistent training again, and my strength is returning faster than I expected. 📊 32 min • 18 sets • 197 reps • 3,108 kg total
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1454df56-71b4-47a0-bfe8-c87ba350cc1e.jpg)
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/08e99276-75b6-4fe0-bcb8-e769a63f994c.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/10ba4435-a0be-4844-ab9c-e39ef9ab3f73.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6a163a50-67e6-4b8d-9c32-30a7bdabdcec.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/251576ae-92e2-4dfe-adfa-bad06e0523ac.jpg)
🇵🇱 ### Regeneracja wraca na właściwe tory Po kilku intensywnych dniach podróży organizm w końcu dostał to, czego najbardziej potrzebował – solidną regenerację. Noc przed treningiem przyniosła 97 punktów jakości snu i ponad 8 godzin snu, a Body Battery rano osiągnęło maksymalne 100 punktów. Jeszcze kilka dni wcześniej status HRV wyraźnie spadł po podróży, upałach i zmianie codziennego rytmu. Teraz jednak pierwsze oznaki odbudowy są już widoczne. To właśnie dzięki dobrej regeneracji mogłem wrócić do spokojnego biegu i treningu siłowego bez forsowania organizmu. Forma buduje się nie tylko na treningach, ale również wtedy, gdy organizm dostaje czas, aby się odbudować. --- 🇬🇧 ### Recovery Back on Track After several demanding days of travelling, my body finally got what it needed most — quality recovery. The night before training delivered a 97 sleep score with more than 8 hours of sleep, while my morning Body Battery reached the maximum 100 points. Only a few days earlier, my HRV status had clearly dropped due to travelling, hot weather and a disrupted routine. Now, the first signs of recovery are already visible. Thanks to that solid recovery, I was able to return to both an easy run and a strength session without pushing too hard. Fitness isn't built only during training sessions — it's also built when your body has enough time to recover.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a2caad2b-eb96-435e-92cb-1e3721bdb9e1.jpg)
🇵🇱 ### Małe kroki, dobry kierunek To nie był trening rekordów ani tydzień idealnych warunków. Był za to powrót do regularności po intensywnym weekendzie, pierwszy krok po regeneracji i kolejna cegiełka do odbudowy formy. Bieganie, siłownia i regeneracja ponownie zaczynają się zazębiać. Organizm jeszcze nie pracuje na pełnych obrotach, ale sygnały są coraz bardziej optymistyczne. Teraz najważniejsze jest zachowanie cierpliwości i systematyczności, bo właśnie z takich spokojnych tygodni rodzi się później prawdziwa forma. Każdy trening ma swój cel. Ten miał przypomnieć organizmowi, że wracamy do pracy. 💪🏃 --- 🇬🇧 ### Small Steps, Right Direction This wasn't a record-breaking workout or a week with perfect conditions. Instead, it was about getting back to consistency after a demanding weekend, taking the first step after recovery, and adding another brick to the foundation. Running, strength training and recovery are starting to work together again. My body isn't operating at full capacity yet, but the signs are becoming increasingly positive. Right now, patience and consistency matter the most, because this is exactly how strong fitness is built. Every workout has its purpose. This one was about reminding my body that we're back to work. 💪🏃
--- ---
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bfef8288-ecd0-4e54-862a-5b4642667665.jpg)
🇵🇱 P.S. Zdjęcia wykorzystane w tym poście pochodzą z Panometer Dresden – ogromnej rotundy z panoramiczną instalacją 360°. Obecna ekspozycja przedstawia podwodny świat rafy koralowej i robi naprawdę niesamowite wrażenie. Jeśli będziecie kiedyś w Dreźnie, zdecydowanie warto wpisać to miejsce na swoją listę. --- 🇬🇧 P.S. The photos used in this post were taken at Panometer Dresden – a huge rotunda featuring a stunning 360° panoramic installation. The current exhibition showcases the underwater world of a coral reef and is truly impressive. If you ever visit Dresden, it's definitely worth adding to your itinerary.

_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@ptaku/actifit-ptaku-20260630t182130390z)_

 Outer Dark is the second novel by American writer Cormac McCarthy, published in 1968. The time and setting are nebulous, but likely take place sometime around the turn of the twentieth century somewhere in Appalachia. The novel tells of a woman named Rinthy who bears her brother's baby. The brother, Culla, leaves the nameless infant in the woods to die, but tells his sister that the newborn died of natural causes and had to be buried. Rinthy discovers this lie and sets out to find the baby for herself.

The name of the novel is derived from the Gospel of Matthew, specifically the meeting between the Roman centurion and Jesus, during which Jesus says: \

body.title: [Esp/Eng] ✨Lindo colgante para el hogar.  // Cute pendant for the home.✨
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

###### <center>✨¡Hola amigos amantes de la creatividad! Espero que estén todos bien.✨</center>

<center>¡Buenas tardes, amigos! Espero que estén pasando una excelente semana. Por mi parte, paso por acá a compartir una linda idea con ustedes. En esta ocasión les comparto el paso a paso para elaborar un lindo colgante para el hogar. Bueno, puede ser para cualquier lugar (en mi caso, lo hice pensando en la puerta de una habitación). Hace mucho que no les compartía unos lindos pájaritos, así que les quise traer esta linda idea.</center>

**🔸Sin más que añadir, a continuación los dejo con el paso a paso:**

> ###### <center>✨¡Hello friends who love creativity! I hope you are all well.✨</center>

> <center>Good afternoon, friends! I hope you're having a wonderful week. I'm happy to stop by and share a lovely idea with you. This time, I'm sharing the step-by-step instructions for making a cute wall hanging for your home. Well, it can be for anywhere (in my case, I made it with a bedroom door in mind). It's been a while since I shared some cute happy birds haha, so I wanted to bring you this fun idea.</center>

> **🔸Without more to add, then I leave you with the step by step:**

---

<center>![Captura.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tbvx2VogQP2o3bFVBicq3RShJdLFudSxEQGxmYdXsuA55acXkt69SESDU2FWNLU1NqL.JPG)</center>

---

<div class=\

> **♥️ESPERO QUE TE GUSTE, ¡Empecemos!**
**♥️I HOPE YOU LIKE IT, Let's start!**
---
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> - Cartulina blanca. - Foami verde, marrón, azul y rosa. - Cinta delgada. - Pinturas y marcadores. - Pegamento. - Tijeras. - Regla. - Hoja blanca. - Lápiz.
- White cardstock. - Green, brown, blue, and pink craft foam. - Thin ribbon. - Paints and markers. - Glue. - Scissors. - Ruler. - White paper. - Pencil.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 1: Lo primero que debemos hacer es tomar una hoja blanca y dibujar lo que tenemos en mente para este colgante. En mi caso, pensé en una base circular básica donde iría un árbol, el cual lleva una curvatura en el borde con la forma de la circunferencia. Además, quería que la decoración fuera un pájaro sobre el árbol y el otro llegando a casa. Así que, al tener la idea lista y dibujada en la hoja blanca, pasé el diseño a los colores correspondientes de foami con las siguientes medidas: ✨Hojas de árbol: 12.2 cm x 5.8 cm en foami verde. ✨Tronco y saliente: 10 cm x 4 cm y 5 cm x 1 cm en foami marrón. ✨Cuerpo y pico de los pájaros: 3.1 cm x 1.5 cm en foami rosa y azul. ✨Alas: 2 cm x 1 cm en foami rosa y azul.

> ###### ✨STEP 1: The first thing we need to do is take a blank sheet of paper and draw what we have in mind for this pendant. In my case, I envisioned a basic circular base where a tree would go, with a curved edge following the shape of the circle. I also wanted the decoration to be one bird perched on the tree and another arriving home. So, with the idea ready and drawn on the blank sheet of paper, I transferred the design to the corresponding colors of foam with the following measurements: ✨Tree leaves: 12.2 cm x 5.8 cm in green foam. ✨Trunk and protrusion: 10 cm x 4 cm and 5 cm x 1 cm in brown foam. ✨Bird body and beak: 3.1 cm x 1.5 cm in pink and blue foam. ✨Wings: 2 cm x 1 cm in pink and blue foam.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260617_101254.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Ep1YQAF8MgLveX9yikJgAob13wbKXM8uhGKvJkNS3iZJVT5AHa36fTzvtFyDrQLBwre.jpg)|![IMG_20260617_101330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoKAbSa6SLQ9krDCZHKxswUztFg7kYYsPoUbbW6n7s2Gk6D252dzW6552DeNdsFNLWE.jpg)| |-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 2: Una vez recortadas las piezas, es momento de dar color a los bordes con pinturas o marcadores. En mi caso (y como la gran mayoría de las veces), utilicé marcadores de un tono más oscuro que el de cada pieza; pero en el caso del árbol, para que hiciera más contraste, utilicé color negro.

> ###### ✨STEP 2: Once the pieces are cut out, it's time to color the edges with paints or markers. In my case (and as is usually the case), I used markers in a darker shade than each piece; but for the tree, to create more contrast, I used black.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260617_105203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Ep1XwxA72yiV6XW62kHRw7seANqKgCmYj6ZLkuRmkSjdGo8xChhgPYXgx8b9pYyv91n.jpg)|![IMG_20260617_105228.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoEtw8ctAyp7mU5g9Ex6uKFpfSndMMXDkpnnJTFDDNMCe9axPcsmNjMrWX5RRkdAaEN.jpg)| |-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 3: Al estar secas las piezas, es momento de dibujar los detalles más específicos con marcadores, como serían los ojos, las mejillas, el pico y los detalles en las alas, además de definir el árbol y sus hojas con unas líneas lindas.

> ###### ✨STEP 3: Once the pieces were dry, it was time to draw the more specific details with markers, such as the eyes, cheeks, beak, and wing details, as well as outlining the tree and its leaves with some nice lines.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260617_110908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Ep3fhnBQXqwNYEJuLXtJAa1Uc1zmgoa3ptjYXnxmdeaD9TTZEsExrgdX6hMCgfYk5AZ.jpg)|![IMG_20260617_110927.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EocBQMtaqezTgbD58KGyuh1SCEUNsZK44LdkWrr8DjydWB7bQMtqFunPECWmpenrb6Y.jpg)| |-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 4: Dejamos las piezas a un lado y tomamos la cartulina blanca. Recortamos una pieza circular de 14 cm de diámetro, en la cual escribí la palabra “WELCOME” justo en el espacio vacío del diseño que tenía pensado. Seguidamente, le di fondo con un color azul, añadí detalles extras (como algunos puntos distribuidos por toda la pieza) y remarqué la palabra con marcador negro.
> ###### ✨STEP 4: We set the pieces aside and took the white cardstock. We cut out a 14 cm diameter circle, on which I wrote the word \

right in the empty space of the design I had planned. Next, I added a blue background, extra details (like some dots distributed throughout the piece), and outlined the word with a black marker.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260617_101219.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoCmwRaMxq8QPt4uYPvkfhaKCkn7t1aharfcHJAYDvYg6BdUVyPsJKQ3hdHupLu2TS8.jpg)|![IMG_20260617_105056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoCjULHXChrUuaYwjMt8gU6EJUqPDWCNLjpBB5KHnc8LLX7ZJr1FqLFcCmNg5GemQgL.jpg)| |-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 5: Ahora sí, llegó el momento de unir todas estas piezas a la base. Comencé pegando el tronco y las hojas del árbol siguiendo la curvatura de la base; luego pegué las alas a los pájaros y fijé uno al tronco y el otro volando hacia el mismo lugar. Finalmente, pegamos una tira delgada de cinta en la parte superior trasera para poder colgarlo.

> ###### ✨STEP 5: Now it was time to attach all these pieces to the base. I started by gluing the tree trunk and leaves, following the curve of the base; Then I glued the wings to the birds and attached one to the trunk and the other flying towards the same spot. Finally, I glued a thin strip of ribbon to the top back so it could be hung.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260617_111329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Eos2LBjPVeMp3juPoqayt1GPVrK4wQVdV7YDrVLnwa2uLzCmfimT11KWXhzJDG6sz6H.jpg)|![IMG_20260617_111421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoiWkUq1sFJBuEZXo9wpyn6CREEQNjupp5ZfKzh8VB3DsFQE9ztphEbhUVxfb1a79M9.jpg)| |-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
✨¡Y listo, amigos! Así es como pueden hacer esta linda idea de colgante para la puerta de una habitación o para el rincón que deseen. Espero que les haya gustado el paso a paso y se animen a crear este o el diseño que más les guste para su hogar.
❤️Hasta la próxima publicación.
>
✨And that's it, friends! That's how you can make this cute hanging decoration for a bedroom door or any corner you like. I hope you enjoyed the step-by-step instructions and are inspired to create this or any other design you like for your home.
>
❤️Until the next post.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

body.title: My Strategy for Bronze League in Splinterlands
body.body:
🛡️ My Strategy for Bronze League in Splinterlands

Bronze League is the perfect place to build solid fundamentals. Card levels are low, abilities are limited, and what really matters are clean stats, reading rulesets correctly, and using efficient combos. Here is the strategy I use to win consistently.

>

⚔️ Why Bronze League Is Special

In Bronze, most cards don’t have abilities, so the winner is the one who uses:

  • Speed
  • Health
  • Damage
  • Mana efficiency

>

🧱 Best Tanks for Bronze League

Djinn Oshannus

Extremely strong against magic thanks to Void at level 1.

>

Unicorn Mustang

High health and great resilience in Earth battles.

>

Living Lava

Massive armor and solid damage — perfect for high mana battles.

>

🎯 Best Damage Dealers

Serpentine Spy

The strongest 3-mana card thanks to Opportunity.

>

Ice Pixie

Cheap magic + Flying — ideal for Earthquake battles.

>

Venari Crystalsmith

Life card with heal that keeps your tank alive longer.

>

🧠 Low-Mana Strategies (8–15 Mana)

🛡️ Life — “Slow & Win”

  • Tank: Pelacor Conjurer
  • Damage: Celestial Harpy
  • Support: Venari Crystalsmith
  • Bonus: Time Mage (slow = huge advantage)

>

🔥 Fire — “Spy Burst”

  • Tank: Cerberus
  • Damage: Serpentine Spy
  • Support: Fire Beetle

>

🌊 High-Mana Strategies (22+ Mana)

Water — “Magic Wall”

  • Tank: Djinn Oshannus
  • Damage: Nerissa Tridawn, Ice Pixie
  • Support: Kelya (speed + armor)

>

🔮 How to Read Rulesets

  • Little League – play low-mana cards
  • Melee Mayhem – melee attacks from any position
  • Super Sneak – attacks focus the backline
  • Reverse Speed – slow cards are best
  • Earthquake – Flying cards win

🧩 Lineups I Use Most Often

🔥 Fire — “Spy Burst”

  • Living Lava
  • Serpentine Spy
  • Fire Beetle
  • Tarsa

>

🌊 Water — “Magic Wall”

  • Djinn Oshannus
  • Nerissa Tridawn
  • Ice Pixie
  • Kelya

>

🛡️ Life — “Slow & Win”

  • Shieldbearer
  • Venari Crystalsmith
  • Celestial Harpy
  • Time Mage

>

📝 Conclusion

Bronze League is the ideal place to learn Splinterlands fundamentals. If you read rulesets correctly, pick efficient cards, and use simple but effective combos, you’ll win consistently and earn strong SPT rewards.

body.title: The Importance of Oral Health in Overall Child Development
body.body: > Children must have good health to grow well and oral health is a vital component of their health. Oral health is defined as maintaining clean and healthy teeth, gums, tongue and mouth. People believe that a healthy mouth is just about white teeth and that is not the case. A healthy mouth enables children to eat, speak, smile and learn with confidence. I feel that if the parents pay attention to their child's oral health at an early age, they are helping their child create a healthier future. Oral health is one of the top reasons that it is important for children to eat well. A healthy tooth enables a child to chew their food adequately before swallowing. This makes digestion easier and provides the necessary nutrients for growth. A child doesn't eat when he or she has tooth decay or mouth pain. The child might refuse healthy foods, such as fruits, vegetables and meats, because chewing is painful. There have been occasions when I have observed children not eating due to pain in their teeth, and this can make them weak and sad. ![1001626162.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/julie100/23vsdDcKMabstvmHtbAs3c2FUcFxZZDzFALeAaEaEoBuGuUyS7ad16EgzXC7E3bFbi8H2.png) Oral health is also important in helping the child develop their speech. Children use their teeth, tongue and lips to say words properly. When a child's baby teeth are lost due to decay, or when they have painful dental issues, it can be hard for them to speak clearly. Children communicate, befriend and succeed in school better with good speech. This is why it is important to take care of children's teeth before all of their permanent teeth have erupted. A healthy mouth also boosts children's confidence. Children can smile more and enjoy the company of others if their teeth are clean and they have fresh breath. However, a damaged or soiled tooth can make children feel uncomfortable or embarrassed. May refuse to share words, smiles or participate in activities with friends. I feel all children should have a smile for which they aren't embarrassed by their teeth. Another good side of having a good oral health is enhanced school performance. Children may find it difficult to focus in school due to toothaches. Some children even abscond school due to extreme dental pain and infections. If children are not able to concentrate on learning, then their learning may be affected. I think that proper attention to the health of children's teeth allows them to be active in school and have a pleasant experience of learning without the pain of ill health. Good oral hygiene is also an effective way of avoiding serious health issues. Disease-causing germs in the mouth can lead to infection which can enter the body if left untreated. By maintaining good gum and dental health, these issues can be minimized. Encouraging children to brush their teeth twice a day, floss regularly and drink water after eating to wash away food particles and bacteria. The regular checkup with the dentist also helps to identify issues before they escalate. Parents and carers play a very important role in safeguarding children's oral health. They should also engage children in encouraging them to use fluoride toothpaste and limit sugary snacks and drinks, and offer healthy food. Kids tend to imitate adults. Children are more likely to learn proper oral hygiene habits from brushing their own teeth when their parents do it. I think it is important that these are taught at an early age so that they become lifelong. Children should be educated on oral hygiene by the school also. Brushing, flossing and eating healthy foods are important and can be explained to students through health education programs. In some schools even dental checkups is organised to help in identifying dental problem at an early stage. Togetherness between families, schools and healthcare workers provide children with better care and support. Finally, oral health plays a very significant role in a child's growth and development! Children with healthy teeth and gums can eat healthy foods, speak clearly, do better in school, and have a good self-esteem. Oral hygiene also helps to avoid pain and serious health issues. From a young age, I think it's important for every child to know about the importance of taking care of their mouths. Brushing, adopting a healthy diet and visiting the dentist can make a world of difference and can help children become healthy and confident adults. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@julie100/the-importance-of-oral-health-in-overall-child-development-edx)

body.title: Film Review: Office Romance | Does this movie not make sense or was it simply not what I expected? 🫨 [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
![1000075858.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uFRNC3VcwCJDwA4wYxps8yvNc1xKZn8yQ2gjipopkTRXtzbvtuv1XoKJaa3SYAU9cRB.png)
[source](https://share.google/znZYnKgSfQD8cf5Oi) **Hello friends who love movies and television**, during these days I have been somewhat distanced from watching movies or being glued to the television. However, I have sought to distract myself from the news in Venezuela for a while and I found a new Netflix movie called **Office Romance** starring Jennifer Lopez and Brett Goldstein. I'm not really into watching romantic comedies but I wanted to give this movie a look because it seemed like it could be somewhat fun. Most Netflix movies usually have a pretty big budget but very little capacity to make you connect with the story and sometimes, it even seems like what you are watching makes no sense at all. And that happened to me with this movie, I invite you to read my review so you can learn my opinion about this romantic comedy. ![1000075868.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EpGWXuthekT2vNu4T8cshESQpwWUYzNfL3omAr86aa9gdLhXgoHopmGsBijTWXXNhtD.png) ##### Review ![1000075883.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tvaMTUkr9qZDp1niRQcSijLukVE7qRaXj1uGN2qvmfm27ew2B6LK74s1uF4FgDe5V6Z.jpg)
[source](https://share.google/Y2q7oV3XCb48wvNTR) The story focuses on Jackie, owner and manager of the airline Air Cruz, a company inherited from her father. Jackie is known among employees for being extremely strict at work, many barely even speak to her and are somewhat afraid of her. But the story takes an unexpected turn when due to changes in the company a new lawyer named Daniel arrives, who replaces Jackie's former lawyer. This generates an atmosphere of tension in the office, amid rumors that Jackie is an overly rigid woman and who also begins to have legal problems due to an encounter with a businessman. But there is also a rule within the company, which is that no employee can have a relationship with another person from the company. And that is when this story begins between Jackie and Daniel, a passionate romance but handled with caution so as not to be discovered. ![1000075868.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EpGWXuthekT2vNu4T8cshESQpwWUYzNfL3omAr86aa9gdLhXgoHopmGsBijTWXXNhtD.png) ##### Opinion ![1000075870.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23u5vwLNZKeEDzV4MwqpV7KbFi5sQef9FJKg4Q44s9LwfuMa3V4oJftmuvGdYx7yE8S5E.jpg)
[source](https://share.google/2OzRqXNYh69r73m6m) It is interesting to see how these types of stories are still maintained in movies, and although sometimes they usually work, in this story I didn't feel that anything connected, neither the actors nor the development of the story. The romance story starts off in a good way, Jackie and Daniel are opposites and come from different worlds, it's something like an *enemies to lovers* at the beginning that later loses the opportunity to be a good story. Jackie has an extensive romance history, but at the same time a story that talks about a woman trying to do things right and earn the pride of her own father, who gave her that responsibility of running the company. ![1000075880.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EowFdxrh6rtK8ACPmDRPRSkTiGtXiDotQHYCCCtNUgn2RQHiK2Pk94t7rJhqT5gF6zc.jpg)
[source](https://share.google/jCurlIQ8Yq2sVbAZD) There is Daniel, who is a man always looking for justice and doing things right, with a backstory of a close relative in prison, about whom it is not fully clear for what reasons he ended up there. Both Jackie and Daniel feel an almost immediate connection without even knowing each other, and also with the fear of being seen as two liars for dating in secret. I liked certain parts of the story, such as Jackie's right hand: Sydney Bloom, who is like her secretary but is always on high alert and truly creates a more pleasant atmosphere in terms of adding fun to the story. ![1000075881.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23xAXVn7fKBR5ujbgThXHftoiz1x8DHq44ub7NVGhUBWM2dvymKWcGEtUpg2EPvrofHrf.jpg)
[source](https://share.google/X3DJElJmA5B4fiofy) The movie seemed very long to me and its duration felt overly forced. Everything that happens between Jackie's legal conflict, Daniel's personal problems, the scenes where nothing made sense because it felt like they were trying to make the story look romantic but at the same time extremely funny, only made the idea I have about Netflix movies stronger. I am not into romance and comedy films, but this was not the best movie I have seen in this genre. Jennifer Lopez's acting looks very exaggerated, I don't find the humor in it in any way and I only highlight a few moments where there was a bit more seriousness, especially when she talks about her relationship with her father. Other than that, I think Brett Goldstein acted better; although I didn't know him from other movies, he brought more dynamism and his character development also looked more natural, though there were also scenes where I thought: What was going through the director's head when making this movie? ![1000075869.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vhoQc3F6KnKFygn1zFEnwKurdNDtzH5ppRctaoqQJVFwCnjz1Z23fEHsfBnKthXeNbi.jpg)
[source](https://share.google/d8voaIoawccAIcNM1) Maybe this is a movie to be taken calmly and with humor, there are certain scenes that feel fun, but the duration of the movie and the way they extend the story so much reaches the point where you don't even know what you are watching anymore. In the end, of course, it ends with a happy ending, but it really was a meaningless movie, with a soundtrack that is perhaps the few things that can be rescued from the film, and the performance of Betty Gilpin showing herself as an extremely worried friend who is also pregnant and has a level of responsibility for her work and for Jackie's life that ends up feeling nice and making you laugh at times. ![1000075882.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tbkx9VrvTK2xVAq5eZt4TDAF11i2xZgyKbJNTZxY9KS5XhuJrmgQTvDkhucRn6idBeB.jpg)
[source](https://share.google/XbqNoAPHYaVvK4SUr) Other than that, the scenery and photography, as is usually seen in Netflix movies, is quite beautiful, showing the cities and settings. I feel this is something positive within these films, but it doesn't end up making you feel like you watched something that was worth it. It truly seemed like a movie that could have been better, maybe the choice of actors wasn't the best or maybe it's just a story that has been told too many times and is cliché. But to pass the time and if you have enough time you can watch it, at least in some parts you will laugh and you might like it more than I did. I would like you to tell me in the comments what you thought of this movie, what you liked most or what you didn't like so much about this story, I will be reading you 😅. --- >! [Spanish Version] > >**«Office Romance»: ¿Esta película no tiene sentido o es que simplemente no era lo que esperaba?** > >**Hola amigos amantes del cine y la televisión**, durante estos días he estado algo distanciada de ver películas o estar pegada a la televisión. Sin embargo, he buscado distraerme de las noticias de Venezuela por un rato y conseguí una nueva película de Netflix llamada **Turbulencia en la Oficina** (Office Romance) con Jennifer López de protagonista y Brett Goldstein. No soy muy de ver comedias románticas pero quería darle un vistazo a esta película porque parecía ser algo divertida. La mayoría de las películas de Netflix suelen tener bastante presupuesto pero muy poca capacidad de hacer que conectes con la historia e incluso, a veces parece que lo que ves no tiene ningún sentido. Y eso me pasó con esta película, los invito a leer mi reseña para que conozcan mi opinión de esta comedia romántica. > >##### Reseña > >La historia se enfoca en Jackie dueña y gerente de la aerolínea Air Cruz, una empresa heredada por su padre. Jackie es conocida entre los empleados por ser sumamente estricta dentro del trabajo, muchos casi ni le hablan y le tienen cierto miedo. Pero la historia toma un giro inesperado cuando por cambios en la empresa llega un nuevo abogado llamado Daniel quien reemplaza al antiguo abogado de Jackie. Esto genera una atmósfera de tensión en la oficina, entre rumores de que Jackie es una mujer demasiado rígida y que además, empieza a tener problemas legales debido a un encuentro con un empresario. Pero también, existe una regla dentro de la empresa y es que ningún empleado puede tener una relación con otra persona de la empresa. Y allí es cuando comienza esta historia entre Jackie y Daniel, un romance apasionado pero con precaución para no ser descubiertos. > >##### Opinión > >Es interesante ver cómo aún se mantienen este tipo de historias en las películas, y aunque algunas veces suelen funcionar, en esta historia no sentí que nada conectara, ni los actores ni tampoco el desarrollo de la historia. La historia de romance comienza de una buena manera, Jackie y Daniel son opuestos y vienen de mundos diferentes, es algo así como un *enemies to lovers* al comienzo que luego, va perdiendo la oportunidad de ser una buena historia. Jackie tiene un historial de romance extenso, pero a la vez una historia que habla de una mujer que intenta hacer las cosas bien y ganarse el orgullo de su propio padre quien le dió esa responsabilidad de llevar la empresa. > >Esta Daniel que es un hombre que busca siempre la justicia y hacer las cosas bien, con una historia detrás de un familiar cercano en la cárcel del cual no se termina de saber muy bien porque razones termino allí. Tanto Jackie como Daniel sienten una conexión casi inmediata pero sin siquiera conocerse y con el temor además de ser vistos como dos mentirosos por estar saliendo a escondidas. Me gustaron ciertas partes de la historia como por ejemplo la mano derecha de Jackie: Sydney Bloom quien es como su secretaria pero que está siempre en un estado de alerta y crea una atmósfera realmente más agradable en cuanto a agregarle diversión a la historia. > >La película me pareció muy extensa y se vio demasiado forzosa la duración de la misma. Todo lo que sucede entre el conflicto legal de Jackie, los problemas personales de Daniel, las escenas donde nada tenía coherencia porque parecía que intentaban hacer que la historia se viera romántica pero a la vez sumamente divertida, hicieron que la idea que tengo sobre las películas de Netflix se afianzaran más. No soy de películas de romance y comedia, pero esta no fue la mejor película que he visto de este género. La actuación de Jennifer López se ve muy exagerada, no le encuentro la gracia en ningún sentido y solo destaco algunos momentos donde había un poco más de seriedad, sobre todo cuando habla sobre su relación con su padre. De resto Brett Goldstein pienso que actuó mejor, aunque no lo conocía de otras películas el aporto más dinamismo y también se vio más natural su desarrollo del personaje aunque también hubieron escenas donde pensé: ¿Que paso por la cabeza del director al hacer esta película? > >Tal vez está sea una película para tomársela con calma y humor, hay ciertas escenas que se sienten divertidas pero la duración de la película y la manera en la que extienden tanto la historia llega al punto de que ya no sabes ni lo que estás viendo. Al final por supuesto termina con un final feliz, pero realmente fue una película sin sentido, con un soundtrack que tal vez sea lo poco que se puede rescatar de la película y la actuación de Betty Gilpin al mostrarse como una amiga sumamente preocupada que además está embarazada y que tiene un nivel de responsabilidad por su trabajo y por la vida de Jackie que llega a sentirse agradable y con el que te llegas a reír por ciertos ratos. > >De resto la escenografía y fotografía como suele verse en las películas de Netflix es bastante bonita mostrando las ciudades y los escenarios, siento que esto es algo positivo dentro de estas películas pero no termina de hacerte sentir como que viste algo que valió la pena. Realmente me pareció una película que pudo haber sido mejor, tal vez la elección de los actores no fue la mejor o tal vez ya es una historia demasiado contada y trillada. Pero para pasar el rato y si tienen suficiente tiempo pueden verla, por lo menos en unas partes se van a reír y puede que les guste más que a mí. Me gustaría que me cuenten en los comentarios que les pareció está película, que les gustó más o que no les gustó tanto de esta historia, los estaré leyendo 😅. --- https://youtu.be/11gcNa-TBRA?si=F4fqmuQKCmFErNA9

links.title: 🌌 SpacePicture of a Day: Unusually Smooth Sections of Asteroid Itokawa 🪐
links.body:
![Unusually Smooth Sections of Asteroid Itokawa](https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/image/2606/itokawa07_hayabusa_1080.jpg)

***

>Why are parts of this asteroid's surface so smooth?  The answer seems likely to do with the dynamics of an asteroid that is a loose pile of rubble rather than a solid rock.  The unusual asteroid Itokawa was visited by the Japanese spacecraft Hayabusa in 2005 which imaged and documented its unusual structure and mysterious lack of craters.  Analyses of the border regions between smooth and rugged sections indicate that jostling of the asteroid might be creating segregation between large and small rocks near the surface, like the Brazil nut effect.  The robotic Hayabusa actually touched down on one of the smooth patches, dubbed the MUSES Sea, and collected soil samples. These samples were returned to Earth and are not only giving clues to the ancient history of this unusual asteroid, but also about the early years of our entire Solar System. Computer simulations show that 500-meter asteroid Itokawa may impact the Earth within the next few million years.   Rocking Space: Today is Asteroid Day

links.title: Access To Good Schools Sometimes Not Possible
links.body: Hi there. In this education post, I cover the idea that access to good schools is not possible sometimes for some households.   ## Home Location, Travel and Nearby Schools --- Many families choose schools that are near them. In terms of travel time, 5 to 10 minutes of travel to school by car is good. Some kids may walk to school. Walking is good exercise, cheaper but takes longer. Some families may send their kids to a good school that is farther away. The travel time would be longer but the school would be better. Better as in nicer classrooms and a higher teaching level. Those with lower income neighbourhoods may not have great schools near them. The families may not have a car available for the parents to send their kids to school. A school bus or public transit would be used. Schools in not so good neighbourhoods may not have good teachers or even well behaved fellow students.

>Image Source   ## Good Schools Can Be Expensive --- A lot of good parents out there want their kids to do well. Good schools can be expensive from grades 1 to 8 and even the college/university years. In the Toronto area, public schools are funded by taxpayer dollars. Public schools are typically free or have low cost registration fees. There are some good public schools that prepare students for post secondary education. These schools could be IB accredited or not. Private schools are mostly for those who have money and are willing to pay a lot of money to send their kids there. Some big advantages of private schools include lower class sizes, access to sports and extracurricular activities. When it comes to teaching quality at private schools, I don't know for sure. It could be better than public school teachers or not. When it comes to post secondary education such as college and university, tuition fees can be really expensive. I think tuition fees in Europe are not that high, Canada tuition fees are much higher than Europe and USA school tuition fees are kind of crazy compared to Canada. One year of tuition in the USA is like the price of a Honda Civic car. Those who are aiming for medical school or law school will have more years of schooling. More schooling includes paying more tuition fees. It gets kind of crazy when it comes to costs. Households who may not have funds may not consider sending their child to more school. Taking on too much debt for school may not be worth it financially.

>Image Source   ## Good Schools Have Limited Spots Or Are Competitive --- There are some good schools that exist that are close by, have good teachers and have a good reputation. The problems with these nice schools is that there may be limited spots and they are competitive. Schools can hold up to a certain number of students so limited enrollment is the only way for them. Application forms may be required for some schools. If it is something like an art school, you may have to do an audition or send a video showcasing your work and talents. I knew of a few people that went to medical school. Very high grades is not enough for medical school. You have to have extracurricular activities on your application as well. Future doctors have to be smart and have good personalities so they can be helpful to society once they become doctors.

links.title: The Tale of Topper - ENG- SPA
links.body: > It was only a matter of time; in a few years, Topper would be able to start singing. He just needed to decide what kind of music he would specialize in. His voice at that time was thin and high, as he was still a child. Since he wanted to decide in advance what he would dedicate his future to music, he thought it would be wonderful to sing opera later on. To make this decision, he was guided by the state of his voice at that time of development. He told his music school teachers that he wanted to sing opera when he was older, as his voice was thin and perfect for it. They didn't agree with him making that choice at such a young age. They feared it might be a hasty decision, but he insisted and convinced everyone that it was the right thing to do. Therefore, he was moved to a classroom with other students to begin opera lessons from a young age. In this musical specialty, Topper quickly excelled and was the most advanced of all his classmates. Then his teachers and he himself believed they had made the right decision in defining his future career in opera. In the following years at school, he stood out even more and began to be recognized as one of the best students. He was always the first to arrive; when classes were in progress, the others were distracted, but he was paying attention and asking questions. And when it was time to practice, because he was the one who paid the most attention, he knew the most. His teachers noticed all of this and saw a very bright future for him.

> Era solo cuestión de tiempo, en unos años ya Topper podría empezar a cantar. Solo le faltaba decidir en que tipo de música se iba a especializar. Su voz en ese momento era fina y aguda y es que el estaba en la etapa de la niñez aún. Como el quería con antelación decidir a que se dedicaría en el futuro en la música pensó que sería genial cantar ópera más adelante. Para decidir eso se guió por la voz que tenía en ese momento de cambio. Le contó a sus profesores de la escuela de música que quería cantar ópera cuando fuera más mayor, pues so voz era fina y perfecta para eso. Ellos no estuvieron de acuerdo en que el hiciera esa elección aún a su corta edad. Temían que quizás fuera una decisión apresurada, pero el insistió y convenció a todos de que eso era lo correcto. Por tanto fue movido de aula con otros alumnos para empezar a impartirle clases de opera desde corta edad. En esa especialidad de la música Topper destacó rápidamente y fue el más aventajado de todos sus compañeros. Entonces sus profesores y el mismo creyeron que habían tomado la decisión correcta al definir su carrera futura en la opera. Los años siguientes en las escuela el destacó mucho más y empezó a ser reconocido como uno de los mejores estudiantes que tenían. Siempre llegaba primero, cuando estaban dando clases los demás estaban distraídos pero el estaba atendiendo y haciendo preguntas. Y cuando era la hora de practicar como era el que más atención prestaba era el que más sabía. Todo esto sus maestros lo iban viendo y por tanto ya veían para el un futuro muy brillante.
![obie-fernandez-bVKkSTttGa8-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tknMRErQdHSigPZJh3YsH2njfkou18n7A1arAc95sbrVPo9rbkXBWznx7axFfo764ep.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> Those were years of incredible learning. Topper learned so much about the art he thought he would dedicate himself to. But then came the end of adolescence. He was now a young man. He had once longed for this point in his life, but he soon realized that it would change everything he had learned up to that moment. With the arrival of adolescence, the high, delicate voice that had characterized him from the beginning began to fade. It became increasingly husky and deep, normal changes for that stage of life. This brought several problems. To begin with, it became harder for him to stand out in the classroom with his fellow students. Some already thought he was strange because he didn't sound the same. And that was just the beginning. Because a little while later, his voice changed completely, becoming much deeper. He no longer had that delicate voice. So he was no longer in the right classroom; he was a tenor. Topper had to change classrooms, his friends, and even his teaching because he was in the wrong place. It was a tough blow that after training and thinking for years that he would be a baritone singer, he now had to change. His teachers encouraged him a lot and told him not to get discouraged. These things happen in music. The important thing is knowing how to adapt. In any case, he still had time to make the changes. Although it was very difficult for him to adapt since everything was new, he persevered. He realized that it wasn't so bad after all. He had the talent and the knowledge from everything he had learned; he wouldn't really have to start from scratch. It was just a matter of changing his approach to practice and teaching.

> Fueron años de aprendizaje increíble, Topper llegó a aprender muchísimo sobre el arte que pensaba que se iba a dedicar. Pero entonces llegó el final de la adolescencia. Ya era todo un joven. Llegar a ese punto de su vida el antes lo deseaba pero pronto se dio cuenta que eso iba a cambiar su vida para siempre y todo lo que había aprendido hasta ese momento. Con la llegada de la adolescencia la voz fina y aguda que lo había caracterizado desde el comienzo se fue diluyendo. Cada vez se volvía más ronca y grave, eran cambios normales de esa parte de la vida. Esto trajo varios problemas, para empezar cada vez le costaba más destacar en el aula con sus demás amigos estudiantes. Algunos ya lo veían raro porque no sonaba igual. Y eso solo fue el comienzo. Porque un poco después la voz cambió totalmente hacia una más grave. Ya no tenía la voz fina. Entonces ya no estaba en el aula adecuada, el era un tenor. Topper tuvo que cambiar de aula y de amigos, y también de enseñanza porque estaba en el lugar equivocado. Fue un duro golpe que después de haberte formado y pensando por años que serías un cantante barítono ahora tienes que cambiar. Sus profesores lo animaron mucho y le dijeron que no se desanimara. Esas cosas en la música pasan. Lo importante es saber adaptarse. En cualquier caso aún estaba a tiempo de hacer los cambios. Aunque lo costó mucho adaptarse ya que todo era nuevo para el siguió adelante. Se dio cuenta de que no era tan malo después de todo. El tenia el talento y el conocimiento de todo lo que había aprendido, en realidad no tendría que comenzar desde el principio. Solo era cambiar el enfoque de la practica y la enseñanza.
![oleg-ivanov-ILybAzFjn5c-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23uExMV7xab9s1sZq1RGzjjjJ6HejCZjtT9w487FT4pxymAsihj1hpM4Qc8eht3Dybc9j.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> Years later, after many sacrifices, he finally achieved his dream. He graduated as an opera tenor. It was a long process of learning and adaptation to get there, but it was worth every minute. It's true that life sometimes gives you lemons and turns your plans upside down when you least expect it, but the important thing is to make lemonade out of lemons. Topper is the best example of that. It is said that he will go so far that he will be remembered forever as the opera singer who adapted to a radical career change. He is a great man and an example for everyone at the school.

> Años más tarde con muchos sacrificios el logró por fin completar su sueño. Logró graduarse como un cantante de ópera tenor. Fue un gran proceso de aprendizaje y adaptación para llegar ahí, pero valió la pena cada minuto invertido. Es cierto que a veces la vida te da limones y te gira los planes cuando menos lo piensas, pero lo importantes es que si te da limones hagas limonada. Topper es el mejor ejemplo de eso. Se dice que el llegará tan lejos que será recordado por siempre, como el cantante de ópera que se adaptó al cambio radical de carrera. Es un grande y un ejemplo para todos en la escuela.
![supradoc-dupxWY9R18M-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/Ep3dpSCuZJbXuBbL6zQzKeS3Byjqrs7b1WWfBQ1SWcMhvhCrzKaWxUAMkSErRDdqbtb.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

Lots of people write product reviews... but I love writing my own reviews and interpretations of characters \🤩/

This review focuses on the villain Rita Repulsa from the Power Rangers franchise. There are already plenty of reviews about the heroes, but what I really love are the villains HAHA, This happens to me with a lot of anime, series, or movies—what amazes me is the personality of those antagonists who’ll never achieve victory, even though deep down in my little heart I’d love for them to succeed… and destroy humanity HAHA!! with an evil laugh.

In my video review, I analyze and focus mainly on the voice actrices who brought the character to life in the American and Latin American versions, and from there I explore different angles, one of which is a negative critique of the character.



>Muchos hacen Reviews de Productos.... mientras yo Amo hacer mis Reviews e interpretaciones de Personajes \🤩/

>Esta es una Reseña enfocada en La Villana Rita Repulsa del producto o serie Power Rangers, ya hay muchas reseñas de los heroes pero a mi lo que me encantan son los villanos jaja, esto me sucede con muchos animes, series o peliculas donde lo que me maravilla es la personalidad de esos Antagonistas que nunca lograran la victoria y yo con mi corazoncito si quisiera que lo lograran.... y destruyeran La Humanidad JAJA!! con risa malvada.

>En mi video Review interpreto y me enfoco principalmente en las voces que le dieron vida para la parte Americana y Latino Americana y a partir de alli establezco aristas donde una de ellas es una Critica Negativa al personaje.

 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/promete0sz/EoEijskTnxycRaWtddjfLaQEXt3oZs7WKYFJoCsLpYAhM1Ae6EGMcmb1N6ifX4dgTP6.png)

![1000001213.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTF9eDMYcT3SMJvMsJ63XdSzfHYQUnTKVsmjrG2rvPwbb/image)



</center>



<div class=\

> I was recently watching Rita with the English dub—it’s a totally different way to experience Power Rangers 😃😃. I’m a Spanish speaker but I know English, so seeing scenes with her like that iconic moment when she breaks free with Barbara Goodson’s voice… that’s priceless. It’s auditory nectar, brimming with the quality and power of dubbing. The same goes for the Latin American dub I listened to as a kid, it really won me over. I’ll say that I prefer things in their original audio, but when a job is well done… well, it’s well done, period. Rita comes from the Sentai series; I still haven’t seen this in all its glory, but I think we can all unanimously agree that Rita’s look is another one of her visual trademarks, along with her staff for making creatures grow and her telescope. As for her personality, she’s as dismissive of those around her as can be, but she does it with such charm that it makes me want to be just like her, haha. She’s like those bosses who think their employees are useless and scold and insult the HAHA, bosses you’ve most likely had yourselves 😜😜 >Estuve viendo recientemente a Rita con doblaje en Ingles, es totalmente otra forma de ver a Power Rangers 😃😃, yo soy de habla hispana pero se ingles, entonces ver escenas de ella, como el mitivo momento en que se libera con voz de Barbara Goodson..... eso no tiene precio, es nectar auditivo lleno de calidad y poder de doblaje. Lo mismo aplica para el doblaje latino que escuche en mi niñez y me conquisto. >Establezco que prefiero las cosas en audio original pero cuando un trabajo esta bien hecho.... pues esta bien hecho y punto. >Rita viene de elementos Sentai, aun me falta ver esto a full espñendor pero todos, pienso, que unanimante estamos de acuerdo que el look de Rita es una mas de sus marcas visuales, junto con su Baculo para hacer crecer a las Criaturas y telescopio. >En cuanto a su personalidad, es despectiva con quienes le rodean a mas no poder pero lo hace con una gracia que me hace el querer tener este aspecto de ella jaja, es como esos Jefes que puensan que sus trabajadores son inutiles y los regañan e insultan JAJA, Jefes que muy probablemente ustedes han tenido 😜😜 I dedicate each and every one of my posts and videos to my little dog named princess, we called her chiquito, she is no longer with us but from heaven she will see that her existence was valuable and the most beautiful thing that will exist in my heart and soul. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/promete0sz/EoEijskTnxycRaWtddjfLaQEXt3oZs7WKYFJoCsLpYAhM1Ae6EGMcmb1N6ifX4dgTP6.png)

links.title: Sunset During Hard Days [ENG🇬🇧|ESP🇻🇪]
links.body:
> On this occasion, I was visiting a great friend. We were talking with his family about the events and tragedies our country, Venezuela, has been going through lately, when I noticed the sunset; it was so bright and orange that I decided to photograph it before it disappeared. # I took some photos from the balcony, but it didn't feel like enough, so I ran out to the main avenue to take more. People were staring at me, but all I cared about was getting a great shot to remember this sunset. I took several photos from the street... I liked these last ones much more. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcnDe5tS59manicbKH6WRx4J9GjkwPepczeRDcNWaXbP5/1782842145780.jpg) ​I find it incredible how, in such bleak days following the earthquakes, nature sometimes offers us spectacles like these sunsets—a sky that provides hope amidst so much tragedy. ​Although I have taken thousands of sunset photos, I think this has been one of the best. If you don't believe me, check out my profile and see for yourself. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbGfjsmvt5sByzCH3JQD2hbL19t91wWjiiFfGJd9hb4WY/1782842145937.jpg) These haven't been easy days, but I will always leave a small space in my life to photograph nature. # |
Español
| |-| ------

> En esta oportunidad, me encontraba visitando a un gran amigo. Estábamos conversando con su familia sobre los acontecimientos y las tragedias que ha vivido nuestro país, Venezuela, últimamente, cuando me fijé en el atardecer: era tan brillante y anaranjado que decidí fotografiarlo antes de que desapareciera. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWMw6PNZkCCpgstLcxcbcDqFUgLYt96fLcFmSm79xNUzQ/1782842146061.jpg) Tomé algunas fotos desde el balcón de la casa, pero no me pareció suficiente, así que salí corriendo hacia la avenida principal para capturar más imágenes. La gente se me quedaba viendo, pero a mí solo me importaba lograr una buena fotografía para recordar este momento. Tomé varias fotos desde la calle y, sinceramente, estas últimas me gustaron mucho más. ​Me parece increíble cómo, en días tan aciagos tras los terremotos, la naturaleza a veces nos brinda espectáculos como estos atardeceres; un cielo que nos ofrece esperanza en medio de tanta tragedia. ​Aunque he tomado miles de fotos de atardeceres, creo que este ha sido uno de los mejores. Si no me creen, chequen mi perfil y confírmenlo ustedes mismos. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSNRWbjtGwcK72tZz6AvccbVh7Ps18ENGaGF7jrpTNhW2/1782842146153.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQDKq2MHxXiWEQ6387NZrroBnYL4wWguhWr9rCjXxde6t/1782842187304.jpg) No han sido días fáciles, pero siempre dejaré un pequeño espacio en mi vida para fotografiar la naturaleza. ------ ---- |

links.title: HEARING BUT NOT LISTENING TO GOD'S WORDS
links.body:
We can hear people talk or speak to us but sometimes we are not listening to what the person is telling us and the same thing is applied in our spiritual life whereby some people can hear the words of God but they fail to practice the teachings of God. 

Throughout the Bible, God calls His people not only to hear His message but also to obey it. Jesus warned that merely hearing without responding leads to spiritual blindness and missed opportunities for growth.

>\

(James 1:22).

Alot of people knows the ten commandments and also study the bible everyday but they fail to practice the teachings. This kind of hearing produces knowledge without transformation. The Bible teaches that true faith is demonstrated by obedience, and those who ignore God's instruction harden their hearts over time.

links.title: Tsunami - The Venezuelan Hero - Acrylic painting [ENG-ESP]
links.body:
![Sin título37.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/AJpjCMRa9Pi1j8SMA5rg7SHYj52SeX6pE9yDp45FRNKiDr9hg4MsELsRZ38oLfF.jpg)

Venezuela is going through difficult times—an apocalyptic, horror-movie scenario I never imagined witnessing so close to home, yet one with consequences and effects so devastating that I feel an emotional earthquake in every fiber of my being. My creativity went dormant, just like the normal life I used to lead; I have spent every day glued to the news, particularly looking for reports of survivors being found. The terrible earthquake of June 24th taught me a great deal—especially the humility to recognize that we are merely passing through this world and must cherish the journey alongside our loved ones. Amidst so much pain, a ray of hope has emerged thanks to Tsunami, a beautiful dog who, together with his rescue team, has found many people alive beneath the rubble; my creativity, previously on hold, found a symbol of hope in this beautiful creature—a symbol that we Venezuelans now share. I have created a painting to pay tribute to this furry friend who helped with rescue efforts and is now receiving international aid, thanks to the solidarity of so many people around the world. Here is the artwork, featuring Tsunami, the rescue dog.

Venezuela está pasando por momentos difíciles, una película de terror y apocalíptica que jamás pensé ver tan cera, pero que sus consecuencias y efectos son tan devastadores que siento un terremoto emocional en cada fibra de mi ser. Mi creatividad se apagó así como la vida normal que llevaba, todos los días los he pasado conectado a las noticias, especialmente donde encuentren a personas vivas. El terrible terremoto sufrido el 24 de junio me ha enseñado mucho, especialmente la humildad de reconocer de que en este mundo solo somos pasajeros y que debemos disfrutar el viaje junto a nuestro seres queridos.  Dentro de tanto dolor el rayo de esperanza ha crecido gracias a Tsunami, un hermoso canino que junto a su equipo rescatista han encontrado a muchas personas vivas bajo los escombros, la creatividad que se encontraba en pausa encontró en esta bella criatura un símbolo de esperanza el cual ahora tenemos los venezolanos. He realizado una pintura para homenajear a este amigo peludo que ha ayudado en las labores de rescate y que ahora cuenta con ayuda internacional gracias a la solidaridad de tantos pueblos en el mundo. Aquí les dejo con esta obra que representa a Tsunami, el perrito rescatista


<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>
<center>PROCESS</center>

|![Sin título1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23xpKXJvAfvgcSHT1gGTrmC91NUxQBak7xT5Jf5iJ6pWkw2Z7spk6yG5WRG6HocEehtN4.jpg)|![Sin título2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wX3o4pnf8rWNNCzqShinp4jU32QVEc6Ctv98yGKEW5sBuNFAuVfqwUdkKEsabDPvDRW.jpg)|![Sin título3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23tmSAJQWDhzDp7CwwoYZTCLu4aRcrt3WRRLxzMquoDTprxALyj3EHV626toTDxJQ3LsJ.jpg)|
|-|-|-|
|![Sin título4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23tvs7b2osiujFhjowUrmpj6YQaYtwQgcdPyS4DuExjRRMufbx2kxomNbLeRZtL4CTDSi.jpg)|![Sin título5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23tcA1pmfszKdf8KB8e8yrT68nGtswRZMd6cd8C32dkDqXvBa918LJGfyMovUWELHngce.jpg)|![Sin título6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23x1HkY6iGsoye8RtdJ1btmHm2bx5JsVisw77Y6ANEsBieu4AmrxkQsApUJRQ7i5daMrZ.jpg)|

I used a canvas I had been holding onto for a long time; it measures 25 centimeters wide by 30 centimeters high. I sketched Tsunami in pencil and then applied a layer of brown acrylic paint mixed with water. I’ve seen various painters use this technique and wanted to try it out; the idea is that it’s easier than painting directly onto a blank canvas, and it certainly yielded good results. I started by painting the nose, focusing on capturing the finest details to make it look truly realistic.

>Utilicé un lienzo que tenía guardado desde hace mucho tiempo, mide 25 centímetros de ancho por 30 centímetros de alto. Hice el boceto de Tsunami con lápiz para luego pasar una capa de pintura acrílica de color café mezclada con agua. Esta técnica la he visto mucho en algunos pintores y quise probarla, según es más fácil hacerlo de esta manera que pintar directamente sobre el lienzo en blanco, y la verdad que dio buenos resultados. Comencé pintando la nariz, tratando de hacerle los mínimos detalles para que luciera bien realista. 

<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>

|![Sin título8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23w2ywdeRsAgXrkHBkkrcr1EpJbQwqiGP9LG5MMG4j7eTygJ6xM6DPZHAE4uuDKchMCkT.jpg)|![Sin título9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wX7pk7kFF3gUM8QBZeaTRq4fXiyhMHRXwFpyqiQc3EnJZbGNLxqakg86CTWZ458iSGt.jpg)|![Sin título10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23xetcM5gZotHQXLqYJRHfjoMv7dh3VRx6sYiphDok1CfYoNqroXqy8A2NfDECSMeqha7.jpg)|
|-|-|-|
|![Sin título11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wCL3YgbavwKpdeMaKneYgcad7rZ8Y8Kq2uG12cfzyXCMi4BvfptfaYp6rYaZRy1WjHh.jpg)|![Sin título12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wCQbidtjLpGfSKF1V2oXmsHh4wKMj31fUVWFAQmkMxXmsTr8tmxiV3awJSdQJyzNxh3.jpg)|![Sin título13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23tSjGuzU6p5CFxQGHGVuMAwYR5LyFTD3z7uiaoCVKg46acde4wtXU9x4D1snKvvAVdDa.jpg)|

As I mentioned earlier, applying a layer of paint mixed with water is a brilliant idea; it looks different while you're painting, and the paint pigments appear distinct. Here, for instance, I started painting the eyes—one of which shows heterochromia, as it is white, perhaps due to a Husky ancestor.

>Como mencioné antes, el haberle puesto un capa de pintura mezclada con agua es una idea genial, se siente diferente a la vista al momento de pintar y se observan diferentes los pigmentos de las pinturas. Aquí por ejemplo comencé a pintar sus ojos, los cuales en una de ellos tiene heterocromía ya que uno de sus ojos es blanco, tal vez de un antepasado Husky. 

<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>

|![Sin título14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23viAWtztFPZmFpKqvB2SPbN5v9YKUeLfU1D3NySKKBUDM73KjU78QwLrj5M3qhyw1Ptp.jpg)|![Sin título15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wXA8riLtDweZRxCpyGiqD5BFDCD5tY4fwBCtuPprK6T4PvNmFR5X9H8cmN4eDB3Z2V6.jpg)|![Sin título16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/24242TQg3neTNf4zWnQFQjgtCytUsKH5UQY6DrnybJzb6Fuynz7c3Labm71aLyHFMrckH.jpg)|
|-|-|-|
|![Sin título17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wMm2ujMbTLHmff59CgbnEDJ88sGFMYAus3GwDq3ivuuXTP4AkxQdfLWp6bEd1kQeoxr.jpg)|![Sin título18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uQzoi3eUeMjiXVFqPA4iSyTJN6edu2jbZYuRMT6aPduchTKSAweFidi2GoCKUJcup5s.jpg)|![Sin título19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23x1FAcZfNHnwsxu8ocUaUTmkwHiywdC7Tyoc5jmYYusvGMKqyw7cGy6TqLXkn4REHRKu.jpg)|

Next, I begin painting the entire mouth, including the teeth and the huge tongue. This dog breed is very intelligent—I’ve read a lot about them; they are even used alongside herding dogs because they are good at understanding commands. During the earthquake, Tsunami did an amazing job tracking through the rubble and finding over 100 survivors—a true legend.

>Seguidamente comienzo a pintar toda su boca, incluyendo sus dientes y su enorme lengua. Esta raza de perro es muy inteligente, leí mucho acerca de ellos, también los usan con perros ovejeros por que son buenos para entender las ordenes. Y en este terremoto Tsunami ha hecho un gran trabajo de rastreo entre los escombro encontrando a más de 100 personas con vida, toda una leyenda. 

<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>

|![Sin título21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFaXLo3gaoTXjQTEgT1hJRBHFJ4ejEweTtZGyGHSx9TtEDnbDehr1SABsd5aL5Tgyqm.jpg)|![Sin título22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23tmPwaW5xYMxCRxoGBfXXa4H19vbQdaP8iQTQ6HAofn74SnCW71EnSzJ3ebDLMyCGv1u.jpg)|![Sin título24.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23tvoBgmUyURceRsqatk6nDrRCNqp13M1CRE19zXhmTGWGGtPSMcWQJehh2rHeJnpvTMX.jpg)|
|-|-|-|
|
![Sin título26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wWyTzJY6ezNjewCvfH6VGxZpqUcL7esUfzc92czk8kudc24CAqpxAAzdRABhFTzE9tr.jpg)|![Sin título30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23x131WKH77YgXWjNxh1BrBb6zU986FqDUFnDWbEisMT1GBRdMKyWsyjV97YTsL5tyGma.jpg)|![Sin título31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/242NcaJMPaQS31YJoHhDPzze9qvMtx8p6SXjAKHj1qP8YJ1E5Q7pDLqmx24oNittiU1oH.jpg)|

Next, I began painting his entire coat white; however, it is not a pure white but rather a blend with brown to create shading between the individual tufts of fur. I also painted the orange rescue vest—bearing the Venezuelan flag—that he wears on his missions. For the background, I used shades of blue with varying contrasts, as the blue of the sky represents, to me, the hope of rebirth.

>Después comencé a pintar todo su pelaje de colro blanco, pero este blanco no es puro sino que está mezclado con color cafe para darle sombra entre cada mechón de pelo. Así también he pintado el chaleco de rescate color naranja identificado con la bandera de Venezuela, que utiliza para realizar las misiones. En el fondo hice algo de color azul con varios contraste, porque el azul del cielo representa para mi la esperanza del renacimiento.

<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>

<center>FINAL WORK</center>


![Sin título33.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23xedu9ZAgZJA49XSt6ZEEG3BDMqwueGWq9ewjMRUUA75SYgPErZ1D3K9k1XaV6VUMiXH.jpg)

![Sin título34.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wWxrjF1JkBzZP9Mg8ExC4Accsibj2cZnTN6btuXPFcPMM36Kn2EpwmDeBPtVk8MLs9s.jpg)

![Sin título35.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23xyZ9dne2uWWKFNnj3GXXab7EexooeJXph6y6axKfnXDawvn2JUHrKhLwP5b7fmZ7Gcw.jpg)

![Sin título36.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23y8v2wsbKSqBFBiEV81mm3hm8yN6KNmuzHSPnn34HbWKTtZo8VpT3eqpsfcsoCT4eHE8.jpg)


What do you think of the result? The acrylic shades are undoubtedly very vibrant, and they really helped me achieve this look. Now, I’m trying to get in touch with the Tsunami rescue team because I want to gift them this painting—that was my intention from the very beginning. I’ll leave a link to the Instagram reel at the end so you can show your support and tag the Tsunami team; that way, they can see the painting and know that I want to send it to them. Thank you for your time, and I hope to be back soon with more creativity and hope. See you next time.

>¿Qué les ha parecido el resultado? sin duda los tonos acrílicos son muy vivos y me ayudaron a lograr este resultado. Ahora estoy tratando de ponderarme en contacto con el equipo de rescate de Tsunami porque quiero obsequiarle este cuadro, esa fue mi intención desde el inicio. Dejaré al final la dirección al reel de instagram, así lo pueden apoyar y etiquetar al equipo de Tsunami para que pueda ver el cuadro y que sepan que quiero enviarles el cuadro. Agradezco a ustedes por la atención ye spero volver pronto, con más creatividad y esperanza, me despido hasta pronto.


![Sin título3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23vi3jaedYQcztzeBybPuEqAVhjdEfH8fMxgyV2qjy46V2Fg8jKkVSBLeijg19m7WLc8f.jpg)

links.title: Elvis Is Literally Donald Trump – Same Entity, Perfect Symmetry, Identical Spots, and the Viral Post That Proves It
links.body:
I have been showing for months that we are not dealing with ordinary human beings who live one life and die. We are dealing with recurring actors — fallen entities that fake their deaths, shapeshift into new forms, and continue their work across decades without the public ever catching on. I already covered Wernher von Braun becoming Elon Musk and Adolf Hitler stepping into the role of Fred Trump. Today I present another undeniable case: **Elvis Presley is literally Donald Trump**. Same fallen entity. Different costume. Same mission.

Look at the four images attached to this post. Study them carefully. These are not coincidences. These are proof.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR96tyAUYvHByiTio2z6zZAeRAnEM3xYbmZS6ZYWhHzpE/1782839385190.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbboL72EMLjkTNKcsZ6BSCs4Jgw24eNHDZZXq1u6eMJTJ/1782839219865.jpg)

**Images 1** shows Tyler Hanson (@FittestFlatEarther) pointing directly at the pink-circled skin markings around the eye and nose area. On the left is Elvis, on the right is Trump. The exact same blemishes in the exact same locations. Tyler has been exposing this pattern for a long time and deserves full credit for putting these overlays together.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme7YubG5ssE3f3FCLkpvNoVxecku3txAwVFeQJD7b5M7n/1782839990402.png)
**Image 2** is Donald Trump’s own verified post from February 2024. He took Tyler’s comparison image, published it himself, and wrote: “For so many years people have been saying that Elvis and I look alike. Now this pic has been going all over the place. What do you think?” He even added the split-face photo that has been circulating everywhere. This is not a joke. This is an encrypted message for those with eyes to see. Here is the direct link to his post: https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/111869870716367808

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQyP1W33zQiJV2rkZUBUW9YNyW4SwoDrBMjHVtWwKcpDj/1782840101673.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmepaH9D6THti5Gk9SSkknm35KESPthWxA3RAzuMymVLYf/1782840112624.jpg)

**Image 3** zooms in on the mouth and chin area. 

Green circles highlight the identical skin spot on both Elvis and Trump in the exact same position. Another permanent marker that cannot be faked.

These images together destroy any claim of coincidence. Shapeshifters can change their overall appearance, but they cannot change the underlying facial symmetry. They cannot relocate or erase their permanent spots, scars, and birthmarks. These identifiers stay exactly where they have always been. That is why the proof keeps stacking up.

**The Viral Post Is the Confession**  
Think about what Trump did. He didn’t deny the resemblance. He didn’t call it fake. He actively spread the comparison photo himself and asked the public “What do you think?” while smiling. For those awake, this is the ultimate troll. He is rubbing it in our faces. “Yes, it’s me. I was Elvis. Now I’m Trump. What are you going to do about it?” The entity is laughing at how blind most people still are.

This is the same pattern we saw with von Braun writing himself into the future as “the Elon” in his 1950s book, and the same pattern with the Hitler-to-Fred-Trump transition. These entities love to leave clues. They mock us with symbolism because they know most will dismiss it as a meme or a joke.

**They Cannot Hide the Marks**  
No matter how many times they fake a death and step into a new identity, the core geometry of the face and the permanent skin identifiers remain. Symmetry does not lie. Birthmarks do not move. Blemishes do not disappear. This is the fingerprint of the recurring actor. Elvis had the marks. Trump has the exact same marks in the exact same places decades later. Same entity. Different era.

**The Spiritual Framework**  
As I have explained in previous long blogs, we must understand this through the authentic Second Temple Jewish worldview preserved in Torah, Tanakh, the Dead Sea Scrolls, 1 Enoch, Jubilees, Daniel, and the Brit Ha-Chadasha. There exists a Divine Council of subordinate heavenly beings. Many of them rebelled and became the powers behind the idols and leaders of the nations. Psalm 82 pronounces their judgment. The Watchers taught forbidden knowledge. Different categories of fallen powers operate on earth.

These recurring actors are agents of those fallen powers. They do not die like mortal men. They complete one assignment, stage an exit (bunker suicide, heart attack on the toilet, whatever the script calls for), and reappear in a new role to advance the next phase of deception and idolatry.

Elvis captured the hearts and worship of millions in the 1950s–70s. Mission accomplished. Fake the death in 1977, step into the Trump identity, and continue the work through politics, business, and modern spectacle. The worship simply shifts from one mask to the next.

The Eternal does not share His glory with another. Yet these entities crave it. They build cults of personality whether through music, movies, politics Sports ect. They want your eyes on the celebrity, the strongman, the golden-haired icon — anything except the Creator.

**Why This Matters**  
This is not entertainment. This is spiritual warfare playing out in plain sight. Every time we accept the mainstream narrative (“Elvis died, Trump is just a guy who looks similar”), we stay asleep. When we recognize the pattern — same face, same marks, same entity — we begin to see the matrix for what it is.

Tyler Hanson has done tremendous work compiling these overlays and forcing the conversation into the open. Whether you agree with every detail of his flat earth work or not, on this particular topic he has provided visuals that cannot be easily dismissed. Credit belongs to him for the heavy lifting on these comparisons.

**The Pattern Is Consistent**  
Von Braun → Musk  
Hitler → Fred Trump (and the family operation)  
Elvis → Trump  

Always the same playbook: achieve the goal in one costume, fake the exit, re-enter in a new high-profile role, keep the masses distracted and worshipping created things instead of the Creator.

**Call to Action**  
Save these four images. Study them. Share them. Ask people the same question Trump asked, but with the full context: “What do you think now that you’ve seen the marks, the symmetry, and the pattern across multiple entities?”

Read the ancient texts. Understand the Divine Council. Recognize the Watchers’ influence still active today. Reject every idol — whether it wears a jumpsuit, a suit and tie, or sits behind a microphone.

The spiritual realm is more real than the physical drama they stage for us. These entities are active, but their time is short and their judgment is already written.

Turn your eyes back to יהוה, the Eternal Creator. Fear Him. Keep His commandments. Do not be deceived by the recurring actors who never truly die — they only change costumes.

Elvis is Trump.  
Trump was Elvis.  
Same fallen entity.  
Same mission.  
Same permanent markers that expose them every single time.

The evidence is in your hands.  
The choice is yours.
