, it becomes the _specific_ `ProxyError` member, so the caller can branch on `error.ConnectionRefused` versus `error.HostUnreachable` and mean it. Point this client at your own proxy from episode 93 over `localhost` and the two validating each other is, as promised, the nicest test in the whole exercise set.

# Learn Zig Series (#94) - NAT Traversal and Hole Punching

Here we go ;-) At the very end of episode 93 I left you with a deliberately uncomfortable question. A proxy solves \

by inserting a machine that can reach _both_. But that only works because the proxy itself has a clean, publicly reachable address -- somebody, somewhere, has to be dialable from the open internet. So what happens when _neither_ peer does? Two laptops, each behind a home router, each with a private address its router rewrites on the way out. No friendly middleman either of them can reach. That, jonguh, is the genuinely hard version of \

, and the box doing the rewriting is the **NAT**.

This episode is about defeating that box -- not with a proxy, but by tricking the two NATs into letting the peers talk _directly_. The technique is called **hole punching**, and the first time you watch it work it feels like cheating. Two machines that provably cannot reach each other suddenly can, and no traffic flows through any server in the middle. Let's understand exactly why, byte by byte.

## The box that rewrites your address

Your laptop almost certainly has a private address -- something like `192.168.1.42` -- that is meaningless on the public internet (millions of laptops have that same address right now). When you open a TCP or UDP connection out, your router performs **Network Address Translation**: it rewrites the source address to its own public IP, picks a public source port, and writes down the mapping in a table:

```
(192.168.1.42 : 51000)  <->  (203.0.113.7 : 49152)
```

Replies coming back to `203.0.113.7:49152` get the swap reversed and delivered to your laptop. This is the same source-rewriting trick a proxy does explicitly, except your router does it transparently to every packet, and -- crucially -- it only creates an inbound mapping _after_ you send an outbound packet. The table entry is born from your traffic leaving. Nobody on the outside can create one for you.

That last sentence is the entire problem, and the entire solution. A NAT will happily forward a reply to a destination you already started talking to. It will silently drop a packet from a stranger you never contacted. So both peers are unreachable strangers to each other -- until they aren't.

## Why two NATs can't shake hands

Picture peer **A** behind NAT-A and peer **B** behind NAT-B. A wants to send B a packet. But A only knows B's private address (useless), or at best B's public mapping -- and even if A fires a packet at `B-public:port`, NAT-B has no table entry for A yet, so it drops the packet as unsolicited junk. The symmetric thing happens to B. Each side is waiting for an inbound packet that the other side's NAT refuses to forward. Deadlock.

The escape is timing. If A sends to B _and_ B sends to A at roughly the same moment, then A's outbound packet creates a mapping in NAT-A that says \

, and B's outbound packet does the mirror in NAT-B. Now when A's _next_ packet arrives at NAT-B, the table entry exists (B's earlier outbound packet created it), so it gets forwarded. The hole is punched from both sides at once. Each peer's own outbound traffic is what opens the door for the other's inbound traffic.

But this raises two questions we have to answer before any of it works. **First**, how does A even learn B's public mapping, given that B doesn't know its own (the NAT picked the public port, not B)? **Second**, how do the two peers agree to fire at the same moment when they can't yet talk to each other? The answers are STUN and a rendezvous server, in that order.

## STUN: asking \
\n\nA peer cannot know its own public mapping by looking inward -- the kernel only knows the private `192.168.x.x` address. The mapping lives in the router. So the peer asks a public server: \

That tiny question-and-answer is **STUN** (Session Traversal Utilities for NAT, RFC 5389), and a binding request is gloriously small -- a 20-byte header and zero attributes:

```zig
const std = @import(\

trivial. You'd write far less code, at the cost of a dependency that hides the byte-level reality we just made visible.

In **Rust**, the same story with `webrtc-rs` or `str0m`: production-grade ICE, async all the way down, memory-safe, and a fairly heavy dependency tree. Rust's enums would model `NatType` and the STUN attributes as cleanly as Zig's do.

Zig lands where it keeps landing in this arc: we wrote the binding request, the XOR-MAPPED parse, the endpoint exchange, and the punch loop in a couple hundred readable lines, every byte and every syscall ours, with the compiler refusing to let a malformed attribute become a wild read. You would not ship this as a replacement for full ICE -- real deployments want candidate gathering, TURN fallback, and IPv6 -- but you now understand precisely what those libraries are doing under their polished surface, and _that_ is the point of building it from scratch.

## Where this is heading

Step back at what we've assembled across this whole networking arc. We can speak raw TCP and UDP (21, 81), resolve names (82), frame our own protocols (90, 91), proxy connections (93), and now -- the last missing piece -- get two machines _behind NAT_ to talk directly without anything in the middle. That's the complete toolkit for real peer-to-peer software: discovery, transport, framing, and traversal.

Which means it's finally time to stop building isolated pieces and build something whole with them. We've got the protocol-design instincts, the server patterns from the HTTP and key-value episodes, the concurrency from the threads and atomics episodes, and now the networking foundation underneath all of it. The next stretch puts them together into a real, multi-user program you could actually run with your friends -- starting, as every good system does, not with code but with a careful look at the messages the participants will exchange.

The thread running through all of it hasn't moved since episode 21: a protocol is a contract written in bytes. Parse every length like the sender means you harm, name your endianness so no target surprises you, and let the type system carry the shapes so the compiler catches the case you'd otherwise forget. NAT traversal sounds like black magic from the outside. From the inside it's a 20-byte question, an XOR, and two machines firing packets at each other at exactly the right moment -- and now you've written all three.

## Exercises

1. **Detect your NAT type.** Send binding requests to two _different_ public STUN servers from the same local socket, parse both XOR-MAPPED-ADDRESS replies, and compare the public ports. Equal ports mean a cone NAT (hole punching will work); different ports mean symmetric (it probably won't). Print a verdict, and write a test that feeds two canned responses into your comparison logic and asserts the classification.

2. **Add a keepalive timer.** Wrap a punched UDP path in a small struct that sends a 1-byte keepalive every 15 seconds (use the `std.time.Timer` from episode 70) whenever no real traffic has gone out, so the NAT mapping never expires. Prove with a test that the \

predicate fires only after the idle interval has elapsed.

3. **Write the rendezvous server.** Build the tiny TCP server that makes the punch possible: accept two peers (the accept loop from episode 51), read each one's six-byte endpoint, store them keyed by a shared room name in a `HashMap` (episode 22), and once both have arrived, send each peer the _other's_ endpoint. Test the pairing logic in isolation by registering two endpoints under one room and asserting each receives its counterpart -- no real sockets needed.

> Hello dear Sketchbook community! 🎨💖👋 Today I’m excited to share a new digital illustration that I created entirely in **Adobe Illustrator**. This time, I wanted to pay tribute to one of the most iconic anime series ever by drawing the legendary **Team 7** in an adorable **chibi style**. 🍥⚡💙 This illustration features **Naruto Uzumaki**, **Sasuke Uchiha**, and **Sakura Haruno** from a unique perspective, with their faces forming a circular composition as if they were all looking down together. 😊✨ I thought this angle would make the artwork feel playful, fresh, and full of personality. The inspiration for this piece came from my love for anime and the unforgettable moments these three characters shared throughout the series. ❤️📺 Although each one has a completely different personality, together they represent friendship, growth, determination, and teamwork.

/> From a technical standpoint, this illustration was created using **vector illustration techniques** in Adobe Illustrator. 🖋️💻 Every element was built using clean Bézier curves, allowing me to achieve smooth outlines, sharp edges, and scalable artwork without any loss of quality. One of my favorite parts of the process was simplifying each character while preserving their most recognizable features. 👀✨ Naruto's blond spiky hair, Sasuke's dark hairstyle, Sakura's pink hair, and their iconic Hidden Leaf headbands instantly make them recognizable even in a minimalist chibi style. I intentionally chose a flat color palette with bold outlines to stay true to the visual language of anime while maintaining a clean and modern vector aesthetic. 🎨🌈 This approach also helps the illustration feel bright, balanced, and easy to read. The circular composition was carefully planned to create visual harmony between the three characters. 🔵📐 Their faces naturally guide the viewer's eye around the illustration, making the overall design feel dynamic despite its simplicity. Creating this fan art reminded me why I enjoy digital illustration so much. 💖✨ It allows me to reinterpret characters I admire while adding my own artistic style and creativity. Thank you so much for stopping by and supporting my artwork! 🤗🎨 I hope you enjoy this illustration as much as I enjoyed creating it! 🍥💙✨ 🍃💙✨ Every illustration is a new adventure where imagination and passion come together. Thank you for your support! ✨🍃💙 * * *
/> 🍥✨ El Equipo 7 en Estilo Chibi – Mi Fan Art en Adobe Illustrator ✨🍥 =====================================================================

/>¡Hola querida comunidad de Sketchbook! 🎨💖👋 Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una nueva ilustración digital realizada completamente en **Adobe Illustrator**. En esta ocasión decidí rendir homenaje a uno de los animes más icónicos de todos los tiempos dibujando al legendario **Equipo 7** en un adorable **estilo chibi**. 🍥⚡💙 Esta ilustración muestra a **Naruto Uzumaki**, **Sasuke Uchiha** y **Sakura Haruno** desde una perspectiva diferente, formando una composición circular como si los tres estuvieran mirando hacia abajo al mismo tiempo. 😊✨ Me pareció una idea divertida y original que aporta dinamismo y personalidad a la escena. />

Desde un punto de vista técnico, la ilustración fue desarrollada utilizando **técnicas de ilustración vectorial** en Adobe Illustrator. 🖋️💻 Cada elemento fue construido mediante curvas Bézier limpias, logrando líneas precisas, contornos definidos y una imagen escalable sin perder calidad.

Uno de los aspectos que más disfruté fue simplificar el diseño de cada personaje sin perder sus rasgos más representativos. 👀✨ El cabello rubio de Naruto, el peinado oscuro de Sasuke, el cabello rosado de Sakura y las emblemáticas bandas de la Aldea de la Hoja permiten reconocerlos inmediatamente incluso en una versión minimalista estilo chibi.

Opté por utilizar una paleta de colores planos junto con contornos marcados para conservar la esencia visual del anime y, al mismo tiempo, darle un acabado limpio y moderno propio del arte vectorial. 🎨🌈 Esta decisión también ayuda a que la ilustración resulte equilibrada y muy agradable a la vista.

La composición circular fue cuidadosamente diseñada para generar armonía visual entre los tres personajes. 🔵📐 Sus rostros conducen naturalmente la mirada del espectador alrededor de toda la ilustración, aportando dinamismo sin necesidad de una escena compleja.

Lo que más me inspiró al realizar este fan art fue la idea de reinterpretar personajes tan queridos utilizando mi propio estilo de ilustración. 💖✨ Cada nuevo dibujo representa una oportunidad para seguir aprendiendo y perfeccionando mis habilidades como ilustrador digital.

body.title: Random Photos From My Last Trip Back Home
body.body:
Hello everyone, hope all of you are doing great today. Since I start writing again , I thought today I would share something a little different. While scrolling through my gallery, I found these random photos that I took during my last trip back to my hometown about a month ago. At first I wasn't planning to make a blog about them because they are just random moments, but after looking at them again, I realised every photo actually reminds me of something from that trip. So I think why not share them here with all of you.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVFt1ckUoXJ54gF3ZxQRqXTjE4Pn6QjBCUBBjQnerRz4S/whatsapp_image_2026_07_01_at_12.30.59_am_3_.jpeg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWk2tWqcfaNByhcJNUA3y5R5oztnsMs6Yd2BcL4th9Fub/whatsapp_image_2026_07_01_at_12.30.58_am.jpeg)


One of the photos was taken when we stopped by a grocery shop before going back home. We just wanted to buy some drinks and a few groceries that my mother asked us to bring back. Nothing really special happened there, but something outside the shop immediately caught my attention. There was a black and white cat sitting quietly near the entrance. He looked so comfortable, like he had been sitting there the whole day. People kept walking in and out, but he didn't seem to care at all. He just watched everyone passing by with that serious face. Looking at him, I almost felt like he was the one guarding the shop instead of the workers.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXHuqCKrWTFR7aJgj1oRmBUz53QNzRCMDgHt2opQb5MPp/whatsapp_image_2026_07_01_at_12.30.59_am_2_.jpeg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbYLW11ejCjgXTVDiCRaoBgZNGSFXzwiqWS3V7fhwQuy2/whatsapp_image_2026_07_01_at_12.30.59_am_1_.jpeg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVJfpXK14xUvwNShznuJTWmkP8wFqy4edE9WZnYHmEtjp/whatsapp_image_2026_07_01_at_12.30.59_am.jpeg)

While we shopping, i noticed another cat inside the store. This one was different from the cat outside. Maybe they were friends, or maybe they just happened to like the same shop. This cat had already found the best place to relax. He was sleeping on the cool floor inside the air-conditioned shop while the weather outside was really hot. I couldn't stop laughing because he looked so peaceful. I quickly took a few photos before leaving because his sleeping pose was just too cute. Honestly, if I were a cat, I probably would choose the same place to sleep too.

The next few photos are from my father's farm. Actually they were not taken on the same day as the grocery shop, but they were still from the same trip back home, so I decided to put everything together in one post. During that time, the weather was extremely hot. It had not rained for quite some time, and even the small river near the farm was almost dry. Because of that, my father decided to stop using the hydroponic system for a while. We had already harvested vegetables from it before, so there wasn't much reason to keep it running when water was becoming limited. Sometimes farming is like that. You have to work together with nature instead of fighting against it.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb4gVSuGGJGpUZkz2iRnp4Es8r8g8aSEu2sRs3DiwoW5Y/whatsapp_image_2026_07_01_at_12.31.00_am_2_.jpeg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaj3rg2nahfPSU5gfjriafekduTwESzSJUvRcHmfovwh3/whatsapp_image_2026_07_01_at_12.31.00_am_1_.jpeg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT2TCSThsyBQAeWo5We7bJyU5A8gZVBeoFdoTbqJZ3oAU/whatsapp_image_2026_07_01_at_12.31.00_am.jpeg)

Most of the garden beds were also empty . They weren't abandoned or forgotten. My father was simply waiting for the rain before starting another planting cycle. At first, an empty garden doesn't really look interesting, but if you know a little bit about farming, you understand that every harvest begins with an empty piece of land. Before you can enjoy fresh vegetables, you need to prepare the soil, wait for the weather, and have a little patience. Farming has always reminded me that not everything can be rushed.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfQvXVH8hf9s1NNf9jHdDeDvsCCnXbDvU5hr5EMgZqRxf/whatsapp_image_2026_07_01_at_12.31.00_am_3_.jpeg)


Around the farm there were still some chilli plants, fruit trees and a few vegetables that managed to survive the hot weather. Some of them looked healthy enough, while others were obviously waiting for rain. Looking around the farm that day felt very quiet. There wasn't much work to do because the weather simply wasn't suitable. Sometimes the best thing to do is just leave everything alone and wait until nature is ready again.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmchoumMKWqgpdcTRf8M5HbUo7QNAHzKEKjdyd56EcEdky/whatsapp_image_2026_07_01_at_12.31.00_am_4_.jpeg)

Now it has already been around a month since I took these photos. My family told me that it has been raining quite often recently, so I guess the farm probably looks very different now. Maybe the garden beds are already full of green vegetables again. Maybe the hydroponic system is running once more. I honestly don't know because I haven't gone back yet, but I really wonder how everything looks today.

Looking through these old photos also reminded me that we don't always need a big event to create good memories. Sometimes it is just a random stop at a grocery shop, watching two lazy cats enjoying their day, or taking a few photos around my father's farm before heading home. These little moments probably don't look special to other people, but somehow they become the memories that I enjoy looking back on the most.

Thank you everyone for stopping by and reading another one of my blogs. I hope all of you have a wonderful day, and I'll see you again in my next post.

body.title: Discovering one of Valletta’s Timeless Beauty of Basilica of St. Dominic and Porto Salvo.
body.body:
![13035.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23ydJu7irmGHvQmYg1qAisD3ro1pArNcb7pZr6aAERotvv7TuUJvEdJ1HCnnpGh7uLABw.png)

Hello, travellers and welcome to our Malta journey! 👋

After exploring the historic Fort St. Elmo and learning about Malta's battles, soldiers' sacrifices and the fortress gave us a full picture. 

We continued our journey through the beautiful streets of Valletta. We have our bottled water to keep us hydrated because of the weather.

![11196.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23ynG8xm8kfTaRp24FRESr8mxWnvB7HPiQsffNFn4kw9CGHBVXrW5goX2HgyKnRZ46vR6.jpg)


Every corner seemed to tell a story. While walking through the city, we were amazed by the narrow stone streets, traditional Maltese balconies  with bright, colorful wooden windows. Some balconies hang their laundry above. We were amazed by how old yet alive it all felt. The old town of Valletta felt alive with history.



![11174.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EprTYTcdtxDEaEt7ph4z1p2AQvTLksu8gcFW8XQ2GtYqefLUSEhSW4kpBeTDCPHUagu.jpg)






As we walked to the beautiful streets, we came across another remarkable landmark-the Basilica of St. Dominic and Porto Salvo.

It was one of the hidden gems of Valletta became one of the peaceful moments of our trip.

Basilica of St. Dominic and Porto Salvo stand gracefully among the city's historic buildings.


![11195.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EqhPNNidgfHufRgZafR5AqXxyV4dBxKkZ9xKGQdCLpm4a38xq6Un4HLMZTASnYsKd1J.jpg)


![11173.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EnWGzMoj1SSJL3sMiGJqAnxXz8EFgZ6G89nbjGeBbNNLJifpcQ1YVENWZVHcxzE7yWY.jpg)

![11175.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Ep1ZHpPUcrkc1RBYpRMXQhmdghdaHK5n5hzFNbxi5ZD1TP4Lr2KzcDxEVDn6DhwXv6J.jpg)

Its architecture from the outside immediately caught our attention.
It was built from Malta's famous golden limestone. The Basilica of St.Dominicand Porto Salvo blended perfectly with the surrounding states.


![11171.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23zkvedDjBcFBhMvXUN7y597YwFqUZaTDQMQ19jpqoRNDivrdrxswzeVdvYaz8PtWUTjY.jpg)

The Basilica looked even more significant because of its warm color. And the stone seemed to glow under the bright Mediterranean sun.


Although the Basilica looks grand and it feels calm. Beautiful without being overly extravagant. It's just a classic Malta.

The curved center, the carved details, and the statues, each piece in its niche creates a visually balanced composition. The tall bell tower rises above the nearby buildings.


![11176.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpxqpdE2c5UnC7U9LNMLM7ESpNKEC5cK7yzBnwS6DYivYfqvdx3jNCuTkbmeNdcS3He.jpg)

I was amazed by its craftsmanship, the people who built the Basilica. It shows how beautifully they made the large wooden entrance doors, detailed stone carvings and windows.


The Basilica is dedicated to the Madonna of Fair Havens and St. Dominic and completed in 1815. And it is a prominent landmark located on St. Dominic Street. 

![11312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/243zhwn2s6XeCHZbAbRWqrY2iSF8cdL2FjtokAeEgrrByY7ZwSmUrStenzxEgHr6PTxpu.jpg)

![8658.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23yTfLWs3LfojaNorhyusKZRA8f2q9miAEKpWuT6Db8uyLgkxx1tXnsCs4N879wPdWqsN.jpg)


![11310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpJZzQaPCRoDJwVkdjreRa3Gjxj6efSHdvciH6eycD3xs28fC7C87eaVHgcQjZGp9Ja.jpg)


Surrounded by busy streets and tourists, the Basilica gave a peaceful feeling that invited everyone inside.

The Basilica of St. Dominic and Porto Salvo is a Baroque facade. Characterized by its distinct Baroque style. With the ornate sculptures and statues of saints 
While standing in front of the basilica, I couldn't help but admire its timeless beauty.

Here's the tip:
Most churches require to dress modestly out of respect.  Some churches provide shawls at the entrance. But during the tourist season they can run out quickly. Same with St. John's Co-Cathedral, one of the busiest church tourists wants to visit.


![11182.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpnBGmxMjoacSFDQfZTNGhA5akFroq958jYGEiS8sxvpwX8XEvqqZQEVJL648PrxLvG.jpg)

![11183.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EoyPaABpEkAFxDaDxsLuTFsDNwDNrDgYBLGZgNzCUKS7vh7KDMQHpZycUHQR5V6pnXX.jpg)

As we entered through the large wooden doors, it  immediately changed the atmosphere. The noise of the busy and narrow streets faded away. It was replaced by a peaceful silence that filled the Basilica. Aside from its calming silence, it was cool inside. Giving us a refreshing escape from the weather outside.

![11178.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Eou7BQWMaeWqxMFbiCfd24gV8rjNeGM2YRDjCtpcF3MR8qHkgwZKLi6KQC8Z5Y3iAmF.jpg)

The Basilica of St. Dominic and Porto Salvo interior design was absolutely breathtaking. It was a welcoming atmosphere and peaceful when the soft natural light streamed through the windows. With its elegant details, every corner was beautifully decorated that reflected history and faith.




![13082.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23wCDvqEc5MCb833DBgabxg6nQp97BMTvMBL4M2fajVkuKPVeBBSbnwma7pMNyHyJZuDX.jpg)


It felt incredibly spacious because of its high ceilings and pure masterpiece of Baroque details. Soft greys and creams with gold leaf, patterns of swirling florals and star-shaped panels holding painted biblical scenes. 


![11189.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EorzMHie1JMDuWgrFk4nn8Wsjbd2NvMQnAf42wnxwTjkwLiURy5Y17BZ5mwRsgZf9o8.jpg)

The second dome opens wider, with frescoes of angels and saints framed with clouds that seem to float above us.

This kind of masterpiece makes you forget the heat outside and just watch from above. From limestone outside to a masterpiece of golden ceiling inside 



![11190.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Ep3erqVriPTpLmt8BC77uqBndooh7rWeMXfVeSgMdUUYSVF5sEmD69ZJhFXm5xqRffd.jpg)



![11186.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23wMaJcfNA5wT2Rw78Xz6YEaT4nmMiq3HXJ7nJYud8akqPNDxawaZ7aeGSCgr67XoM8eQ.jpg)

Another stunning masterpiece was the altar. It really caught my attention because of its gold accents, decorated with beautiful marbles and artwork. Such a centerpiece of the Basilica, we admired its beauty and had a moment of praying.


Everything was well-preserved, maintained carefully and clean. Especially the polished marble floors.



We truly appreciate the peaceful atmosphere. It was calm and gave us time to relax. We shared a quiet moment with my family, took a deep breath and just slowed down the moment.


![11185.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EoyPzdqVTRXU2McSJA7vkyAC14nSvbvxKokgmaz6VufTYfGHbWBuKQ8b6eGQRaw62yT.jpg)


Before we left, we spent time praying. You can see in the photo that my girls are wearing shawls. After we prayed, we spent more time appreciating the details.


![13084.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Eonn3BEJvHhmPGmuqmLFFdF2PKieE16ceh5kpV5QCPdKVNqgKyBj5W186Mt8dGVpn54.jpg)


![13081.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EoeFTb3H7mwM27bPATCnCJz8joDZ46ASTyd6BZ1TTq3izGM3HhRCV9fjGHL2xAAHNL2.jpg)
![13084.jpg](image-3-13084.jpg)
![11187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Ep5ni9fqnQbvcJxc9n4wAQQoX8ztdm2DyotTxtWVZogSxfSpibQk7AipLcqSypKiv71.jpg)

![11188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EoiWDFmvCpPf6Ba3JF4dLjJmSLyoLfSPtN6NzocsfjCe6ybt1zJyrZmQ2Fksbpe4hkm.jpg)

![11193.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Ep5kkTdaQ11JgeBQ4FyGSaa6CASWqzvyHoGHYnEC9oRsJKsBkjXzQ4md4UJhn8vwffH.jpg)

![11194.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EoAafFS61cj2zTYg1CgQEx9eqeAdbZu2NZ4texY2eoyEdUnqSxVbupHwubBohVTbAa9.jpg)

The incredible dedication of the artist's craftsmanship shows in very detail. From the star- shaped panels holding biblical scenes, endless gold ornamentation and nothing here was rushed. They were a labor of faith.

Visiting the Basilica of St. Dominic and Porto Salvo was more than seeing another historic building. It reminded us to appreciate the beautiful place, slow down and be thankful for the opportunity to discover one of Malta's remarkable places.


I hope you enjoyed this glimpse of Valletta's Basilica. I can't wait to share our next Malta Adventure. See you in the next post!.


![FOOTER.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23tw1RGcyG27D9fJmVn5wUt6ozVrBsc7N7jczbyttLHAFwvXpAyMEdMdodaBMwmq4Rx7o.jpg)

body.title: Renewed Effort by European Bureaucrats Targeted at Privacy Coin Ban
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pivx/48fLbjDvynN5WTV6EeNggZMRYFF1hMx4HiLTVaEfyDQhDzYZJ45yn3xxMhyzMVqswb.png)


For years, privacy advocates warned that the war against financial crime could gradually evolve into a war against financial privacy itself. What was once dismissed as a slippery-slope argument is now becoming reality in the European Union.

Beginning in July 2027, the EU's new Anti-Money Laundering Regulation (AMLR) will usher in one of the most aggressive regulatory frameworks ever imposed on privacy-preserving financial technologies. Under the new rules, cash payments above €10,000 will be prohibited, anonymous crypto accounts will be outlawed, and regulated cryptocurrency service providers will be effectively forced to remove privacy-focused cryptocurrencies from their platforms. While policymakers frame these measures as necessary tools to combat money laundering and terrorism financing, critics see something far more concerning: a renewed bureaucratic campaign against financial privacy itself.

The attack on privacy coins is particularly significant because it strikes at a fundamental principle that originally inspired cryptocurrency adoption. Bitcoin emerged as an alternative to a financial system increasingly dependent on surveillance, censorship, and centralized control. Yet despite Bitcoin's reputation, its blockchain is entirely transparent. Every transaction can be analyzed, traced, and linked through increasingly sophisticated surveillance tools.

Privacy-focused cryptocurrencies emerged as a technological response to this reality. Projects such as Monero and Zcash were designed to restore the fungibility and confidentiality traditionally associated with physical cash. Their purpose was not to facilitate crime but to protect ordinary users from excessive financial surveillance. Journalists, activists, businesses, political dissidents, and everyday citizens all have legitimate reasons to value financial privacy.

Nevertheless, European regulators have increasingly portrayed privacy-enhancing technologies as a threat rather than a civil liberty. The AMLR reflects this mindset by specifically targeting accounts and services that enable transaction anonymity. Regulators argue that anonymity creates obstacles for law enforcement investigations and increases the risk of illicit finance. From the perspective of Brussels, greater transparency equals greater security.

This argument, however, suffers from a fundamental flaw.

## Privacy is not inherently suspicious.

In every other area of modern life, privacy is considered a basic right. Europeans lock their doors, encrypt their communications, and protect their personal information online. Financial privacy should be viewed through the same lens. The assumption that individuals must surrender their transactional confidentiality simply because criminals might exploit privacy tools creates a dangerous precedent.

The irony is particularly striking because the European Union has often positioned itself as a global champion of data protection. Through regulations such as GDPR, Brussels has repeatedly argued that personal information deserves strong safeguards against unnecessary collection and misuse. Yet when it comes to financial transactions, the same institutions appear increasingly comfortable with creating systems of comprehensive visibility and traceability.

The AMLR's treatment of privacy coins illustrates this contradiction. Rather than focusing on criminal activity itself, regulators are targeting technologies that make surveillance more difficult. The distinction is important. A tool that can be abused by criminals is not inherently criminal. Encryption can be used by cybercriminals, yet society recognizes that encryption remains essential for protecting ordinary citizens. Privacy coins deserve similar consideration.

Supporters of the AMLR frequently argue that privacy-focused cryptocurrencies have become obsolete because compliance requirements are now unavoidable. However, history suggests otherwise. Technologies that satisfy genuine market demand rarely disappear simply because regulators disapprove of them. Instead, innovation adapts.

## This is precisely where projects like PIVX enter the conversation.

Unlike older privacy-focused networks that have often found themselves at the center of regulatory controversy, PIVX has pursued a more balanced path. Built around advanced Zero-Knowledge cryptography, PIVX seeks to provide users with optional privacy while maintaining the decentralized ethos that defines cryptocurrency. Its shielded transaction technology demonstrates that privacy and innovation can coexist without compromising network security.

More importantly, PIVX represents a broader philosophical challenge to the assumptions underpinning modern surveillance-based regulation. The project recognizes that privacy is not a loophole to be closed but a fundamental human condition that deserves protection. Financial transparency should be a matter of choice, legal process, and due cause—not a default condition imposed upon every citizen.

The European Union's renewed effort against privacy coins may succeed in removing certain assets from regulated exchanges. It may increase compliance burdens and further consolidate oversight within the traditional financial system. What it is unlikely to accomplish is eliminating the demand for privacy itself.

The history of technology repeatedly demonstrates that individuals seek tools that preserve autonomy, confidentiality, and personal freedom. Whether through encryption, decentralized communications, or privacy-preserving cryptocurrencies, innovation tends to move toward empowering users rather than exposing them.

This is why the debate surrounding privacy coins extends far beyond cryptocurrency. At its core, it is a debate about the future relationship between citizens and institutions. Should financial activity become permanently visible to regulators and intermediaries? Or should individuals retain some degree of economic privacy in an increasingly digital world?

## The AMLR reflects the EU bureaucracy's answer to that question.

Privacy advocates, technologists, and decentralized communities continue to offer another.

The outcome of this debate will shape not only the future of privacy coins but also the future of financial freedom in the digital age.

## Conclusion
The EU's AMLR is being presented as a necessary response to money laundering and illicit finance, yet its practical effect reaches much further. By restricting anonymous accounts, imposing tighter transaction monitoring, and pressuring regulated platforms to delist privacy-focused cryptocurrencies, European policymakers are advancing a vision of finance where surveillance becomes the default and privacy becomes the exception.

The real question is not whether criminals use privacy technologies—they always exploit every available technology. The question is whether ordinary citizens should lose access to privacy because criminals exist.

As July 2027 approaches, the battle over privacy coins will increasingly become a battle over the meaning of financial freedom itself. Projects like PIVX remind us that privacy is not merely a technical feature. It is a fundamental right worth defending in an age where digital surveillance continues to expand.

The renewed effort by EU bureaucrats may slow the adoption of privacy-preserving cryptocurrencies within regulated markets, but it is unlikely to extinguish the broader demand for financial privacy. If anything, it reinforces why privacy technologies remain necessary in the first place.

_Written by Sapentia_

Join our Official HUNTER FOR CHRIST page on  [Hunter for Christ](https://x.com/danielasikpo2) (X account)  >[Hunter for Christ](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbCyoE277qVUyGkUds0t) (WhatApp channel)  >[Hunter for Christ](https://www.tiktok.com/@daniel_effiong28?_r=1&_t=ZS-97XjBuaUw6f) (Tik tok  >And also my faith content creations here Hive from @daniasi Help follow and engage with our post; let's work together and spread Jesus.   
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUcMGhJ5Q5FYRAGh2SjxKf7TjFvL6dmioUY358jcfEzhK/1000221288.jpg 
[source](https://www.magnific.com/free-vector/silhouette-hands-reaching-out-help_6910785.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=0&uuid=5ec00d46-7bca-4757-b94a-074de4487418&query=A+source+of+help+)  
Sometimes I just put an article topic in my archives and forget what motivated it. This was the fate of this one. I can remember I have checked in some couple of times and never really understood the inspiration behind until this evening.   

Indeed, it was a good topic to build upon. First, let's try and address the question of who a sent man is. At least we should be familiar with John the Baptist. He was sent to prepare the way for The Lord.We can also talk of personalities like Jeremiah and also Ezekiel and prophet Isaiah from the old testament.   

We can from the above person say that a sent man is someone in time for a specific purpose. It is more like sending a solution to address a problem. Is the ministry of a sent man still relevant to our generation?  

Those who make the law control the system. It is as simple as that, the more people who are law makers to you favor, the higher the chances. This is where we have faced setbacks. For instance, Jesus said, ‘the poor will always be amongst you’. The statement is more like an open cheque because God has already provided a solution that will curb that; ‘the generous rich’. So how many of them do we have?.  

We can look into the aspect of governance, greed has become more like a household name. Life becomes so unbearable for many when God has put some as custodians of wealth and to generously share it across. There are so many things to conclude here; perhaps the person sent never emerged or the system corrupted him. In whatever way we want to put it, it points that; ‘sent man failed’.  

The main aim of this content is the issue and the mentality that God doesn't care. With the current local, state, national and global situations, many swerve from faith out of misunderstanding. If God is actually there, why does this or that keep happening. The answer can be very straightforward, it is people who are not keeping up to duty.   

To conclude, let me add, so it comes back to, are you playing your part you ought to?. Are you keeping your duty post as called? What are you planning to become or are you already there? Are you taking advantage of your office to be a source of blessings to others? Little things count, your contributions are of great value. There is a need to understand that you are a sent man.

body.title: Taark Nightbloom: Upcoming Epic Voucher Card
body.body:
>
Hello, there! **@saydie** here, playing **Splinterlands** everyday!

> Today is Tuesday, which is the usual maintenance period for Splinterlands, where they implement game updates, and one of the updates that will take place during this maintenance is that the new Voucher cards will become available in the Voucher shop. Just like the previous Voucher cards, there will also be 3 new cards that will be available in the Voucher shop. As for their skins, I believe that they will be added at a later time.
So, while waiting until the maintenance period ends, I might as well talk about the last Voucher card within this batch, which is the epic unit, **Taark Nighthbloom**. ![CA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tvY7mZ5F1UqsiqG2X3RRGzAX3ozTT6Hq4tcztUxyzehmwovZ6ty8JR6rmEoqVCkYBQp.png)

>
### Taark Nightbloom ![Taark Nightbloom.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/AKe8DJCpVvGaGWst4inmirpXyF7XmYv2aygco43qyYkA5wgk9Rdc3Smesv7JUdP.jpg) |Edition| ![CA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23xynQT4fv9Dur4BqVAaFySoowevat2mPAWo2n9G4YwbqTAMqd2njGcmhAqJSAKKcjcFU.png) Conclave Arcana (Promo)| | --- | --- | |Mana Cost|4| |Element| ![6-Dragon.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23ydCWwfoJ8T2LrBGVouATJ3fxpdyHMGo4nD4T4yccpg176i6JEDjbKiZpZsdvZD8Ugzf.png) Dragon
![4-Death.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23wCDzbso7SYbrLJDX4hT6kf3zzmbLoqLQSHgR4dKFGBoLfQB8Vkd8yyxAUpLx2cLpSfX.png) Death| |Bloodline| Threefolk| |Rarity|Epic| |Max Armor|2 https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/AK2D3YHkBEoorxaEyCMY9Mi1sciiNAd7nd58YtBQC689EB46gPfn8YdSBDbmpnR.png| |Max Health| 4 ![health.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/AKRAXo8dZzRmb1teXD9QV5SNveBS4KBmefRLD9D3WJ4GgQ9P9Q8mHKUyJeg411V.png)| |Max Speed|4 https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/AKNHMVQ49NpchCemwQ2RgjusNLnP8HjK11qQd6Afw2W5a2ZdDoEyYyZNycwkLPS.png| |Max Damage|3 Melee | |Abilities/Debilitations| Lvl 1 - Sneak
Lvl 2- Shatter
Lvl 4- Flamefed
Lvl 6- Protect|

> Unlike the last card that I talked about, **Taark Nightbloom** does not possess any enormous stats, as it only has 4 health and 2 armor even at max level. And neither does it have powerful damage, as its max melee damage was 3. But that was fine because where it will shine is in the small leagues, for it only has a mana cap of 4. As a Treefolk Bloodline, it doesn't really have any Conclave Arcana Archon to benefit from its Bloodline Dominion, but being a Dragon unit will allow it to be able to form different synergies across different elements. Not to mention, it also has the Death element that will allow it to be summoned even if the Dragon element was not available in the ruleset. For its abilities, it does possess the *Sneak* ability that will allow **Taark Nightbloom** to attack the backline of the opponent team. And it doesn't matter if the target has tons of armor, because with the *Shatter* ability, all that armor will be gone when this card's attack lands on the target. **Taark Nightbloom** also has the *Protect* ability that will give +2 armor on all allied units, so long as this card remains at play, but what really makes this card a strong contender in the combat arena is its *Flame Fed* ability, which will allow it to gain +1 health when it was under the *Burning* debilitation, making it a good choice, when working with units such as **Zyrx the Emberglaze** or, when rulesets such as Global Warming and Dragon's Breath was active. https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/conclave/Zyrx%20the%20Emberglace_lv4_blk.png

> During the general sale, each copy of Taark Nightbloom will cost 250 Vouchers, with 2% base chance to drop a gold foil and a 0.25% base chance to drop a black foil version of the card. You can have a guaranteed gold foil drop for every 50 cards that you purchase, but you can lower it to 25 copies if you use 8 Alchemy Potions on each card, which will also double the chance to get a gold foil version of the card. Meanwhile, you can also double the chance to get a black foil version of the card if you use 8 Midnight Potions on each card you buy. As of the writing of this post, 250 Vouchers are equivalent to 8,018.25 DEC, so if you want to get a max copy of this card, you will need 11,500 Vouchers for 46 BCX of the card, which will be equivalent to 368,839.5 DEC. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23swdzxmXD5Ayjzno7iQpLixeLZmXHyx5WCQWvUaMbpL7wgV9MGrzH79S2ajiUVgccHaY.png)
> ![CA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tvY7mZ5F1UqsiqG2X3RRGzAX3ozTT6Hq4tcztUxyzehmwovZ6ty8JR6rmEoqVCkYBQp.png) ### GFA Fortune Draw & BFA Auction

>
Gold Foil Arcane Fortune Draw: August 19th, 2026
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/Eo6Qn2Do4Hg8BvgNRdWZ4uyjjAKC6e6id1qPggYW1eUfmxXnTqgtjvWUgNCqMVCYbVD.png In this method, you cannot directly buy Taark Nightbloom using Vouchers. Instead, players will need to join the Fortune draw event by entering Fortune tickets, which can be crafted by using 200 Aura, 10 Vouchers, and 200 DEC. It takes 10 Fortune tickets to enter a raffle draw, where there will be a total of 5 Gold Foil Arcane versions of Taark Nightbloom that will be raffled within 5 days. And even if you do not win, your entry will still receive a regular foil version of the card based on the number of entries you entered. Looking at the current price of crafting a fortune ticket, it is currently equivalent to 759.41 DEC per ticket, or 7,594.10 DEC for 10 tickets that are needed for a single entry, which is much lower if you purchase the card using Voucher in the General sale. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23sweHr9U5ACZvzC32fapWGsAYaN2Qc31bYJQvwB8TTLUPpLS8JMGhrCPZzhPPcJvJU5g.png)

>
Black Foil Arcane Auction: September 12th, 2026
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/Eo6KuaD2GmB2gwKHTCeJ4NWUAQUQR9vMgZaC3sVQsvqCuPhk5fXCHrqxA1HunQi2wKr.png?token=2b8e13df83c63d54cba8dfeaf6fbe1fa182cc315fcf62687 If you want to chase those premium cards but do not think you have the luck to win the raffle, you can also brute force it by entering the Black Foil auction, where there will be 3 Black Foil versions of the card that will be auctioned, with a copy being auctioned every 30 hours, with up to 1 hour extention. Here, what you need is to have enough Auction Marks to outbid other players. This token can be crafted by using 1000 Aura, 50 Vouchers, and 500 DEC for each Auction Mark. As of the writing of the post, the price of crafting an Auction Mark is 3297.05 DEC, but to determine whether it will be cheaper to get this card through the auction or the general sale can only be known once we get to the auction. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/Enynb1YF7UTmjUNQAXUPYzkqPXVoEKdBdVNmPXF8oXP3d6gkJ4ut9ftTPxyJc7Cfc4g.png)

> And that was it for Taark Nightbloom. It is a card that you will most likely see at the little leagues or when the battle's mana cap is very low, so demand for this card may not be much. But given that the last dragon Voucher card also has a Treefolk Bloodline, the team may be cooking something else using this card. My guess is that it will have something to do with one of the remaining Escalation Archons, because there are still 4 archons that we do not know yet. Thank you, and see you on the next post!

> This were assets that I edited using Adobe Photoshop and more of this assets were available in this [post](https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@saydie/free-to-use-splinterlands-dividers-and-other-materials-for-blogging) for anyone who likes to use them. ![Conjurer's Hubris 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tvCoUgxe2TpKKGAFiioFiPppBJXFZhPZRT5rqG9VjFwzXSAvSDcVbtXTefwfNvy6wuq.png) ![Conjurer's Hubris.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tm7G1ZmEPd2X5xPegT4NpXjXCYYkK6VkXksCcnwb6fkzC8FXBj6stR31dLbr812RLxq.png) ![Lorn 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23w2efNDXGA9aLuVA8v8gUeQ6NpWpsRQmjhjpZdScxjfKbTR7ULMdNZ5bW9KxZKs5k22X.png) ![Lorn.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23w2h6Yfq92bMbZxU9WRXyNMUQu271w2KMXqs38vCAF9NpuLBa9vjRidg1FeHicBwuUVF.png)

body.title: Holy week is it biblical (part 2 of 2) The old path
body.body:
https://youtu.be/PR6KqmOnUJ0?si=9wJJM7EbYBcm-Voy
Holy week is not seen as anual celebration, it is the week which Christian remembers the sorrowful passion of Jesus Christ while he was on earth. While the events remembered during Holy Week Jesus triumphal entry into Jerusalem, His crucifixion, burial, and resurrection are clearly recorded in Scripture, Christians are never instructed to set aside a special week each year to commemorate them. Instead, believers are called to remember Christ's sacrifice continually through faith, obedience, and the Lord's Supper.

The new testament did not teach us to observe some special occasions of Jesus Christ, but instead it teaches us on how to be serious in following Jesus Christ everyday of our life. The apostles emphasized holy living, worship in spirit and truth, and faithful obedience rather than annual traditions. Therefore, while remembering Christ's death and resurrection is central to the Christian faith, observing Holy Week is a matter of personal or church tradition, not a biblical command.

body.title: Whispers of Twilight,, My Actifit Report Card: June 29 2026
body.body:
> The late afternoon sky always exudes a strange illusion. Today, I am sharing with you some of the quiet moments of nature captured in the camera frame recently. Looking at the pictures, a different and gentle feeling touches the mind, which can instantly forget all the fatigue of mechanical life. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7348a112-bc38-4dc3-a7bf-fe1413f699ed.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/97ba4c23-4f05-431f-ad41-3548c396d073.jpg) In the first few pictures, a winding path is seen winding its way to the edge of twilight. On both sides of the path, dense rows of trees stand calmly, taking on a black form. Above their heads, the warm golden and dark orange hues of the departing sun play across the sky. And a piece of gray cloud hanging right in the middle adds a unique aesthetic to the entire scene. It seems that the lone cloud is lazily enjoying the beauty of the last light of the day. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b6f65c96-8943-45d1-a809-d6a00930726b.jpg) In another picture, a completely different and softer form of the sky is captured. There is no splendor there, only the gentle movement of light clouds. The intensity of twilight has decreased and the surroundings have become calm with a touch of soft colors. This gentle form of the sky reminds us that a silent peace awaits at the end of each day. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2335e354-4dd2-4fd5-8f01-9e75c81381b9.jpg) This transformation of nature is not only a pleasure for the eyes, but also a deep peace of mind. Even in the midst of busyness, when we stop for a moment and look at this beautiful canvas of the sky, a strange feeling of well-being fills our hearts. Hopefully, this familiar yet enchanting form of the late afternoon will bring some peace to your mind too.

body.body:
I think this year has been the hottest I've experienced in all the time I've lived in Mexico. Even at the beach, it was uncomfortable because the air was so hot. Cuyutlán is a beach that offers a spectacular view at every moment. body.title: Rainy days.
body.body: > https://img.leopedia.io/DQmX8PPfBzrQG87WB5TGhBMfPSyuFBxoYSR5rr9EjbRZSE4/1000072149.png Hello friends, I hope you are doing well. Welcome to my new post. Sometimes I remember the words of my childhood, when it rains in our area, in fact, rainy times are very beautiful. When I was a child, I saw that when it rained, I would take off my shirt and go outside. Then I would take a bath in the rain water. Sometimes I would jump into the pond with the rain water. The feeling of rain water falling from the sky and bathing in the pond is really good for me. After a while, I would see that my friends had also come to me. Then we all would take a bath in the pond. After a while, my mother would come. Then she would beat me a little because bathing in the pond water would often make me cold. I still remember those childhood memories. Actually, my mother's discipline was very good, but we did not understand it then. Now when we grew up, we could understand that our mothers were really right. Sometimes it would happen that I could not get wet in the rain because my mother would lock me at home. But I used to sit inside the house and watch TV all day, I liked it very much then. But sleeping well and comfortably during the rain is a different feeling. When it rains from the sky, it is very peaceful to sleep with a little sheet flying. In the summers, there would be a lot of sunshine for three to four days. Then suddenly it would start raining. At that time, the appearance of the sky would change, we would see black clouds in the sky. I can still see it, but those childhood memories are quite emotional. I hope you like this post of mine, thank you all. ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) --- Divce | realmi c67 -|-| source this picture link|https://pixabay.com/illustrations/girl-rain-raincoat-umbrella-drop-8861154/ ### Kind Regards @nahid43 ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@nahid43/rainy-days-acb)

body.title: DTube vs Rumble: Which Video Platform Is Better for Creators in 2026?
body.body:
DTube vs Rumble: Which Video Platform Is Better for Creators in 2026?

As online video continues to dominate the internet, creators have more choices than ever when it comes to publishing content. While YouTube remains the largest platform, many creators are exploring alternatives that offer different approaches to monetization, ownership, discoverability, and audience engagement.

Two platforms that frequently enter the conversation are DTube and Rumble. Although both position themselves as alternatives to traditional video hosting services, they serve different audiences and follow very different philosophies.

This guide compares DTube and Rumble across the features that matter most to creators.

What is DTube?

DTube is a modern video hosting platform relaunched in 2025 with a renewed focus on providing creators with a fast, creator-friendly publishing experience. While originally known for its blockchain origins, today's DTube focuses on delivering a reliable video platform with modern creator tools, easy uploads, discoverability, and community-driven growth.

The platform is designed for independent creators, educators, journalists, businesses, and communities looking for an alternative place to publish videos.

  • Fast video uploads
  • Modern video player
  • Community-focused discovery
  • Video embedding
  • Creator profiles
  • DTube Ad Network
  • Cross-device accessibility

What is Rumble?

Rumble is a video-sharing platform that has gained popularity as an alternative to YouTube, particularly among creators seeking additional monetization options or broader content freedom.

The platform offers advertising revenue sharing and has built a large user base across news, commentary, entertainment, podcasts, and independent creators.

Rumble has become especially popular with political commentators and independent media publishers.

DTube vs Rumble Comparison Table

Feature DTube Rumble
Video Uploads ✔ ✔
Video Embedding ✔ ✔
Creator Profiles ✔ ✔
Advertising DTube Ad Network Revenue Sharing
Community Discovery ✔ ✔
Mobile Friendly ✔ ✔
Independent Creator Focus Strong Strong
Modern Interface ✔ ✔

User Experience

Uploading and managing videos should be simple regardless of audience size.

DTube has been rebuilt with a modern interface that emphasizes ease of publishing, straightforward navigation, and a clean viewing experience. The platform aims to reduce unnecessary complexity so creators can focus on producing content rather than learning complicated workflows.

Rumble also provides an intuitive publishing experience and includes familiar features for creators migrating from larger platforms.

Both platforms are accessible to beginners, although DTube's refreshed interface focuses on simplicity and streamlined content management.

Discoverability

One of the biggest challenges for any creator is getting discovered.

DTube continues expanding its recommendation systems, creator pages, categories, and search functionality to help viewers discover new content across multiple topics.

Rumble benefits from a larger established audience, giving creators immediate exposure to an existing viewer base.

For new creators, success on either platform still depends on producing quality content consistently and promoting videos through external channels.

Monetization

Generating income is often a major consideration when choosing a platform.

Rumble primarily monetizes through advertising revenue sharing, allowing eligible creators to earn from views and licensed content.

DTube supports monetization through its growing advertising ecosystem, including the DTube Ad Network, while continuing to expand opportunities for creators as the platform evolves.

Content Ownership

Creators increasingly value control over where and how their content is published.

DTube emphasizes giving creators greater flexibility and independence while allowing them to build their own audience without relying entirely on a single dominant platform.

Rumble also offers creators an alternative publishing destination and gives them flexibility through various licensing and distribution options.

Who Should Choose DTube?

  • Creators looking for a modern publishing platform
  • Independent journalists
  • Businesses hosting branded videos
  • Educational creators
  • Communities seeking alternatives to traditional platforms
  • Creators interested in the DTube Ad Network

Who Should Choose Rumble?

  • Creators wanting access to a larger established audience
  • News publishers
  • Political commentators
  • Podcast creators
  • Creators seeking advertising revenue sharing

SEO and Website Integration

Both DTube and Rumble allow creators to embed videos into websites.

Embedding videos within blog posts, documentation, tutorials, and landing pages can increase engagement while supporting a broader content marketing strategy.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is DTube free?

Yes. Anyone can create an account and upload videos.

Can I upload the same videos to DTube and Rumble?

Yes. Many creators publish across multiple video platforms to increase visibility and reduce dependence on a single platform.

Does DTube have advertising?

Yes. DTube offers advertising opportunities through the DTube Ad Network for brands and publishers looking to reach its growing community.

Which platform is better for independent creators?

Both platforms support independent creators. Rumble offers a larger existing audience, while DTube focuses on providing a modern creator experience, community growth, and expanding monetization opportunities.

Final Thoughts

DTube and Rumble both provide alternatives to traditional video hosting platforms, but they appeal to different creator needs.

Rumble offers a mature ecosystem with a larger user base and established advertising options. DTube focuses on a modern publishing experience, community-driven discovery, and continued platform innovation.

Many creators choose to publish on multiple platforms to maximize reach, diversify traffic sources, and maintain greater control over their content strategy.

\n\n# ​

body.title: MLB:  Lunes de catarsis...  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
body.body: <div class= 'text-justify'>\n\n      Si usted está fuera del Venezuela y  ha seguido por las redes la tragedia que enluta nuestra nación, es natural suceda escenas como la de ayer en Fenway Park cuando luego de conectar un cuadrangular con dos hombres en circulación, el primera base criollo de los patirrojos Willson Álvarez estalló a llorar de emoción en el dugout. Esa muestra de humanidad tiene que ver, por supuesto, con la solidaridad hacia las víctimas. Pero también tiene otro trasfondo. La presión dentro del equipo por resultados mejores. Es decir, un cúmulo de sentimientos que estallaron. Y debe ser que al umpire de primera no le gustó tal despliegue de emotividad, porque en el siguiente turno de Willson, lo expulsó del juego. Aunque las cámaras demostraron que el juez tenía razón al haber cantado el strike por swing \

donde el bate se ve traspasó la goma, ha debido tener un poco de consideración con Willson, quien a modo de protesta silente se tocó el casco cuando caminaba hacia la cueva (sólo se puede pedir revisión de un strike por ABS cuando el bateador no le hace swing a la pelota). Aún con la expulsión, nada pudo evitar que la embajada venezolana en Boston, impulsara 5 de las 6 carreras anotadas por el equipo. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     If you are outside Venezuela and have been following the tragedy gripping our nation on social media, it’s only natural for scenes like yesterday’s at Fenway Park to happen, where after launching a three-run jack, Red Sox Venezuelan first baseman Willson Alvarez burst into tears in the dugout. That display of raw emotion stems, of course, from solidarity with the victims, but there’s also another layer to it: the heavy organizational pressure to produce, creating a perfect storm of bottled-up feelings that finally boiled over. Apparently, the first-base umpire didn't care for that emotional outburst, because during Willson’s next trip to the dish, he tossed him from the game. Even though replay showed the umpire made the right call on the check-swing strike where the barrel clearly crossed the plate, he should have cut Willson some slack, who offered a silent protest by tapping his helmet as he headed back to the dugout (keep in mind, challengeable ABS strike calls only apply to pitches taken without a swing). Despite the ejection, nothing could stop the Venezuelan contingent in Boston from driving in 5 of the team’s 6 runs.

# ---

![Ranger.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23vsN22N6rzQAGwTPb54HWJTQ4JgHG2pqWkiiBVStX3ztK81KjRChvDQNZxyiWzf4Nf9P.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/nationals-vs-red-sox/2026/06/29/824741/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Con un marcador final sobre los Nationals de 6-3, las 3 carreras traídas al plato con el estacazo de Contreras, se agregaron a la impulsada por Wilyer Abreu y a la remolcada por Carlos Narváez. Y esa labor ofensiva, a su vez, protegió la victoria del abridor larense Ranger Suárez. Con otra salida de calidad, Ranger transitó 6 tramos completos tolerando 6 inatrapables (entre ellos un jonrón), permitiendo tres carreras limpias, regalando 1 pasaporte y guillotinando a 8 contrarios. Por supuesto, la quinta victoria seguida de los Medias Rojas (quienes vienen de barrer a los Yankees), permite levantar el ánimo puertas adentro, porque los duendes irlandeses se colocan a 4.5 juegos del comodín. Y no se puede culpar al camarógrafo por dar más protagonismo del necesario, a una muestra de vulnerabilidad que trasciende fronteras y que nos indica, que los jugadores profesionales viven pendientes de la tierra que les vio nacer. Humanidad pura en desarrollo. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      With a 6-3 final score over the Nationals, the 3 RBIs from Contreras' three-run big fly were packaged with runs driven in by Wilyer Abreu and Carlos Narvaez. That offensive output, in turn, locked down the win for Laras native and starting pitcher Ranger Suarez. Turning in another quality start, Ranger cruised through 6 full frames, scattering 6 hits (including a solo shot), giving up three earned runs, issuing just 1 free pass, and fanning 8 batters. Of course, this fifth consecutive victory for the Red Sox (fresh off sweeping the Yankees) provides a massive clubhouse boost, pulling the Beantown boys within 4.5 games of the Wild Card spot. And you can’t blame the camera crew for over-indexing on that moment of vulnerability, an emotional display that transcends borders and reminds us that these big leaguers remain deeply tethered to their homeland. Pure human emotion on full display.

# ---

![Eduardo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23tGXnHxWSbSRrSWsA22ZcENqD9ErnQL44BP7DGvEUrW8Q2RVXaTYZx2G5WZBqCpr3D5a.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/dbacks/video/eduardo-rodriguez-s-outing-against-the-giants-x3774) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Y ¿saben ustedes quien tuvo otra salida de calidad extraordinaria? Pues sí, el abridor valenciano de los Diamondbacks de Arizona Eduardo Rodríguez, quien supo contener con su labor a los Gigantes de San Francisco. Apenas ponchó a un solo contendiente, pero durante siete episodios de labor, toleró 5 imparables, una carrera limpia y no regaló ningún boleto. El hombre arribó a su 7mo. triunfo en la campaña con solo 2 juegos perdidos y estacionó su EFE en 2.21. Un minúsculo WHIP de 1.18 y un promedio de bateo de los contrarios estacionado en .219, dicen mucho de la extraordinaria zafra que está teniendo el hombre. Para éste redactor, Eduardo es el mejor candidato hasta ahora del premio \

, luego de sortear sus dos últimas campañas con EFE de +5.00. Desde que lanzó y ganó su salida a los Estados Unidos en el WBC, el criollo ha sido otro lanzador. Y aunque los Dodgers están escapados en el liderazgo del oeste de la Nacional, los ofidios se encuentran a tan solo 2.5 juegos del tercer comodín de la liga. Oportunidades tienen de pasar a la postemporada. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     And do you know who turned in another absolute gem of a quality start? You guessed it, Arizona Diamondbacks' Valencian starter Eduardo Rodriguez, who completely shut down the San Francisco Giants. He only fanned a single batter, but over seven strong frames of work, he scattered just 5 hits, allowed one earned run, and issued zero free passes. The man picked up his 7th win of the campaign against just 2 losses while dropping his ERA to a microscopic 2.21. A tiny 1.18 WHIP and a microscopic .219 opponent batting average speak volumes about the stellar season this guy is putting together. As far as this writer is concerned, Eduardo is the frontrunner for Comeback Player of the Year after battling through his last two seasons with an ERA north of 5.00. Ever since he took the bump and earned the win against Team USA in the WBC, the Venezuelan lefty has been a completely different pitcher. And even though the Dodgers are running away with the NL West lead, the Snakes are sitting just 2.5 games back of the third National League Wild Card spot, keeping their postseason hopes very much alive.

---

![Sanoja.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23w2esrMtCnhQCPqdWYj3dnQssfqvkRHX48DbjcJ3WteX6RfnTnppgDr74KTA4Jp4CATw.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/marlins-vs-rockies/2026/06/29/824339/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Para culminar ésta crónica, no nos cansaremos de alabar a un utility criollo que parece sacado de un cuento. Primordialmente por la estatura que tiene, peleada con los estándares actuales de \

para una firma de prospecto y que además, demuestra que si se quiere y se tiene el talento, se puede. Javier Sanoja Anoche en Denver, se presentó a la caja de bateo con las bases congestionadas y devolvió por la banda contraria, una recta de 99 MPH ceñida a la raya de cal ¿resultado? Un triple barre bases que alejaba a sus Marlins en el marcador, desde un peligroso guarismo 6-5 a una cifra más tranquilizadora: 9-5. Los extraordinarios peces terminaron ganando a los Rockies por 10 carreras a 7 y con ello, han empatado increíblemente el tercer comodín de la liga con los Cachorros de Chicago. No solo eso, jugando para 8-2 en sus últimos 10, se han acercado a 5.5 juegos de los Bravos de Atlanta y se meten de lleno en la carrera hacia Octubre. ¿Quien dijo que la estatura mínima para un pelotero debía ser de 1.75, cuando Javier con sus 1.61 ha demostrado ser un jugador de élite? Seguimos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     To wrap up this column, we will never tire of praising a Venezuelan utility man who looks like he came straight out of a fairy tale, primarily because his height defies today's scouting standards for signing prospects, proving that with desire and talent, anything is possible. Javier Sanoja took the trip to the dish last night in Denver with the bases juiced and laced a 99 MPH fastball down the line to the opposite field, the result? A bases-clearing triple that blew the game open for his Marlins, pushing a tight 6-5 lead into a much more comfortable 9-5 cushion. The red-hot Fish ended up outlasting the Rockies 10-7, incredibly moving into a tie with the Chicago Cubs for the third Wild Card spot. Not only that, but by going 8-2 over their last 10 games, they’ve clawed within 5.5 games of the Atlanta Braves and thrown themselves right into the hunt for October. Who says a ballplayer has to be at least 5-foot-9 when Javier, standing at just 5-foot-3, is proving to be an elite big leaguer? We keep moving.

body.title: Cuckoo wasp (Chrysis fuscipennis)
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeJUQzaf81q6P7UmtW4m88mNPsJ9CybVo1sNC5V8JYKbB/20260627_105610_20_1_.jpg)


| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Chrysis fuscipennis*** | Jun 27, 2026 |  Natore, Bangladesh |

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZUpgmLwT1zzzd9pWv8aq7t49rFD53PFGyKyuHozSP81/20260627_105609.jpg)

A wonderful subject of macro photography is the colorful insects around us. The beautiful metallic blue-green insect that you see in your photos is known to the common people as the 'Cuckoo wasp' or Kokil Bolata. Just as cuckoo birds lay their eggs in the nests of other species, these wasps also lay their eggs in the nests of other species of wasps, hence their beautiful name. Their bodies sparkle like precious gems or jewels in the sunlight.

​Scientific name:
According to the scientific classification of biology, the scientific name of this attractive wasp is Chrysis fuscipennis. In various studies by scientists, this species is often considered a synonym or synonym for Chrysis angolensis.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSRFmvu64EbdijX89GVPef4rBDuD9L4m2ZS4E4wxq1H2v/20260627_105616.jpg)

Family and Genus:
The cuckoo wasp is a wonderful member of the vast Arthropoda phylum and Insecta class of the animal kingdom. According to the classification made by scientists, they belong to the Chrysididae family under the Hymenoptera order. Their genus or genus name is Chrysis. The genus was first named by scientist Carl Linnaeus in 1761. The name comes from the Greek word 'chrysis', which means 'golden vessel' or 'cloth woven with golden thread'. Such a royal name has been given because of the bright metallic color of their body. There are more than a thousand species under this genus.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdhqbeYjB9TkZTkxLUZBieLm6LtdScFHLYrxdYT6AnJCD/20260627_105623.jpg)

​Size and body structure:
Compared to ordinary wasps, their body structure is quite different and attractive. A wonderful mixture of very bright metallic bluish-green and golden colors can be seen all over their body, but their wings are quite black or dark in color. Their defense mechanism is very amazing. These wasps are completely stingless, meaning they do not have a sting. When they face any danger or are scared, they roll up their very hard shelled body into a round ball. As a result, no other predator or host wasp can bite or sting them.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdkPpfUj6Jm2KFCg9f4dAhNtCSkuaRJaxZVtNFLn9R3dE/20260627_105624.jpg)

​Habitat and Habitat:
In terms of geographical distribution, these dog wasps live over a large part of the world. They are widely found in North America, India and various parts of the Old World. They usually prefer to live alone or solitary. They are often seen roaming around the locality, in the cracks of wood or near the nests of other wasps.

​Food:
Although they usually survive by drinking nectar from various flowers as adults, their larval diet is completely different. They are mainly known as kleptoparasites or parasites. They do not collect their own larval food, but depend on the food collected by other species of wasps.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXRMKM5q8o6efrUXsFFr9raYdSfkEL92rqoG8gmsezkSe/20260627_105611.jpg)

​Reproduction:
Their reproduction process is one of the strangest phenomena in nature. A mother cuckoo wasp does not build a nest of her own, but sneaks into the open or unprotected nest of another species of wasp (such as the mud dauber wasp, which makes its nest with mud) and lays her eggs there. After the eggs hatch, the cuckoo wasp larvae or babies emerge, which eat the larvae of the original owner of the nest and all the food stored for them.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdw9hZW2tJrXY6RGyuJAS3i3o6N4rmuuk8Ne6xuLcuFMk/20260627_105610.jpg)

​Benefits:
These cuckoo wasps play a very important role in our environment's ecosystem. They help to naturally control the population of certain species of wasps. In addition, their beautiful colors and structure are a great attraction for nature lovers and photographers.

Harmfulness: This beautiful insect is not harmful to humans. They are very docile and do not bite or cause any harm to humans as they do not have a stinger. They are considered harmful only to their specific host.



I hope you like the information.






  I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

body.body:
Puchka is one of the most loved street foods, famous for its crispy shell, spicy potato filling, and tangy tamarind water. Every bite delivers a perfect balance of crunch, spice, and refreshing flavors that make it truly unforgettable. Whether enjoyed with friends or family, puchka always adds joy to the moment. More than just a snack, it brings people together and creates lasting memories. Its simple ingredients and irresistible taste have made it a favorite for food lovers of all ages, proving that the best flavors often come from the simplest recipes. 😋🌮

![Screenshot_20260425_130939_Gallery.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma8QU9WGZdjQqmyfLY9fXqjrCaaS6YCgYo26U9SQsbHPf/Screenshot_20260425_130939_Gallery.jpg)

![IMG-20260426-WA0040.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYdyfW3iaS5WhTFvLH6m4eAVzSFvNK4W9q2QzTFYiroka/IMG-20260426-WA0040.jpg)




![IMG-20260428-WA0079.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTcG8wSTwGoNoojMuTcT57Uh5Vao34fZYVQi2B7eMKB1T/IMG-20260428-WA0079.jpg)

![IMG-20260426-WA0017.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb3xnLYt5cayCwXx4LRrUzcMBhpDhPvxGHo9ms9XigbPp/IMG-20260426-WA0017.jpg)

![IMG-20260426-WA0005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWw5RNZZuaZ8cWpYonXYg5wtaDu2yWuuCcb7NHrFMsjbD/IMG-20260426-WA0005.jpg)

Puchka is more than just a street food—it is an experience that brings people together through its unforgettable taste. The crispy shell, filled with a flavorful mixture of mashed potatoes, chickpeas, and aromatic spices, becomes even more delicious when dipped into chilled, tangy tamarind water. Every bite offers the perfect combination of crunch, spice, and freshness, making it a favorite snack for countless food lovers.

One of the most special things about puchka is the joy of sharing it with friends and family. Whether it is an evening walk, a weekend outing, or a casual gathering, a plate of freshly made puchka always makes the moment more enjoyable. The excitement of waiting for the next perfectly filled puchka and choosing between extra spicy or extra tangy flavors adds to the fun.

Despite its simple ingredients, puchka has earned a special place in the hearts of people across generations. It is not only loved for its unique taste but also for the memories it creates. Every street corner serving puchka has its own style and flavor, making each visit a little different and exciting. This timeless snack reminds us that happiness can often be found in the simplest moments. A plate of puchka, shared with good company and plenty of laughter, is enough to turn an ordinary day into a memorable one. Its irresistible flavor and joyful spirit continue to make it one of the most cherished street foods around the world. 🌮😋
![IMG-20260428-WA0141.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXBMJiR4Dxg8FuaSFGJVxs5PFVZapK2QJPatxErB2Wtmc/IMG-20260428-WA0141.jpg)


Chotpoti is a delicious street food loved for its rich flavors and satisfying taste. Made with tender chickpeas, fresh vegetables, aromatic spices, and tangy tamarind sauce, every bite is full of excitement. It is a perfect snack to enjoy with friends and family, bringing smiles, lively conversations, and unforgettable moments. Simple ingredients come together to create a truly comforting and flavorful experience. 😋🥣

body.title: New Hopes for Synapse
body.body: > Every move by a major investor in the cryptocurrency market catches the eye of ordinary investors. Especially when that investor is a well-known person like Arthur Hayes, the market reaction is much stronger. The project has recently returned to the spotlight after he invested about $2.2 million in the Synapse (SYN) token. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb6xBYUJf8uJnYYaiUZfNby4GuVJnnFXqd9aQMWbXCg4T/Screenshot_2026_0701_002404.jpg According to on-chain data, Hayes has collected about 6.16 million SYN tokens. The token’s price increased by more than 40 percent in the 24 hours after the news broke. Although SYN had been performing well throughout June, this large investment has further strengthened the positive sentiment of the market. In my opinion, the most important aspect of this event is that the market is now looking not only at the price of the token, but also at the potential of the ecosystem behind it. In particular, there has been renewed interest around Hyperliquid and its related Hypercall project. How successful Hypercall can be as a decentralized options trading platform in the future is now a topic of discussion for many investors. Data from the derivatives market is also showing similar positive signs. Trading volume for SYN futures has increased significantly and open interest has also increased rapidly. In general, these changes indicate that new money is entering the market and many traders are interested in taking long-term bullish positions. Meanwhile, many traders who were short in the market have been forced to close their positions due to the price increase. Such short liquidation often creates additional buying pressure, which helps the price rise even faster. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUXUEz3GVf7zJXdZ3eMNvV2Mjsj2BnZy4qhN7F2YvPVF4/Screenshot_2026_0701_002415.jpg Technical analysis is also showing some important changes. The downward trendline that has been holding the price of SYN for a long time has been broken and has been able to rise. During this breakout, trading volume also reached its highest level in several months, indicating a strong presence of buyers. Currently, important resistance levels in the market include $0.59 and then $0.74. If the buying pressure continues, the psychologically important $1 level may also be discussed in the future. On the other hand, $0.33 is seen as an important support. If strong selling pressure develops below this level, the positive trend of the market may weaken somewhat in the short term. In my opinion, the long-term future of a project does not depend on the participation of a large investor alone. The real success will depend on how many users the Hypercall and Synapse ecosystem can actually attract and how well their product is accepted. All in all, Arthur Hayes' investment has brought Synapse back into the discussion. At the same time, the increased activity in the derivatives market, the technical breakout and the growing interest around the Hyperliquid ecosystem have made SYN one of the most talked about altcoins in the market today. However, keeping in mind the natural volatility of the crypto market, everyone should do their own research and risk assessment before investing.
