body.body:
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/Eoc61bQQXaheUY69KaNEhxQMi6ds6WgiQ6TLeVEquRm1P6c7FoSJXYNa9iSmNnou4VG.png) --- For years, thousands of League of Legends players have asked for the same thing: the chance to enjoy the game again just as it was during its early seasons. After countless rumors, leaks, and speculations, Riot Games has finally made one of the community's most anticipated projects official: League of Legends Classic is real, and we will soon learn all the details. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/EpA24eHxzFNcxnE15wWKE86FpPUon212h8UVKxRTetWDLC6UVk2A9uTVKidxo64z5GB.png) --- The announcement has sparked great excitement among veterans who began their journey on Summoner's Rift over a decade ago. For many of them, the early versions of League of Legends offered an experience vastly different from the current one—featuring less complex champions, a slower match pace, and a playstyle that defined an era in competitive gaming. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tGa4Qp31UBTvTaFvdcEaixyBWSpJxcsYibD8zBy6mEQ6qjWPbnyKDVLbuc9yPhXSEhw.png) --- However, Riot has made it clear that they do not intend to recreate a specific season from the past. Instead of simply copying a particular version of the game, League of Legends Classic will combine elements from various stages of its early years to deliver an experience that captures the essence of the original LoL while incorporating certain modern adjustments. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23zS5K4opgGQ5UZrWbHQhDJUBr41THem3ks1Q79e48PBfpsbG5QKkq5xALqcDuubxHPui.png) --- Among the confirmed features, a standout is the return of around 60 champions with their classic abilities—many of which predate the numerous reworks they have undergone over the years. Characters like Sion, Gangplank, Graves, and Skarner will return in versions that many players will fondly remember. Additionally, the old runes, the mastery system, items that vanished years ago, and the classic look of Summoner's Rift will all be making a comeback. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tbkXVccMzbYRUUybML7stWcZ4QP8U1P3MyaxkYHCv5XbnX52v2PfpC5NUUvnohswFuP.png) --- For now, Riot hasn't revealed a release date for this new mode, though they did confirm a much more comprehensive presentation during the 2026 Mid-Season Invitational (MSI), where they will demonstrate how it works and answer many of the community's lingering questions. Personally, I believe this is one of the best decisions Riot has made in recent years. The success of projects like *World of Warcraft Classic* demonstrated that nostalgia can be a highly appealing proposition when handled with care. Many players aren't just looking to use old champions again; they want to relive an era that defined their early experiences with online gaming. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tvZhJNFFL7nfz2bVNtv9A9Txg2hGcgzjYx37BMWne59KmwDCUDvyC2rTCXniK52kWv4.png) --- However, there are also some significant challenges. The *League of Legends* of over a decade ago was far less balanced than the current version. There were extremely powerful abilities, strategies that were hard to counter, and a level of balance well below what we see today. Precisely for this reason, it will be interesting to see to what extent Riot decides to maintain that authenticity versus introducing minor changes to improve the experience. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23u5bqazHrYw2J14YE1Ew8F7rxALV7W9nryxJgADkHhoTFJRSHJm9LgDc6dRvBdRmPSy3.png) --- Another point of debate is whether this mode will be suitable for new players. Although on paper it might seem like a simpler version of the game, the reality is that it is designed primarily for those already familiar with the history of *League of Legends*. Learning the MOBA through a classic version could actually prove more confusing for players who later want to make the jump to the modern game. What does seem clear is that Riot is once again demonstrating its ability to listen to its community. After years of requests, *League of Legends Classic* is finally becoming a reality, promising to be one of the most significant events for the game in a long time. Now, all that remains is to wait for the MSI to see just how far this highly anticipated trip down memory lane will go.

En lugar de copiar exactamente una versión específica del juego, League of Legends Classic combinará elementos de distintas etapas de sus primeros años para ofrecer una experiencia que evoque la esencia del LoL original sin renunciar a ciertos ajustes modernos. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23zS5K4opgGQ5UZrWbHQhDJUBr41THem3ks1Q79e48PBfpsbG5QKkq5xALqcDuubxHPui.png) --- Entre las novedades confirmadas destaca el regreso de alrededor de 60 campeones con sus habilidades clásicas, muchas de ellas anteriores a los numerosos rediseños que han recibido con el paso de los años. Personajes como Sion, Gangplank, Graves o Skarner volverán a mostrar versiones que muchos jugadores recordarán con cariño. Además, también regresarán las antiguas runas, el sistema de maestrías, objetos que desaparecieron hace años y el aspecto clásico de la Grieta del Invocador. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tbkXVccMzbYRUUybML7stWcZ4QP8U1P3MyaxkYHCv5XbnX52v2PfpC5NUUvnohswFuP.png) --- Por ahora, Riot no ha revelado una fecha de lanzamiento para este nuevo modo, aunque sí confirmó que ofrecerá una presentación mucho más completa durante el Mid-Season Invitational (MSI) 2026, donde mostrará su funcionamiento y responderá muchas de las preguntas que todavía tiene la comunidad. Personalmente, creo que esta es una de las mejores decisiones que Riot ha tomado en los últimos años. El éxito de proyectos como World of Warcraft Classic demostró que la nostalgia puede convertirse en una propuesta muy atractiva cuando se hace con cuidado. Muchos jugadores no buscan únicamente volver a utilizar campeones antiguos, sino revivir una época que marcó sus primeros pasos en los videojuegos online. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tvZhJNFFL7nfz2bVNtv9A9Txg2hGcgzjYx37BMWne59KmwDCUDvyC2rTCXniK52kWv4.png) --- Sin embargo, también existen algunos desafíos importantes. El League of Legends de hace más de diez años estaba mucho menos equilibrado que el actual. Había habilidades extremadamente poderosas, estrategias difíciles de contrarrestar y un nivel de balance bastante inferior al que conocemos hoy. Precisamente por eso será interesante ver hasta qué punto Riot decide mantener esa autenticidad o introducir pequeños cambios para mejorar la experiencia. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23u5bqazHrYw2J14YE1Ew8F7rxALV7W9nryxJgADkHhoTFJRSHJm9LgDc6dRvBdRmPSy3.png) --- Otro aspecto que genera debate es si este modo será adecuado para nuevos jugadores. Aunque sobre el papel podría parecer una versión más sencilla del juego, la realidad es que está diseñada principalmente para quienes ya conocen la historia de League of Legends. Aprender el MOBA a través de una versión clásica podría incluso resultar más confuso para quienes después quieran dar el salto al juego actual. Lo que sí parece claro es que Riot vuelve a demostrar que sabe escuchar a su comunidad. Tras años de peticiones, League of Legends Classic finalmente será una realidad y promete convertirse en uno de los acontecimientos más importantes para el juego en mucho tiempo. Ahora solo queda esperar al MSI para descubrir hasta dónde llegará este esperado viaje al pasado.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbTqvt8jWLHo8CJoivSmQ7x5wcrRAcLYYvj9zbetghMa1/img_1224.jpg)Young person getting a COVID-19 Vaccine by [cdc](https://unsplash.com/photos/woman-in-black-crew-neck-t-shirt-wearing-white-face-mask-uN8TV9Pw2ik) on Unsplash


To those of you who know me, it is no surprise that I never tire of being right. To be fair, there is that occasion when I’m not correct, but it happens so rarely. Take the COVID-19 fiasco, for instance. I wrote on that subject exhaustively for several years, and I was right on every measure except one: I predicted that the public would reject the foolishness after the first two weeks. Boy, was I wrong on that one. On every other count, however, I was spot on. Lockdowns were ineffective, masks were worthless and even made infection more likely, social distancing was a farce, and the “COVID-19 vaccine” wasn’t effective at all. Still, to this day, the government keeps pushing these lies on us. Including the refusal to admit that the virus was initially contracted by the virologists who created it, then mutated in its host, as it was carried into the public. I talked about it at the time and provided evidence based on intelligence reports that were available until they were pushed into the dusty back shelves to hide what Fauci and the NIH were about.

Eventually, the truth came out about all of it, not that the media made as much of the truth as it did of the lies.

When the perpetrator says, \

One of the worst aspects of this debacle was the influence the pharma industry secured by paying researchers, funding their “research,” and promoting the publication of papers that were used as evidence that effective treatments were bogus. As if that wasn’t bad enough, the lives and careers of legitimate doctors, scientists, military personnel, police officers, and teachers were destroyed by the sycophant media. All of this resulted in the deaths of vast numbers of people, testified to by no less than Dr. Ben Carson, one of the preeminent medical professionals in the world.

The current count of COVID-19 papers that have been retracted, from both sides of the debate, stands at 676.

I won’t take you through the labyrinth of those past conversations; we have current mischief to expose. On June 25, 2026, The Epoch Times published an article by Zachary Stieber, a Senior Reporter, titled “COVID-19 Vaccine Study, Blocked From CDC Journal, Now Published.”

https://cmsapi.theepochtimes.com/health/covid-19-vaccine-study-blocked-from-cdc-journal-now-published-6053180

This study, funded and influenced in part by vaccine manufacturers, claims that the vaccines were 55% effective against hospitalization. Gee Whiz, can you imagine that, with all the hyperbole surrounding these genetic vaccines, they are willing to boast a whopping 55% success rate. I can remember one talk show celebrity stating that people who didn’t get the vaccine were guilty of dangerous behavior. She specifically stated that if you got the jab, you couldn’t get COVID or transmit it. None of which is true. There is zero evidence that any vaccine can exist that would allow a population to reach herd immunity faster than it does, nor that it prevents mutations from developing naturally. The variables are far too dynamic, and the numbers move with the variants the population faces during any given period. We have been administering flu vaccines for 80 years with no indication that the practice changes the percentage of the population that contracts the disease. In fact, one of the worst years was 2009, when 61 million people contracted H1N1.
But I digress, back to the matter of the publication in question. The problem, as Mr. Stieber explains, is that the study was originally blocked by the Director of the CDC because it isn’t true, at least it is highly dubious. It seems that both the method and the means used to determine 55% efficacy were faulty and biased. Not to be deterred by mere facts and actual science, the industrial influences finally got their propaganda published in the Journal of the American Medical Association.

I think a brief explanation might help shed some light on medical publications. If you were to look at one, the percentage of pages devoted to advertisements averages about 36%, and 95% of those are for drugs that manufacturers wish to promote to doctors. Those subscriptions are mostly paid for by the hospital or clinic where they work. This is hardly unbiased.

The article goes on to explain that this study was funded by the CDC and a major hospital system, which shows bias, since both receive substantial funding from the drug industry. The CDC receives millions of dollars every year from the pharmaceutical industry through donations to the CDC Foundation, and hospitals generate about 10% of their revenue from insurance and government-paid medication administration, with a 91% profit margin. Is there any wonder why so many ads are on the radio attempting to influence people to get COVID vaccines?

Making this publication even more suspect, several of its authors disclosed that they were paid by the vaccine manufacturers they reviewed.

To quote Martin Kulldorff, a DSHS adviser, “… those who come to the hospital for a different infectious disease, they are more frail and therefore they have a different probability of having been vaccinated. Has nothing to do with if the vaccine protects you against COVID or not. It just creates the bias, and the bias can go in either direction.”

In summary, a paper touting the benefits of COVID-19 Vaccine use was produced, but it was blocked by the CDC Director for bias, so the vaccine makers went to sources they financially influence to get it published. Now they are going to use that to promote vaccination, which is mostly paid for by the government, which in turn grants manufacturers immunity from liability.

Nice. A $30 billion carnival con game of “follow the peanut.”

But they want us to “trust the science.”

body.title: Крах «духу Анкоріджа»: як Москва намагалася виграти війну дипломатичним блефом
body.body: >Знаєте, я завжди вважав, що дипломатія — це мистецтво не стільки домовлятися, скільки бачити справжні наміри за товстим шаром гарних слів. Усі ці «духи» зустрічей, самітів та кулуарних розмов часто нагадують мені спроби продати повітря в гарній упаковці. Останні пів року ми всі спостерігали за тим, як російська пропаганда роздувала термін «дух Анкоріджа». Ви ж пам’ятаєте цей хайп? Москві дуже хотілося, щоб ми повірили в якісь таємні, майже містичні домовленості між Трампом та Путіним на тій холодній Алясці в серпні 2025-го.

>Для Кремля це була ідеальна гра. Вони намагалися провернути класичний трюк: виграти за столом переговорів те, чого не вдалося здобути в окопах під Авдіївкою чи Часовим Яром. Це ж так зручно — посилатися на «дух», який ніхто не бачив, ніхто не підписував і ніхто не може перевірити. Ти наче маєш карт-бланш, але твої карти — це просто порожні папірці. Вони грали на непевності, на нашій тривозі, намагаючись втиснути Україну в рамки «домовленостей», про які сам Захід, як з’ясувалося пізніше, навіть не думав.

>Я впевнений, що в глибині душі кремлівські стратеги розуміли: це блеф. Вони знали, що ситуація на фронті для них виснажлива, і єдиним виходом залишалося перенести війну в площину політичних ігор. «Дух Анкоріджа» став для них останньою надією створити ілюзію сили там, де була лише втома металу і людей. Це була спроба нав’язати світу реальність, де агресор диктує умови, спираючись на вигаданий консенсус. І як же приємно було бачити, як 25 червня 2026 року Марк Рубіо просто взяв і розбив цю кришталеву вежу, заявивши офіційно: ніяких домовленостей не було.

>Бачите, брехня має одну слабку сторону — вона завжди потребує підживлення. Коли ти не можеш пред’явити результат, ти починаєш придумувати нові історії про «глибоке взаєморозуміння». Але в сучасному світі, де кожен крок політика відстежується, а розвідки працюють швидше, ніж методички пропаганди, такі конструкції руйнуються миттєво. Весь цей «Анкорідж» виявився не дипломатичним проривом, а просто спробою Москви виторгувати собі час. Вони хотіли, щоб ми відступили, повіривши в «тайну», але натомість отримали лише більше санкцій та розчарування партнерів у власній адекватності.

>Чи був цей «дух» небезпечним? Безперечно. Він тримав нас у напрузі, змушував сумніватися в підтримці союзників і витрачати енергію на аналіз того, чого не існувало. Але зараз, коли дим розвіявся, стало зрозуміло: ніяких магічних «формул» немає. Є війна, є наші партнери, є наші інтереси, і є ворог, який вміє лише блефувати.

>Можливо, урок Анкоріджа нам був потрібен. Це ще раз доводить, що ніхто не вирішить нашу долю за нашою спиною, бо в цій грі насправді існують лише конкретні дії та чіткі зобов’язання. А всі ці міфічні «духи» — це лише привиди, які тануть під світлом реальних фактів. Що далі? Москва спробує вигадати нову назву для свого чергового «провалу року», але ми вже знаємо ціну таким «домовленостям». А як ви вважаєте, чи варто взагалі звертати увагу на такі дипломатичні вкиди в майбутньому, чи краще ігнорувати їх як інформаційний шум?

body.body: As they journeyed farther north, the air grew heavier with every step. The wind lashed against their faces like sharpened blades, and the snowflakes did not fall from the sky—they seemed to rise from the depths of the earth itself. Kael pulled his cloak tighter around him and noticed the light of the crystal fragment trembling in his hand.\n\n\

Lira opened her book, its pages trembling beneath an icy breath.

\

At the end of the valley stood an enormous cave of ice. At its entrance were statues carved from the frozen walls themselves. Each bore a different expression: fear, hope, anger, and love. Lira studied them carefully.

\

As they stepped inside, the icy walls reflected the light, revealing their own images with every step. Yet something was different. Kael's reflection appeared strong, but utterly alone. Lira's looked wise, yet fragile.

\

At that moment, a voice echoed from deep within the ice—deep, powerful, as though the cave itself had begun to speak.

\

Kael raised the crystal. Its light resonated through the frozen walls, but the fire did not appear. Lira opened her book once more, and a single sentence began to glow.

\

Suddenly, the wall of ice cracked. A crimson light seeped through the widening fracture. Kael and Lira reached out at the same time. The light merged with the crystal fragment. In an instant, the cave was filled with flames—but they did not burn. They only brought warmth.

Then a figure emerged from the shadows.

It was the echo of Varzoth.

\

With a piercing scream, Varzoth's echo dissolved into nothingness. The crystal fragment now shone brighter than ever. Within the heart of the ice, it had become one with the fire.

Lira smiled.

\

body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSbVAZisa6LoBbQFzboumrV2XHvjYYQutEo5SKt4AygsR/img_1737.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcApM1TtA9GeboUXvUEoj5CkxTRG74JPsTWVY1guq7RBN/img_4613.png)

**The Bigger Picture**

If we look at the Spot ETFs, we see a lot of red over the past few weeks. Bitcoin worth hundreds of millions of dollars has been sold every single day. That’s definitely not a small amount. But to put things into perspective, you have to zoom out.

Looking at Bitcoin holdings instead of dollar value (a much cleaner metric since it removes price effects), ETF holdings peaked at around 1.38 million BTC in October 2025 and later declined to roughly 1.22–1.28 million BTC. That’s only a 7–9% drop.

This shows that ETF investors are actually strong hodlers. Most of the selling seems to be coming from other groups, such as whales and early OGs who started cashing out after Bitcoin moved above $100k.

I actually find this quite surprising, but it suggests that most ETF investors aren’t here for a quick 20% gain. They’re positioning for the next major move toward $1 million Bitcoin. It also helps that, for many of them, Bitcoin represents only a small allocation, often around 1% of their overall portfolio, making it much easier to hold through volatility.

body.title: Vegetables to Plant in the Garden During the Month of July
body.body:
July is a month of intense activity in the garden. Although it is a very hot month in most of Spain, it is the key moment to prepare for autumn and winter crops while maintaining the summer ones in full production.

Here is a guide on what you can plant or sow in July:

### 1. Direct Sowing (in the ground)

In July, you can sow directly into the ground fast-cycle vegetables or those that take advantage of the heat to germinate, provided you ensure constant watering:

* **Carrots:** This is an excellent time to sow new batches.
* **Green beans:** You can continue planting bush or pole varieties to harvest at the end of summer and the beginning of autumn.
* **Zucchini:** If you sow them now, you will have produce before the first frosts arrive.
* **Cucumbers:** They grow very quickly in the heat.
* **Chard:** They are very resistant and tolerate the July heat well if kept well-watered.
* **Radishes:** Very short cycle; you can harvest them in just a month.

### 2. Seedbed (to transplant later)

July is the ideal month to prepare vegetables in seedbeds that will occupy the garden in autumn and winter. Since these plants will be outdoors in the middle of summer, they will need shade and high humidity:

* **Cabbages (Broccoli, cauliflower, cabbage):** It is the perfect time to sow them so they are ready to be transplanted at the end of August or September.
* **Leeks:** Sow in seedbeds now to transplant in autumn.
* **Celery:** It benefits from starting in a protected seedbed.

### 3. Transplants

If you have purchased seedlings from a nursery or already have them ready from your seedbed, you can transplant:

* **Tomatoes:** Especially if you live in areas where autumn is not extremely cold, you can plant late-season seedlings.
* **Peppers and Eggplants:** If the plant is vigorous, they still have time to bear fruit before temperatures drop.

---

### Key Tips for the Garden in July

> **Water Management:** With high temperatures, irrigation is vital. Use **mulching** with straw or bark on the soil to prevent moisture from evaporating and to keep the roots cool.

* **Irrigation:** Always water early in the morning or at dusk. Avoid getting the leaves wet to prevent the appearance of fungi.
* **Protection:** If the sun is very intense, consider using **shade cloth** over the most delicate crops to prevent them from burning or suffering from thermal stress.
* **Harvesting:** It is the month of highest production. Pick the fruits (tomatoes, zucchini, cucumbers) as soon as they reach their optimal point; this will encourage the plant to continue producing new fruits.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc2MRD1VAgjbU5bYKgVEi3JkrALTiSAQcgRr6qQKg9596/1782835605126.jpg)

Hola mis estimados amigos de Full Deportes, como siempre es un placer inmenso estar por acá y hoy les traigo una propuesta relacionada con nuestro deporte nacional, el béisbol. Como cubano nacido en la década de 1970 era casi imposible que no me convirtiera en un ferviente aficionado del deporte de las bolas y los strikes. Sobre todo porque, a pesar de cuestiones ajenas al deporte, en nuestro país se trabajó con tanto esmero en este juego, tanto en lo relativo a la infraestructura —incluyendo la construcción de estadios muy acogedores en todas las provincias y en varios municipios— como en el rigor y el talento de entrenadores, técnicos y atletas.

Para casi todos los que conocemos un poco de béisbol, sabemos que contamos con una liga cuya calidad se podía considerar de nivel Triple A.Lamentablemente, tanto para los jugadores cubanos que no pudieron mostrar su inmensa calidad en el mejor  béisbol del mundo como para los aficionados de la Gran Carpa que se perdieron la posibilidad de verlos establecer números excepcionales, quedó esa deuda histórica. Peloteros que sin dudas hubieran aportado para mejor en la MLB.Crecí disfrutando de un excelente béisbol y también, ya entrando al tema en el que quiero detenerme un instante para posteriormente escribir otras publicaciones —porque realmente el tema tiene mucha tela por donde cortar—, crecí manejando las estadísticas tradicionales o convencionales dentro del béisbol. Pero cuando surgió la llamada sabermetría fue un deslumbramiento para mí, porque es evidente que estas dicen mucho más y aportan tanto recursos estratégicos como tácticos dentro de lo que los cubanos conocemos como “la pelota”, nuestro deporte nacional.

La sabermetría nos enseñó que el promedio de bateo no lo dice todo, que un jugador puede ser mucho más valioso por su capacidad de embasarse o por el impacto total que genera en las victorias de su equipo. Métricas como el OPS, el WAR o el WHIP comenzaron a cambiar la manera en que se toman decisiones estratégicas y tácticas en el béisbol moderno. Y lo más fascinante es que estas herramientas no solo enriquecen el análisis de los especialistas, sino que también nos permiten a los aficionados ver el juego con otros ojos, con una mirada más completa y justa.

Por eso quiero iniciar este ciclo de publicaciones: porque creo que la sabermetría no es un lujo académico ni un capricho de estadísticos, sino un recurso que nos ayuda a entender mejor nuestro deporte nacional, a valorar de manera más precisa a nuestros peloteros y a disfrutar con mayor intensidad cada partido.Así que aquí comienza este viaje. Hoy solo he querido abrir la puerta, compartir la emoción de ese descubrimiento y dejar planteado el camino que iremos recorriendo juntos. Porque la pelota, nuestra pelota, merece que la miremos con toda la pasión del corazón y con toda la claridad que nos regalan los números. Y yo, como cubano que creció con el béisbol en las venas, no puedo menos que celebrar este encuentro entre tradición y modernidad, entre la emoción de la grada y la precisión de la estadística.

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS8NxVgy4gwzyp6DQhH5bFiDnCC7e3UoZD2sHdkm8NfM4/1782157964881.jpg)

***

\

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc2MRD1VAgjbU5bYKgVEi3JkrALTiSAQcgRr6qQKg9596/1782835605126.jpg)

Hello my dear friends at Full Deportes, it’s always a huge pleasure to be here, and today I bring you a proposal tied to our national sport, baseball. As a Cuban born in the 1970s, it was almost impossible not to become a passionate fan of the game of balls and strikes. Especially because, despite issues beyond sports, our country worked so hard on this game—building cozy stadiums across provinces and municipalities, and training coaches, technicians, and athletes with real rigor and talent.

For almost anyone who knows a bit about baseball, we recognize that we had a league whose quality could be considered Triple-A level. Sadly, for Cuban players who couldn’t show their immense talent in the best baseball in the world, and for MLB fans who missed the chance to see them put up exceptional numbers, that remains a historical debt. Players who no doubt would have made the league better. I grew up enjoying excellent baseball, and also—getting into the topic I want to pause on for now—I grew up with traditional stats. But when sabermetrics came along, it was a revelation for me, because it’s clear these numbers tell us much more and give both strategic and tactical resources in what we Cubans call la pelota, our national sport.

Sabermetrics taught us that batting average doesn’t say it all, that a player can be far more valuable for his ability to get on base or for the total impact he has on his team’s wins. Metrics like OPS, WAR, or WHIP started to change the way strategic and tactical decisions are made in modern baseball. And the most fascinating part is that these tools not only enrich the analysis for specialists, but also let us fans see the game with new eyes—with a fuller, fairer perspective.

That’s why I want to start this series of posts: because I believe sabermetrics isn’t an academic luxury or a statisticians’ whim, but a resource that helps us understand our national sport better, value our players more precisely, and enjoy each game with greater intensity. So here begins this journey. Today I just wanted to open the door, share the excitement of that discovery, and lay out the path we’ll walk together. Because baseball—our baseball—deserves to be seen with all the passion of the heart and all the clarity that numbers give us. And I, as a Cuban who grew up with baseball in my veins, can only celebrate this meeting between tradition and modernity, between the thrill of the stands and the precision of statistics.

***

Hi Mac! Thanks so much for your support, and especially for the recommendations, since for many of us, this is our first time experiencing this.

Yes, it is a seismically active country, and following the earthquake 60 years ago, many earthquake-resistant structures were built. You know, I’m right here in the capital, and I believe fewer than ten buildings in the entire city actually collapsed—though several that are still standing are at risk of falling. On the other hand, the situation on the other side of the mountain, along the coast, is terrible; practically the entire state was lost. Even though we are far from the epicenter, Caracas and La Guaira sit on sedimentary soil—much like Mexico City—which intensified the force of the tremors. Caracas has been established for a long time, so the best approach is to reinforce it; however, La Guaira is a place where there shouldn't be any housing at all, given the tragedy caused by the rains back in '99.

The disastrous government we had for the last 27 years made a habit of building housing in record time just to appear on television claiming to help people; the truth is, however, that everything still standing dates back to before their time—though I suppose the earthquakes played a role, given that there were two of them. My wife and I were terrified by the force of the first one, and at the time, it seemed very strange when the intensity suddenly spiked; only hours later did we learn that a second, even stronger earthquake had merged with the first. We felt certain the building was going to collapse, largely because the duration of the event caused so much damage across the country.

I’ll also try the trick with the glass of water you mentioned, because just writing this message makes me feel like the ground is moving. We do have something hanging in our bedroom that lets us know when an aftershock is happening—or if we’re just feeling phantom movements—but right now, anything helps. Today is the last day of the month; we’re waiting for our paychecks so we can go visit our families in Aragua. It’s a state near the capital that suffered moderate damage—partly because the ground is more stable—but is geographically closer to the earthquake epicenters.

I feel so much sadness for my country right now, because there are also floods and fires on the other side of Venezuela; hundreds of families there have lost their homes, too, yet hardly anyone is talking about it.

Thanks, Mac! And sorry for using your comment to vent a little more 🙏

body.title: Do you think there should be a law that makes it illegal?
body.body:
Since the introduction of smartphones, we enjoy the freedom to capture moments. Family hangout, creating memories: our phones are always available to capture those beautiful moments. There is one thing we don’t think about: someone can unknowingly become part of our video and photo.



I know you will be battling in your mind: How can someone be part of our video or photo? Here I come. Have you ever wondered how many times you have appeared in someone's picture or video without realizing it? Maybe in church, crossing the road, or shopping in a mall, someone took an image of you. You may be scrolling through Facebook or TikTok, and you will see an image of you without you knowing. You will be shocked or wowed because technically you just saw an image of yourself online without your permission.




![C64AAE34-EDE9-4D10-AD7C-FABEB6EC903B.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/EoK6KwvGPhQQT4iC78YRvMy4WK6qLvMS9y2dnShJazUFK98yAqnUPxGfL4kdmWeswaK.png)



Do you think there should be a law that makes it illegal?





After thinking deeply, the answer is yes for me; everyone deserves a certain level of privacy and control over how their image is used. To be honest no one will be happy to see their face going viral without their knowledge. It will be uncomfortable for them; they may feel unsafe, more especially since the content will attract a lifestyle they try to take out from the internet.





For instance, you are scrolling through the internet, and to your greatest surprise, you find yourself in a video that you are not aware of, and you realize that millions of people have viewed the video. You don’t know who else has shared the video or how viral the video has gone. For someone like me, it will be unsettling.



The bitter truth is the public space is not private. The moment you step out of your comfort zone, there is nothing like privacy again. Some streets, malls, and filling stations have security cameras recording us, content creators creating video, and journalists covering events. If ever an accidental appearance requires permission, it will be difficult for filmmaking and so on.




![A3897036-B35C-48A5-B061-0B7968DFF8F1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/23wCBeJ2mnUK87KyqTcKKv69M8UPDxmynT44qeAAV8975BN469rRKtJ2JmhJM4iZYp2Jo.png)



One thing about street photography is that everything about it is genuine the moment it's unplanned, and it tells a powerful story. If the laws required that everyone in the background give consent before a video or a photo of them is captured, believe me, many stories will remain untold. When it comes to the area of news, it will be very hard for journalists to capture moments, making news coverage complicated. Like I will always say the real issue is not taking the picture; it’s what happens afterward. We should focus on how images are used rather than who captured the image. Is it right that someone is profiting from your image or video without your consent? Should they be allowed to post a video that will ruin your reputation, embarrass, or mock you? Should there be consequences for using someone's image for your own selfish interest?





If I must say, there is a little complication here. The challenge is finding a balance between the individual right to privacy and content creators documenting the world around them. I don’t think that humans can have that privacy the moment they are in a public space. I don’t think there is a perfect solution to this, but it will be nice if content creators seek the permission of those individuals before capturing them. I understand the fact that everyone uses cameras in their pockets; it will be nice if we seek permission.







Do you think that recording strangers in public without their permission should be considered a crime? Or should the law focus only on how those photos or videos are used after capturing?

***All images are generated with ChatGPT.***


This is my entry on the weekly prompt #hivelearners #hl-w224e1 topic, \

Thank you for stopping by my blog. I appreciate your support, comments, and upvotes. Have a lovely day.

body.title: A Despidida Party of My Colleague, Wishing Him a Safe Travel Abroad
body.body: I just wanted to share how I gave importance to the people who are dear to me. He's one of my colleagues who's been successfully hired on the spot abroad last month. And this month will be his scheduled flight going to USA. I can't helped but to keep cheering on his achievements in his career. And what I wished for him was that he may have a safe, sound and productive trip.

> Yesterday was a big day. I together with some colleagues prepared something for our dearest friend. He's my very friend way back then when I got hired last 2013. Were both having the same department. Having him in a group felt so much lively and energetic before classes started. As I recalled back then during our first day of service at work. It's a perfect timing that he will be travelling in Lapu-Lapu City to have his medical check up. So without hesitation weve picked him up and brought him to the place where despidida will be held.

> Everything's already prepared from tarpaulin, cake,foods,drinks and bouquet. They're all being set up before he came. And we're very happy that finally we successfully invited him to be at the place. The despidida Party was held in a beach. This place was also very memorable for us. Occasions and simple celebrations like birthday of my colleagues will be most of the time held in this beautiful beach in Lapu-Lapu City.
> He was surprised with all the preparations we've made during the night. He was happy seeing us.
> And then we welcomed him through capturing group photos... Each one of us were enjoying the night.
>\nWe blessed the food, through offering prayers and gratitude that were able to gather around as one family.\n
> And then we satisfied our tummies on that night eating our delicious and our favorite foods.
>\nThe foods filled everyone's tummy. It was a happy mood for everyone of us eating delicious and varieties of foods.\n

> So much things to be grateful for..Were so happy one of our colleagues wish really came true..It's his long time dream to work abroad and finally God granted it. The despidida celebration lasted for how many hours. It was such a beautiful bond of friendship and camaraderie. Sharing the excitement of the opportunities and success of one of our colleagues was something to be cherished with.

>
And then the night couldn't be completed without his message to everyone of us.. Some hearing his messages were teary eyed, not because of being sad but a joy felt in our heart, that at last he will be in his permanent greener pasture..

And everyone wished him to travel  well and be safe. We wished him that wherever he may go, always to be his  foot set on the ground,be humble always and placed God at the center of your life.

The night filled with so much joy sharing stories, laughters that made each one of us forget that it's already night. It was such a beautiful gathering towards with another colleague...

This would be all for now and see you then until next blog journey of my life...Surely I'll keep you updated...Bye👋👋😘🤗

body.title: ✨🇻🇪 Fuerza y empatía en momentos de angustia🇻🇪✨🙏
body.body:
>

Hola y buenas noches a ustedes. Son justo las 11:33 pm, momento en el que estoy comenzando a escribir. No tengo sueño. La verdad, los momentos que estamos viviendo aquí en Venezuela no son buenos tiempos; desde mi ubicación les cuento que el temblor se sintió fuerte y la señal quedó en estática, pero no fue un daño tan grande, solo sentimos la sacudida. Mi familia y yo estamos bien.

Es la primera vez que comparto mis palabras aquí, y quisiera que no fuera en momentos tan angustiosos como los días que venimos pasando desde el 24 de junio. Creo que ese día no se borrará de la memoria de los venezolanos. Pienso que deberíamos dar a conocer cómo hemos afrontado cada uno nuestra situación.

---

La distancia de donde me ubico es de unas 5 horas en auto para llegar a La Guaira, por lo que solo queda ayudar con donaciones y palabras de aliento para las personas afectadas. Es muy lamentable ver cómo se pierde un hogar en cuestión de segundos, es algo difícil de creer. Desde ese día no he dejado de seguir las noticias; sé que no es recomendable, pero la necesidad de saber cómo va la situación es real.

Y es difícil no sentir empatía. No sé cómo hay personas tan tranquilas con este grandísimo desastre. Eso no me ha dejado dormir, y creo que así estamos más de uno, porque las calles están en silencio, casi no se oyen las voces de las personas... es un silencio parecido al de un velorio. No es para menos, ya que desde hace tiempo que no pasaba una gran tragedia, y ver cómo muchas personas perdieron a un ser querido, o la cantidad de fallecidos, no es fácil de digerir. Pienso en los problemas que hemos vivido todos los venezolanos y en cómo hemos salido adelante, pero esta vez el problema ganó la batalla; eso pensé en un momento.

---

Pero pidamos la revancha por los caídos, porque no es justo que nos demos por vencidos ni dejemos de hacerles honor. Sigamos adelante así como siempre lo hemos hecho, solos en la batalla. Porque si observamos bien, la tierra sigue girando, y si ella no se detiene aun recibiendo daños, ¿por qué debemos detenernos nosotros? 

Como venezolana que conoce muy bien lo que estamos viviendo, te mando mis palabras de fuerza. Sé que no es fácil, sé lo que es perder a nuestros seres queridos y sé por lo que hemos pasado. Confiemos en las manos de Dios.

<center><i>\

---
La foto presentada en este post es el atardecer del día de ayer, fue tomada con mi celular Infinix Smart 7 y mejorada con IA.

body.title: FINE, DESPITE JUNE! - PHOTOGRAPHY STORIES
body.body:
![Tcats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AKGZTGCDta2cgh47u1tunMMtMj3BV38Lf3Z8uaZBWXnnYgkqC1jBbpKqzV5PQM5.jpg)

----

**P**eople who live in small towns like mine here in Venezuela have been used, since the beginning of this century, to dealing with problems and shortcomings by the ton, so that is something which has made them tougher than normal... And I write this because today in the morning I greeted a neighbor of perhaps some 80 years, and when I asked him, \
, he answered me with a somewhat gruff gesture and with an ironic smile, **\

.**.. And I was on the point of answering him with a recriminatory phrase, since it still seems to me that the days we have lived recently are not such as to make jokes of this type. But immediately I braked my impulse to do that, since, despite the fact that I am a man of already 55 years, immediately there came to my mind the teaching of my mother which says, \

so instead of recriminating Venancio (which is our neighbor's name), I simply decided to smile a little and nod with my head and continue ahead on my way...

>**L**as personas que viven en pueblos pequeños como el mío, aquí en Venezuela, están acostumbradas, desde comienzos de este siglo, a lidiar con problemas y carencias a por montones, así que eso es algo lo cual las ha hecho más duras de lo normal... Y escribo esto porque hoy en la mañana saludé a un vecino de quizás unos 80 años y, cuando le pregunté: «¿Y tú cómo estás?», me contestó [con] un ademán un tanto osco y con una sonrisa irónica: **«Bien, a pesar de junio»**... Y yo estuve a punto de contestarle con una frase recriminatoria, pues me sigue pareciendo que los días que hemos vivido recientemente no son como para hacer chistes de este tipo. Pero de inmediato frené mi impulso de hacer eso, pues, a pesar de que soy un hombre de ya 55 años, de inmediato se vino a mi mente la enseñanza de mi madre que dice: «A los mayores se les respeta», así que, en lugar de recriminar a Venancio (que así se llama nuestro vecino), simplemente decidí sonreír un poco, asentir con la cabeza y seguir adelante mi camino...

![T01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23w33mwJyQ7qDMwu2zNu9E52pJmDSbxpsQdPRdf8wKeoM26xdr2YME2mXkLNSBSfEJZrg.jpg)

![T02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/244Kdo2huzdZFS7rZiwHDV5pdZfMWxT77J7Nk9ySfVvTffY5GLu2MTPUjcVJDLS2pqdi7.jpg)

![T03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23uQxSqaGLZAPxHKm1vTEXQATzVNy8MxrYmPT8iQZWeNT1SiiwvNCtRmgpoJ3o32HU5ZD.jpg)

**F**ew meters down the street, after my brief conversation with Venancio, I realized that that small listless smile with which I accepted the old man's ironic phrase was perhaps the first I had had since the afternoon of the earthquake on the past 24th. Then Venancio's response stopped seeming rude or inappropriate to me and seemed to me a gesture of resilience typical of someone who has had a hard life and now has to go through another difficult moment. Then I thanked in silence for not having recriminated Venancio and even mentally thanked him for having taught me that little lesson...

>**P**ocos metros calle abajo, después de mi breve conversación con Venancio, me di cuenta de que aquella pequeña sonrisa desganada con la que acepté la irónica frase del anciano era quizás la primera que tenía desde la tarde del terremoto del pasado día 24. Entonces la respuesta de Venancio dejó de parecerme descortés o inadecuada y me pareció un gesto de resiliencia propio de alguien que ha tenido una vida dura y ahora le toca pasar por otro trance más. Entonces agradecí en silencio no haber recriminado a Venancio y hasta le di mentalmente las gracias por haberme enseñado esa pequeña lección...

![T04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23vhwMPunK1G2V5F8Qi14UFDs2PFtyu39jStJopFdF19Xey7nK5ty5Hdch1FxBKFBXZ6p.jpg)

body.title: Harvesting the garlic field
body.body:
<center>



For the last week or so, we have been pulling up the garlic we started last autumn. It has been a full growth cycle for the bulbs and time for them to get out of the ground. Then we will dry and cure them for weeks before we decide what to do next with them. Some will probably be seed garlic, going right back into the fields to produce more next year. And some may be sold, but hard to say how much we will keep vs sell right now. Waiting for them to all dry and then we can weigh them.

https://i.postimg.cc/5tc37mqJ/20260616-163831.jpg

Here are two shelves of the garlic, right now we are up to about 7 of them full. But we are not done harvesting, so will probably use most of them. Buying 25 shelves seemed like a lot, but rather have more than not enough. And then we are ready for expansion when we produce more in the future as well.

https://i.postimg.cc/0yKn04ms/20260613-125336.jpg

About two weeks ago we built out all the shelves that will hold the garlic while it dries and cures. They are just your basic plastic shelves.. but 25 of them.

https://i.postimg.cc/8C8HKbd3/20260613-130351.jpg

Took us about half a day to build them all.

https://i.postimg.cc/HLG2Zt0F/20260614-144635.jpg

The water reel is being brought back into the building. We will drain it and keep it stored until next year. Without this reel, we would have had a complete loss. As the whole growing season we were under an extreme drought. Garlic areas that did not get irrigation did not survive, so it will be important next year to only plant where we can reach with this water reel.

https://i.postimg.cc/yNqPQTht/20260616-161020.jpg

Harvesting is slow going, we only get a few rows done a day. Its hard work, following behind the tractor and pickup and bulbs the machine misses. I usually do this for an hour or two before taking a break. And then coming back to cut and clean the garlic I grabbed.

https://i.postimg.cc/s2Fc6J9d/20260616-161026.jpg

We pull out bulbs out of the bags, lots of grass mixed in. So it takes some time to go through it all.

https://i.postimg.cc/6Qs0jhLw/20260616-163851.jpg

They may look dirty now, but we only cleaned them off a little bit. So we do not damage the skin of the bulb.

https://i.postimg.cc/PqG43Mzd/20260616-163858.jpg

We will give them a proper cleaning after they dry and cure.

https://i.postimg.cc/BvWgYCcq/20260616-163958.jpg

Another day, another row of garlic to pull up.



https://i.postimg.cc/KYXNq5rz/20260621-120328.jpg

You can see we are slowly going through the rows. About half way done at this point.

https://i.postimg.cc/1zxHCKcX/20260621-124740.jpg


My foreman runs the machine, and I follow behind pulling up any it misses.

https://i.postimg.cc/xdrRxPyc/20260621-125148.jpg

Some of the bulbs are on the bigger side, but many are pretty small. Probably next year they need more water, and fertilizing earlier in the year. We added it to the ground in late April when we should have done it late March. Oh well, next year we will do better on many things.

https://i.postimg.cc/25pwcxFb/20260621-125203.jpg

We have to stop the harvester machine sometimes as the grass clogs it up. Next year we also plan on dealing with the weeds better. Shifting the PH did not seem to help as much as we hoped.

https://i.postimg.cc/6QdhDGY3/20260621-125535.jpg

Hah my foreman is so happy! We are glad we made it to the end, with actual bulbs! Success!

https://i.postimg.cc/FKjx2JDz/20260621-131208.jpg

Its hard to say how much we have yet, we lost some due to the water reel not reaching parts of the field. Along with the extreme drought. So not sure if we had a net gain or loss on garlic bulbs this year.

https://i.postimg.cc/PqmMB82N/20260621-131215.jpg

We started cleaning them more, not sure if this is too much before drying.

https://i.postimg.cc/DzqctbB8/20260621-161105.jpg

I like the system we have, we harvest before it gets really hot outside. And then we take lunch after a few hours in the field. And come back after our food settles to trim and clean off the garlic we collected earlier that day.

https://i.postimg.cc/cJQcV8X8/20260621-161118.jpg

May not look like much now, but once all trimmed and cleaned they are nice bulbs.

https://i.postimg.cc/yNFTwSvZ/20260628-120741.jpg

Well harvesting was going well, until a line burst on the machine.

https://i.postimg.cc/3wgZPDnG/20260628-125615.jpg

One of the hydraulic lines was rubbing on the tractor and went unnoticed. So now we are in the process of fixing it. Hopefully we will be back up and running this week. And then finish up harvest in the next week or two.

So with this setback, we are a little behind. But I think there is still time to harvest the rest of the field as long as we get this hose fixed soon.

</center>

**_Saludos amigos de Hive & Liketu | Greetings friends of Hive & Liketu._**
 
   _Ya les he mencionado en muchas ocasiones lo mucho que me gusta el sushi y aunque ya tengo mi lugar favorito a donde ir tenía también pendiente intentar hacer sushi en casa y si bien no es lo mismo quería vivir la experiencia._ >_I've mentioned many times how much I love sushi, and although I already have my favorite place to go, I also wanted to try making sushi at home, and while it's not the same, I wanted to have the experience._ _Esta semana Dani y yo nos decidimos finalmente a preparar sushi en casa por primera vez así que investigamos un poco el hicimos nuestra lista con los ingredientes que necesitabamos, entre ellos alga nori, arroz para sushi, vinagre de arroz, queso crema, salsa de soya y ya que estábamos experimentando por primera vez sustituimos el salmón por  2 latas de atún y tiras de pescado blanco._ >_This week Dani and I finally decided to make sushi at home for the first time, so we did some research and made our list of the ingredients we needed, including nori seaweed, sushi rice, rice vinegar, cream cheese, soy sauce, and since we were experimenting for the first time, we substituted the salmon with 2 cans of tuna and strips of white fish._ _Dani se encargó de todo el proceso, desde preparar el arroz hasta armar los rollos y la verdad para ser la primera vez quedaron bastante bien y lo más importante es que quedaron deliciosos y con ese sabor característico del sushi, lo que nos indicó que lo hicimos bien y la experiencia fue sin duda increíble._ >_Dani took care of the entire process, from preparing the rice to assembling the rolls, and honestly, for it being the first time, they turned out quite well. Most importantly, they were delicious and had that characteristic sushi flavor, which told us we did it right, and the experience was undoubtedly incredible._
  ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb8MUQ9JXMEENRpercup7dcUR3qxqRwkezc4nbLmd7KwK/sep_hive_nr.jpg)

body.title: Un espacio para Emmaris / Reportando sus publicaciones (Esp-Eng)
body.body:
>
![portada_gif.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/EpGQGaRouDh8NgyndYtem3As79ZUkGKNuecSxgFG4dJtQYLMGnkvQuyADAsjdQqwb4U.gif)
Este será un espacio para reportar el contenido publicado por @emmaris e igualmente las ganancias serán destinadas para ella al 100%. Hemos decidido crear este reporte para tenderle una mano amiga a una joven madre venezolana, de 36 años, que lucha contra el cáncer que le diagnosticaron en el Estado Nueva Esparta (Isla Margarita) en Venezuela. Específicamente, se le descubrió hace pocos meses un Carcinoma de mamá izquierda y el 23 de febrero le practicaron una Mastectomía Radical. Emmaris es miembro de nuestra comunidad, porque ella publica contenido sobre su hijo de 10 años con autismo no verbal. Además de su príncipe azul, tiene dos hijas pequeñas, una de 6 años y una bebé con pocos meses de nacida. Desde este espacio los invitamos a corroborar la veracidad de su situación a través de sus propias publicaciones, las cuales serán compartidas aquí semanalmente o de acuerdo al ritmo que Emmaris mantenga publicando en HIVE.
![informeMEDICO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23sxdY7gZzqdL5YtWfR6S6FD2Y33jGDLq7a1y7ZDzW5oEFH4PmL9DPcJEB1HZEwowaw3J.jpg)
Informe médico de @emmaris
Ya inicio el tratamiento con quimioterapia, como ella misma lo ha documentado para poner al tanto a la comunidad de HIVE a quien ha pedido apoyo para costear sus gastos médicos. A continuación, te invitamos a visualizar las siguientes publicaciones de @emmaris 💙 >! [English] This will be a space to share content posted by @emmaris, and 100% of the proceeds will go to her. We have decided to create this initiative to lend a helping hand to a 36-year-old Venezuelan mother who is battling cancer diagnosed in the state of Nueva Esparta (Margarita Island) in Venezuela. Specifically, she was diagnosed with left breast carcinoma a few months ago, and on February 23, she underwent a radical mastectomy. Emmaris is a member of our community because she posts content about her 10-year-old son with nonverbal autism. In addition to her “little prince,” she has two young daughters, a 6-year-old and a baby just a few months old. We invite you to verify the accuracy of her situation through her own posts, which will be shared here weekly or as often as Emmaris continues to post on HIVE.
![informeMEDICO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/23sxdY7gZzqdL5YtWfR6S6FD2Y33jGDLq7a1y7ZDzW5oEFH4PmL9DPcJEB1HZEwowaw3J.jpg)

body.title: Coffee From Home, Bengkulu Full Wash From Askara Roastery
body.body:
Back to brewing from home, I decided to find better roastery. Thankfully, with the growing demand of quality coffee, some roastery are popping up, one being Askara. This place serves not only great coffee but also assorted bread and pastry that we typically find at bigger cities. ![20260623_184538.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPyujKYTxhjFpcEvR9o6mUvkvJkRpKWh5f1VAXNidgHda/20260623_184538.jpg)
If you enjoy filtered coffee, the selections that they have is perfect to be a base for your homebrew. This time, I decided to bring home Bengkulu Coffee, 100% arabica beans with full wash. It has lemon and palm sugar aftertaste which is perfect for a filtered morning coffee.
![20260622_132813.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZYat9S3NmHPzq2WfTYtVwoU5CtNY8Nxto7iZNn4rbet4/20260622_132813.jpg)
They have quite the selections especially if you enjoy espresso based drinks. The staff will ask your preference and gives some good recommendations. I personally wanted one of their blends but they didn't have it a the time. In this economy, it's better to make coffee at home and invest in good quality espresso machine considering a coffee served at a cafe costs somewhere around $1.5 to even 2$. For me personally, drinking way too many cups, it's more reasonable to have it and brew it at home. All I need is just a good quality coffee because the regular one hardly tastes the same. At the moment, I am waiting for my other coffee shipment and I am pretty excited for it as I order one fits for espresso and latte based drinks. So, see you in my next review on it.

body.title: Like A Few Minutes Ago
body.body:
But whether it was intercepted yet, what exactly, what type of missile, ballistic missile, it's totally unclear at the moment. Well, I mean, today Turkish officials have been claiming that it was not a target, the first, the morning missile was not targeting Turkey. All pro-government journalists and commentators were saying that, well, Iran does not attack Turkey.

And Iranian ambassador to Ankara was invited to call to foreign minister's office. And I think they gave him notice. If this is the second one, and there is a tendency among Turks, well, that maybe Israel is simply doing these things to put Turkey into a war.

And there was claim. And these are not just a conspiracy theory claim. That's the mainstream pro-government media was reporting.

So all these indicate that Turkey certainly wanted to simply stay away from war. But it appears that, well, Iran doesn't care if that's the case. And today, Turkish minister of defense statement, when you read it from Turkey, it was very soft-toned statement.

There was almost no warning to Iran. There was no call for Iran to stop doing this. And they were only saying that we are prepared to defend.

But there was no, you know, tough tone against Iran. Probably, if this is the case, and we will see tomorrow what they are going to come up with. In addition, I wanted to just remind you guys, Turkey informed Iran back in January that the United States is preparing for Kurds to simply have them cross into Iran to conduct land operations.

And Turkey was, in fact, trying hard to keep the relations well with Iran. So it is totally a surprise for me if Iran simply continues to do this. Let me check if I can find any news updates on Turkish media.

Well, so far, they haven't disappointed in terms of trying to expand the countries that they're attacking and grow the number of enemies that are facing them. So their strategy is crazy, but they're doing it. The report I saw was just like a few minutes ago, right as we were crashing.

body.title: ✨🇻🇪Pidamos Fuerza y empatía en momentos de angustia🇻🇪✨
body.body:
>

Hola y buenas noches a ustedes. Son justo las 11:33 pm, momento en el que estoy comenzando a escribir. No tengo sueño. La verdad, los momentos que estamos viviendo aquí en Venezuela no son buenos tiempos; desde mi ubicación les cuento que el temblor se sintió fuerte y la señal quedó en estática, pero no fue un daño tan grande, solo sentimos la sacudida. Mi familia y yo estamos bien.

Es la primera vez que comparto mis palabras aquí, y quisiera que no fuera en momentos tan angustiosos como los días que venimos pasando desde el 24 de junio. Creo que ese día no se borrará de la memoria de los venezolanos. Pienso que deberíamos dar a conocer cómo hemos afrontado cada uno nuestra situación.

---

La distancia de donde me ubico es de unas 5 horas en auto para llegar a La Guaira, por lo que solo queda ayudar con donaciones y palabras de aliento para las personas afectadas. Es muy lamentable ver cómo se pierde un hogar en cuestión de segundos, es algo difícil de creer. Desde ese día no he dejado de seguir las noticias; sé que no es recomendable, pero la necesidad de saber cómo va la situación es real.

Y es difícil no sentir empatía. No sé cómo hay personas tan tranquilas con este grandísimo desastre. Eso no me ha dejado dormir, y creo que así estamos más de uno, porque las calles están en silencio, casi no se oyen las voces de las personas... es un silencio parecido al de un velorio. No es para menos, ya que desde hace tiempo que no pasaba una gran tragedia, y ver cómo muchas personas perdieron a un ser querido, o la cantidad de fallecidos, no es fácil de digerir. Pienso en los problemas que hemos vivido todos los venezolanos y en cómo hemos salido adelante, pero esta vez el problema ganó la batalla; eso pensé en un momento.

---

Pero pidamos la revancha por los caídos, porque no es justo que nos demos por vencidos ni dejemos de hacerles honor. Sigamos adelante así como siempre lo hemos hecho, solos en la batalla. Porque si observamos bien, la tierra sigue girando, y si ella no se detiene aun recibiendo daños, ¿por qué debemos detenernos nosotros? 

Como venezolana que conoce muy bien lo que estamos viviendo, te mando mis palabras de fuerza. Sé que no es fácil, sé lo que es perder a nuestros seres queridos y sé por lo que hemos pasado. Confiemos en las manos de Dios.

<center><i>\

---
La foto presentada en este post es el atardecer del día de ayer, fue tomada con mi celular Infinix Smart 7 y mejorada con IA.

body.title: The Orchid House
body.body:
Here are some photos taken in the Orchid House at the Lincoln Park Conservatory in Chicago. 

To give citizens an escape from factory lfe and city grime, , the Lincoln Park Commission decided to build a grand Victorian glasshouse in the 1890's

>When it was completed, the conservatory was divided into distinct environments to showcase specific botanical collections:
> * **The Palm House:** The first section to open to the public (in 1892), designed to showcase towering tropical palms and giant rubber trees.
> * **The Fern Room:** Formed to highlight ancient, primordial plant species like ferns and cycads.
> * **The Orchid House:** Historically dedicated to showcasing rare and exotic orchids alongside other epiphytes, bromeliads, and a serene koi pond.
> * **The Show House:** A dedicated space used to propagate thousands of plants for the surrounding parks and to host rotating, vibrant seasonal floral displays.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbscVUCKff4nSkrf2knUXEYBYsAfsF8ERFF3XmGehFvx5/1782834346429.jpg)


The conservatory was an immediate success, visited by millions of visitors. The interior layout and historic, breathtaking Victorian framework remain almost exactly as they were when the doors first opened.



***The Orchid House at the Lincoln Park Conservatory***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQi5RgWwcwKkKWKy9vK2PLsVW2NTKcEXvKUtwwsc2mUqs/1782665715842.jpg)

>## Orchid House
>**Historically this room housed orchids. Today, it is home to many kinds of epiphytes.**
Pronounced “eppy-fights,” these plants are defined by the way they live – by growing upon other plants, an adaptation for getting more light. They are not parasites, however; epiphytes get most of their water and nutrients from the air. Many different species of plants are epiphytic, including orchids, bromeliads, cacti, ferns, mosses, and lichens.
**Of all the epiphytes, orchids are the most popular.**

body.title: Laughing at Ourselves Is Also Part of Growing. Ladies of Hive Community Contest #295 [EN/ES]
body.body: 🇬🇧 In English * * * Laughing at Ourselves Is Also Part of Growing ---------------------------------------------

/> Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/smile-smiling-laughing-happy-girl-2607299/) --- Hello dear @ladiesofhive community ### What is the most embarrassing moment I can laugh about today? I think we all have at least one story that was terribly embarrassing at the time but eventually became something we laugh about. Mine happened many years ago, when one of my nephews was still a little boy. Today he is already thirty years old, but back then he was about eight. Someone had given him a toy gun that shot small suction-cup darts, and he loved running around the house pretending to shoot everyone. One day, a close friend of my father came to visit. He was a very serious gentleman whom we all respected. When I saw my nephew coming toward the living room with his toy gun, I immediately took it away from him because I was afraid he might accidentally shoot our visitor. I thought I had prevented an embarrassing situation. Instead, while I was talking with my father's friend, I accidentally pulled the trigger myself. The dart flew straight toward him and landed right on his face. I wished the floor would open and swallow me. Of course, I apologized over and over, and fortunately he understood it had been an accident. After he left, everyone in the family burst into laughter. Today, every time we remember that story, I end up laughing too. Life has taught me that some embarrassing moments simply need time before they become funny memories. * * * ### Do I follow fashion? Not really. I have never been someone who follows every new trend. For me, clothing has always been more about feeling comfortable than about wearing what is fashionable. I like simple clothes that allow me to move freely and that are suitable for everyday life. Since I enjoy sewing, I also like repairing or adapting clothes instead of replacing them immediately. Sometimes a small adjustment is enough to give a garment a second life. I believe fashion changes constantly, but feeling comfortable with who you are never goes out of style. That is the style I try to follow. * * * Both questions reminded me that, with time, we learn two valuable lessons: to laugh at ourselves and to stop worrying so much about what other people think. Thank you for reading. * * * The images are from Pixabay. The English version was translated using DeepL Translate. * * * 🇪🇸 En Español * * * Aprender a reírnos de nosotros mismos también es crecer -------------------------------------------------------

/>
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/smile-smiling-laughing-happy-girl-2607299/)

---

Hola querida comunidad @ladiesofhive

### ¿Cuál ha sido el momento más embarazoso del que hoy puedo reírme?

Creo que todos tenemos alguna historia que en su momento nos hizo pasar mucha vergüenza, pero que con el tiempo termina convirtiéndose en una anécdota divertida.

La mía ocurrió hace muchos años, cuando uno de mis sobrinos era todavía un niño. Hoy ya tiene treinta años, pero entonces tendría unos ocho.

Alguien le había regalado una pistola de juguete que disparaba pequeñas flechas con ventosa y se pasaba el día jugando a dispararle a todo el mundo en la casa.

Un día vino de visita un amigo de mi padre. Era un señor muy serio, al que todos le teníamos mucho respeto.

Cuando vi a mi sobrino acercarse con la pistola, rápidamente se la quité de las manos porque temía que fuera a dispararle al visitante.

Pensé que había evitado un momento incómodo.

Pero ocurrió exactamente lo contrario.

Mientras conversaba con el amigo de mi padre, sin darme cuenta accioné el gatillo y la flecha salió disparada directamente hacia él... ¡hasta pegarle en la cara!

En ese instante quería que la tierra me tragara.

Por supuesto, le pedí disculpas una y otra vez y, por suerte, comprendió que todo había sido un accidente.

Cuando se marchó, en la casa no podíamos dejar de reírnos.

Y lo más curioso es que, cada vez que recordamos aquella historia, vuelvo a reírme como si hubiera ocurrido ayer.

Con los años entendí que algunos momentos de vergüenza solo necesitan tiempo para convertirse en buenos recuerdos.

* * *

### ¿Soy una entusiasta de la moda?

La verdad es que no.

Nunca he sido una persona que siga cada nueva tendencia.

Para mí, la ropa siempre ha tenido más que ver con sentirme cómoda que con vestir lo que está de moda.

Me gustan las prendas sencillas, prácticas y que me permitan moverme con libertad.

Como además disfruto cosiendo, muchas veces prefiero arreglar o adaptar una prenda antes que sustituirla.

A veces basta un pequeño cambio para darle una segunda oportunidad.

Creo que la moda cambia constantemente, pero sentirse bien con uno mismo nunca pasa de moda.

Ese es el estilo que intento seguir.

* * *

Ambas preguntas me hicieron pensar en algo bonito: con el paso de los años aprendemos a reírnos de nuestros propios errores y también a preocuparnos mucho menos por la opinión de los demás.

Gracias por leer.

* * *

La versión en inglés fue hecha con DeepL Translate.

* * *

Thank you for reading.

body.title: Why Coordinated Building Systems Start with Accurate BIM Models
body.body:
Why Coordinated Building Systems Start with Accurate BIM Models  
Every successful construction project has one thing in common.  
Teams trust the model they are working from.  
When that trust disappears, coordination becomes much harder.  
A conduit ends up where a duct should be.  
A pipe blocks maintenance access.  
Equipment no longer fits inside the room it was designed for.  
These problems usually don't start during construction.  
They start much earlier, when inaccurate information enters the BIM model.  
The better the model reflects reality, the easier it becomes for every discipline to coordinate their work before crews arrive onsite.  
Accurate Models Create Better Coordination  
Many people believe that when other disciplines come together to review for clashes, coordination begins. It starts way before that, in fact.  
Before the coordination meetings, each team will have already made design decisions and will have their information base. Reliable decisions about equipment location and routing paths will be made quickly if they are not correct.  
Precise models provide all with a common starting point. Teams can work on the design rather than questioning the model. This change will save time and effort during the entire project.  
BIM Is More Than Geometry  
A coordinated model is not simply a collection of 3D objects.  
Every modeled element carries information that affects other systems.  
Equipment dimensions influence clearances.  
Pipe elevations affect ceiling layouts.  
Cable tray routing impacts mechanical services.  
Support locations influence structural coordination.  
When these details are accurate, coordination becomes much more predictable.  
When they are not, problems spread across multiple disciplines.  
Why Small Modeling Errors Become Large Construction Problems  
Major construction delays do not always begin with major mistakes.  
Often they begin with small inaccuracies.  
An incorrect elevation.  
A missing support.  
An equipment family that was never updated.  
A clearance zone that was overlooked.  
Individually these issues appear minor.  
Together they create installation conflicts, redesign work, and unnecessary field adjustments.  
Finding these problems during coordination is always easier than discovering them after fabrication or installation has started.  
Every Discipline Depends on the Same Model  
Modern buildings are highly interconnected.  
Mechanical systems rely on structural openings.  
Electrical pathways share ceiling space with ductwork.  
Plumbing systems compete for the same shafts and corridors.  
This is why coordinated [MEP BIM Services](https://eracore.com/mep-bim-services/) has become such an important part of project delivery.  
Rather than treating each discipline separately, teams work from one coordinated source of information that supports better collaboration throughout design and construction.  
Coordination Is Not a One-Time Activity  
One of the biggest misconceptions about BIM coordination is that it happens once.  
In reality, coordination continues throughout the design process.  
Architectural layouts change.  
Equipment selections evolve.  
Owners request revisions.  
Every change has the potential to affect multiple disciplines.  
Successful project teams regularly review and validate their models to ensure everyone continues working from the latest information.  
Coordination is not about finding clashes once.  
It is about maintaining model accuracy as the project develops.

Plumbing Systems Leave Very Little Room for Error  
Plumbing infrastructure often occupies some of the most congested spaces in a building.  
Vertical risers.  
Service shafts.  
Mechanical rooms.  
Above-ceiling spaces.  
Routing decisions made early in design influence multiple trades later.  
Well-coordinated [Plumbing BIM Services](https://eracore.com/plumbing-bim-services/) help project teams visualize these relationships before installation begins.  
This reduces field conflicts and creates more efficient installation sequences.  
Mechanical Systems Influence Every Other Trade  
Mechanical systems typically consume more physical space than almost any other building service.  
Large ductwork.  
Air handling equipment.  
Mechanical piping.  
Equipment access zones.  
Because of this, mechanical layouts often establish the framework that other disciplines must work around.  
Comprehensive [Mechanical BIM Services](https://eracore.com/mechanical-bim-services/) allow teams to coordinate equipment placement, maintenance access, and routing strategies before construction starts.  
The earlier these relationships are understood, the fewer changes are required later.  
Electrical Coordination Extends Across the Entire Building  
Electrical systems connect almost every part of a facility.  
Power distribution.  
Lighting.  
Communications.  
Fire alarm.  
Controls.  
Each system depends on coordinated routing and properly planned equipment locations.  
Accurate [Electrical BIM Services](https://eracore.com/electrical-bim-services/) help project teams preserve installation access, coordinate pathways with other disciplines, and reduce conflicts before construction reaches the field.  
When electrical infrastructure is modeled correctly, downstream coordination becomes significantly easier.  
Better Models Support Better Decisions  
An accurate model does more than improve coordination.  
It improves decision-making.  
Project teams can evaluate:  
installation sequencing  
maintenance access  
equipment replacement  
future expansion  
constructability  
with greater confidence.  
Instead of reacting to unexpected conditions, they make informed decisions earlier when changes are less expensive.  
That advantage benefits owners, designers, contractors, and facility managers alike.  
The Value Continues After Construction  
A BIM model should not lose its value once a project is complete.  
Accurate models continue supporting building operations for years.  
Facility managers use them to locate equipment.  
Maintenance teams reference them during repairs.  
They are used in future renovation works so that awareness of existing conditions can be gained prior to the commencement of new works. The more accurate it can be at handover, the more useful it will be throughout the building's life cycle.  
Building Confidence Before Construction Starts  
The purpose of BIM is not simply to create attractive 3D models.  
It is to reduce uncertainty.  
Every verified clearance.  
Every coordinated routing path.  
Every accurately placed piece of equipment helps build confidence that construction can proceed as planned.  
Once the teams are confident with the model, they do not spend as much time on workarounds to solve unnecessary problems, but rather put their time and effort into the project itself. One of the greatest advantages BIM can offer is confidence.  
Final Thoughts  
Coordinated building systems do not materialize out of nowhere. They start with factual information. All disciplines have common foundation and all design decisions are more reliable if the model is based on actual construction situations.  
From mechanical equipment to plumbing to electrical distribution, the exact BIM model can be used to coordinate projects earlier, and to have a smoother communication and less risks of unexpected costs when it's time to install.  
Projects with the most complex models are not the most well coordinated. It is they who have the most correct ones.

links.title: Cameras Don't Take Permission.
links.body:
I have never once caught myself in anybody video at least not that I know of but let's be honest, in this Lagos, you can never be too sure, Somebody could be filming street style content for their TikTok and I just happen to be passing, looking like I am rushing somewhere important when I am actually just going to buy bread, that is just how things are now, cameras are everywhere  in pockets, on wrists, mounted on car dashboards, the moment you step outside, you have basically signed an invisible agreement that says, you might end up in somebodys footage, whether you like it or not.

And to be sincere, I am not against that one bit, I think it is asking too much to expect total invisibility once you are in public, public is public, if I am walking on the road, standing at a bus stop, or just minding my business at the market, I don't think I have the right to demand that every phone around me points elsewhere, that is not how shared spaces work, people have always watched each other in public  cameras just made the watching permanent.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXVQ6h5HWu1NEUWudQ2xHSTy43YBKRNVsFSwaoRL4aG7A/1782834876750.jpg)

What I would actually have a problem with is becoming somebody's punchline without my consent, there is a big difference between appearing in the background of someones video and being made the subject of it  especially if the subject treatment is mockery, you know the type, Somebody filming a stranger's outfit and captioning it  see as person dress for 2026 like this,  somebody catching a person mid sneeze or stumbling on the road and turning it into a meme that gathers a million views, somebody filming a private moment an argument, somebody crying, somebody having a bad day and posting it for entertainment, that stranger never agreed to star in anybody's storyline, they just wanted to cross the road in peace, and now they are a screenshot with jokes underneath.

So if you ask me should there be a law criminalizing this, my honest answer is not all of it, but some parts definitely need boundaries If it is accidental, harmless, just background presence  leave it alone, no wahala, the man crossing the road in the back of your vlog isn't being harmed by that. But the moment somebody films specifically to expose, mock, or embarrass a stranger who never agreed to be filmed, that has crossed from public life into public shaming, and shaming somebody for content, without their consent, should carry some kind of consequence maybe not full criminal law, but at least proper platform accountability, or some civil route for people who get dragged online for laughs they never signed up for.

At the same time, I understand the concern from the creator's side, tighten the rules too much and you kill the realness out of street photography, documentaries, journalism, even casual everyday content,some of the best photography that exists happened because somebody caught a real, unplanned human moment in public, If creators now need permission from every single face in every single frame, a whole chunk of authentic storytelling just dies, lagos traffic, market women haggling, children playing football on sandy streets that is culture, and capturing it shouldn't require paperwork.

So my real stance sits somewhere in the middle, film me if I happen to be there, I genuinely don't mind being scenery in your story Just don't turn me into the joke of it, Let me know if you want the tone adjusted further, or I can format it nicely like the last piece for posting.




***[Image Credit](https://unsplash.com/photos/black-and-gray-film-camera-near-printed-photos-F3Dde_9thd8)***
