links.title: Lunch at Sing Hong Kong Kitchen
links.body:
Weekends are my favorite days for a reason. First, I finally get to take a break from work, and then it becomes my chance to explore the city and hunt for a new food place. For me, that is already a kind of adventure. Some people go to malls, some people go to parks, but for me, one of the best ways to enjoy the weekend is to find a food stall that can make my day exciting.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.03 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EokeWsrgkQ3pDwKkY7hHnwCJrME4BY5Pz8eiJZLmn6kM7NcLrjuSRn7DtZgw2Kij5v6.jpeg)


Last Sunday, I went to Lau Pa Sat for lunch. Lau Pa Sat is always interesting because there are so many stalls around, and every corner seems to offer something tempting. The place itself has that classic and beautiful architecture, but at the same time, it feels very alive with people ordering food, looking for seats, and enjoying their meals. It is the kind of place that makes food hunting even more fun.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.01 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoiXb5C53Dm7XF8w7SumTx6RmBmPq3RNoAQddRYnufydJjjFSCvuxGM2LNoBHHA4Phr.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpGRjDSpPvmLj67So58qPa8CRokUTx4Ukgayx3ddWHidHE68nPZT4W4m1kFaAQodrkc.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.04 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eoc7yhWgKpheKk8v9bqHBsgGRXoAguPeYaE5sqFHTNrgYeYYkQYiShh2nAmyAmvT2r5.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.07.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EogNqoZrLTaoMzZmPwGBfLP8CY4Q76mGEMxU2U3wwUMXGVkseZDZaDk7N62uwbAW3Jw.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.29.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpEHkFHtfQkBioPnP162u8sE6QGd4psEDZn76xDkAetyPMqZoY7SGWud1zfHb9u8WLj.jpeg)


While walking around, Sing Hong Kong Kitchen immediately caught my attention. Their signage looked bright and inviting, and the menu had many dishes that looked very appetizing. But one dish made me stop and think, “Okay, this is the one.” It was their Sing’s Special Baked Chicken Rice.

I have always liked this kind of chicken dish. Lam’s Salt Baked Chicken has already become one of my long-time favorites, so seeing another stall offering baked chicken leg made me curious. Of course, every stall has its own recipe and style, and that is what makes trying different versions exciting. Even if the dish sounds familiar, the taste can be very different depending on how it is prepared.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.27 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EogPiVEynMsjKVdtoGS5XgyRzM2ZFs4N1Pqxncq4ZXgcpMaZjVj4aPzxHKs1z73r9rp.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.28 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoiWfays58DNR7GmkMaBMp2CFFbzcApCXyzkGvPaqips7Q3kcEjnMZJLS4EGJpFmURQ.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.28 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoeEtcm8UQLA8ZC62QAey4CGJhg7staFtJhJj9F28dhtgfrUgdUwSH3x2DgYQtgkjgr.jpeg)


I arrived around lunch time, but the baked chicken leg was not ready yet. I had to wait for around 15 minutes. Normally, waiting can feel a bit frustrating when you are already hungry, but this time I was actually happy about it. Why? Because it meant that the chicken would be freshly cooked. Usually, this kind of dish is already prepared beforehand, but this one was fresh out of the oven.

And yes, the wait was worth it.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.04.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eo8VHh3zUwAZZ2DeA9mffF5L6jnfoRv9wbKteeJTRhy3DbJrsnzhqDJYxwcN3RcYaoW.jpeg)




When the plate arrived, the chicken leg looked so appetizing. The skin had that beautiful golden-brown color, and it looked slightly crisp on the outside. Once I started eating, I really enjoyed the texture. The skin was still crispy, while the meat inside was juicy and tender. That combination is always a winner for me. Every bite had that comforting savory flavor, and the sauce made it even better.



![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.03.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpQwqDm1HdUVpdCCetJ8cfjSYuDvZpbXT7DPgqFXefmBGpCcDM4zGAajd9NPY3fXz62.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.02 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpCAoj3ABkkjfpm2XdZrCerjorxmK2eT3xJCg2YrAkr2gpCHAH3bUpUUQciuda9vxUZ.jpeg)

The sauce was perfect with the rice. It gave the dish that extra depth of flavor without overpowering the chicken. I also liked the chili paste on the side. It added a nice hot and spicy touch, just enough to wake up the palate and make the whole meal more enjoyable. Sometimes a good chili can really change the experience of a dish, and this one worked very well with the baked chicken.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.02.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoptvtPCLfnfhtMc8ki8AEW2qGwhVxRWVes7KG8Qfky9kTYynV6gZjqbPauJmaeQnDW.jpeg)


To go with my meal, I also got myself an iced Kopi-C, less sweet. I like this kind of coffee because it still has that nice creamy taste, but not too sugary. It was refreshing, especially after eating something savory and flavorful.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.19.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpCAoiCGxMHJqvL8zz8yZGBeRQpwVJEgDP84qMZNdJU8DT4rmqwNgDcB9Kw81Z13apS.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.26 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EokeYw6JZqqNzmthUKesuFqKNxgzqgVCLcMdmQA5NgRyfDTNZp2w4SNzCxVrtru549v.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.26.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23uFVazE7Ta876XScJqFQP9zkAzBbNBU9rnVX3GPufNa2kL8mCVxpWXvFqGr63mKwLgco.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.27.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoK7fvCpx8C5ixRNbzw6mvL4Es1EJKojB9PhZY9G5evcagyeRit6TKCZZhCnR1TpaQM.jpeg)


And because lunch feels even more complete with a little sweet treat, I also bought a classic cheesecake from Butter Cream dessert stall. It was creamy, smooth, and satisfying. A simple dessert, but definitely a nice way to end the meal.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-30 at 23.14.03 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EokeWsrgkQ3pDwKkY7hHnwCJrME4BY5Pz8eiJZLmn6kM7NcLrjuSRn7DtZgw2Kij5v6.jpeg)


***Now that it is already Wednesday, I am already excited for the weekend again. Another break from work, another city walk, and hopefully, another delicious food discovery.***

## Bon appetit!





***


https://images.ecency.com/p/x7L2VSNEiyAB5Ux7nxKqZetUQAKDhXE3SwQAvkNJXbDxJbhhbSoDYkFW3TPedgzbYRsZXheJpwhchfs.png?format=match&mode=fit



***

## [click here ⏩ City Life Explore TikTok Page 🎦](https://www.tiktok.com/@city.life.explore?_t=ZS-8wAxWX2d8Ex&_r=1)


***


![curamax.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lolodens/23wMzFGa42KXDPWZpERkDEc6jAqTB6yg699kJkAP8gwYh9FoELHeCUxkWG6zLSFKNtMg6.gif)

links.title: I Would Like Your Feedback On Kolony
links.body:
Regular Hive users know there are a ton of ways to read content on Hive. There aren't many ways to present it. That has changed, and it's why I built Kolony. ## What Is Kolony [Kolony](https://kolony.us) is an Hive app that turns any user's content into a magazine layout. Point it at any Hive account — including your own — and it pulls your posts, organizes them into topic-based content blocks, and displays them the way a publication would.
It's not a feed. It's a magazine. ![Kolony Allen Taylor.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcMqNDa9hKLZDW5MMr5VrTXzofKW32uyr5uAJ7jjehUfJ/Kolony%20Allen%20Taylor.png)
If you haven't already, visit kolony.us/@yourusername to claim your magazine. You already have your own public-facing profile that looks like a magazine you built on purpose. It's your content, reorganized in a 3-column magazine format. ## **Why Did I Build Kolony?** Hive has great infrastructure. It's monetization and IP protection features are outstanding. No other decentralized social media platform comes close to Hive in terms of user benefits. The tooling around content presentation, though, has always been a weak link.
Most front-ends show you a reverse-chronological feed. That works fine for discovery. It doesn't do much for a writer, creator, or community builder who wants their body of work to feel like something more than a Twitter scroll.
If you write about crypto one day, poetry the next, and travel the day after that, your profile looks chaotic. Kolony fixes that by grouping your content automatically — and letting you customize the layout when the defaults don't suit you.
**The goal was simple:** give Hive creators a home that looks like they mean business. ## **What Kolony Does for Hive Users** I started Kolony with a simple concept: turn any Hive user's already published content into a magazine. Since the first version of Kolony, it's expanded into something even better. Here's a rundown of the features as they are today.
### Magazine View Your posts are sorted into content blocks by topic — automatically. The magazine pulls from your post history, groups similar content into a single block, and lays it out in a clean grid. Each block has a title, a list of posts with thumbnails, and a reading mode that keeps your readers inside your Kolony magazine.
### Customizable Layout Don't like how the auto-categorization sorted things? Open the Dashboard and rearrange. Drag posts between blocks, rename categories, pin the content you want front and center. You can even rearrange the blocks on the page. Your preferences are saved server-side, so every visitor sees the layout you chose.
### Reading Mode Click any post and it opens in an in-app reading box — full post body, rendered Markdown (tables included), images, and voting. No redirect to hive.blog unless you want one. You and your readers stay inside the experience.
### Upvoting and Comments On Kolony, there's no Upvote button. There's a Sweeten button.
Sweeten posts and comments directly from the reading box. Threaded comment replies render to four levels deep.
### Navigation Tabs Beyond the magazine, Kolony gives you tabs for Posts (your full reverse-chron history), Blog (a curated feed including reblogs), Communities (every community you're subscribed to), Wallet (HIVE, HBD, HP, Savings, estimated account value, and your Hive-Engine tokens), and Notifications (for logged-in owners).
### Write Tab You can publish directly from Kolony. The compose interface uses a WYSIWYG/Markdown toggle editor, supports image uploads to images.hive.blog, lets you pick a community, add tags, and save drafts locally. Posts go on-chain via Hive Keychain. No middleman.
### Hive Keychain Authentication Login is signature-based — Kolony never touches your keys. It issues a server-verified challenge, Keychain signs it with your posting key, and you get a JWT. Standard stuff, done right.
### Public URLs Your magazine is public without a login. kolony.us/@username works for anyone. Share it. Link it in your bio. Send it to people who've never heard of Hive.
## **What's Next on Kolony** Kolony is functional and live, but it's still early. Here's a list of some of the planned coming features:
**Blog posts and short-form content as magazine blocks.** Right now the magazine pulls from your standard post history. The next version will let you surface blog-style content and Waves/Threads short posts inside the magazine layout.
**Follower subscriptions.** Readers who want to know when you publish will be able to opt in. When you post, they'll get a notification. Consent-based, no spam, on-chain.
**Visual media blocks.** Standalone image blocks first, then 3Speak video blocks. For creators whose work is more visual than textual.
**Pinned posts.** Feature your best content. Up to three posts. Red boxes. Top of the magazine. Hard to miss.
**Must Reads.** A curated block for off-chain links — for when the thing you want to point people to isn't on Hive.
**Tipping.** HIVE, HBD, or Hive-Engine tokens via Keychain. From inside the magazine.
**The roadmap is long.** The pace depends partly on how many people are actually using the thing. I've got ideas, but I want to hear yours.
## **Try It — and Tell Me What's Broken** Kolony is live at [kolony.us](https://kolony.us). Your account is at kolony.us/@yourusername. Log in with Hive Keychain, poke around, post something from the Write tab, rearrange your magazine. Then come back here and tell me what you think.
What's useful? What's confusing? What's missing? What did I build that you'll never use?
Early feedback shapes what gets built next. If you're a Hive user and you want a say in how this thing evolves, now's the time to chime in.


**Kolony is a solo project, built in public, for the Hive community. No VC money. No token sale. Just a writer who wanted a better way to present content on the blockchain he actually uses.**
Now it's your turn. What would you like to see in Kolony? ---
✍️ Published to the Hive blockchain by

Learn how to make a single serving cake in a mug in just about 90 seconds. If you are craving cake but don't want to make a whole cake and don't want to take the 1 hour or so to make it, then make this [chocolate mug cake](https://www.inthekitchenwithmatt.com/chocolate-mug-cake) recipe. **Ingredients**
*For a Mug (Full Sized Mug, 11/12 oz)*
- 6 tbsp of cake mix use whatever cake mix you like
- 4 tbsp of water
- 2 tsp of canola or vegetable oil

*For a Small Bowl (4/5 oz)*
- 3 tbsp of cake mix
- 2 tbsp of water
- 1 tsp of canola oil or vegetable oil

*From Scratch Chocolate cake recipe*
- 3 tbsp all-purpose flour or cake flour
- 3 tbsp sugar
- 4 tsp cocoa powder
- 1/4 tsp baking powder
- 1 tbsp vegetable, canola, olive, coconut, or avocado oil
- 3 tbsp water, milk, almond milk, or coffee

links.title: Social Media, Privacy And Public Picture Taking
links.body:
Change we know is the only thing constant, which is why the era we are in now is entirely a different era. An era where most of us don’t see anything wrong in doing some certain things like taking pictures in public without the knowledge of those involved since many might fill invasion of privacy if they get to see their pictures posted online without their consent. 

# Origination And Professionalism 

Apart from being a social media content creator or an online writer, public picture taking of images of others without their consent has been long on- going, dated back to many years and many has built wealth through this profession, example being the “Paparazzi” who secretly follows and takes pictures of then mighty and rich 🤑, seeking information and selling the pictures to publishers for huge sums of money 💰.

And even before the boom 💥 of social media platforms, people whose work are professional photographers were practically secretly taking pictures without informing those involved, especially for the purpose of giving out information, knowing what is going on in someone’s life, knowing who is dating who, and other top informations just for the purpose of creating news 📰.

# Public Picture Capturing And The Era:

I love ❤️ to take lots of pictures in public either when am alone or with family. I mean visiting places that needs to be documented is one thing I love too as this helps me save pictures for memory keeping. So there is no way to avoid others coming into your public shots , especially during festivals when we go to the beach 🏖, carnivals 🎡, concerts and family gatherings. 

In this kind of environment, it becomes very difficult to avoid faces you do not know, and can in the future post this pictures in the internet without consulting them because you do not know them. And because of the era we live in, everyone should know that things like this happens and have to accept the times and what is going on in the times.

Social media is a means whereby many are making ends to meet. And many post on daily basis through every day blogging, without caring if anyone shows up in the blog because that is why its called a daily blog with the content creator going on the streets to get what is going on called activities. Although many do it for fame, popularity and growth in the social media, but the see it as things of the era of internet period.

# Approach To Issues Like This:

I believe that every individual has a different perception to issue like this. I mean, why will I suddenly see myself in a background of someone else’s posted pictures or blog? For me I will see it as oh, this is the era of social media , change to old thinking 💭 and how we need to move with times. But others might not see it this way. So for anyone who might take offense of coming across such an act, the best approach to this is to simply ask for the picture or pictures to be taken down. This is simple and without any problem.

So its never a crime or will ever be to share other peoples pictures without knowing what they will feel when it comes across to them. Posting a picture with others in the background is merely a coincidence and should not be taking so seriously. Times has  made many to realize that change is constant, so people I think should move with time, otherwise, those who fill sharing their pictures in a background should avoid public places and should not  attend functions. Its as simple as this because times will continue moving.

Las manos no mienten.
Guardan las evidencias de los hechos que las palabras manipulan.
Muchos las ocultan
para esconder las marcas del tiempo
en el cronómetro de la vida.

Guantes de seda,
anillos de oro y diamantes,
maquillaje efímero de la flacidez de las carnes.
Los dedos
nos avisan primero de que la fecha de caducidad se acerca.

Las manos no mienten,
porque son firmes o tiemblan.
Sostienen o dejan caer.
Ni los ojos ni la boca tienen esa sinceridad perenne.

Las manos no mienten,
por eso, cuando hablabas del futuro
nunca me dejaste sostener las tuyas.

links.title: Overcoming Fear Through Faith
links.body:
>


Everyone has encountered fear at some time in their lives. It can arrive when we're in a problem, uncertainty, sickness, money troubles, or situations that appear larger than us. When we are afraid, we may feel vulnerable, anxious, and paralyzed. But as Christians we are taught that fear shall not take hold of us, the answer is faith. This is how we can find courage and peace in the midst of difficult times when we put our trust in God and His promises.

Many times we are reminded in the Bible not to fear! God says that you must not fear for He is with you (Isaiah 41:10) nor be dismayed, for He is your God. This is a scripture that I find comforting because it reminds me that I am not alone. In every circumstance God is able to lead and uphold me. When I do my focus is on my problems, and fear increases; when I do my focus is on God and His power, and faith increases.



![1001626080.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/julie100/23xL6stDVD1Ubw9bwygwNi1A5rGpiXEGUb5Nq7BPPWTTSL4wFSn9MyzFPDdjCZcZ7b98G.png)


The first realization that I had of this is when I was waiting for an important result. I was extremely concerned because the results would have an impact on my future plans. I was plagued by fear-filled thoughts each day. I had many thoughts about all the bad things I could imagine and couldn't get a good night's rest. During that time I increased my prayer time and spent more time reading God's Word. I was encouraged by one scripture, that read “Be careful for nothing; but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.” Philippians 4:6-7. As I continued to pray, I gradually felt my fear leaving. I came to know God rather than my own understanding. It all worked out great in the end, and I found out that God had been all along.

Faith doesn't take away our problems, but it makes us strong enough to handle them. Peter was able to walk on water to Jesus because he had faith. But while he was looking at the wind and the waves, he became afraid, and began to sink (Matthew 14:29-30). This is a lesson to me that I must learn: When I look at my problems, fear grows, but when I look at Christ, faith grows.

Everyone who is a Christian has to make the journey of overcoming fear by faith. There will be times that will try to make me afraid, but God has given me His promises to cling to. In 2 Timothy 1:7 it says, “For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.” When fear strikes my mind, I say, \

body.title: 人生虚无~
body.body:
![1000029010-00e438c99522.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/muwangxuan/lkt-mr0sbmwb-x4env0rc/1000029010-00e438c99522.webp)

![1000029011-aa56f85a96cc.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/muwangxuan/lkt-mr0sbmwb-x4env0rc/1000029011-aa56f85a96cc.webp)

朋友最近开始喜欢摆弄起花花草草和养鱼。
这让我不禁想起那句流传甚广的“中国人一旦到了某个年纪，就会自动觉醒某项天赋，可能是钓鱼，可能是养花草，可能是种菜……”
这一度让我觉得怀疑，有这么玄嘛？
但伴随着如今的我也慢慢长了年纪，我才知道，或许这并不是什么来自古老的传承，只是一种，人类对抗虚无的方式。
近几年，偶尔就会感觉有点无聊，时不时就会冒出来一点人生好像没啥意思的感觉。
我记得以前我虽然也会感觉无聊，但更多想的是去找个什么活动摆脱一下这种心情。
而现在已经开始感觉到了人生的虚无。
还记得多年前我曾看到有的文章在那里写老人的晚年会很孤独，那时的我就在想，那是因为他们不会玩手机，要是天天打游戏刷视频的，怎么可能会孤独。
 然后我们现在也的确能看到，很多五六十岁的老人其实短视频刷的比我们都还六，从早刷到晚。
乍一看，好像充满了欢声笑语，但当我自己也这么度过一天后，才发现，那种玩手机后的空虚感，其实也十分强烈，甚至强烈到不敢入睡那种，感觉睡觉前那几分钟特别空虚。
所以，人生到某个时间点，解锁某项技能，可能就是为了对抗虚无的。
就好比以前我们最常听到的就是养儿防老。
但这几年开始出现另外一种观点，就是其实养孩子主要是为了以后自己感觉虚无的时候，让人生有个盼头，说白了，孩子其实就是你留在这个世界上的锚。
也有的锚是伴侣，但这种其实很少，因为绝大多数家庭都是奔着你条件不错，你长得也还可以的搭伙过日子去的，感情并不一定多深厚。
所以，大部分人的锚，其实就是孩子。
这也正是解释了为什么其实大部分人都知道所谓的养儿防老有点不切实际，却还是想要孩子的心理。
尤其是在农村长大的人，更能体会到，当自己子女结婚后，慢慢的就会想着分家了，兄弟多的更明显，父亲归谁管，母亲归谁管，都要划分清楚。
有的父母因为不想分成两家人，就会在还能动的时候选择两口子自己在老房子里煮饭吃，等彻底走不动了，在去麻烦子女。
哪怕是独生子，其实只要结婚，有的也会有分小家的想法。
名义上或者户口上不分家，但是饭已经不是在一个灶里吃了。
从小见惯了这些情形的人，又怎么可能不知道养儿防老的大部分真实情况。
但到了某个时间节点，大部分还是会选择去生孩子。
或许是基因为了繁衍，也或许是受主流价值观所影响，也或许是因为想对抗人生的虚无……
正如所有事情都不会只有一个因一样。
你觉得呢？

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | Marrying after the death of a spouse
body.body: > https://youtu.be/5OYmS8syUlo?si=FZIexCnbXQ3e7l4w The subject of remarrying after a spouse's passing is really very heartbreaking and significant. It's about love, loss, healing and God's direction in our lives. When a man or a woman loses a husband or wife, it is one of the most agonizing experiences anyone could endure. The loss can be profound and the feelings of the loved one may stay in the heart for many years. During the Topic Review at the MCGI, I was told that the Bible doesn't say anything against a widow or widower remarrying after the death of their spouse. A couple's covenant commitment to one another is lifelong; not until one of them dies is it dissolved. The Bible states in Romans 7:2 that “For the woman which hath an husband is bound to her husband so long as he liveth.” This makes it clear that the marriage covenant lasts until both parties are alive. But as soon as one spouse passes away, the other one is not tied to that marriage. Also, in 1 Corinthians 7:39 it states: “The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.” This does not mean that remarriage is prohibited but it should be done in God's will. A key point that did touch my heart in the process of this topic, was that God knows how to feel. He knows the pain of loneliness and the need for companionship. Some people may not want to remarry after their spouse dies, while others might want to remarry. The decision of both should be honored. The key is not to seek God's guidance and not to make a decision He will not like. While looking at this topic I recalled a thing from my life. I remember a woman who lost her husband at the end of some years of marriage. She was extremely sad and felt her heart was broken and she had been grieving for a long time. She was thought to not smile again. But after a few years, she came across a good man that treated her kindly and respectfully. They consulted with each other, and they sought God's counsel before they took the plunge. I learned that God can bring healing out of great sorrow; watching her find happiness again. It brought me to a realization that life goes on after death and that God's love lives on in our lives. I was also reminded of the words of the psalm, Psalm 34:18, “The Lord is near unto them that are of a broken heart.” God is near to the one who suffers. He cares for them, encourages them and guides them through His good plan to move forward. Therefore, it is not a sin to get married after a spouse dies, according to the Bible. God allows widows and widowers to remarry, as long as they do it in a manner that pleases Him. I gained a deeper appreciation of God's compassion and wisdom in this topic. It made me realise that God will guide, comfort and bless anyone who chooses to stay single or remarry as they further their journey of faith.

body.title: Flower Macro
body.body:
Like all photography, lighting is a big determining factor in how something might look when shooting something in macro. It's good to experiment with different looks; even a slight change can yield a result you didn't expect. 

I used a single light source for these shots but was moving the light around to get other details to come out and see what kind of look I could achieve for these close-up flower shots. 

I was really focused on the center of the flower, and I found even adjusting the intensity of the light was enough to change the tones. I like doing a variety of shots because when it comes time to edit, there might be ones I didn't like as much or others that looked much better than I thought, so it gives me more options to work with.

body.body: > Assalamu Alaikum. how are you Today I will share with you a Macro Photography. Macro photography means photographing a very small object or organism so closely that even its finest parts are clearly visible. The details that cannot be seen easily with the naked eye can be clearly shown through macro photography. Flower petals, color of butterfly wings, bees, ants, spiders, leaves, drops of water are popular subjects of macro photography. Macro photography is all about capturing the beauty of small things by enlarging the hidden beauty of flowers in front of the camera. Macro photography is not possible with normal cameras. This requires a quality camera or mobile phone. However, patience is required when doing macro photography. Hands should be kept steady. May the picture be beautiful. I have tried to capture the beauty of nature and the point of water in the pictures I have shared. I ended my post today here. Be well. Allah Hafez.Assalamu alaikum.

body.title: Deafet Wilson Fisk
body.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=mavvxen/0ncdf9oa




So, in today's post, we're finally going to defeat Fisk.

Starting from the last checkpoint Spider Man breaks through a door and enters the building where he fights several enemies before moving into the next room. There he meets some police officers but they end up betraying him. Spider Man quickly takes them down and makes his way to the main boss Wilson Fisk. Fisk retreats into a glass control room and orders his heavily armed machine gunners to deal with Spider Man. However, Spider Man destroys them all without much trouble. Furious Fisk charges at Spider Man himself and after an intense fight he smashes Spider Man into another room.
That room is filled with even more enemies. Spider Man is defeated on, he overcomes them all. He then continues his battle with Fisk as they fight their way down through the building. In the end Spider Man traps Wilson Fisk with his web shooters wrapping him up completely in webs.






















![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23tbiE4TErsWeswriQNNuTtGMwg1T6ZsedUAps5SWkxmyZPKeNJ6mo64mhASBGrvF9smt.png)

![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23tRzSy7LQUGGGxJj8KGgSNCYELqbWFTERCXJRQVtYaBEqU65dvCezjdbpELz5et2MNT9.png)





Here, Spider Man breaks through the door and enters the room. After overcoming a few obstacles he finds several enemies waiting to attack him. Spider Man defeats them all and I really enjoy how he keeps talking while fighting. After taking them down Spider Man heads toward the next room.






![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23tbRmAWqMg7AV4aXxTA4yPhvRsRYrKzaKSZgmDTWmg9HVCAKzTo8a9DT8Y9Db1UTHzUF.png)

![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23uEyuCyfPXYUGnTFeY3ASjp3Ft4UhfQZd3zkgPa2bTMYokf8LuUbgL2ue1UXTjfARVWb.png)

![5-5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23wMTp4JBfQUjwjgXq2Ms83he89D9V19vfq2MRCCan3nK5tWAzPwos7NtAxf4g9TwfZyd.png)





After entering this room, Spider Man finds several police officers. He asks them are you all okay and cops reply that they need more cops for backup. As Spider Man starts walking forward, his Spider Sense suddenly warns him and he realizes that the cops have betrayed him. Spider Man then defeats all of them without much trouble.










![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23u5tdoYLBPYU5o51cm3oqfVkTfgdMB6wPZAKHDfdPSrNsZrC5VGj6f8jCYzFBSsSzPs2.png)

![7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23tGY4hdVe3NVQtjf8X8cjXCbgBf6rCxHJumsTam3dYwiUaVRVs4yixJadKuaspqY4Sju.png)





After leaving that room, Spider Man enters Fisk's office where Wilson Fisk is busy signing some documents. Spider Man and Fisk exchange a few words before the fight begins. Confident that Spider Man won't stand a chance Fisk steps into a secure glass room and leaves Spider Man to face several automated machine guns.









![8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23wzze81j4pAzEyo9eL8pwCvN97Yhxts5PgerpF76m1QyurLuL5j8erR5gTAhcoxQxgFi.png)

![9.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23tbRLVXMByXfAuEWfPrmcqMhyaekgxHsvzRqH1UuMdYDD1GYhpCYHjkq8criwU53PWB9.png)




Spider Man quickly destroys the machine guns and throws the wreckage at the glass surrounding Fisk's room shattering it. Seeing this Fisk becomes furious and threatens to finish Spider Man once and for all. At that moment Spider Man's main objective changes to defeating Fisk.

An intense fight breaks out in the room and after taking several heavy hits from Spider Man Fisk grabs him and hurls him into another room.













![10.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23x12nvNYmm9ohdfVj7zF6MVYPFkY93oJr3Sq5hHxvrFCcUMm51riYa1Qu9Loj3wQ8wg3.png)

![11.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23u63AJWvdC9Wd2VVWW9CxWJvRovR9VhivynoiTnvGgi2YcEFaVviEHEaPcnwcc7FWYws.png)





After being thrown into the next room Spider Man discovers that even more enemies are waiting for him. He quickly defeats all of them with ease before continuing the fight.









![12.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23vsJECPh85JWZWKr29DXBJatyLh6GG4rwKPybjJgJnxgjekCZxm9k8Wz8g2AGKnQ7rmB.png)

![13.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23uQr4haQcFreA1pJjCzejjXXxFHhYNFsobLkTezK9F7BPAoy8PDVY9oH4rHqxysiGsxJ.png)

![14.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23uQrdx2f2sjsyHHsQt5vxUFSU8sabUYwzhewbdXUAA3WMSqQLt5siMbcv1fvpamTnWsK.png)



After defeating all the enemies Spider Man faces Fisk in the final battle. During the fight Fisk grabs Spider Man by the throat but Spider Man breaks free counters the attack and lands several powerful blows on Fisk.










![15.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23wMRrNGtYpz3tw2RwucroCcnHqSNteRT7rEinVCZVEceYyCmojYQ8pxSuqAq1RcQxVBM.png)

![16.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mavvxen/23wqaBzKMqsm3XDA9TJBYGZ3npSfSkhZUrGvf9sM4zX6xxq9aCYWKtWrJJpiqoSDQaCi7.png)






After taking so many hits Fisk becomes furious and smashes the floor beneath them. As the fight continues they crash through several floors and make their way down the building.

In the end Spider Man launches Fisk into the air with a series of punches before bringing him down to the ground floor. Then spider Man completely traps Fisk in a giant web using his web shooters. To top it off Spider Man jokingly says So we kiss now

That's all for today's post. More exciting Spider Man gameplay is coming soon, so stay tuned



![edited-photo.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYMcrVcxPPqvuzbLz3aqaFBqwbg19drrZRvUokFsUH3w6/image)






Thank you😚

body.title: Food Court Finds and Family Time: Sharing Good Food And Happy Moments!💗
body.body:
A Beautiful and Wonderful day to each and everyone!👋😊

Hello to all of my friends here and of course to all my dear fellow hivers in this lovely @bayanihive community!😍

How are you all today? I hope everyone is doing well and happy right now. Here I am again, @lj1728 to share another simple life story with you all.💕

![June 2026 Blogs.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23w2wPkqf7aLhfJdHNJAskNqNn663KUZJeju4ZDBuorSpafyhjXDtrPevfnQVR6pUEhUX.png)

Last week, my husband, my son, and I planned to have a simple lunch date at the mall. We did not have a specific restaurant in mind, so I suggested that we eat at the food court instead. I thought it would be the best option since there were so many food stalls to choose from, and everyone could order whatever they were craving. My husband and son agreed right away, so we headed there as soon as we arrived at the mall.

![IMG_5737.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wMYkvZyEd18HvyiJeCTgVYEpQMV7dhH1QUZhHikVscTeHS2ik3wMMsaDyZ821SGXPRW.jpeg)

![IMG_5734.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wqrjjoA4PqCoyddvfbabEwzq53oqVTNhBNrZrvrbEHV3DWwuFGYNQ2oc5AaG1KsavWj.jpeg)

![IMG_5735.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wMhBoehDaF67dYnWUFKFZTSZZhGS3LVDSQ2PiiqBmr6yANqLngJy6H2QctqqfHDQcQx.jpeg)

Luckily, we were able to find an empty table without waiting too long. It was already lunchtime, but the food court was well organized, and people were enjoying their meals with their families and friends. I told my husband and son to choose their food first while I stayed at our table and watched our belongings.

![IMG_5738.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EonmuKWsUtJhVvjdLC9SPqk5XFCJTnq9oeSVYkMLqNiPmdr4w4RL9YNZwoAVf1GZNNH.jpeg)

![IMG_5735.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wMhBoehDaF67dYnWUFKFZTSZZhGS3LVDSQ2PiiqBmr6yANqLngJy6H2QctqqfHDQcQx.jpeg)

![IMG_5736.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EoGzSaGNYyxiuRMfGRBtpxidVSHeKFxa9k5pRSBaTF4U92E8E9AicASpnd2UNPFncgx.jpeg)

After looking around, the two of them decided to order a combo meal from “Lechon Belly Kitchen”. Their meal included crispy lechon kawali, flavorful sisig, two servings of rice, and a bowl of hot soup. It looked like a satisfying meal and was perfect for sharing. Once they had placed their order, it was finally my turn to choose what I wanted to eat. I also told my son to buy some fries from potato corner because I know he loves it!

![IMG_5745.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wMj3j2EM9yccRNmaedMYKBmDJndcWyxfFbF2pWTufqXs9zC93zNKhFF5CCGaPkHi2bK.jpeg)

![IMG_5741.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wCE1asUQef223kgnS1EndNiBfNZH7Q2wuQfhoxXW6ngVwsFZSDNiANjvUukFy5DaowV.jpeg)

![IMG_5743.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/Ep7w4ujj5tqS1BCx3zxx4vXSBCkK4ayK4exwuB7PhyjFy7B814HFm6B2Z3464TtxAfC.jpeg)

![IMG_5742.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23zbYZybdvo9uXZS1oh8a87swsLEKhU1MH6eY3Qfe2PixLf2XGbkZbvArZYkw51yHrHVf.jpeg)

I went to “Kimbob” and ordered my all-time favorite bibimbap. I have always loved Korean food, and bibimbap is one of my comfort meals because it is filling, colorful, and packed with different flavors and fresh vegetables. I was excited to enjoy it again after quite some time.

![IMG_5749.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23tvpq7KkTXVLELCQbcws1fD7c9aFVB566FRHzajBL8C3qy6TKWUx1hk291WTZz3y4Got.jpeg)

![IMG_5752.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23vsWhBH68dQq9pNkQ6D6mMKASMfq39nE9r5nxDXgbyWhLFgQzPPf9YiLG2mx16ZWBRdB.jpeg)

![IMG_5751.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23u6Fzz78jdHgsbajR2YER4qN6RgZnNjgRVfA5jWuSjBAcFBHgGCMCjuQRYLfzqMFWCLc.jpeg)

![IMG_5759.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23xpFHu1Yz5rFBZqDWJ5wSn4wgbgP5eT711Y72FpwUAYqTte5JPSUbzGYaFnN3qNqvvBQ.jpeg)

When all of our orders arrived, we gathered around the table and finally started eating. Everything tasted delicious. The lechon kawali was crispy, the sisig was flavorful, and my bibimbap was just as good as I remembered. We enjoyed every bite while chatting about random things and laughing together.

![IMG_5754.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EoGzsTp4kkBoFq3Y19nhNH6kmFbUjvaPz2YDjRGeTj3NNUcH27Rgt7ssEpvrXfSVMfS.jpeg)

![IMG_5755.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EoEsWLyrEMyRsnTHwxYeqVbyd5DQ1ZQ85x4aNaKg5vsyDxEapv6uMAXaKr9XZ8aGUxj.jpeg)

It was a simple lunch date, but it reminded me that family time is very important and sharing a good meal while creating happy memories are what truly matter! Looking forward to have more family lunch dates like this in the future.💗

And that's it for today's blog! Thank you so much for dropping by and taking the time to read my simple life story. This means a lot to me! I hope you enjoyed it and see you on my next one. Have a nice day ahead to all of us.😍

These photos were mine and taken with my iphone13pro and the lead image was edited through Canva.✍️👩‍💻

Lots of love,
LJ💗

body.title: Letras Inspiradoras: Vacaciones, hasta donde me alcance el dinero ja ja ja.[ESP/ENG]
body.body:
> Hola bellas mujeres en esta comunidad, empezando con @syllem que con este tema sobre las vacaciones me lleno de nostalgia, porque ahora las vacaciones no son como antes, que no las pelaba cada año al salir de clases, pero ya desde la penultima vez que fui hace 14 años, salir a unas seria como la primera vez, pero no pierdo la esperanza de que volvere a tener unas buenas vacaciones y dignas de nosotros. Pero si las vacaciones implica muchas cosas incluido principalmente los gastos: pasaje, hospedaje, comida, paseos. Mis vacaciones pasadas casi siempre fueron a Cumana en Venezuela, porque ahi vivia una tia, ya con esto me ahorraba el hospedaje, me gustaba mucho por las playas y la accesibilidad a ellas, que hasta en bus podiamos ir, con nuestras cosas, que nos dejaba a unas cuadras pero ibamos felices.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoAaCgxh4Q7TygvSW3kbLtTCGRQpaRQuKcUkRHV24yEiX6egEXCw6G8hK4JUdQeGsCc.png) Trujillo 2014.

> Ya en la playa como ibamos a disfrutar, alla mismo comiamos, nada de llevar hecho de casa, porque de eso se trata las vacaciones de disfrutar y olvidar la rutina de la casa. De niña viaje en muchas vacaciones con mi abuela, ya que fui la primera nieta y mi abuela tenia un espiritu aventurero, creo que lo herede de ella je je, con ella conoci mas que con mis padres: fui a Margarita, Cumana, Puerto La Cruz, Barcelona, con mis padres: Caracas, Trujillo.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EqWnf1H463jXUVVF1dq678ivVEiX6GR6o4ma8cMrPtqfVoparxayiR5qffHfcZGzseq.png) El Tigre 2015.

> Pero tengo la esperanza de cuando estemos mejor conocere mas primero de mi Venezuela, porque con tantos Hive que viven aquí, tendre donde llegar, no creo que me digan que no de pernoctar en las noches, porque cuando uno sale de vacaciones la idea es pasear no quedarse dentro de la casa, para eso me quedo en la mia ja ja ja, pero es importante donde pasar las noches para descansar y guardar las cosas.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoyQ1dLRdrSNzXpb3bGgn8thPX3T8tZYXFFnPNgRVWFGn5BgLbWnZQNqPbaMnafdtAT.png) Cumana 2013.

> Yo si me planifico, porque sera que como siempre he sido asi de organizar, planificar todo, anotar, registrar lo que se va llevar, no me gusta el exceso de equipaje. Cuando viajaba sola, estaba soltera igual me planificaba antes del viaje mis padres me daban carta blanca, es decir me daban para los gastos antes del viaje, luego durante el viaje. Ahora con mis hijos como somos mas, los gastos son mas, pero la hemos disfrutado.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/244KNeQt1CFoqdo228L6KeVijhwtpEuL5vCyczeHN94LmwbFJ1ieC9HaGRdFkhKEyuofE.png) Puerto La Cruz 2012

> Eso si ya una vez que se para donde vamos, empiezo a sacar cuentas y a reservar lo de los pasajes de ida y de vuelta, si llego a casa de un familiar, reservo lo del apoyo de los alimentos, aunque igual comeremos algunas veces fuera. Lo de los paseos a lugares en la ciudad destino, porque no todo es playa, me gusta ir a museos, plazas, centros comerciales, cine no puede faltar.

> Cuando ya veo que los fondos o sea el dinero ya se va terminando, ya es hora de regresar, pero con la felicidad de que esos dias se disfrutaron. Asi que a quienes voy a invitar a esta dinamica pilas que algun dia me llegue por alla @anasuleidy @sacra97 @amymari @purrix aquí el enlace de la dinamica https://hive.blog/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-vacaciones-haciendo-que

> Mis fotos del baul de los recuerdos de algunas vacaciones pasadas con mis hijos, bendita sea el invento de las camaras fotograficas. Traduccion realizada con la app DeepL. Portada editada en Canva.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/242sGaoyF7i81S9gwVKicXKybW23aa8Rvu2oNxRSRwxAL3thUUx9Tai1G7qZYCGNBAvef.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23x1DUm9V7TKzj4PnHsHeXjkGYdbbcukM5P9HT5LhmywLtcLsz3g9xJ526BNauWAo8TCt.png)

> Hello, beautiful women in this community! Starting with @syllem, who—with this topic about vacations—has filled me with nostalgia, because vacations aren’t what they used to be. I used to look forward to them every year when school let out, but since the second-to-last time I went on vacation 14 years ago, going on one now would feel like the first time all over again. Still, I haven’t lost hope that I’ll have another great vacation—one that’s truly worthy of us. But vacations involve a lot of things, mainly expenses: travel, lodging, food, and sightseeing. My past vacations were almost always to Cumana in Venezuela, because an aunt of mine lived there—which saved me on lodging. I really liked it because of the beaches and how easy it was to get to them; we could even go by bus with all our stuff. The bus would drop us off a few blocks away, but we were happy just to be there.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoAaCgxh4Q7TygvSW3kbLtTCGRQpaRQuKcUkRHV24yEiX6egEXCw6G8hK4JUdQeGsCc.png) Trujillo 2014.

> Once we were at the beach, we were ready to enjoy ourselves. We ate right there—no bringing food from home—because that’s what vacations are all about: enjoying yourself and forgetting the daily routine. As a child, I went on many vacations with my grandmother, since I was her first granddaughter and she had an adventurous spirit—I think I inherited that from her, hehe. I got to see more places with her than with my parents: I went to Margarita, Cumana, Puerto La Cruz, and Barcelona; with my parents, I went to Caracas and Trujillo.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EqWnf1H463jXUVVF1dq678ivVEiX6GR6o4ma8cMrPtqfVoparxayiR5qffHfcZGzseq.png) El Tigre 2015.

> But I’m hopeful that once things get better, I’ll get to know my Venezuela better first, because with so many Hive members living here, I’ll have places to stay. I don’t think anyone will turn me down if I ask to stay overnight, because when you go on vacation, the idea is to go out and explore, not stay cooped up inside—I can do that at home, ha ha ha. But it’s important to have a place to spend the night so I can rest and keep my things safe.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoyQ1dLRdrSNzXpb3bGgn8thPX3T8tZYXFFnPNgRVWFGn5BgLbWnZQNqPbaMnafdtAT.png) Cumana 2013.

> I do plan ahead—I guess it’s because I’ve always been this organized: planning everything, taking notes, and keeping track of what I’m going to bring. I don’t like traveling with too much luggage. When I traveled alone—I was single at the time—I still planned everything before the trip. My parents gave me free rein; that is, they gave me money for expenses before the trip and then during the trip. Now that I have my kids and there are more of us, the expenses are higher, but we’ve still enjoyed it.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/244KNeQt1CFoqdo228L6KeVijhwtpEuL5vCyczeHN94LmwbFJ1ieC9HaGRdFkhKEyuofE.png) Puerto La Cruz 2012

> That said, once we’ve decided where we’re going, I start crunching the numbers and booking our round-trip tickets. If I’m staying with a relative, I make arrangements for food, although we’ll still eat out a few times. As for outings to places in the destination city—because it’s not all about the beach—I like going to museums, plazas, shopping malls, and of course, the movies are a must.

> When I see that my funds—that is, my money—are running out, it’s time to head back, but with the joy of knowing that I truly enjoyed those days. So, to those I’m inviting to join this challenge—keep your eyes peeled in case I end up visiting you someday: @anasuleidy @sacra97 @amymari @purrix. Here’s the link to the challenge: https://hive.blog/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-vacaciones-haciendo-que

> My photos from the treasure chest of memories of past vacations with my kids—bless the invention of cameras. Translation done with the DeepL app. Cover edited in Canva.

 In the examination hall, a student, holding a question paper in his hand, started looking around for the answer. The teacher, seeing this, said with a smile, “If you didn’t look for the answer in the book all year, now there is no use in looking for the answer in the examination hall.” The student lowered his head in shame and realized that last-minute efforts can never be a substitute for regular hard work. To do well in the examination, you have to study carefully from the beginning. Preparing on time also increases your confidence and there is no fear. body.body:
[UPS](https://sites.usp.br/cdccenglish/cinema-paradiso/)
Today, I'm writing this post to put into practice an idea that I had been developing for quite some time. However, with the creation of this new project (led by acidyo, who, by the way... encouraged me to move forward with what I had already been planning), I think the time has come to make it happen. One of the best ways to encourage engagement is through contests, especially when there are new projects... So, here we go! This is the first (of many, I hope... because everything will depend exclusively on the participation of each and every one of you) contest from the Scrobble Life community. In this first edition, anyone who wants to participate needs to think of a movie that brings back a particular memory (whether good or bad). The idea is to write about the reasons why that movie is special to the person writing about it. The more personal it is, the more interesting it becomes. Please pay attention to the basic rules (otherwise, your post will not be accepted): Write a review (with at least 250 words) using Scrobble.Life specifically so that the project can grow sustainably (and meaningfully) within the ecosystem. Don't know how to do that? Feel free to post your question in the comments section of this post, and I'll reply as soon as possible. It's simple, easy, and a lot of fun to take part in this project, especially if you genuinely enjoy movies. For now, the next editions of the contest will depend on the success of this first step. My idea is to organize a themed contest with different editions. I'm still refining that part of the concept, but you can be sure it will be something very interesting. If you'd like to help the project grow, join this contest and, if possible, promote it however you can. Together, we can make this project become a reference. Last but not least, the prizes are 350 HIVE (sponsored by acidyo) and 50K ECENCY POINTS (sponsored by me). The deadline to participate is July 15. I will choose THREE WINNERS to receive the main prize, but all participants will receive a participation award (provided their posts comply with the rules mentioned above). That's all for now, everyone... I hope to see all of you in this new adventure. ---
**[CONCURSO] Scrobble Life: Películas, con recuerdos.**
Hoy, estoy escribiendo esta publicación para poner en práctica una idea que ya venía madurando desde hacía algún tiempo; sin embargo, con la creación de este nuevo proyecto (liderado por acidyo, quien, por cierto... me animó a seguir adelante con lo que ya había planeado), creo que ha llegado el momento de hacer que las cosas sucedan. Una de las mejores maneras de intentar promover la participación es a través de concursos, especialmente cuando existen proyectos nuevos... Así que, ¡allá vamos! Este es el primer (de muchos, eso espero... porque todo dependerá exclusivamente de la participación de cada uno de ustedes) concurso de la comunidad Scrobble Life. En esta primera edición, quienes deseen participar deberán pensar en alguna película que les traiga un recuerdo en particular (ya sea bueno o malo). La idea es escribir las razones que hacen que esa película sea especial para quien escribe sobre ella. Cuanto más personal sea, más interesante será. Atención a las reglas básicas (de lo contrario, su publicación no será aceptada): escribir una reseña (con al menos 250 palabras) utilizando específicamente Scrobble.Life para que el proyecto crezca de manera sostenible (y relevante) dentro del ecosistema. ¿No sabes cómo hacerlo? Puedes escribir tu duda en la sección de comentarios de esta publicación y te responderé lo antes posible. Es simple, fácil y muy divertido participar en este proyecto, especialmente si realmente te gustan las películas. Por ahora, las próximas ediciones del concurso dependerán del éxito de este primer paso. Mi idea es promover un concurso temático, con diferentes ediciones. Esa parte de la idea todavía la estoy perfeccionando, pero pueden estar seguros de que será algo muy interesante. Si quieres incentivar el crecimiento del proyecto, participa en este concurso y, si es posible, promuévelo por ahí de la mejor manera que puedas. Juntos, podemos hacer que este proyecto se convierta en una referencia. Por último, pero no menos importante, los premios son 350 HIVE (patrocinados por acidyo) y 50K PUNTOS ECENCY (patrocinados por mí). El plazo para participar es hasta el 15 de julio. Elegiré a TRES GANADORES para recibir el premio principal, pero todos los participantes recibirán un premio de participación (si sus publicaciones cumplen con las reglas mencionadas anteriormente). Por ahora eso es todo, amigos... Espero verlos a todos ustedes en esta nueva aventura. ---
**[CONCURSO] Scrobble Life: Filmes, com memórias.**
Oi, pessoal. Tudo bem com vocês? Hoje, eu estou escrevendo este post para colocar em prática uma ideia que eu já vinha amadurecendo já faz um tempo; porém, com a criação desse novo projeto (liderado por acidyo, que aliás... me incentivou a seguir em frente com o que eu já havia planejando), acho que chegou o momento de fazer a coisa acontecer. Uma das melhores maneiras de tentar promover engajamento é através de concursos, principalmente quando existem projetos novos... Então, lá vamos nós! Esse é o primeiro (de muitos, assim espero... porque tudo vai depender exclusivamente da participação de cada um de vocês) concurso da comunidade Scrobble Life. Minha ideia é promover um concurso temático, com diferentes edições. Essa parte da ideia eu ainda estou aprimorando, mas podem ter certeza de que será algo muito interessante. Se você quiser incentivar o projeto a crescer, participe desse concurso e se possível o promova por aí da melhor maneira que você conseguir. Juntos, podemos fazer esse projeto se tornar uma referência. Por último, mas não menos importante, as premiações são 350 HIVE (patrocinados por acidyo) e 50K PONTOS ECENCY (patrocinados por mim). O prazo para participar é até o dia 15 de julho. Eu irei escolher TRÊS VENCEDORES para receber o prêmio principal, mas todos os competidores irão ganhar um prêmio de participação (se suas publicações estiverem de acordo com as regras mencionadas acima). Por quanto é isso, pessoal... Espero ver todos vocês nessa nova aventura. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/contest-scrobble-life-movies-with-memories-dxk)

body.title: Giveaway: 100+ Packs and 10,000+ STEL for the First Pilots to Enlist
body.body:
> The airlock is opening, and we're not letting the first pilots through empty-handed.

We're giving away more than 100 Genesis card packs and more than 10,000 STEL to the pilots who enlist now.

Follow and comment, and one guaranteed pack is already yours. Everything past that is you stacking the odds in your favor.

![A Stellarch pilot at an opening starship airlock with a Genesis card pack, a STEL coin, and the gold First Pilot card drifting in golden light](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPraNCqKQV4RfWY67mdUCrnfzrWDmA4wsDbghqDeCFC1k/stellarch-giveaway-hero.jpg)

___

## What is in the pool

Two prize stacks make up the draw pool, pulled by ticket:

- **100 Genesis card packs.** Unopened packs of real, ownable cards.
- **Ten prizes of 1,000 STEL each.** That's 10,000 STEL total, and every one of them lands as a staked position locked for three months after launch.

That headline is the floor, not the ceiling. Every task you finish also banks guaranteed rewards on top of the draw, which is why the real total runs past 100 packs and past 10,000 STEL.

![A vault hoard of Genesis card packs beside a blazing gold STEL coin, the giveaway prize pool](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSPbMh8Wb4e9g66XV9vfrapPxUZQ9SHnFuop4jRhNYKLg/stellarch-prize-pool.jpg)

A locked stake isn't dead weight. While it sits locked it earns a share of the daily staking rewards, so a 1,000-STEL prize keeps paying out across the full three months.

Straight answer on the timing: STEL staking is being built right now, so it's not live yet. Your staked prize is granted and starts its three-month lock when staking goes live around launch, and it earns the whole time it's locked. The giveaway is how you reserve your place in it.

___

## Step one: follow and comment

This is the base requirement, and it's the only one that's mandatory. Follow [@stellarch](https://peakd.com/@stellarch) here on Hive and leave a comment on this post. Do that and you're in:

- **One guaranteed Genesis pack**, yours on top of the draw (it doesn't come out of the 100-pack pool).
- **One ticket** in the grand draw for the packs and the STEL stakes.

One thing that matters: comment with the Hive account you actually plan to play the closed alpha with. That account is how we match your entry to your rewards later, so use the real one.

![A pilot pressing a gold follow sigil as a Genesis card pack materializes, the guaranteed base reward](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQECxdxy2gnzDCJKwE8hnctJPyBJ25HmTTQWobLo9Zk9x/stellarch-base-enlist.jpg)

___

## Stack it up: enlist on the alpha waitlist

Sign up for the closed-alpha waitlist with that same account, and your haul grows: **100 STEL**, granted as a staked position locked for three months after launch, the same deal as the grand prizes. It also drops a second ticket into the draw.

You earn this one by showing up. Join the closed alpha with the account you commented with, run through the [getting-started guide](https://stellarch.io/en/docs/getting-started), and play a few matches. The staked STEL is yours.

Enlisting carries a bonus that is already real today: every confirmed pilot gets **The First Pilot**, a free gold-foil Genesis promo card minted straight to your collection when the airlock opens.

**Enlist here:** https://stellarch.io/en/#waitlist

![The gold-foil First Pilot Genesis card with a STEL coin orbiting it on a dark slate console](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYRhptkhWjGeE6h9dwQMrBksbyWoSaFvMhvB7BhNwD9TE/stellarch-first-pilot-card.jpg)

___

## Stack it higher: back us on Product Hunt

Stellarch launches on Product Hunt soon, and the warm-up matters more than the day itself. Follow our Product Hunt page now so you get pinged the second we go live. That's worth **three more guaranteed Genesis packs**, plus a third ticket into the draw.

The catch is the proof. Follow the page, open the menu on our profile, and screenshot the view that shows the **Unfollow Stellarch** option. If the menu reads Unfollow, you're following, and that screenshot is your receipt. Drop it in your comment. It has to look like this:

![Product Hunt follow proof: the profile menu showing the Unfollow Stellarch option, which confirms you are following](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdbCTaTNptJqTDCy75V5CqNHdj7hDC7N8zr6MaJ2VZv5E/ph-follow-proof-example.png)

**Follow the page:** https://www.producthunt.com/products/stellarch

We're not asking you to upvote. Product Hunt doesn't allow makers to solicit votes, and the launch is still weeks out anyway. Right now, the follow is all that counts.

___

## How winners are drawn, and how you claim

The entry window runs **one week** from today. Every task you finish drops a ticket in the pool: follow and comment for your first, sign up for the alpha for a second, back us on Product Hunt for a third. More tickets mean more chances, and the draw can pull the same name more than once, so double and triple wins are on the table. When the window closes, we pull the 100 Genesis packs and the ten 1,000-STEL stakes from every ticket in the pool.

Your guaranteed rewards and anything you win in the draw land on your account and are **claimed during the closed alpha**, through the in-game claim screen. That claim screen and the STEL staking it pays into are the two pieces we're building right now, which is exactly why the prizes settle in the alpha and not a day before. Claim them in the alpha and they carry through to release. Leave them unclaimed and they're forfeited.

![A holographic in-game claim console showing a Genesis pack and a staked STEL coin ready to redeem](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfGP3xFSaDmwgDWKu3G17geeEDHsBs8Cc19fiY5QmM7Jn/stellarch-claim-console.jpg)

___

## A quick word on the STEL

STEL is your stake in Stellarch: governance and staking, the long game. We're upfront that the rewards are phased. SGC is the ranked reward at launch, and STEL becomes the ranked reward, with a STEL-to-SGC burn path, once the economy is steady. Winning a staked STEL position now puts you on the right side of that from the start.

What you win here is real, ownable, and yours to trade once the lock lifts.

![The three Stellarch currency coins, SGC, STEL, and KRED, with the gold STEL token glowing at center](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYQpBMRkLALxZuMWhWaT1imxeBrND8knhCvqrhiBM7nYY/stellarch-currencies.jpg)

___

## Your enlistment checklist

Run the list. Each step stacks on the last.

1. **Follow [@stellarch](https://peakd.com/@stellarch) on Hive.**
2. **Comment** on this post with the Hive account you will play the alpha with. *(1 guaranteed pack plus your first draw ticket.)*
3. **Enlist on the [closed-alpha waitlist](https://stellarch.io/en/#waitlist)** with that same account. *(100 staked STEL plus a second draw ticket, earned by playing the alpha.)*
4. **Follow our [Product Hunt page](https://www.producthunt.com/products/stellarch)**, screenshot the follow, post it in your comment. *(3 more guaranteed packs plus a third draw ticket.)*

Run all four and you're holding four guaranteed packs, a staked STEL position, The First Pilot card, and three tickets in the draw before you've played a single match.

![A glowing four-step enlistment roster in a dark hangar with a Genesis pack and the First Pilot card](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUgKVYSeTEN33TdAiE9UfLToeCUNzM4Er9zbvo3d8REwy/stellarch-enlistment-roster.jpg)

The airlock opens for the alpha soon. Be on the roster when it does.

**Claim your spot:** https://stellarch.io/en/#waitlist

___

### Enlist & stay in the loop

- **Follow @stellarch on Hive** → https://peakd.com/@stellarch

body.title: ⚔️ Survival Bracket Testing Continues
body.body:
# ⚔️ Survival Bracket Testing Continues


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/23u5vM7Ne3gF7EEYjDDEMo3hhmm1erK6RhDSU7UbzksJm7NENtfpPNv8Rb1JzCR86MQRy.png)


A new Survival season is underway, and we're continuing to expand testing across the Survival Brackets.

The feedback from previous seasons has been incredibly valuable, and we'll continue offering **bonus Glint rewards** over the next few seasons as we prepare for the Modern Ranked Bracket overhaul.

If you're planning to participate this season, here's everything you need to know.

---

# 🎁 Bonus Glint Rewards

Players who complete **250 Survival battles** during the season and submit feedback are eligible for the following rewards:

* **250,000 Glint** — Complete **250 battles**, maintain a **50% or higher win rate**, and submit feedback.
* **100,000 Glint** — Complete **250 battles** and submit feedback, even if you finish below a 50% win rate. Eligibility will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

---

# 📝 Feedback Form

To be considered for the bonus Glint rewards, please complete the feedback form after you've finished your Survival battles for the season.

### Submit your feedback here:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScGd-zjcaHZQONMBNTEaRa4JspRryD9LyGc1ka1OODRILqtXQ/viewform?usp=header

Your feedback helps us improve matchmaking, bracket balance, bot behavior, and the overall Survival experience.

---

# 📋 What You Need to Know

* **Survival Brackets 1–5** will continue to be **Modern, manual play only**.
* Players who complete **250 battles**, meet the reward requirements, and submit feedback are eligible for the bonus Glint rewards listed above.
* Beginning **the season after next**, Survival ratings will begin using **seasonal rating resets**, similar to Ranked play. If you've climbed the ladder, you won't return to zero each season.
* **Bracket 6** will switch to **Manual Wild** play for players who prefer using Wild cards. **Bracket 6 is not eligible** for the additional Glint rewards.

---

# 🏆 Which Bracket Should You Choose?

Choose the bracket that best matches your collection—or the cards you intend to rent.

| Bracket       | Format                                                      |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Bracket 1** | **Novice Modern** *(Level 1 cards only)*                    |
| **Bracket 2** | **Bronze Modern** *(Common 3, Rare 2, Epic 2, Legendary 1)* |
| **Bracket 3** | **Silver Modern** *(Common 5, Rare 4, Epic 3, Legendary 2)* |
| **Bracket 4** | **Gold Modern** *(Common 8, Rare 6, Epic 5, Legendary 3)*   |
| **Bracket 5** | **Diamond Modern** *(Max-level cards)*                      |


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/EnyoWibpfkXyGBY2NhSChKpkSvWz5j6uFpYzGhXc953NjjYcF3wiF1APwM2oUv3k7Hw.png)


We encourage everyone to choose a bracket that fits their collection and **stay in that bracket for the next few seasons**. This consistency will help us properly tune the upcoming rating reset system and overall matchmaking.

Our liquidity bots will continue targeting card levels appropriate for each bracket, and we'll be making adjustments throughout the coming seasons as we continue refining the experience.

---

# 💬 Thank You

A huge thank you to everyone who has participated in Survival Bracket testing so far.

Your battles and feedback are helping shape the future of Survival. Every season gives us more data to improve matchmaking, balance the brackets, and deliver the best possible experience ahead of the **Modern Ranked Bracket overhaul**.

We appreciate your continued support and look forward to seeing you in the arena this season!

body.title: Unholy Father.
body.body: > Joining Lif to assassinate Wigmund's loyal priest in Walden, I used my raven to track the target inside the local church. After navigating past village fights, I fought through several waves of Saxon soldiers, executed the priest, gathered a Book of Knowledge, and looted the area before completing the quest with Lif. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWGcMpmyWAFZo3Qkf74cijeLNwgKpdbRcJxqhUhVqnEXX/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXLqmPwyiH8wPCSJT7og5c4qZo87C9RbS9BK97prmHxgC/screenshot_2_.png) This time, I joined Lif in a plot to assassinate the priest of Walden, a man loyal to Wigmund. And I found Lif, along with some of his men, close to Walden. I spoke to him and asked the regular questions to understand his motive, looking for any signs of hesitation in his posture. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTNdq53FbFkComnigcz6HaQU8SthPtsWiao2xiDQFrN1G/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNd1VrDJvRDe2yxL4BTGFrUC6P1fcJ9DgtyMN2T6C9dqY/screenshot_4_.png) Lif suggested his warriors will distract the Saxon forces at the gate when I and him will find the priest. I called my raven first to check around, and I understood the priest should be inside the church. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmceRaK1qBfSNoafkz2iEjpWP7ZSTWMLhnUstdCgaqk3jA/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcmvssgchddqWV3i211Sn3HxX6kteJKgRaBSAZYWzw6D8/screenshot_6_.png) We navigated around and went close to the church from an alternative way, while the men of Lif were fighting the Saxon soldiers in the village. And I was looking for a way to get inside the church quietly. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWGkA6Rg1gVtEUwqaA31G6DPjDJw4G8USKN6spxhK6WSW/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNm2o8Dh7Amcj7a2H4WLFFxnCtS8RF9sg9SaPgy1QPBtR/screenshot_8_.png) After getting close to the church, I shot down this guard on watch. I noticed the main entrance of the church was guarded by a handful of Saxon soldiers, with their heavy shields blocking the archway completely. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmekRKXDE8kZcyE3UY1RJLSGV3JXnzJwBHzVsb8qd6VKtj/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVqMxPg7ispynkVSvbHocFsLVTMAcL8Y42QRrHUs4GXRH/screenshot_10_.png) While I was looking for an alternative way to get inside the church, I assassinated two Saxon soldiers on my way. And then I had to fight more of them inside the church, as I was detected. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQmUGEUDS72sMAeufQnb8whX1YGEsm3z93He6yEP5sfEc/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaXCNzebMHzurLbhmfFqMSWveB8bZyRPEaVsgoTg26Gwu/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW8Das5ezJSX2nHBphhVkcZM9jhpX5juBndejwGdUZFWx/screenshot_13_.png) I had to get outside again as there came some more soldiers to fight us. And there I took them down brutally, beheaded one of them. And I noticed they were the guards at the entrance. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT25DnkMy7YhLipyJQNkJQb6h28NRq6YG6dPtnhvFoddm/screenshot_14_.png) Before getting back in, I stopped there to try this photo for the thumbnail, where both me and Lif were shown. I tried the in game logo in the photo mode so I didn't have to try photoshop. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbN4j36FvStFRNPsYPNdNXMPuDCrQj1neCfs77BWyb46V/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdr9Fq9dgZyBLGna5u9mJu6NZWfqwf4Jdi77ToSiyC6hb/screenshot_16_.png) After getting inside the church again, I found the priest, and there was a guard beside him, whom I didn't notice. So I took down the guard first, and then I assassinated the priest as well. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWk1EdVEsjncmqBprFchoUuGBYDwcSSZa8QHM6JPr1gCZ/screenshot_17_.png) Now that I was done taking care of the priest, I had to escape Walden. But before that, I collected this book of knowledge which gave me a special ability. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUKRP4tDbzLKtv8GMTzPGcx9anbVcFZw6gqvJSfRMYAaq/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVTu7L9v8r1rA1HZ97MdT56MADSPvkjDvpKfnWfq7anoK/screenshot_19_.png) I was not escaping the place without collecting the loots I could get from the village. And for that, I had to fight more Saxon soldiers on my way. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfXXNoGFuVVu2kBfr2FJRM8itGya9r2mH91M71fFvReyv/screenshot_20_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQa38i9Sz3qfqgfkD1A4aHMUJ77kujgGcpY8wVE2xNHMT/screenshot_21_.png) While I was taking care of the enemy forces, I got some cool captures as you can see. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf6oanc3krsBBfRysJSF7QaZBHzNEjn3EYV3PAQreqY2u/screenshot_22_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWZ6ZEaTEbvAYPCtzomRiSqLwHtvPC1ggh9t4VnttAYiZ/screenshot_23_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTjZtTpvbzqeJuQigZk9dMVbnXeT9mwicJn8UtpeuCXjg/screenshot_24_.png) Once I was done collecting all the loot I could from the place, I called Synin to check around, and then I went outside the village and spoke to Lif once again to complete the quest. That's all for now. --- ▶ [Watch on 3speak.tv](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=coooldude/unholy-father-996)

body.title: The story of the aroma and taste of a bakery ☕🧁
body.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmao1eZLzM1HPEDkpAqQ7UzAcXVeLmpPBTEhKZNCiQ521S/1782829969142.jpg) It's always a great feeling to get out in the afternoon to escape the monotony of a busy life. Today, on such a lazy afternoon, I was craving something sweet and a hot cup of tea or coffee. So without further ado, I headed to a local bakery shop. As soon as I stepped into the shop, the familiar sweet aroma of freshly baked cakes and pastries instantly made my heart feel better. The glass display cabinet of the shop was decorated with a variety of delicious foods that were bound to make your mouth water. The top shelf was lined with rows of pound cakes and rolls, the middle shelf with tempting muffins and crispy patties. And the soft bun and sweet tart placed underneath it all together is like a heavenly scene! Since I was too greedy to handle, I chose several wonderful items. Some of which you can see in the picture. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY4kNWV732aQhbVbUM9mP6JxvKoG1L4mrkSH1jHHpXnoT/1782829969521.jpg) The hot patties and pastries, with a golden glow on top, caught my eye from the glass showcase. When the food arrived on the plate, the hot smoke and crispy texture were irresistible. I especially tried their signature triangle and roll patties, which had an incredibly spicy and delicious filling inside. The first bite made the crunchy parts break apart in my mouth, creating a heavenly taste. I shared that wonderful close-up shot of the food. The combination of these hot patties and sweet muffins with a cup of steaming coffee was just perfect. The soft lighting of the bakery and the soft music in the background made the atmosphere even more peaceful. For a while, I forgot all the hustle and bustle of life and found a different kind of happiness in this small meal. Sometimes it's those simple afternoons that add extraordinary memories to our lives.

body.title: The most beautiful rock – Milky quartz
body.body:
>

<center>![portada.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parauri/EoGzGkWEw29wt5wgysuxRq6QZU325umvHzRpKNnSF8K8WkpZPWGJMcb4mCXoahy76Xs.JPG)</center>


Hello, I greet you from this beautiful space dedicated to the vastness of nature. From here, I wish to express my admiration for those who share a special connection with the natural world. I also want to express my solidarity with my fellow Venezuelans; living in Colombia, I am deeply saddened by the tragedy unfolding in my home country following the earthquakes that struck it—a reminder that nature can be as fierce as it is beautiful.


Speaking of natural beauty, I am presenting my entry for the \

contest. For this, I chose a stone that is incredibly common worldwide; in fact, it can be found in diverse environments ranging from beaches, mountains, and forests to deserts and even urban areas. I am referring to Milky Quartz. We encounter it so frequently in our daily lives that we have all grown up seeing it, and many of us even collected it as children. I admit that I, too, was fascinated by rock collecting at one point in my life—a hobby I’ve left behind, though I still keep my collection safe back in Venezuela.



![1.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parauri/EonnSYptmdo3LTWC4CiUnxc1CAFRAJ77PFpVyNVW3pLDhSwGJ63vWpK8qRmdY7ATDLL.JPG)


![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parauri/EoGyuzzKWTDfYpR1CMU8ooTaZX567MP6bMq8ajQgM36eKmvAcbD5RXnhxW3RjTLfp4y.JPG)




[Milky Quartz](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuarzo_lechoso) is a type of quartz that, as I mentioned earlier, is very common; in fact, this white variety is considered the most abundant quartz in the world. It has a milky, whitish-yellowish hue that might look \

at first glance. However, it is fascinating to learn about this seemingly ordinary rock: I discovered that it is composed primarily of silicon dioxide and contains tiny air bubbles within its structure—features that give it its characteristic opaque white color while still retaining a hint of transparency. I knew none of this about a stone I had seen so often throughout my life. I invite you to learn more [here](https://www.mindat.org/photoscroll.php?searchbox=Milky+Quartz+with+Quartz). ![3.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parauri/EogPHUUQ9ZvPNdaEmgw4AWKPmFDWW6zJ5idWNR6AnWXkNfaFGWf8Xrg4X4wwpbhYsyc.JPG) ![4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parauri/EoptotTQBLZXXqcLaBWdkW8Vjjc45BSoyrxAtNAHHUo44bMYZthywRGqpds8M89FX7F.JPG) ![5.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parauri/Eoc8U1bjCfB1VBa1ZX2BTTzPQHX8CsthvsU4J4UaLPKCsbRGcfbkJuxFKNHVgMyfhSz.JPG) This mineral is considered one of the crystals with the greatest spiritual value and the most powerful within the quartz family. Regarding its age in Antioquia, Colombia, milky quartz formed during the Late Cretaceous period as magma cooled deep within the Earth's crust; it was also used as a tool by pre-Hispanic populations. You can learn more about its value and importance [here](https://www2.sgc.gov.co/Publicaciones/Cientificas/NoSeriadas/Documents/recursos-minerales-de-colombia-vol-1.pdf). ![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parauri/Ep1YuRrT5gXyM5YRjZEpo7YW4h9DKyozCQrJnSPcxvpyM46xWx6PeVJLkZxakdfopZ5.JPG) ![7.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parauri/Eos2ho72ki1EWkJHLevitkUMCy2k8VTaaChQRXzWugWk7aAkUjUdGTZBWro7r72uaVx.JPG) ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parauri/EoeGqkqDDSC54CxTphkERY9RUuqqRtnpqQHoXGhd99ruaD8UTi6dsuRZPG1AmMGE1nD.JPG) ![9.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parauri/EoiX9rzP7KnzSUXt78AP3npfB69gx5dx6CY67tNMcKE9VfHntCtkLdfnvQ6d524Kvvb.JPG) Today, milky quartz is used in the glass industry and in jewelry making. It is a rock that is both common and beautiful, and is highly valued in various fields. When you see this stone on your path, remember that it is very valuable and think about how old it is; to me, that is the greatest value a rock can have. I invite @gsbilbao, @emmaris, @eumelysm, and @jordy0827 to join [Amazing Nature (AN)](https://peakd.com/c/hive-174680/created) and participate in its amazing contests.
A hug!
>! [Spanish] Hola, los saludo desde este espacio hermoso, dedicado a la inmensidad de la naturaleza. Desde aquí quiero expresar mi admiración a quienes tienen una especial relación con lo natural. También desde este espacio quiero expresar mi solidaridad a los hermanos venezolanos, pues desde Colombia sufro por la tragedia que se vive en mi país, Venezuela tras los terremotos que la azotaron y es que la naturaleza es tan agresiva como bella. Hablando de belleza en la naturaleza, presentaré mi entrada al concurso La roca más hermosa. Para participar elegí una piedra que es una de las rocas muy comunes en el mundo, de hecho, se puede encontrar en distintos medios ambientes, como playas, montañas, bosques, desérticos y también urbanos. Me refiero al Cuarzo lechoso, que con facilidad nos los encontramos en la cotidianidad, tanto así que todos hemos crecido viéndolo y hasta muchos de nosotros lo hemos coleccionado en nuestra infancia. Levanto la mano para reconocer mi fascinación por coleccionar rocas en una oportunidad de mi vida, aunque ya quedó en el pasado pero que mantengo guardada en mi país Venezuela. El [Cuarzo lechoso](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuarzo_lechoso), es un tipo de cuarzo que como dije al inicio, es una roca muy común, además, hasta se considera que este tipo de cuarzo blanco es el que más abunda en el mundo. Es una piedra de color lechoso, como blanquecina y amarillenta, que, si la vez parece que está sucia, pero resulta interesante conocer sobre esta roca considerada común porque aprendí que está compuesta principalmente de dióxido de silicio y que en su estructura hay burbujas de aire, por todo esto se debe su color blanco opaco con un poco de transparencia al mismo tiempo. Nada de eso lo sabía sobre esta piedra que vi en la cotidianidad de mi vida. Te invito a conocer [aquí](https://www.mindat.org/photoscroll.php?searchbox=Milky+Quartz+with+Quartz) A este mineral se le considera uno de los cristales de mayor valor espiritual y el más poderoso entre la familia de los cuarzos. Sobre su antigüedad en Antioquia, aquí en Colombia, el cuarzo lechoso se formó durante el Cretácico Tardío cuando el magma se enfrió en las profundidades de la corteza y sobre su uso tuvo utilidad como herramienta por las poblaciones prehispánicas. Mira su valor e importancia [aquí](https://www2.sgc.gov.co/Publicaciones/Cientificas/NoSeriadas/Documents/recursos-minerales-de-colombia-vol-1.pdf). En la actualidad el cuarzo lechoso es usado en la industria del vidrio y también en joyería. Es una roca muy común como bella, apreciada en distintas áreas. Cuando veas esta piedra en tu camino, recuerda que es muy valiosa y piensa en la cantidad de años que tiene para mi ese es el mayor valor que puede tener una roca. Invito a @gsbilbao, @emmaris, @eumelysm y @jordy0827 a unirse a [Amazing Nature (AN)](https://peakd.com/c/hive-174680/created)y participar de sus increíbles concursos.
¡Un abrazo!
