body.title: Kiddo's Summer Vacation 2: Morning Walks at the Old Airport's Runway
body.body:
>

It's her summer vacation, but I still have to work graveyard shifts. I couldn't accompany her for sightseeing frequently. One morning, in one of my rest days, we planned to have a walk at the Old Airport's Runway and have a breakfast at the diner near the shore. 

At our hometown, baywalks are far from our location, so she couldn't enjoy this more often unlike with her other cousins who has motorbikes. It's more convenient for them to go wherever they want everytime. 

![1000160726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EpvhpnhH1asTjdSVeZkz5mEuPVFHdQNhNhkcK7h4d3JrHmZxSkCMGfddPxayy3aj7WT.jpg)

Though she's not that demanding, she still mentions what she wants sometimes  and one of them is to go to the sea. Well, as a parent, it hurts more if you can't provide what your child desires even in the simplest of things. Sure, expensive toys can make up for it but giving the most simple thing to them is sometimes the hardest to give. It's a challenge to build a relationship if it's difficult to find time to be together. 

![1000160740.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EqfGp1BwbrLuQys4KtkbS8jSUinD1RZsxaHd72wM5FoS9gZB2SnKTdHMi6Bt5wVknYg.jpg)

When we reached the shore, we stopped by the seawall and say by to watch the waves for a while. We're talking about what to eat while she's busy interrupting us and pointing what she could observe. 

**\
** *It's the Island of Guimaras that could be clearly seen when it's sunny.*\n\n**\

** *I have no idea.* It's kind if hard to keep up if you're a nonchalant Mom and you have a talkative daughter. ![1000160743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EqL7JdKLeMzKXpSYc4d9mF8CtxdhsqeAw7H3DSL3Hud5o8Yi2V4VnUWMSDiQ2ZpDf6i.jpg) ![1000160744.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EqBbgsQLGf7pvaecrHsGjAKGAVCSgNjX3YHoE3wqPyrsQUDhqmawAxbttNkRVuAS4cH.jpg) We're having a good weather today, so we stay there for a while until the dogs approached us. They looked like they meant no harm but those are stray dogs, and I mean, it's a lot of them which we're not familiar with. Just to be safe we moved to the diner. ![1000160727.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EonmXn2gMrUSoXN2Pvp3S2NtDmD2ZkH5Ud4LENGs3qBtW2WWna8cjgz5sy2D2pXA8wN.jpg) We bought **Taho** on our way here, by the way. It's only Php 20 per cup, but the seller didn't have any change with him, so he let us pay with only Php 50 since the other one is a kid. He's very kind and generous. ![1000160748.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EqjX9BztnJkawhBn55qazs4fvwDrwa7DAr1P9soubiqibM4sBgAV3R23HziEHH7VSWD.jpg) ![1000160749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EqhPDraSYfUtedPivRh3iuTXtFSKtWUaKKgAUHA4JKDb1R5uyo2q8GzQdtWRTP4TCKL.jpg) We ordered a few dishes and warm drinks to have a table. It's our usual spot. I know I keep posting about this place everytime I go here. It might look simple but it's peaceful for us. No noise, fresh air and not crowded. After we're done, we hurriedly went back home because the sun is scorching hot already at 8AM. It's still early but it's summer, you know. This is the season where we have the highest heat index throughout the year.
Anyway, that's all for now. Thanks for dropping by! ![1000126301.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/23wCbb1sRLHKU724Ko6dWVbuN2QdYWiG1izWZycWmXWRntfdPJkQQ6qSnZAK14dGPHeAu.png)

body.title: 夏日的抹茶冰皮绿豆沙饼
body.body:
这两天的温度越来越高了， 尤其是中午热的出奇，但是早晚还没有到热的不像话的程度，突然想吃点绿豆制品这样可以解暑降温，还可以消耗一下家里的绿豆，正好还有一些没用完的抹茶，那就做个抹茶味道的绿豆冰皮月饼吧！

之前看过一个博主做过，觉得不难， 很简单，以前曾经做过驴打滚，所以这个也该很好做。 提前泡好绿豆，这样晚上回来就可以用电饭锅将绿豆做熟啦。 用电饭锅的帘子，正好再蒸一下糯米面的冰皮，材料是300克的糯米粉，100克的澄粉，放入澄粉的效果会让冰皮更加透明。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSQwfS8DV6g6Pna9rLdfjdLP5fa5NQHuTx7kXGYGvZshz/_.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV65aC78AY7VSWa4Dw7sVMqLRaPMf9b927w3qRP9Pe1Yp/_.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW8u6j5hmau1XNVWnjqfczfmDkM2mVFuPwtt3bT7eJzDi/_.jpg)


加入50克的白糖，绿豆熟了，糯米面的冰皮面也熟了， 趁热扔进去20克的黄油，不停的用说揉搓拉扯，等到黄油充分融进去的时候，这个冰皮就非常的有延展性啦！而且非常丝滑，哇，这个其实可以用来做雪媚娘，还可以做水果糯米糍呢，等找个时间一定做一个水果糯米糍试试。 


冰皮面团揉好后， 做了一个小小的抹茶粉的面团，这个做冰皮上面的小花印，哇塞，直接变成了一个深绿色的青团了！
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWAW134Mm58skF6Ko6eRpgSF7Rpu6pgZ7rtkUdM2XiAFC/_.jpg)


豆沙馅两种口味，一半放了点抹茶粉，另一个是纯绿豆沙馅的， 尝了一下，感觉还是抹茶味道的更好吃。 都揉成20克左右的球型！
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXLeSdAqh2CAshUrN3nKAFtt8JmJYqKt8U3wrLuYMeDeK/_.jpg)

冰皮也做成20克左右的剂子，然后用说按压成一个薄饼，  包上豆沙馅团好，用磨具按压成型，不过动作不太熟练，有的竟然蘸到磨具上了，没办法，用手给薅下来了，哈哈，影响了美观，但是一点也不影响吃哦！

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbN99hQUCRfSzZyrp1y5tcwpnTWK79Uu3FaDqZ1ykRdAe/_.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfNtYYR38JayD2wwCFRZGZqHAixUoy5eV8bKwSL9jpqjA/_.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbN99hQUCRfSzZyrp1y5tcwpnTWK79Uu3FaDqZ1ykRdAe/_.jpg)

最后装盘整理一下吧， 晶莹剔透的，尝了一个，真是太好吃了， 因为绿豆里放的是冰糖，而且不是那么多，就不是那种齁嗓子的甜，是一种非常清香的微甜，带有抹茶的清香，嗯，真是太好吃了！

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbzzae2569pon8eXg6pNR7AgaMidNCTiAQn1Z7rGDdS4U/4.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcobVcjUECWm2EhawKQrNrkom3i9qQpxYPmV7sQrAPAep/3.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNXr1oVT1j2PfaNPA61YTcCQdsx9guGP6ndY9JcAn2a9j/2.jpg)

我觉得我再练练，熟悉一下流程，就可以摆摊啦！说不定也去小市场吆喝一下，也许真的能有销量呢！如果这个办法可行， 是不是能换点零花钱，哈哈，先梦想一下，有时候有梦想不是 坏事儿，因为万一如果实现了呢！😊🤭

body.title: Benefits of Walking Warefoot on Earth.
body.body:
Hi Actifit Friends.
I hope you all are well, I am also well. This morning I was watching the news that the temperature in London has increased at this time, so the people there are very worried and how many people are there in a single day, where there's many peoples died, so I have to say this here that we are currently living in Multan city and the temperature here goes up to 50 in summer, so even in such high heat, the people here are drinking tea,
![IMG_20260629_164617.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPPeFGkitKSjATaDyNPfFnPnPWmiFVkmWePjhujzuFdzp/IMG_20260629_164617.jpg)
So the people here have become accustomed to living in the heat and the temperature there was only 40 and such things have happened that people could not bear it at all. So, the weather was a bit nice here this morning, so I had set my routine for today in the morning itself, and today I thought that if I go to the village again in the morning, I will get to see a lot more beautiful sights. We were not walking in the afternoon due to the heat,
So now we plan to change our routine and do the same in the morning. So here we are in the morning, just like it starts to get light at 5 o'clock, so we left home at 6 o'clock and reached our destination in no time. Some of our friends were also waiting there and we completed most of the steps right there and the rest were completed in our daily routine. Like now I go to the shop and I also walk there and I have to go to work somewhere,
Even then I still walk, so then all these steps were completed. This is something that the sooner we understand, the easier our life will start because walking is very important for all of us. Good health The most important thing in life is our health. We can earn as much money as we want, but if we do not have good health, we will never be able to live a good and normal life. We all should work hard to earn money,
![IMG_20260629_164429.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSuwVSbSzKu648HA1PYz24mnQTi9Q8Erqou68qxgQxa89/IMG_20260629_164429.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164438.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTnv33zCFEuGAS9Pj8VmqSQdBUmXV3Z7cP6MSSS7XyM5z/IMG_20260629_164438.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164420.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPxBhDAw22fQMb8UALrw1ZaazBohDGagKsXjXvoUJVWbB/IMG_20260629_164420.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164410.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYh71xZ5TFSJK7Sn7kL9UA8329XoAWGFr5LFvmQPF8FYL/IMG_20260629_164410.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164447.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc7uVfQnz7c7ksZHYTer2zCuscBVKecvb2RvsQ8aPpfKm/IMG_20260629_164447.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164457.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQq6VSxXyAoKBMF7EJkuoavYHGdZYaRSU3yii1wqJVhVn/IMG_20260629_164457.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164506.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXPqbbPAD9S1Pm6NxaUWyTTEbXS9R7mmXEEBv1HGDTych/IMG_20260629_164506.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164521.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbtjRV5VUC63UWSFHNHTAcApJsoyQ44PgWiLiDaQQizNx/IMG_20260629_164521.jpg)
But for our health we should also do things like this, take our walks, and incorporate plenty of exercise into our daily routine. When all these things change, we will see a lot of benefits in our health and many other things. When routine changes, then everything starts to become perfect.
So now I have also changed my routine and I will try to maintain the same routine in the future as well. Because the summer temperature is quite high here and the daily temperature is above 50, that's why I say that we have to do whatever we have to do to avoid the heat, otherwise we can die from the heat.
Just as the temperature in Spain has gone above 40, people have started dying there because they were not used to the heat at all, and this time the heat has become so intense that it has become almost impossible to leave the house, But out of compulsion, we see people going and doing their jobs.
![IMG_20260629_164538.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXu9ZYMP7XhH6yxAAtJrYfLmkTVPnnopmWes8BVsLu8bM/IMG_20260629_164538.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164548.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb1x3fU9jW5Zt6KnsNr41TtiSqkCd3FcLRuMjB6wgHwTS/IMG_20260629_164548.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164608.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXP22btAdJj2mfkjdhEtivtjZwjHWizBe6EdarnbZq7oK/IMG_20260629_164608.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164634.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZgoXwra8pfan3Spv5DUJQuyd97kiCnFM1ZEeeWa1nfMX/IMG_20260629_164634.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164700.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWbhytqi2sedSsDHfeZNFw25LSS81X9bwh5gVXo8haCUk/IMG_20260629_164700.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164709.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSyNbQR12N4gzf8Y7Stfx8LQrhdoSEHzdTrFZ4nnc4p4u/IMG_20260629_164709.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164738.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaJokE7NW3KwCVhpZTm93Uqw45cp4PyzKwFbJq4SxpmNx/IMG_20260629_164738.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_164803.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYkhNKiHo2zDfMBDQ8uPyEatzLLeDiN8j15EgSMR9J1PD/IMG_20260629_164803.jpg)
Here we will talk a little about the crypto market, as we do in our daily post. If the market has given us a closing below 60 thousand, then this is not a good sign at all. But if the market recovers again and stays above 60 thousand, and starts giving daily closings and weekly closings above this, then this will be great news for all of us. If we continue to get candles here in a good way and above 60,
Then we will wait for the weekly candle and if we also get that above 60,000, then we will see here that the market will slowly start to recover. At the moment, the market is trading above 60,000, so what I have to say here is that if all the people are thinking of investing, then they should do it for a short time. Now, they should invest in this market and after a few days, if they are getting good profits, then they can make a profit.
Making a profit is the most important thing and when the market goes down again, then we should reinvest or we should withdraw the money we have invested and the rest of our profit we have to wait for it to be more profitable, then we are getting it. We also made the same mistake that people think too much about the market and we were left thinking that the market would only go up because the market did not complete.

Its cycle this time, especially since there was no reversal and thus people's trust in the market is eroding. That's why we may see a lot of declines in the market, especially the altcoins I'm talking about. This time, they haven't gotten the kind of boost they needed. If the market goes up, then it will be a good chance. You can also get good profits by investing in altcoins. Taking profit is the most important thing in this market.
Those who did not take profit out of greed that they would get more profit will never be able to make profit in this market. Rather, they will be seen wasting their invested money. There are many people whom I know who did not take profit out of greed and today their amount has become almost non-existent. Therefore, taking profit is the most important thing.
You all also have to tell how long you have been in this market and how much profit you have made and how much loss you have made. You also get to learn a lot of things by listening to all these things. Now, in this way, I have also been in this market for eight years and I am also trying to learn things by working very hard and I will gradually learn more and more so that I can know a lot of things and then I can tell people.

body.title: Una segunda balada - Historia [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
A la mañana siguiente, ya era el séptimo día y el estudio volvió a llenarse de ilusión, puesto que la balada estaba terminada y después de revisar cada detalle una última vez la pieza fue enviada a la computadora de Daniel. Los cuatro se reunieron a su alrededor para escucharla, donde nadie hablaba y cada segundo se escuchaba muy bien, por eso cuando el proceso terminó, fue enviada al equipo de Apple Music para su revisión, donde Michelle comentó —Ahora solo queda esperar— Las horas comenzaron a pasar lentamente y algunos Intentaban distraerse afinando instrumentos, otros conversando sobre nuevos proyectos y Daniel revisaba el teléfono a cada rato. Finalmente en horas de la tarde llegó una notificación que rompió el silencio del estudio, siendo la respuesta. Los cuatro se volvieron a reunir y Daniel comenzó a leer en voz alta —La composición transmite una gran emoción y tiene potencial. Sin embargo, hay una sección de la balada donde la melodía pierde fuerza y les recomendamos revisar esa parte y enviar una nueva versión.— >The next morning—it was already the seventh day—the studio was once again filled with excitement, since the ballad was finished, and after going over every detail one last time, the track was sent to Daniel’s computer. The four of them gathered around him to listen to it; no one spoke, and every second sounded perfect. So when the process was over, it was sent to the Apple Music team for review, and Michelle remarked, “Now all we can do is wait.” # >The hours began to pass slowly. Some tried to distract themselves by tuning their instruments, others chatted about new projects, and Daniel kept checking his phone every few minutes. Finally, in the afternoon, a notification arrived that broke the silence in the studio—it was the response. The four of them gathered again, and Daniel began to read aloud: “The composition conveys great emotion and has potential. However, there’s a section of the ballad where the melody loses its strength, and we recommend that you revise that part and send a new version.” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbseYoVVdpnyunYt3TpQn1ZvCpZjQnTDkTnD1Zi9xRxeX/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/gente-oficina-sentado-reunion-8730127/) Todos quedaron sorprendidos, Michelle bajó la mirada como de decepción, Richard dejó la guitarra sobre una silla y suspiró profundamente, Lucas permaneció unos segundos sin decir nada, pero después levantó la vista y comentó —No nos dijeron que la canción era mala, nos dijeron que puede ser mejor— Daniel asintió y añadió —Si llegaron hasta aquí es porque creen en nuestro trabajo, solo nos están pidiendo un último esfuerzo— A pesar de eso, ya había cansancio, frustración, sueño, pero ninguno dio un paso hacia la puerta. Michelle tomó nuevamente su cuaderno y comenzó a escribir ese nuevo verso, Richard volvió a colgarse la guitarra, Lucas se sentó frente al piano y comenzó a tocar una melodía diferente, mientras que Daniel los escuchaba y trataba de darle ánimos. Las ideas comenzaron a fluir una tras otra y cuando terminaron de grabar la nueva versión, ya era de madrugada. Los cuatro volvieron a escuchar la balada desde el principio hasta el final y Daniel la envió por segunda vez. Mientras observaban la pantalla, ninguno sintió miedo, ya que habían entregado lo mejor de sí mismos y estaban muy cerca de cumplir el sueño de tener su segunda canción sonando oficialmente en Estados Unidos. >Everyone was surprised. Michelle looked down, as if disappointed; Richard set his guitar on a chair and sighed deeply; Lucas remained silent for a few seconds, but then looked up and said “They didn’t tell us the song was bad; they told us it could be better.” Daniel nodded and added, “If they made it this far, it’s because they believe in our work—they’re just asking us to make one last effort.” Despite that, they were already feeling tired, frustrated, and sleepy, but none of them took a step toward the door. # >Michelle picked up her notebook again and began writing that new verse. Richard slung his guitar back over his shoulder, Lucas sat down at the piano and began playing a different melody, while Daniel listened to them and tried to encourage them. Ideas began to flow one after another, and by the time they finished recording the new version, it was already dawn. # >The four of them listened to the ballad again from start to finish, and Daniel sent it off for the second time. As they watched the screen, none of them felt afraid, since they had given it their all and were very close to fulfilling their dream of having their second song officially played in the United States. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWDMNNbb9hmgrHneJ5gLutwfKktsofRrB5wJpUBCwx6EC/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/31236094/)
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

body.body:
![md.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23x12aPEbTZaomZyrUHgsbgVG8CxuLc2bLqiHDwYdYbVbDYpzNHffye5VXXMHfjWG1Xo1.png)

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. This time I will be opening 100 common draws from batch 1 of this season. Each one costs 500 glint, so I spent a total of 50k glint. And I used 100 alchemy potions to double my chances of getting gold cards.

Unfortunately, I didn't get any legendary or epic cards, but I did get two gold rare cards, the djinn, Surgehammer; and the avian, Dragonfang Lancer . I also got a lot of regular rare and common cards. In addition, I got 11 alchemy potions and 11 legendary potions; and 1545 merits. Finally, I got 6 energy and 8 entries for the weekly fortune draw.

body.title: Petrovac, a true paradise on earth
body.body: \nI returned from Petrovac, a small seaside town on the Adriatic Sea. As they say, \

🙂

I used the days of my old annual vacation and chose this slightly smaller, seaside, tucked-away place as my destination.

The most important thing for me was to rest and for that reason we chose a destination for which I expected a little less crowd.

However, this year, according to several locals, \

in Petrovac.

The number of people on the promenade in the evening didn't bother me too much, mostly they were couples with small children and some grandparents who were accompanied by their grandchildren. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTaX7vYuX56XjA4B9DGT3kv1RDQZoSfTdf2pc2fVeRDhg/1782829222688.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSgmwHeFcPc8rQj19PEUNE34FgiLV179hiUh1N49A8AKp/1782829222825.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf1kRJ6JXEWe4oyDKfKVHNkVbeqq3yyyirLLdyWAkv5Wq/1782829222913.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR1e2wP817Hmt58EDj3bU2juDS1FGDwgk2NybrktQ6rSv/1782829223030.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTpZoqXzR7PsZee21n7CkyyXrqGABiKmS1mVnhokxjPKv/1782829223119.jpg)

I didn't feel crowded even on the beaches we visited. I swam on the beach in Petrovac only one afternoon, all other days we visited the surrounding beaches...

And that's why, every day, after visiting the nearby beaches or nearby towns (about which I will write to you later), I returned to my base for this holiday, Petrovac.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmawCYhKciUnNUsFEarAcDoUNxegcvPVz65SSAonLPGbmr/1782829274441.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQm6yLTwwzX82oMKZFWrSZYYKV7sztBNWZTSXMLWNCdro/1782829274537.jpg)



The promenade and the beach itself are not too long. From the hotel where we were staying, on the promenade that begins with the Ponte restaurant and the steep stairs that only the bravest can climb to the viewpoint on Mali Brdo, and to the small port at the end of the beach next to the fortress, you can easily walk for 10 or 15 minutes.

https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=duskobgd/wohtybg8

During that time, in the early evening, I enjoyed the color of the sky made by the setting sun, as well as the walk, the music coming from the nearby restaurants, while I sat on a bench by the beach and looked at the night over the sea.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcda7Y6dAEQJFnR426AMMXy3C6zovX2davdZtmR3ykq8V/1782829274611.jpg)

But I think I got the full impression of this nice place and its peace only one morning, when I woke up before dawn and went for a walk.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmca5s5biWdfaeQn87N4KrqH71VpdbwDKhEzdfdnPMNyWB/1782829337482.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf1MkDDcSVarNAtykYyS8VeMU2zJZ2MJKCoz5FXngmLn8/1782829337586.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXRGxJCREstumzGDUgtkhMQSu7zjW1U7rw4JxW1PEz9ie/1782829337676.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWeXsiAkULCW7zZ6Gc4V3bZbQNCSn7sZxpgk79bCty8Do/1782829337769.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaS2zoP5i4ThUZr5MxV7X5yfsqrJLaK6gS3VY8aaoypr7/1782829337858.jpg)

I used the walk to photograph the completely empty streets of the city, the promenade without people, empty benches in the parks, restaurants without guests, boats waiting for their owners to take them out to the open sea and pick up the nets with the catch, with one pair of early-morning fishermen 🙂 , but also to climb the small fortress, without anyone next to me, without passing on the steep steps and to enjoy the view of the open sea, the pier against which they break waves, and the mountain behind which the first rays of the sun can be seen.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVdmqfm4E1qB3Y6HZARBdUte5As4ms1zSF4RMFX6QYYwM/1782829575961.jpg)


A great moment marking this #summervibes of mine.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZP571fxpQS5brfRtU5HtCuJofXjUZHb8bBvxAEe5St1f/1782829594040.jpg)

I also used the empty promenade without people to mark this beach with a #worldmappin sticker (the kind I got as a prize in the hide-and-seek game at last year's meetup in Graz, and which I haven't had a chance to stick so far).


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf2gDvU3kThY3qn9psYPHi616inbitbNhc8pUZ7UChCFJ/1782829614536.jpg)

During the last two days of our stay in Petrovac, crowds began to form. 
Families with school-aged children started to descend on the sea, and it was a great timing to pack up and drive away from the peaceful and quiet Petrovac and leave it to the bigger crowd that will be in the place until the end of the summer season.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma56f1Lx8FaKsWpMn1FUenECzp4kkFKYQB7gyPU1p6xiv/1782829634028.jpg)

If you liked this story of mine, stay here, because these stairs will take you with me tomorrow on some new #worldmappin adventure.

body.title: What Is My Favourite Mode of Transport?
body.body: > ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWTV6bqNLZnJ2tLofVAULrr7nVkX4ezG669ir1AXqWiu4/1782829491225.jpg) --- ### **What is your favourite mode of transport?** --- One of my favourite modes of transport is **Bicycle**. When I was in school, I was very interested in riding a bicycle. Those of us who grew up in the late 90s or early 2000s know how much bicycles were dear to us. We also used bicycles to travel far away. It is relatively affordable, easy to maintain and a lot of fun to ride. So bicycles have become my favourite vehicle since childhood. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmekjNFkur66LfzbfWZRLNuoJz9z7Abnahwtjct1CHta9d/1782750484986.jpg) --- ### **Why do you like it?** --- Bicycles are not just a means of transport for me, but they are also part of countless memories of my childhood and adolescence. I still remember the joy of learning to ride a bicycle for the first time. Even though I fell a few times, I gradually learned to ride it well. After that, whenever I got the chance, I would go out with my friends on bicycles. Another thing is that I love photography. I prefer to take my bicycle with me when I go somewhere to take pictures. When you see a beautiful view, you can easily stop the bicycle and take pictures. Earlier, I used to use bicycles regularly to go to school and college. So I have many beautiful memories associated with this vehicle. Also, bicycles are environmentally friendly. They do not require any fuel, do not pollute the air. Regular cycling is also beneficial for my body and serves as a good exercise. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma1NzRtNvqQ2xeRquswS665d1mwwDnPHWwJ3FkKW4BNak/1782750852905.jpg) --- ### **Share a memorable travel experience.** --- One of my most memorable bicycle trips was when I went to a beautiful natural place about **7 kilometers** away with one of my younger brothers. The greenery, fresh air and peaceful environment all around made our trip more enjoyable. Upon reaching the destination, we spent a lot of time, enjoyed the beauty of nature and also took several photographs. Although I felt a little tired on the way back, the joy of that day is still etched in my mind. All in all, a bicycle is not just a vehicle for me, it is a symbol of freedom, joy, health and countless beautiful memories. In the future, whenever I get the chance, I want to explore new places on a bicycle and capture those beautiful moments on camera. I had a dream of buying an electric bicycle. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWzdc6BkJLMsknxm29MzDMJjHKdWmDewdtv8Ep2AVkRgj/1782750853290.jpg) This post has been translated with [Google translator](https://translate.google.com/?hl=bn&sl=bn&tl=en&op=translate) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXGGmnjm6RaajhQ13xGMdfLH9wNidJevTb8FTXhp8XR8v/1741454587114.gif)

body.body: Sabath day is the last day which God rested after creation of everything. In the Ten Commandments, God commanded His people to remember the Sabbath day and keep it holy. Jesus also observed the Sabbath during His earthly ministry, showing its importance while teaching that it was made for humanity's benefit, not as a burden.\nhttps://youtu.be/QEF5Xl8veGQ?si=tZWIp8k46XbvRkKS\nTrue worship is someone who obeys God will and reflects the good image of God to people in the world, sabath is not all about going to the place of worship. While Christians hold different views about Sabbath observance, believers are encouraged to honor God with sincere hearts and avoid judging one another over such matters. The focus should remain on trusting Christ and living according to God's will.

body.title: Pain, Fungus, Car Starter, Mole, Peas, Tools, Weeding Garden - Monday
body.body:
Yesterday morning after shit sleep the theracane was my savior as I had to keep mashing it into my hips and thighs to try and get the pain to abate. It's a battle I am still fighting. Went out to get the mail and saw this mass in the grass. Wild looking fungus that I have no clue what it is. ![IMG_20260629_090902.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wC7dv6ua87RsCDtVwF7BkceEBokqWqxKkxrdowBmagp7KfbtuMcHaD12eBAPgtAZZGc.jpg) Mid morning I finally took the time to pull the starter off the car and took it apart. I scrubbed the armature and the stator and the brush contact part. Time will tell if it did anything. It has been the problem much of the past year with not starting at times and needing the jump pack to get enough current to force the armature off a dead spot. ![IMG_20260629_102522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23x135mM7YXscjBJyCLzgd2pLrHW6Vm4BeBZPn83844UEG2La1cMjrxNbzyWwv7i6XED7.jpg) The cat was proud of her catch that she brought inside and laid in the kitchen. ![IMG_20260629_113205.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vhwVcdSnbLwjF2iFBp6xk1jCti9mLFahXsjyfMkkWNzKnN7Tkribryc2JZeBcAWXqaQ.jpg) Managed to hobble the pea rows and got a couple pounds that went to the fridge. ![IMG_20260629_130440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23w2guRmbSisoAGVs6iw8uAFEs92QXa5oz3dFHuju5aAjmwNnKLfW6VzgocG7Moae66eL.jpg) Late afternoon I got the car loaded with my tools for today and more work on the flooring job. I likely won't finish today but hope to finish by noon tomorrow. ![IMG_20260629_170355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tm9Yhw6LP2HbiYjEC2a26WLo1cXqJZBQ5h1TpxLiyKmUpdmeh2c1xgmMHmnB4YAqhsG.jpg) Then I was able to get in the garden and weed more finally. Thankfully I have a smaller garden this year so it was only the 4 rows I had to get. ![IMG_20260629_175200.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tvc9UUKGuURi5BsxMcd7kKbBLB4szTcFa2Maa31DbXcBZSa7CkBU8LhUabNQf9gsyh2.jpg) That last thing my body could manage was weeding the end of the rows. The boys will haul the tub to the animals today. ![IMG_20260629_181028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tvkg2cvZPS8TotHoHp6KX6yHzK2BAsyaWkjbkfcMDw75186iBoxSjeh8Pt3u1136f1b.jpg) Today I am still fighting the pain fight, will go to my session, then go to the flooring job. I'm hoping my body works better today cause this pain is a bitch. ---

body.title: TXOne Networks Expands the Element Portfolio with Virtual Portable Inspector, Extending Operational Inspection Across Modern OT Environments
body.body:
*The operations-first OT security partner advances the Discover. Assess. Protect. framework by extending trusted, agentless inspection into OT environments where physical inspection workflows are difficult to scale.*


![2Q==.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edcalmedia/242DhwLKYU4Zpk72TYorK5sZHuuf3Mqch3vPVW9vjnCXjLowi68HQDYtDKrJha5iLGdtX.jpg)


**Taipei – June 30th, 2026 –** TXOne Networks today announced Virtual Portable Inspector (vPI), a software-based addition to the Element inspection portfolio designed to extend OT inspection into environments where physical inspection is difficult to scale — including geographically distributed sites, assets without accessible USB interfaces or HMIs, and facilities where on-site inspection creates significant deployment overhead.

As industrial organizations expand operations across more sites, physical inspection workflows face increasing pressure to scale. Organizations need practical ways to validate device integrity, collect asset intelligence, and inspect for malware across distributed assets without requiring persistent software deployment or production disruption.

Regulatory frameworks are compounding the challenge. SEMI E187 raises expectations for asset inventory accuracy, device integrity validation, and inspection auditability across OT environments. These are requirements that are difficult to meet through periodic, manually coordinated inspection.

Like all Element inspection products, vPI requires no installation, no system reboot, and no system configuration changes — enabling organizations to inspect OT assets without triggering revalidation requirements, voiding vendor warranties, or impacting production workloads.

vPI builds on the same inspection technology that has been deployed in semiconductor manufacturing environments for more than two years through TXOne’s Fab Tool Scan program. In real-world deployments, this approach has reduced inspection cycle time — including malware scanning and asset intelligence collection — by 50% across high-throughput OT environments.

Through vPI, organizations can perform these inspection activities across connected and distributed environments — without installing software or interrupting production. Distributed and managed through ElementOne, vPI scales across hundreds of endpoints from a single console. Built on the same trusted inspection technology that powers Portable Inspector, vPI extends TXOne’s proven inspection model into the connected and distributed parts of the OT environment.

The Element portfolio is designed around inspection, validation, and integrity assessment workflows for environments where persistent endpoint deployment may not be operationally feasible. vPI extends this model across distributed OT environments. For organizations on TXOne Complete, vPI’s inspection data also flows into SenninOne — TXOne’s cross-product governance platform that aggregates security intelligence across the broader OT environment, alongside ElementOne’s per-product management.

“For most OT environments today, inspection happens once a year during scheduled maintenance — or once a quarter at best,” said Dr. Terence Liu, CEO of TXOne Networks. “vPI lets organizations run that same trusted inspection across every connected OT asset weekly, or even daily, without dispatching technicians or disrupting production. That’s a step change in how often we know our OT environment is still trustworthy.”

**Purpose-built for production-critical OT environments**

vPI is purpose-built for environments where production continuity and deployment flexibility are critical — its software-only design extends inspection into scenarios where physical inspection is difficult to scale.

By reducing dependency on physical logistics and on-site inspection, vPI shifts inspection from periodic, event-driven cycles — annual maintenance outages or quarterly inspection windows — to recurring, software-driven validation that can run weekly or daily without additional headcount. The result is a step change in inspection coverage: from a handful of cycles per year to continuous validation across the asset inventory, narrowing the window in which a compromised or drifted asset can go undetected.

With vPI, industrial organizations gain a complete operational inspection strategy that advances the Discover. Assess. Protect. framework across the OT environment — from periodic asset onboarding through to recurring operational visibility and continuous device integrity assessment across connected, distributed environments.

**Availability:** TXOne Virtual Portable Inspector will be available in mid-July 2026 through TXOne Networks and its global partner network.

**About TXOne Networks**

TXOne Networks is the operations-first OT security partner. Since its founding, TXOne has focused exclusively on operational technology, helping organizations protect critical infrastructure while keeping production running. Purpose-built for industrial environments, TXOne enables organizations to discover their assets, assess risks in context, and protect operations without compromising productivity or safety.

body.title: Hive Philippines Travel and Nature Photography #1183 - by Allmonitors
body.body:
#1183 - Mount Pulag Shots for Tuesday. 

A wonderful Tuesday to all my dearest Hive friends across the globe! Let us keep this positive momentum going. If you see a post that makes you smile or teaches you something new today, take a second to leave a nice comment, much better vote it 😉. Wishing everyone a smooth and truly fulfilling Tuesday. Keep up the great work, stay safe and enjoy the moment❤️!

Onto our daily shots with my wife, our friend Dandreb, two other companions and I were through the final assault to the summit of Mount Pulag in Kabayan, Benguet. By the time we reached the top, it was around 5AM. We made it just in time. 
![1000019364.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/245ccrQYMR2eLwpf5D7vdnLWRxdppXZFmP63UjfE675Xs6LHbe4FEvYB3xtu4GbTcxeEB.jpg)

![1000018297.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23qrV1mLZLem2nQoTydeLUeVKdgwHMqXwaQHeSju2ALPmy4tH4m2S3nrCVGXADaZYoneY.jpg)

The temperature up here was easily around 10 degrees Celsius or even less but with the strong wind constantly blowing felt absolutely freezing. The wind ripped right through our multiple layers of jackets. We were all shivering as we tried to find a spot to sit on the grass. It was brutally cold but we knew we had to endure it for the scenic sunrise.
![1000019379.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/243frcARXyvVaz4ofvaYiutXK2NonCBHNP4goe8exFsuBvjkY5Y6NfhxPTRP4kzeCVKSM.jpg)

![1000019385.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23qrMtdsmo52L3BTqLfbxUpSBwkVVgpMpTR3AksmrxZMcK7k17LSMn2Bg54HkpfY67gYK.jpg)

We huddled close together waiting in the cold breeze. We could hear the wind howling. Then, the magic began. A line of orange appeared on the horizon. As the minutes passed by, the sun started to peek over the edge. 
![1000019391.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/244A2kRcshckfbHMSDLGh2rVicVnDyWKx1KxTYyZH4iU2q9h9s14pxMPamj73NcL77dT3.jpg)

![1000019397.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/EqWnHFexxyey6QYMVNMvv7JavL4bFa29STZyJ4jvGEovjcUr44wkvzsFRpcfrM3sES8.jpg)

When the sunlight finally broke through, the view was nothing short of breath taking. Below was a thick sea of low clouds hugging the Cordillera mountains that surround Pulag. It looked like a massive ocean frozen with only the peaks of the nearby mountains sticking out like small islands. The golden sunrise painted the clouds. The cold wind was still biting but we completely forgot about the freezing temperature. 
![1000019403.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/EqHzKFUpiJth8sr59LgkNGpA6ySrqmeLQ2gUFqQN7WXGGeskwNChhVcjv85VWTLLqSX.jpg)

![1000019409.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/EptaV7eTVV63Rjsg7gjgAhEhLsF4avDz4725QT3hma11Vv137eb92qYAxcUxXmZXVAA.jpg)

We just stood here in awe, taking photos and digesting the breathtaking scenery. What an experience it was. Standing at the top of Luzon watching the sun rise over the sea of clouds, made every shiver and every exhausting step of the midnight trek absolutely worth it💪. 
![1000019373.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/241tUpT6VQQB636ocACUtNPGJDGdaemYXrm7nuxhpvBXWMfBVLaYULTeFaNLDUNd4mSVA.jpg)

![1000019415.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/2449zbhX3QcTitdNoUbYQ51Laxv57x8ZqcyVCuP6uJaqFLP78WCeTG8NX7GBLNttrXKXr.jpg)

Follow me on my nature travels. Shot taken in Mount Pulag Summit, Philippines.

<center>Image/s were shot using Samsung Z5 flip phone. ~rex</center>

body.title: Childhood Reunion: A Day of Joy at Uncle's House.
body.body:
> ![BeautyPlus_20260630195634527_save.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPAzTbTL4wkbGoDW6SfQ56qxizN8G7THSVM1Ua2rBBXj2/BeautyPlus_20260630195634527_save.jpg) Today was a day of joy and freshness, because today I came to my uncle's house. In the midst of a busy life, days at uncle's house always bring a little different love and nostalgia. However, today was made even more special because of two little people, my son Eyan and my cousin's daughter Fabiha. ![IMG20260630193359.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSn4xADEJu2uoiLoYgs7paioAop8KS942F9EqAJGbU81Z/IMG20260630193359.jpg) Fabiha is a very cute girl, her innocent eyes and sweet smile are enough to make anyone's heart feel good. And then there is my son Eyan. They are not same age, it didn't take long for the two to become friends. Shortly after setting foot in uncle's house, their pranks, laughter and fun of playing together started. Their sweet friendship and playing scenes seemed so precious to me that I was busy trying to frame these priceless moments of theirs with my camera the whole time. It was truly amazing to see the kingdom they had built by making a tent with small toys. ![IMG20260630194239.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYgUA7Pzf8waib4CjaAdpJKdKaDwr3Jmsgcfx7eNuE4fv/IMG20260630194239.jpg) At one point, Fabiha and Eyan were seen sitting snuggled up inside a beautiful blue play tent. Eyan was looking at the camera and posing sweetly, while Fabiha was looking at them with her wide eyes, curious. Their simple expressions were so cute. ![IMG20260630193402.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSZC5dDs5vq6rizPQhMG7pRFV1rkqQcBQU3MeaWTVEweC/IMG20260630193402.jpg) At another point, they were seen playing with all kinds of colorful toys scattered around the tent. Fabiha was sitting in front, holding a pink toy in her hand, and Eyan was busy moving his toys around in the back. It was really great to see their playful and lively appearance from outside the net tent. ![IMG20260630193348.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdnEGRUtTn4uBu8rxAPNxzFkXjNYuZm6KJpeimaHic8iS/IMG20260630193348.jpg) There is a strange peace in seeing this innocent joy and pure friendship of children. This beautiful day and these sweet moments between Eyan and Fabiha will remain indelibly etched in my memory forever. May their childhood be spent in joy, laughter, and love. ___ |

body.title: A pair of 🩳 shorts for my little one.
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Feliz día para todos mis amigos creativos que hacen vida en esta grandiosa comunidad, deseo que la paz y la bendición de Dios repose sobre cada uno de ustedes; continúo compartiéndoles parte del trabajo que he aprovechado en estos días no laborables a realizar en casa. Busqué unos retazos de telas que tenía por ahí guardado, encontré un trozo de tela vino tinto y le elaboré un shorts a mi hijo pequeño, que ya no es tan pequeño Jeje, ha crecido bastante y realmente la ropa le ha dejado de servir; así que vi la tela y dije porque no hacerle un short a mi hijo? fácil, en pocos pasos y el resultado excelente, les muestro.

> **
ENGLISH
** Happy day to all my creative friends who are part of this wonderful community. I hope that God’s peace and blessings rest upon each and every one of you. I’m continuing to share some of the work I’ve been doing at home during these days off. I looked through some fabric scraps I had stashed away, found a piece of burgundy fabric, and made a pair of shorts for my little boy—who isn’t so little anymore, haha. He’s grown quite a bit, and his clothes really don’t fit him anymore. So when I saw the fabric, I thought, “Why not make my son a pair of shorts?” It was easy—just a few steps—and the result was excellent. Let me show you. ![1000978833.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/EpXKYe5UQyW2LdfdRdpEmVGyYjXyviM8G11dmArbsXxykjkFS1gocyzy2rSZ6VKgouk.jpg)

> **
MATERIALES
** Tela, aguja, hilo, máquina de coser, elástico.

> **
MATERIALS
** Fabric, needle, thread, sewing machine, elastic. ![1000978764.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23xpAd6s37xKe1MjKyGbMTHi5maVByMViScFEgYfTjCtoTbj7wgfxA7uhCNMC4riR5rTW.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Tomé un short de mi hijo, lo usé como patrón, por supuesto lo dejé un poco más largo, un poco más ancho y así corté ambas piezas. Luego llevé a la máquina, cosí ambos lados en la parte superior, luego en el entrepierna, finalmente tomé la elástica, cosí por el lado reverso del short, luego le pasé una segunda costura y finalmente hice un dobladillo en la parte inferior en cada pierna.

> **
PROCEDURE
** I took a pair of my son's shorts, used them as a pattern—of course, I made them a little longer and a little wider—and cut out both pieces that way. Then I took them to the sewing machine, sewed both sides at the top, then the crotch, and finally took the elastic, sewed it onto the inside of the shorts, added a second seam, and finally hemmed the bottom of each leg. ![1000978763.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/2423x4uN7r4Hmg7QU2WEjHePohN3LjcnXApyzMQGBha2wBbAoqXDqZKrDgo36RTZzE1hF.jpg) ![1000978795.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23ywrxfMLdYqVvbTrzwdiyYi8UJVyHAeZDbxZMeVGM2qwKGUf2xtiUUqKXAiX5D6DzcfP.jpg) ![1000978804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/242rpiDXsLipoLxkuBTKrJSjGMgikFWkqLLNVwCkzp5DA3ipBiqLkt79t8rr2T9TMFTuS.jpg) ![1000978828.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/243M1EHziVZDDZ9dizvRPpVF7ePZT5rYmaEdTi8uBSNXy1t333DheAbEmV6ZENNKVXoKz.jpg) ![1000978829.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/EpLg4NttDDfoibpvBRfUfYB3WU9xrZ7msm88266iJFvdXHaJiSB3nk34WthnjB97gFD.jpg)

body.title: Social media and how it has affected our lives.
body.body:
> ## Hello, everyone. I welcome you to my blog. The continuous evolution of technology has impacted our world in ways that words cannot even describe. There were times when communication had to be face-to-face or it did not happen at all, but today we have a world where we can know all that is happening in a friend's or family member's life without even seeing them physically. Thanks to technology, we keep more in touch with friends and loved ones but hardly even see them or see them in person; the need for seeing each other or having a face-to-face interaction has reduced drastically since the evolution of technology. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR8EfVL5oPG744BjfHYrc1bx6L54B3owododi5EaqcXuL/1782829341104.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-group-of-different-social-media-logos-HBkpnDVc_Ic) As much as technology made it possible to communicate when we want and how much we want, it came with demerits, and they have been affecting our lives as individuals and as families negatively. Before social media and easy communication, we visited family and friends often and created an unbreakable bond together, but today we just talk and chat over the phone, and the best we can do is a video call, which has little impact compared to seeing and spending time physically. Today it is easier to tear a family apart compared to back in the days because families don't have strong bonds anymore and a little problem can cause everything to just fall apart. Today even families still living together don't even spend time together, not to talk of those who are far away; today we have family members locked up in their rooms and spending most of their time scrolling through social media rather than spending time with each other. Once, I followed a friend to his hometown, and until we left, we only saw his siblings during morning prayers, and after that, they spent the rest of their day in their rooms, going from one social media app to another and sometimes coming out to take food. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY9TkwUJGDztzu7PJ74jfZvHLi7ohjnPMUFBPhbFurztC/1782829340957.png)
*Image generated using Chatgpt.*
Left for me I will say the effect of social media on families, particularly, is more negative than positive; it made communication with those far easy while breaking, destroying, and stopping those close from creating any bond. Even for those far away, just communication over the phone is not enough to create or make any bond. When they see each other for a period of time, they don't spend time with each other; they still spend time scrolling social media too. Social media is breaking homes and stopping strong bonds from existing amongst family members.

body.title: Book Review: The Magic of Thinking Big by David J. Schwartz
body.body:
![133.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/EoeLhrQQF2ojcQKxzRo13YbvTL9dWHVYczWUyFbPoFjmfbBYi38YyEjJgzmxbDpcppD.jpg)
Hello everyone, Welcome to a new book review from my blog. I will be sharing my knowledge from the book using a quote that stood out to me. The quote from the book The Magic of Thinking Big by David J. Schwartz is:
**“Action cures fear.”**
As a reader, this is one quote from a book that sticks with you easily. It is short and precise, but the best part is that more is said with just a few words. Action cures fear, and you get the point right from the start, or at least you get a drift of the conversation. It is not about the long and witty quotes, but the short and precise ones can be quite powerful as well, and here is one. Through the quote, the author gets right into the expression of his knowledge through the use of anecdotes. It is the best part of the book, because he goes the extra mile to express his knowledge that he is trying to pass across. Fear is a human emotion; we all have experienced it at least once or twice in our lives. It is the limitation we get when it is time to carry out a task, or it is the anxiety of not messing up. For me, I see it as the worry about things getting bad or worse coming to ruin. Where the author draws the line is when he shares that there is no problem with having fears or experiencing them. The problem comes in when you let it ruin you or control your actions. When you place the fear at the center of your attention, every other thing becomes small when compared to the fear. Then the problem has crippled you before you know it. You have to let the one thing that can beat the fear be taking action regardless. That is the antidote. Another shared knowledge from the book by David J. Schwartz is the misconception among people that confidence is the cause of action, but for David J. Schwartz, it is the other way around. Confidence comes from the action already placed in motion. This is what got me thinking, that most times, I could get confident not before the action was taken but when it is already in motion. It brings me to the understanding that one should take that step first, even when fear is present. Do not get more scared that you refuse to take action, or worse, remain scared. This is because fear will only get bigger and worse. Another bonus to the understanding that confidence comes along the way when action is already in motion is that the solution comes along the way as well. Here is what I mean, one you take that leap of belief in going ahead with your action, you come focused on solving the problems that come along the way, and that way you are less and less concerned about the fear that limited you from the start. It is kind of like distracting your mind with something else as you gradually stop worrying about what the storm was from the start. The beauty of the book The Magic of Thinking Big by David J. Schwartz is that it is an old book published in 1959, but to date it is still considered one of the best books in the category of self-help and development.

body.title: Printing for Venezuela: how a group of makers turned their 3D printers into a relief effort
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptosimplify/23tGXyvY7TYN3iCfminRFM94HXnQ5Fy6G2mok6dXtGuzE2qLA9EgHZtoKbPmBQFjNP4qT.png)


I want to talk about something that has nothing to do with filament sales or business numbers, and everything to do with why I got into 3D printing in the first place.

A few days ago, two earthquakes struck Venezuela within seconds of each other — a 7.2 followed by a 7.5, the strongest the country has seen in over a century. The numbers coming out of there are hard to even process. More than 1,450 people killed. Over 3,150 injured. Tens of thousands missing. Hospitals that were already short on supplies before the disaster are now completely overwhelmed — running out of antibiotics, anaesthetics, basic equipment, to the point where patients are being asked to bring their own supplies and residents are donating whatever they can from their own homes. The type of injuries flooding in are exactly what you'd expect from collapsed buildings: crush injuries, broken bones, fractured limbs.

And that last part — the broken limbs, the fractures — is where a group of us realized we might actually be able to help.

---

## What we're doing

I've joined a group of makers who decided to put their 3D printers to work for a cause: printing splints for arms, shoulders, wrists and fingers, to be sent to Venezuela in response to the needs created by the earthquakes.

And this isn't a plan for the future, or a nice idea we're talking about doing someday. It's already happening. The first pieces I produced have already been handed over to begin their journey to Venezuela, and I'm currently printing more for the next shipment. Real parts, already made, already on their way to people who need them.

If you've seen my workshop lately, it's covered in these yellow lattice-pattern splints — the wrist braces, the finger splints, the larger arm and shoulder supports — alongside the print supports that hold them together during production. It's become the main thing my printer does now. Every spare hour of print time goes towards the next batch.


![photo_1_2026-06-30_14-56-48.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptosimplify/ALBh1Qprtjyo5iwqeVMgMLUy7hknGU79kCkM6py1bhez6VMVAVoxiZWdffPG2vR.jpg)

![photo_2_2026-06-30_14-56-48.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptosimplify/ALBh5XvLxmVSD9mDeBehpj44Ru3Gwhd7qFG1odqUStTPtR4xT5UExZTU3m94Shg.jpg)

![photo_3_2026-06-30_14-56-48.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptosimplify/ALFzjsKDydivFk1yoZhiqJoc5pwgC17kteDyPt75fTmBK2apz2U3Xv24mUoGvPr.jpg)


---

## Why splints, and why this design

Here's the clever part, and I can't take credit for the thinking behind it — it came from the collective problem-solving of the group.

The splints are printed in PLA. And the reason that matters is that PLA can be thermoformed with boiling water. You heat the splint up, the plastic becomes pliable, and you can mould it directly to the physical characteristics of each individual person at the actual moment of use. No need for measurements taken in advance. No need to print a custom model for every single patient.

That last point is everything. Producing personalized, made-to-measure splints — one at a time, each modelled to a specific person — would simply never reach the people who need them in time. In a disaster zone where hospitals are overwhelmed and supplies ran out within hours, speed is the entire game. A generic splint that any medic can heat in boiling water and mould to a specific arm or wrist on the spot is infinitely more useful than a perfect custom piece that arrives three weeks too late. We found the solution that prioritizes getting help to people fast, because fast is what actually saves limbs and reduces suffering.

So that's the design philosophy: print a lot, print fast, print something that adapts on arrival rather than something that has to be tailored before it leaves.

---

## My focus right now

My goal at the moment is simple and direct: produce as many splints as possible.

That's it. That's the whole strategy. Every piece that comes off the printer represents a person who can be helped — someone with a fractured wrist who can be stabilized, someone with a broken finger who can be supported, someone whose shoulder injury can be immobilized properly while they wait for proper care in a system that's stretched beyond breaking point. Each one matters. So I keep the printer running.

It's an entirely solidarity-based collaboration, with no compensation of any kind. Nobody's making money here. Nobody's getting anything out of it except the knowledge that they helped. It's just people with technical know-how, 3D printers, and the will to help. That's the whole thing. That's the whole beautiful, simple thing.

---

## An invitation

I'm sharing this not only with pride, but also as an invitation.

If you work with 3D printing, or you know someone who does, there's always room for more hands — and more machines — in this cause. The maths is brutally simple: the more printing capacity we have, the more people we can help. One printer running flat out makes a difference. Ten printers makes ten times the difference. A hundred makes a hundred.

You don't need to be an expert. You don't need a fancy setup. You just need a working printer, some PLA, and a few hours of print time you're willing to donate to something that matters. The designs are out there, the group exists, and the need — right now, in Venezuela, today — is enormous and immediate.

---

## Why this matters to me

I started this blog mostly writing about football, about my car, about my little filament business. The lighter stuff. And I'll go back to all of that. But I wanted to write this one down because it's reminded me of something I think we all forget sometimes when we get lost in the specs and the upgrades and the next cool print.

Technology is worth what it allows us to do for others.

That's it. That's the lesson. We have these incredible machines sitting in our homes and workshops, capable of turning a spool of plastic into almost anything we can imagine. Most of the time we use them to print phone stands and miniatures and little organizers for our desks, and that's fine — that's part of the fun. But every now and then, a moment comes along where that same machine, that same spool of plastic, can become a splint that stabilizes a child's broken arm on the other side of the world. And in those moments you remember that the technology was never really the point. The point was always what we could do with it.

So my printer is going to keep running. Batch after batch, splint after splint, for as long as the need is there. If you can help, reach out. If you can't, that's okay too — but maybe share this, because somewhere out there is another maker with an idle printer who'd want to know.

Technology is worth what it allows us to do for others. Right now, mine is making splints for Venezuela. And I can't think of a better use for it.

body.title: [ESP/ENG] Crónicas de una distracción apestosa / Chronicles of a smelly distraction🚶‍♂️💨/Ladies of Hive Community Contest #295
body.body:
>
Les saludo amigos, de nuevo estoy escribiendo en la comunidad Ladies of Hive, me identifique con una de las preguntas de esta ronda, dice asi: ¿Qué es lo más vergonzoso que te ha pasado alguna vez, algo de lo que incluso te has reído? ..., abajo respondo la interrogante, contándoles mi tragedia urbana

>
Hello, friends. I’m writing again in the Ladies of Hive community. I related to one of the questions in this round, which goes like this: “What’s the most embarrassing thing that’s ever happened to you something you’ve even laughed about?” ... Below, I’ll answer the question by telling you about my urban tragedy.
...
😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊

>
Recuerdo ese día y aún me da mucha risa, en el momento exacto de los hechos quería que la tierra se abriera y me tragara, pero ahora que ha pasado el tiempo, entiendo que fue una escena muy cómica, todo comenzó una mañana de un día lunes. El sol brillaba fuerte, el clima caluroso, de esos típicos de San Juan y yo con mucha flojera, pero tenía que ir al banco a retirar mi tarjeta de débito, pues la había extraviado y tuve que solicitar una nueva; Me vestí sencilla, me puse un buen perfume y salí con el paso firme y decidido de alguien que tiene su vida bajo control.

>
I remember that day, and it still makes me laugh a lot. Right at the time it happened, I wanted the ground to open up and swallow me whole, but now that some time has passed, I realize it was a very funny scene. It all started one Monday morning. The sun was shining brightly, and it was hot, the kind of weather typical of San Juan and I was feeling really lazy, but I had to go to the bank to pick up my debit card, since I’d lost it and had to request a new one. I dressed casually, put on some nice perfume, and headed out with the firm, determined stride of someone who has their life under control.
...
😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊

>
Caminé hasta mi destino, ya que eran pocas cuadras las que debía recorrer, iba tranquilamente chateando con el celular, escuchando los ruidos de las bocinas de los carros y las motos, metido por completo en mis propios pensamientos. Estaba tan distraída que jamás me enteré del preciso momento en que crucé caminos con el regalo que un perro de proporciones verdaderamente jurásicas había dejado en medio de la acera. No sentí nada. Mi mente estaba en blanco. Llegué al banco, empujé las puertas de vidrio y entré., no había cola afuera, sentí alivio; Dentro estaba lleno de gente y, como de costumbre, el aire acondicionado funcionaba a máxima potencia, rico después de se ser atacada por los inclementes rayos del sol.

>
I walked to my destination; since it was only a few blocks away, I was calmly chatting on my cell phone, listening to the honking of cars and motorcycles, completely lost in my own thoughts. I was so distracted that I never even noticed the exact moment I stepped right into the “gift” that a dog of truly Jurassic proportions had left in the middle of the sidewalk. I didn’t feel a thing. My mind went blank. I reached the bank, pushed open the glass doors, and went inside. There was no line outside, which was a relief. Inside, it was packed with people, and, as usual, the air conditioning was running at full blast, which felt wonderful after being battered by the merciless rays of the sun.
...
😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊

><div class=pull-left>Camine hasta la fila, todo normal; Pero a los pocos minutos de haber entrado, noté que el ambiente cambió drásticamente. Un Olor denso, pesado y sumamente apestoso empezó a flotar en el aire, lo primero que se puso en mi mente fue: \
. Discretamente me gire a todos lados, buscando al culpable con la mirada, arrugando la nariz y uniéndome mentalmente al juicio de la masa, estaba convencida de que el apestoso era otro y no yo.

>
I walked up to the line; everything seemed normal. But a few minutes after I walked in, I noticed that the atmosphere had changed drastically. A thick, heavy, and extremely foul odor began to hang in the air. The first thought that crossed my mind was: “My God, someone in this place has a serious hygiene problem, what a lack of respect in such a confined space.” I discreetly looked around in all directions, searching for the culprit with my eyes, wrinkling my nose and mentally joining the crowd’s judgment;I was convinced that the stinker was someone else, not me.
...
😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊

>
Lo que pasó después me hizo sospechar que algo andaba mal, un señor que estaba a mi lado leyendo su teléfono arrugó la nariz con violencia. Miró disimuladamente hacia el suelo, luego me miró a los ojos con una mezcla de asco y lástima, y camino lentamente a unos cuatro metros de distancia; En menos de cinco minutos, todos se habian separado de mí, se creo un vacío absoluto a mi alrededor. Nadie se me acercaba, preferían arrinconarse en una esquina antes que estar cerca de mí.

>
What happened next made me suspect that something was wrong: a man standing next to me, reading his phone, wrinkled his nose violently. He glanced surreptitiously at the floor, then looked me in the eye with a mixture of disgust and pity, and walked slowly about four meters away; in less than five minutes, everyone had moved away from me, creating a complete void around me. No one came near me; they’d rather huddle in a corner than be anywhere near me.
...
😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊 😊

><div class=pull-left>Aún seguía inocente de lo que pasaba, pero cuando me toco dar un paso al frente para avanzar en la fila. Al levantar mi pie derecho, sentí una resistencia extraña, algo pegajosa, en eso escuché un sutil \

contra el piso pulido del banco. Mire hacia abajo, trague grueso, la sangre se me congeló. Ahí, parada sobre el brillante suelo blanco del banco, había una perfecta y horrorosa huella marrón que seguía el patrón exacto de mi calzado. No se como pude cargar ese peso en mi zapato y no sentirlo, yo sentía que mi cara estaba mas roja que un tomate. Apenas fue mi turno, caminé hacia la taquilla dejando un rastro apestoso y vistoso a mi paso. Creo que el cajero rompió el récord mundial del trámite bancario más rápido de la historia moderna, no me miraba a la cara para pedirme los datos; Procesó todo a la velocidad de la luz mientras respiraba discretamente por la boca y me miraba de reojo. Solo quería que firmara la planilla, tomara la tarjeta y me alejara de su ventanilla, lo más rápido posible. Salí del banco casi corriendo, sin decir nada, la señora de la limpieza, que ya venía marchando hacia mi zona con un balde de cloro y cara de pocos amigos, me acribillaba con la mirada. Regresé a mi casa caminando de forma extraña, apoyando solo la punta del pie, algnos me miraban con curiosidad, otros percibian lo que pasaba; Al llegar, pasé un buen rato en el patio trasero usando una manguera, un cepillo de dientes viejo y una cantidad industrial de ace y cloro.

>
I was still oblivious to what was happening, but when it was my turn to step forward in line, As I lifted my right foot, I felt a strange, sticky resistance, and just then I heard a faint “CHLOUP” against the bank’s polished floor. I looked down, swallowed hard, and my blood ran cold. There, standing on the bank’s gleaming white floor, was a perfect, horrifying brown footprint that followed the exact pattern of my shoe. I don’t know how I could have carried that weight on my shoe without feeling it; I felt like my face was redder than a tomato. As soon as it was my turn, I walked toward the teller window, leaving a smelly, conspicuous trail in my wake. I think the teller broke the world record for the fastest bank transaction in modern history; he wouldn’t look me in the face to ask for my information. He processed everything at the speed of light while breathing discreetly through his mouth and glancing at me out of the corner of his eye. I just wanted to sign the form, grab my card, and get away from his window as fast as possible. I practically ran out of the bank without saying a word; the cleaning lady, who was already marching toward my area with a bucket of bleach and a scowl on her face, was giving me a withering glare. I walked back home in a strange way, resting only on the tips of my toes; some people looked at me curiously, while others sensed what was going on. When I got home, I spent quite a while in the backyard using a hose, an old toothbrush, and an industrial-sized amount of soap and bleach.
...

>
Definitivamente es una de las experiencias mas penosas que he pasado en mi vida, pero hoy es un recuerdo gracioso. En cuanto a la otra pregunta debo decirles que nunca sigo la moda siempre me visto con lo que me gusta y me hace sentir cómoda.

>
It was definitely one of the most painful experiences I've ever had, but today it's a funny memory. As for the other question, I have to tell you that I never follow fashion—I always wear what I like and what makes me feel comfortable.
...
Eso es todo, agradezco su tiempo para leer mi publicación, Siéntete libre de comentar y de participar en el concurso, acá te dejo el enlace con las reglas: >That's all. Thank you for taking the time to read my post, eel free to leave a comment and enter the contest, here's the link to the rules: https://hive.blog/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-295 ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYjZ3tksWgAUTbBkPMcDnKsREz8Um9zN1LCsN8D4TW846/imagen.png) *Fotografía gratuita de Pixabay Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

body.title: Después del Terremoto... (Esp/ Eng)
body.body:
>


Después de 7 días del terremoto que asoló a Caracas y al estado de La Guaira y tras todos esos días sin internet en casa, solo por mi teléfono, apenas vuelvo a mi casa, a @mundohispano a Hive a comentarles, para los que se han preguntado por mí, que estoy bien, gracias a Dios; pero con un \

a medias..., porque todo esto desató en mi interior, todos los miedos que no conocía, despertó nuevas ansiedades y angustias que hace tan solo unos días atrás no tenía idea de que existían. Como el miedo de salir de casa sin mi hijo menor, que es el que siempre está conmigo en estos últimos días, pues los demás han salido a ayudar y a colaborar ante esta contingencia.\n\nMi esposo, que es bombero, no ha tenido ni un solo día de descanso desde que esto sucedió, yendo a rescatar a personas, haciendo inspecciones de estructuras; en fin, mis hijas mayores, colaborando en hospitales y ya esperando el llamado para empezar a trabajar la mayor, pues la vida sigue aunque se vea y se oiga cruel, y ya muchas empresas, tanto públicas como privadas,  están llamando a su personal a que se reintegren a sus puestos de trabajo, todo esto mientras aún no hemos asimilado lo que nos ha sucedido... Y es que es algo tan irreal, es como si esas películas de terror que tanto me gustaban se hicieran realidad, esas con esos títulos como \

...


De hecho, en estos días, hablando con mi gente, les dije que ya no me creo capaz de ver una película de ese corte, ¿para qué?, si ya lo estoy viviendo en carne propia. Ya no me imagino cómo podría ser vivir una de escenas de desesperación o angustia ante un evento tan traumático como ese; ya hoy día lo sé y no es nada agradable, se los puedo asegurar. Cada día es como si te fueras a dormir lo poco que puedas y, al despertar, continuar en la misma pesadilla continuada, con mucho dolor, tristeza y sintiéndote mal cada vez que haces algo que es normal, pero que ahora valoras más que nunca, como el estar en casa, sin que tengas daños estructurales importantes, poder comer en tus propios platos, tener una nevera con comida, poder bañarte en tu baño, tener tu ropa disponible, hasta tomarte un café o té en tus propias tazas.

Pues muchos perdieron todo, familias enteras quedaron desamparadas a la intemperie; mascotas también sufrieron en este desastre natural, muchos muertos, otros tantos de miles lesionados y, ante este panorama, los que sobrevivimos y estamos \

nos quedaron muchos sentimientos y emociones a flor de piel, estamos que todo nos afecta, ya nada nos sorprendería, hasta que viniera una nave espacial y nos llevara; es lo que nos falta, como dice mi hija mayor, suena fantástico, pero a ese nivel estamos. 



Quisiera contarles y decirles que todo está estupendo, pero realmente ahora es que nos falta joropo para bailar; pero lo que si puedo es darles testimonio de que en esos 39 segundos tan cruciales yo pude ver la mano de Dios sosteniéndome junto a mi familia y comprobar este versículo de **Jeremias 33:3 \

**, pues en esos momentos lo que pude hacer fue clamarle a Él, a nuestro Señor, por protección, y aquí estoy echándoles este triste cuento, pero a la vez agradecida de poder hacerlo, pues entiendo que es una gran bendición y así la recibo. Ahí entendí de primera mano lo que tantas veces vemos en mensajes, en tarjetas, post, escritos... que la vida puede cambiar en unos segundos y que debemos apreciar lo poco o mucho que tenemos, pues nada es más satisfactorio como poder comer con tranquilidad con nuestros seres queridos, y no quejarnos tanto, señores, hasta por los platos o la ropa sucia que tenemos que lavar, porque eso significa que tenemos familia, que hubo comida y que tuvimos ropa que usar y que ponernos; que estamos aquí para poder disfrutar de nuestras familias, que los tenemos al lado y que estamos completos y que mientras haya vida hay esperanzas, agradecida con mi Padre por verme con ojos de piedad. A aquellos que se han preocupado por mí, gracias infinitas, un abrazo desde la distancia, esperando que todos mis amigos también estén bien, como @popurri, @germanandradeg, las chicas de @holoslotus y, entre tantos otros que ya sé por el privado que están bien, gracias a Dios, y a los que ahora mismo se escapan de mi mente, ruego a Dios que estén bien junto a sus familias. Nos estamos viendo.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23wMcP7nZBhRW3XBdXgRPkNzCmLmA1R6o2Ma9TQRUEsMmjJkKoK8yJdZJQZdx5VhdWdoZ.png)

## Eng Seven days after the earthquake that devastated Caracas and the state of La Guaira, and after all those days without internet at home—relying only on my phone—I’ve just returned home to @mundohispano and Hive to let you all know, for those who’ve been wondering about me, that I’m fine, thank God; but it’s only a half-hearted “I’m fine”... because all of this has unleashed within me fears I didn’t even know I had—it’s awakened new anxieties and distress that, just a few days ago, I had no idea even existed. Like the fear of leaving the house without my youngest son, who’s been with me every moment these past few days, since everyone else has gone out to help and pitch in during this crisis. My husband, who is a firefighter, hasn’t had a single day off since this happened—he’s been going out to rescue people and inspect buildings; in short, my older daughters are volunteering at hospitals, and my eldest is already waiting for the call to start working—because life goes on even if it looks and sounds cruel—and many companies, both public and private, are already calling their staff back to their jobs, all while we still haven’t come to terms with what has happened to us... It’s just so surreal—it’s as if those horror movies I used to love so much had come to life, the ones with titles like *The End of the World* or *Earthquake*... In fact, just the other day, while talking with my family, I told them I don’t think I’m capable of watching a movie like that anymore—what’s the point, when I’m already living through it firsthand? I can no longer imagine what it would be like to experience scenes of despair or anguish in the face of such a traumatic event; now I know firsthand, and it’s not pleasant at all—I can assure you of that. Every day, it’s as if you go to sleep for whatever little time you can, and when you wake up, you’re back in the same ongoing nightmare—filled with pain, sadness, and feeling terrible every time you do something that’s normal, but which you now value more than ever—like being at home without major structural damage, being able to eat from your own dishes, having a fridge full of food, being able to shower in your own bathroom, having your clothes available, even drinking coffee or tea from your own cups. Well, many lost everything; entire families were left homeless and exposed to the elements; pets also suffered in this natural disaster—many died, and thousands more were injured. Faced with this situation, those of us who survived and are “okay” are left with raw feelings and emotions; everything affects us, and nothing would surprise us anymore—not even if a spaceship came to take us away. That’s what we’re missing, as my oldest daughter says—it sounds fantastic, but that’s where we’re at. I’d like to tell you that everything is wonderful, but the truth is, right now we’re at our wits’ end; but what I can do is bear witness that during those 39 crucial seconds, I could see the hand of God holding me and my family close and confirm this verse from **Jeremiah 33:3 “Call to Me, and I will answer you and show you great and hidden things that you do not know,”** for in those moments all I could do was cry out to Him, to our Lord, for protection, and here I am telling you this sad story, yet at the same time grateful to be able to do so, for I understand that it is a great blessing and I receive it as such. That’s when I understood firsthand what we so often see in messages, on cards, in posts, and in writings… that life can change in a matter of seconds and that we must appreciate however little or much we have, because nothing is more satisfying than being able to eat peacefully with our loved ones—and not complain so much, folks, even about the dishes or the dirty laundry we have to wash, because that means we have a family, that there was food, and that we had clothes to wear; that we’re here to enjoy our families, that they’re by our side, and that we’re whole—and that as long as there’s life, there’s hope. I’m grateful to my Father for looking upon me with mercy. To those who have been worried about me, thank you so much—a hug from afar. I hope all my friends are doing well too, like @popurri, @germanandradeg, the girls from @holoslotus, and so many others whom I already know through private messages are doing well, thank God. And to those who slip my mind right now, I pray to God that they are safe and sound with their families. See you soon.
![Añadir un título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/EpLjnqM8ptWQ4Du5t5CwS6WYp1eCBU7DpXt3ACNMACzh5nnshNkUPpfATytGxcHuqFx.png)
