body.title: Garlicious!
body.body:
Let's start off this blog by already paying my dues to the title of this post. Because yes this post will be about homemade garlic, but the reality of the 'garlicious' title can only be claimed by the little wok place in the city of Eindhoven which doesn't exist anymore. But they used to have this kind of sauce that was called 'garlicious' sauce and together with udon noodles and some shrimp this was like my first exposure to take away noodles that were way better than anything that existed in the `Dutch kitchen'. (because let's face it, there isn't really a Dutch kitchen, but that is a whole different kind of story haha) > Back on topic time!!
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVGJwu7FyTJQaYvc3azxi5JMARUhkHj6HJQDUqQnmDrBB/1782811392688.jpg) My precioussssss

>
## Just make some garlic people! So what this one is about is I just want to showcase my garlic harvest from the garden and just make a statement for how damn easy this is to grow yourself, *especially* when you have some garlic that isn't really the winner of winners anymore. Recycle, replant, have better luck next year and even more garlic than what you started on with. Because what is the easiest to do is just see when you have some cloves that you had forgotten about that don't look all that fine anymore. You know the drill.... You are gone for a while, the garlic is still laying around in the fruit basket between the onions and the bananas (no combination, but for reason this is the reality for me) and when you return you can see that the cloves have started to sprout.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXVSwFXmdv5NsqgmWYiQfZF2GdVuCe7CckWsC59hMG9tL/1782811392658.jpg)
That all looks cute, but it is not that fly for the taste of you garlic as it is taking over the centre of the clove. Still, dice it and you will be fine but when you need whole cloves that isn't too nice anymore when the sprouting process has started. The best thing to do then is to just pop the cloves 2 centimeters in the ground with the sprout sticking up, about 20 centimeters at minimum from each other *and then forget about it for like 7-8 months* And when you think about that this is in autumn time and stuff won't grow in the winter, well that is even better. The garlic *loves* the Dutch winter and even thrived when it was snowing here. Do nothing, just let the stems get bigger and bigger. Water every now and then, but heck...I didn't go outside in winter time, that all did it by itself. As you can see here in the picture, this one was super healthy. A lot of leaves, standing up firmly and the color was a vibrant green.

>
## Harvesting time! So at a certain point the stems were starting to get a bit more yellow as June had started and they also started to tip over. The strength in the leaves had gone and you could see they were starting to change. As a wise LLM told be after some ask for advice, is that the moment for harvesting is there when the lower four leaves have started to turn brown. Harvesting is easy for these guys. Just pull the stem and dig in the ground at the same time and you would be surprised what gigantic bulbs were hiding there beneath the soil. Not all of them were gigantic, I also had some smaller ones which are just cute to use in one dish.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR2k4sz3RtuqFZyUHocRxvHuJE1EFWM3yRWMpnX2yzcyV/1782811392608.jpg)
In true Mediterranean spirit I decided to braid them together and let them rest for 2 weeks in a dark and cold place. (the reality is that here the Netherlands had 40 degrees Celsius last week so cold was more like a solid 35 humid degrees in the dark...I guess it didn't really matter :D) Of course I did hang them somewhere because there was still sand on the outside skin which was moist and that also needed to dry out so you don't get the fungus in the wet spots. 2 weeks later they looked dry enough and then this was the end result.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV9bPmGUhmcVyhCdEcqGAkPqFBE15EAachYcv9p8mMWYh/1782811392643.jpg)
As options you can do sweep out the old dirt and keep them on the stems, which makes them good for keeping them months after harvesting. But I will eat these in the upcoming days/weeks so I decided to clean them. I cut off the stems and also peeled the first outside skin as there were a couple of layers also underneath it still. This was easier than removing all of the dirt honestly and they looked fantastic! Cut off the lower roots and presto!
https://i.ecency.com/DQmVGJwu7FyTJQaYvc3azxi5JMARUhkHj6HJQDUqQnmDrBB/1782811392688.jpg
So in the series of gardening with really doing nothing for months and getting something cool in return. Well, I can totally recommend you growing your own garlic! Disclaimer: you really need the months of waiting though....

body.title: The Physiological Sigh: Our Brain's Built-In Stress Reset Button
body.body: />\n\nWhen stress hits, our default reaction is often to tell ourselves to \

But forcing yourself to think your way through being extremely worked up is never going to happen. So here comes the physiological answer to acute stress and anxiety – and it's right in front of your nose.\n\nIt's called the \

which is nothing more than a breath trick that can be used as an on-the-spot reset for your autonomic functions.

To do a physiological sigh, you simply take two fast breaths through your nose, then hold one long breath through your mouth.  
Here is how it works on a physiological level:

Re-inflation of Lungs: The second inhalation quickly opens the collapsed air sacs in your lungs and optimizes oxygen intake.

Heart Rate Deceleration: The extended exhalation activates the vagus nerve, telling your nervous system to slow down your heart rate.

And by doing this two times, you switch your whole body from fight or flight mode to normal mode. It's a stunning illustration of how our biology has answers for modern-day problems.

Have you ever tried using this breathing exercise for acute stress?

body.title: Pear Gloom Handmade Clay Keychain
body.body:
![Copy of heart gloom.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc8uMBmre5BB5nURTbLez9iV2x4mHnjEZ3CXxaYtfFzhqbJZVeFeEJhBuGQFuvX9fg.jpg)
Hello, how are you? To end this month, I am going to make Pear Gloom using polymer clay, of course LOL, and I am going to use a keychain for the charm. The idea for this is that I am so fascinated by the pear I know about, which is light pale yellow, but the pear from abroad is green, which I wish we had here in the Philippines too. So yeah, last time I drew a pear using oil pastels, but today I am going to show you how I make Pear Gloom. Enjoy! -----
Materials I Used:

>
  • Polymer Clay
  • Weighing Scale
  • Needle Tool
  • Dotting Tool
  • Clay Hole Cutter
  • X- Acto Knife
  • Metal Ball
  • UV Resin
  • UV Lamp
  • Nail Polish Brush

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpEKEmRafET58JzxrVaQQ7Sv1RUvFq5WDUVmL3c4gMKzMh4M3kn9wyNVQAfJ62dXnxS.JPG) I am going to shades the clay I am going to use, so I am going to use a lighter clay this color I am going to use. By the way, I condition the clay. -----
> ![4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep1YuQYa1VBADS1D1YecmFa4kYTaXQrJyjaPwKgAa39bY9kbn2soKkHBr71RQMikHsN.JPG) Weigh it and shape it into a pear shape. -----

> ![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eos3fAHrzgcd5XjXGwdvy2YHZLsWtooLm4Gh7zLMJB7CV2QCDUBeQhxSuXqG9de5itd.JPG) And then using the metal ball. I added a dent to where the head of Gloom I am going to put in. ----

> ![9.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EouAZCpCLoEBethshLSpD4g72qjkLm2o4FmHGavLUtEWsZfBN8DfE9oguPYUjfTixHK.JPG) Using soft pastels and a brush, I added shades using different green colors. -----

> ![12.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eos3j6URTx1NY2EfUBKQVnqkC62Kzo3V7tzeB3pPQxWQCREhZr8mMWowyTL45NWsNJf.JPG) For the stem, I use brow clay, shape it, and add it above the pear. -----

> ![14.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EonntdvbL2N1T9XZHafdE29aVhR6GZE4H1JkH5RY1qMGnMB37wpPtP5nn4ZmDduckPa.JPG) For the head of Gloom, I am going to use a skin tone clay, weigh and condition it just like I did to the pear. -----

> ![16.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiY6EpZUsNnzZjMqScR5bPkk2L61bAZWPJPhXULkUXpjw9TUXt7ZXRv8V9SSJhZBz3.JPG) Shape it into a head shape. By using my palm, make sure the outer part is completely smooth. -----

> ![19.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeHqrzV7ggYcbiyrrqb3EdcoP4Yky2MJ2jJw3q7csxUbrboGnHeJNKvBsQK9yEDfYc.JPG) And then I put the head in the dent I made on the pear. ----
> ![21.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoH1LyDZqd5Q6AUrbqUN297Eijuubidsk6aLpbeXU2SKrgsupRj16rfcwSp794pPr1D.JPG) Then I added a map using the dotting tool. ----

> ![24.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoH1t18mWzeYHhxr5gnnCfgbSdt5g3gAp8QpRKbP3g2e9UP4LqQHKTRsGePkwtRxdds.JPG) For the eyes, I rolled a small dark brown clay and then added it one by one to the map I made earlier. ----

> ![27.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EonnrLqLecS57kX5YLRr9Vecf6wSi4gAomJQJ8mFaKDfRztfgQ6KztdFCyc9YTchees.JPG) For the eyebrows, I use the same size as the eyes, and then for the nose, I use pastel pink and shape it into a triangle, and add those to the face. -----

> ![29.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokgTvPTdPapwLmRDQTUDvG5dLjz626jLPHDBhr4CpgGWAGvif7eMNcrt4sKFfEJz7T.JPG) Cut the bottom part only to make a heart-shaped nose. ----

> ![31.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpELG3pkXEejALW3LTT6WKXmmG6Eko9HqFFiebRmt4U4hCRuz3Kr4vz26jVksfUtn7S.JPG) For the lips, I rolled a thin line and cut it with an X-Acto knife, and then added it to the face one by one. ----

> ![34.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoySs5i2EH7nDrZMj6o6oqcx6vwYSbetfrJys1pq1A1XEdW5fnzBKBFhPcXmg5kGPyc.JPG) For the blush, I use soft pastel and apply it using a brush. ---

> ![37.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eos2kYif47Qu9andMc7NvdnPa2TyqaxjJv7P6t3y6oQf1kNJ4cLoinXqE5QPHt4MDV1.JPG) And before I baked, I added the eyepin and then baked it according to the instructions on the packaging of the clay, and let the clay cool off before proceeding to the next step. ---

> ![39.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep1XwwLiPdJH5tWgLicBmRnnJTNWQ8tovEzSq29JkXrFf7kpxNepuqGYMb1pDzTQcAR.JPG) To add a clear coat and protection at the same time, I use UV resin, and then I apply it using a nail polish brush. ---
> ![41.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiTpmUfRrbMsTdvqzWUcRtgoyezgN464G3C2LE5LVKddoy7Phx7PvnbArYp2SrBpeu.JPG) Cure it under a UV Lamp for a few minutes. ---

> ![43.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowJ1FhQQEekWHL7DG7Q7qPHnZhQz1spabjRV8DJ5K88ydPZs2AZcmzRj2eTszEtt61.JPG) To add the keychain, I first put in the jump ring along with the keychain on the eyepin. ---

> ![46.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiWheaqdCyGmcWK62oTScJFXWMQVr1H19rxpuSA1ygtwoomXmNBNdxRcdZCz8j1gzF.JPG) And then lock it using my two pliers. ----- ![45.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiX6vtDzEkckqxYGZDnchcstpJL8vB8eT3g4dQCpAofF5vdSz2v5pKt4GkvkZrdoqV.JPG) Pear Gloom! I hope you like it! :D ----
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))
---

body.title: Scaling Shapes in GLSL: Making Procedural Graphics Grow and Shrink
body.body:
If you've ever zoomed into a map, resized an image, or watched a button grow when you hover over it, you've seen scaling in action.

Scaling is simply changing the size of something.

In shaders, however, the idea is slightly different.

Just like translation and rotation, we don't scale the shape.

We scale the coordinate system before the shape is drawn.

Once this idea clicks, you'll realize that every procedural object can become larger or smaller without rewriting the drawing code.

## Imagine Looking Through a Camera
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUM4GymyeQVYYnGGd5G7azbdDM9ymg9KDXcZkVA5NjC4d/ChatGPT%20Image%20Jun%2030,%202026,%2006_42_50%20PM.png 

Imagine pointing a camera at a drawing.

If you zoom in, did the drawing become bigger?

No.

Your view changed.

The drawing stayed exactly the same.

Scaling in GLSL works the same way.

The coordinates change.

The mathematics describing the shape does not.

## Starting with Centered Coordinates

We'll continue using centered coordinates.

```glsl id=\

vec2 uv = vUv - 0.5;
```

This places the origin in the middle of the screen.

Scaling is easiest when everything is centered.

## Drawing Our Rectangle

We'll reuse the rectangle from the previous lesson.

```glsl id=\

float rect =

step(-0.20, uv.x) *

(1.0 - step(0.20, uv.x)) *

step(-0.10, uv.y) *

(1.0 - step(0.10, uv.y));
```

At the moment, the rectangle has a fixed size.

Let's change that.

## Scaling the Coordinates

Suppose we divide the coordinates.

```glsl id=\

uv /= 2.0;
```

Most beginners expect the rectangle to become smaller.

Instead, it becomes larger.

Why?

Because every pixel now appears closer to the center.

The coordinate space has expanded.

The rectangle occupies more of it.

## Making the Shape Smaller

Now multiply the coordinates.

```glsl id=\

uv *= 2.0;
```

This compresses the coordinate space.

As a result, the rectangle appears smaller.

Again, the shape itself never changes.

Only the coordinate system does.

## Complete Shader

```glsl id=\

float scale = 1.5;

uv /= scale;
```

Now the size can be changed anywhere in the shader.

This also makes animation much easier.

## Animating the Scale

Let's make the rectangle pulse.

```glsl id=\

float scale =

1.2 +

sin(uTime) * 0.4;

uv /= scale;
```

The rectangle smoothly grows and shrinks forever.

This simple animation is used everywhere in modern interfaces.

## Scaling Only One Direction

Scaling doesn't have to affect both axes.

Stretch the X axis.

```glsl id=\

uv.x *= 2.0;
```

The rectangle becomes thinner.

Stretch the Y axis.

```glsl id=\

uv.y *= 2.0;
```

Now it becomes shorter.

Scaling each axis independently allows you to create many different shapes.

## Combining Transformations

One of the biggest strengths of procedural graphics is combining transformations.

```glsl id=\

uv -= vec2(0.2,0.0);

uv *= 1.5;

uv = rotation * uv;
```

Translate.

Scale.

Rotate.

Then draw the shape.

The rectangle automatically follows every transformation.

Notice that the drawing code never changes.

## The Order Matters

Suppose we rotate first and translate afterward.

The result changes.

Changing the order of transformations changes the final animation.

This is one of the most important concepts in computer graphics.

As shaders become more advanced, understanding transformation order becomes essential.

## Where Is Scaling Used?

Scaling appears in countless graphics.

* Hover animations.
* User interface buttons.
* Pulsing effects.
* Heartbeat animations.
* Zoom effects.
* Camera movement.
* Particle systems.
* Loading indicators.
* Motion graphics.
* Game effects.

Almost every animated interface uses scaling somewhere.

## Try These Experiments

Make the rectangle twice as large.

Make it half its size.

Animate the scale.

Stretch only the X axis.

Stretch only the Y axis.

Combine scaling with rotation.

Combine scaling with translation.

Watch how each transformation changes the final result.

## A Small Challenge

Can you create these effects?

* A pulsing button.
* A breathing square.
* A growing loading icon.
* A shrinking star.
* A rotating shape that also changes size.

Each effect uses exactly the same drawing code.

Only the coordinate transformations change.



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@hey2d/scaling-shapes-in-glsl-making-procedural-graphics-grow-and-shrink-px)

body.title: Rotating Shapes in GLSL: Understanding Coordinate Rotation
body.body:
Rotation is one of the most powerful transformations in shader programming.

Spinning loading icons.

Rotating radar displays.

Clock hands.

Compass needles.

Particle effects.

Many procedural animations rely on rotation.

The surprising part is that, just like translation, we don't rotate the shape.

We rotate the coordinate system.

## Imagine Rotating a Piece of Paper
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQuXSjFGjKVqkewszF9WeZfhwfwuq6H87mcSqeYnx2Pz3/ChatGPT%20Image%20Jun%2030,%202026,%2006_39_06%20PM.png 

Draw a square on a sheet of paper.

Now rotate the paper by ninety degrees.

Did the square change?

No.

Only the paper rotated.

That's exactly what happens in GLSL.

The mathematical description of the shape stays the same.

Only the coordinates change.

## Starting with Centered Coordinates

Rotation always happens around a point.

The easiest point is the center of the screen.

```glsl
vec2 uv = vUv - 0.5;
```

Now `(0.0, 0.0)` represents the center.

Everything rotates around this point.

## Why Center the Coordinates?

Suppose we don't subtract `0.5`.

The origin remains in the bottom left corner.

If we rotate now, every shape spins around the corner of the screen instead of around itself.

Centering the coordinates moves the pivot point to the middle.

This is exactly how many animation tools work.

## The Rotation Formula

Rotation uses a small amount of trigonometry.

```glsl
float angle = uTime;

float c = cos(angle);

float s = sin(angle);

mat2 rotation = mat2(

c, -s,

s,  c

);
```

This matrix rotates any two dimensional coordinate.

You don't need to memorize it.

After using it a few times, it becomes second nature.

## Rotating the Coordinates

Apply the matrix to the UV coordinates.

```glsl
uv = rotation * uv;
```

That's it.

Every procedural shape drawn using these coordinates now rotates automatically.

## Drawing a Circle

Let's reuse our familiar circle.

```glsl
float circle =

1.0 -

step(

0.25,

distance(uv, vec2(0.0))

);
```

Notice something interesting.

The circle doesn't appear to rotate.

## Why Doesn't the Circle Spin?

A circle looks identical from every direction.

Rotating it changes nothing.

This is actually good news.

It proves the coordinate system is rotating correctly.

The shape simply has rotational symmetry.

Let's use something more obvious.

## Rotating a Rectangle

Replace the circle with the rectangle from an earlier lesson.

```glsl
float rect =

step(-0.20, uv.x) *

(1.0 - step(0.20, uv.x)) *

step(-0.10, uv.y) *

(1.0 - step(0.10, uv.y));
```

Now the rectangle visibly rotates.

Unlike a circle, every angle looks different.

## Complete Shader

```glsl
#ifdef GL_ES
precision mediump float;
#endif

uniform float uTime;
varying vec2 vUv;

void main(){

    vec2 uv = vUv - 0.5;

    float angle = uTime;

    float c = cos(angle);

    float s = sin(angle);

    mat2 rotation = mat2(

        c, -s,

        s,  c

    );

    uv = rotation * uv;

    float rect =

        step(-0.20, uv.x) *

        (1.0 - step(0.20, uv.x)) *

        step(-0.10, uv.y) *

        (1.0 - step(0.10, uv.y));

    gl_FragColor = vec4(vec3(rect),1.0);

}
```

A few lines of mathematics create a smooth rotating animation.

## Rotating Faster

Multiply the angle.

```glsl
float angle = uTime * 2.0;
```

The rectangle spins twice as fast.

## Rotating More Slowly

```glsl
float angle = uTime * 0.5;
```

Now the movement becomes calm and gentle.

## Rotating Around Another Point

Translation and rotation work together.

Move the coordinate system first.

```glsl
uv -= vec2(0.25,0.0);
```

Then rotate it.

The rectangle now spins around its new position instead of the center of the screen.

This is how planets orbit, wheels spin, and interface elements animate independently.

## Combining Rotation with Previous Lessons

Everything we've created can now rotate.

Circles.

Rounded rectangles.

Stars.

Polygons.

Entire tiled patterns.

Instead of rewriting each shader, simply rotate the coordinates before drawing.

One transformation affects every procedural shape.

## Where Is Rotation Used?

Rotation appears almost everywhere.

* Loading indicators.
* Radar displays.
* Compass needles.
* Clock hands.
* Planetary systems.
* User interface animations.
* Particle systems.
* Motion graphics.
* Procedural artwork.
* Game effects.

Once you understand coordinate rotation, many advanced shaders become much easier to read.

## Try These Experiments

Rotate a rectangle.

Rotate a star.

Rotate a hexagon.

Rotate a repeated pattern.

Slow the rotation.

Speed it up.

Translate the coordinates before rotating.

Observe how changing the order changes the final animation.

## A Small Challenge

Can you create these effects?

* A spinning loading icon.
* A rotating compass.
* A spinning star.
* A rotating radar display.
* Several rotating shapes with different speeds.

Every challenge uses the exact same rotation matrix.

Only the shape changes.



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@hey2d/rotating-shapes-in-glsl-understanding-coordinate-rotation-9js)

body.title: A Joyful Milestone: Youth Members of Hillside Malamba Southern Baptist Prepare for Baptism
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image Jun 23, 2026, 07_21_19 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhe/23xehpakEVVVeA7w9t9o1DgQfJJ1FjMrdacKJhLbg3AxLqPmMFkcDRJ2jDdYBREoY2QvG.png)
Hello have a great Day 💐 it's me again @mhe 😊 hello hivers! How's you're doing right now?? Anyways,I have something to share this community which is meaningful in our lives.i wanna share it to you and my experience during our activities with my co members in our church.sooo are you ready???🤗🤗 
 For the youth members of **Hillside Malamba Southern Baptist Church**, this special occasion marks a significant step in their spiritual journey as they publicly declare their faith in Jesus Christ. It is a celebration not only for the young believers but also for their families, church leaders, and the entire congregation who have witnessed their growth in faith.


![received_1366447374483119.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhe/243BiVXWP6ygXnZshjjBEdUq59F5mKeusr949gtgVuSwwDThFWRWiaQdgrvLyAdAQh5u9.jpeg)
![received_2034200227378077.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhe/EoyPXTFChUK78K6czMmHhFctVRRpcx2kF9CqDDarhWAU1t8uAq5sCte3DKCpB1mpAJp.jpeg)

The upcoming baptism reflects the commitment of these young individuals to follow Christ and live according to His teachings. Over the months, the youth members have actively participated in Bible studies, worship services, prayer meetings, and various church activities that have helped strengthen their relationship with God. Through guidance from pastors, youth leaders, and mentors, they have learned the importance of faith, obedience, and Christian service.
![received_1316315716851429.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhe/242NqGPe4pQWWsEBMxGB3X9gDgs1J5QaoGj4iZLHFrBnMSVDDyApjRcLvqhMthXzDa3AD.jpeg)

![received_1249057520577099.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhe/241theiNbpNAQ2ns35rwH7UDzah971V6bgYTnaYB6onAqZ5rw3WPZNj6BQ5p8hCWTwzrk.jpeg)


For many of these young people, baptism represents a personal decision to accept Jesus Christ as their Lord and Savior. While baptism itself does not save a person, it is a powerful symbol of a transformed life. It signifies leaving behind an old way of living and embracing a new life centered on faith, love, and devotion to God. As they enter the waters of baptism, they demonstrate their desire to walk faithfully with Christ and become living examples of His grace.


![received_821539427356925.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhe/23yTjCfbN7RHHbLM2uuA6nJ5gKeNEJHUYWpBgUUsqiyVNbTGfJqMEpA6ya7vD5LgPbpcA.jpeg)
![received_1162077736089768.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhe/23yx1Z5A69M7omortCC1d5Ev7CAQL4vt5PspA3LaJXSYJ8pMr4JpivJGp7B4ZXPQ7BnYA.jpeg)

The event is expected to be filled with joy, worship, and thanksgiving. Family members and friends will gather to witness this important milestone, offering encouragement and support to the youth as they take this public step of faith. The church community views baptism as a celebration of God’s work in the lives of these young believers, recognizing that each testimony reflects His love and faithfulness.

![received_1020891743566613.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhe/EqHzviVAGyBGENwqQ4gMqkMWxU4kyUKkoV9EJFr4sqU9f4WZFgZVmti8FpNTx5DWVSM.jpeg)

![received_880830731261854.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhe/EpvjrXYUeSPGA7D93fKoYG5vJTsRcy3nPrwQKyuaEZzwRLZXv9qW3KjMXjuaCNXXtr3.jpeg)

Beyond the ceremony itself, baptism serves as a reminder that the Christian journey continues long after the event. The newly baptized youth are encouraged to remain active in the church, continue studying God’s Word, and use their talents and gifts to serve others. Their commitment inspires fellow young people to deepen their faith and become more involved in ministry and community outreach.

The youth ministry of Hillside Malamba Southern Baptist Church plays an essential role in nurturing future Christian leaders. Through discipleship, fellowship, and service opportunities, young believers are equipped to face life's challenges with faith and confidence. Their baptism is a testament to the positive impact of a supportive church family and a Christ-centered environment.

![received_851726580983513.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhe/EoiVAQnuJssH7TwF1hU1PMnT5sbcSeAzEm69kVZYBNDgAmBe8Fdy2wS2ovWwPda1CtC.jpeg)

As the day of baptism approaches, excitement continues to grow among the congregation. This occasion is more than a church event—it is a celebration of changed lives, renewed commitment, and the enduring hope found in Christ. The youth members taking part in this sacred act serve as an inspiration to others, reminding everyone that faith can flourish at any age.

May this baptism be a blessing to all who attend and a lasting reminder of God’s love, grace, and faithfulness. As these young believers begin a new chapter in their spiritual lives, the church rejoices with them and prays for their continued growth, strength, and dedication in serving the Lord.

body.title: El Declivi de Hive Blockchain: Com i Per Què Ha Caigut en els Últims Dos Anys
body.body:
Hive és una blockchain descentralitzada orientada a les xarxes socials i contingut generat per usuaris, amb el seu token natiu HIVE. Va sorgir com una forquilla de Steem i va guanyar tracció durant el bull market de 2021 gràcies al seu enfocament en contingut i comunitats. Tanmateix, en els últims dos anys (2024-2026), el projecte ha experimentat un fort declivi en preu, adopció i rellevància al mercat. El token HIVE ha passat de valors superiors a 0,3-0,6 dòlars a principis de període a mínims prop de 0,045-0,05 dòlars el 2026, una caiguda de més del 80-90% des dels seus màxims històrics.

### Com s'ha produït el declivi?

El declivi s'ha manifestat principalment en el preu del token i la capitalització de mercat, que ha caigut dràsticament. Segons dades històriques:

- **2024**: Preu mitjà al voltant de 0,27 dòlars, amb un màxim proper a 0,49 dòlars.
- **2025**: Caiguda pronunciada, tancant prop de 0,097 dòlars (declivi anual superior al 70%).
- **2026**: Preu oscil·lant entre 0,045 i 0,11 dòlars, amb volums de negociació baixos i una market cap inferior als 30 milions de dòlars.

A més del preu, l'activitat a la xarxa ha disminuït: menys usuaris actius en plataformes com PeakD o Hive.blog, reducció en el desenvolupament de dApps i una comunitat que ha perdut impuls davant competidors més dinàmics. El volum diari de transaccions i el engagement han caigut, reflectint una pèrdua d'interès general.

### Per què ha passat això?

Diversos factors interconnectats expliquen aquest enfonsament:

1. **Mercat Crypto General i Bear Market**: Hive, com moltes altcoins, és altament sensible als moviments de Bitcoin. Després del bull run post-halving de 2024, el mercat va entrar en fases de correcció amb caigudes de preus de BTC, sortides d'ETFs i sentiment de \

. Les altcoins com HIVE van patir caigudes més severes (beta alta).

2. **Competència Intensa en SocialFi i Layer-1**: Hive competeix amb plataformes com Friend.tech, decentralized social protocols sobre Solana, Base o projectes com Telegram Mini Apps, que ofereixen millor UX, escalabilitat i integració amb DeFi/NFTs. Hive, tot i ser eficient i sense fees elevats, ha quedat percebut com antiquat o amb creixement limitat.

3. **Falta d'Innovació i Adopció Massiva**: Encara que el projecte continua amb actualitzacions (com millores en HAF APIs, seguretat i eines per desenvolupadors), no ha aconseguit atraure usuaris nous ni grans partnerships. L'ecosistema social descentralitzat no ha explotat com s'esperava, i molts usuaris han migrat a cadenes més ràpides o amb millors incentius econòmics.

4. **Problemes Econòmics i Tokenomics**: Inflació persistent del token, recompenses de staking/mining que dilueixen valor i dependència d'una comunitat existent sense creixement significatiu. Sense casos d'ús massius (com contingut viral o integracions Web3 reeixides), el token ha perdut utilitat percebuda.

5. **Factors Macro i Regulatoris**: Incertesa regulatòria global sobre cripto, costos energètics (tot i que Hive és PoS-like) i competència de projectes finançats amb més capital han pressionat el projecte, que opera amb recursos més limitats.

### Perspectives Actuals i Futur

Malgrat el declivi, Hive manté una comunitat lleial i continua desenvolupant el protocol amb enfocament en escalabilitat i eines per creadors de contingut. No obstant això, sense un catalitzador important —com una gran integració, burn de tokens o pivot cap a tendències com AI/social amb recompenses— és difícil revertir la tendència. El projecte ha passat de ser una promesa en social blockchain a un actor de nínxol amb baixa visibilitat.

En resum, el \
és una combinació de caiguda de preu correlacionada amb el mercat i pèrdua d'impuls operacional. El \

rau en la incapacitat de diferenciar-se en un ecosistema crypto hipercompetitiu, agreujat per condicions macro adverses. Hive exemplifica els riscos de projectes que no evolucionen ràpidament en un sector dominat per la innovació constant i el hype. Els inversors i usuaris haurien de seguir de prop les actualitzacions del roadmap per avaluar possibles recuperacions. \n\n

body.title: Hello Hive.. Meet CLOUDYSKY
body.body:
Hello Hive Community,

I hope you are all doing well. Today, I am very happy to share my first introduction post with the Hive community.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNUSULZj1uNpvRWazfWdWsfEKx1jXkeGk725k4f4tKgBi/meshy_ai_8bcf884b2eb704e112e85c38f2c611d83dfa36f8f4157d29cdc5466ad104d8c8.png)


My name is, well I will go with my gaming name, ***CLOUDYSKY*** and I am from the planet earth.😅 As a girl, I am facing a lot of problems in my life but today, I am excited to become a part of this amazing platform and connect with people from different parts of the world.

Every person has a unique passion, and each person want to share passion and love with others. I believe Hive is a wonderful place to share experiences, ideas, creativity and the thing you love most. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXQHAj8MwctyXHRa7pb3VdCFWJUBDCekvS9dwsHimehNX/screenshot_3039_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVs2MCoFRQGiN4reYoqLnVRCkfShM3bc3utVwsCegMnyJ/ac_mirages_main_menu_feels_like_art_until_the_hud_kicks_in_v0_7pc4yw186k3f1.webp)
[](https://www.reddit.com/r/Assassinscreedmirage/comments/1kxk4px/ac_mirages_main_menu_feels_like_art_until_the_hud/)



In my daily life, I enjoy spending time playing games. Although my parents often complain about why I play so many games as a girl, they don't understand that I like playing games on the PC.

I am grateful to have found this platform by the help of my friend @yakubnoyon, who told me that I could share my gaming experience with you all. It's been a long time and now I think I am ready to begin my new journey. Through Hive, I hope to engage with inspiring people who love gaming content, and contribute positively to the community.

Thank you very much for taking the time to read my introduction. I appreciate your support and welcome. I look forward to interacting with all of you and being a part of this wonderful community.

body.title: Streem
body.body:
I'm thinking about getting back to some streaming again, although most likely not just on one platform as I'm pretty sure I'm going to have close to no viewers. So will probably look into some tools for multi-streaming on twitch, youtube and whatever else you may have that's worth it. 

Today was the first day I've played some games (cs2) + bought some games from the steam summer sale. It feels like I've been so busy trying to build things lately while doing my other hive stuff that I've not had any time to play, while at the same time feeling like any time playing is a time wasted. 

I have tried to watch more things however, so I can log them on scrobble.life mainly, lol. It's hard to try focus on watching something while running multiple claude instances and trying to remember what you were working on. Often times that bites you in the ass cause you may forget some of teh steps and it causes you to give it unnecessary prompts you may have to revert on, etc.

I'm not counting playtesting holozing:wilds as gaming cause that's not really been \

so to speak, lol, more like checking it profusely that things are working as they should and that they're scaling as they should. We plan on opening it up to a wider audience soon so we can at the same time maybe stress test the servers to make sure it can handle mutliple people all playing at the same time before considering a reset and beta launch with more things to do and less resets. 

Either way, it was quite fun to play something again today. Did two premier matches of CS2, won one and had a nice ace in the first match. Took a break from writing to go back and record it for the fun of it: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j6UbTayu7QU

Either way, it kind of feels like I need gaming, or like my brain needs it every now and then. Like there's an emptiness kind of that needs to be filled somewhat. I was hoping by now I'd be able to fill it with my own games but as we all came to know the markets decided Hive wasn't going to hang along with the others when they were doing better a couple years ago. 

I am hopeful however that with AI tools that exist now we can get there and with the way hive and other tokens work that we can be a place that offers players more value for their time, attention and effort and that that's what people will strive for eventually rather than just being all \

. Like, sure, that's all fine, but don't you realize you can have the same amount of fun soon while also not being treated as a cashcow? Not being studied and seen as just another wallet and how to get you to empty your paychecks onto our microtransactions, dlc's, ingame items you can't trade, sell or even own, really? 

Yeah, I don't know, this world is quite upside down lately and it feels like it's just getting worse. People spend so much time, effort and attention where others are benefiting from it and it's only possible thanks to the people, yet they don't know any better nor care to figure out if any better options exist. 

The reputation of crypto has been put through the gutter and it's been filled with fake web3's for years now while the real gems see no attention and people can't seem to solve the puzzle even when it's presented right in front of them. 

Maybe AI will see it and be able to put it in better words than we can, who knows. Anyway, just a little shitpost today as my sleep rhythm is messed up and I'm supposed to go on a show tonight - not sure how that's gonna go. 

Thanks for reading anyway. (and maybe watching (and maybe watching more in the future once I start streaming again))

Suan Rot Fai looks like an abundant forest in a big city. body.title: Your last harvest.
body.body:
![IMG_20231014_124439911.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/galberto/EpA2bSxHnSDZjJCuYAga84ZktG9R8TH1rQzxAw2abCTK4Q3G7Zk7cRsiqjJnq7egKEH.jpg)



It hurts, it hurts to lose a noble being to whom you owe everything, from your life to everything you know. Here is his last harvest before he left. It hurts to say goodbye to the loved one who gave you everything in this life, but since the work must go on, here I show you what he left behind: the inheritance, the vestiges, and the mark of his work, where he left his life, the place he loved, the place where I saw him standing like an oak.


![IMG_20231014_124444493.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/galberto/EpT4kGMXmwgQYw4hEuPFF8FKYCaNwY9v74s6a8LK8SWydv1wZgRxCTJpfLgyLKn5SdR.jpg)

![IMG_20231014_124446359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/galberto/EpzybygT7cCt7BHsTDac2jWkrD4FkMQ9ZxnpfXgYCXuy8ScqcKnxa8qvcqdkCA9TyNe.jpg)



That place that little by little saw him slow down until watching him fade away. Our turn will come for all of us, but in the meantime we must leave this planet better than we found it. 
That’s why, no matter all the pain you may have or experience, you must get up and keep going.

Keep standing and don’t let yourself be defeated and sink into the shadows, nor give up, no matter how much pain you’re going through.

![IMG_20231014_124450003.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/galberto/EpVC5eK99V6oFXDCU5YGPnoC9qwGTn4i5WgMkW8eKgihas36F7VJGDB8g6FR4BXVoa6.jpg)

![IMG_20231014_125509222.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/galberto/EoCj7cXFC5qwwJWsmUpDbk3r8ST6KpgzswgGnor2XzoSAq51XaQvV5GwgZ3f7HHayMd.jpg)


Hang in there, friend, everything is going to be okay. Don’t think you’re the only one who has lost a loved one, a living being, or a material possession. As long as you’re alive, nothing can stop you. If your house fell and your things lie buried under the rubble, it doesn’t matter. You still have light to keep going in this world, and while there is life there is hope. All the goals and plans you thought were important in life are just that: pure vanity and falsehood, many times. And this is where you can see that there really is nothing more important than being alive. Covid taught us to be strong, but as always, it’s never enough for acts of such grave magnitude as the recent earthquakes in Venezuela, which have caused so much pain.

But tomorrow the light will shine again and everything will be as it was before. Of course, our angels will watch over us from heaven and we can start over.

I know it all looks easy from the outside, but it isn’t. I can only say how sorry I am.

Farewell forever to our loved ones. 
May this post serve to send words of encouragement to our Venezuelan brothers who are really going through a hard time.

body.title: Relato: Las ilusiones de Aurelia
body.body: https://64.media.tumblr.com/e072fa9af93ed747bb7fb8812d1adb83/4ee4352eb3c30a2e-53/s1280x1920/27697c630614b64aee0bf500fa9ab21d1e846d10.png **Imagen editada con Canva. Fuente de la imagen: [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/espejo-rectangular-con-marco-de-madera-1188410/)**

> Aurelia sabía que sus oraciones quizás serían escuchadas. O quizás serían respondidas con otra cosa.

Todo a su alrededor se desmoronaba, como un castillo de aire que ya no puede sostenerse más. El futuro que se estaba formando no era solo sombrío; era un futuro desolador, un futuro donde todo el color de la vida sería drenado, donde sería esclava de un empleo que nunca le daría descanso de mente y alma, donde sobrevivir sería lo primero que aparezca en su pensamiento en lugar de la paz.

Por un instante, solo un instante, deseó que el futuro fuera más brillante, más próspero. Deseó que pudiera escapar de su realidad tan aplastante. Que existiera la magia, que existieran conjuros que le permitieran adentrarse a otros tiempos, a otros siglos. Que viviera una aventura repleta de artefactos extraños, de mundos desconocidos, de ciudades que ya no estaban, de gente que pudiera ser más cálida que las personas que ella trataba.

Pero todo eso se reducían a deseos, a anhelos, a sueños. Nada de eso le ayudaría a pagar una renta, servicios básicos, y la comida. Nada de eso le ayudaría a tolerar el futuro sombrío donde el gobierno quiere saber en todo momento qué haces, con quién y por qué.

Cada día se convencía más de que no quería vivir en un mundo así. No toleraba más las deshumanización y la falta de sensibilidad de las personas. Se sentía asqueada de todo y de todos; sentía que ya no podía hablar con alguien, mucho menos llorar por ese futuro por el que tanto había luchado desde su niñez. Se sentía asfixiada, hastiada, ansiosa de levantar vuelo lejos, como las aves que trinan al amanecer en su ventana.

Y con esa ansiedad por levantar el vuelo llegaban las ideas de la muerte.

Cosa extraña era que no quería suicidarse. Solo quería esperar a que la muerte llegara y se la llevara a otro lugar, a otra vida, a otro tiempo. Quería vivir lo que muchos personajes de los cómics que solía leer en las noches experimentaban: dormir en un tiempo y despertar en otro.

Pero todo eso era pura ilusión. Fantasías de alguien que estaba en una situación desesperada. Las esperanzas rotas de alguien que nunca tuvo suerte ni siquiera en el campo amoroso.

Aurelia suspiró quedamente mientras cerraba la ventana de la página web de los sorteos locales, cuyos boletos había adquirido recientemente. \

, dijo con frustración y decepción mientras leía las vacantes de empleo.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickaboleyn/48GgTH3bVrpU2deKJnBCBbBUqaE4LUQy5PcyqgUfWnoGhxWmz9BfxVz4YRoqgDJ4Pu.gif

body.title: How Can You Create a Cosy and Stylish Living Space?
body.body:
></center>

Creating a cosy and stylish living space is all about finding the right balance between comfort, functionality and timeless design. Whether you are updating a single room or refreshing your entire home, choosing quality furniture can make a significant difference. A statement piece such as the [Amelia Sofa Collection](https://mandhliving.co.uk/collections/amelia-sofas) can instantly become the focal point of your living room, offering both elegance and everyday comfort while complementing a wide range of interior styles.

**Focus on Comfort Without Compromising Style**

A welcoming home starts with furniture that encourages relaxation. Comfortable seating, soft textures and a thoughtful layout help create an environment where family and friends naturally enjoy spending time together. Neutral colours remain one of the most popular choices in UK homes because they create a calm atmosphere and can easily be paired with different accessories throughout the year.

Adding cushions, throws and textured rugs introduces warmth while giving the room more depth and personality. Simple decorative touches, such as indoor plants and carefully selected lighting, can also transform the overall feel of the space without requiring a complete redesign.

**Invest in High-Quality Furniture**

Quality furniture is an investment that continues to add value over time. Well-crafted sofas not only provide lasting comfort but also maintain their appearance for years to come. Rather than replacing furniture frequently, many homeowners are now choosing handcrafted pieces that combine durability with timeless style.

M&H Living is a UK luxury furniture brand specialising in handcrafted sofas and bespoke seating solutions. Combining contemporary design with traditional British craftsmanship, the company creates premium furniture that suits modern lifestyles. Every sofa is made using carefully selected materials to provide exceptional comfort, durability and elegant design.

The brand offers a wide range of collections, including corner sofas, U-shaped sofas, modular seating and custom-made furniture. With bespoke options available, customers can choose fabrics, colours and configurations that perfectly complement their homes while reflecting their personal style.

**Make the Most of Your Living Room Layout**

The arrangement of your furniture has a major impact on how comfortable and practical your living room feels. Selecting seating that suits the size of your space helps create better flow while making the room feel more open and inviting.

For larger households or open-plan interiors, [Luxury Corner Sofas](https://mandhliving.co.uk/collections/corner-sofas) provide generous seating without sacrificing style. They create a natural gathering place for family and guests while making excellent use of available space. Their versatile layouts also make them ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.

**Add Personal Touches to Complete the Look**

Once your furniture is in place, smaller details help bring the room together. Artwork, decorative mirrors, soft lighting and carefully chosen accessories add character while maintaining a clean and uncluttered appearance. Mixing textures such as velvet, boucle and woven fabrics creates visual interest and enhances the cosy atmosphere.

Choosing timeless décor rather than following every passing trend allows your home to remain stylish for years. Small seasonal updates, including cushions or decorative accessories, can refresh the space without the need for major changes.

**Create a Home That Reflects Your Lifestyle**

A cosy and stylish living space is not about filling every corner with furniture. Instead, it is about selecting quality pieces that support your lifestyle while creating a welcoming environment. Handcrafted sofas, premium materials and thoughtful design choices all contribute to a home that feels comfortable, elegant and practical.

By investing in beautifully crafted furniture from M&H Living, homeowners can enjoy the perfect combination of British craftsmanship, contemporary style and lasting comfort. The result is a living space that looks sophisticated, feels inviting and remains enjoyable for many years to come.

body.title: Rs Pro Condenser Mic, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
body.body:
![kl.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpQxkrAatUETChTdsH71yoRZz273sJfYwPUn5RjaTk2K2dV7ordnT8GFyJ2Hjxastx4.png)


Good morning! I hope you're enjoying a good cup of coffee to start this beautiful day off right. Friends, I'm back to show you my drawing for today. I created this drawing inspired by the R192 RS Pro Condenser Mic. As you can see, it's a very nice microphone. What I like most about it is its modern and minimalist design. It barely has any protrusions; it's just a smooth, cylindrical body. The gray color highlights that minimalist style. I think it's one of the most minimalist I've ever painted.

In this post, you'll be able to see how I painted it from beginning to end, step by step, and I won't keep you waiting any longer. Let's get to it. To begin the drawing, I started by sketching what would be the inner frame of the card. I made this frame with my classic design: curved edges with straight sides. It turned out like this.

<div class=\

> ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZT9ykVFygft28CPL7yZhza9T7U3nHpC1dUJKW5gyXayG3R4iH7kwZWGN2E.jpg) After that, I drew two lines that represent the two sides of the microphone. At the top of the lines, I added some protrusions. These protrusions are for later adding the grille through which the audio would be captured, in real life, of course. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BM1YUX8DHkTQvmBvpT1npzr5iCSktEbuRJ4DqFSF9tAB6NT6RQsBuQaaRCJYZ1PP.jpg) After drawing the sides, I drew the top and bottom. With that, the main silhouette was finished. It has that characteristic cylindrical shape of these minimalist microphones. In the game, there are several others that are similar in shape, but they have different colors. This one is completely gray, which is why I find it more minimalist than the others. ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTNgDdAnsxRWnUsJE7DmYDnjE2gXjhgfojRNy45dD8v6syFxJSHdWzN6Wd.jpg) Now all that's left is to start filling in the newly finished sketch with color. This is the most fun part. First, I started by painting the background a light red. I took this red from one side of the card. If you look at the cover, the card has red in the corners. Using Paint's eyedropper tool, I picked that color and applied it to the background of the drawing. After that, I painted the frame dark gray. And to finish, I drew the inner background in various shades of blue and the microphone in a minimalist light gray. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoCovWH8N1GueKkbzVojMKoHKiYDxJNPvz9yqUWRVm48sfbgXuz4TAkTLowahsqHmN3.jpg) ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Ensbrw8kUzYfawJkjc2EQQ6QYj1Q7BXXUthAEtHZCMbbC2RLbdRRCZJsuQGUEVR1xpN.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoTduQTfhzhun4omd92CqiNxSwgbWDMU3dWa7yKuFmWoHrvBsLLzkjuBtq9ryZrhU8t.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoTduQTfhzhujUxAiMQrfmj2f17Lq2rmodpbyVQyJrmLFCddaM8iGWRAW8haqN3wjTy.jpg) To complete the microphone, I added the decorative elements and the microphone mute button in the middle. I also finished the top grille. What do you think of the finished product? ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoXtggmWFYBCjkeNWFjhkEUfSzR5nmWdT8u2V5fgvLvPysh3enykTCbm6w4vmfUFK4E.jpg) To say goodbye for today, here's the final result of the drawing. See you in the next drawing. Blessings to all. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/243qU1WHU11hJS76bfMPQe8n3AFa65zCeBLfwXPSAQ5wTBxYnXFqSGku5Uya1NZEfppri.jpg)

body.title: Quantum Technology Gadgets: The Next Revolution in Computing and Innovation
body.body:
# Quantum Technology Gadgets: The Next Revolution in Computing and Innovation

Technology has advanced rapidly over the past century, transforming nearly every aspect of human life. From computers and smartphones to artificial intelligence and robotics, innovation continues to reshape the [lv88blue](https://lv88.blue/). Among the most promising emerging fields is quantum technology, a branch of science that uses the principles of quantum mechanics to create powerful new devices and systems. Quantum technology gadgets have the potential to revolutionize computing, communication, healthcare, security, and scientific research in ways that were once considered impossible.

Quantum technology gadgets are devices that utilize quantum phenomena such as superposition, entanglement, and quantum tunneling to perform tasks more efficiently than traditional technologies. These gadgets are designed to process information, transmit data, measure physical [tin tức lv88](https://lv88.blue/tin-tuc-lv88/), and solve complex problems with unprecedented speed and accuracy.

One of the most important quantum technology gadgets is the quantum computer. Unlike classical computers that use bits represented by either 0 or 1, quantum computers use quantum bits, or qubits. Qubits can exist in multiple states simultaneously through a property known as superposition. This capability allows quantum computers to perform many calculations at the same time, making them significantly more powerful for certain applications.

Quantum communication devices are another major innovation. These gadgets use quantum principles to transmit information securely. Quantum encryption technologies can detect unauthorized attempts to intercept data, providing an extremely high level of security. Such systems may play a crucial role in protecting sensitive information in the future.

Quantum sensors are among the first quantum gadgets to achieve practical applications. These highly sensitive devices can measure time, gravity, magnetic fields, temperature, and motion with extraordinary precision. Quantum sensors are used in scientific research, navigation systems, medical imaging, and environmental monitoring.

Quantum clocks represent another important advancement. These devices are far more accurate than traditional atomic clocks and can improve navigation, telecommunications, and scientific measurements. Precise timekeeping is essential for many modern technologies, including global positioning systems and communication networks.

Healthcare is expected to benefit greatly from quantum technology gadgets. Quantum imaging systems may enable doctors to detect diseases at earlier stages and with greater accuracy. Advanced quantum sensors could improve diagnostic procedures, leading to better treatment outcomes and improved patient care.

Quantum technology may also transform drug development. Researchers can use quantum computers to simulate complex molecular interactions, accelerating the discovery of new medicines and treatments. This capability could significantly reduce the time and cost required to develop life-saving therapies.

In transportation, quantum gadgets could enhance navigation and logistics systems. Quantum sensors provide highly accurate positioning information even in environments where satellite signals are unavailable. These technologies may improve the performance of autonomous vehicles, aircraft, and maritime transportation systems.

Environmental monitoring is another area where quantum gadgets show great promise. Highly sensitive quantum sensors can detect subtle changes in environmental conditions, helping scientists study climate change, monitor natural resources, and improve disaster prediction systems.

Financial institutions are also exploring quantum technology. Quantum computers may analyze large datasets, optimize investment strategies, and improve risk management. These capabilities could transform financial services and decision-making processes.

One of the greatest advantages of quantum technology gadgets is their exceptional processing power. Problems that would take classical computers years to solve may be completed by quantum systems in a fraction of the time. This capability opens new possibilities in science, engineering, and industry.

Enhanced security is another major benefit. Quantum communication technologies provide strong protection against cyber threats and data breaches. As digital information becomes increasingly valuable, secure communication systems will become more important than ever.

Scientific research will also advance through quantum technology. Researchers can use quantum gadgets to study complex physical phenomena, develop new materials, and explore previously inaccessible scientific questions. These discoveries may lead to further technological breakthroughs.

Despite their enormous potential, quantum technology gadgets face several challenges. One major obstacle is technical complexity. Quantum systems require highly controlled environments and are sensitive to external disturbances such as temperature changes and electromagnetic interference.

Cost is another significant concern. Developing and maintaining quantum devices often requires expensive equipment and specialized expertise. Widespread adoption may take time as technologies mature and become more affordable.

Scalability remains a challenge for quantum computing. Researchers are working to increase the number of stable qubits while reducing errors. Significant progress has been made, but practical large-scale quantum systems are still under development.

Workforce development is also important. The growth of quantum technology requires skilled scientists, engineers, and technicians. Educational institutions and research organizations are investing in training programs to prepare future professionals for this emerging field.

The future of quantum technology gadgets is incredibly exciting. Advances in materials science, computing, and engineering are expected to improve the performance and reliability of quantum systems. Researchers continue to explore new applications that could transform industries and society.

Quantum internet technologies may eventually enable ultra-secure global communication networks. These systems could provide unprecedented levels of data protection and information exchange.

Portable quantum sensors may become more common in healthcare, environmental monitoring, and industrial applications. Smaller and more affordable devices will expand access to quantum technologies and increase their practical value.

Artificial intelligence and quantum computing may work together to solve complex problems more efficiently than either technology alone. This combination could accelerate innovation across numerous scientific and industrial fields.

In conclusion, quantum technology gadgets represent one of the most significant technological frontiers of the modern era. From quantum computers and communication systems to advanced sensors and medical devices, these innovations have the potential to revolutionize many aspects of life. Although challenges related to cost, complexity, and scalability remain, ongoing research and development continue to drive progress. A Peaceful Night at Bamboo Sanctuary Resort
The night at Bamboo Sanctuary Resort in Davao offers a peaceful escape where nature and tranquility blend beautifully. Soft lights gently illuminate the bamboo cottages, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere beneath the dark evening sky. The cool breeze whispers through the towering bamboo, bringing a refreshing sense of calm to every visitor. Every corner of the resort feels relaxing, making it an ideal place to unwind after a busy day. 

![IMG20251104195024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhe/EoCffyPPHNCu1hEC7M6j3BoeT3VGx7gshwpstST6vYVuDUP41eDmfyLzwPbx92JTQjr.jpg)
The quiet surroundings allow the soothing sounds of nature to become the perfect evening soundtrack. Families, friends, and couples can enjoy meaningful conversations while appreciating the serene environment. The gentle glow reflected on the pathways adds a magical touch to the entire landscape. Spending the evening here reminds us that simple moments surrounded by nature are often the most memorable. Bamboo Sanctuary Resort is truly a hidden gem where peaceful nights create lasting memories and unforgettable experiences.

body.body:

![_20260630205311_72_77-f72d12b2a64f.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/jychbetter/lkt-mr0nk2b9-smh1yz4a/_20260630205311_72_77-f72d12b2a64f.webp)

各位小伙伴们好！友哥今天来分享一个团队，是的，可以称他们为一个团队。友哥在秦皇岛某超市门口遇到的，他们是有创意的团队。欢迎继续阅读了解！

友哥去某超市买东西的时候，正是接近饭点的时间，超市门口有一个棚子，是售卖小龙虾的，他们是在现场炒制后，再按斤售卖，看着挺干净的，友哥就凑上前，准备买点儿。

看到了他们的宣传语：

> “专业糕虾，绝不虾搞，现做现炒，味道才好”

首先，宣传语押韵，读起来顺口。其次，合理利用了谐音，让人印象深刻。

友哥在等待大哥炒制的时候，和他们聊了两句，说要是将来赚到钱了，他们可以开店啊。建议他们拉微信群，将老顾客留住，将来开店就是客户群。然后他们说已经有群了，但是呢，友哥扫码时候，桌子上打印出来的二维码是过期的了，于是又扫女老板的手机上的二维码。一看群名还是买水果的群呢，看来他们之前做水果生意。这时候其中一位男老板说，把群名改成“虾路相逢”，真是有创意的，原来他就是他们团队中的军师。

祝他们越做越强！做大做强！




![dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/p/qjrE4yyfw5pJD9LKQ1BG3NbSyKTowh8wnMyt99dK65jb9EyRiDqdkR63HQ91ZqnuFHTiEML7JsCGppcMeUsSg6BbKH3QeuVfMQwWygfDgJTnhE1wD53KXCSa?format=match&mode=fit)

好了，各位小伙伴们，友哥今天就分享到这里吧！明天见！祝各位小伙伴们天天快乐，天天好心情！

body.title: Breaded Cutlet, Salad And French Fries / Milanesa, Ensalada Y Papas Fritas
body.body:
> ***English Version*** ### **Milanesa, Ensalada Y Papas Fritas** Warm greetings, friends, and blessings to you all. Today I began my day under a gloomy, rainy sky. As lunchtime approached, I thought of something light, since the weather often catches us off guard. I decided to make some French fries in the air fryer, an appliance that has allowed me to create and invent different dishes since I learned how to use it. >***Versión en Español*** >### **Milanesa, Ensalada Y Papas Fritas** >Un grato saludo, amigos, lleno de bendiciones para todos. Hoy comencé mi día con una atmósfera triste y de lluvia. Acercándose la hora del almuerzo, se me ocurrió algo ligero, ya que el tiempo nos agarra desprevenidos. Decidí en primer lugar preparar unas papitas fritas en la freidora de aire, un artefacto que me ha permitido realizar e inventar diferentes comidas una vez que aprendí a manejarla. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaQsMjHERnCz1oHjHjHgR4t7uLb8UVywTgoqys9KrzpRY/light_brown_collage_coming_soon_instagram_post_1_.png)
*Design Made with Canva*
Cooking is quite fast; cooking in the fryer has also been a simple practice that allows me to use little oil and is therefore healthier. >La cocción es bastante rápida; cocinar en la freidora también ha sido una práctica sencilla que me permite utilizar poco aceite y, por ende, es más saludable. ![IMG_20260622_115905_MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23vsUyRKet3rwg9aN2ZYBf3hqZbhwp3NMgKKZuWS6p3tuHs3zJDTz5tZtTwjBNtohccQU.jpg) ![IMG_20260622_115910_MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23uFXnHw5x7Xuyms4rHc59B4hN7an9dqVAR4DxAxEwPeayWwxon1czX5Wb9wYSdphAuhH.jpg) I'm preparing a simple lunch: a salad of shredded carrots, tomatoes, and onions, with French fries and breaded chicken cutlet, well-seasoned with a blended scallion mixture. It's perfect for those looking for simple, healthy meal options. >Estoy preparando para mi almuerzo un plato sencillo, una ensalada de zanahoria rayada con tomate y cebollas, papas fritas y milanesa de pollo, bien condimentada con una mezcla de cebollín licuado, para los que buscan opciones de comidas sencillas, sanas y saludables. --- #### **Ingredients:** - 500g breaded chicken cutlet - 2 carrots - 2 potatoes - 2 tomatoes - 1 small onion - 1 packet of seasoning and spices to taste - 1 scallion - Oil --- > #### **Ingredientes:** >-500 g de milanesa de pollo >-2 zanahorias >-2 unidades de papas >-2 tomates >-1 cebolla pequeña >-1 sobre de sazonador y condimentos al gusto >-1 rama de cebollín >-Aceite ![IMG_20260622_103824.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Ep7v1tLgyr8fPruGu4guGBY49Y5LLwr6GQRksqYbKGbmC6o1KoE65tHXoLX5cu4mzNb.jpg) ![IMG_20260622_105231.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpVCZw3TrdZTyrPqk7sxS7okaPn8vKJ3hs9gqLBFKEDxwujkkUcxTB2J8zCksCnfdfT.jpg) ![IMG-20260624-WA0016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23wX5gtcR9ZjXU27n3xAPzJhw2kbrkxmqsPxP1s9qvPAEnAjbpfZw8rvUYmDhHUS3TMg2.jpg) --- **Preparation:** I wash my vegetables and then peel them; I grate the carrots. I chop the potatoes, then wash them again to remove the starch. >**Preparación:** >Lavo mis verduras y luego retiro la cáscara; las zanahorias las rallo. Las papas, las pico, las pico y luego vuelvo a lavar para sacar su almidón. ![IMG_20260622_111335.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23zbXxQdXHzos7D4Xzvbj4XJpfhLnBGyfB4V96x7J2PK1hqst9NpRgXEiuAz1z4VuabnN.jpg) ![IMG_20260622_105338-COLLAGE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Ep3gjBK3uiBMY47uh9wj62FW6JYPZgyfMqSJFeKapZ5Wr7K5RmzEbncEmBkGGrnLBwS.jpg) ![IMG_20260622_105601-COLLAGE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpA3wDZQS51cfHsB3UJu2NBBqDKzwWw7P43GpkDTMvbtq2w7yWnCnnzashUEu7kaBHR.jpg) I wipe the potatoes with a cloth to dry them well and add a little oil, mixing it in with my hands. Then I place them on the tray and put it in the fryer at 200° for 20 to 25 minutes. >Las papas las paso por un paño para secarlas bien y les agrego un poquito de aceite e integro con las manos, después las colocamos en la bandeja y la metemos en la freidora a 200° por un tiempo de 20 a 25 minutos. ![IMG_20260622_110006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Eo8Tr2UUgoX9DLPh5JWFZrfoeTnz88UcUMBnJ1uoQy6RHoXodNSLW5SuMADftHX1MSU.jpg) ![IMG_20260622_110014-COLLAGE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EoGzRMDynWTDvEgBG4FaFqQFNVjvXmUCXLvVoBkZGnwoesSjARabMZ2e23SqejdAD2Y.jpg) ![IMG_20260622_110122-COLLAGE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Eos1io1KD6XLALcwa1XTpkNyJLh71bEu6zPAhAuUmCn6qP1y82k3REUrk85VvnN8VtV.jpg) ![IMG_20260622_110515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EogNE7RYqjN2rQ5yyk7WLWHbbVhGLzJJqiQoHn8Upn68up4R3febJjiXKmbf71HBKbT.jpg) ![IMG_20260622_110543.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpVBX5AiYBdsBdiAseBp9GoXeCwqDVgn4Psywjko5xdJDwDp63AE3tQvsiHcNtYVF6i.jpg) ![IMG_20260622_110602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EptbvzGvL6nkoxKkYvn3pCJtis1GPitV7i3v7AEV5fQWviNcPKuFha7Vz6RXamz6RyF.jpg) We chop the spring onion and blend it; we add the minimum amount of water so that it processes and becomes thick. >Picamos el cebollín y licuamos; agregamos lo mínimo de agua para que se procese y nos quede espeso. ![IMG_20260622_103958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpLgYzW2tymv9VEhVULvBRKGsL8Hf9ryyVMVcLPmr2to3DsDhtWxVK5JJtQS3Qc1q5m.jpg) ![IMG_20260622_104103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpnBQ4dpdwgesqVZXfDfY1wj7pn1oPLs2YmVBVo59z8ukGKiAr7Mmbufks8QrJoGLqH.jpg) ![IMG_20260622_104144.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpCAKXRx9HF31SQLVjp2a6N98ybCHYJDp4EZFSe4T6cYN8NnT4UjVoxzshgUNxs4mi3.jpg) Next, we take the breaded cutlets; body.title: White Stripes Guitar Pick! My Actifit Report Card: June 30 2026
body.body:
Today we have for you a guitar pick from the band called 

White Stripes 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bbb3c8ec-3019-4849-80d5-68a9efef962a.jpg)

---

Here's a look at the front side of this guitar pick. The back side is blank 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9a9d29cb-b081-4aef-bf59-fccbf0f6c7f8.jpg)

---

https://youtu.be/0J2QdDbelmY?si=RQAFK_JjFbDfKufG

---

The White Stripes were a defining force in the 2000s garage rock revival, stripping rock and roll down to its absolute bare essentials. Composed of Jack White on vocals and guitar and Meg White on drums, the Detroit duo famously restricted themselves to a strict minimalist aesthetic: just two musicians, a primal and explosive blues-punk sound, and a visual palette limited entirely to red, white, and black. Jack's blistering, innovative guitar work contrasted perfectly with Meg’s deliberately simple, metronomic drumming, proving that a band didn't need a bass player or complex production to create massive anthems. Tracks like \

—with its iconic, stadium-shaking riff—cemented their legacy as rock innovators who turned artistic limitations into pure, raw energy.

body.title: [Movie] Made in Hungaria (2009) - Movie Review
body.body:
Today I'm back with another movie review, that unfortunately may not be for everyone yet, but this movie is one of the best among the Hungarian movies and one of my favorites, so I'm leaving a digital mark on the blockchain about it. The reason I said it may not be for everyone is that it's a Hungarian movie and I don't know of any existing English dubbing, but it seems there's English subtitle available. 

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRgfxxb7XwMVLoDy36nJJd31pJ7f7ekMZ9vzposREpj2p/6313-made-in-hungaria-0-600-0-900-crop.jpg)
[source](https://letterboxd.com/film/made-in-hungaria/)

>Miklós Fenyő's parents returned to Communist Hungary in the mid sixties - when everyone else was fleeing to the West. For young Miki, arriving from America sporting a Hawaiian shirt, a perfect quiff and a rebellious streak, life under dictatorship was going to be tough. Miki's old friends don't know what to make of his outrageous clothes, flawless American accent and collection of original Buddy Holly 45s. His childhood sweetheart is cold and distant while local tough guy Röné is unmoved by the challenger to his rock 'n' roll crown. But that's not all. When the authorities see the effect Miki's gyrating hips and lewd music have on teenage girls, they won't stand for it. His father's job is on the line, and, for the first time, Miki must play by the rules. He has no choice but to enter the local talent show - and the rest is rock 'n' roll history. [](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1224369/?ref_=fn_t_1)

This is the storyline, but this is not all, there's more to it. The movie is following real events to some extent, but in fact, in plain English, it is a big middle finger to the old, communist regime. Obviously this movie could not be made during the communism, so it had to be made after the regime change and 10 years was needed for this amazing movie to be made. 

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY2j7kmCftNnmr2PVzSJs4xGtFyHFmwUVrxP1ZY76uS4N/made-in-hungaria.jpg)
[source](https://www.justwatch.com/us/movie/made-in-hungaria)

[Miklós Fenyő](https://hu.wikipedia.org/wiki/Feny%C5%91_Mikl%C3%B3s) is not just a respected name in the Hungarian music history, he's a legend in every sense of the word and when you think of rock 'n' roll in Hungary, his name is the first to mention. Unfortunately he's not among us anymore as he passed away in January this year. 

As the storyline says, the story is from the mid sixties. I was born way later, so I only know about those times from my parents. Life was not easy back then, the 1956 Revolution was crushed, many people fled to the United States, to escape the brutal persecution and life that followed. 

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPeYvUXMDQ6bJ2j7AGbJaYMZsb1ydBapLT776XKxnRij7/61418_1487347151.3115.jpg)
[source](https://www.mafab.hu/movies/made-in-hungaria-61418.html)

For some reason, Miklós Fenyő's parents decided to relocate back to Hungary and for Miki, after experiencing what freedom means for a teenager, coming back to a country where freedom was just a word in the dictionary, life was really difficult. The communist regime did everything to suppress gatherings, everything that was new and may have had a revolutionary effect and tried to brainwash the youth and shove the communist ideology down their throats.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmddNY7QfvMLZkFLdwhqcC6hqnN9MgJhM5yjzNdh9AcoPi/MV5BM2E1ZDY0ODMtODgzYS00OWZhLWI4YjQtMWNhMjA2MjkzZGFmXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg)
[source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1224369/)

As I said, the whole movie is a big middle finger to the communist regime and the writers make sure to make it hilarious. Miklós Fenyő was one of the writers by the way. 

The whole movie is a comedy and although I'm not a huge fan of comedies as you rarely find a good one, that is not low IQ movie, I must admit, I've rarely laughed this much. I've sen the movie several times and never get bored of it. Ok, so let's get on with the review. 

[Szabó Kimmel Tamás](https://hu.wikipedia.org/wiki/Szab%C3%B3_Kimmel_Tam%C3%A1s) had the pleasure to play Miklós Fenyő's role and although I can understand the pressure such a role means, he played it very well, I can't imagine someone else in this role. It required some skills, like singing, dancing and even playing the piano. The other lead actor, [Iván Fenyő](https://hu.wikipedia.org/wiki/Feny%C5%91_Iv%C3%A1n_(sz%C3%ADnm%C5%B1v%C3%A9sz)), who played Miklós Fenyő's rival, Röné, was also exceptional. 

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeukvsa84sct7JM8uh8NHiLXzzkKRME9jLtEQdmuyfz5D/790.jpg)
[source](https://port.hu/adatlap/film/tv/made-in-hungaria-made-in-hungaria/movie-95257)

The writers made sure to bringing back the 60s vibes. The costumes are entirely from those times. The music was almost entirely, or entirely of Miklós Fenyő's songs. The slang is also from that age and you have to be familiar with it in order to understand and enjoy it. 

The script stays close to the real events in Miklós Fenyő's life, but it  also grants you a glimpse into what life was back then and what teenagers had to do to fool the authorities and still have some fun. They say where there's will, there's a way, it's a cliche, but it is true and Miki and his friends make the most of it. You can see some funny scenes, like the May Day festival right at the beginning, then the dance at the beach, but also the practice for the talent scout competition. Absolute hilarious. 

There are several dance scenes in the movie, one of which has a huge crowd dancing and the best of all in my opinion, so I have to say, they really put in all the effort needed, to get the maximum result. 

Important to mention, or better give an explanation regarding the title. Made in Hungaria seems like referring to where the movie or the music was made, which is accurate as both were made in Hungary, but this is not all. In 1967, Miklós Fenyő founded his famous band, called Hungária. 

Although it's not an autobiography movie, it still pays tribute to Miklós Fenyő's work and I'm glad it was made during his life and not after.
