body.title: WOO Battle Pass Season 2 Announcement
body.body:
# 🚨 WOO Battle Pass Season 2: Bigger Rewards, Bigger Stakes, and a 25,000 WOO Premium Track


![ChatGPT Image Jun 26, 2026, 04_21_53 PM (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23w2aXknb8kfDtVX2gFFQKH9VbrSzmDBtGHKJWCvjQPH86czUftrHB7j1Cxe1BjjDPaMS.png)


The first season of the WOO Battle Pass was a huge success.

Players showed up, completed quests, climbed the reward track, unlocked prizes, and gave us some very clear feedback.

The biggest thing we heard?

**The Premium Track was too cheap.**

Season 1 was our inaugural launch season, and the Premium Track was intentionally priced low while we tested the system, watched how players interacted with it, and learned what felt good from a reward and progression standpoint.

Now that Season 1 has proven the system works, Season 2 is coming in bigger.

Bigger rewards.

Bigger stakes.

Bigger milestones.

And a Premium Track price that better reflects the value inside.

---

# 🎟️ WOO Battle Pass Season 2 Overview

Season 2 of the WOO Battle Pass is built around consistent play.

This is not just a login bonus. This is a full seasonal progression system where players complete quests, earn XP, level up, and unlock rewards across both a Free Track and a Premium Track.


![ChatGPT Image Jun 26, 2026, 04_21_53 PM (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23u5WwgR7CgEyQU7fyNxToDYPQ3vnYkbDrJCFoZCUsW5J8N6X3XCXUKHZeM3SLL3Zk8F7.png)


## Season 2 Core Details

| Feature               | Details                                                  |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| Battle Pass Season    | Season 2                                                 |
| Season Length         | 28 Days                                                  |
| Total Levels          | 50                                                       |
| XP Per Level          | 1,000 XP                                                 |
| XP Needed to Complete | 50,000 XP                                                |
| Tracks                | Free Track + Premium Track                               |
| Premium Cost          | 25,000 WOO                                               |
| Main Rewards          | WOO Gym Bags, WOO Jobber Packs, WOO Tokens, WOOBucks     |
| Battle Pass Page      | https://play.wrestlingorganizationonline.com/battle-pass |

Players will have 28 days to climb through all 50 levels.

That means the Battle Pass is achievable, but it is not something designed to be finished casually without playing.

If you want the biggest rewards, you will need to stay active.

---

# 💰 Why the Premium Track Price Is Increasing

Season 1 Premium was priced at **1,000 WOO**.

That was a great launch price for the first season, but after seeing how players responded, it became clear that the Premium Track was underpriced.

Players told us the value felt much higher than the cost.

So for Season 2, the Premium Track price is increasing to:

# **25,000 WOO**

This is a major increase, but it makes sense for where the Battle Pass is going.

## Season 1 vs Season 2 Premium Price

| Season   | Premium Cost | Purpose                       |
| -------- | -----------: | ----------------------------- |
| Season 1 |    1,000 WOO | Inaugural test season pricing |
| Season 2 |   25,000 WOO | Full-value seasonal pricing   |

Season 1 helped us prove the system.

Season 2 starts moving the Battle Pass into a more serious role inside the WOO economy.

---

# 🧠 Why 25,000 WOO Makes Sense

The WOO Battle Pass is meant to do more than just hand out rewards.

It should also create a meaningful reason to use WOO.

The Premium Track is designed to be a real seasonal commitment. It gives players access to significantly more rewards, but it also asks players to put WOO into the system up front.

That matters.

## Why Increase the Cost?

| Reason                                | Why It Matters                                    |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| Better reflects reward value          | Season 2 has a much stronger reward pool          |
| Creates a stronger WOO use case       | Premium is unlocked with WOO                      |
| Makes completion feel more meaningful | Players have to commit to the season              |
| Protects the economy                  | Rewards are valuable, but not just free giveaways |
| Responds to player feedback           | Players said Season 1 was too cheap               |

This is not just a price increase for the sake of increasing the price.

It is a balancing adjustment based on player feedback, reward value, and long-term economy health.

---

# 🎁 Season 2 Reward Philosophy

Season 2 rewards are focused heavily on the items players care about most:

* **WOO Gym Bags**
* **WOO Jobber Packs**
* **WOO Tokens**
* **WOOBucks**

The Free Track is still very worthwhile, but it is mostly built around Gym Bags and Jobber Packs.

The Premium Track is a major upgrade, with significantly more rewards across the board.


![ChatGPT Image Jun 26, 2026, 04_21_53 PM (3).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23uExBVLZLFLu25KEgfVHf5QC49G5SQjwFMw1hATAYaHLJGESDC1bqKEgQMCJX1DAo9pp.png)


---

# 🆓 Free Track Rewards

The Free Track is available to everyone.

You do not need to unlock Premium to earn rewards during the season. If you show up, play, and complete quests, you can still make meaningful progress and earn useful items.

## Free Track Total Rewards

| Reward           |   Total |
| ---------------- | ------: |
| WOO Gym Bags     |      44 |
| WOO Jobber Packs |      30 |
| WOO Tokens       | 500 WOO |
| WOOBucks         |     100 |

The Free Track is designed to reward active players without flooding the game with too much liquid value for free.

There is some WOO.

There are some WOOBucks.

But the main focus is on gameplay rewards through Gym Bags and Jobber Packs.

---

# 💎 Premium Track Rewards

The Premium Track is where Season 2 becomes much bigger.

Players who unlock Premium will gain access to a much stronger reward path with more WOO Gym Bags, more WOO Jobber Packs, more WOO Tokens, and more milestone rewards.

## Premium Track Total Rewards

| Reward           |      Total |
| ---------------- | ---------: |
| WOO Gym Bags     |         84 |
| WOO Jobber Packs |         70 |
| WOO Tokens       | 18,000 WOO |
| WOOBucks         |        500 |

The Premium Track costs **25,000 WOO**, but players who complete it can earn back **18,000 WOO** from the Premium Track alone.

That means Premium does not simply become a full liquid refund.

Instead, the value comes from the full reward package.

---

# 🏆 Completed Premium Player Total

Players who unlock Premium and complete the Battle Pass earn both the Free Track and Premium Track rewards.

That means a completed Premium player can earn:

| Reward           | Completed Premium Total |
| ---------------- | ----------------------: |
| WOO Gym Bags     |                     128 |
| WOO Jobber Packs |                     100 |
| WOO Tokens       |              18,500 WOO |
| WOOBucks         |                     600 |

That is a massive seasonal reward pool.

The Premium Track gives players a way to earn back a large amount of WOO while also stacking up a huge amount of Gym Bags and Jobber Packs.

---

# 📊 Free vs Premium Comparison

Here is how the reward tracks compare.

| Reward           | Free Track | Premium Track | Completed Premium Total |
| ---------------- | ---------: | ------------: | ----------------------: |
| WOO Gym Bags     |         44 |            84 |                     128 |
| WOO Jobber Packs |         30 |            70 |                     100 |
| WOO Tokens       |        500 |        18,000 |                  18,500 |
| WOOBucks         |        100 |           500 |                     600 |

Premium is not a small upgrade.

It is a major seasonal boost.

But the Free Track still gives active players a strong reason to participate even if they do not unlock Premium.

---

# 📈 Bigger Rewards at Higher Levels

One of the important changes for Season 2 is that the best rewards are pushed toward the higher levels.

That means players who grind deeper into the pass will see stronger payouts as they go.


![ChatGPT Image Jun 26, 2026, 04_21_54 PM (4).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23uFHAsV3LzD2zGwEKGSuvP2w2jTA44FWMrtfyWouA6gXCcoYytPZifN37aH7k7EPEZ1j.png)


## Major Reward Milestones

| Level | Free Track Highlight | Premium Track Highlight |
| ----: | -------------------- | ----------------------- |
|    10 | Jobber Pack x2       | Jobber Pack x5          |
|    20 | Jobber Pack x2       | Jobber Pack x7          |
|    25 | WOO Gym Bag x3       | WOO x750                |
|    30 | Jobber Pack x3       | Jobber Pack x8          |
|    40 | Jobber Pack x4       | Jobber Pack x10         |
|    45 | WOO x100             | WOO x1,500              |
|    49 | WOO x125             | WOO x2,250              |
|    50 | Jobber Pack x5       | WOO x6,000              |

Level 50 is meant to feel like a real finish line.

The final Premium Track reward is a large WOO payout, giving players a strong reason to push all the way to the end of the 28-day season.

---

# 📋 Quest System: Daily, Weekly, and Seasonal XP

Season 2 progression is powered by quests.

Players will be able to complete Daily, Weekly, and Seasonal quests to earn Battle Pass XP.


![ChatGPT Image Jun 26, 2026, 04_21_54 PM (5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23uEukCJcjj2mqpSPp8enhhT6584RRHp3r518QK6fDhePduHDUcsprrSAoHzMUXLswRZg.png)


The goal is to reward consistent play without making the Battle Pass impossible for players who miss a day here or there.

## Quest Categories

| Quest Type      | Purpose                                                 |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| Daily Quests    | Encourage players to check in and play every day        |
| Weekly Quests   | Give larger goals across the week                       |
| Seasonal Quests | Reward long-term activity across the full 28-day season |

---

# ⚡ XP Needed vs XP Available

To complete the Battle Pass, players need **50,000 XP**.

Season 2 offers more XP than that through quests, so players have room to miss some days or skip some harder objectives.

## XP Balance

| Category                          | XP Available |
| --------------------------------- | -----------: |
| Daily Quest XP Per Day            |     1,100 XP |
| Weekly Quest XP Per Week          |     6,700 XP |
| Seasonal Quest XP Total           |    19,000 XP |
| Total XP Available Over 28 Days   |    76,600 XP |
| XP Needed to Complete Battle Pass |    50,000 XP |
| XP Buffer                         |    26,600 XP |

This means players do not have to be perfect every single day.

But they do need to participate.

The XP buffer gives players breathing room, while still making Level 50 something that active players have to work toward.

---

# 📅 What Does the XP Buffer Mean?

The Battle Pass requires 50,000 XP.

There is 76,600 XP available.

That gives players a buffer of 26,600 XP.

## What This Means for Players

| Player Behavior                                    | Outcome                             |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| Plays daily and completes most quests              | Strong chance to finish             |
| Misses a few days but completes weeklies/seasonals | Still has a path to finish          |
| Skips some harder quests                           | Still possible with consistent play |
| Barely logs in                                     | Will not finish                     |
| Wants Level 50                                     | Needs to stay active                |

This is the balance we want.

The Battle Pass should not feel impossible.

But it should also not feel automatic.

---

# 🗓️ Daily Quest Examples

Daily quests are meant to be simple, repeatable, and tied to normal gameplay.

## Daily Quest XP

| Quest              | Objective               |     XP |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- | -----: |
| Claim Daily Reward | Claim your daily reward | 100 XP |
| Play 3 Matches     | Finish 3 matches        | 200 XP |
| Play 5 Matches     | Finish 5 matches        | 250 XP |
| Win 1 Match        | Win 1 match             | 250 XP |
| Open 1 Pack        | Open 1 pack             | 200 XP |
| Burn 5 Cards       | Burn 5 cards            | 100 XP |

Daily total: **1,100 XP per day**

The daily quests are built to reward players for actually interacting with the game, not just clicking one button and leaving.

---

# 📆 Weekly Quest Examples

Weekly quests are bigger goals that help players make meaningful progress.

## Weekly Quest XP

| Quest                       | Objective                   |       XP |
| --------------------------- | --------------------------- | -------: |
| Claim 5 Daily Rewards       | Claim daily rewards 5 times |   750 XP |
| Play 20 Matches             | Finish 20 matches           | 1,000 XP |
| Play 35 Matches             | Finish 35 matches           | 1,250 XP |
| Win 7 Matches               | Win 7 matches               | 1,250 XP |
| Open 3 Packs                | Open 3 packs                |   900 XP |
| Burn 25 Cards               | Burn 25 cards               |   800 XP |
| Participate in 1 Tournament | Play in 1 tournament        |   750 XP |

Weekly total: **6,700 XP per week**

These weekly quests are important because they give players a way to catch up even if they miss some daily quests.

---

# 🏁 Seasonal Quest Examples

Seasonal quests reward long-term consistency across the full Battle Pass.

## Seasonal Quest XP

| Quest                  | Objective                    |       XP |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------- | -------: |
| Claim 20 Daily Rewards | Claim daily rewards 20 times | 1,500 XP |
| Play 90 Matches        | Finish 90 matches            | 2,000 XP |
| Play 150 Matches       | Finish 150 matches           | 3,000 XP |
| Win 30 Matches         | Win 30 matches               | 2,500 XP |
| Win 50 Matches         | Win 50 matches               | 3,000 XP |
| Open 10 Packs          | Open 10 packs                | 2,000 XP |
| Burn 100 Cards         | Burn 100 cards               | 2,500 XP |
| Play 4 Tournaments     | Participate in 4 tournaments | 2,500 XP |

Seasonal total: **19,000 XP**

These are designed to reward players who stick with the season from start to finish.

---

# 🔥 Why This Quest Design Works

Season 2 gives players multiple ways to progress.

You can progress by:

* logging in
* playing matches
* winning matches
* opening packs
* burning cards
* joining tournaments
* completing weekly goals
* working toward seasonal milestones

This keeps the Battle Pass from being too narrow.

Players do not have to complete every single quest, but the more they engage, the faster they climb.

---

# 📱 Mobile-Friendly Improvements

Alongside Battle Pass improvements, WOO has also continued improving the mobile experience across the game.

A lot of pages have received mobile-friendly updates, including:

| Page           | Mobile-Friendly Improvements           |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| Matches        | Improved usability on smaller screens  |
| Events         | Easier event viewing and participation |
| Battle Pass    | Better reward and quest viewing        |
| Earn           | Easier reward tracking                 |
| History        | Better browsing on mobile              |
| Explore Cities | Improved layout                        |
| Store          | Better mobile shopping experience      |
| Organization   | Improved mobile management             |


![ChatGPT Image Jun 26, 2026, 04_21_54 PM (6).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23wM4WXncQbD9AhHtgPYckLkj6H1UHtajzrsR3eosaihT67vz4wuU9abcmT1tTGc2dPpj.png)


This matters because players should be able to check progress, claim rewards, complete tasks, and manage their account from wherever they are.

WOO should feel better whether you are on desktop or mobile.

---

# 🏷️ What About Player Titles?

We recently added cosmetic Player Titles to WOO, and we would love to use Battle Passes as a way to reward exclusive titles in the future.

A Level 50 exclusive Battle Pass title would be an awesome reward.

However, the implementation for awarding Player Titles directly through Battle Pass tiers is not ready yet.

Rather than delaying Season 2, we are moving forward with a reward structure focused on:

* WOO Gym Bags
* WOO Jobber Packs
* WOO Tokens
* WOOBucks

Player Titles are still something we are excited about for future Battle Pass seasons once the reward integration is ready.


![ChatGPT Image Jun 26, 2026, 04_21_55 PM (7).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23uEz8HnHfgvbVBZCk7rXxbQ23QEwCr66A6d2b2sFMpygBTE9crwHyrcE8BPL27DFnxET.png)


---

# 👀 Who Should Unlock Premium?

The Premium Track is best for players who plan to actively play the season.

If you only plan to check in once or twice, the Free Track is still there for you.

But if you want to push through the full Battle Pass, complete quests, and chase the biggest milestone rewards, Premium is where the real value is.

## Free vs Premium Player Fit

| Player Type                                       | Best Fit              |
| ------------------------------------------------- | --------------------- |
| Casual player                                     | Free Track            |
| Active weekly player                              | Free Track or Premium |
| Daily player                                      | Premium Track         |
| Reward grinder                                    | Premium Track         |
| Player aiming for Level 50                        | Premium Track         |
| Player who wants the biggest pack and bag rewards | Premium Track         |

Premium is not meant to be mandatory.

It is meant to be valuable for players who plan to engage with the season.

---

# 🧩 Season 2 Is Built From Season 1 Feedback

Season 1 gave us real information.

Players liked the Battle Pass.

Players liked the reward structure.

Players liked having reasons to play daily.

Players also told us the Premium Track price was too low.

Season 2 is a direct response to that feedback.

## What Changed From Season 1?

| Area            | Season 1               | Season 2                    |
| --------------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------- |
| Premium Price   | 1,000 WOO              | 25,000 WOO                  |
| Reward Pool     | Inaugural test rewards | Larger seasonal reward pool |
| XP Structure    | Initial testing        | More tuned XP buffer        |
| Player Feedback | Very positive          | Used to shape Season 2      |
| Economy Role    | Early experiment       | Stronger WOO use case       |

This is how WOO improves.

We launch, we listen, we adjust, and we keep building.

---

# 🚀 Battle Pass Page

When Season 2 begins, you can access the Battle Pass here:

https://play.wrestlingorganizationonline.com/battle-pass


![ChatGPT Image Jun 26, 2026, 04_21_55 PM (8).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23u5zoUS8edxaq53zz47fwNPPrkgis7fQqJSXjno6errFVAJxPDmHQiDpT2V5dPS7SARQ.png)


---

# 🎯 Final Call to Action

Season 2 is bigger than Season 1 in every way.

A bigger Premium Track.

A bigger reward pool.

A bigger WOO commitment.

A bigger reason to play daily.

If you want the full rewards, you will need to show up, complete quests, and push through all 50 levels before the 28 days are over.

The Free Track is there for everyone.

The Premium Track is there for the players ready to commit.


![ChatGPT Image Jun 26, 2026, 04_21_55 PM (9).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23u5vN3DmJNDNVUsQzKR5GLDRwu2qXAbCBXgM4w2ctg33fC37cc5t271Wb1Tm5ZKxWmfo.png)


**Play daily. Complete quests. Level up. Earn bigger rewards.**

The WOO Battle Pass Season 2 is coming.

Are you ready?

body.title: Neutralizing Simulated Bandits.
body.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=alpha-g/6yy5nfuu

I tackled the remaining combat modules of the fundamentals program, mastered advanced melee combinations with blocking, cargo strikes, and firearm mechanics. After testing these skills against moving targets and active bandits, I finished my training in a free practice arena.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVHmtftB5qxfgHqtkRL13cUAgkpCDcSzXKuoquCb7FkgZ/screenshot_1_.png)

The Porter fundamentals program had one more test for me, which was about melee combat, where I had to eliminate the enemies using the specified actions and reach the objective area.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTwLUV9emjMQvse1bkfaDR4TbLHsV89nGF8csc3HENGCx/screenshot_2_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS5csLU2jRj39xjVqMSeWTEWhrbqZP6Sh9YFNbhjPde7z/screenshot_3_.png)

I started attacking the bandit using the specific actions where I had to try combination attacks at first, and then blocking, timing my defensive stance perfectly to deflect incoming blunt strikes from the training frame.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXuu7VjtURXcatnyFYzW36srwBjLyZJVemCzwRfAy9N9F/screenshot_4_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb2QFPMfAJwcRfjRZEro9mD6b4YLVc6YisnzuEvkfoqg9/screenshot_5_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcrTLkCYa6hV7ebjLejN7KP15t9zh2UxUNnoUXdGLEhmT/screenshot_6_.png)

Then I was taught how to jump attack with knee strike, and how to attack with cargo next, swinging a discarded container box like a makeshift heavy weapon to break the opponent's guard.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRQtrnZ4hGf8VMrX52JD58tpgf53BBcRWCxNG7L6gouf9/screenshot_7_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSDi8Rnhsw2hUvwPHXkRZWu47h8rZEGA28rYB1rJoPLhh/screenshot_8_.png)

After learning all those moves, I had to knock that bandit down using the actions I just learned. And then I made my way to the goal to finish it up.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYPvqpxi6BiGMHPfAiGMyqoHZFnLJ3B5HqdCrj43udXtY/screenshot_9_.png)

Then I understood the fundamentals program was not done yet, as I was yet to learn firearms action, where I had to destroy all targets with firearms, defeat all the bandits, and reach the objective area.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTjUeaP19BGijtfdidWovLJnHyWwvW5jL8i14v43y5xfa/screenshot_10_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYT3o4XJJ51W3B9tLuBrKP57477gExXe5XR4VJo6BjfSc/screenshot_11_.png)

After destroying all the moving targets with firearms, I reached another stage where some bandits were waiting for me, taking cover to scan the shooting range layout.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaTFyFoWQMZHVQQ2ALrgPQBCmtfPX1TPVFje86MLKGr2q/screenshot_12_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeLzijVZJ4D9Yxf9QD4MpKQihASc7J4hALMsFciewh1r7/screenshot_13_.png)

I knocked down the bandits as well using some firearms, and then I reached the objective area to finish the job.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRWn6Syi41QtXGr6FfTNx9UuyPv5GJPJyPtLJAXvU1UQz/screenshot_15_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQHx8Kf7mBs1NSNfHto9mkgASNueM9UUHhS8G6Gryks4x/screenshot_16_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVJ5p87Y4oZkYzHy5ECm8yz157VcDA4dJ2T2kJakPwcNG/screenshot_17_.png)

Now that I was done with the fundamentals program, I found another program which was like a free roam practice, where I could try everything I just learned, on bandits or on moving targets.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXfCUP8Qmw2x1zNFqK5qYw2WsJQN4f9NeNf7WVJsqbVLC/screenshot_18_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY9L7SyNQzAjzs9GxNjmmZ98iutYmQojLJibNMxq4x7cU/screenshot_19_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmezKBykNTcXSDuCLrgqsqEdG2mCwL6xbitCEfCdroABJr/screenshot_20_.png)

It seemed fun, as the bandit was not striking back, so I was just attacking him nonstop, using all the actions I learned in the sessions back, till I was satisfied. And it looked like the training sessions really came handy for me, and will be helpful in the real world.

---

Which shot was your favorite from today's set? Let me know in the comments. Until the next frame drops, keep exploring. Alpha Gamer, out.

> 📸 ** Every image in this gallery is an original screenshot captured during my live gameplay. Please credit if sharing.**

---

body.title: Y’all Need to Wake Up: Abundance Year Episode 2013 (audio: noxsoma.substack.com)
body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1948
Tuesday 30, June 2026
Abundance Year Episode 2013
Noxsoma Life Camp:  
Y’all Need to Wake Up
Quantum Dynamics
The Living Earth
Earth disaster. Deep water. El Nino. Weather.   

![2013.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXeEj1AHFxqnpdoPsjwykZtvvzVCU5UBPw68heQJdd1Sh/2013.png)

Today's Episode: https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1948_full_6-30-26_2013_tu:8?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 
I’m not angry. Or maybe I’m just in denial. 
Maybe I’m “too sensitive.” Back in the day people took sensitive to mean fragile. What actually happens is, we “sense” what’s going on around us. But we don’t sense these activities with the five senses they try to limit us to. 
If you’re asking who, “They are,” stop right now! You’re dismissed!!
We are taught about the five sense in school and through this repetitive limitation we focus on the big five and ignore the others. The really important ones. The ones that originate in the organs, gut, heart, brain, genitals, maybe even the spleen. If you somehow manage not to suppress your “organic” [pun intended], senses, you are seen as a weirdo, because you feel what others cannot, and they can’t have that. You must be ostracized. So you either go off to a corner of the school yard and talk to your imaginary friend, or you pretend you don’t feel what you feel, so you can fit-in with morons. You don’t react to the pain. You laugh at shit that’s not funny, but you always know when some shit’s about to go down. You invoke your physical senses, “I think I hear my Mom calling me.” And sho’nuff, you miss the drama.  
All humans are psychic. And all humans are healers. This is “normal.” What’s abnormal is the way modern day hominids behave and react, and cannot connect with their environment. Otherwise, you’d be able to heal yourself, or know how not to have to be healed. But accidents happen.  
It’s not just the land of the blind. It’s the land of the stupid, the violent, the addicted… basically the walking dead. The none player character.  
Denial is a beautiful place. It’s more like a state. You can walk around on cloud nine wearing a cultish smile on your face, glorify the day, write beautiful poetry and post cute images of kittens, while stress is eating you alive from the inside out. 
I was telling my recent house guest, that I might be stressed and not know it. 
Back in middle school, this cat called Reverend Melvin Floyd (1935 – 2020), used to come to our school and speak to us at assembly about drugs and stuff. (Drugs are bad, okay?) This is where I first heard about, “tolerance.” The body builds up a tolerance to the drug, so you need a higher and higher dose to kill the pain, until you O D. No more pain.  
It could be, and probably is, that your humble vagabond philosopher has been slacking on the nightly destressifying practices. It could also be, and we shall accept the following as truth, that the environmental stress, (probably from listening to the Church of Barking Dogs), has affected the vessel, and Ego doesn’t recognize it. This is where “imagination” comes into play. It’s kind of like what I call the “double-reverse,” but have since learned it’s been called a double-bind. 
Here’s the layout. You, (meaning Me,) don’t feel like you’re stressed. Nonetheless you’re feeling some kinda-way. Staying up too late. Sleeping too late. Can’t conjure the energy to go to the gym, or even to the playground, or even get out of the house sometimes. So, you have a talk with your imaginary friend, who has become a physician while you were ignoring her. She diagnoses you with stress. 
“But I don’t fee stressed. I’m chilly-will,” I insist. Denial is a beautiful place. 
Imaginary Doc says, “Use your imagination.”
“Huh?” grunts a perplexed carbon unit.  
“Imagine you are stressed, and do what you would do if you were stressed, even though you’re not.” 
My imaginary girlfriend, is a physician and a psychologist, but not a Freudian, thank god! (This is why we argue.) 
So that’s the look. Next comes the practice. Which means Solfeggio beats, Wayne Dyer affirmations, yoga poses and maybe even chanting. 
But that also means pulling myself away from my 823,543 followers. But y’all will understand. We won’t be missing any episodes anytime soon. As for these things, (audio companions). I might just whip something up that I can use again and again, like the TV guide. Something akin to a, “Back in 15 Hours” sign hung on the door of the Mind Cafe. Help yourself to a cuppa tea.

Remember your dharma. Elevate and expand. Peace.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQvpJmeeoRtEbDLpVzd34qb2HkCpfg5AefJ34Nq5rxSq7/img_20260128_094622_114.jpg)
Manuel y Gabriela se dirigían hacia la casa del pescador. El barrio era la imagen corrompida de la belleza colonial del centro de la ciudad, sus viviendas hacían sucumbir los techos alquitrabados a dos aguas con sus tejas criollas y afrancesadas. Sus amplios ventanales eran sustituidos por otros menos amplios y de mal gusto. Las antiquísimas casas de madera iban extinguiéndose ante el paso del tiempo y los ciclones que comúnmente azotaban a la región de Cienfuegos. De vez en cuando, un ambiente de plena desolación era el paisaje que caminaban hasta que el murmullo, la gente y las casas iban desapareciendo mientras más penetraban en la península y se acercaban de nuevo al mar. 

Ya en el lugar donde se situaba la casa del pescador, un grupo de viviendas cercanas al final de la península fastidiaban el entorno. Una de ellas, la más baja, era la casa del testigo. Su pequeñez y oscuridad mostraban las necesidades de estas personas que toda la vida se habían dedicado a la pesca. Una señora con canas que le hacían gris el rostro se encontraba impaciente en la puerta. Miró hacia los policías con los ojos casi cerrados por el cansancio y las arrugas. Sabía perfectamente a que venían. 

–Buenas, pasen por favor, enseguida les llamo a mi esposo –dijo la anciana–. Les voy a preparar un poco de café en lo que lo llamo, siéntense. 

Manuel asintió con la cabeza y se dio cuenta que no había mucho lugar donde sentarse, dos sillas hechas de cabilla o barras de acero, conformaban los muebles de la sala. Hacían compañía, un televisor de la antigua Unión Sovietica junto a una cama solitaria tendida con una sobrecama de Chenilla, gastada hacia el centro como una hoja transparente que mostraba la debilidad de la tela por el paso del tiempo.
 Manuel miro a su acompañante; luego, realizó una nueva pesquisa a su alrededor. Recordó que en la casa de su abuela había existido un televisor como ese, imponente en madera y bombillos, “toda una reliquia de la industria soviética y hasta le pintaron el tubo de pantalla”, pensó mientras a su cabeza venían las imágenes de una época en que los televisores simulaban ser equipos de alta tecnología con toda una gama de colores gracias a los trazos de pintura con pincel que les daban a los tubos de pantalla y hasta algunos que utilizaban brochas sin ton ni son para competir con los nuevos televisores llegados gracias al CAME y todos los países socialistas de Europa del este, ya con los colores incluidos dentro de su sistema y solo adquiridos por dirigentes y algunos vanguardias en su trabajo.

 “Que época esa”, pensó, “comprar cuando podías hacerlo y de acuerdo a lo que te tocaba, para vivir ahora del libre mercado y lo que puedes comprar con dólares, porque lo demás es nada, ni la libreta de la bodega te alcanza”. Terminó sonriendo mientras observaba los rasgos de aquella historia pintoresca en el televisor. 

Para Gabriela la casa tenía cierta opacidad, provocada por la media luz que iluminaba dos habitaciones a la vez y por las manchas de tizne de una lámpara chismosa que junto a las telarañas adornaban el techo. Consideró que en algún tiempo la casa no tuviera luz. Un vaho caluroso y sostenido aumentaba el olor a pescado y tal vez a masa de cangrejo o jaiba que provenía del patio trasero de la vivienda. Era un olor penetrante que llegaba a ser molesto, y provocó que Gabriela se parara en el marco de la puerta y respirara profundo. El teniente Madrazo con el rabillo del ojo la siguió, “esta jevita no tiene tabla para esto, aunque también no sé si yo la tenga”, calculó. 

De forma disimulada observó sus pequeñas nalgas moviéndose en forma cadenciosa acusando un hilo sobre el centro de las mismas. Manuel estaba decidido a acercarse a la puerta y observarla más detenidamente, pero la llegada de la anciana con dos vasitos plásticos marcados por el olor a café paró en seco su disposición.
 
–Tomen, está calientico –dijo la señora
–Gracias –respondió Gabriela por los dos.

El café tenía buen aspecto, su olor penetraba con la misma fuerza que su sabor por los labios. Deleitados por el elixir no habían reparado en la entrada del anciano por la única cortina que separaba la sala del resto de la vivienda.

– ¿Está bueno el café? –pregunto el pescador. 

Manuel sintió la tonalidad nerviosa y preocupada del hombre a pesar de tener un rostro tranquilo. Sus manos sudaban y no se mantenían fijas en un solo lugar, pasaban del área de los muslos hacia el pecho y del pecho terminaban en un juego incontrolable entre los dedos, lo que obligó al oficial a pararse y entregarle su silla para tranquilizarlo. El pescador lo miró fijamente por varios minutos antes de hablar.

–Cuando estábamos subiendo la chalupa a la arena, me extraño ver unas ropas ripiás ahí mismitico en la arena. Mi sobrino cogió el farol chino y entró al barco –hizo una pausa tragando el café qué parecía estar más amargo que nunca.
–Luego, sentí un grito de horror y entré corriendo. Encontré a mi sobrino agachado ante ese hombre medio muerto que parecía querer decirle algo al oído….
– ¿Y luego? –preguntó Gabriela adelantándose a la narración.
–Falleció –dijo tajante el pescador.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgEYwbWXsPtnALCquFf8frbap3fDb9s56qGhCcPDj5KD/_al_nhyamar78_1_.jpg)</center>

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQUNqDXZ5CVYPvhJr369ApccLYKQU3ANCKR6XqUPbQJhB/versi_n_en_espa_ol_3_.jpg)</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQvpJmeeoRtEbDLpVzd34qb2HkCpfg5AefJ34Nq5rxSq7/img_20260128_094622_114.jpg)
Manuel and Gabriela were heading towards the fisherman's house. The neighborhood was a corrupted image of the colonial beauty of the city center; its houses were crumbling, their tarred, gabled roofs covered in Creole and French-style tiles. Their once-wide windows were being replaced by smaller, tasteless ones. The ancient wooden houses were slowly disappearing, ravaged by time and the hurricanes that frequently battered the Cienfuegos region. At times, a scene of utter desolation unfolded before them, until the murmur of voices, the people, and the houses themselves faded as they ventured deeper into the peninsula and drew closer to the sea.

Upon reaching the fisherman's house, a cluster of dwellings near the tip of the peninsula marred the surroundings. One of them, the lowest, was the house of the witness. Its small size and darkness reflected the needs of these people who had dedicated their lives to fishing. A woman with gray hair that made her face appear gray stood impatiently in the doorway. She looked at the police officers with eyes almost closed from weariness and wrinkles. She knew perfectly well why they were there.

\

Manuel nodded and realized there wasn't much room to sit. Two chairs made of rebar or steel bars were the only furniture in the room. A television from the old Soviet Union stood next to a solitary bed made up with a chenille bedspread, worn in the center like a transparent sheet, revealing the fabric's weakness from the passage of time.

Manuel looked at his companion; then, he took another look around. He remembered that his grandmother's house had once housed a television like that one, imposing in its wooden frame and light bulbs, \

he thought, as images flashed through his mind of a time when televisions pretended to be high-tech equipment with a whole range of colors thanks to brushstrokes applied to the picture tubes, and some even used random paintbrushes to compete with the new televisions arriving thanks to the CMEA and all the socialist countries of Eastern Europe, which already had color integrated into their systems and were only acquired by leaders and a few at the forefront of their work.\n\n\

He finished with a smile as he observed the traces of that picturesque history on the television screen.\n\nFor Gabriela, the house had a certain gloom, caused by the dim light illuminating two rooms at once and by the soot stains from a stray lamp that, along with the cobwebs, adorned the ceiling. She wondered if the house had once been without electricity. A hot, lingering steam intensified the smell of fish and perhaps crabmeat emanating from the backyard. It was a pungent odor, almost unpleasant, causing Gabriela to stand in the doorway and take a deep breath. Lieutenant Madrazo watched her out of the corner of his eye. \

he mused.

He discreetly observed her small buttocks swaying rhythmically, revealing a thong across their center. Manuel was determined to approach the door and observe her more closely, but the arrival of the old woman with two small plastic cups, redolent of coffee, stopped him in his tracks.

“Here, it’s nice and hot,” the woman said.

“Thank you,” Gabriela replied for both of them.

The coffee looked good; its aroma penetrated their lips with the same intensity as its flavor. Lost in the elixir, they hadn’t noticed the old man enter through the single curtain separating the living room from the rest of the house.

“Is the coffee good?” the fisherman asked.

Manuel sensed the man’s nervous and worried tone despite his calm expression. His hands were sweating and fidgeting, moving from his thighs to his chest, and from there, his fingers flailing uncontrollably. This prompted the officer to stand and offer him his chair to calm him down. The fisherman stared at him for several minutes before speaking.

“When we were hauling the boat onto the sand, I was surprised to see some tattered clothes lying there on the sand.” My nephew grabbed the Chinese lantern and went aboard—he paused, swallowing his coffee, which seemed more bitter than ever.

Then I heard a scream of horror and ran inside. I found my nephew crouched before that half-dead man who.

body.title: If I Had The Choice, I'd Fly.
body.body: > I just came to the realisation that I have only ever used one means of transportation throughout my life, and that is road transport and seriously, this is the only one I have used. Whether it is travelling within my state or going to another state, it has always been by road, I have spent countless hours inside buses, from short trips that take less than an hour to very long journeys that seem like they will never end,so let's say technically, road transport is the one I have the most experience with. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmShqcqERxFUx6yuM2HygSXLjAitekAYJY9exQKRv7uzc8/1782824717134.png) But if you ask me to choose my favourite mode of transport, I don't think I will choose road, I will choose air transport, and it is not because I have experienced it before, but because of how fast and convenient it is, let us be honest, one of the most tiring things about travelling by road is the amount of time you spend sitting inside a bus. There are some journeys that can take over fifteen hours depending on where you are going to and by the time you finally arrive, your whole body is already complaining, your back hurts, your legs feel stiff, you are tired before you even begin whatever took you there. Sometimes you even get stuck in traffic for hours, and there is absolutely nothing you can do about it except wait, that one alone can be very frustrating, so now compare that with travelling by air, imagine getting to the airport, boarding your flight, and arriving at your destination in about an hour instead of spending almost a whole day on the road, that sounds like a dream to me. I also like the whole idea of being in the air, maybe it is because I have never experienced it before, but I think it would be exciting to look out through the airplane window and see the clouds from above, I have watched videos of people flying, and every single time I tell myself that one day I would love to experience it too. I know flying is more expensive than travelling by road, and that is one of the reasons many people still choose buses, It is simply more affordable. But if money was not a problem at all and I had the opportunity to choose freely every single time, omooo, I would definitely go by air, even though I have not travelled by air before, I actually do hope I get to experience it someday soon, I think it would be one of those moments I would never forget. But until then, road transport remains the only mode of transportation I know, It has taken me to school, to family events, and also different places over the years, some journeys were smooth, while others were long and very exhausting, but they have all became part of my travel experiences sha ... So for now untill there's a chance in my financial status, I will keep using the road, but if you ask me what my favourite mode of transport is, my answer will still be the same. If I had the choice, I would fly. *** --- ***Image Modified with ChatGpt*** Join the Indiaunited Contest [HERE](https://peakd.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-195215e392a64) ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)

body.title: A come back: What happened for the last 3 months?
body.body:
>

**Hi, Creative Minds with Optimistic Hearts!**

![Screenshot 2025-07-18 083102.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mriakyla/23tmBQZPGeUZwgn2SwLSbENSbzecY9ASV8TcgWJiqozGRLVUaeskDvvpb4JgzzVwS1wpg.png)

It's been 3 months since my last visit here in Hive. How have you guys been? I missed wandering here connecting with each of you. I am truly excited to share to you what happened in these months! I can't put it in one blog. So, this will serve as my teaser only. The past months have been a rollercoaster of emotions, inside and out.

Let's start with March!

So guys, I haven't been able to write blogs because as I shared with you, I am a Department officer. And March to April are preparations for the College Fiesta event. There were various activities like: sports, academics and performances. And of course, I was assigned in the performance segment. The pageantry side.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mriakyla/23xVTp1s9WCKjbBex6PwWwR5CsNXDVcGjmWVoe67L2W12uQ4XvJRRMwBBEkZF3Qgx96Sy.png)

I handled 3 candidates. And boy-oh-boy, it was kinda heavy and hectic. One candidate, for Miss CRMC 2025 and two candidates are for the Mr&Ms. SportsIcon.

It started by picking of our candidates with a screening. I searched each section of our department to look for the right candidates. Then, at our try-out, we conducted the screening. I was so happy because a lot of beautiful girls screened. Last time, only 4 ladies did. 

I created a small production number for them, for us to see who can \

on stage. And surely, all of them did! Then, an introduction and their Q&A, to test their wit. Thankfully, with the help of our teachers, my co-officers, and our department handler, we found our lovely candidates.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mriakyla/23tvgjbuUVjmNRv8rcK2PmZczp63cTaSfFZTwupW1ceBi5NRAuyEp93N5F1eCshpvKQxt.png)

For almost a month, I took charge of everything. From budgeting, trainings, preparations and coordinating with the organizers and handlers - I lead the steps. But of course, I wouldn't have done it without these individuals: the handler, my regents, my co-officer and our teacher, during the final show.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mriakyla/23xL5DyUBXfQFTjJTtZS9S8i7J4cp4WeUspPrnWJgGAq1qK5RyEiwbUKifzgses6Ntigx.png)

For this event, I really struggled with budgeting. Unlike my first one from Founders Day, where we have enough finance for everything.  Here, I really have to take a good grip at holding the money. Goodness, 3k budget for 3 candidates plus handler and assistant for the pictorial, opening, and final night. And it's great if only a meal for each, but sometimes it's like breakfast and lunch or lunch and dinner. And other unexpected necessities are included and snacks for the four weeks of practice. My mind was really running wild during those times. But, with God's grace, thankfully, it went well.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mriakyla/23tbuCMbYnMr5hMWxDoFDd2efHRsr5TyGmoHhJDDyhqezqLUYc129UxF1XNx4DTkR2yB8.png)

In the middle of a tiring fiesta, a party for each department was held. For us, we had it two nights before the final event - the Miss CRMC. Our PsychNight, with a theme: A Psychtacular Sparkle of Chaos. We had a Barbie theme. In our department, walls and differences are less activated and alerted, of course it is respected. But in terms of a space where you can be yourself and loose your facade of character? Chaos of Sparkle and laughter it is! Our mother dean, sets the lead to be just ourselves. Of course, we follow. I just love our department. A program, games, a dinner, a beat of songs, and a heat of dance. That night sum it hahahaha. Here are the pictures.

But mind you guys, me, the regents and our candidate were 2 hours late in this event. You know why? WE WERE STILL PRACTICING ON STAGE, BECAUSE THAT WAS THE ONLY TIME WE CAN TAKE THE PLACE SOLELY. 

After everything, it was like a thorn was pulled from me hahaha. But, I'm still grateful for the opportunity and trust the department have given to me. My leadership skills was honed, my capabilities were improved, I got to get along with people even better and I learned to be decisive and diligent. It's not enough you participated or showed up in a competition. You should make it grand, with all your best and your artistry. Still, it is a lesson to be learned.

My experience for the College Fiesta event was truly one of a kind.

For you, do you think being an officer is worth it?

body.title: Travel Gadgets: Making Journeys Smarter and More Convenient
body.body:
# Travel Gadgets: Making Journeys Smarter and More Convenient

Traveling has become an essential part of modern life. People travel for business, education, tourism, and personal reasons, often covering long distances across countries and continents. As technology continues to evolve, travel gadgets have emerged as valuable tools that make journeys [13win.com](https://13win-asia.com/), safer, and more enjoyable. From navigation devices and portable chargers to smart luggage and translation tools, modern travel gadgets help travelers overcome challenges and enhance their overall experience.

Travel gadgets are technological devices specifically designed to assist travelers before, during, and after their journeys. These gadgets improve convenience, communication, navigation, safety, and [xổ số 13win](https://13win-asia.com/xo-so-13win/). Whether someone is traveling locally or internationally, the right gadgets can save time, reduce stress, and provide greater peace of mind.

One of the most essential travel gadgets is the portable power bank. Smartphones, tablets, cameras, and other electronic devices are heavily used during travel for communication, navigation, and entertainment. A power bank allows travelers to recharge their devices when electrical outlets are unavailable. High-capacity power banks can charge multiple devices and are particularly useful during long flights, road trips, and outdoor adventures.

Smart luggage has become increasingly popular among modern travelers. These advanced suitcases often include GPS tracking systems, digital locks, USB charging ports, and weight sensors. GPS tracking helps travelers locate lost luggage, while built-in charging features ensure devices remain powered throughout the journey. Smart luggage combines convenience with enhanced security.

Portable Wi-Fi hotspots are another valuable travel gadget. Internet connectivity is crucial for accessing maps, booking services, communicating with family, and staying informed. Portable hotspots provide secure internet access in locations where public Wi-Fi may be unreliable or unavailable. These devices are especially useful for international travelers.

Language translation gadgets have transformed international travel. These devices use artificial intelligence and speech recognition technologies to translate conversations in real time. Travelers can communicate more effectively with people who speak different languages, reducing misunderstandings and enhancing cultural experiences.

GPS navigation devices remain important travel tools. Although smartphones offer navigation applications, dedicated GPS gadgets often provide more reliable performance in remote areas. These devices help travelers find routes, locate destinations, and avoid traffic congestion, making journeys more efficient and less stressful.

Noise-canceling headphones are highly valued by frequent travelers. Long flights, crowded airports, and busy transportation hubs can be noisy and exhausting. Noise-canceling technology reduces background sounds, allowing users to relax, enjoy entertainment, or focus on work while traveling.

Portable water purifiers are particularly useful for adventure travelers and outdoor enthusiasts. These gadgets remove harmful bacteria, viruses, and contaminants from water sources, providing access to safe drinking water in remote locations. Portable purification systems contribute to health and safety during travel.

Travel adapters are essential gadgets for international journeys. Different countries use varying electrical outlets and voltage standards. Universal travel adapters allow travelers to connect and charge electronic devices regardless of their destination, eliminating compatibility concerns.

Smart travel wallets offer enhanced security for important documents and valuables. Many models include RFID-blocking technology that protects credit cards and passports from electronic theft. Some smart wallets also feature tracking systems that help users locate misplaced items.

Action cameras have become popular among travelers who want to document their experiences. These compact and durable devices capture high-quality photos and videos in challenging environments. Adventure travelers often use action cameras during activities such as hiking, diving, skiing, and cycling.

Health and fitness gadgets also support travel experiences. Smartwatches and fitness trackers monitor physical activity, heart rate, sleep patterns, and health metrics. These devices help travelers maintain healthy routines and stay informed about their well-being during trips.

One major benefit of travel gadgets is convenience. Many travel-related tasks that once required significant effort can now be completed quickly and efficiently using smart devices. Travelers can access information, manage reservations, and solve problems with minimal difficulty.

Safety is another important advantage. GPS tracking, emergency communication tools, and secure storage gadgets help protect travelers and their belongings. Advanced technologies provide additional layers of security and reduce travel-related risks.

Travel gadgets also improve communication. Translation devices, internet connectivity tools, and communication platforms enable travelers to stay connected with family, friends, and colleagues regardless of location. Effective communication enhances both personal and professional travel experiences.

Entertainment is another area where travel gadgets excel. Portable gaming devices, e-readers, tablets, and multimedia systems help travelers remain entertained during long journeys. Access to digital content makes travel more enjoyable and comfortable.

Despite their many advantages, travel gadgets also present challenges. Cost is a common concern, as high-quality devices can be expensive. Travelers must carefully evaluate their needs and choose gadgets that provide the greatest value.

Battery life is another limitation. Many travel gadgets depend on rechargeable batteries, which may require frequent charging during extended trips. Portable power solutions help address this issue but do not eliminate it entirely.

Device security is also important. Travelers must protect gadgets from theft, damage, and unauthorized access. Strong passwords, tracking features, and protective cases help safeguard valuable equipment.

Overreliance on technology can sometimes create challenges. Technical failures, connectivity issues, or software problems may disrupt travel plans. Travelers should maintain backup options and basic problem-solving skills to manage unexpected situations.

The future of travel gadgets is highly promising. Artificial intelligence will enable smarter travel assistants capable of providing personalized recommendations, itinerary management, and real-time support. These systems will make travel planning and execution more efficient.

Augmented reality technologies may enhance tourism experiences by providing interactive information about landmarks, historical sites, and cultural attractions. Travelers could access educational content simply by viewing locations through smart devices.

Wearable travel gadgets are expected to become more advanced. Future smart glasses, translation devices, and health-monitoring wearables may provide seamless access to information and services throughout journeys.

Sustainability will also influence the development of travel technology. Eco-friendly materials, energy-efficient designs, and renewable power solutions will help reduce the environmental impact of travel gadgets.

In conclusion, travel gadgets are transforming the way people explore the world. They improve convenience, safety, communication, entertainment, and overall travel experiences. From smart luggage and portable chargers to translation devices and navigation systems, these technologies help travelers overcome challenges and enjoy smoother journeys. While issues such as cost, battery life, and security remain, ongoing innovation continues to enhance travel technology. As new advancements emerge, travel gadgets will play an even greater role in making journeys smarter, safer, and more enjoyable for people around the globe.

body.title: Y’all Need to Wake Up: Abundance Year Episode 2013 (audio: noxsoma.substack.com)
body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1948
Tuesday 30, June 2026
Abundance Year Episode 2013
Noxsoma Life Camp:  
Y’all Need to Wake Up
Quantum Dynamics
The Living Earth
Earth disaster. Deep water. El Nino. Weather.   

![2013.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXeEj1AHFxqnpdoPsjwykZtvvzVCU5UBPw68heQJdd1Sh/2013.png)

Today's Episode: https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1948_full_6-30-26_2013_tu:8?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 
I’m not angry. Or maybe I’m just in denial. 
Maybe I’m “too sensitive.” Back in the day people took sensitive to mean fragile. What actually happens is, we “sense” what’s going on around us. But we don’t sense these activities with the five senses they try to limit us to. 
If you’re asking who, “They are,” stop right now! You’re dismissed!!
We are taught about the five sense in school and through this repetitive limitation we focus on the big five and ignore the others. The really important ones. The ones that originate in the organs, gut, heart, brain, genitals, maybe even the spleen. If you somehow manage not to suppress your “organic” [pun intended], senses, you are seen as a weirdo, because you feel what others cannot, and they can’t have that. You must be ostracized. So you either go off to a corner of the school yard and talk to your imaginary friend, or you pretend you don’t feel what you feel, so you can fit-in with morons. You don’t react to the pain. You laugh at shit that’s not funny, but you always know when some shit’s about to go down. You invoke your physical senses, “I think I hear my Mom calling me.” And sho’nuff, you miss the drama.  
All humans are psychic. And all humans are healers. This is “normal.” What’s abnormal is the way modern day hominids behave and react, and cannot connect with their environment. Otherwise, you’d be able to heal yourself, or know how not to have to be healed. But accidents happen.  
It’s not just the land of the blind. It’s the land of the stupid, the violent, the addicted… basically the walking dead. The none player character.  
Denial is a beautiful place. It’s more like a state. You can walk around on cloud nine wearing a cultish smile on your face, glorify the day, write beautiful poetry and post cute images of kittens, while stress is eating you alive from the inside out. 
I was telling my recent house guest, that I might be stressed and not know it. 
Back in middle school, this cat called Reverend Melvin Floyd (1935 – 2020), used to come to our school and speak to us at assembly about drugs and stuff. (Drugs are bad, okay?) This is where I first heard about, “tolerance.” The body builds up a tolerance to the drug, so you need a higher and higher dose to kill the pain, until you O D. No more pain.  
It could be, and probably is, that your humble vagabond philosopher has been slacking on the nightly destressifying practices. It could also be, and we shall accept the following as truth, that the environmental stress, (probably from listening to the Church of Barking Dogs), has affected the vessel, and Ego doesn’t recognize it. This is where “imagination” comes into play. It’s kind of like what I call the “double-reverse,” but have since learned it’s been called a double-bind. 
Here’s the layout. You, (meaning Me,) don’t feel like you’re stressed. Nonetheless you’re feeling some kinda-way. Staying up too late. Sleeping too late. Can’t conjure the energy to go to the gym, or even to the playground, or even get out of the house sometimes. So, you have a talk with your imaginary friend, who has become a physician while you were ignoring her. She diagnoses you with stress. 
“But I don’t fee stressed. I’m chilly-will,” I insist. Denial is a beautiful place. 
Imaginary Doc says, “Use your imagination.”
“Huh?” grunts a perplexed carbon unit.  
“Imagine you are stressed, and do what you would do if you were stressed, even though you’re not.” 
My imaginary girlfriend, is a physician and a psychologist, but not a Freudian, thank god! (This is why we argue.) 
So that’s the look. Next comes the practice. Which means Solfeggio beats, Wayne Dyer affirmations, yoga poses and maybe even chanting. 
But that also means pulling myself away from my 823,543 followers. But y’all will understand. We won’t be missing any episodes anytime soon. As for these things, (audio companions). I might just whip something up that I can use again and again, like the TV guide. Something akin to a, “Back in 15 Hours” sign hung on the door of the Mind Cafe. Help yourself to a cuppa tea.

body.title: LOVE LETTER 💌 TO ABBA FATHER
body.body:
Dear ABBA,

Sometimes I sit and think...

Even without showering me with Your love,
Your care, Your grace,
and Your countless acts of kindness,
You would still be GOD.

You would still be LORD.
Still be KING.
Still be THE MONARCH OF THE UNIVERSE.

![17828233410473428986005218812481.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AKJ1ukuzVVjhnfbNTaLWCGSU2H3Ktw4bSgDUFGBmZRsWaSdSAcUEpvjwZLfJgfq.jpg)


Nothing would be taken away from YOU if YOU didn't love me.

YOU are GOD all by YOURSELF.

And that leaves me wandering in my thoughts 
Because Your Love was never an obligation.
YOU didn't have to choose me.
YOU didn't have to be this kind.

Yet YOU did.

Your Love is another thing entirely
It is not merely what YOU give.
It is who YOU are; LOVE 

I wish I knew how to explain what Your Love feels like.
I wish words were enough.
But they always fall short.

Because Your actions have always spoken louder than language.

Every care, show of mercy;
Every gentle reminder that I am seen.

YOU have loved me in ways I could never earn,
and in ways I may never fully understand.

Not because You had to love me...
but because You wanted to.

And that truth will forever leave me in wonder

Thank YOU ABBA 🥹❤️

                
                                  
Yours Faithfully,
                              Your    

                             beloved 

P.S: Today's piece is not longggg though ABBA deserves a lottttttt more 🥹🥰
Thank YOU for being on this series with me, it's your handsome friend John Petra.
Peace 🕊️ and love 💕

body.title: Trip To La Pineda
body.body: > The beach of La Pineda, with its golden sands and crystal clear waters, is the epitome of a tropical paradise. As the sun begins to set and the shadows lengthen, the magic really begins. In this post I want to show you the charm of the evening and night photographs of this beautiful coast, capturing the gentle play of light and dark, the reflections of the city lights on the calm sea and the fleeting beauty of these moments. ![La (5).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSqtsUdRoYY5Jg9KkTiFMuhCsUu1BM41xguKzJJpqQvC3/La%20(5).jfif) As day gave way to night, the sky became a canvas streaked with hues of orange and gold. The sun dipped toward the horizon, casting long shadows on the sand and creating a dramatic contrast between light and shadow. I couldn't fail to capture in photos the essence of the calmness of the beach before nightfall. The waves, which until recently had been gentle and playful, now take on a more melancholy movement under the soft light of the sunset. They crashed against the shore with a seductive whisper, leaving a trail of white foam in their wake. These details add a sense of movement and life to photos, making them even more dynamic and captivating. ![La (4).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfEJnWGzeebeVq2aWQtkx1ALCCZ1aqxctj2T95KVWEZBi/La%20(4).jfif) After dark, the city comes alive with thousands of twinkling lights reflecting off the calm sea. This situation gave me the opportunity to experiment with reflections and refraction of light. The city skyline, illuminated by inscriptions and bright facades, is refracted in the water surface, creating a kaleidoscope of colors and shapes. Images of city lights reflecting on the water give La Pineda Beach an ethereal, almost otherworldly atmosphere. The buildings seem distant and unreachable as their reflections seem to dance on the waves. It evoked in me a sense of admiration and wonder at the beauty of nature mixed with human creation. ![La (3).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZfgg5km6KJSyWr9SoQ9hQnzDPpTqLJKWDZqJzyRwiBVS/La%20(3).jfif) Night photos on the beach are filled with romance and intimacy. Light from the moon and stars illuminated the sand, casting long shadows that gave the scene a dreamy and romantic feel. People walking on the beach and sitting on the shore seemed isolated from the outside world, absorbed in the beauty of the moment. In my photographs, I used longer exposures to blur the motion of the waves and recreate a silky effect, adding a sense of calm. The starry sky strikes me as a dramatic backdrop, emphasizing the solitude and silence of the night beach. ![La (2).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUK4x9HBAFG4u5skrj5HMa3rWvhhaCLjoN5VFXMF8EefZ/La%20(2).jfif) The light changes and the scenes are transient, making every shot different. This encounter with nature and night photography was really very pleasant for me. I knew I had limited time to capture the essence of the beach as I was aware of the changes in light and mood of the weather. ![La (1).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSuqWMs35qa73vQ34sFNJhkejzzQsSzqfPQ3diwUoJbUr/La%20(1).jfif) [//]:# (!worldmappin 41.07546 lat 1.18222 long d3scr)

body.title: Not the Easter Bunny, But the Eastern Cottontail
body.body:
My evening walks are always an adventure. This time of year that adventure includes rabbit-spotting.  Rabbits are everywhere it seems. Sometimes we see two on one lawn.  These little critters are busy.   According to one [rescue center](
https://wildliferescuecenter.org/animal/rabbits/), the rabbit's peak breeding season in my area is between early spring and September.

![still rabbit 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23tmBhTJgyvAfkAyr3whqgRa6mtPyePDaWsuybBpz3raCgaPiHriWUKWx4kBFM9PsFtTL.png)

The lovely, long-eared character in my shot is an Eastern cottontail.  There are only two species of rabbit in New York (my state in the USA): the New England cottontail and the Eastern cottontail. They are almost impossible to tell apart, but they are distinct species and do not interbreed.  One, the New England, is [listed](https://dec.ny.gov/nature/animals-fish-plants/new-england-cottontail) as \

The other species, the Eastern is not threatened. 


![funny rabbit2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/EorzJTzsFSQQQrSe1TqBnNWFCZMVZkp8HAmzZSm7Y4mfAvmM8PrAFiY5esYBuCGs9jZ.jpg)










We were amazed when we passed the rabbit that it was well on its way to digging a noticeable hole in a neighbor's grass.   The animal was watchful, but it didn't stop digging. 

![rabbit smaller.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23vsDhtTaHnzw7c4k4FjyXkokMKJFMDocSjT3ZUWhZvvZd2Xvzt3suUAbhbfixGh5GjH2.png)


In this really short *YouTube* video you can see the rabbit from the back, working away.  Look at this on *YouTube*.  You get a better view.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mL8Urkpq1Gg

I didn't know rabbits were such fans of lawn grass. After watching this rabbit chomp away, I saw others also eating lawns.  According to *Homes and Gardens* [website](https://www.homesandgardens.com/gardens/how-to-protect-a-lawn-from-rabbits), rabbits are \

. That is apparently very true. 

We went back the next day to see if the rabbit had actually made a burrow. It hadn't but it left this naked patch, actually a hole, in the turf. 



![turf hole.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/Eobzm26uFEEh3sCiDYoxQPGYPUVJRtXEwSzzkf9MSYyXyBqcqDBw9WVEREHPQujmmZ3.png)

We went back last night to see if the damage caused by the rabbit had been repaired.  It had not.  Here's a shot I took in the dark. This clearly shows the rabbit hole was still there. No rabbit, but clear evidence of his visit.


![turf at night.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/EnymbsBEhNa2CrdHAj2RsgTaDudJc8oAkXQNEfPAFkTvjXbGGCgUH8yTtFVVkryyN4Y.jpg)

So far this year I have seen rabbits on my lawn, but no signs of damage. Although, it seems we have a vole or some small animal digging tiny holes in my backyard.  

Here's a really short video of the neighbor's rabbit taking note of my presence and then continuing to eat. He doesn't seem frightened, which is surprising considering how vulnerable rabbits are to predators.  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0RfGHL_Xyho
While we don't have coyotes or bobcats in my neighborhood, we do have owls.  Every morning we hear an owl hoot at about 5 am.  The owl is sort of the neighborhood rooster.  According to the website [birdfact.com](https://www.birdfact.com/articles/do-owls-eat-rabbits), owls prey on rabbits of all sizes. 

Here's what the site says about owls eating rabbits:
>Owls will mainly hunt and catch rabbits when they're out in the open eating grass. They'll generally perch on a branch and wait patiently.

Oh dear. That's not good at all for our grass-chomping rabbit.  Apparently the owl swoops down and kills the rabbit with its talons straightaway.  Some owls can carry rabbits that are four times their weight.


I'm amazed that our sweet, lawn-destroying rabbit was not more alarmed.  Here's another short video of the rabbit taking note of my presence and continuing to eat.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hswi58y02gc

It's not as though the rabbit could defend itself if attacked.  A rabbit's defense mechanism is basically freeze, or run for your life.  A rabbit does have [claws, teeth and powerful back legs](https://bunnylady.com/can-rabbits-defend-themselves/) they can use to fight back. They use these often against each other.

 

Rabbits are highly [territorial](https://bunnylady.com/can-rabbits-defend-themselves/).  If a strange rabbit enters the territory a fierce fight will ensue.  In the following amazing video (from *YouTube), two rabbits are standing on their hind legs and 'boxing'.  I don't know who won this match.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kBhQ4JjwuSI

Why do rabbits fight? I just [looked that up.](https://nebraskawildliferehab.org/wildlife-help/wildlife-conflict-issues/rabbits.html) Predictably, male rabbits fight over females.  Females fight over nesting areas.  In reading about fights between rabbits, I came across [this passage](https://nebraskawildliferehab.org/wildlife-help/wildlife-conflict-issues/rabbits.html):

>The female rabbit creates a nest for her babies by making a shallow indentation in the ground called a scrape. She lines this scrape with dry grass and fur plucked from her chest. This creates a warm, dry, water-repellent, comfortable resting place for the babies. These nests are frequently constructed in the middle of a lawn, in the open, to the amazement of homeowners. 

Oh heavens!  Was my lawn-chomping rabbit making a nest?  That's what it looks like. However, the nest isn't likely to last long in that neighbor's yard.

Here is another short digging video.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iprLCf4iq5w&t=5s

Do the survival strategies of the Eastern cottontail work?  For the species, apparently it works fine. The IUCN [lists it](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_cottontail) as a species of 'least concern'. For individual rabbits, the rabbit lifestyle does not give the rabbit a high chance of survival.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fq_4Wp5yMmU

One rabbit can have as many as [70 offspring](https://a-z-animals.com/blog/eastern-cottontail-lifespan-how-long-do-they-live/)--kits--a year.  They need that many because only about 44% of a litter make it past their first month. Care of the kits is entirely up to the mother.  Only about 25% live for a full year.  Actually, the average life span for a rabbit that survives the nest is 11 months. These statistics are for wild rabbits. Domestic rabbits can live up to ten years.(Information from [a-z animals.com](https://a-z-animals.com/blog/eastern-cottontail-lifespan-how-long-do-they-live/))

 Here is another short animal video I shot:

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/l1CO1u90iAg

You can see I was fascinated, and delighted by this rabbit.  The people who own the house do own a dog, but that dog is contained behind a fence on the porch.  The evening I shot these videos the dog was not in evidence.

I hope you enjoyed my little Eastern cottontail excursion.  I certainly did.

Peace and health to all.

Hive on!

_____
***All videos and photos were shot by me, except the video of the boxing rabbits (credited in the post)***

body.title: Funny Prompts On Rally - Web3 Ups & Downs
body.body: Shoutout to [Rally ](https://rally.fun/r/pvmihalache)for bringing back the stories behind the trades, not just the PnL screenshots. Let's make have fun while we remember the Web3 ups and downs that made us who we are! \n\nI accidentally got into DeFi after spotting my own meme in a [Harvest Finance](https://x.com/harvest_finance) article! Replied \

and they offered to sent me two $FARM tokens for the effort! 

It was 2020 back then... just the start of the DeFi summer! I installed MetaMask just to claim it, but had no clue what an EVM wallet was, and that's my first DeFi interaction! 

Fast forward I somehow ended up farming airdrops across half the Layer 2 ecosystems, and creating crypto content for thousands of days. Had Web3 jobs and got better at building! 

[Rally](https://rally.fun/r/pvmihalache) gave me the Reverse Bio idea, so went for a trip down memory lane! It started with a Bitcoin article on Publish0x and it expanded to community roles at UMA, Across and Horizen! 

Ready for the jobs of the future? I want to be a Clone Identifier! This specialist verifies which human was the original DNA source after dozens of legally registered clones exist!

Sounds like a weird one but someone has to figure out which Elon Musk is Elon Musk Prime. Our world will evolve faster then we adapt, and we will cling to the past! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdznFEzDRkT6mEQjhsNhTCyMxwHPVMBEhn38hLkk3Zw5f/image.png)


Some corners of the internet disappear quietly, but they leave behind some of the best memories. This is my little eulogy for the [SuperUmans](https://x.com/SuperUmans) and the great frens' I made along! 

I still miss those days. Logging in every morning, grinding missions with the community, celebrating every small win, and of course... boosting those KPI options! If you know, you know!

It was chaotic, fun, and somehow managed to turn the simplest things into inside jokes that everyone shared. Crypto moves so fast that entire communities can become memories before you realize it.

New platforms launch every week, but that feeling of everyone building, laughing, and creating together is much harder to replace. It ended as quick as it started... like everything in crypto! 

Here's to the SuperUMAns, the egg jokes we made along the way, and the people who made that little corner of the internet feel like home. What's the online community you still miss the most?


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWBs3nizPLjS9kReDqZQpMhrqMc5evQn97HSNjL2qSvug/image.png)

It takes trust to let people in, to let them see what you are not proud of.  You must have been a good friend to them.

For me, the issue between individuals needs to be worked out always with children in mind.  We are free agents, until we have children. Then we have a responsibility that is larger than ourselves. body.title: Portable Handheld and Table Fan Hybrid
body.body:
> #
Portable Handheld and Table Fan Hybrid

https://youtu.be/mVY5FoRLPFU?si=QDGiI1VMmCagb_YT

> So many people have some kind of version of this fan apparently. I see people holding them these days, especially since this June has been the hottest one on record in the UK. I've had this one for about a year now. I bought it off a TikTok ad when they had some sales so I got a deal on it. It's actually quite a good fan. Unlike the one I see people holding, this one has a stand so it can be used as a table fan. The base also comes with a self-adhesive plate so it can be stuck to a smooth wall or tile surface or something like that. The base is easily detachable so it can still be used hand-held since only the base is attached to the surface. The battery is also quite long lasting, probably more so than the average, because this thing lasts me all day. It also comes with a neck strap so it can be used as a neck fan. It has 5 speed settings even though the lowest setting is already quite good. The top speed, 5, feels like a much larger fan. Of course, it uses more energy in that setting. I like this device because it's a singular purpose device. It doesn't try to be an LED light, power bank or moustache shaver 😅. It just does one thing and does it very well indeed. Peace & Love, *Adé*

>Good evening everyone, how are you my friends who love macrophotography and I hope you are having a pleasant day and in good condition wherever you are. On this occasion I have no activities outside so on this occasion I went back around this small forest, and as my daily routine always hunts for small animal species in the forest and at that time I took my Smartphone camera and macro lens and then I put it in a small bag.

\n\n

>And at that time I immediately took this small bag and immediately left on my motorbike. and a few minutes later when I arrived there I immediately walked and circled this small forest and hoped to get some species of small animals, and in the middle of walking and accidentally found a species of bush cricket crawling on one of the wild leaves, and at that time I immediately approached it to see from and its body shape was quite large compared to other species of crickets.

\n\n

>And it has a very attractive color shape and its beautiful eyes look unique. And at that time I immediately took my smartphone camera and macro lens in my small bag, and without waiting long I immediately took several different angles of pictures and looked very beautiful and graceful, and on this occasion I again show some portraits of this bush cricket species, and you can see them below.
