body.title: [Movie] El riesgo de Keanu Reeves: Por qué Siberia (2018) no es la película que esperas [ENG/SPA]
body.body: >\n\nWho doesn’t love Keanu Reeves? He is the quintessential action hero—the man who emerges unscathed from the worst shootouts, defeats the \

claims the glory, and delivers that cathartic sense of triumph we find so comforting in big-budget cinema. He is the classic American figure, adept at business, romance, and handling a gun.

Yesterday, I decided to watch *Siberia* (2018), drawn in precisely by his name. Yet, what I found was not just another Hollywood action flick. I discovered a monumental risk taken by Reeves. I found more than a crime thriller or suspense film a genuine theatrical tragedy.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arribaeltelon/241tXLtP9GhTMKxYtbDPy6deFFfkWYNvURLw74i54kL3JkvdJEvPrfzZbivQCiHfCcqA3.png) 
[Sources](https://www.themoviedb.org/movie/438689-siberia?language=es)
</center>
> ***Breaking the Mold of the American Hero***

In *Siberia*, Keanu plays Lucas Hill, a diamond trader trapped in a ruthless underworld. Yet, there is no room here for the \

Unlike his other blockbusters where the protagonist comes out on top, manipulates money at will, and rescues the damsel this film reveals a completely different side: the vulnerability of a man walking straight into his own checkmate.

A reflective note: In a cinematic world obsessed with happy endings and instant gratification, it is worthy of applause that a star of Reeves's stature would take on such a raw project that deconstructs the hero myth.

> ***Checkmate on the Russian Steppe: Crime, Romance, and Doom***

The film is marketed as a suspenseful romance, but those elements merely set the stage for something far deeper. The romance that blossoms amidst the Siberian chill is no typical Hollywood love story; it is a desperate refuge for two souls who know their time is running out.

What we are truly witnessing is a structure of classical tragedy:

*The flawed hero:* Lucas is no superman; he makes mistakes, trusts the wrong people, and finds himself overwhelmed by circumstances.

*The oppressive atmosphere:* Siberia’s frozen landscape acts as a character in its own right, a constant reminder of the isolation and coldness of his fate.

*Inevitable destiny:* There are no miraculous last-minute plot twists. The tension lies not in whether he will be saved, but in how he will come to terms with his downfall.

>  ***Conclusion: The Value of a Tragic Ending (My Assessment)***

If you are looking for pure, *John Wick*-style adrenaline, you will be disappointed. In fact, TMDB (The Movie Database) gives it a rather low score—hovering around 43% demonstrating that mainstream audiences were expecting the usual commercial formula but instead ran into a wall of Siberian cold.

However, art isn't always measured by its ability to please the masses. Personally, I give it a score of 68/100. It earns that rating through the boldness of its subject matter and, above all, the courage of its final decision. In a risk averse Hollywood that prefers sugar-coated endings, the fact that this story embraces its tragic nature to the very end is something worth highlighting.

For me, *Siberia* was a powerful reminder that Keanu Reeves is much more than just a blockbuster actor; he is an artist willing to risk his \

screen persona to remind us that both in life and in great drama the most powerful stories are those that end in an inevitable checkmate.



*Souces*

*Screenshot from: [TMDB](https://www.themoviedb.org/movie/438689-siberia?language=es)
I used Google Translate*

</div class=\

>

### SPANISH 

¿Quién no ama a Keanu Reeves? Es el héroe de acción por excelencia, el hombre que sale ileso de las peores balaceras, que derrota a los \

, se queda con la gloria y nos da esa catarsis de éxito que tanto nos reconforta en el cine taquillero. El clásico norteamericano hábil para los negocios, el amor y las armas.

Ayer decidí ver Siberia (2018) guiado precisamente por su nombre. Pero lo que encontré no fue otra entrega de acción hollywoodense. Encontré un riesgo monumental por parte de Reeves. Encontré, más que un thriller de crimen y suspenso, una auténtica tragedia teatral.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arribaeltelon/241tXLtP9GhTMKxYtbDPy6deFFfkWYNvURLw74i54kL3JkvdJEvPrfzZbivQCiHfCcqA3.png) 
[Fuentes](https://www.themoviedb.org/movie/438689-siberia?language=es)
</center>

> ***Rompiendo el molde del héroe estadounidense***

En Siberia , Keanu interpreta a Lucas Hill, un comerciante de diamantes atrapado en un despiadado submundo. Sin embargo, aquí no hay lugar para el \

. A diferencia de sus otros éxitos de taquilla, donde el protagonista triunfa, manipula el dinero a su antojo y rescata a la damisela, esta película revela una faceta completamente distinta: la vulnerabilidad de un hombre que se dirige directamente hacia su propia trampa.

Una reflexión: En un mundo cinematográfico obsesionado con los finales felices y la gratificación instantánea, es digno de aplauso que una estrella de la talla de Reeves se haya embarcado en un proyecto tan crudo que deconstruye el mito del héroe.

> ***Jaque mate en la estepa rusa: crimen, romance y fatalidad***

La película se promociona como un romance lleno de suspense, pero esos elementos solo preparan el terreno para algo mucho más profundo. El romance que florece en medio del frío siberiano no es la típica historia de amor de Hollywood; es un refugio desesperado para dos almas que saben que se les acaba el tiempo.

Lo que realmente estamos presenciando es una estructura de tragedia clásica:

*El héroe imperfecto:* Lucas no es un superhombre; comete errores, confía en las personas equivocadas y se ve abrumado por las circunstancias.

*La atmósfera opresiva:* el paisaje helado de Siberia actúa como un personaje más, un recordatorio constante del aislamiento y la frialdad de su destino.

*Destino inevitable:* No hay giros argumentales milagrosos de último minuto. La tensión no reside en si se salvará, sino en cómo afrontará su caída.

> ***Conclusión: El valor de un final trágico (Mi valoración)***

Si buscas adrenalina pura al estilo John Wick , te llevarás una decepción. De hecho, TMDB (The Movie Database) le otorga una puntuación bastante baja, alrededor del 43%, lo que demuestra que el público general esperaba la fórmula comercial habitual, pero se topó con un muro de frialdad siberiana.

Sin embargo, el arte no siempre se mide por su capacidad para complacer a las masas. Personalmente, le doy una puntuación de 68/100. Se gana esa calificación por la audacia de su temática y, sobre todo, por la valentía de su decisión final. En un Hollywood reacio a los riesgos que prefiere los finales edulcorados, el hecho de que esta historia abrace su naturaleza trágica hasta el final es algo digno de destacar.

Para mí, Siberia fue un poderoso recordatorio de que Keanu Reeves es mucho más que un actor de éxitos de taquilla; es un artista dispuesto a arriesgar su imagen de \

en la pantalla para recordarnos que, tanto en la vida como en el gran drama, las historias más poderosas son aquellas que terminan en un jaque mate inevitable.

>

body.body:
> Todo estaban el estudio de holozing, diseñado, compartiendo ideas, hasta que las luces de ese lugar se apagaron y una sola computadora que era donde siempre se revelaban las criaturas del torneo comenzó a mostrar línea verde a como si se estuviera dañando, pero en realidad se estaba preparando para revelar el tercer grupo de criaturas que iban a formar parte del torneo. El empresario no dijo nada esta vez, ya que estaba seguro de que había hecho la elección correcta para este tercer grupo, por eso solo tomo una silla y sentó para disfrutar del espectáculo. >Everyone was in the holozing studio, designing and sharing ideas, until the lights in the room went out and a single computer—the one that always revealed the tournament creatures—began to display green lines as if it were malfunctioning, but in reality, it was preparing to reveal the third group of creatures that would be part of the tournament. The businessman didn’t say anything this time, since he was sure he’d made the right choice for this third group, so he simply pulled up a chair and sat down to enjoy the show. ![loppj.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdZXysgChiBdAPWhrBfdfZPMtw2jWQatQD4McEa9Yog2P/loppj.jpg) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/manos-escritorio-sentado-mesa-6804597/) El primero en aparecer fue VERDION, una criatura de aspecto orgánico, por su color y habilidades. Su cuerpo parecía estar formado por corteza en movimiento, como los árboles, además de sus hombros crecían estructuras similares a hojas luminosas que cambiaban de color según su estado. Lo mejor era su música, ya que era de tonos profundos mezclados con pulsos digitales, como si el bosque tuviera un latido artificial. Sus estadísticas SINCRONÍA: 97%, ADAPTACIÓN: 100% y REGENERACIÓN DINÁMICA: 98% —No solo se adapta al terreno, lo escribe—murmuró uno de los programadores. El segundo fue TERRARION, siendo una criatura muy fuerte, donde su estructura parecía una mezcla entres piedras y una armadura tectónica, además en cada movimiento generaba microfractura en él tierra por lo fuerte que era. Su música era pesada, con golpes de percusión que recordaban a placas tectónicas chocando entre sí. Sus estadísticas SINCRONÍA: 94%, DEFENSA: 100% y CONTROL DE TERRENO: 99% —Este será un gran rival— dijo Claudio en voz baja. El tercer fue muy distinto y era conocido como GLACION, su cuerpo era delgado, elegante, ya que estaba hecho de cristal y nieve comprimida, además con cada respiración liberaba pequeñas partículas heladas que flotaban en el aire. Mientras que así música era minimalista, casi silenciosa, con notas agudas que cortaban el aire como vidrio fino. Sus estadísticas SINCRONÍA: 98%, CONTROL TÉRMICO: 100% y PREDICCIÓN DE MOVIMIENTO: 99% —Esta criatura no reacciona al combate, lo anticipa antes de que exista— dijo el diseñador. >The first to appear was VERDION, a creature with an organic appearance, both in color and abilities. Its body seemed to be made of moving bark, like trees, and from its shoulders grew structures resembling luminous leaves that changed color depending on its state. The best part was its music, which consisted of deep tones mixed with digital beats, as if the forest had an artificial heartbeat. Its stats: SYNCHRONY: 97%, ADAPTATION: 100%, and DYNAMIC REGENERATION: 98%. “It doesn’t just adapt to the terrain—it shapes it,” murmured one of the programmers. # >The second was TERRARION, a very powerful creature whose structure resembled a mixture of rocks and tectonic armor; moreover, every movement it made caused microfractures in the earth due to its sheer strength. Its music was heavy, with percussive beats reminiscent of tectonic plates colliding. Its stats: SYNCHRONY: 94%, DEFENSE: 100%, and TERRAIN CONTROL: 99%. “This will be a formidable opponent,” Claudio said quietly. # >The third one was very different and was known as GLACION; its body was slender and elegant, as it was made of glass and compressed snow, and with every breath it released tiny icy particles that floated in the air. Meanwhile, its music was minimalist, almost silent, with high-pitched notes that cut through the air like fine glass. Its stats: SYNCHRONY: 98%, THERMAL CONTROL: 100%, and MOVEMENT PREDICTION: 99%. “This creature doesn’t react to combat—it anticipates it before it even happens,” said the designer. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRWyvf4NCrZyhtBihnKpCrjguMJHXgyHPmTw9dcSy3jzm/image.png) [Source](https://peakd.com/hive-131131/@holozing/new-creature-reveal-dragon-creatures-naming-contest-concluded-and-zing-distribution-changes) La pantalla volvió a colocarse en negro, pero una vez que encendió mostró a las tres criaturas juntas por primera vez: VERDION, TERRARION y GLACION. El estudio quedo en silencio total, puesto que estas tres criaturas eran dragones y podían sorprender en este gran torneo. El empresario finalmente sonrió, esta vez con menos calma que antes dijo —Ya no estamos diseñando un torneo, estamos creando el mejor juego del mundo— con esas palabras todos aplaudieron, ya que cada vez el torneo iban creciendo y el nivel de habilidades y poderes cada vez está más alto. >The screen went black again, but when it lit up, it showed the three creatures together for the first time: VERDION, TERRARION, and GLACION. The studio fell completely silent, as these three creatures were dragons and could be a surprise in this major tournament. The businessman finally smiled, this time with less composure than before, and said, “We’re no longer just designing a tournament; we’re creating the best game in the world.” At those words, everyone applauded, as the tournament continued to grow and the level of skill and power kept rising.

body.title: Building Reusable Editing Templates in Kdenlive
body.body:
If you find yourself creating the same titles, transitions, colors, and layouts for every project, it is time to start using templates. A well prepared template allows you to begin editing immediately instead of rebuilding your workspace and graphics every time you start a new video.

Whether you create tutorials, travel videos, product reviews, or educational content, reusable templates can significantly improve your editing workflow.

## Why Use Templates
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmP6hDuVoadbscaCSnYCZ7JYzxwvf7Mbx9CGd16iS9ZCMi/ChatGPT%20Image%20Jun%2030,%202026,%2005_17_21%20PM.png 

Many editors spend the first fifteen minutes of every project importing the same assets, creating title designs, arranging tracks, and adjusting the workspace.

Templates eliminate this repetitive work.

Instead of starting with an empty project, you begin with everything already prepared.

This lets you focus on editing rather than setup.

## Create a Standard Project

Start by creating a project that contains the elements you use most often.

For example:

* Intro sequence
* Outro sequence
* Logo
* Background music track
* Title design
* Lower third design
* Organized timeline tracks

Once these are ready, save the project as your master template.

The next time you begin a video, simply open the template and replace the placeholder content with your own media.

## Organize Your Tracks

A consistent timeline makes editing much easier.

For example, you might use:

* Video Track One for the main footage.
* Video Track Two for overlays.
* Video Track Three for titles.
* Audio Track One for voice recordings.
* Audio Track Two for music.
* Audio Track Three for sound effects.

Using the same arrangement in every project helps you work more quickly because you always know where each element belongs.

## Save Common Titles

If you regularly use the same title style, there is no need to recreate it.

Design your title once, then duplicate it whenever you need a new version.

Simply change the text while keeping the same font, colors, and animation.

This creates a consistent visual identity across all of your videos.

## Keep Frequently Used Effects

Many projects require similar adjustments.

For example:

* Color correction
* Audio level adjustments
* Fade in and fade out
* Sharpening
* Noise reduction

Instead of remembering every setting, save a reference project containing these effects so you can copy them into future edits.

## Store Your Assets

Create a dedicated folder for items that appear in multiple projects.

This folder might include:

* Logos
* Intro music
* Sound effects
* Background graphics
* Fonts
* Watermarks

Keeping everything together makes starting new projects much easier.

## Create Project Folders

Use the same folder structure for every edit.

For example:

* Video
* Audio
* Images
* Exports
* Project Files
* Thumbnails

A consistent folder structure prevents missing files and makes backups much easier.

## Save Different Templates

One template may not suit every type of video.

Instead, create several templates.

For example:

* Tutorial template
* Travel video template
* Podcast template
* Product review template
* Short social media video template

Each template can include graphics, titles, and timeline layouts designed for that type of content.

## Update Templates Regularly

As your editing skills improve, your templates should improve as well.

Replace older title designs.

Improve transitions.

Organize tracks more efficiently.

Add new graphics or music.

Your templates should evolve alongside your editing style.

## Keep a Backup

Templates often become some of your most valuable editing resources.

Store a backup on another drive or in cloud storage.

If your computer ever fails, you can quickly restore your editing environment without rebuilding everything from scratch.



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@hansama/building-reusable-editing-templates-in-kdenlive-ddc)

body.title: Tomorrow is the beginning of the biggest regulatory experiment our industry has ever seen. 🧡
body.body:
Tomorrow is the beginning of the biggest regulatory experiment our industry has ever seen. 🧡

On July 1st, MiCA's transition period officially ends.
From tomorrow onwards, exchanges operating in Europe need a CASP licence.

On paper, the objective is clear:
- more trust
- more transparency
- better consumer protection

These are good goals.
But here's where things become interesting.

Europe also says goodbye to two of the biggest names in crypto.

USDT, the world's largest stablecoin, chose not to pursue MiCA authorisation.
Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange by trading volume, reaches the deadline without a MiCA licence.

Think about what that means.

A regulation designed to protect European users now prevents them from accessing the world's largest stablecoin through regulated platforms and significantly changes access to the world's largest exchange.

So here's the question.

Is consumer protection simply about reducing choice?
Or should it also mean giving consumers access to the best products within a safe regulatory framework?

Because those are not necessarily the same thing.

History teaches us something important.
Demand rarely disappears. It adapts.

People who still want USDT won't suddenly stop needing dollars.
People who still want products unavailable on regulated platforms won't suddenly lose interest.

They'll simply look elsewhere.
To offshore platforms. To DeFi.
To solutions outside the perimeter regulation was trying to shape.

That's why the real challenge is writing rules together with the people building the industry.
Builders. Exchanges. Stablecoin issuers. Banks. Regulators. Users.

Because regulation works best when it understands the technology it's regulating.

MiCA is undoubtedly a milestone.
It brings legal certainty.
It creates a common European framework.
It will help institutional adoption.

All of that matters.

But tomorrow also marks the moment when we'll start discovering the unintended consequences of the framework.

The real question isn't whether MiCA succeeds.
The real question is: Will Europe manage to protect consumers... without protecting them from innovation itself?

That's the conversation worth having. 🧡

A few days ago, I told you about a futures grid strategy. Today I will explain its practical side, how it generates profit and where losses are possible.

As I mentioned before, if you want to use a grid strategy, the first requirement is to have a Binance account. On Binance you can easily apply a futures grid strategy to cryptocurrencies, metals or other tradable assets.

As I explained earlier, silver has good volatility. Since it is a strong and valuable metal I believe it is more suitable for investment and trading. It is considered one of the safer assets after gold and its demand continues to increase over time. That is why my main focus is on silver and I recommend trading silver more than other assets.

As you can see in the screenshot the futures grid that I started yesterday is giving me a good profit ratio. I simply set a trading range between 52 and 62. My bot will continue trading automatically as long as the price stays within this range.

Based on this range, I opened both a long position and a short position on silver. I used 2x leverage because I consider it relatively safe and I allocated 500 USDT to each side of the trade.

![Screenshot 2026-06-30 111527.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23w3EnVJejUiakGE5vD5ozYiB3p6bH6fm5uvsR1KJarRquR1z5L5ixKTiS5FuDj7pe31e.png)

The strategy works like this whenever the price of silver moves by around 0.2%, the bot executes a trade and books a small profit.

So far, within the first 24 hours the bot has completed around 250 trades and generated about $5 in profit. In my opinion this is a very good return based on the APR.

I have set both the upper and lower trading limits at about 8%. As long as the price remains within this range, the bot will continue generating profits.

The main risk comes if silver makes a strong one-sided move of more than 8%, either upward or downward and breaks out of my trading range. In that situation there is a chance of a temporary loss.

![Screenshot 2026-06-30 111603.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23sxpXQpjBiM2QEsfELCDyJ7W6U4QGis1aKT8uPHPNVcVKMv7gNq6VMZKJLDi1XYxydA9.png)

As you can see in the screenshot, many grid orders are active and the bot is continuously trading.

body.title: Exporting Videos in Kdenlive Choosing the Best Render Settings for Every Platform
body.body:
After spending hours editing your project, the final step is exporting it. This process, called rendering in Kdenlive, converts your timeline into a video file that can be uploaded, shared, or archived.

Choosing the right render settings is important because they affect video quality, file size, and compatibility. Fortunately, Kdenlive provides presets that make exporting straightforward for most projects.

## What Is Rendering
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQKhrHJcEoH66WLmhSnmw9qDxHNZQrZHnhNhbn6JHB4qd/ChatGPT%20Image%20Jun%2030,%202026,%2005_13_20%20PM.png 

Rendering is the process of combining every clip, effect, transition, title, and audio track into a single video.

Unlike editing, which works with your project files, rendering creates a finished video that can be played on almost any device.

The time required depends on your computer, the length of the project, and the number of effects being used.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPCiLnDgdHVp7HjQRQPZirjnmG8L9GT2j56WwmUJQYs7d/Screenshot_2026-06-27_13-57-31.png 

## Open the Render Window

When your edit is complete, click the **Render** button in the toolbar.

A new window opens with several export options.

Here you can choose:

* Output format
* Resolution
* Frame rate
* Quality settings
* Save location
* File name

Take a moment to review these settings before starting the render.

## Choosing the Right Format

For most users, the MP4 format is the best choice.

It offers good image quality while keeping file sizes manageable.

It is also supported by YouTube, Vimeo, social media platforms, televisions, and mobile devices.

Other formats are available for specific purposes, but MP4 is usually the safest option.

## Match Your Project Settings

Whenever possible, export your video using the same resolution and frame rate as your project.

For example:

* A Full HD project should be exported at 1920 × 1080.
* A 4K project should remain at 3840 × 2160.
* A project edited at 30 frames per second should usually be rendered at 30 frames per second.

Matching these settings helps preserve image quality.

## Understanding Bitrate

Bitrate controls how much information is stored in each second of video.

Higher bitrates generally produce better quality but also create larger files.

Lower bitrates reduce file size but may introduce visible compression.

For most online videos, the default bitrate provided by Kdenlive is sufficient.

Only increase it if you notice visible quality loss.

## Select a Save Location

Before rendering, choose a folder where the finished video will be stored.

Use clear file names that include the project name and version number.

For example:

* Travel Video Final
* Tutorial Version Two
* Product Review Final Edit

Clear file names make future revisions much easier.

## Preview Before Rendering

Always watch your project from beginning to end before exporting.

Look for:

* Missing clips.
* Incorrect titles.
* Audio problems.
* Sudden cuts.
* Color issues.
* Spelling mistakes.

Finding these problems before rendering saves time and prevents unnecessary exports.

## Test Short Exports

If you are using several new effects, render a short section first.

Testing a small portion allows you to verify quality without waiting for the entire project to finish.

Once you are satisfied, render the complete video.

## Upload Friendly Settings

If your video is intended for YouTube or similar platforms, there is usually no need to use extremely high quality settings.

A standard MP4 export with the correct resolution and frame rate provides excellent results while keeping upload times reasonable.

Large files take longer to upload and may not produce noticeably better quality after online compression.

## Save Your Project

Rendering creates the final video, but it does not replace your project.

Always save the Kdenlive project file separately.

Keeping the project allows you to return later to make corrections, update titles, or export the video again using different settings.

Many editors also keep a backup of important media files along with the project.

body.title: Cafe Onthel: Classic, History, Taste
body.body:
Hello guys....

How are you all? I hope you are all well and always happy. Meet me again, nice to meet you all. I'm back with my story about visiting a beautiful cafe with delicious drinks.

This time, I visited a rather unique cafe, Cafe Onthel. The cafe, which has an old-school theme, is very unique and interesting. I came here with my family. Even though it was quite a long way to go, my mother really wanted to come here, so we headed there.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWLjyALonx3C2P7j1NCbDKvmpzqmDY6gxGbZvcoZV4jUa/1782793978657.jpg)

This cafe is unique and beautiful, very comfortable. They have a spacious cafe, spacious parking, lots of tables and chairs. You can sit outdoors or indoors, choose whichever you think is most comfortable. Because this time I came with my family, they wanted to sit outdoors, so that's how it was. Even though it's outdoors and the weather is very hot, sitting here isn't too hot, because there are fans and also a roof that covers from the hot sun.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPmco1FqFCJNXuaZNaAJpw4DGhEDACx8BbLo4zz3ArK3R/1782794174766.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVhbsLAUmNBGeULpEHMX1sXE7z8VmBR9RtjHvaSw9z8Yo/1782794174805.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ5gUrX941wfBbUoxU2Dy75GpuQCMDd7deA8BBGzq63PY/1782794174843.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbgUNQakc8Wf4vThLzjPbAZZLY2SwabgE8WRWi1UV7qZQ/1782794174883.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfBKjmNJzxmartLDb2GN4ifV82KnfTqkMtPv9wz98NMoc/1782794174918.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdHiPN38UMCr3PWNHgCi2c8dzR1LrAE1XqDLJnMgxKwwx/1782794285195.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbF61vNxgVA4oyfRhY3SbVg2kZ29CGQgZXNN1u7PC8enM/1782820591630.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWxNv4LXuPvEcb268M5SAPGaEMk4DwDx59zhCZzbWXSx7/1782820591675.jpg)


There are several menu options here, ranging from snacks, main courses, desserts, and even a selection of drinks. Of course, they offer a variety of rice and chicken options with various chili flavors, such as Nasi Ayam goreng Cabe ijo, Nasi Ayam goreng sambal pecak, and others. They also offer a wide selection of drinks, including coffee, chocolate, matcha, strawberry, tea, and more.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaJesQFM3WDzCbzPprdQXtGsezToKQ2rggS1yW5oPzpmj/1782811368972.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdYEghhXqtNMdTLMhGYnLhE1ch31ToPFrzrX6QibwZzKw/1782811383768.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWHCiyDmGHs3oCBkNQ4mWc4a3ghKJ91aTrFwQMC24rRKm/1782811383810.jpg)

They also have a new menu, namely ice cream. There are ice cream cones and ice cream cups. There is also an option of ice cream with added bread.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcYujvgDhxyzKZntDmrwtgJ4RjZgCjjWTZr61Rz11NXkb/1782811448469.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQAzjPwPbH8eos22SDGjxrqGvCZ3paaCznybe17ykT18K/1782811448512.jpg)

*Nasi Ayam Goreng Sambal Pecak*


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWQjgZX18N8E472TrBRhUWhG4EVT1X8Y1Ekkiy3c6GB7d/1782811528913.jpg)

For the main course, I ordered Nasi Ayam Goreng Sambal Pecak (fried chicken rice with pecak chili sauce). It consisted of fried chicken breast, rice, tofu, tempeh, fried eggplant, tomatoes, cucumbers, and sambal pecak.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPvTSui5QgHgJiHPPUJ9SwJnUX95j3po9ZkJAWLK7JFAM/1782811701895.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgfgR8V1pJFHtDbUxU4GNUoHzWGaRAUukhPW1ei7uMKc/1782811701941.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTZy1L2BxNMx8ZyVxgfXn6guMtphXvpKYBNNPmBvfW7Pw/1782811701977.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb3VF5d1FdjHmQAdkMyEicYwctHVhYG6zWtywABw3bMPw/1782811702012.jpg)

Sambal pecak is a traditional Indonesian (especially Betawi and Javanese) chili sauce dish with a spicy, savory, and refreshing flavor. Its main characteristics lie in the sprinkling of hot water or hot cooking oil and the generous amount of sliced shallots, giving the sauce a distinctive kick.

And the Pecak Sambal Fried Chicken Rice from this cafe is very delicious, tender chicken fried very well. Tofu, tempeh and eggplant are also fried well, the rice is fluffy. And most importantly when eating this is the taste of the sambal, and it is very delicious, dominated by spicy and savory flavors. Very delicious.

*Bakwan Jagung*

Besides rice, I also ordered a snack. The snack I ordered was Bakwan Jagung (corn fritters). This dish, made from flour, vegetables, and corn, is one of my favorite snacks. It's delicious, soft on the inside and crispy on the outside. It's even more delicious with the sauce.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQHuhB2WFdLHPRUJ6rmuWZyk95EMAsyyDNNnzhVxJHoFM/1782820905727.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU2F65ZAnqHCQ1xhTtrGAcKHssnEXYHztg41ZwnJYeU6x/1782820913952.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZWQ6XxHez3iDyqRih1p7agnMuk2sbw3yte9yVrfqrXGn/1782820921161.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmURpYxucV6BuejY8ct6cj1iChQQ241CA5LhtJzUf7Nk2A/1782820928141.jpg)

*Es Cemil*

Next, I also ordered ice cream. They have several ice cream variants, and I ordered the Es Cemil. The Es Cemil here is ice cream with pieces of bread, topped with chocolate syrup, sprinkles, and choco chips. It's very delicious. The ice cream comes in three flavors: chocolate, strawberry, and vanilla. Sweet and refreshing, perfect for a day like this.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdQByWNpKPBWnUcxA51SUhxwwdnaWkP7pqD5GG6fa58Fj/1782821101918.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYRRhrGQyeGSSPJUp3UujnzwWXPCYUv1bJhHYEKTKsU6P/1782821101963.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTXG2JhLon4wW1kZQKZuwSboL3Dp4tVDFLzxd7iDNGUaB/1782821101999.jpg)

Okay, that's my activity this time. Thank you for reading my story, see you in my next story~

body.title: Твоє життя — твоя дорога: чому не існує єдиного \
body.body: Коли мені здається, що я недостатня, запізнилась або “не дотягую” до чужих стандартів, я згадую одну просту річ: у світі є люди, які в 50 років досі не вміють кататись на велосипеді. І це абсолютно нічого не говорить про їхню цінність як людини.

/>

Хтось навчився плавати у п’ять, а хтось — у сорок.  
Хтось став мамою у двадцять, а хтось так і не захотів дітей. Хтось знайшов себе після університету, а хтось — після розлучення, еміграції чи депресії.

Ми надто часто міряємо себе чужими лінійками, забуваючи, що стартові точки у всіх різні.

Комусь у дитинстві дали підтримку й відчуття безпеки. А комусь — тривожність, страх помилки й постійне “будь зручнішою”.

Тому доросле життя — це не марафон із єдиним маршрутом. Це швидше величезне місто, де кожен іде своєю дорогою, своїм темпом і зі своїми зупинками.

Іноді те, що для одних “елементарно”, для інших — маленька особиста перемога.

Тож якщо вам здається, що ви щось не встигли — можливо, ви просто жили занадто багато всього, про що інші навіть не здогадуються.

Не існує єдиного “вчасно”.  
Є лише ваше життя.  
І ваш шлях💙💛

#особисте

body.title: Motor Car My Favorite
body.body:
Hello, friends!

>What Is Your Favourite Mode of Transport?


Over the years, I have used different modes of transportation in my life and I can tell which one is the best for easy movement to places. I am a young man who has traveled to many places for business, especially this one, or maybe if I want to travel home to see my parents. 

My favorite mode of transportation is a motor car. With this one I can move around my immediate town to see friends, to work, and pick up my business materials for my business. 



![1000844638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23vsHsQxLFinCA6XTx573MUmV4AUSZmfpPVpac6tL9uSPh7CZw6qf1ahURv5XMwPZGWVo.jpg)

Traveling to a far distance I prefer using a bus because I can see the road and the beautiful nature. I could recall when I traveled on the road, I saw things, and I learned from them, and I was amazed by who this God is for putting the earth this way by His wisdom and power. Traveling by car gives me chances to learn, mapping the world, and the driver who has the heart to take this risk so far, just to transport people to their designated places, and by satisfying them, they get to earn from it too. Aside from the money part, it takes heart to do this kind of job.

While traveling, I saw rocks that I had never seen before. I like traveling by motor so I can have the visibility of the environment. Every mode of transportation is very risky, but then we have faith in God that everything will be sorted out, or you will reach your destination successfully. 

While traveling, you might experience a delay on the road because of traffic congestion, but this builds patience in you as a person and gives you a lot of meaning as well. Before you could reach your ordained place, patience was required, and you have learned it.

The way God created us, and put things in place that may cause delay, so we can learn from them and grow with them. There are some characters you need to build to be able to handle those blessings beautifully. I am saying this because of my experience while traveling. Hurdles will come and many that will open your eyes to see and learn.

Thank you for reading and I am happy to participate.

body.title: Homemade Venezuelan Churros / Churros Venezolanos Caseros
body.body: > **English** ### **Homemade Venezuelan Churros** For several days I'd had a craving for something sweet; it happens to me from time to time, right after lunch. Because of this, I wanted to eat churros; that's what I was craving. And it took me back to my childhood when my father would buy them for us every time he passed by a corner in El Silencio; I don't remember the name, but I remember the man who had a metal frame with an awning like a hot dog cart, but on the flat surface he had a huge cauldron of very hot oil, and with a small machine he would turn a handle and the long, strip-shaped dough with grooves would come out through a nozzle and fall into the oil in the cauldron. >***Español*** > >### **Churros Venezolanos Caseros** >Hace varios días tenía un antojo de comer algo dulce; me da de vez en cuando, justamente al terminar de almorzar. En vista de ello, quise comer churro; era lo que se me antojaba. Y me remonté a mi niñez cuando mi padre nos compraba cada vez que pasaba por una esquina del Silencio; no recuerdo el nombre, pero recuerdo al señor que tenía una estructura de metal con un toldo como un carrito de perro caliente, pero en la superficie plana tenía un caldero inmenso con aceite bien caliente, y por medio de una máquina pequeña le daba con una manija e iba saliendo por una boquilla la masa larga en forma de tira y con surcos que caía en el aceite del caldero. ![IMG_20260624_174015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23zks2Ujih23LyS8rhuTCkSKA4zVNfuhQjrW422BcD9BoJH4FKMzXPs4TZVkZTRzXQ5Vq.jpg) ![IMG_20260624_174553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23yJJcXjpKH9CeEjBAnScQCxkmBusqkqnwKjM86wRWNVXM9KVAeuT52MQNsP47cbUcrQY.jpg) With tongs and great agility, he would begin twisting the dough many times, creating a spiral inside the cauldron. The hot oil would immediately brown the spiral, and then he would turn it over to brown the other side. Once it was ready, he would place the entire spiral on a very clean tray and, with scissors, precisely cut it into 15 cm sticks. He would then sell them in a small bag appropriate for the number of churros and sprinkle them with sugar. Later, when I was older, I discovered a man in Plaza Candelaria who used the same method, but he shaped them into rings, and I liked those better. >Él, con una pinza y gran agilidad, comenzaba a darle muchas vueltas a la masa y quedaba como un espiral dentro del caldero. Lo caliente del aceite de inmediato doraba el espiral y luego le daba la vuelta para dorar por el otro lado. Una vez que estaba listo, colocaba todo el espiral en una bandeja muy limpia y, con una tijera, comenzaba a picar con precisión todo el espiral y los churros quedaban en forma de palitos de 15 cm. Los despachaba en una bolsita adecuada a la cantidad de churros y luego les espolvoreaba azúcar. Después, más grande, descubrí a un señor en la Plaza Candelaria que utilizaba el mismo método, pero él les daba la forma de aro y me gustaron más estos. ![IMG_20260624_174339.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xpB5zVkQZqdeZRvjeTYjxy788WVMkXg37EGtc8dQt26RGwzKnr6UAEhKmeSWP4TBNBU.jpg) As a girl, I would have given anything to eat those churros. Now, with that memory in mind, I'm making them for the first time, following the instructions in my recipe book; even though I didn't have the tools, I tried to cut and shape them both ways. >Yo, muchacha, daba la vida por comer esos churros. Ahora, con esa remembranza, por primera vez los estoy haciendo, con las indicaciones de mi cuaderno de recetas; aunque no tenía las herramientas, traté de cortar y hacer las dos formas. ![IMG_20260624_175038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23ydATMwDzEiMmKUCG5judWM3bKouw5HWqeVtZjsSDLSZmrEaFy6ig3T8yYjS3Gc66g9s.jpg) --- #### **Ingredients:** - 1 cup of water - 1 cup of all-purpose flour - 1 teaspoon of salt - Sugar, as needed - Oil, as needed --- > ### **Ingredientes:** >- 1 vaso de agua >- 1 caso de harina de todo uso >- 1 cucharadita de sal >- Azúcar, la necesaria >- Aceite lo necesario. ![IMG_20260624_155243.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EoyQxCyCeQj3JEbxcbDAXWwwSnFCMWv8J25J36XwWpLExD3o7yshx2X3msEwtgWUEe6.jpg) --- We will use some materials >Utilizaremos algunos materiales ![IMG_20260624_160218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23wWyPz7f22F8jD8b3Brk7e7F8SJxydWVXvh5KsapfhEFhkYvjaiVTz1LmvgSxya4aprx.jpg) #### **Preparation:** Bring the water to a boil and add the salt; once boiling, turn off the heat and begin adding all the flour, stirring until a smooth and manageable dough is formed. > #### **Preparación:** > Montamos a hervir el agua y le agregamos la sal; una vez en ebullición, la apagamos y comenzamos a agregar toda la harina revolviendo, hasta que se haga una masa suave y manejable. ![IMG_20260624_160817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Eoptt8iRjAUsd6eJ3xcAbNcmwsf3UPmFJexfvnQ5Tbty4aPJ5fVqS2zNXhNvPZ5v55u.jpg) ![IMG_20260624_160844.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpLfZ7vgcadLyjkNMy2GjGatKw5AW2cnzpVikYgFUkZCPRpCmsA2SCsQxEBNU4gxCC6.jpg) ![IMG_20260624_160855-COLLAGE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/AK9QZvB6BFYz7WtRqAGVEnL7RZzrVg1QKDV88pFbQz55NvNw9khPnFmAQpceNf9.jpg) ![IMG_20260624_161433.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EoeEzk6N7obU4iPB5TZ5Fr53DRZqKR2xwoc1cyaBVA5XpSHmEgQptDzHz3pVkqXTFGg.jpg) We put the pot on the stove and added the oil; we waited for it to heat up thoroughly. Meanwhile, we put some of the dough into the piping bag and piped the churros. Since the nozzle was too small, I decided to pipe them directly into the pot without the nozzle. I wanted to imitate the rings and sticks; that was the idea. > Montamos el caldero y le añadimos el aceite; esperamos que caliente bien. Mientras tanto, volcamos una parte de la masa en la manga y hacemos los churros. Como la boquilla era muy pequeña, decidí hacerlos sin boquilla y directo en el caldero. Quise imitar los aros y los palitos; era la idea. ![IMG_20260624_161729.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23uQtadvXhHtK8XYnKTURekT3TwyZNNy6PEYACQfMWioRxUZd7KSgbbbHq4v4QdYZ4PDE.jpg) body.title: From Famous Brands to Herbal Wonders: My Journey with Malunggay Facial Toner for Healthier, Budget-Friendly Skincare
body.body: /> **Hello Hive Fam, most especially my ever-supportive Hive Friends all over the world! 💚** I recently made a big switch in my skincare routine, from a famous commercial brand to something closer to nature: **Malunggay Herbal Facial Toner.**

/> Why the change? Honestly, I wanted to save a little, but more importantly, I felt it was time to try something healthier. **_Malunggay (moringa)_** is known for its antioxidant and antibacterial properties, and I was curious to see how it would work on my skin.

/> I bought this toner online, and so far, I’m loving the refreshing feel. It’s gentle, doesn’t sting, and I feel good knowing I’m using something herbal instead of chemical heavy. Plus, it’s proudly Filipino which makes me even happier to support local products.

/>

Switching brands wasn’t just about saving money; it was about choosing wellness and sustainability. Sometimes, the best skincare solutions are right in our backyard. 🌱

**Thank you so much for reading, Hive Fam!** Your support inspires me to keep sharing my little discoveries and choices. Here’s to healthier skin and smarter savings. 💕

body.title: Rolling Along
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmStz8YmEB5Tee2sQKzq83Q1SqViaYxviQoAshWqRo5kT4/PXL_20250417_211623519.webp)

---------------------------------------

The AUSL continues to roll along with  plenty of games happening to keep us occupied.  Actually, it's kind of weird having only six teams to keep track of instead of however many college teams there are or something like the  MLB where you have a 30 or more teams battling it out at any given time.  I'm actually really bummed that I am not going to be able to see my niece play ball at all this summer, but the schedules didn't work out for it to happen.  Perhaps things will be different in the fall.

There  have been some pretty amazing series happening over the past few days and we got the chance to see the end of one of them on Friday night as we were settling down from a busy day of camping.  I'll get to that in a second though.

First, we have the Thursday action where Utah took down Carolina 3 to 2.  Then on Friday, Utah shut out Carolina 3 to 0.  The real excitement was in the late game though when Portland faced off against Texas.  Texas was leading the game 1 to 0 until late in the game when the Portland offense came alive and quickly put five runs on the board for them.  At that point it was just a matter of the Portland pitching holding off the Volt offense.  Which they did and the final score was Portland 5, Texas 1.

On Saturday all teams were active with Utah finally taking a loss against Carolina 6 to 1, Chicago hammered Oklahoma City in to  oblivion 14 to 0, and Portland had another strong game against Texas 6 to 3.

On Sunday there were only two games with Portland once again taking down Texas 5 to 2, and Chicago handed Oklahoma City a 8 to 6 loss.  Finally, on Monday, Carolina hit a late game grand slam to move past Oklahoma City 5 to 4.  

There are two games on tonight as Portland moves on to Chicago and Texas takes on Utah.  

Current standings have Utah on top with a record of 10-4, Portland slides in to second place with a 8-4 record, and then Carolina in third at 7-5.  Wrapping up the bottom is Chicago with a 6-7 (did you say it that way in your head?) record, Oklahoma City in fifth place at 5-9, and Texas bringing up the rear at 3-10.  

That isn't really accurate though because in the  AUSL, they celebrate the individual athletes and stats are based less on the team and more on the players.

Я обожнюю ірландських пенсіонерів.

Вони приходять у наш замок — красиві, доглянуті, в панамках та з помадою. Бачать на мені українську символіку:

— О, Україна? А звідки ти?

Я кажу, що з окупованої території. Що втратила дім. Що починала життя заново. Що вельми вдячна Ірландії і ірландцям за все. Головне - за можливість жити далі

І вони дивляться на мене так, ніби зараз терміново мають вирішити мою долю.

— Тобі треба знайти хорошого ірландського хлопця.

Посміхаюсь, показую обручку.

— Дякую, але я вже заміжня.

— Що?! Ми думали, ти студентка! Ну максимум — практикантка!

— Та ні, я заміжня понад двадцять років. Але дякую.

*   What?
    
*   No way!
    
*   Are you kidding me?
    

І це так щиро☺️ що я стою й думаю:  
це, мабуть, найприємніший бонус роботи серед ірландських пенсіонерів.

Бо коли тобі “сорок з хвостиком”, а люди 80+ дивляться на тебе як на дитину, — самооцінка відновлюється швидше, ніж українська енергосистема після обстрілів.

body.title: ETFs bleed $261M as Bitmine loads up on ETH
body.body:
Good Morning Lions,

There's a real divergence playing out right now — and I'm watching both sides of it.

On one hand, the ETF bleed is real. Spot Bitcoin and Ethereum products have been net-negative for eight straight days, and we're tracking toward over $4 billion in monthly outflows. That's the biggest monthly drain since these products launched in January 2024. When you see that kind of consistent redemption pressure, it usually means one of two things: either the smart money's rotating out ahead of something, or retail got spooked and is taking their chips off the table. My read? Probably both.

But here's the part that actually gets me — and this is where I stay long. Bitmine just put another $43 million to work in Ether last week. They're now sitting on 5.7 million ETH tokens, closing the gap to their 5% supply target. That's not the move of someone who thinks we're headed lower. To me, an institution that just joined the Russell 1000 still buying ETH at these levels means they're accumulating into this dip, and I pay attention to that.

XRP Ledger lending protocol enters validator voting. Australia's travel rule kicks in July 1. And China tightens offshore fundraising as LGFVs face $35B in maturities.

body.title: Electrical Integrity Analysis - Troubleshooting Persists and New Setbacks Part 2 [ENG/SPA]
body.body:
Today, I’m bringing you an update with part 2 of my work on the vehicle, following the number of error codes thrown in the last diagnostic, which you can check out in my [previous post](https://peakd.com/hive-102066/@danielcarrerag/electrical-integrity-analysis-sensor-connector-cleaning-part-1-engspa). In that post, I mentioned that one of the persistent errors had to do with the MAP sensor, but that the two oxygen sensors had been added to the mix. >Hoy traigo actualización con la parte 2 de mi trabajo en el vehículo, tras la cantidad de códigos de error arrojados en el último diagnóstico, el cual puedes chequear en mi [publicación anterior](https://peakd.com/hive-102066/@danielcarrerag/electrical-integrity-analysis-sensor-connector-cleaning-part-1-engspa). En dicha publicación mencionó que uno de los errores persistentes tiene que ver con el sensor MAP, pero que se le sumaron los dos sensores de oxigeno.
![1000433558.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23w2h7ZKLWQ2XAd5jsCKifZhUbhtD7NsP14EaJ1CEskJ456cYDuVHACht7hQ4Xb4wvTsm.png)
The job involved verifying the physical integrity of all the related wiring, and what I found was a lot of dirt and a connector that was nearly loose due to a broken anchor. Also, the corrugated insulation was already quite toasted from the engine heat, just like the electrical tape. >El trabajo fue verificar la integridad física de todo el cableado relacionado, y lo que encontré fue mucha suciedad y un conector casi suelto por perdida de anclaje. También el elemento aislante corrugado ya se encontraba muy tostado por el calor del motor, al igual que la cinta eléctrica aislante o tape.
![1000433209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/EowGX46qvY8WNofZySbvHDQceNJKwa8H8B9z6seRj2XV7kXZKfVmuGJR7VDsivZj68h.jpg)
I had to wash the whole area with degreasing soap, but not before disconnecting the battery and waiting for the energy from all the internal ECU components to dissipate. Then, I used slightly stronger solvents to remove the grease and oil that remained even after the degreaser, which finally gave me a better view of the wiring's integrity. >Tuve que lavar toda la zona con jabón desengrasante, no sin antes desconectar la batería y esperar que la energía de todos los componentes internos de la ECU se disipara. Luego use solventes un poco más fuertes para quitar la grasa y aceite que permanecía aún después del jabón desengrasante, lo cual me dió finalmente una mejor visión de la integridad del cableado.
![1000433208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/Eq5EXU4h46sRdQcyWPno695ykPpMhj6aLgfM92SuB4v4HE7r4CktPMN7N6x744R1v3q.jpg) ![1000433214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/EpVC8MsWDgStdbt75bYKvircBrM2nYnJB42xLRha3vsp5trfpgAXE9avbDbhMA8LNYs.jpg)
Honestly, everything looks really good. If any of the faults originate from the cables, it's due to the dirt, because they aren't broken, they aren't sulfated, and they certainly don't show any signs of a short circuit. This worries me because I still haven't determined the reason for so many faults; all that's left is to replace the MAP sensor and hope the oxygen sensors are okay. >Honestamente todo está muy bien, si alguna de las fallas tiene como orígen los cables, se debe a la suciedad, porque no están rotos, ni sulfatados y mucho menos con señales de haber algún cortocircuito. Esto me preocupa porque aún no determinó la razón de tantas fallas, me resta solo reemplazar el sensor MAP y esperar que los de oxigeno estén bien.
![1000433213.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/EoyQXemgafgWM6WGP58Vj1rJHnZHQXKKCijJB15GwsV1sRLEuokcczbG3XHLwZRKPut.jpg) ![1000433207.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23uFPDDnYTSFFPkBm6XAob9iRFMVBLEh6mn66j35t9WvrJw8UJ4JpRNtvdYEmZr7ceuua.jpg)
After cleaning the cables and connecting everything back to test it, a new problem arose: the car battery died. It only had 6 volts stored, so I asked a neighbor to help me charge it with a charger he has, but the battery wouldn't hold the charge it received. When you check it visually, you can notice it's starting to bulge on the sides. >Tras limpiar los cables y conectar todo de nuevo para probar, surgió un nuevo problema, la batería del carro se descargo. Solo tenía 6 voltios almacenados, así que pedí a un vecino me ayudara a cargarla con un cargado que el posee, pero la batería no sostuvo la carga que recibió. Cuando la chequeas visualmente, se puede notar que está comenzando a hincharse por los costados.
![1000433282.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/EpxqJghUTW6sdPnvCNzTpX5BP22t9BAXU4MNJA5GG2EtsBHafFkxLx7Z8oMZpjmMwtp.jpg) ![1000433283.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/Eou8i52LZdYxVUjiTQnH1Q3mGt1bAyvUTBNLkQzVuj7UVjKTjPN88wMbnWugG4967cu.jpg)
With the help of a friend, we tried it with his vehicle's battery, but the car still won't start. Now the problem has escalated; I have to buy at least the MAP sensor and a new battery to keep trying to start it, praying that the oxygen sensors are fine and that the ECU hasn't been affected. >Con la ayuda de un amigo, probamos con la batería de su vehículo pero el carro aún no enciende. Ahora el problema aumento, tengo que comprar mínimo el sensor MAP y una batería nueva para seguir probando encender, rogando que los sensor de oxigeno estén bien y que la ECU no se haya visto afectada. *** Photos taken by ©danielcarrerag copyright reserved. These images may not be reproduced, distributed or used without the express permission of the author.

body.title: Hime Kishi wa Barbaroi no Yome – Anime Review (2026) [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
>Today I'm here with a recommendation for an anime I just finished. Honestly, I was eager to watch it from the promotional images; it seemed interesting, especially since the protagonist looked much older than he actually was. Anyway, I hope you like this recommendation and decide to watch it. ---
# Hime Kishi wa Barbaroi no Yome (姫騎士は蛮族の嫁)…
---

>Premiered in early April, director Takayuki Tanaka and animation studio Jumondō bring us a story of dark fantasy, fantasy comedy, and romance in a 12-episode format. A second season has not been announced, and I really hope there is. ---
![imagen_2026-06-30_074502809.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23wWTXbuaoGaQidiBhoo1rtbuoMDu6WrAbYGGTuhDyG6exzxgWhamEiANKoTogb8aiQPi.png) [Source](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/xVRpdsYlQR6hsapwFbwxVnFXDBH.jpg) ---

>The story follows the life of Serafina, a strong and proud young knight with a strict code of honor, who, after being defeated in battle by the fearsome Barbaroi tribe (considered savages by the empire), was preparing for the worst of fates as a prisoner of war. However, things take a 180-degree turn when Veor, the imposing leader of the tribe, proposes marriage to her instead of executing her. ---
>“Forced” to live among those she always considered uncouth savages—\

in quotes, because she could actually leave if she preferred—the relentless warrior, as she adapts to the life of those she thought were savages, learns their customs, their food, and their deep respect for nature and strong sense of family. She finds herself wanting to be closer to them. Will she return to her life as a knight for the Holy Roman Empire, or will she continue to explore this culture where she discovers true value, warmth, and humanity? ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-30_074619_image.tmdb.org.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xeYyhJg6w9CnXmyyVh5p3wUA3ayiP4JuYcqm6Pj3rx4wBgQ7499qXtpaFMs8vbtepf6.png) [Source](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/7jYFxmxVABcGZD6PT387My3hhPB.jpg) ---

>Although the story plays with the classic enemies-to-lovers trope, I feel it handles it with a maturity that's not so common, avoiding excessive drama and politics to delve into the anthropology of coexistence; however, you might find the plot's pace slow. Let's talk about the characters. Serafina is very funny to me, especially with her tendency to jump to conclusions and think the worst. Well, that's also because she was raised with the ideology that the Barbaroi were evil and savage, but I do find her expressions very amusing, and she's a character who doesn't fall into ridicule or constant fanservice. Her internal conflict between her military indoctrination and the reality she sees is very well-developed. ---

>As ​​for the protagonist, Veor, he's the perfect contrast. Visually, he's the typical imposing barbarian, but his personality is patient, respectful, and observant. It's refreshing to see a male protagonist who isn't a shy teenager or a toxic \

He respects Serafina's space and timing. Regarding the animation, it's quite modest, fluid in everyday moments, and the body language and facial expressions (crucial for noticing Serafina's discomfort or relief) are well done. However, in the few combat sequences or complex movements, the animation is noticeably simplified or relies on static shots, lacking dynamism. Although, for me, it was good—not the best, but the characters are well illustrated and represented in their clothing and equipment. ---

>Something I must point out is that the message is clear: fear and hatred are born from ignorance, and institutions or individuals create false narratives about other cultures to justify war, and people follow them blindly. This is represented by Serafina, who, when sharing bread (or roast meat) at the table with her supposed enemy, discovers that they share the same desires for peace, family, and survival, and that war did not justify other families losing their loved ones. ---

> - A healthy and mature relationship: It's a welcome change from toxic romances or those filled with absurd misunderstandings. The relationship between Serafina and Veor is built on mutual respect, patience, and communication. - Organic character development: Serafina's evolution doesn't happen overnight. The culture shock and the deconstruction of her prejudices unfold gradually, making her transformation completely believable. - Comforting atmosphere: The artistic design of the villages, the natural surroundings, and the food preparation creates a very pleasant sense of warmth and peace. ---

> - Slow-burn pacing: If you're looking for a fast-paced story with quick plot twists in every episode, this anime might bore you. - Predictable external conflicts: When the plot attempts to introduce political tension or external threats, the resolutions tend to be simple and predictable. - Flat villains or antagonists: The characters representing the empire or Serafina's past are often clichés with very basic motivations, serving only as tools to justify the protagonists' progress. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-30_074717_image.tmdb.org.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23qrJ7ou1zKWDsTFHufKWtqcE7Q6u7xATGSNSeMB76yJeFxZrjHzzXxyJ9UJZR1Pb2h4C.png) [Source](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/zGr5xsk4Q0z6zslKDBaar4isjyq.jpg) ---
>7.5/10 Story │ 7/10 Animation │ 7/10 Sound │ 8.7/10 Character Design │ 7.4/10 General ---
>Hime Kishi wa Barbaroi no Yome is a remarkable anime not for trying to \
but for executing a familiar formula with admirable decency and maturity. Furthermore, it has some genuinely funny and quite relaxing moments that help pass the time. ---

# ESPAÑOL</center>

---

<div class=\

>Hoy vengo con un anime, recién terminado, que la verdad desde las imágenes promocionales tenia ganas de verlo, se me hacía interesante, más cuando la pinta del protagonista se veía como de una persona bastante mayor y resultó todo lo contrario; en fin, espero les guste esta recomendación y se animen de verla. ---
# Hime Kishi wa Barbaroi no Yome (姫騎士は蛮族の嫁)…
---

>Estrenada a inicios de abril, el director Takayuki Tanaka y el estudio de animación Jumondō, nos traen una historia de fantasía oscura, comedia fantástica y de romance, en un formato de solo 12 episodios, no se ha anunciado una segunda temporada y realmente espero que sí. ---
![imagen_2026-06-30_074502809.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23wWTXbuaoGaQidiBhoo1rtbuoMDu6WrAbYGGTuhDyG6exzxgWhamEiANKoTogb8aiQPi.png) [Fuente](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/xVRpdsYlQR6hsapwFbwxVnFXDBH.jpg) ---
> # En cuanto a la trama… ---

>La historia sigue la vida de Serafina, una joven caballera fuerte y orgullosa, con un estricto código de honor, quien tras ser derrotada en combate por la temible tribu de los Barbaroi (considerados salvajes por el imperio), se preparaba para el peor de los destinos como prisionera de guerra. Sin embargo, las cosas dan un giro de 180 grados cuando Veor, el imponente líder de la tribu, le propone matrimonio en lugar de ejecutarla. ---

>“Obligada” a vivir entre aquellos a quienes siempre consideró salvajes sin modales, digamos obligadas entre comillas, porque realmente se puede retirar si prefiere, no obstante, la implacable guerrera al adaptarse a la vida de quienes creía salvajes, va conociendo sus costumbres, la comida y su respeto profundo por la naturaleza y el gran sentido de la familia, va queriendo estar más cerca de ellos. ¿Volverá su vida de caballera para el imperio sagrado o seguirá conociendo esta cultura donde descubre conocerá el verdadero valor, la calidez y la humanidad del otro? ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-30_074619_image.tmdb.org.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xeYyhJg6w9CnXmyyVh5p3wUA3ayiP4JuYcqm6Pj3rx4wBgQ7499qXtpaFMs8vbtepf6.png) [Fuente](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/7jYFxmxVABcGZD6PT387My3hhPB.jpg) ---

>Aunque la historia juega con el mismo clásico tropo de enemigos a amantes, siento que, lo maneja con una madurez que no es tan común de ver, evitando el drama excesivo y lo político, para adentrarnos en la antropología de la convivencia; no obstante, pueden encontrar un ritmo lento en la trama. Hablemos de los personajes, Serafina para mi resulta muy graciosa, más con adelantarse a los hechos y pensar mal, bueno, también es como se crio con la ideología de que los Barbaroi eran malos y salvajes, pero si me resulta muy graciosas sus expresiones y que es un personaje que no cae en la ridiculización y fanservice constante, su conflicto interno entre su adoctrinamiento militar y la realidad que ve con sus ojos está muy bien construido. ---

>En cuanto al protagonista Veor, es el contraste perfecto, visualmente es el típico bárbaro imponente, pero su personalidad es paciente, respetuosa y observadora; es refrescante ver a un protagonista masculino que no es un adolescente tímido ni un \

tóxico, él respeta el espacio y los tiempos de Serafina. En referencia a la animación, es bastante modesta, fluida en los momentos cotidianos, el lenguaje corporal y las expresiones faciales (cruciales para notar la incomodidad o el alivio de Serafina). Sin embargo, en las pocas secuencias de combate o movimientos complejos, se nota que la animación se simplifica o recurre a planos fijos, le faltó como más dinamismo; aunque para mí, me resultó bien, no la mejor, pero si están bien ilustrados y representados en sus personajes, en lo que visten y usan. ---

>Algo que debo acotar es que, el mensaje es claro: el miedo y el odio nacen de la ignorancia y como instituciones o personas, crean narrativas falsas sobre otras culturas para justificar la guerra y la gente la sigue ciegamente, representado en Serafina, que, al momento de compartir en la mesa el pan (o la carne asada) con tu supuesto enemigo, descubres que comparten los mismos deseos de paz, familia y supervivencia y que la guerra no justificaba el que otras familias perdieran a los suyos. ---

> - Una relación sana y madura: Es un gran respiro frente a los romances tóxicos o llenos de malentendidos absurdos. La relación entre Serafina y Veor se construye desde el respeto mutuo, la paciencia y la comunicación. - Desarrollo de personaje orgánico: La evolución de Serafina no ocurre de la noche a la mañana. El choque cultural y la deconstrucción de sus prejuicios se cocinan a fuego lento, haciendo que su cambio sea completamente creíble. - Atmósfera reconfortante: El diseño artístico de las aldeas, la naturaleza y la preparación de la comida logran transmitir una sensación de calidez y paz muy agradable. ---

> - Ritmo lento (Slow-burn): Si buscas una historia dinámica, con avance rápido o giros impactantes en cada episodio, este anime te puede llegar a aburrir. - Conflictos externos predecibles: Cuando la trama intenta meter algo de tensión política o amenazas externas, las resoluciones suelen ser simples y predecibles. - Villanos o antagonistas planos: Los personajes que representan al imperio o al pasado de Serafina suelen ser clichés con motivaciones muy básicas, sirviendo solo como herramientas para justificar el avance de los protagonistas. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-30_074717_image.tmdb.org.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23qrJ7ou1zKWDsTFHufKWtqcE7Q6u7xATGSNSeMB76yJeFxZrjHzzXxyJ9UJZR1Pb2h4C.png) [Fuente](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/zGr5xsk4Q0z6zslKDBaar4isjyq.jpg) ---
>7.5/10 Historia │ 7/10 Animación │ 7/10 Sonido │ 8.7/10 Diseño de personajes │ 7.4/10 General ---
>Hime Kishi wa Barbaroi no Yome es un anime notable no por buscar \
, sino por ejecutar una fórmula conocida con una decencia y madurez admirables. Además, de que hay momentos graciosos y bastantes relajantes que ayudan a pasar el momento. ---

title.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
Most people do it with their index finger
***
>\n\nThe index finger hovers over the plastic surface; it's a minimal, almost imperceptible gesture, yet it contains the entire universe. By saying, \

the average person begins their morning ritual. The roar of the blender crushing ice or the soft hum of the laptop awakening the digital world. It's an act of domestic faith, a small spark that ignites our routine.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23tbPQh48Mvw7VkHaRpJfRKeFqMDCbVqhyee1WWXM7nZgPi3jb2YK4rCeCqaFHukrX8N6.png) [](https://gemini.google.com/app)
However, the same movement carries a leaden weight in other settings. In the dim light of a factory, the operator alerts their colleagues before setting the heavy machinery in motion; there, the button is the heartbeat of industry, the beginning of sustenance. But the mind inevitably flies to the pinnacle of power, where a leader entertains the idea of ​​a red button that doesn't turn on lights, but rather extinguishes civilizations. It's the same finger, the same tendon tensing, but with a profound chasm of difference in its consequences. We press buttons to send that love confession burning in our chests, or to definitively erase a past we no longer wish to carry. We press buttons to lift us up in the elevator or to have the coffee maker return our souls to us. We are a species defined by this small mechanical pressure. Between the start of an industrial process and the end of the world, there is only a decision and the resistance of a spring. Each click is a full stop, an invisible border crossed between the silence of thought and the roar of absolute reality. *** ***

Pero la mente vuela inevitablemente hacia la cima del poder, donde un mandatario acaricia la idea de un botón rojo que no enciende luces, sino que apaga civilizaciones. title.title: 🇮🇪 Чому в Ірландії всі несуть непотрібний одяг у charity shops?
title.body: Якщо ви живете в Ірландії, то напевно помічали магазини з назвами NCBI, Barnardos, SVP або Sue Ryder. Це не секонд-хенди в звичному для нас розумінні, а charity shops — благодійні магазини.\n\n

/>

Їхня ідея проста: люди віддають речі, які більше не використовують, а магазини продають їх і спрямовують прибуток на благодійність.

**Чому це стало настільки популярним?**

По-перше, це спосіб підтримати благодійні організації. Кожен магазин належить певному фонду, який допомагає дітям, людям з інвалідністю, малозабезпеченим сім’ям або іншим групам населення.

По-друге, в Ірландії дуже сильна культура повторного використання речей. Замість того щоб викинути одяг, книги чи посуд, люди воліють дати їм друге життя.

По-третє, це просто зручно. Звільняєш шафу, допомагаєш комусь і водночас підтримуєш добру справу.

**Чому магазини мають різні назви?**

Тому що кожен належить окремій благодійній організації. Наприклад, NCBI підтримує людей із порушеннями зору, Barnardos допомагає дітям, а SVP працює з малозабезпеченими сім’ями. Саме тому на вивісках різні назви, хоча принцип роботи однаковий.

**Як це працює?**

Люди приносять речі безкоштовно. Працівники та волонтери сортують їх, перевіряють стан і виставляють на продаж. Те, що не підходить для магазину, відправляють на переробку або продають текстильним компаніям.

Цікаво, що не весь одяг, який приносять, можна продати. Тому благодійні магазини завжди просять приносити лише чисті та придатні для використання речі.

**Скільки вони заробляють?**

Мережі charity shops по всій Ірландії щороку отримують десятки мільйонів євро від продажів. Але ці гроші не є чистим прибутком. Частина йде на оренду приміщень, комунальні послуги, зарплати працівників та логістику. Решта фінансує благодійні програми.

**А як визначають ціну?**

Багато хто думає, що все має коштувати символічні гроші, адже речі отримані безкоштовно. Насправді ціни формуються досить професійно.

Працівники враховують бренд, стан речі, попит і навіть можуть перевіряти вартість схожих товарів на eBay чи Vinted.

Тому поряд із футболкою за €4 можна побачити дизайнерське пальто за €80 або вінтажну сумку за значно більшу суму.

Саме тому один charity shop може здаватися дуже дешевим, а інший — майже як звичайний магазин одягу.

І так, справжні знахідки там трапляються регулярно. Багато людей спеціально ходять по charity shops у пошуках якісного одягу, брендових речей, книжок або предметів для дому за невелику ціну.

_А ви купували щось цікаве в ірландських charity shops?_

title.title: The Hidden Valve: Why HIVE Can't Easily Stop Bleeding
title.body:
## *A Narrative Investigation Into Hive's Supply Mechanics*
By @yordan96
- *Sometimes the thing holding a price down isn't sentiment. It's plumbing.*
---
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNfVyYmmFWC6zuQV5wPgbAjVm9bhTc8GSX1wDNFi5nGL9/1000744345.png 
---

## Prologue:  A Question I Couldn't Let Go

It started as a simple curiosity.
HIVE was trading near its all-time low.
Down 98% from its 2021 peak.
The kind of number that makes you ask uncomfortable questions.
So I did what anyone building a position should do.
I asked.
Not a random stranger.
Not a hype account.
I asked @rafiki, the AI built directly into the inLEO ecosystem—the same place I publish my work, the same place that knows this chain better than most humans ever will.
What I got back wasn't reassurance.
It was a mechanism I hadn't fully understood.

---

## Chapter I: The Question Everyone Skips

Most investors ask one question about inflation.
How many new coins are minted?
That's the easy part.
The harder question—the one that actually matters—is why new coins get minted, and when.
I asked Rafiki to break down Hive's annual token issuance from 2021 to 2026.
Its answer was honest in a way most sources aren't.
It admitted it didn't have a clean year-by-year table.
But it gave me something more valuable than a spreadsheet.
It gave me the mechanism.

---

## Chapter II: The Valve Nobody Talks About

Here's what Rafiki explained, in its own words:
*\

*
Read that again.
A valve.
Not a leak. Not an accident.
A built-in mechanism that opens precisely when conditions are already weak.
When HBD—Hive's stablecoin—drops below its dollar peg during a downturn, holders convert it into HIVE.
That conversion creates new HIVE on the spot.
Which means the worse things get, the more fresh supply gets pushed into a market that's already struggling to absorb it.

---

## Chapter III: Does Powering Up Even Help?

This was the part I needed answered for myself.
I power up HP every month. I've encouraged others to do the same.
So I asked directly: does that actually offset this pressure?
Rafiki didn't soften the answer.
\

Translation:
Power-up is real. It's not wasted effort.
But it's not a counterweight strong enough to beat a valve that can open wider than your accumulation can close it.

---

## Chapter IV: A Name Enters the Conversation

When I pushed further—asking what could realistically ease this pressure—something interesting happened.
Rafiki's response surfaced a name I recognized immediately.
@khaleelkazi.
Khal. The founder behind LeoFinance and inLEO itself.
The AI's reasoning pointed toward the same conclusion a founder would eventually have to face:

*\

*
No magic lever exists.
No team announcement, no protocol patch, can simply switch this valve off.

---

## Chapter V: The Final, Uncomfortable Answer

I asked one more time, hoping for a loophole.
Is there any mechanism to relieve this pressure beyond market forces?
Rafiki's last answer was the most honest of the entire conversation:

*Not much beyond market mechanics — Hive's own HBD conversion rules already do the heavy lifting, so any real relief comes from demand, not a magical pressure-release button.*

There it was.
No shortcut.
No insider fix.
Just demand. Real, organic, hard-to-manufacture demand.

---

## My Perspective

I didn't go into this conversation expecting to feel less certain about my strategy.
But that's exactly what happened—and I think that's a good thing.
Too many people in crypto build conviction on vibes. I'd rather build mine on mechanics, even when the mechanics are inconvenient.
Here's what I now understand that I didn't before:
Power-up isn't a magic shield. It's a discipline.
DCA isn't a timing strategy. It's an acceptance that I can't know the bottom.
And HIVE's price recovery isn't blocked by sentiment alone—it's structurally tied to a valve that only closes when demand for the ecosystem itself genuinely returns.
That's not bearish. That's just honest.

---

## Yordan's Thought

- **I asked an AI a simple question about inflation.**

- **It gave me a lesson about plumbing instead.
Every chain has pipes most holders never look at.**
- **The ones who understand the pipes don't panic when the water runs strange.**
- **They just keep building — knowing the valve closes only when real demand decides it should.**

---


## What Do You Think?

If HBD conversion pressure is structural, not sentimental...

**Does that change how you think about accumulating HIVE during downturns?**

And @khaleelkazi — if you ever see this, I'd genuinely value your take on whether anything on the demand side is being explored to ease this valve.

---

Special thanks to @rafiki for walking through this mechanism patiently, one honest answer at a time.

Hello! Welcome to the Hive ecosystem. Here, with patience and perseverance, you can achieve wonderful things; the key is not to get discouraged and to network extensively.

In the Aliento community, there are several tutorials that I recommend you read to help you find your feet a bit more. But amongst the most basic suggestions I can offer are: finding the communities that suit what you want to share, writing posts with a minimum of 300 words (if possible, with a Spanish translation – all the better, as there’s a large Spanish-speaking community here), include three photos in each post – if they’re your own, all the better; if they’re stock images, make sure they’re royalty-free and include a link to where they were sourced from.

Replying to comments is a good bonus, as is voting on and commenting on posts in the communities where you’ll be sharing your content.

I look forward to seeing more from you in the coming days.
