title.title: Two of my favorites on show.
title.body:
The smallest and the biggest of the sunbird species with their iridescent colors.
![060.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/243zi34biaqFpJY1xpWL7h7iMx7FhAkTi22RQXtC1jmhjGncvfBg59nPQPrD7DzVATbPL.jpg)

At first, I will show you the smallest sunbird and his claim to fame is that he is the best singer of all the sunbird species that we have over here. His song can at times last for about 4 seconds, and I call it his twinkling song, as it is so distinct. 
**He is a Southern Double-collared Sunbird (Cinnyris chalybeus)**.



He dropped down onto a bush with that has small flowers, and he started to inspect it for a nectar drink.
![134.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23uFXzpboENrcyd8wssTH2GuVsC7WVyFN5VPyskcuyanKewTavc5aG4LpBVx6vurJqrpi.JPG)

![128.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tmHaJQomUwjEu9TvKpvHVhHHfLZjRzV8rUPz7DLX1URWRzibBMreZfyZsHPiK2eA3Wq.JPG)

![130.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23u62syzyiaggbk7dzKxrCG7njnmpEmvrP1KgE1s9NhMwgCkZmPupCDpBqbUxU61DdNzv.JPG)

It is still early in the winter season, and the King Protea flowers are not fully developed yet. The Protea flowers are an important food source for the sunbirds, as it is the sunbird mating season, and they will only start nesting when the flowers are in full bloom, so that their babies will have ample food when they come out of the nests. There are many protea flower species, and the sunbirds prefer to eat on the protea pincushion flowers as they are filled with nectar. 

![101.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoprzievceteCcWwTzNXPp17RGFK1e1ymhn23PoPDyMybwUEpAKjZ5N9yf9UxqWtUe1.JPG)

![103.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23w2cuEK9FZcBq81WrH1tGMqAJZH3gByoii3c1PAzGUFbWjYRMVwjQqb3bgBsLvu676uv.JPG)

And here below is the biggest of our sunbird species.

It is a Malachite Sunbird (Nectarinia famosa). Very similar to the smaller sunbirds, this one has the same mating and nesting system, and they also wait until the flowers are in full bloom. It lacks in the singing department as maybe they can only get out one or two notes when they sing, their call is a loud, sharp whistling sound. So, the double-collared sunbird beats it hands down in the singing department. 


![057.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoEjBer1vaXqSabdCp6owEC4whrWuBV2bWyzsqCzDqEG6Fwz8V55KestkJCCeJsBeXc.JPG)

![054.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tkmvVCEnQAgEnhmDV5dXwRSEtkz9eVq8Ko4NeCokP35T8UkECJg9nHEpKFhytc4eLTC.JPG)

![051.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eoc5AE48D6bf1bnGxqjSRkxypJ6F6pmJvax1uxVrwHSqT3q2LaZG3GVNHVcTf6h44Pv.JPG)

Finally, the spot where I come to get the sunbirds is very close to the mountains, and whenever we are here, we get a real feeling that one can only get in the beauty of nature.
![100.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoPKiRtoqGVyYWS4MdRsjVeUQWQn28M8k6ezA5kzfMD2nNcreifc6WTZPbBNXr3k1by.JPG)

The thing about the strange new weather systems is concerning, as we have now been warned that a new cold front is on its way, and flooding is expected again. It is the people living in the shacks that we are always worried about. A notice was issued for them to dig furrows around their dwellings to prevent the flood water from washing the houses away. Most of them are situated in townships that are below the high-level water mark, and over the years many have lost everything that they own, including their houses, to the floods. Flood waters are so strong that they can wash cars away, and much damage to nature can occur.

It is also reckoned that the El Nino weather system is going to create even more havoc across the world, and of course we, here at the southern tip of the African continent, are also standing in the queue to wait for our turn. Not much good news about this El Nino thing as they are saying that it will be worse than the ones before. Almost as if we don't have enough damages already that occurred from the last storm, we now face a stronger weather system. We, as the human race, can't blame the weather for being mad at us, as we have not treated nature very well. Instead, we have successfully managed to destroy many wildlife habitats, and it is so bad that we have red lists of birds, plants, and animals that face extinction. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera. 

Until next time, cheers!

title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmduAAoLpR4R5ro2c124bgyEUwRE8MhjRsbbsYg3du1H1S/1782807594362.jpg)

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. My home garden has been neglected, and I haven't planted anything new for a while. Probably due to my health issues, I've been suffering from back and leg pain for a long time. That’s why I don't feel like taking care of the garden or planting any new vegetables now. My back and leg pain is finally getting better today. After my wife and I took our granddaughter and our autistic son to school, we planned to take care of the fruits and vegetables in our home garden again. My wife and I divide our morning tasks. I am in charge of spraying a 5-liter mixture of calcium boron, liquid fertilizer, and plant disease control on the fruits and vegetables, This time, I used a 5-liter sprayer, spraying 3 rounds until I had treated all the vegetables and fruits trees in my home garden.

title.title: Goodbye June
title.body:
<center>![PXL_20240529_221416094.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23v4P1pQhu2SMvWCierzW1GUNHU8XPkjZN2e6uZwkFg4yqZ38g2dAAS7amXNExhVDHidx.jpg)</center>

-----------------------

You might recall this past Spring, my wife and I were supposed to make a trip down to North Carolina.  Unfortunately, due to some circumstances out of our control, that trip got cancelled.  I was really looking forward to it too, because that is one of the states that I have been to when I was little, but so far @mrsbozz and I haven't had the chance to visit it together.  I'm guessing as long as our niece keeps going to university in Radford and her softball team plays schools from North Carolina, it will eventually happen.  

I remember North Carolina being very very pretty, so I am definitely looking forward to getting back there one day.  

Somehow, I can't believe it is already the last day of June.  We are halfway through 2026 and that is downright scary to me.  I feel like we were just flipping the calendar over, and now here we are.  Given this fact, I will be sharing a few photos from past June's in my post today.  Which works out really well since I don't have any recent or digital photos of North Carolina.


<center>![PXL_20240608_212237063.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xoswa22d7By6ETW2sTj5JfH5g7VdZLQis76Bi8egjZkbgDhnUMvrqEJ43dGjmqgMDvd.jpg)</center>

------------------------------

That's right, in case you haven't figured it out yet, our theme this week is North Carolina.  Which if you are an astute observer of the United States, that would mean next week we are heading to North Dakota before we move into the 'O's'.  There is actually a band called Goodbye June as the title states, and I was hoping they might have a song with North Carolina in the lyrics or title, but it appears they do not.  That would have been so perfect though right?  Instead, I had to dig into the archive and get you three other songs that mention North Carolina.

As seems to be the case, it was a little tougher than I thought.  There are tons of songs that mention just \

, but that could also refer to South Carolina, so I didn't really feel I could use those.

Instead, I had to meticulously pick three songs that specifically say North Carolina.  Are you ready?


<center>![PXL_20250628_161408613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/245w7DG9ZazdNRLjaELQyNXgPDHFPwbR3LKk2A24djbokxFb9WFf9d57ZTiPgsfTaW5dZ.jpg)</center>

------------------------------

<center><iframe width=\

allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

------------------------------

[Direct Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hvKyBcCDOB4&list=RDhvKyBcCDOB4&start_radio=1)

------------------------------

This first song was a tough one and a no brainer all at the same time.  While the lyric is technically \
, there was absolutely no way I could leave \

off this list.  What started as a rough work by Bob Dylan was picked up by the bluegrass band Old Crow Medicine Show and turned into a full song.  Then Darius Rucker did his cover of it and it became a global sensation.  The rest as they say is history.  This is one of those songs that I think has transcended its original status and has turned the corner to iconic.  \

covered by Chris Stapleton is another one that fits into that category.

As I said, there is no way I could leave Wagon Wheel off this list and it is the perfect way to get things started today.  However, because this song is just so huge, that means the other two songs I am going to share with you for #threetunetuesday sponsored by @ablaze are likely going to be a bit more obscure.  There isn't much I can do about that, so you just need to power through it.  You might even find something you like!

<center><iframe width=\

allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

-------------------------------

[Direct Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Oo3brFVJ9A&list=RD-Oo3brFVJ9A&start_radio=1)

------------------------------

There was a live version of the song \

by Fleetwood Mac I was going to use for this next one.  However, Bob Welch's lips didn't match up with the words in the video, and it drove me crazy, so I just couldn't bring myself to share it.  Instead, you get this boring video with awesome sound.  This is a Fleetwood Mac song I am not super familiar with.  In fact, I couldn't tell you 
if I had ever heard it before today, but now that I know it, it is quickly becoming one of my favorites.  The groove is just so laid back and awesome.  The lyrics are interesting (did you catch the North Carolina reference about a minute and a half in?), and it just has a good vibe in general.  The drum intro at the beginning is also pretty awesome.  I am a percussion guy though.


<center><iframe width=\

allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

----------------------------

[Direct Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u9guFvftk9c&list=RDu9guFvftk9c&start_radio=1)

----------------------------

Finally, it would have been wrong if I didn't share another country song since we are talking about one of those states \

is a song by Scotty McCreery that features the amazing Alison Krauss.  If you don't know who Krauss is, do yourself a favor and check her out.  Her work with Robert Plant has become iconic in it's own right.  As for McCreery, I was never much of a fan of his, but I got the chance to see him at the Grand Ole Opry and he actually wasn't that bad.  He does have some good songs too, but I feel like there were better contestants on his season of American Idol.

This song has a kind of sad feel to it that just works really well for the state in general.  It's slow, and it's thoughtful, but there is a beauty to it that just kind of picks you up and floats you along.  I hope you enjoyed it as much as I do.

title.title: Nachhilfe Oberengstringen für individuelle Lernunterstützung
title.body:
Jede Mutter und jeder Vater möchte, dass ihr Kind in der Schule mithalten kann, ohne dass es zu Hause zu einem täglichen Kampf wird. Doch was passiert, wenn sich die Lücken still und leise ansammeln – ein verpasstes Konzept in Mathematik, eine verwirrende Grammatikregel in Deutsch – und plötzlich ist Ihr Kind verloren, bevor Sie es überhaupt bemerken? Dieses beklemmende Gefühl, nicht zu wissen, wie man helfen soll, kennen viele Familien. [Nachhilfe Oberengstringen](https://effektivlernen.ch/) könnte der Wendepunkt sein, der verhindert, dass sich kleine Lücken später zu grösseren Problemen entwickeln.

Kinder geraten nicht von heute auf morgen ins Hintertreffen. Meist beginnt es mit einer unsicheren Grundlage, und alles, was darauf aufgebaut wird, wird nach und nach instabil. Die Art von Unterstützung, die wirklich funktioniert, eilt nicht durch die Themen oder hilft nur bei den Hausaufgaben für den nächsten Tag. Sie geht zurück, findet heraus, was verpasst wurde, und baut das Wissen richtig auf. Für Eltern, die möchten, dass ihr Kind wieder echtes Selbstvertrauen in der Schule gewinnt, kann dieser ruhige und beständige Ansatz alles verändern.

## Wie Nachhilfe Oberengstringen Lernlücken schliesst, die im Unterricht oft übersehen werden

In einem vollen Klassenzimmer kann eine Lehrperson nicht bei jedem Kind anhalten, das etwas nicht ganz verstanden hat. Die Themen gehen weiter, und die Lücke bleibt still und leise bestehen. Mit der Zeit häufen sich diese verpassten Inhalte an. Wenn Eltern den Leistungsabfall bemerken, ist das Fundament oft bereits erschüttert. Individuelle Lernunterstützung in Oberengstringen setzt genau dort an, wo der Unterricht aufhört.

Die Schule vermittelt allen Kindern denselben Stoff im gleichen Tempo. Doch nicht jedes Kind lernt auf diese Weise. Wenn Mathematik oder Deutsch schwierig werden, liegt es selten am Einsatz. Meist fehlen Grundlagen, die nie richtig erkannt oder korrigiert wurden. Individuelle Unterstützung, die zu diesen Grundlagen zurückkehrt, ist das, was für Kinder, die sich bemühen und dennoch Schwierigkeiten haben, wirklich einen Unterschied macht.

Hier sind einige wichtige Punkte, die Eltern oft nicht bewusst sind und bei denen der Unterricht ihr Kind nicht ausreichend unterstützen kann:

*   Der Unterricht richtet sich nach dem Lerntempo Ihres Kindes und nicht nach dem Tempo der Klasse, sodass kein Thema nur halb verstanden bleibt, bevor es weitergeht.

*   Grundlagenlücken in Mathematik und Deutsch werden früh erkannt und gründlich aufgearbeitet, statt nur für die nächste Prüfung notdürftig überdeckt zu werden.

*   Kleine Lerngruppen mit zwei Schülerinnen oder Schülern sorgen dafür, dass Ihr Kind direkte Aufmerksamkeit und echte Antworten erhält, statt nur allgemeine Erklärungen.

*   Hausaufgabenhilfe und Prüfungsvorbereitung sind in jede Lektion integriert, damit Ihr Kind gut vorbereitet und nicht mit Angstgefühlen in die Schule geht.

## Warum lernt Ihr Kind stundenlang und kommt trotzdem mit einer schlechten Note nach Hause?

Lerngewohnheiten: Die meisten Kinder sitzen am Schreibtisch und lesen ihre Notizen immer wieder durch, ohne sich selbst wirklich zu überprüfen. Das fühlt sich wie Lernen an, doch wenig bleibt tatsächlich hängen. Das Gehirn muss gefordert und nicht nur erinnert werden. Dieselbe Seite zweimal zu lesen, bereitet ein Kind selten auf das vor, was in einer Prüfung gefragt wird.

Fehlende Grundlagen: Ein Kind kann eine Stunde an einer Aufgabe arbeiten und sie dennoch falsch lösen, wenn die zugrunde liegenden Grundlagen nie richtig verstanden wurden. Es geht nicht darum, wie viel Zeit investiert wurde. Es geht darum, was bereits verstanden wurde, bevor dieses Thema überhaupt begann. Alte Wissenslücken blockieren immer wieder neues Lernen.

Nachhilfe Oberengstringen bietet Kindern die Aufmerksamkeit, die ein volles Klassenzimmer schlicht nicht geben kann. Wenn die Grundlagen unsicher sind, reicht Lernen zu Hause allein oft nicht aus. Ein Kind braucht jemanden, der genau erkennt, wo die Schwierigkeiten begonnen haben, und diese gezielt aufarbeitet. Wenn Ihr Kind sich bemüht hat, aber dennoch keine Fortschritte sieht, ist jetzt der richtige Zeitpunkt für den nächsten Schritt.

La combinación de estas experiencias hizo que mi caminata fuera no solo un ejercicio físico, sino también un viaje de descubrimiento humano. title.title: EASTER CELEBRATION, WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY ABOUT IT
title.body:
https://youtu.be/nl3MN7WewDY?si=JKcc7l2E6mmOHSJ8
What Christians usually celebrate on Easter Sunday is the death, ressurection and triumphant entry of Jesus Christ into Jerusalem and that's what the bible teaches us in the new testament. His resurrection gives believers hope of eternal life and victory over sin and death. While Christians are encouraged to remember and proclaim these events, the Bible does not command believers to observe an annual festival called Easter.

The new testament made us to be serious in the remembrance of the death and resurrection of Jesus Christ. Christians are free to honor the resurrection of Jesus, but true worship is not centered on a particular day or tradition. What matters most is a sincere relationship with Christ and living according to His teachings every day.

title.title: Amarnath Yatra by Road: Complete Itinerary and Travel Planning Guide
title.body:
![Amarnath Yatra by Road Complete Itinerary and Travel Planning Guide.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/b8886c3b9654a32c41b8319d367777506358b955f0900df1c296cd4c8d23fbf5)



The [Amarnath Yatra by Road](https://gurgaontempotraveller.weebly.com/blog/amarnath-yatra-by-road-complete-itinerary-and-travel-planning-guide) is one of the most preferred pilgrimage journeys for devotees visiting the sacred Amarnath Cave in Jammu and Kashmir. Travelling by road allows pilgrims to enjoy beautiful mountain landscapes and experience the spiritual atmosphere throughout the journey.

A typical itinerary begins with reaching Jammu, the main entry point for the yatra. From Jammu, pilgrims travel to Pahalgam or Baltal, which are the two official base camps. Those choosing the Pahalgam route usually proceed through Chandanwari, Sheshnag, and Panchtarni before reaching the holy cave. The Baltal route is shorter and suitable for pilgrims who wish to complete the yatra in less time.

Proper planning is essential for a safe and comfortable pilgrimage. Devotees should complete their registration in advance and carry valid identity documents. Packing warm clothes, rain gear, comfortable trekking shoes, and basic medicines is highly recommended. Booking transportation and accommodation early can help avoid last-minute difficulties during the peak season.

The Amarnath Yatra by Road is not just a pilgrimage but also a memorable spiritual experience that combines devotion, natural beauty, and adventure in the Himalayan region.

title.title: The ₱20 That Changed Everything
title.body:
I used to believe that success belonged to people with money.

People who had connections. People who were lucky. People who never had to choose between paying bills or eating a decent meal.
Then life humbled me.

There was a season when my pockets were almost empty, but my mind was full of worries. 
Every sunrise felt like another reminder that I was falling behind while everyone else seemed to be moving forward.

One afternoon, I counted everything I had.
₱20.

That was all.
I could have spent it on food. I could have complained. I could have blamed everyone else.

Instead, I sat quietly under the shade of a tree and asked myself one question:

\

That question changed my life.
I realized something powerful.
Your greatest investment isn't the money in your wallet.

It's the decisions you make when you have almost nothing.

Day by day, I stopped waiting for miracles and started creating small ones.
I learned new skills.

 I worked whenever opportunities appeared. I failed more times than I can count. I wanted to quit countless times.
But every small step became another brick in the road I was building.

Looking back, I understand that the ₱20 wasn't the most important thing I had.
Hope was.
Hope costs nothing. Discipline costs effort. Consistency costs patience.
But together, they are worth more than any amount of money.

Today, I still remember that afternoon because it reminds me of one truth:
Rock bottom is not where your story ends.
Sometimes it's where your strongest chapter begins.
If you're struggling today, don't measure your future by your current bank balance.
Measure it by your willingness to keep moving, even when progress is painfully slow.
One day you'll tell your story, and someone else will find the courage to continue because you refused to give up.
And maybe...
That is the greatest wealth any of us can ever leave behind.

What is one difficult moment that made you stronger?

title.title: It is a Matter of Resilience and Empathy [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-15 at 12.23.53 AM (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23ywm6D3uFpgk95vxZDb7JXQotswvSccZiCG5izMbDXNjKZbcbKaQopLL1U7cALjhbnCG.jpeg)

This is my first time posting in this community, and yes, I know—I’m just another person talking about the earthquake that struck my country. I don’t want to dwell on details you likely already know: there were two earthquakes—one with a magnitude of 7.2, followed just 39 seconds later by another measuring 7.5. I won’t talk about the panic my family and I felt at that moment, nor the specific details; I’ve already covered all that in another post. Today, I simply want to share my feelings following the event. I’m experiencing a mix of emotions: on one hand, I am overjoyed and grateful to God that absolutely nothing happened in my city—aside from a few cracks in major buildings like the cathedral, no homes or structures collapsed. We are all safe—my family is safe, thank God. We’re a bit shaken, but we’re okay. However, another part of me is overcome with deep grief knowing that other cities weren't as fortunate—that there are still people trapped in the rubble and families torn apart. A period of national mourning has been declared across the country, and people are truly observing it from the heart; no one wants to listen to music, sing, or dance. It is incredibly hard. >Esta es la primera vez que publico algo en esta comunidad y sí, lo sé, soy alguien más que viene a hablar del terremoto que ocurrió en mi país pero no quiero ahonda en los detalles que posiblemente ustedes ya sepan, fueron dos terremotos, uno con magnitud de 7.2 y 39 segundos después tuvimos otro de magnitud 7.5, no les hablaré del pánico que sentimos mi familia y yo en ese momento ni tampoco los detalles, todo eso ya lo mencioné en otro post, hoy solo quiero compartir con ustedes mis sentimientos luego de ese evento, tengo una mezcla de emociones, por una parte estoy muy feliz y agradecida con Dios porque en mi ciudad no ocurrió absolutamente nada, salvo algunas fisuras que tuvieron algunos edificios importantes de la ciudad, como la catedral, pero ninguna casa o edificio se derrumbó, todos estamos a salvo, mi familia está a salvo, gracias a Dios, un poco nerviosos pero todos estamos bien, sin embargo otra parte de mi está embargada por un luto profundo al saber que otras ciudades no corrieron con la misma suerte, que todavía hay gente atrapada entre los escombros, que hay familias divididas... En todo el país se declaró el luto nacional y la verdad es que la gente lo está respetando de corazón, nadie quiere oír música, nadie quiere cantar o bailar, es muy duro.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-24 at 8.18.19 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23tvo2Z7eN3z4Dk82Y7VAY1SVgygMrTy4DWioFgasaCNZXNAYYvPid7uqBLwL9MJqAtvq.jpeg)

However, amidst all this chaos and pain, I want to invite you to reflect deeply and try to find the good within every bad event: the realization that our lives are not guaranteed and that everything can change in a split second. We must not waste time on grudges, hatred, or complaints of any kind—such things are trivial. Let us no longer be divided by political preferences, race, social class, or creed; we are all human beings sharing the same homeland and the same emotions. Let us hold fast to one another for comfort, without asking whether someone is right-wing or left-wing, white or black, male or female, rich or poor. Ultimately, life is but a moment and a wonderful gift; let us take nothing for granted, never stint on hugs or \

and never put off until tomorrow what we can accomplish today.

>Sin embargo, en medio de todo este caos y dolor quiero invitarlos a una reflexión profunda para tartar de hallar eso bueno que tiene todo suceso malo, y es que ahora sabemos que no tenemos la vida comprada, que todo puede cambiar en un segundo, por eso no debemos perder el tiempo en rencores ni en odios o quejas de ningún tipo, todo eso es banalidad, que ya no nos separen preferencias políticas que no nos distinga la raza, i las clases sociales o el credo, todos somos seres humanos, todos compartimos una misma patria y un mismo sentir, aferrémonos unos a otros para hallar consuelo sin preguntarnos si es de derecha o izquierda, si es blanco o negro, hombre o mujer, rico o pobre, en fin, la vida es un instante y es un regalo maravilloso, no demos nada por sentado, no escatimemos en abrazos o en \

no dejemos para mañana lo que podamos terminar hoy

Let us give thanks to God for life and for the unity that fills us today, and—this is very important—let us stop consuming toxic content on social media. What do I mean? We all know that not everything posted online is true, and we also know that—especially nowadays with AI—we must be wary of anything presented as \

So, I invite you to reflect on this: there are unscrupulous people creating false reports to sow chaos, telling half-truths, or simply filming themselves handing out aid just to gain popularity online (this makes me sick). There is also real content that adds nothing positive to our mental well-being—such as people weeping in despair or, worse yet, those who film lifeless bodies. It is time to put a stop to this; I know the algorithm is saturated with this type of content, but let us choose responsibly what we want to watch. What do I recommend? Videos of successful rescues of people and animals, or messages of encouragement and prayers. In short, the point is not to overwhelm ourselves with pain, because that helps no one.

>Demos gracias a Dios por la vida y pro la unión que hoy nos embarga y... esto es muy importante, dejemos de consumir contenido toxico en las redes sociales ¿A qué me refiero? todos sabemos que no todo lo que se publica en las redes es verdad, y también sabemos que incluso hoy en en día con la I.A debemos desconfiar de todo aquello que se presenta como \

entonces yo los invito a ser más reflexivos respecto a eso, hay personas sin escrúpulos creando falsos positivos con el objetivo de crear el caos, o diciendo medias verdades, o simplemente fotografiándose o grabándose mientras entregan un aporte tan solo por ganar popularidad en las redes (esto me enferma) También hay contenido real pero que no aporta nada positivo a la psique (personas llorando desesperadas o peor aún, hay quienes graban con sus cámaras los cuerpos sin vida) Es hora de parar con esto, sé que el algoritmo está saturado con este tipo de contenido pero elijamos con responsabilidad lo que queremos ver ¿Qué recomiendo?: rescates exitosos de personas y animales, videos con personas mandando mensajes de aliento u oraciones, en fin, el caso es no sobresaturarse de dolor porque esto no ayuda en nada.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-24 at 8.18.18 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23uFVawXKUMFxjYfZYFDpWVK1ER2f2mNnVZeGR8oukcyqy8emYgqgypAEq6y23a3krBgT.jpeg)

Anyway, friends, I just wanted to share with you what is on my heart right now; I hope you are doing well and that God blesses you abundantly.

>En fin amigos, solo quería compartir con ustedes lo que llevo por dentro ahora, espero que estén bien y que Dios los bendiga grandemente.
![Presentación Propuesta de Proyecto Portfolio Scrapbook Marrón y Negro.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqwC8G3pmfAmUg1E61Zg3gUWbUypQbajqdteMGTFid9mWcYbLuHqe1kY7FxJ8zAiMM5.jpg)

title.title: Biography of Gabriel García Márquez [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
![Green Beige Vintage Scrapbook Historical Project Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23viAFXP44EEnEJncxkMLdrcwZWcFLbcLyNcvdJUMtcgrWuNWCEKnWcqEziptNm9C6Nhx.jpg)
Made with Canva Editor >Imagen editada en Canva

I would like to talk to you about this biography of Gabriel García Márquez by Gerald Martin. It is a rather substantial book packed with information about the Latin American author; although Gerald Martin is British, he is a great admirer of Latin American culture in general—and Colombian culture in particular. The biography begins well before Márquez’s birth, covering the wars in Colombia and the boom of the banana companies; this provides historical and social context, helping us understand why many of these events appear in Márquez’s novels. His grandfather, Colonel Márquez, was the primary inspiration for two of his most famous characters—most notably Colonel Aureliano Buendía, a military man with a melancholic gaze and complex emotions. Furthermore, his grandfather's unusual death inspired that of a character in *Love in the Time of Cholera*, and the same holds true for all the people who, in one way or another, played a part in Gabo’s life. >Me gustaría hablarles de esta biografía sobre Gabriel García Márquez de Gerald Martin. Es un libro bastante grueso y con mucha información sobre el autor latinoamericano, y es que Gerald Martin, aunque es británico es un gran admirador de la cultura latinoamericana en general, pero en especial de la colombiana. La biografía empieza no desde el nacimiento de Márquez sino desde mucho antes, las guerras que hubo en Colombia y todo ese boom de las compañías bananeras, lo cual le da un contexto histórico y social, y nos ayuda a entender por qué muchos de estos eventos aparecen en las novelas de Márquez. Su abuelo el coronel Márquez fue su mayor inspiración para dos de los personajes de sus novelas más celebres, en especial uno de ellos, el Coronel Aureliano Buendía, el militar de mirada melancólica y sentimientos complejos, pero también su inusual muerte inspiró la de uno de los personajes de El Amor en Tiempos de Cólera, y los mismos sucede con todas las personas que de una manera o de otra formaron parte de la vida de Gabo.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-29 at 5.34.35 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EptbVqCtWvebksTJefvaRdjU4x68VmfGdnS7CTpWeTxLDavRndDonRmgBvjEE2mTMdC.jpeg)

The book contains a wealth of striking visual material—such as maps of Colombia, the Caribbean, and specific local areas—designed to provide the reader with context regarding the location of each region mentioned. It also features numerous photographs, not only of García Márquez at various stages of his life but also of his family, friends, and surroundings: the school he attended, and even (something I particularly loved) a photograph of the old house where he grew up—a home that would later be immortalized in the pages of one of his most iconic novels, \

.

>El libro contiene mucha información visual que resulta muy llamativa como por ejemplo mapas de Colombia y también mapas del caribe o de zonas más específicas, como una manera de dar más contexto al lector acerca de donde está situada cada región que se menciona, asimismo tiene muchas fotografías, no solo de García Márquez en todas sus etapas, sino de sus familiares, amigos y su entorno: el colegio donde estudió, incluso (y esto me encantó) hay una fotografía de la viaja casa donde creció y que más tarde quedaría inmortalizada entre las páginas de una de sus novelas más emblemáticas, Cien años de Soledad.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-29 at 5.34.35 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/Eo4E17kV5NNfULrvPwsZrB1pytUhwvZrH4egKgHgRQBVhBrD5rukVSgdFWLmap6phFV.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-29 at 5.34.34 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EoeGNZDZCRttudxfHkMrVWCsVqTTcjmd1Xnjrhd7vEGC1C1VTiUKGqTsR9AcbdgSt2f.jpeg)

This biography contains many interesting details regarding the creation of his novels, the sources of his inspiration, and—above all—the foundations of the signature magical realism that defined his entire body of work. It also covers important aspects of his professional and personal life, such as his stint as a screenwriter for Mexican films during the Golden Age and, even more significantly, his journey from living in austerity—at times even pawning household appliances to make ends meet while writing *One Hundred Years of Solitude*—to ultimately becoming a Nobel Prize winner in Literature.

>En esta biografía hay muchos datos interesantes acerca de la creación de sus novelas, de donde sacó la inspiración y sobre todo en que fundamentó su característico realismo mágico, ese que caracterizó todas sus obras. También hay datos importantes acerca de su vida laboral y personal, como se convirtió también en guionista de películas mexicanas durante su época de oro, y más importante aún, como pasó de vivir en austeridad, llegando incluso a empeñar electrodomésticos para poder subsistir mientras escribía Cien Años de Soledad, a finalmente convertirse en el ganador del premio nobel de literatura.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-29 at 5.34.33 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/Eo26aBk7D1pbFZKjhV1xXiXvYaZ2chL4UThhSq5CoNJ9jKZxBjzUZLKbPZFmLsvhyTJ.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-29 at 5.34.34 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EoeGNZDZCRttudxfHkMrVWCsVqTTcjmd1Xnjrhd7vEGC1C1VTiUKGqTsR9AcbdgSt2f.jpeg)

Martin demonstrates great mastery and skill regarding Latin American and Caribbean language and has a deep understanding of the culture; that is why he so aptly captures the essence of García Márquez.

>Martin demuestra una gran destreza y habilidad en el lenguaje latinoamericano y caribeño, comprende muy bien su cultura, y por eso describe de manera tan acertada la esencia de García Márquez.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-29 at 5.34.34 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23xVErWTtMZabrHw1SC9L2ak613vJWDqUwGPHcuafesc8tMVyWiwgvtpG54gmY67tWoaD.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-29 at 5.34.33 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EonkaCpELKpMrjNe5n5Sh5hpGn2cSMf8TLyxbimL4a7Y7bCUD3EUt2gSjm82jSyfaau.jpeg)

Thank you very much for reading my review; as always, I’m sending you virtual kisses and hugs.

>Muchas gracias por leer mi reseña, como siempre les envío besos y abrazos virtuales.
![_Miniatura de Youtube Procrastinación Simple Dorado y Crema.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/245n5WzTfDjt8QuC1CfX1iGPu5crq9bsYhnHjwPHUAnBL93vKUMEPGEND9gUCyLLvHj4k.jpg)

title.title: Ladies of Hive Community Contest #295 (ESP/ENG)
title.body:
![Global Football Tournament Football Menu in White Yellow Style.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23xefJao1XEim7PFvh8B82UrHwjB8Tp6tGfdCtAGvQoRPfVPvtmdqs69Jx3NHigQRSBSS.png)

Hello, hello, internet folks! How are you doing? This week's questions made me laugh because they fit me perfectly—haha, because I have a couple of anecdotes that, while they make me crack up now, were really embarrassing at the time. >¡Hola, Hola, gente de internet! ¿Cómo están? Las preguntas de esta semana me hicieron reír porque se ajustan perfectamente a mi, jaja porque tengo un par de anécdotas que, si bien ahora me hacend esternillar de risa, en su momento fueron muy vergonzosas.

1️⃣ What is the most embarrassing thing that has ever happened to you, something you’ve even laughed about yourself? Tell us about your experience.

>1️⃣¿Qué es lo más vergonzoso que te ha pasado alguna vez, algo de lo que incluso te has reído? Cuéntanos tu experiencia.

My first experience with embarrassment happened when I was five years old; I was in the middle of a school performance, dancing on stage with my classmates, when I suddenly had a wardrobe malfunction and my skirt fell down. Of course, I was wearing shorts underneath, but while the memory makes me laugh now that I’m an adult, at the time I was incredibly embarrassed and wanted to get off the stage immediately.

>Mi primera experiencia con la verguenza me ocurrió a los cinco años, yo estaba en pleno acto escolar, bailando en el escenario con mis compañeras, cuando de pronto tuve un fallo en mi vestario y se me cayó la falda, obviamente yo tenía unos shorts debajo de mi falda pero aunque ahora que soy adulta ese recuerdo me da mucha risa, en esa época me dio muchísima verguenza y quería bajar del escenario enseguida.

Another embarrassing moment I experienced was back when I was a teenager; there was a boy from high school I really liked. Feeling like a modern girl, I wanted to take the initiative, so I gathered my courage—and despite being incredibly nervous and a bit embarrassed—I told him how I felt. However, he turned me down very diplomatically and respectfully, explaining that he had a girlfriend. Looking back on it now, I think he acted very sensibly and kindly; he remained true to his feelings for his girlfriend, something I deeply value and respect. But at the time—facing that rejection—I felt terribly embarrassed.

>El otro momento vergonzoso que tuve fue cuando era adolescente, había un chico de la escuela secundaria que me gustaba mucho, y yo, sintiénome toda una chica moderna quise tomar la inciiativa, así que me arme de valor y, aunque moría de nervios y un poco de verguenza, le dije lo que sentía por él, le declaré mis sentimientos, pero él, muy diplomática y respetuosamente me rechazó aduciendo que tenía novia. Hoy en día, mirando hacia atrás, recordando el hecho pienso que él actuo de manera muy sensata y amable, fue fiel a sus sentimientos por su novia y es algo que yo valoro y respeto muchísimo, pero en su momento, es decir, al sentir el rechazo, me dio muchísima verguenza.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/2432Z2b3U8d1uPuj5FheaZoh3DKK7TroodrLk6RdiyXPn79hBpXMtPXEDHyAsc8xpPXTN.png)
[Fuente](https://eju.tv/2013/05/razones-por-las-que-un-hombre-rechaza-a-una-mujer/)

2️⃣ Are you a fashion enthusiast? Do you follow trends, or do you simply wear what you like and what makes you feel comfortable?

>¿Eres un entusiasta de la moda? ¿Sigues las tendencias o simplemente vistes lo que te gusta y te hace sentir cómoda?

Yes, the truth is that I’m a fashion enthusiast—even without consciously setting out to be one. I enjoy evaluating new trends; for instance, I love South Korean fashion, where short skirts are common but the tops are more modest. However, I don’t stick to just one style; I dress according to the occasion and even my mood—sometimes opting for a more urban, comfortable look, and other times going for something fancier—while always staying true to my own tastes. I do keep an eye on new trends, but with a critical eye; I don’t like following them aimlessly, as fashion has its own rules, and certain styles work best depending on skin tone, height, and body shape.

>Sí, la verdad es que incluso sin proponérmelo soy una entusiasta de la moda, me gusta evaluar nuevas tendencias, amo la moda estilo Crorea del Sur, por ejemplo, donde predminan las faldas cortas pero es más discreto en la parte de arriba, sin embargo no me apegó a un solo estilo, me visto de acuerdo a la ocasión y hasta mi estado de ánimo, algunas veces más urbano y cómodo, en otras más fancy, pero siempre siendo fiel a mis propios gustos. Suelo revisar nuevas tendencias pero con ojo crítico, no me gusta seguirla sin un propósito definido, ya que hay que tomar en cuenta que la moda tiene sus propias reglas y hay estilos definidos según tonos de piel, estatura y morfología.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 10.53.49 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23xKvadCKDJ6tLbBubEkCx2TsfHTQeMg851PQmHeFZcbYH5v8LvmMNf8mU8to4kQBu7m6.jpeg)
![IMG_20260206_171606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23ynWTTWHyP7dKy1BgXSMD6AsHhFe3ad757YVG5UFwVtjc5cr95xCkv21kuZ2A6zJygHP.jpg)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post
![Miniatura de YouTube Ilustrativo Niños Naranja Amarillo Blanco.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wggpJxc7pQATGzLcLTp9GjDNd3VfauwAPHDRxoZ8EmXsU7zoEGH9nhDKFtEYUji1Fvf.jpg)

title.title: Chicken Chowmein - Swirl of Noodles and Tender Juicy Chicken. 🍜
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbUbQoJXzi7NzgYCXt8ucZbWHwe9r97bfK3bkdmafp8TB/1782815767149.png)

Hello Hiver! 
How is every one doing amd let me know what's the temperature in you city? Its 37° C in Islamabad. 🥵
Well let me share a yummy recipe of chicken chowmein. I will be sharing all the ingredients and process step by step. 

---
## Ingredients for boiling noodles
---
1. Noodles / Spaghetti 1 pack
2. Water for boiling
3. Salt 1 tbsp
4. Oil 1 tbsp

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdJdLD361BtyQyXUhMmXgDdhwLeDaicVVgk9EKu2uB3b8/1782816338800.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd5om7dg1cDTQwuyAbqwRoTGzVjG8VLg3VHChRgmFt1QM/1782816338835.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPuf8ZRAJQ3fNFkdq5t4XtK88MfiwULUrbUrq6ACcwWPH/1782816338868.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXnhdKMoYq7nWaUjWPGkDydFbGRaCvr8UMaWuzHcQNuvM/1782816338896.jpg)

---
## Ingredients for chicken Gravy
---
5. Chicken boneless 300 gm
6. Ginger garlic paste 1 tbsp
7. Carrot 1 large
8. Capsicum 2
9. Cabbage 1 small
10. Green onions according to taste
11. Salt 1 tbsp
12. Chicken powder 1/2 tbsp
13.White pepper 1 tbsp
14. Vinegar
15. Garlic powder tbsp
16. Cooking oil
17. Soy sauce 2 tbsp
18. Chilli sauce 
19. Oyster sauce
20. Black pepper 1 tbsp

---
## Making 
---
Put water in a pot and let it boil

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb4tA1nGbVsUF8pfAU9oB4je7o2iSGwRnTufCLr5oZEjp/1782816654265.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcP1hxm4ERoN5B3tJupPdxqR2cEGfDY843ScRA9yf6wdJ/1782816654296.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfBAEaCtEcJcaV8ymASerXCHxNwYLftoZTmsMnYzoigLb/1782816633139.jpg)

Add full pack of spaghettis in the boiling water

Add oil and salt and let it cook untill soft. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS8Vn3BcX7Ap12AYwN8tgonRNa6nCfjVVtuYb5km2Pv3W/1782816645862.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRgw4T3CFWGZummdv6NDWnfiS7shLcANmszoC7utYp7qk/1782816645897.jpg)

Strain the spaghettis when cooked completely. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcbdtXTBE3GhZTGGMVQbFoQjEadVZ2GYCe6syEMJxKTTG/1782816716462.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWYvCWsDkZd5nDg7kAhJQF3gSVSzX5G3whc8L2NPyKyzr/1782816716495.jpg)

Cut the boneless chicken into cubes or strips

Wash the vegetables and Cut them juvenile

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb74WiVZFRMKADZ3WetwCNTiHCYcduoThqKo7BKu3DgVb/1782816771136.jpg)

In a frying pan add oil amd chicken
Add ginger garlic paste

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmejRGGnsK6FcNvvn5qR4uHEAgCYY7sUYtHVouqtJ4SVYJ/1782816784712.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWpaUH5L6FQ8D55cfmFZ24jCeze2xsjStDpZMepBX8EU9/1782816784758.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXc5oaZ6QKxaYtHWkLQtC3Qs7HWHUBGTGQmakMw1PBcdF/1782816784799.jpg)

One the spices one by one salt pepper, white pepper, chicken powder

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmazUPaMwx6reWfQicyteL2sy3tTKruCXeWDJvfwn9f6HJ/1782816809461.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTrN5Y5oMGnJCK2phh2d7K6AtPPGDxbrBtdQJDU7wF5hX/1782816809500.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX5wQNyWWpDpqSPGFL4CKxqPvGKxb4x6qEdPjqSgXJW8c/1782816809537.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNN1qhZYAxMtytzu2qz9BbgAWtXFJtaKpbtkdFdzRpafn/1782816809574.jpg)

Add Sauces soy sauce, chilli sauce and oyster sauce

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPwZRurLg6yUWv5hJuupJ81eCHJKnbhc9pAKDMqAg2Yzm/1782816824821.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSnsrFLj2f9bG9FC4gKbWk7mL8ofhmLAC28yvmHZrHBWV/1782816824856.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVDMNy9DQhibJavorn6JYqgFk9Vq58YL7t5wTB4SpXYQu/1782816824895.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYPAVwPyurXdS22Sz6adW5hz9pYgonXAzhMgukJc5RGHv/1782816824927.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX32ng7LccGWY4ghgxeDAHMUMB8zmSpViFuYxGr6FaPZb/1782816824959.jpg)

Let the chicken cook until oil separates

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWMLzK9F6fggdSz1inYd1jus1xCbDDpmSA9b7VJK7HsFg/1782816842372.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWiYv8oYFTaHrnLcqgH6wReMmxSdCs4RUpcvQLVJQ6RFP/1782816842412.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSp2xd24iQqBHeVEHK9Pwd5ETnxyDi5KAuHbB3hmHU1kk/1782816842451.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamnZ245H3dSHvsnpRHi67dAAUfDBy66DwtyxMq4CDLWU/1782816842484.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNN1qhZYAxMtytzu2qz9BbgAWtXFJtaKpbtkdFdzRpafn/1782816842515.jpg)

Add the vegetables and stirr fry them until crispy. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ3bZP9haC9AggD1nra7ce5scewfAGVcDxBDPvxSYJ6WR/1782816863175.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeS4nZfKE5oxi8aNvqfuxmo1FjeLKbTZZdC1HHsdQWdc4/1782816863218.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdJxQ4P9pL2ubDLZCBYs42qPiYkukZNXfeSKfQP7FazPf/1782816863258.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcTzdA7vAXhbQNKNsVkFyeDjeK2NcT3SvxTMYDbqKH6Vv/1782816863290.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdZYHGT4wcCw259x3LXzMdWH8qefg8e1VaXovnnd8MQQM/1782816863326.jpg)

Now add the chicken and vegetables mixture into the boiled noodles pan and mix evenly. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmadWGEbA6JhWRCaco2gfJXJyKRXj6xwsuBdjDkEESKNk2/1782816877122.jpg)

Garnish with green onions for extra rich taste and yummy Chicken chowmeim is ready to serve

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPYrj1yS5gTyZpePrvRcZ9zBc4GAhuNMNDyEDPYb1wVvb/1782816888337.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRzq4LXK9xbJuYeXoLJ8sv32SAAWQSg4csKNeo2vtJ3Ck/1782816888374.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQKYVUjH5p76XR4kxauafbYcjD8S1KKBoJdUkS4SDbWLW/1782816888415.jpg)

---
## Results
---
I tried making chicken chowmein  and the results turned out really satisfying and it was too good. The noodles were perfectly soaked in a savory sauce, the chicken was tender, and the vegetables added extra  crunch and crisp. It had that comforting street-style chinese flavor but with a homemade touch.
---
## My experience
---
 Concluding all my experience was enjoyable and the dish came out flavorful, and definitely worth repeating.The whole process was quick, simple, and worth the efforts, and it felt really rewarding to recreate a restaurant-style dish at home.

title.title: 러브 스토리의 주제는 다양
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/ge1651502dcc549019d514a589254b7ac2af5d05d3d208d3d801a1512ca33aa9d276d9fbec82731914572354917aad32e_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 사랑 이야기: 다양한 주제

## 1. 첫사랑의 기억
어린 시절, 같은 동네에서 자란 두 소년과 소녀는 서로를 좋아했지만, 서로의 마음을 표현하지 못하고 성장한다. 시간이 지나 그들은 다시 만나게 되고, 첫사랑의 감정을 되살리며 서로의 마음을 확인하는 이야기.

## 2. 시간 여행자의 사랑
한 남자가 우연히 시간 여행을 할 수 있는 능력을 얻게 된다. 그는 과거로 돌아가 사랑하는 여인을 구하려 하지만, 매번 시간의 흐름이 그들의 관계에 영향을 미친다. 결국 그는 사랑과 운명을 선택해야 하는 상황에 놓이게 된다.

## 3. 이질적인 문화의 만남
서로 다른 문화와 배경을 가진 두 사람이 우연히 만나 사랑에 빠진다. 그들은 각자의 전통과 가치관을 이해하고 존중하며, 서로에게 배우고 성장하는 과정을 그린 이야기.

## 4. 재회와 용서
과거의 상처로 인해 서로 헤어진 연인이 몇 년 후 우연히 재회한다. 그들은 서로에게 상처를 주었던 과거를 극복하고, 용서를 통해 다시 사랑을 찾는 과정을 그린 이야기.

## 5. 비밀연애
두 사람은 서로에게 끌리지만, 가족이나 사회의 반대 때문에 비밀스럽게 연애를 시작한다. 그들은 사랑을 지키기 위해 많은 어려움을 겪지만, 결국 진정한 사랑의 의미를 깨닫게 된다.

## 6. 직장 내 연애
직장에서 만난 두 사람은 처음에는 서로에 대한 감정이 없었지만, 함께 일하며 서로의 매력을 발견하게 된다. 하지만 직장 내 연애의 어려움과 갈등을 극복하며 사랑을 키워가는 이야기.

## 7. 사랑의 재발견
결혼 후 일상에 지쳐버린 부부가 서로의 사랑을 재발견하는 과정을 그린 이야기. 작은 이벤트나 여행을 통해 서로의 소중함을 다시 느끼게 되고, 관계를 회복하는 과정을 담고 있다.

## 8. 친구에서 연인으로
오랜 친구인 두 사람이 서로의 마음을 깨닫게 되면서 연인으로 발전하는 과정을 그린 이야기. 그들은 우정과 사랑 사이에서 갈등하며, 결국 서로를 선택하게 된다.

## 9. 꿈과 사랑
꿈을 이루기 위해 노력하는 한 남자와 그의 꿈을 지지하는 여자. 그들은 서로의 꿈을 응원하며 사랑을 키워가지만, 각자의 목표와 사랑 사이에서 갈등을 겪는다. 결국 서로의 꿈을 함께 이루기 위해 노력하는 과정을 그린 이야기.

## 10. 사랑의 끝
사랑이 끝난 후 각자의 삶을 살아가는 두 사람. 그들은 서로를 잊으려 하지만, 과거의 추억이 계속 그들을 괴롭힌다. 결국 그들은 서로의 존재를 받아들이고, 새로운 시작을 향해 나아가는 과정을 그린 이야기.

---

이처럼 사랑 이야기는 다양한 주제를 통해 우리의 감정을 자극하고, 인간 관계의 복잡함을 탐구할 수 있는 매력적인 소재입니다.

# some early morning shots at the Port of New Bedford MA Good Morning and have a great day Today I will share a few shots from recent visits to the port around sunrise. I was actually parked there this morning. I was about to head somewhere else, but trying to get myself organized to head out, I must have been noisier than normal when I could sneak out quietly while my wife sleeps, as she woke up. SO we chatted for a litle bit, and then she settled again and off I went, but since it was a bit later, I headed to and parked at the port, and then crossed over and took a stroll inthe historic district But as I tend to do I have waffled off subject again, so back to todays post. I have been lucky to catch some nice sunrises at the port recently, its a very short drive from home so easy to get to about an hour before sunrise with sunrise around 5:08 AM, as the days get longer I will start going a little further afield :)

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: June 30 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g8361f05306a54134faa80eddd5abac5f5b7fb58a57376bac8846597c07db6d15b9b3a5419c9811e58e661e06e32715d5fbd057cbce0d383b91123b49b5330d4e_640.jpg)
Hoy mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente inspiradora. Comencé mi recorrido temprano, cuando el aire fresco de la mañana aún se sentía revitalizante. Pasé por un parque donde vi a un grupo de personas practicando yoga; sus movimientos eran tan fluidos que me hizo querer unirme a ellos. Hablé brevemente con una mujer que estaba dirigiendo la clase, y me contó que lleva más de cinco años enseñando en el parque. Ella mencionó cómo el yoga ha transformado no solo su vida, sino la de muchos de sus estudiantes. Continuando mi camino, me encontré con un artista callejero pintando un mural colorido en una pared. Era impresionante ver cómo su creatividad daba vida al lugar, y me contó que estaba trabajando en un proyecto para representar la diversidad cultural de la ciudad. Me comentó que había estado viajando por diferentes barrios para inspirarse en las historias de las personas que conocía. Lo más interesante fue que, al final de mi caminata, me detuve en una pequeña cafetería, donde conocí a un grupo de adolescentes que estaban organizando una limpieza comunitaria para el próximo fin de semana. Su entusiasmo y deseo de hacer un cambio positivo me recordaron lo importante que es involucrarse en la comunidad. En general, hoy me sentí conectado no solo con la ciudad, sino también con las personas que la habitan. Cada caminata siempre trae consigo nuevas historias y un sentido de comunidad que me motiva a seguir explorando. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title.title: Time to shut things down.
title.body:
#
Thank you everyone
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tergan/23tGa8kRLRAtxshmNmfcEjJNKTA9VC4JwsmD5DbjUHPs1JDkAEbCBcTrpm5uga8W7Kj8g.png)
### The energy has left the building. That's what it feels like when I look at the crypto market right now and when I look at HIVE. I have been on HIVE as @terganftp since 2019. Six years give or take. I've seen it blow up and then seen it slowly fade away. Learned a lot about how the blockchain works and found a much deeper respect for all those people who keep things going. I've also been dabbling for crypto for even longer since I mined my first Monero coin on my cellphone way back in 2014. Started mining Ethereum a little while later when an AMD RX480 was a cutting edge card. That's not nearly as long as some but well over a decade ago. At that time there was a considerable amount of energy in the Crypto community. However, perhaps I'm just getting old, but it feels like Crypto has had its day and AI has taken its place as the new and shiny toy.
# Turning off the lights I've always seen HIVE as a way for anyone to make and grow a little investment fund and that was much of the reason for the old Earn, Spend, Give community. As that faded I thought perhaps making a digital world layered on top of HIVE to make money on HIVE while playing a game would be much more fun. So the name changed and I worked in the background trying to figure out how to put all the pieces together. Unfortunately things have not gone the way I hoped. A computer crash caused me to lose the keys to the GLD community account. HELIOS shuttered and changed it's mission. HIVE price has tanked so badly that rewards from curation are tiny at best. I read the news on Bitcoin and it seems pretty bleak moving forward. Then I was stress testing the GLS coin and found that the redemption bot works for some accounts and not for others. Spent many hours trying to figure what was wrong only to fail. ....And I asked myself. ***Why am I doing this??*** How many hours will I continue to burn for no visible return. ***It just stopped being fun*** # Personally I'll be writing less on HIVE I'll be decreasing the amount of time I spend writing articles and checking messages on HIVE. With my @terganftp account I've written a lot of #Hive Learner posts and they have eaten many hours of my time. I've also written hundreds of Actifit reports. On my @tergan604 account I've logged many many hours playing Splinterlands. However, I'll be spending much more time on other pursuits. I'm expecting to keep on posting Actifit reports because I like keeping a journal and a private little photo log of how things have gone day by day. I'll keep an eye on the Hive Learners prompts and write an article from time to time on the most interesting prompts. However, writing on every prompt? Writing updates in the community here? Well, this community has felt more like an obligation than a fun hobby. I'll keep tinkering but updates and new posts may become sparse at best.
# Transition to my own personal sandbox In that regard I'm closing things down from a HIVE community point of view and transitioning it to my own personal sandbox. I still enjoy tinkering with HIVE and seeing what it can do. The blockchain is fascinating that way. I'm still going to tinker on making a game world with a real economy, bots running things, and a gaming feel to it. However, it will primarily just be for fun and private research. If it ever fully runs and is profitable for others to play I may turn the lights back on again on the idea of a community project. For right now though? It will be my own little workspace on HIVE where I hope to tinker quietly.
# But the GLD and GLS coin will continue to be supported. I will continue supporting the GLD and GLS coins for anyone who holds them. The GLS coin will have buy orders placed regularly so users can redeem them 1:1 for HIVE at least for the short to medium term. I will keep the GLD buy and sell bot running so that anyone who holds GLD will be able to liquidate them at 100GLD : 1 HBD And for the forseeable future I'll be keeping the tipping bot operational giving out rewards to those people holding the coin and staying active on HIVE. I may be turning off the lights but I have no desire to pull the rug out from anyone.
# Keeping people posted I don't really know if anyone is looking or if anyone cares but I just thought anyone dropping by should know what's going on. In that regard I'll probably keep on posting little \

posts every now and then, probably with proof that I'm still honoring the coins that I created long ago.

**It has been fun**

.... but its time for things to come to and end.

title.title: Celebration over Embarrassment #295
title.body:
Greetings, everyone!

>What is the most embarrassing thing that has ever happened to you, something you’ve even laughed about yourself? Tell us about your experience.

This is my experience, it was in the midst of people gathered for a meeting, and then I was the secretary taking the minutes. I wasn't well armed as a lady 😂 since it was at night I had to remove my armor and keep so I could receive fresh air. So I stood up to present something, and my co-female executives burst into laughter, and everyone in the meeting realized that I wasn't well armed, so they all laughed.  It was embarrassing to me, but then when I remember that time, maybe when I am alone, I would laugh over the past.


![1000840932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23z7DhAkd4pLZu3zS4VmMNvDU1PkMpFTCcGgQ4NketAzgZ23eZdt7tSPyXfUQw8dvkVE7.jpg)


Again, this time was a surprise birthday celebration that I didn't know would be held in the NCCF family house for me. It is a culture to celebrate people in the family house. And mine came as a surprise.

It was on an evening devotion, I put on my normal dress without being fully armed, and I was called out to be celebrated. I was ashamed that day, and still, my female executives who knew about it laughed at me. 

And after the celebration, I went in and laughed again and they came in and laughed too.

This was what happened that day.

_**This is my response to the ladiesofhive contest #295**_

_**I love, I care, and I forgive**_

body.title: Every Harvest Carries a Dream: The Inspiring Lives of Our Aeta Students
body.body:
***Many Aeta families live in remote mountain areas, where life is simple but meaningful. Each day, our Aeta students walk long distances to reach school, carrying not just their bags but also hopes for a better future. Even with the challenges they face, these children inspire us with their resilience, determination, and generosity. One of the most touching moments for us as teachers is when we buy vegetables and other products from our Aeta students.***

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EonkRhAisax19sPDXMhpKoWxgN8Tv12qrh2iCpGTLjefm49xuPiqefbVyFqg5fon8Th.jpg)

Nearly every morning, some students come to school with small baskets, plastic bags, or woven containers full of fresh produce from their farms. They bring bananas, root crops, eggplants, string beans, squash, papaya, cassava, sweet potatoes, and leafy vegetables. Sometimes, they also have wild fruits, mushrooms, or other foods gathered from the forest. These items might seem ordinary to others, but to us teachers, they mean much more.

***The vegetables and other goods our Aeta students sell are more than just products. They show the hard work and sacrifices of their families. Most of these foods are grown by hardworking farmers on small mountain farms. Parents and children often wake up early to care for their crops, making sure they have food to eat and sell. The produce they bring to school is carefully picked, which makes every purchase feel special.***

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23zkpVU2pqkfnNfHPYFdvTrnQrsJPtDMk7HUfEUJWvDRnMaGamWDWpBYMF8qcsTgaLbso.jpg)

**We are happy to buy these products, not just because they are fresh and healthy, but also because we know our small purchases help our students.** The money they earn might go toward snacks at recess, school supplies, notebooks, pencils, or other needs. For some families, this extra income helps cover food and daily expenses.

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23z7Fvod95y79NJf48jyiBbSVDCyqqrKwL86jGfDv7oBzbYTyLUpm3wuG7mjU9HA5RTqC.jpg)

**Watching our students proudly offer their products makes us happy.** Their smiles grow wider each time they sell what they brought. You can see their pride in knowing they have helped their families, even in a small way. These experiences teach them hard work, responsibility, and perseverance from a young age.

**These simple exchanges between teachers and students build a strong bond beyond the classroom.**They remind us that education is not just about what is in books, but also about understanding our students’ real lives. By supporting them, we show compassion and empathy, and we encourage them to keep going with their studies, even when money is tight.

**Moreover, buying from our Aeta students helps preserve their culture of self-reliance and sustainable living.** Many Aeta families still practice traditional farming and gather resources from nature carefully. Their lifestyle shows deep respect for the environment and teaches us about simplicity, gratitude, and the care of natural resources. As teachers, we often learn as much from our students as they do from us. Through these meaningful moments, our Aeta students show us what generosity really means.

**Even when they have little, they are willing to share what they have worked hard for.** Their kindness and humility remind us that happiness is not always about material things. Small exchange carries a story of hope. It is a story of families striving to survive, children working hard to stay in school, and communities supporting one another. These moments may seem ordinary, but they leave lasting impressions on our hearts.

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23vhz1gWsMRA86EqUKbfcSZWCsmByHVSNp3axyYFkc6E6Pj52dekXdo2zsjiTFE3UggtH.jpg)

**The products our Aeta students sell are not just goods. They stand for resilience, love, sacrifice, and hope.** Each vegetable picked reminds us of a family hoping for a better future for their children. As teachers, we feel lucky to help them, even in small ways like buying their produce.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23yd5cNHNTTvnFVyJtxB4NHDngi5RJ2N8XKgfHqfuYZ1jneUCT7RXMdRfC3hr2oxQh9n5.jpg)

***In the end, these heartfelt products nourishIn the end, these special products feed both our bodies and our spirits. They inspire us to be more caring, grateful, and aware of our blessings. Most of all, they make us even more committed as teachers to guide and support our Aeta students as they work toward their dreams and a better future for their families.***

body.title: Are we financially responsible to other people
body.body:
The bible teaches us to have good heart to always extend help to those people who are in need of our help. God wants us to share our resources to those who are seriously in need of help, caring for the poor, supporting widows and orphans, and helping fellow believers during difficult times. Giving should come from a willing and loving heart, not from pressure or pride.

At the same time, the Bible does not teach that one person is financially responsible for meeting everyone's needs. Each individual is expected to work diligently, provide for themselves and their families when able, and manage their resources wisely. Personal responsibility and faithful stewardship are important biblical principles.

body.title: How Customer Reviews Can Help You Avoid the Worst Food Chains
body.body:
These days, online reviews make the process of choosing a place for dinner an easy task. A few taps of your finger, and you already have access to thousands of opinions from people who have already experienced the food, service, and overall dining environment. And though customer reviews are not the ultimate truth, they can be a valuable tool for identifying the [++worst fast food chains++](https://help-center.pissedconsumer.com/worst-fast-food-chains/) and helping you avoid unpleasant dining experiences.


![How Customer Reviews Can Help You Avoid the Worst Food Chains.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUbWW6J3YZncvds1gMVnYFp1Ryg9HGqwApdkcJ43hy8qK/How%20Customer%20Reviews%20Can%20Help%20You%20Avoid%20the%20Worst%20Food%20Chains.jpg)


## How Reviews Help to Reveal the Truth?

While restaurant advertisements highlight a brand's best aspects, customer reviews offer the advantage of revealing what meets guests on the spot. If a food chain repeatedly receives complaints about cold food, long wait times, incorrect orders, or poor customer service, those issues may hint that it’s a rule rather than an exception.

Online reviews can help consumers identify patterns. A single negative review may simply reflect an isolated incident, but dozens or hundreds of similar complaints deserve attention. Looking for recurring themes can provide a more accurate picture of a chain’s overall performance.

According to a PissedConsumer study on famous food chains and their complaint trends, several key criteria customers never miss when evaluating an establishment. And while some minor defects may stay unnoticed, consumers will always judge the restaurant by its food quality, customer service, and prices.

## Focus on Food Quality

Food safety concerns make up a significant portion of [++fast food reviews++](https://www.pissedconsumer.com/search-companies/category/fast-food.html). Customers often share experiences of undercooked meals, concerns about foodborne illness, or poor sanitation practices. While not every complaint can be verified, repeated reports of cleanliness issues should encourage consumers to exercise caution.

One customer [++left a Dominos review++](https://dominos-pizza.pissedconsumer.com/poor-service-and-unprofessionallism-202602077079971.html) about the situation that left an aftertaste, even despite the later refund: _“After I opened the pizza box and took the smallest slice and discovered thick brownish red hair.”_

## Is It Worth It?

Customer reviews are also useful for comparing price vs. value. Fast-food and casual dining chains compete aggressively on affordability, but low prices do not always translate into quality.

Reviews often discuss portion sizes, menu consistency, and whether customers feel they received a satisfactory experience for the money spent. A chain that frequently receives complaints about shrinking portions or rising prices may quickly earn the worst fast food chain title.

A KFC customer [++shared the experience++](https://kfc.pissedconsumer.com/food-quality-202603067114981.html) about the portion:

_“Anyhow, the third time I went to a KFC in my area, the little teeny tiny thigh of a baby chicken is disgusting to look at… Plus, don't be so cheap as to get a chicken company that throws your little teeny baby chicken thighs; it's horrible.”_

## When Customer Experience Turns into Reputation

Customer service plays a major role in shaping a restaurant's reputation, and diners never hold back in their reviews. You can often find mentions about employees’ friendliness, attentiveness, and willingness to resolve problems when issues occurred, as well as complaints about rude staff, slow service, or unhelpful management.

One customer [++shares a story++](https://taco-bell.pissedconsumer.com/got-done-dirty-cashier-ringing-up-wrong-stuff-like-she-cant-hear-didnt-guve-us-all-our-food-chalupa-steak-meal-ask-for-chalupas-to-be-soft-and-was-still-very-hard-and-cold-202505216641313.html) of a nighttime snack gone wrong:

_“Spent a good amount of money to be disrespected and no cared about quality or customer service. Will never go back. Second time? nah. Very rude at night.”_

By reading reviews that discuss customer service experiences, consumers can make more informed dining choices, identify _bad_ _fast_ _food_ _chains_ that consistently fail to meet expectations, and find atmospheric places with courteous employees and prompt issue resolution.

## Do Worst Food Chains Really Deserve Their “Laurels”?

Before putting a label, it is important to consider both positive and negative feedback while reading reviews. The verdict on good and bad fast food restaurants should be based on a broad range of opinions, not on a few extreme comments.

Individual preferences vary. A restaurant that receives criticism for a particular menu item may still perform well in other areas. The goal is not to avoid every chain with a few negative reviews but to identify the worst-rated fast food restaurants that allow underperformance across multiple categories.

Customer reviews serve as a powerful consumer protection tool. By taking a few minutes to research restaurants and consumer issues described in the reviews, diners can make more informed decisions before visiting and avoid chains with recurring problems, increasing their chances of having a positive dining experience.

Whether you are looking for quality food, excellent service, or good value, customer reviews can help you steer clear of the worst fast food chains in America and choose establishments that are more likely to deliver a satisfying meal.

body.title: How Can You Remember Federal and State Privacy Law Enforcement Agencies for the CIPP/US Exam?
body.body:
You're staring at a list of agencies. FTC HHS state AGs CFPB and a dozen sector-specific bodies all blur together by the third review session. If you've ever mixed up who enforces HIPAA versus who handles general consumer privacy complaints you're not alone. This is one of the most common stumbling blocks for anyone prepping for the iapp certified information privacy professional/united states exam.

## Group Agencies By What They Actually Protect

Stop memorizing names alone. Instead sort agencies by the type of data or industry they watch over. The FTC handles broad consumer protection and unfair trade practices. HHS through its Office for Civil Rights enforces HIPAA. The CFPB watches over money privacy under Gramm-Leach-Bliley. Once you see the pattern the names stick because they're tied to a job not a random set of letters.

## Build a Federal vs State Mental Map

Federal agencies enforce federal laws but states often have their own attorneys general with separate power to act especially for laws like CCPA.

Draw a simple two-column list. One side is federal the other is state. When a question describes a scenario ask yourself which column the violation fits before picking an answer.

## Practice With Scenarios Not Flashcards

Flashcards test memory. Scenarios test understanding and that's what the exam actually rewards. Try this: read a short case where a health app leaks patient data then name the agency in charge before checking your answer. Repeat with different fields like banking phone service and education. This is exactly the kind of drilling you'll find in iapp cipp us exam questions built to match real test logic.

## Tie Each Agency to a Real Headline 

Pick one enforcement case per agency and read the real summary. A true story sticks longer than a bullet point ever will. This small habit turns vague names into memorable events you can recall under pressure.  

You started this worn out by a wall of letters and now you have a system instead of a guessing game. The trick was never raw memory work it was sorting agencies by purpose and practicing real scenarios. For your CIPP US certification prep Pass4success offers practice material built around this exact approach so give it a look when you're ready to test what you know.

body.title: Social media and the people
body.body:
/>

Social media in our today's world, is no longer just the platform where we catch fun through various entertainment features or just a place where we catch information, it has progressed a lot into various aspects and it's wisdom for one to make good use of it and as well as cutting off the sides that may put our life into a mess.

For me, I use social media a lot; no day passes that I don't use it. I'm not among those who preach that one should stay off social media once in a while to gain environmental consciousness. No, I have the pattern that helps me to balance the system for me.

Being honest here, people who earn money on social media shouldn't be frowned upon for how they spend their time deeply on social media. Gone are the days when people who spend their day on social media were criticised. One can only be frowned upon if they're doing it entirely for entertainment, or even as real as getting information and not earning a dime.

Hold on,

_if the very wealthy people spend their time on social media for entertainment purposes alone, do they need to be frowned upon? Of course not._

So, in a nutshell, everyone is allowed to do whatever they like with their life, and this is the absolute truth about life. People can only moderate the usage of social media based on their kind of lifestyle, and this helps to keep everything around them intact. Take, for example, a father who has his wife and children around shouldn't substitute the responsibility of sharing moments with the family for being plugged into social media. Even if the father earns a living from there, there's a place of wisdom for the father to create a chance to mingle with the family.

I'm the type that loves sports, especially football, and the ongoing World Cup has been one of the biggest reasons I use social media these days, but even at that, I have the time for it and the time to attend to my work. That's the place of wisdom. I won't say because it's the World Cup season and I must abandon everything just to be online to catch up every moment on social media. No, there's time for it.

Also, a lot of people do not know how to use the \

features on social media. I block pages and people a lot because I know that if I keep seeing the irritating things, I will lose my mind one day. So whenever I come across pages or people who are just into sharing fake news for traffic's sake or sharing content that needs graphic warnings but didn't put that, I block them without thinking twice.

Thanks for reading.

body.title: 'Last Year at Marienbad' Review: Like a gentle fever dream
body.body:
![Last.Year.at.Marienbad.1961.REMASTERED.1080p.BluRay.x264-DEPTH-0001.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23wC9MDH1Tye9aLvzeZuNV3ccR62DKNniijmA2ytjaCbGi8vd46ZaomG1p1xPSV3SdNLs.png)

I haven't really been watching things lately. I just haven't had the time. Though I have been thinking about it here and there, and stumbling across Last Year at Marienbad online made me instantly curious about the film, I saw stills that had me captivated, frames and an aspect ratio that looks visually appealing. And after a quick read on its more dream-like narrative structure, I knew I had to watch it, and so I did yesterday evening. I love films like these, ones that genuinely feel like you've been pulled into a dream-like state, another world in which things are similar but not quite as they seem. To add, Last Year at Marienbad is repetitive, with cinematography that weaves into architectural spaces with an anamorphic aspect ratio that is wide and beautiful. It really is like you've closed your eyes and entered a story that has no real structure to it.

![Last.Year.at.Marienbad.1961.REMASTERED.1080p.BluRay.x264-DEPTH-0002.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23yJGU54DHWvcBnxyYxJZ5DKn3Ti8WexUpppprAbaWdBjq1WE5cSVFF5CSRLD4X9yodCe.png)

That's where this story does come in: a hotel for the elites in the 60s, a man seeing a woman he believes he has seen before. A woman to which he had an affair with, claiming that the two fell in love a year prior and agreed to meet a year later but never did. Though their paths have since crossed again, or so he claims. The woman is at the hotel with her partner, though she claims none of this is true and that they've never met. The whole film basically being a jump between past and present as the man tells the stories of their supposed previous encounter. Attempting to refresh her memory and the emotions that were felt. Utilising a repetitive set of dialogue, and environments within the hotel space to connect these emotions and claims. The film feels still, but in constant motion. Dolly shots with interiors, reflections within the beautiful designed interiors. A gentle way of speaking through the dialogue that feels cold and nostalgic. 

This is an art film to say the least. A film that takes into consideration every composition. Moving the camera when necessary. Taking advantage of symmetry within the beautiful architecture, but also knowing when to stay still. It reflects this feeling of the man's emotions, the attempts to revive the love he claims to have felt and exists, while the woman constantly denies it all, leading back to that initial beginning: the memories. The stories of the past. Everything remains in one place due to that constant disconnect between these two characters. And we, the audience, are never sure whether it's true or not. Whether one is telling the truth or the other is lying. And it feels regretful in its moments, as if a love was lost.

![Last.Year.at.Marienbad.1961.REMASTERED.1080p.BluRay.x264-DEPTH-0003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23tRzT39XavBxPrksSeFfxGAtN5T37fQ4zogGpU3ijKV13pfecnrk9tFeSmLwZpxCbGAW.png)

I haven't seen a film quite like this in a while, and I loved that it was shot back in the 60s and with black and white film stock, I don't think it would've had that same atmosphere on colour. Even with the aspect ratio, it gave me a little bit of a La Dolce Vita feeling to it. Though definitely more Avant-garde.

body.title: 无聊日记-康复运动毕业考试在即
body.body:
不知不觉，拉叔的复健锻炼课程也进入尾声了。中场不少同学已经自动退学。有一些提早退学是因为家里有钱，宁愿到外面去花金子；有两个是被炒鱿鱼的，因为留班太久了，其中一个已经复健了五年还是老样子😛 在我还没来得及文是否因为院方的关系前，那仁兄已经给了我们答案，是那种典型的问题学生。真是不管什么年龄层，只要是团队学习的时候，一定会有这种特别吸引注意力的~~小~~老同学的。叫他联系刷牙，他就说手疼问你能不能用脚。叫他用脚上楼梯，他就问你有升降机为什么不用。另一位伯伯就不知为何被开除了，老师也因为每次都不同人，我都不敢问太多。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme1ZB43v2ioiReCxJkwkiEok1cGWTt6VNcnsiA8qriYRM/1782810832218.jpg)

至于你们拉叔我，以前在学校时的确是有点难度的学生。不过，在复健中心，却是个一等的最佳模范学生。老师会经常用拉叔来做示范。“拿，大家看好拉叔表演金鸡独立。” ， 有时做到我都不肯下去了，还需要找男护士来把我“请”下去🤣 前半段我的复健速度神速进步。你们拉叔我第四天就上山了，虽然龟速爬行，但绝对上得了。后来发现药物降低心率，更是肆无忌惮的，越走越快，甚至连在跑步的贝贝都被我毫无怜悯之心，一律打包，连过弯都不减速直接超车。我感觉，这次毕业考试应该问题不大，弄好了以后就不必回来医院上物理治疗课程了。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYrnKbQCw3nKa2poNtJhJHQuSHaFjZNY5KKwCLVTYY6Gx/1782810832290.jpg)

那天去一家商场，找一家专门导游中国大陆的旅游公司，停车时竟然遇到对面停着一辆德国名厂保时捷944，这辆估计是80年代末，90年代初的尾期掀背超跑。后轮沙板抛阔明显说明了这架不是前身924（也有可能是自改版，不过这个年代谁还会花大钱去切割一辆三十几四十年的跑车呢？）。这车的前身924可是你们拉叔我想当年，老爸第一台买给我的……玩具车。主要原因是，我对当时的911复古系列跑车觉得太过甲虫款了，觉得这种924系列的跑车，子弹型的，才是有型有款。四十年后的今天，这车看起来还是真正的男人气概。真的好喜欢。

---

这里开始看图说故事，带大家看看拉叔平日的日常锻炼和西洋和晨光摄影。很久没有抓老手机出来玩了。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP56FSyv3oYZCrnHb6YDsAUNtPTv1K2chmvk8cxoffmRZ/1782810832359.jpg)

上图是，某天下班时间竟然没有下雨，所以终于有了一次机会上山拍夕阳。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYvxxYzNjXoQUtXQHhXSMKuPLe9HR8sHSfhEkNKqKRJJA/1782810832634.jpg)

隔天早上也是无雨，也没有云朵。蓝天8K高清，非常清爽。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd4iSHnHSZ8n3DTubtVzNhXaCmdLbqu22Hnn7JnBPk3i9/1782810832912.jpg)

周六晚上下了一场雨，但是明显还没下完。隔天早晨再去上山，天空还是有一些白云。估计下午可能又要下雨了。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcvNXGfgsbF4VpiYQuDGEPtc9hBbdYLa6Er1BQytTt1ky/1782810876585.jpg)

那天一边上山一边刷虾皮视频，想赚点金币。家里花洒头坏了，想换一个。结果，刷着刷着，锻炼也完了。啥都没拍到，正当我往后一看，竟然看到了一道曙光，觉得很有意思，于是就拍了下来。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeCf7RYaKzDD5XQnCHP3WnyQLtyFuF5wiAeXobBC1mm2Z/1782810876719.jpg)

工作日下班有点迟。赶回家换衣服出来锻炼时不可能了，所以直接在学校等放学。结果，偏偏这时候太阳高挂。这种天气最适合锻炼了！

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYohoBeA6YEfExLAJba4ff5yghFEfDLCjjn4cjC1Qh27V/1782810876815.jpg)

这是锻炼后在汉堡王打包给娃们的时候拍给母老虎，通知说已经在打包了。免得老人家待会儿又打电话来“吩咐”。
