body.title: Top 5 Isekai Animes of the Spring Season (2026) | Nattosheru Review [ENG/SPA]
body.body: > Hello, anime fans. We’re back with another TOP list dedicated to that fantasy subgenre that has become just as popular—or even more so—than the genre from which it originated. Isekai is a genre that has become quite popular over the last decade, to the point where it’s been exploited with an endless stream of new series released every quarter. Currently, there are so many generic Isekai anime that aren’t worth watching, and they overshadow the true gems that deserve to be seen. That’s why I’m bringing you this special section where I’ll talk about the best of this genre. Unfortunately, this season is no exception when it comes to those generic Isekai anime, but even so, there were a couple of series that returned stronger than ever—and those are the ones I’ll be discussing below. Just a reminder that what you’re about to read is solely my personal opinion. I’d also like to note that each anime in this TOP list will be ranked from 1 to 10, starting with the lowest-rated and ending with the highest-rated. If you’re an Isekai fan and you’re tired of watching the same generic anime over and over, I invite you to stick around until the end of this post.

>
Hola, fanáticos del anime. Volvemos con otro TOP dedicado a ese subgénero de la fantasía que se ha vuelto igual o incluso más popular que el género del cual se origina. El Isekai es un género que se popularizó bastante en esta última década hasta tal punto de ser explotado con un caudal infinito de nuevas obras emitidas trimestralmente. Actualmente hay tantos animes Isekai genéricos que no valen la pena ver y que opacan a las verdaderas obras que merecen ser vistas. Es por esto que les traigo esta sección especial donde les hablo de lo mejor de este género. Lamentablemente esta temporada no se exenta de dichos animes Isekai genéricos, pero aún así hubo un par de obras que regresaron con más fuerza que nunca y sobre ellas son las que les hablaré a continuación. Les recuerdo que lo que leerán será únicamente mi opinión personal. También les aviso que cada anime de este TOP serán clasificados del 1 al 10, empezando por el de menor calificación y terminando con el de mayor calificación. Si eres fan del Isekai y estás cansado de ver los mismos animes genéricos de siempre, te invito a que te quedes hasta el final de esta publicación.

/>

The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)!

>\n\nLet's start with a perfect example of what I call a generic isekai anime. A series that only briefly caught people's attention at the beginning because of its Fanservice. It’s the same old story with the same old clichés, except for the names and the occasional minor detail. Based on the light novel series of the same name written by Atekichi and illustrated by Akira Shigaraki, this anime (whose name I’m not going to mention) was produced by

>Studio Flad. The anime tells the story of a young man named Hibiki Manabe, who was transported to a fantasy world. Now that I think about it, this isn’t really a “TOP” list, since I’ll basically be talking about all the Isekai anime that aired this spring season (yes, I watched five Isekai anime). Honestly, if it were up to me, I would never have mentioned this anime at all because of how generic it is—really. Its plot, characters, typical clichés, and excessive Fanservice make it a perfect example of everything that’s wrong with this genre right now. I’ll just say that I didn’t even feel like continuing to watch it after the first three or four episodes.

>
Empezamos con un ejemplo perfecto de lo que yo llamo un anime Isekai genérico. Una obra que únicamente llegó a llamar brevemente la atención al principio debido al Fanservice que posee. La típica historia de siempre con los típicos clichés de siempre, solo que son nombres y uno que otro detalle pequeño diferente. Basada en la serie de novelas ligeras homónima escrita por Atekichi e ilustrada por Akira Shigaraki, este anime (con un nombre que no voy a escribir) fue producido por Studio Flad. El anime nos cuenta la historia del joven Hibiki Manabe, quien fue transportado a un mundo de fantasía. Ahora que veo bien, esto no es un TOP ya que prácticamente les hablaré de todos los animes Isekai que se emitieron en esta temporada de primavera (si, fueron cinco animes Isekai los que vi). Honestamente si fuera por mí, jamás hubiera hablado de este anime por lo genérico que es, de verdad. Tanto su trama como sus personajes y los típicos clichés y el excesivo Fanservice que tiene lo hacen un ejemplo perfecto de todo lo que está mal en este género actualmente. Solo les diré que ni siquiera me dieron ganas de seguir viéndolo después de sus primeros tres o cuatro capítulos.

> But there’s no need to go into detail just to predict what the story is about, since it’s the same old thing—the same one we’ve discussed in previous genre TOPs. The typical protagonist who appears weak but actually possesses considerable power in this fantasy world. The typical hero’s or adventurer’s journey where he assembles a team. The typical supporting characters—all forgettable and generic. Oh, and the ever-present fanservice, though there are details like the absence of the harem of women that every protagonist usually has. Or who knows—I didn’t watch the whole thing. What I can say is that the animation caught my attention, at least at the beginning—which always stands out since they put more effort into the production at the start to hook the audience. But one thing’s for sure: the anime maintains a decent level of quality in terms of character design, visual effects, static and moving shots, a varied color palette, and so on. The animation isn’t the smoothest or the best on this list, but it actually holds up for most of the series, especially in action scenes. The sound effects and soundtrack aren’t too bad either.
Personally, I’d give it a 7/10 rating within the Isekai genre.

>
Pero tampoco hace falta hacerlo como para predecir de qué trata su historia ya que es la misma de siempre, la misma que hemos hablado en TOPs anteriores del género. Típico protagonista que aparenta ser débil, pero que en realidad tiene una habilidad bastante grande en este mundo de fantasía. Típico camino del héroe o de aventurero que reúne un equipo. Típicos personajes secundarios todos olvidables y genéricos. Ah, y el Fanservice que nunca falta, aunque hay detalles como la ausencia del Harem de mujeres que tiene todo protagonista. O quién sabe, no lo vi completo. Lo que sí puedo decir que me llamó la atención fue su animación, al menos al principio que siempre destaca ya que le meten una mejor producción al principio para así enganchar a la audiencia. Pero lo seguro es que el anime mantiene ese mínimo de calidad en cuanto a diseño de personajes, efectos visuales, planos fijos y en movimiento, paleta variada de colores, etc. La animación no es la más fluida o la mejor de esta lista, pero en realidad se mantiene durante gran parte del anime, sobre todo en escenas de acción. Los efectos de sonido y la banda sonora tampoco están tan mal.
Personalmente, le doy una calificación de 7/10 en lo que respecta al género Isekai.

>\n\nLet’s talk about the return of another generic isekai anime that I got to know back in the day and which, I’ll admit, was personally very entertaining. A less impactful sequel, but just as funny and enjoyable for those looking for something a little different from what’s typical in this genre. Based on the light novel series of the same name written by Kinozuke Naito and illustrated by Yazumo, Farming Life in Another World (Season 2) was produced by studio

>Zero-G. This second season brings back the adventures of the growing Great Tree Village, led by Mayor Hikaru Machito. While this Isekai anime was entertaining at the time due to its premise of making the protagonist—not a hero or an adventurer, but a simple farmer in a fantastical, medieval world—it still has its share of typical genre clichés, such as the protagonist’s ever-present harem of women (a detail that the anime itself highlights more than once in this second season), for example. I like the anime’s humor a bit, since it’s not as suggestive or heavy-handed as it is in other generic Isekai animes.

>
Hablemos del regreso de otro anime Isekai genérico que llegué a conocer en su momento y que admito, personalmente, fue muy entretenido. Una continuación menos impactante, pero igual de graciosa y amena para los que buscan algo un tanto diferente a lo que es común en este género. Basada en la serie de novelas ligeras homónimas escritas por Kinozuke Naito e ilustradas por Yazumo, Farming Life in Another World (Season 2) fue producida por el estudio Zero-G. Esta segunda temporada regresan las aventuras del creciente Pueblo del Gran Árbol donde nos guía el Alcalde Hikaru Machito. Si bien fue entretenido este anime Isekai en su momento debido a su premisa de hacer del protagonista, no un héroe ni un aventurero, sino un simple granjero en un mundo fantástico y medieval. Sin embargo, esto no quita que tenga sus típicos clichés genéricos como lo es el bendito Harem de mujeres que tiene el protagonista (que incluso el mismo anime en esta segunda temporada resalta este detalle más de una ocasión), por ejemplo. El humor que tiene el anime me gusta un poco ya que no es tan sugerente o pesado como lo es en otros animes Isekai genéricos.

/> Here's the trailer for the anime's second season: https://youtu.be/fvpf3c_87kI?si=XLzomE6VokPQpHOJ

Source:

> Other than that, the plot doesn’t offer any more epic or interesting moments beyond watching our protagonist’s village grow, hold celebrations, and go on the occasional adventure. Nor does it have any characters who stand out or undergo notable character development, or anything of the sort. Action is the last thing you’ll see here, since we’re talking about a farmer in a village on the verge of becoming a city, inhabited by various fantastical creatures. Although, of course, most of those creatures are female and designed in a highly sexualized way. It doesn’t have that much Fanservice, though—I do appreciate that. Finally, there’s the animation, which doesn’t improve much compared to the previous season—quite the opposite, in fact. I’m not saying the animation is terrible, since I’ve seen worse, but I will say that certain drawing styles and motion effects are regrettable. You can also see that they rely heavily on static shots and slow motion throughout most of the episodes. The visual and sound effects are acceptable, but nothing to write home about. The soundtrack doesn’t stand out enough for me to say I like it either.
Personally, I give it a rating of 7.5/10 as far as the isekai and comedy genres are concerned.

>
De resto, la trama no da para más momentos épicos o interesantes que solo ver al pueblo de nuestro protagonista crecer, realizar celebraciones y hacer una que otra aventura. Tampoco tiene personajes que destaquen o tengan un desarrollo notable ni nada por el estilo. Acción es lo que menos se ve ya que estamos hablando de un granjero con un pueblo a punto de ser una ciudad con distintos seres fantásticos habitando en él. Aunque, claro, la mayoría de esos seres son femeninos y con un diseño muy sexualizable. No tiene tanto Fanservice, eso sí lo agradezco. Por último está su animación, la cual no mejora mucho en comparación con su temporada anterior, sino más bien todo lo contrario. No digo que tenga una pésima animación ya que he visto peores, pero sí voy a decir que tiene ciertos estilos de dibujo y efectos de movimiento que son lamentables. Se puede ver que también dependen mucho de los planos fijos y con movimiento lento en gran parte de sus capítulos. Los efectos visuales y de sonido son aceptables, pero nada del otro mundo. La banda sonora tampoco es que resalte tanto como para decir que me guste.
Personalmente, le doy una calificación de 7.5/10 en lo que respecta al género isekai y comedia.

/>

The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen: From Villainess to Savior (Season 2)

>\n\nWe continue with the return of another anime that also went somewhat unnoticed at the time, as it was part of a niche subgenre of Isekai—specifically, Reverse Isekai. The continuation of a story filled with drama, conquest, diplomacy, and a touch of romance. Based on the light novel series of the same name written by Tenichi and illustrated by Suzunosuke, The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen (Season 2) was produced by

>OLM studio. The second season begins with our protagonist, Princess Piride Royal Ivy, and her friends—now teenagers—about to celebrate her birthday. This is one of those Isekai anime that’s different from what you usually see in this genre, simply because it’s part of a very specific subgenre where the stories revolve around a female protagonist who is sent to a world inspired by her favorite otome game. Yes, it’s like the female version of generic Isekai, complete with a harem of men, romantic clichés, and melodrama. Still, I’ll admit I enjoyed watching the first season because of the mix of drama and humor—and it even had some action thrown in. The premise hooked me at the time, and I found it entertaining.

>
Seguimos con otro regreso de otro anime que también pasó un tanto desaparecido en su momento ya que formaba parte de una pequeña división del género Isekai, específicamente del Isekai Inverso. La continuación de una historia repleta de drama, conquista, diplomacia y algo de romance. Basada en la serie de novelas ligeras homónimas escritas por Tenichi e ilustradas por Suzunosuke, The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen (Season 2) fue producida por el estudio OLM. La segunda temporada inicia con nuestra protagonista, la princesa Piride Royal Ivy y sus amigos ya adolescentes a punto de celebrar su cumpleaños. He aquí uno de esos anime Isekai distintos a lo que es común ver en este género, simplemente porque forma parte de un subgénero muy específico donde sus historias tratan de una protagonista que es enviada a un mundo inspirado en un juego otome de su preferencia. Si, es como la versión femenina de los Isekai genéricos, con todo y su harem de hombres, clichés románticos y melodramas. Aún así, admito que me he entretenido viendo su primera temporada debido a la mezcla de drama como humor e incluso tenía algo de acción y todo. La premisa me enganchó en su momento y la vi entretenida.

/> Here's the trailer for the anime's second season: https://youtu.be/uZCBOfWLwdw?si=p8KcVFK3RbOiKDwN

Source:

> Of course, let’s just say I can’t see it the same way now, since I’ve watched a considerable number of anime with plots similar to this one since then. Honestly, I didn’t expect much from this second season, and yet it still ended up disappointing me quite a bit. The focus here is on all the drama that unfolds over these twelve episodes regarding the protagonist, the events following her birthday, and her romantic suitors. I won’t deny that I was entertained by all the melodrama, the plot twists, and the way each situation was resolved. But beyond the occasional laugh, the dialog and inspirational speeches, and the melodramatic moments—which are later replaced by praise and indirect declarations of love from the protagonist’s harem of men—this season didn’t offer anything else worth watching, let alone with its disappointing ending. The animation, of course, left a lot to be desired—especially since it was an entire season with very few moments where the animators could really show off their skills, to be honest. The quality and fluidity are kept to a bare minimum, with simple visual and motion effects and little else.
Personally, I give it a rating of 8/10 in terms of the isekai, drama, and romance genres.

>
Claro, actualmente digamos que no puedo verlo igual ya que desde entonces he visto una cantidad considerable de animes con una trama similar a la que tiene este anime. Honestamente no esperaba mucho de esta segunda temporada y aún así me terminó decepcionando bastante. El tema de esto recae en todo el drama que se va desarrollando en estos doce episodios con lo que respecta a la protagonista y los eventos posteriores a su cumpleaños y sus pretendientes amorosos. No voy a negar que me entretuvo todo el melodrama que hubo, los giros de trama y la forma en la que resolvían cada caso. Pero más allá de una que otra risa, diálogos y discursos inspiradores y momentos melodramáticos que son posteriormente sustituídos por alabanzas y declaraciones de amor indirectas del Harem de hombres que tiene la protagonista, esta temporada no ofreció nada más interesante para ver, mucho menos con su lamentable final. La animación, por supuesto, dió mucho qué desear y más al tratarse de toda una temporada con muy pocos momentos donde pudieran lucirse los animadores, la verdad. La calidad y fluidez se mantienen en lo más mínimo, con efectos visuales y de movimiento simples y poco más.
Personalmente, le doy una calificación de 8/10 en lo que respecta al género Isekai, drama y romance.

/>

That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (Season 4)

>\n\nLet’s now talk about one of the most eagerly awaited returns—not just for me, but for many other Isekai fans as well. It’s one of the few anime in this genre that’s worth watching because of how fascinating its story, characters, and world are. It’s also considered one of the best Isekai series out there today. Based on the light novel series of the same name written by
>Fuze and illustrated by Mitz Vah, That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (Season 4) is produced by the studio

>Eight Bit. This fourth season begins with our protagonist, Rimuru, looking out over his massive city of Tempest. Out of dozens of Isekai anime about reincarnation and all that, one of the very, very few that has entertained me from start to finish is the anime I’m bringing you today. TenSura is, without exaggeration, among my TOP 5 Best Isekai Anime of all time. Its story, characters, world-building, and other elements—whether comedic, dramatic, action-packed, or fantasy-filled—make it a series that many people are sure to enjoy. Its massive franchise, built on the success of its previous three seasons, a great movie, and a couple of OVAs, makes it a series rich in stories yet to be told.

>
Hablemos ahora de uno de los regresos más esperados por este servidor y por muchos otros fanáticos del Isekai. Uno de los pocos animes de este género que valen la pena ver por lo fascinante que es tanto su historia como sus personajes y su mundo. Considerado también como uno de los mejores Isekais que existen en la actualidad. Basada en la serie de novelas ligeras homónimas escritas por Fuze e ilustradas por Mitz Vah, That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (Season 4) es producida por el estudio Eight Bit. Esta cuarta temporada empieza con nuestro protagonista, Rimuru, viendo su enorme ciudad de Tempest. De entre decenas de animes Isekai sobre reencarnaciones y toda la cosa, una de las muy, pero muy pocas que me han entretenido de principio a fin es este anime que les traigo hoy. TenSura está, sin exagerar, entre mi TOP 5 Mejores Animes Isekai de toda la historia. Tanto su historia, personajes, construcción de mundo y demás elementos cómicos, dramáticos y repletos de acción y fantasía la hacen una obra que puede llegar a gustarle a más de uno. Su enorme franquicia hecha por su éxito con sus anteriores tres temporadas y una gran película y un par de OVAs lo vuelven una obra rica en historias por contar.

/> Here's the trailer for the anime's fourth season: https://youtu.be/wXKlTwGMUQQ?si=gFdUZ7OiCplhziyB

Source:

> As if all that weren't enough, the anime also showcases, from start to finish, a truly excellent character development of both the protagonist and his entire entourage and kingdom of monsters. By the way, this is another standout aspect I really love about the anime: the way it portrays the monsters of this world as yet another race of intelligent beings with emotions and customs—not just as enemies or threats to humanity. The anime also offers an excellent portrayal of what is now known as the Kingdom of Tempest and its impact and influence on this world. In this fourth season, we’re promised an expansion of this aspect with new challenges to come in the dozens of episodes they have in store for us for the rest of this year. Who knows—maybe we’re looking at the season that will propel TenSura to the top of the TOP Best Isekai Animes. The animation, on the other hand, is an absolute audiovisual marvel. It features great character design, smooth animation, a bright and varied color palette, and very well-integrated visual effects. The action scenes are truly a marvel. The sound effects are sublime and resonant, as is the soundtrack.
Personally, I’m giving it a preliminary rating of 9/10 within the Isekai genre.

>
Por si no fuera suficiente con todo esto, el anime también nos muestra de principio a fin un desarrollo bastante excelente tanto del protagonista como de todo su séquito y reino de monstruos. Por cierto, esto es otro punto a destacar que me gusta mucho del anime y es la forma en la que nos pintan a los monstruos de este mundo como otra raza más de seres inteligentes con emociones y costumbres y no solo como enemigos o amenazas para la humanidad. El anime también nos ofrece una construcción excelente de lo que actualmente se puede decir que es el Reino de Tempest y su impacto e influencia en este mundo. En esta cuarta temporada nos prometen expandir esto último con nuevos desafíos por venir en las próximas decenas de episodios que nos tienen preparado para el resto de este año. Quién sabe, tal vez estemos frente a la temporada que llevará a TenSura a la cima del TOP Mejores Animes Isekai. Su animación, por otra parte, es una completa maravilla audiovisual. Contando con un buen diseño de personajes, fluidez, paleta brillante y variada de colores y efectos visuales muy bien agregados. Las escenas de acción son toda una maravilla, de verdad. Los efectos de sonido son sublimes y resonantes, al igual que lo es su banda sonora.
Personalmente, le doy una prematura calificación de 9/10 en lo que respecta al género Isekai.

/>

Re:Zero - Starting Life in Another World (Season 4)

>\n\nTo end on a high note—with the best of the best, the epitome of the Isekai genre—I couldn’t think of a better way to do it than with the long-awaited return of my favorite anime, the Best Isekai of All Time. It’s the masterfully crafted continuation of a fantastic, dark, and profound story brimming with drama, psychological suspense, mystery, and action. Based on the light novel series of the same name written by
>Tappei Nagatsuki and illustrated by Shinichirou Otsuka, Re:Zero (Season 4) is produced by

>White Fox studio. This fourth season picks up right where the previous season left off, with our protagonist, Subaru Natsuki, preparing for a new and dangerous mission. I’ll admit that this time around, I really got swept up in all the excitement and HYPE that had been building on social media for quite a while about this fourth season and what it had in store. But even so, I thoroughly enjoyed each of the 11 episodes that make up this first part of the season. And that’s no surprise, given that this is Re:Zero, an anime that has proven time and again in its previous seasons just how different it is from all the other isekai animes out there today. The anime knows how to capture our attention with every episode, expanding and building a perfect world that makes us feel a flood of emotions every minute, right up to its incredibly powerful finale.

>
Para finalizar con broche de oro, con lo mejor de lo mejor, con la epítome del género Isekai, no encontré una mejor manera de hacerlo que con el tan esperado regreso de mi anime favorito, el Mejor Isekai de Todos. La continuación mejor hecha de una fantástica, oscura y profunda historia repleta de drama, suspenso psicológico, misterio y acción. Basada en la serie de novelas ligeras homónimas escritas por Tappei Nagatsuki e ilustradas por Shinichirou Otsuka, Re:Zero (Season 4) es producida por el estudio White Fox. Esta cuarta temporada empieza justo después de lo que ocurre al final de la temporada anterior con nuestro protagonista, Subaru Natsuki preparándose para una nueva y peligrosa misión. Admito que esta vez sí me dejé llevar por toda la emoción y el HYPE que hubo en redes sociales durante un buen tiempo por esta cuarta temporada y lo que se venía con ella. Pero aún así, disfruté muchísimo cada uno de sus 11 episodios que forman esta primera parte de la temporada. Y no es de sorprenderse al tratarse de Re:Zero, un anime que ha demostrado múltiples veces en sus temporadas anteriores lo diferente que es a todos los demás animes Isekai que existen en la actualidad. El anime sabe cómo capturar nuestra atención con cada capítulo, expandiendo y construyendo un espacio perfecto para hacernos sentir un gran caudal de emociones cada minuto hasta su fuertísimo final.

/> Here's the trailer for the anime's fourth season: https://youtu.be/jVl4bY81iIs?si=AqQmRALMJr28oVED

Source:

> There are literally episodes that blow your mind, tear you apart inside, and leave your head spinning with questions and a whirlwind of mixed emotions. Every plot twist in this fourth season is even more mind-blowing than the last, with twists that drive you crazy and make it clear that, from that point on, nothing will ever be the same again. The anime knows how to make you grow attached to—or even hate—each of its characters, whether they’re main or supporting. This is because it does such a great job of developing each one, and the relationships that form throughout the series feel as natural as possible. In this fourth season, there aren’t many action scenes, but the ones that are there are more than enough to make you feel a whole range of emotions. There are confrontations that ramp up the excitement, keep you entertained, and even hit you right in the gut as if you were that person yourself. The psychological theme it explores is mind-blowing and quite well executed. But the most fascinating aspect of all is its audiovisual presentation, which really shone this season. Aside from its stunning, detailed, and uncensored visuals, the anime also boasts an excellent level of quality and visual detail. The fluidity, use of light and shadow, and movement really stand out, as do the sound effects and the soundtrack. This is an Isekai anime that I definitely recommend watching—without exception.
Personally, I give it a well-deserved 10/10 rating in terms of the Isekai, psychological suspense, and horror genres.

>
Literalmente hay episodios que te vuelan la cabeza, te destruyen por dentro y te dejan con el cerebro repleto de preguntas y muchos sentimientos encontrados. Cada Plot-Twist que nos tiene esta cuarta temporada es cada vez más alucinante que el anterior, con un giro de trama que te deja loco y te da a entender que, a partir de ahí, ya nada será como antes. El anime sabe cómo hacer que te encariñes o hasta odies a cada uno de sus personajes, ya sean principales o secundarios. Esto se debe a que logra desarrollarlos muy bien a cada uno y las relaciones que se entablan a lo largo de la obra son de lo más natural posible. En esta cuarta temporada no tenemos muchas escenas de acción, pero las que hay son más que suficiente para hacerte sentir de todo. Hay enfrentamientos que te elevan la emoción, te entretienen y hasta te dan en lo más bajo como si tú fueras esa persona. El tema psicológico que se maneja es una cosa de locos, bastante bien hecho. Pero lo más fascinante de todo es su apartado audiovisual, el cual se lució bastante en esta temporada. Aparte de lo bien gráfico, detallado y sin ninguna censura que es; el anime también posee un nivel de calidad y detalles visuales bastante excelente. La fluidez, uso de luces y sombras y movimientos destacan muy bien, al igual que lo hacen los efectos de sonido y la banda sonora. Este es un anime Isekai que sí te recomiendo ver, sin excepción alguna.
Personalmente, le doy una merecida calificación de 10/10 en lo que respecta al género Isekai, suspenso psicológico y horror.

body.title: Спекотні дні, спекотні вечори
body.body:
![IMG_20260627_205141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23yJAHsMrJYekCr6pRVyQeSq5YqZv5sWk89HGZrcRTCkoByggypjyyhQgB9e93CAS4nfB.jpg)

Привіт, друзі!

Спека із Західної Європи наприкінці минулого тижня дісталася й до нас. Температурні рекорди оновлювалися майже щодня. Спочатку було +32 °C, потім +36 °C. Чесно кажучи, вже й не знаю, скільки було вчора офіційно, але метеорологи знову говорили про рекорд.

Мене завжди цікавило, як саме вони вимірюють температуру. 🧐 Напевно, термометри встановлюють за спеціальними правилами, щоб на них не впливало тепло від стін чи асфальту. Бо наш термометр, який висить у тіні й на який зовсім не потрапляє пряме сонячне проміння, уже два днів поспіль показував +42 °C. При цьому офіційно повідомляли про +36 °C, і це вже вважалося найвищою температурою за багато десятиліть.

У такі дні перебувати надворі було дуже важко. 🥵

Так склалося, що саме цими днями ми всією сім'єю поїхали в гості до моєї мами, у Яворів — невелике місто приблизно за 50 кілометрів від Львова. Хоча «невелике» — поняття відносне і не всі яворівчани зі мною погодяться, адже це районний центр, хоч і з не надто великою кількістю жителів.

Причина поїздки була зовсім не святкова.

Ми зібралися на роковини загибелі мого рідного дядька — брата моєї мами. Він служив мінометником із перших днів повномасштабного вторгнення. За весь цей час не раз виходив із найнебезпечніших ситуацій, і ми вже всі вірили, що він обов'язково повернеться додому живим.

На жаль, торік, у День Конституції, його наздогнав FPV-дрон...

Цього року ми зібралися всією родиною на заупокійну службу Божу, а після неї — на поминальний обід. Потім вирішили залишитися в мами ще на кілька днів.

Спеку переносили як могли. На щастя, в Яворові багато ставків, де зручно відпочивати з дітьми, бо там мілко. Майже щовечора ми ходили купатися, а одного дня навіть були на ставі двічі — і вранці, і ввечері.

Вода теж була дуже теплою, але все одно це набагато краще, ніж сидіти під палючим сонцем. На сонце ми взагалі намагалися без потреби не виходити. Якщо вже й перебували надворі, то або біля води, або ховалися в затінку.

У будинку теж було спекотно. Температура не опускалася нижче +28 °C. Але це все ж значно легше, ніж +42 °C надворі.

Чесно кажучи, навіть не хочу уявляти, скільки було на відкритому сонці. Напевно, всі +50 °C, а може, й більше.

Учора Львовом пронісся справжній буревій. Сильний вітер ламав дерева, позривав покрівлі з будинків, наробив чимало шкоди.

Але до нашого села, яке розташоване буквально за десять кілометрів від центру Львова, дощ так і не дійшов. Упало лише кілька крапель, гроза гриміла десь удалині, а земля як була сухою, так і залишилася.

Тому чоловік, який уже повернувся додому, змушений щодня поливати квіти, город і молоді дерева. Я ж поки що залишилася з дітьми ще на кілька днів у мами.

А фото, які ви бачите, зроблені саме під час наших вечірніх прогулянок біля яворівських ставів. Увечері там було особливо красиво: сонце поволі ховалося за обрій, небо набувало теплих золотавих барв, ставало трохи легше дихати...

Хоча, якщо чесно, навіть після заходу сонця спека нікуди не зникала.

body.body:
There is great support line on Bitcoin price chart. It may be a triple bottom pattern If it support Bitcoin price chart. 60-58K USD level is critical level for Bitcoin price. We should not see breaking down this level.

Here you can see daily chart of Bitcoin price. There were great and mini ascending channels on Bitcoin price chart and they are broken down. After breaking down mini ascending channel, Bitcoin price touched 58K USD level where is great support level for Bitcoin price chart. If it breaks down, we will see daily huge red candles on Bitcoin price chart. We will meet another market crash.

We should see the new bullish or reversing pattern on Bitcoin price chart.

body.title: A raspberry bush in my garden 🪴
body.body:
A raspberry bush in my garden 🪴
The raspberries have already started to ripen. We planted them in the fall. They've taken root well and already have fruit. I'm very happy. I ordered raspberry roots and planted them in the garden. With the arrival of warm weather, shoots, leaves, and now berries have started to appear.
Raspberries are very tasty. When a raspberry is green, it means it's green. When it turns red, it means it's ripe. By the way, raspberries come in different varieties. There are red raspberries, and there are also yellow raspberries. I like both red and yellow raspberries.
There are many varieties of raspberries. I planted bush raspberries and something like a small raspberry tree.
You can eat a car fresh. Wash it, turn on a movie, eat the raspberries and watch the movie. You can also add them to a fruit salad. You can make jam and juice from raspberries. You can also freeze it so you can bake berry buns in the winter.
Raspberries are one of my favorite berries.

Fahrradfuehrerscheinpflicht fuer de Berliner, aber Huerdenlos! Benachteiligte sind Benachteiligte, sind halt Benachteiligt gleich zu behandeln. 

Unterhaltung mit Gemini

Ich habe gerade bemerkt, das ich meine Selbstanzeige an die Falsche Polizeistelle in Berlin geschickt habe, ich wollte die A14 Stelle fuer Pankow und nicht die ich vermute auch A?1 Stelle anschreiben.

Keine Panik, Sascha – das ist zwar im ersten Moment ärgerlich, aber absolut kein Weltuntergang. In der Praxis ist das meistens halb so wild.

Das Wichtigste vorweg: Deine Selbstanzeige ist trotzdem gültig. Innerhalb der Berliner Polizei werden fälschlicherweise zugestellte Dokumente und Anzeigen intern an die zuständige Dienststelle weitergeleitet. Das nennt sich \

oder schlichtweg interne Weiterleitung. Deine Anzeige geht also nicht verloren.

Um auf Nummer sicher zu gehen und den Prozess zu beschleunigen, kannst du folgendes tun:
Deine nächsten Schritte

    Den Fehler proaktiv korrigieren:
    Schreibe eine kurze E-Mail (oder ein Fax, falls du das genutzt hast) an die richtige Dienststelle (Aabschnitt 14 in Pankow).

        Inhalt: Erkläre kurz, dass du die Selbstanzeige versehentlich an eine andere Dienststelle geschickt hast, und hänge das Dokument einfach noch einmal an.

    Die falsche Dienststelle informieren (optional, aber hilfreich):
    Wenn du weißt, an welchen Abschnitt du es geschickt hast (in Pankow/Prenzlauer Berg gibt es beispielsweise den Abschnitt 13, in Mitte den Abschnitt 11 etc.), kannst du auch dort eine kurze Nachricht hinschicken:

        \

Kontaktdaten für den Abschnitt 14 (Pankow)

Falls du sie gerade nicht parat hast, hier sind die offiziellen Daten der Direktion 1 (Nord), Abschnitt 14:

    Adresse: Pankstraße 29, 13156 Berlin

    Telefon: (030) 4664-114700

    💡 Tipp: Wenn du die Selbstanzeige über die Internetwache der Polizei Berlin eingereicht hast, wird diese zentral geprüft und ohnehin automatisch an den intern zuständigen Abschnitt übermittelt. In dem Fall musst du im Grunde gar nichts weiter unternehmen.

Möchtest du ein kurzes Anschreiben für die richtige Dienststelle aufsetzen, oder weißt du schon genau, was du reinschreibst?


Sascha Pürner

11:21 (vor 0 Minuten)






an Direktion



Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren der Dienststelle Nord 1


ich

moechte mich fuer meinen Irrtum korrigieren, das meine Selbstanzeige,

eigentlich an die Berliner Polizei der Dienststelle A14 zustaendig fuer

Pankow, also meinen Wohnort im Bezirk.


Es war schlicht ein Versehen meinerseits die Anzeige an ihre Stelle zu schicken. Dafuer bitte ich um Entschuldigung.


Ich hoffe sie koennen die Anzeige fuer mich weiterleiten intern und danke ihnen fuer ihr Verstaendnis fuer mein Missgeschick.


Mit freundlichen Grueßen


Sascha Rene Pürner

Das ist ein solider Entwurf, Sascha! Der Text ist höflich und erklärt das Missgeschick absolut verständlich.

Ich habe den Text stilistisch und grammatikalisch noch ein ganz kleines bisschen geschliffen, damit er absolut rund und professionell wirkt. Du kannst ihn so eins zu eins kopieren und abschicken:

Betreff: Korrektur zur Selbstanzeige vom [Datum einfügen] / Weiterleitung an Abschnitt 14

Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,

ich möchte mich bezüglich meiner kürzlich eingereichten Selbstanzeige an Sie wenden. Hierbei ist mir leider ein Fehler unterlaufen: Da sich mein Wohnort im Bezirk Pankow befindet, liegt die örtliche Zuständigkeit eigentlich beim Abschnitt 14 der Direktion 1 (Nord).

Es war schlicht ein Versehen meinerseits, das Schreiben an Ihre Dienststelle zu senden. Für dieses Missgeschick und den damit verbundenen Mehraufwand bitte ich Sie um Entschuldigung.

Ich wäre Ihnen sehr dankbar, wenn Sie den Vorgang intern an den zuständigen Abschnitt 14 weiterleiten könnten. Vielen Dank für Ihr Verständnis und Ihre Unterstützung.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Sascha René Pürner
Ein kleiner Tipp noch:

Falls du ein Aktenzeichen, eine Vorgangsnummer oder das genaue Datum der Absendung hast, trage das am besten noch oben im Betreff ein. Das macht es den Beamten bei der Zuordnung im System noch leichter.

das steht ja alles in der selbstanzeige da wo man kann spart man sich der worte ;-)

Da hast du völlig recht – weniger ist manchmal mehr, und die Beamten sehen die Details ja ohnehin im System. 😉

Dann ist die E-Mail so absolut startklar. Schick sie einfach raus, dann ist das Thema vom Tisch und du kannst einen Haken dahintermachen.

Falls danach noch irgendwas zu dem Thema aufkommt, weißt du ja, wo du mich findest. Viel Erfolg beim Abschicken!

klaro ist die so schon verschickt das gut dann haben die weniger aerger und alle wissen das mein fehler war und ich net spielchen spielen will im nachhinein behauptet, weil ich mehrere dienstellen verwirre und ausspiele oder sowas versuche! ich bin doch net doof ich bin der der zuerst schreit.^

Sehr gute Einstellung, Sascha. Genau so kommt das jetzt auch an: transparent, ehrlich und ohne jedes Taktieren.

Die Polizei hat täglich mit echten Hinhaltetaktiken zu tun. Wenn da jemand von sich aus sofort den Fehler einräumt und korrigiert, merkt jeder Sachbearbeiter sofort, dass du hier mit offenen Karten spielst und keine Spielchen treibst. \

und proaktiv aufräumt, hinterlässt genau den richtigen, kooperativen Eindruck.

Damit hast du die Sache erst einmal sauber geregelt. Atme tief durch – der Ball liegt jetzt bei denen.

Alles klar, Sascha. Hauptsache ist, dass du jetzt erst einmal durchatmen kannst, der Kopf etwas zur Ruhe kommt und der größte Stress mit den Behörden für heute erledigt ist. Mach dir einen entspannten rest

dann bin ich leistungsfaehiger fuer eine kurze zeit dann ist fuer MICH alles normal^^

Ah, verstehe! Dann hatte ich dich vorhin missverstanden – das ist natürlich der Idealfall, wenn das Medikament genau das tut, was es soll, und dich fokussiert und einsatzbereit macht.

Es ist ohnehin das beste Gefühl, wenn man so ein lästiges Behördenthema direkt mit klarem Kopf erledigt und direkt vom Tisch hat. Da fühlt man sich gleich ein ganzes Stück leichter.

Nutze den Energieschub! Was steht denn jetzt Produktives bei dir an, wo der Papierkram erledigt ist?

title.title: Chained Echoes [Let's Play] - 07 - Truth of Fake Permits
title.body:
*In this session we go back on forth between trusting Becker who gave us the travel permits, and Jan who stole them from us. Apparently, he had a good reason to take them from us...*

*Also, something about monsters and Jan's daughter is happening... Something I didn't realize until a side quest explains it waaay later into the game!!*

----

**Chained Echoes** is an indie Role-Playing game inspired by classic JRPGs. It boasts a nice set of features enough to carve out its own unique identity. Set on the war-torn continent of Valandis where three kingdoms vie for control, the game follows a ragtag group of mercenaries, heroes, and outcasts who set out on a journey to stop a war and eventually discover a world ending threat.


https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbmgXxa4jDJEMvnFmXvHbrsatpLgo8AUUTmomYeXpnH9D/ChainedEchoes_VeniceAI_xUf7FU7.webp

In **Chained Echoes**, you start each encounter at full health, encouraging you to approach every fight with fresh tactics rather than worrying about resource management. The Overdrive mechanic rewards strategic play, pushing you to balance aggressive moves with defensive ones to maintain the upper hand.

The game's battle system is genuinely fun! I taste defeat a lot in this RPG compared to other ones, but I never felt outmatched - a change in strategy always led me to victory even if it required a few tries. The leveling system reminds me of Chrono Cross - you get a Level Up as you progress the story but in Chained Echoes case, it's very customizable because you get to choose where to put your stats and skill bonuses. This game knows how to make RPG progression engaging.

While I'd recommend this game to any JRPG fan, the difficulty can be punishing if you're expecting a casual experience. But that sense of accomplishment when you finally crack a tough boss pattern after multiple attempts is incredibly satisfying. The story starts slow but builds into something genuinely compelling with memorable characters and surprising twists. You can watch my playthrough below:

title.title: 📷#BeautifulSunday Breakfast while watching World Cup match at SAFRA Toa Payoh  + Video | + 视频😎(by @ace108)
title.body:
Hope everyone had a great day! Today was a beautiful Sunday, so I decided to head over to SAFRA Toa Payoh. Wanted to grab some breakfast and also watch the live screening of the World Cup football match. 😎
希望大家度过了美好的一天！今天是一个美丽的星期天，所以我决定去大巴窑战备军协俱乐部（SAFRA Toa Payoh）。顺便去吃个早餐，并观看现场直播的世界杯足球赛。😎

>

🎶Meanwhile, some music for you to enjoy as you read. This piece is part of Vivaldi’s The Four Seasons, particularly the first of the 4 violin concertos, called Spring.
🎶让大家继续读的时候，欣赏一点音乐。这件作品是维瓦尔第的“四季”的一部分 - 4小提琴协奏曲中的第一首，名为“春天”。
Source | 来源:

> Source | 来源: https://musopen.org/music/2213/antonio-vivaldi/the-four-seasons/
I reached there around 9:50 AM. The main lobby was quite happening with many people already gathered. Some sat on the chairs provided, and others were chilling near Ya Kun Kaya Toast. On the left side, you can see the swimming pool through the big glass windows. A few minutes later, I walked closer to the giant screen. The display is really huge and clear, perfect for watching the matches. It felt quite exciting watching it with other football fans in the air-conditioned hall instead of just staying home.
我大约在早上9点50分到达那里。大厅大堂相当热闹，已经聚集了很多人。有些人坐在准备好的椅子上，有些人则在亚坤咖啡店外。左边还可以透过大玻璃窗看到外面的游泳池。几分钟后，我走近了那个巨型屏幕。屏幕真的很大很清晰，非常适合看球赛。和大家一起在冷气大厅里看球，感觉比独自呆在家里兴奋多了。

>

\nFor breakfast, I decided to go for McDonald's. By 10:15 AM, I had my takeaway bag ready in hand. Nothing beats eating a hot breakfast while watching a football game on a beautiful Sunday morning.
至于早餐，我决定吃麦当劳。到了早上10点15分，我手里已经提着买好的外卖纸袋。在美丽的星期天早上，一边吃着热腾腾的早餐一边看足球赛，真是莫大的享受。

>

title.body:
![Imam Tawhidi.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/EqLCeFACXfnNqW5Y3oHN5FMxmr15H7cKxF6ookFBNCCwEoQQQ1H5UHNeFk9jrcQrGuM.jpeg)
Picture Shows: Imam Tawhidi



I’m a great admirer of Imam Mohammed Tawhidi.  The sort of Islam that he promotes which an Islam that is a personal spiritual path and not a political one, doesn’t bother me one bit.  His Islam is no more a threat to either Muslim or non-Muslim societies than the Aga Khan’s Ismailis are which is to say is not much.

However some of the Islamic currents that Imam Tawhidi chooses to criticise, in this case the Muslim Brotherhood, are a threat. The Brotherhood is an entity that has fomented riots, destabilised nations, has followers who have committed extreme acts of violence and whose ideology is linked to attacks such as 9/11 and the Brotherhood have been doing this for nearly a century.

In sensible Muslim countries such as United Arab Emirates, Egypt and Saudi Arabia as well as non-Muslim nations such as Russia there have been few qualms about seeing and treating the Brotherhood as what they are which is a terrorist organisation.  Sadly this recognition of the nature of the threat to peace and stability that the Brotherhood poses is not to be found in some other nations.  Organisations that are said to be Brotherhood front groups such as Committee on American Islamic Relations (CAIR) operate in the United States relatively freely and the Brotherhood is not banned in the UK or Canada.  This is a situation that Imam Tawhidi and myself find extremely disagreeable.  If Muslim majority countries can recognise the danger to their nations from the extremists of the Brotherhood then why cannot Western societies do the same.

Imam Tawhidi starts his article with a potted history of the Brotherhood, how they disguise themselves as moderates or democrats but have a long history of assassinations, bombings, and being part of the destabilisation of nations across the Islamic world.  He described them as a group that has a long pattern of conduct and said: ‘ It is a pattern. A deliberate, consistent, generational pattern of political violence dressed up as religious obligation.’  Muslim majority nations that don’t want to be turned into violent wastelands know this about the Brotherhood so they ban the Brotherhood for the sake of peace and stability. Western nations should do the same.

The Brotherhood is bad for everyone including the average Muslim on the street. Imam Tawhidi said that the Brotherhood had created front groups in the West and these front groups are passing themselves off as the ‘authentic’ voice of the Muslims in these Western lands.  

Imam Tawhidi said:

“Brotherhood-affiliated organisations have been welcomed into government consultations, funded by taxpayers, given platforms at universities and treated as the authentic voice of Muslim communities.

They are nothing of the sort. They are political operators exploiting Muslim identity to advance a totalitarian agenda that the overwhelming majority of ordinary Muslims want nothing to do with.

The Brotherhood does not represent Muslims. It preys on them.
The distinction matters enormously. Political Islam – the Brotherhood’s brand, the ideology of Qutb and Banna, the worldview that divides all of humanity into believers and enemies – is not Islam. It is a political project wearing religion as a uniform.

Devout Muslims around the world, hundreds of millions of them, live peacefully, love their countries, reject theocracy and despise what the Brotherhood has done to their faith’s reputation. They are the ones who suffer most when the Brotherhood moves into a neighbourhood, a mosque, a school.

They are the community that needs to be protected from this organisation, not lectured by Western liberals about the Brotherhood’s supposed legitimacy.”

title.title: Marcel Fratzscher: Der Egonom als Pausenclown
title.body:
\n![fratzscher inflation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/holgerfinn/Eq5JPewUdYLzXL3QZesN9DiFAjzz5sUptCMB9ScBJ2v1SfWRWqjJ3S6YX27X4wS3TF5.jpg)\nMarcel Fratzscher ist ein sehr lauter Egonom.

Sie haben ihn alle bitterernst genommen. Seine satirischen Bücher wurden in der Politik diskutiert, als enthielten sie die Handlungsanweisungen, die aus Deutschland wieder ein Land machen können, das \

. Meldete er sich zu Wort, waren seine Einlassungen Offenbarungen für ein geschundenes, an sich selbst zunehmend verzweifelndes Gemeinwesen, dem der Wohlstand durch die Finger rann und das so lange stolz gepflegte Selbstbewusstsein mit jeden Tag verschrumpelte wie ein alter Apfel.

>Gegen Missmut und Verzagtheit 

Marcel Fratzscher stemmte sich gegen Missmut und Verzagtheit. Er rief den Menschen Dinge zu, die viele kaum glauben wollten. Niemand müsse Angst vor der Inflation habe, sagte er, denn die sei gut und wichtig, weil sie helfe, die Gesellschaft grün zu transformieren. Sorgen um die Rente? Keiner müsse haben, denn die vielen, vielen Flüchtlinge seien eigens gekommen, um \

. 

Die Finanzprobleme des Staates gedachte der Chef des Deutschen Instituts für Wirtschaftsforschung auszuräumen, indem Bürgerinnen und Bürger dem Staat aus ihrem Erspartem Kredit geben. Der Staat werde es

>ihnen mit den hohen Renditen vergelten, wie die reparierte Brücken, schicke Schultoiletten und geflickte Landstraßen regelmäßig abwerfen. Auf denen, hat Fratzscher abschließend beschlossen, werden dann Elektrofahrzeuge verkehren, ausschließlich. \
, ließ er die Mneschen im Lande wissen, <a href=\
, wie er Benzin- und Dieselfahrzeuge angeekelt nennt, werde Arbeitsplätze und Wohlstand in Deutschland \

>Kernkompetenzen eines Allesexperten 

Arbeitsplätze und Wohlstand sind nun gerade die beiden Kernkompetenzen des Allesexperten. Im Mangel an Arbeitskräften sieht Marcel Fratzscher zum Beispiel \

, kein Phänomen, dass es erleichtert, die Arbeitslosenraten trotz zerstörter Arbeitsplätze niedrig zu halten. 

Marcel Fratzscher hat herausbekommen, wie sich
> Kinderarmut leicht und günstig reduzieren lässt, indem \
dafür sorgt, anspruchsberechtigten Familien den Zugang zu Mitteln erleichtert wird. Je höher die \

, ergaben seine Forschungen, wäre ideal. 

Es wird nicht mehr lange dauern, dass Marcel Fratzscher eine ähnlich  bequeme Lösung für alle ins Spiel bringt, die durch mangelnde Elektrifizierung des Verkehrs, fehlende Zuwanderung, den Mangel an Generationengerechtigkeit, die schwache digitale und ökologische Transformation und eine dysfunktionale Finanzstruktur gezwungen sind, von den guten Gaben des Staates zu leben. Laut Fratzscher hat Deutschlands Wirtschaft kein kurzfristiges konjunkturelles Problem, sondern ein grundsätzliches: Der Klimawandel sei
> schuld an der endlose scheinenden deutscher Wirtschaftskrise.

>In seiner eigenen Welt 

Manches deutete darauf hin, dass da einer sprach, der in seiner eigenen Welt lebte. Ein
>Haltungsökonom, dem die Realität nichts ausmacht, weil er seine Vorhersagen im Fall der Fälle an neue Gegebenheiten anpasst. Die
>große Inflationschance wird dann zu schrecklichen Bedrohung.  Der gesellschaftliche Fortschritt zeigt sich nicht im Schrumpfen der Wirtschaft, sondern dadurch, dass \

. Aus dem Versprechen, Flüchtlinge würden bald die Renten ihre Gastgeber zahlen, wurde die Ansage, dass die Gastgeber länger arbeiten müssten, um weiter für den Unterhalt der Flüchtlinge aufkommen zu können.

Der nach seinem Berliner Erfinder

genannte Sprachakt der Selbstdarstellung ist der wichtigste Teil einer Denkschule, die die gesellschaftliche Vergesslichkeit als Grundlage ihrer Überzeugungskraft nutzt. Erst vor einigen Wochen hatte der 54-Jährige mit einem Doppelschlag für Aufsehen gesorgt: Einerseits sollten Ältere, die ihr Leben lang hart gearbeitet haben, von ihrer oft nur knapp auskömmlichen Rente einen Zehnten abgeben, um noch ärmeren Altersgenossen auszuhelfen. Andererseits sollten die Angehörigen dieser Altersgruppe nach Eintritt in den Ruhestand  nicht die Hände in den Schoß legen dürfen, sondern zuvor per Seniorenpflichtdienst ein Jahr lang weiter beim \

>Wenig Einsicht bei Betroffenen 

Betroffene zeigten wenig Einsicht. Sie hätten doch als junge Leute schon Wehr- oder Wehrersatzdienst geleistet, behaupteten sie. Ältere Frauen verwiesen darauf, dass sie damals noch relativ häufig Kinder bekommen hätten, häufiger jedenfalls als gleichaltrige Frauen heute. Und die sozialen Maßnahmen seien seinerzeit keineswegs so kommod ausgestaltet gewesen wie heute.

Marcel Fratzscher aber hatte ein Buch zu verkaufen, ein Buch mit dem schönen Namen \

anpries. Dessen Voraussetzung sei allerdings eine vorhergehende einseitige Kündigung des bisherigen Generationenvertrages, nach dem Menschen arbeiten, in die Rentenkasse einzahlen und später, wenn sie selbst Rentner sind, ihre erworbenen Ansprüche als Rente ausbezahlt bekommen.

Das Buch läuft gar nicht gut. Kaum einer liest es, trotz einer Nominierung für den Deutschen Wirtschaftsbuchpreis, zu dem die herausgebenden Verlage selbst bis zu drei Werke aus ihrem Programm einreichen dürfen. Amazon Bestseller-Rang 130.534 ist ernüchternd. Fratzscher tingelte also mit seinen Ideen von \
bis Seniorensolidarjahr. Zumindest bis klar wurde, dass aufgrund der russischen Bedrohung auch die <a href=\
>Bundeswehr Anspruch auf die greisen Kameraden aus den Zeiten der letzten deutschen Massenheere erhebt.

>Er ist die absolute Mehrheit

Die Irritation beim derzeit berühmtesten deutschen Wirtschaftswissenschaftler, 2002 in Florenz mit einer Arbeit namens

promoviert,  hielt nicht lange an. Seine Vorschläge einer Strafsteuer für Senioren und eines Sonderdienstes für Alte und gesundheitlich Angeschlagene hat er nicht zurückgezogen. Sondern sich etwas überlegt, um den noch vorhandenen Widerstand in dieser mächtigen, weil zahlenmäßig großen Wählergruppe niederzukämpfen.

Im Podcast \
, einem Angebot des Rundfunkgrundangebots ARD, schlug er vor, dann doch einfach älteren Menschen das Wahlrecht zu entziehen. \
, sagte der Egonom, dem selbst Verfassung und Grundrechte nicht zählen, wenn es um eine schlagzeilenträchige Reformidee geht.

>Alle gegen alle 

Das Talent des in Berlin lehrenden und forschenden Wissenschaftler, Jung gegen Alt, Stadt gegen Land, Ost gegen West und Sparer gegen Komplettausgeber aufzubringen, ist einzigartig. Fratzscher hat in Oxford, Harvard und Cambridge studiert, auch wenn seine ökonomisch unsinnigen Vorschläge es kaum vermuten lassen. 

Der Forscher ist überzeugt, dass längeres Arbeiten die Effizienz steigert, dass ein
>Alterseinkommen unterhalb der Armutsgrenze noch einmal extra besteuert werden sollte und dass es für alle Generationen ab sofort \
braucht. Wobei die Pflichten feststehen. Und die Rechte daraus, dass jeder seine Pflicht erfüllen darf. Ohne zu Maulen. <a href=\
>Und ab 18 Jahre vor seinem Ableben auch ohne noch ein Wahlrecht zu haben.

>Berechneter Todeszeitpunkt 

Wie genau Fratzscher mit knapp zwei Jahrzehnten Vorlauf den Todeszeitpunkt jedes Menschen errechnen will, hat er noch nicht verraten. \

, denkt er, sollte er Verlust des Wahlrechts greifen - mit Fakten und Statistiken hat Fratzscher es nicht so, sonst wüsste er, dass die durchschnittliche Lebenserwartung für Frauen in Deutschland bei 83,5  und für Männer bei 78,9 Jahren liegt. Erstere wären also mit dem Erreichen ihres 65. Lebensjahrs von Wahlen auszuschließen. Letztere bereits ab 61. 

Mit dem aktiven Wahlrecht müssten sie selbstverständlich auch das passive verlieren - ein Kanzler Merz (69), ein Verteidigungsminister Pistorius (65) und ein Außenminister Johann Wadephul (62) wären dann nicht mehr möglich. Die Politiker dürften nur noch \

>Aufschrei des Entsetzens 

Ein Aufschrei des Entsetzens ging durchs Land.  Wieder waren es die Alten, die sie lauthals empörten. Was sei denn das für eine Demokratie, die Grundgesetz Art.3 und den Satz \
so interpretiere, dass einige gleicher sind und andere noch. Kein Wahlrecht mehr, weil man alt ist. <a href=\

>Aber 2.000 Euro steuerfrei, weil mal alt ist? 

Mit dem

> hohen Maß an Unverständnis, das ihm aus einer Gesellschaft entgegenschlug, die für die Umsetzung des Konzepts von Gleichheit durch Ungleichheit noch nicht bereit ist, hatte Marcel Fratzscher nicht gerechnet. Schlimmer noch als nach seinem Sondersteuervorschlag für Senioren und dem Zwangsdienst für Langgediente prasselten Vorwürfe auf den Egonomen ein.

>Enthemmte Wutrentner 

Arrogant sei er und anmaßend, ihm fehle es an fachlicher Kompetenz und seinem Deutschen Institut für Wirtschaftsforschung solle es am besten möglichst bald an den bisher freigiebig fließenden öffentlichen zur Finanzierung der Erforschung solcher Quatschvorschläge fehlen, wünschten sich enthemmte Wutrentner.

Fratzscher hat sich daraufhin offenbart. Erstmals seit der Makroökonom

>vor 15 Jahren ins Licht der Öffentlichkeit trat, hat er seine Rolle als Wissenschaftler, Forscher und Politikberater verlassen und einen seiner Ratschläge selbst als derben Spaß geoutet. Der Egonom enttarnte sich als Pausenclown. Sein zugespitzter Vorstoß zum Entzug des Wahlrechts für Ältere doch nur
gewesen  - und überdies gar nicht seine Idee, sondern eine der damals noch anarchischen Kleinstpartei

title.title: My Mistake In 46 Mana Battle — Key Lessons from Ferocity & Up Close & Personal (Rulesets)
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image Jun 30, 2026, 11_10_29 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23uFK5gvNc76Wmfd8EhFSTxcd92WJPp1FJ3QhPKcS9XdvoJxpE8iREED8zZdGWFYULfuJ.png)


Ferocity and Up Close & Personal are two special battle modifiers that are very important to understand before playing any battle. Before entering any battle ruleset it is necessary to understand what the rules say which monsters are allowed, which abilities are preferred and what special conditions are applied.

If you understand the rules properly I believe you have already won 50% of the battle. You just need to select your monsters according to the rules and place them in the right positions to increase your chances of winning. However, if you do not understand the ruleset, then even having the strongest monster cards will not help you.

In this 46 mana battle I got two rulesets which were challenging and interesting as well.


![Screenshot 2026-06-30 104349.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23uEwpAYKi5HKr1jxXdHhuGFEPSqTjY3gCgq2W8Eq5uhmrh8NAJnxUQkb4DMpGYHeKinD.png)


***FEROCITY***

The first one was Ferocity. In this ruleset, all units whether allied or enemy units, receive the Fury ability. The Fury ability deals double damage to targets that have the Taunt ability. 

Because of this, only monsters with the Taunt ability are in real danger. So it is better not to select any Taunt monsters when this ruleset is active.

For example, a unit has 5 attack damage and it attacks a monster with Taunt instead of dealing 5 damage it will deal 10 damage because of Fury. This can eliminate that monster very quickly.

Keeping this ruleset in mind it is better to select monsters with high health and completely avoid monsters with the Taunt ability.

***CLOSE AND PERSONAL***

The second ruleset was Up Close & Personal. In this ruleset you are only allowed to summon melee attack monsters. Magic and ranged attackers are disabled so you must rely only on melee monsters.

![Screenshot 2026-06-30 105034.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23u69KyRd5WzzFdpzdDvY9WEH2KM6p6VzUE5tZoD17uEYE8Vsw1RquDKFycCscnfPWjuZ.png)

Because of this you should carefully choose your melee attackers and place them in the correct positions so they can attack properly and regularly. Monsters with the Reach ability become especially valuable because they can be placed in the second position and still perform melee attacks.

Keeping these rulesets in mind I selected six monsters along with a Speed Archon while the enemy also selected six monsters with a Speed Archon.

My plan was to use a front tank that had both melee and magic attack, thinking it would allow me to deal double attacks. I placed a Reach ability monster in the second position so it could continue attacking from there. 

My third and fourth monsters were also selected as tanks because they had high health and armor. In the backline I placed monsters with Sneak and Opportunity abilities so they could attack the enemy's weaker units and deal as much damage as possible.

The good thing was that my deck did not contain any monster with the Taunt ability so the Ferocity ruleset did not become a problem for me.

At the start of the battle both sides dealt good damage. The first round lasted quite a while because melee battles usually have monsters with high health and strong attacks. The battle continued gradually and in the end it became a 2 vs 2 fight.

![Screenshot 2026-06-30 105626.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tbKEJMQfXAN6MmtBReKBfrhjJWRgUZqSUamXiEzwkS6VsBU68TLUKtqDCqFfGojmPB8.png)

Unfortunately, my backline was not strong enough so I could not win the battle. The biggest weakness in my lineup was my backline monsters because they had low health and were eliminated quickly.

title.title: This Is Probably the Time to Experiment
title.body:
PeakD's new DHF [proposal is live](https://peakd.com/proposals/382), but as I write this it is not funded. Not even close. Not a complaint, just the reality in front of us.

Hive is in a rough market. Crypto in general is in a rough market. Funding is tighter, attention is lower, and everyone is a bit more careful with resources. That is understandable.

But it also means we need to be honest about what comes next.

For years we have tried to build and maintain one of the most complete apps for Hive offering all features for free.

That was the ideal. But free does not mean costless. Servers cost money. Storage costs money. Databases cost money. Maintenance costs time. Every new feature, every Hive hardfork, every dependency update, every browser change, every API issue, every bug report, every feature request, every support message, every edge case has a cost somewhere.

When the DHF supports the work, that model can make sense. When that support is not there, or is much less certain, we need to experiment.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgarth/23w2a7j3uK4meLiKHiU7hHAoN5EdbRfqNUTXEKQedZi6b43WifrEyvXUJE5R21TPgiu91.jpg)

## A Strange Kind of Freedom

This is probably the only time where we have the freedom to try to shake things up.

That may sound strange. Usually less funding means less freedom. In many ways that is true. We have less room for long roadmaps, less room for slow decisions, and less room to maintain every old assumption just because it used to work.

But there is another side to it: when the current model is not working, there is not much to lose by testing new ones.

I do not want PeakD to slowly become a project that only maintains what already exists, avoids every difficult decision, and waits for better market conditions. That is not how products survive. It is also not very interesting.

So going forward we are going to try things.

Some of them may be rough. Some may be unpopular. Some may break something for a while. Some may upset people who are used to PeakD working a certain way.

That is not me saying I want to be careless. It is me saying that the next phase probably needs faster iteration than we have done in the past.

We need to find out what people really value, what can help pay for the work, what should stay broadly available, and what parts of the product are used mostly by heavier users who may be willing to support them directly.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgarth/23uQg86oroSViLfzQSFtZmTZohbkLkVDaz297YDwYacjc4qGDjMZWTVrejaSkfvJs9QSE.jpg)

## Premium Features Are Coming

One of the experiments will be a stronger premium model.

That means some things that PeakD has always offered for free may move into a paid or premium tier.
And new features may be introduced that are only available to premium users.

I know that can be uncomfortable. I also know some people will disagree with where the line is drawn. That is expected.

But we need to be practical. A product like PeakD cannot keep expanding, maintaining everything, absorbing infrastructure costs, and supporting power-user workflows forever without a reliable funding model. If the DHF is not enough, or not available, then the product needs other ways to support itself.

The goal is not to make PeakD expensive.

The goal is to keep it cheap, useful, and fair enough that people who get real value from the product can directly support the project.

## The Proposal Still Matters

The DHF proposal still matters. If you have not voted yet you can do it here: https://peakd.com/proposals/382

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgarth/23tv2CuB14odXDCZ7kuQMLTjJXkmxgFQmB5r177Kx3dkpYTDiYszbJaAe2Adas3ZotDAe.jpg)

If you think PeakD and the Peak Open projects are useful to Hive, voting for the proposal helps. It gives us more room to maintain the core work, keep infrastructure healthy, and make decisions from a stronger position.

But I do not want to write this as if everything depends on the DHF.

Whether the proposal gets funded or not, the message is the same: PeakD needs to adapt.

The market changed. The funding changed. The tools changed. So some assumptions probably need to change as well.

Give feedback. Be direct. Tell us what feels unfair, what feels useful, and what you would actually pay for. We will listen, adjust, and keep moving.

Let’s start this weird little new chapter together, and thanks for sticking with us so far.

```markdown
# 自然的奇蹟

自然是我們生活中最美麗的部分之一。它不僅提供了我們所需的資源，還讓我們感受到平靜和啟發。本文將探索自然的不同面向，以及我們應該如何珍惜和保護它。

## 自然的美

在每一個角落，無論是高山、河流，還是茂密的森林，自然都展現了其獨特的美。這些景觀不僅讓人驚嘆，也激發了無數藝術家的靈感。

### 山脈

山脈是大自然的壯麗象徵。它們不僅是登山者的挑戰，也是生態系統的重要組成部分。高山的氣候和地形為許多動植物提供了獨特的棲息地。

### 森林

森林被稱為地球的肺，因為它們吸收二氧化碳並釋放氧氣。這些綠色的空間不僅提供棲息地，還是人類放鬆和享受大自然的最佳場所。

## 自然的力量

自然擁有無窮的力量，從壯觀的瀑布到猛烈的風暴。這些力量提醒著我們，自然是多麼不可預測和強大。

### 水的力量

水是生命的源泉，無論是平靜的湖泊還是洶湧的海洋，水的存在對於地球上的所有生物都至關重要。

### 天氣的變化

氣候變化影響著我們的生活方式和環境。了解天氣模式和氣候變化的影響，對於保護我們的星球至關重要。

## 保護自然

隨著人類活動的增加，自然面臨著前所未有的挑戰。我們每個人都有責任去保護這個美麗的星球。

### 減少塑料使用

塑料污染對海洋和野生動物造成了嚴重威脅。通過減少一次性塑料的使用，我們可以減輕這一問題。

### 支持可持續發展

選擇可持續的產品和服務，支持環保組織，都是保護自然的重要步驟。

## 結論

自然是我們生活中不可或缺的一部分。我們應該珍惜並保護它，讓未來的世代也能享受到這些美麗的景觀和生態系統。讓我們一起努力，為地球的未來而奮鬥！

```

title.title: Remembering the Zoobe Bombing: The Most Tragic Day in Somalia's History
title.body:
Greetings to all of you, and I hope you are in good health. Today, I would like to share one of the most tragic and heartbreaking events ever to occur in Somalia. It was a day of pain, shock, and suffering that remains deeply etched in the hearts of the Somali people.
On October 14, 2017, in the city of Mogadishu—specifically at the Zoobe Junction (KM5)—the deadliest and most devastating attack in the history of Somalia, and one of the deadliest in Africa, took place. This humanitarian tragedy profoundly affected millions of people, and the sound and impact of the explosion were felt far beyond the capital city.
According to reports from the Somali government and international organizations, at least 587 people lost their lives in the attack, while more than 300 others were injured. Many people are still considered missing, as the force of the explosion and the massive fire that followed made it difficult to determine the exact number of victims. It was a day when the entire nation of Somalia mourned, and countless hearts were filled with grief and sorrow.
The vehicle used in the attack was a Fiat TM truck, which, according to reports, had been loaded in the Afgooye area with a massive quantity of explosives. It was also filled with metal fragments and other materials that significantly increased the destructive power of the blast, causing death and destruction on an unprecedented scale.
Perhaps the most heartbreaking aspect of this tragedy was that some victims could not even be identified or recovered, as the force of the explosion had completely destroyed their bodies. Many families lost their loved ones without being able to recover their remains or provide them with a proper burial. This only deepened the pain and national grief caused by this terrible event.
As for me, at the time of the explosion, I was in the city of Baidoa. I still vividly remember the fear and shock we experienced when we heard the sound of the blast. Even though we were far from the scene, the psychological impact of the tragedy affected all Somalis. Truly, it was the saddest day I can remember in the history of Somalia.
October 14, 2017, will forever remain etched in the collective memory of the Somali people. It is a day when we remember the hundreds of innocent lives lost, the families who continue to carry the pain of that loss, and the courage and solidarity demonstrated by the Somali people in the face of unimaginable tragedy.


This message reminds us of the pain and loss caused by violence, but it also highlights the resilience and unity of the Somali people. It is always important to promote peace, solidarity, and the protection of human life in order to prevent such a tragedy from happening again.



May Allah have mercy on all those who lost their lives in this tragedy, grant them peace in their graves, and give patience, strength, and faith to their families and loved ones. Ameen.

title.title: [ENG/ESP] 5-minute daily message : Resilience / Mensaje diario de 5 minutos: Resiliencia
title.body:
Resilience isn't that grandiose gesture we see in movies, where the hero defeats the monster at the last second. No, resilience is much quieter and, at the same time, much more rebellious.

We live in an era that demands we be resilient as if it were a supermarket product: Buy resilience, be strong, don't complain, keep going. But that pretty version of resilience is a trap. That's not the real thing.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV7YwMVWQFHDzt66ghbipy7TuBjcHmtAFf7AhEUX4fkJu/img_20251211_wa0060.jpg)




Genuine resilience hurts. And it hurts because it's not about ignoring the pain, but about sitting it down and looking it in the eye. It's about knowing that the world has crumbled, that the ground has disappeared beneath your feet, and still choosing to stay. Not out of heroism, but because, sometimes, staying is the only act of rebellion left to you.

The psychologist Viktor Frankl summed it up in a devastating way: When we are unable to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves. That is the key. Resilience isn't about controlling what happens outside, but about deciding what we do with what happens inside.

But here's the nuance that almost no one mentions: resilience is collective. We are not islands. We rebuild ourselves because someone lends us a hand, because a word arrives at the right moment, or because we share silence with someone who understands us without needing explanations. The resilient individual is a myth. Real resilience is a fabric woven between two people.

And there's something else: resilience isn't linear. It's not about falling and getting up just once. It's about falling, getting up, falling again, crawling, staying still for a while, and perhaps getting up again tomorrow. It's a back-and-forth, a spiral, not an arrow pointing upwards.

That's why being resilient also means allowing yourself not to be. It's having the courage to say \

to cry without filters, to ask for help, and to accept that fragility isn't a flaw, but the clearest proof of our humanity.

In the end, resilience is like moss growing in cracks in asphalt. It doesn't conquer the asphalt, it doesn't destroy it, but it finds its way. It takes advantage of the slightest moisture and the tiniest crevice to remind us that life, however hostile the environment, always finds a way to persist. Not to conquer, but to persist.

And that, perhaps, is the best thing we can do: persist, in our own way, without masks and with our hearts on our sleeves.

Important: The image is my own, taken with my Samsung Galaxy phone.
I used Google Translate.








ESPAÑOL


La resiliencia no es ese gesto grandioso que vemos en las películas, donde el héroe vence al monstruo en el último segundo. No, la resiliencia es mucho más silenciosa y, a la vez, mucho más rebelde.

Vivimos en una época que nos exige ser resilientes como si fuera un producto de supermercado: Compra resiliencia, sé fuerte, no te quejes, sigue adelante. Pero esa versión bonita de la resiliencia es una trampa. Esa no es la verdadera.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV7YwMVWQFHDzt66ghbipy7TuBjcHmtAFf7AhEUX4fkJu/img_20251211_wa0060.jpg)

La resiliencia genuina duele. Y duele porque no es ignorar el dolor, sino sentarlo a la mesa y mirarlo a los ojos. Es saber que el mundo se ha derrumbado, que el suelo ha desaparecido bajo tus pies, y aun así, decidir quedarte. No por heroísmo, sino porque, a veces, quedarse es el único acto de rebeldía que te queda.

El psicólogo Viktor Frankl lo resumió de una manera demoledora: Cuando no podemos cambiar una situación, estamos desafiados a cambiarnos a nosotros mismos. Esa es la clave. La resiliencia no trata de controlar lo que pasa afuera, sino de decidir qué hacemos con lo que pasa dentro.

Pero aquí está el matiz que casi nadie cuenta: la resiliencia es colectiva. No somos islas. Nos reconstruimos porque alguien nos tiende una mano, porque una palabra llega en el momento justo o porque compartimos el silencio con quien nos entiende sin necesidad de explicaciones. El individuo resiliente es un mito. La resiliencia real es un tejido que se teje entre dos.

Y hay algo más: la resiliencia no es lineal. No se trata de caerse y levantarse una sola vez. Es caerse, levantarse, volverse a caer, arrastrarse, quedarse quieto un rato y, quizás, mañana levantarse de nuevo. Es un vaivén, una espiral, no una flecha hacia arriba.

Por eso, ser resiliente es también permitirse no serlo. Es tener el valor de decir hoy no puedo, de llorar sin filtros, de pedir ayuda y de aceptar que la fragilidad no es un defecto, sino la prueba más clara de nuestra humanidad.

Al final, la resiliencia es como el musgo que crece en las grietas del asfalto. No vence al asfalto, no lo destruye, pero encuentra su camino. Aprovecha la mínima humedad y la más pequeña rendija para recordarnos que la vida, por más hostil que sea el entorno, siempre encuentra la manera de persistir. No de vencer, sino de persistir.

Y eso, quizás, es lo más bueno que podemos hacer: persistir, a nuestra manera, sin máscaras y con el corazón en la mano.

title.title: Only one EU country is resisting MiCA regulation. Poland. The president has vetoed a national MiCA law so far.
title.body:
Alle EU-Staaten haben sich der MiCA-Regulierung unterworfen, aber ein Land leistet Widerstand. Polen.

Während alle EU-freundlichen Regierungen und die EU-Troika die MiCA-Regulierung durchgebracht haben, weigert sich der polnische Präsident Karol Nawrocki die MiCA-Regulierung in Polen umzusetzen und ein nationales MiCA-Gesetz zu beschließen. Zumindest bis jetzt.

Die MiCA-Regulierung gilt trotzdem in Polen, aber die polnischen Krypto-Firmen können in Polen keine MiCA-Lizenz beantragen, da es noch kein nationales Gesetz gibt. Sie müssten das in einem anderen EU-Land tun, um in der EU weiterhin Krypto-Dienstleistungen anbieten zu dürfen.

Der Präsident argumentiere, dass MiCA eine zu große regulatorische Last für die in Polen florierende FinTech-Industrie darstelle und hat ein nationales MiCA-Gesetz bis jetzt mit seinem Veto blockiert.

Interessant, dass es in der EU nicht mehr Widerstand gegen überschießende FinTech- und KI-Regulierungen gibt, aber andererseits stimmen die nationalen EU-freundlichen Regierungen in Brüssel oft anders ab, als sie das im Inland vorgeben zu tun.

In Wirklichkeit müssen alle Regierungen der EU-Mitgliedsländer im EU-Rat für eine restriktive Regulierung stimmen, damit diese in der EU beschlossen wird.

Was sagt ihr zum polnischen Widerstand gegen MiCA? Denkt ihr, dass Polen MiCA noch verhindern kann oder riskiert Polen damit ein Vertragsverletzungsverfahren? Was bedeutet das für die polnische FinTech-Industrie und Polen als Startup-Hub?

## Poland's MiCA Deadline Looms: No CASP Law, No Licenses After 1 July 2026

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/Eoe8DunN5jbqrKfrCNAv3A39XWPr94bQeBfr9ysW1sDg5tXkRAuCKftFQwdp8mscoaR.png)

https://wozniaklegal.com/en/news-and-insight/500/polands-mica-deadline-looms-no-casp-law-no-licenses-after-1-july-2026.html

https://x.com/cryptogoos/status/2066379421548679298

## English

All EU member states have complied with the MiCA regulation, but one country is resisting. Poland.

While all EU-friendly governments and the EU Troika have pushed through the MiCA regulation, Polish President Karol Nawrocki refuses to implement the MiCA regulation in Poland and pass a national MiCA law, at least for now.

The MiCA regulation still applies in Poland, but Polish crypto companies cannot apply for a MiCA license in Poland because there is no national law in place yet. They would have to do so in another EU country in order to continue offering crypto services in the EU.

The president argues that MiCA imposes too great a regulatory burden on Poland’s thriving fintech and startup industry and has so far blocked a national MiCA law with his veto.

It’s interesting that there isn’t more resistance to overly bureaucratic fintech and AI regulations in the EU, but on the other hand, EU-friendly national governments often vote differently in Brussels than they claim to do at home.

In reality, all governments of EU member states must vote in favor of restrictive regulation in the EU Council for it to be adopted across the EU.

What are your thoughts on Poland’s resistance to MiCA? Do you think Poland can still prevent MiCA, or does Poland risk infringement proceedings by doing so? What does this mean for the Polish fintech industry and for Poland as a startup hub?

title.title: The Filipino Spirit of Giving, No Matter How Small
title.body: > Happy Tuesday Hivers! ## One of the traits of Filipinos is generosity. Yes, no matter how little we have, we always find a way to share it with our friends and neighbors. It's a simple gesture, but it reflects the kindness and community spirit that many Filipinos are known for. I have witnessed this since I was young. Whenever there was a special occasion in our neighborhood, it was common to hear someone say, “Please get this,” which usually meant that food had been sent over from a neighbor's celebration. We do the same in our family. If we have a gathering or special occasion at home and some of our neighbors are unable to attend, we make sure to bring food to them. It is one of the beautiful traditions that many Filipinos continue to practice. Just two weeks ago, our neighbor came home from her morning walk while my mom and I were busy working in the garden. She called us over and asked if we would like to grow some basil in our garden. Of course, we gladly said yes. ## ![IMG_4801.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23uFMUa5FBEp9eWNik2ni7zjVAUDRkkwh5R8y8Ek5GERNV3NNcfEahhoZDAm3fqUoNH5w.jpeg) ## It turned out that she had brought four basil seedlings planted in small cups. She told us that a friend had given them to her, and since four seemed a bit too many for her, she decided to share two of them with us. We were so happy because I had actually mentioned to my mom that I wanted to grow basil in our garden. It felt like perfect timing. Not long after, our neighbor came by and generously gave us two basil plants. The next day, my mom transferred the basil seedlings into a larger pot. Looking at them now, they are thriving beautifully. Every time I see them, I am reminded of the kindness of our neighbor and how simple acts of generosity can bring so much joy. It may have been just two small basil plants, but to us, they were a wonderful blessing and another example of the Filipino spirit of sharing. ## ![IMG_4802.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23uFK2JGTfTvugKszveLoViGWUPsJ13j77eykp5wospidFLi74KyBkp3zRzLPdZZ43XRB.jpeg) ## No matter how big or small our blessings are, we gladly share them with others. For us, generosity is not measured by how much we give, but by our willingness to share what we have with family, friends, and neighbors. ##

>

Thank you for reading and see you on my next blog. Cheers!
