## 📉 Market Update: Hang Seng Index (HSI) Wraps Up a Bruising June
![Screenshot 2026 06 30 at 3.57.36 PM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbXTiS7XFg1CkTors1V2dnbGu91WaKgzMHqwwAuQ9gbXJ/Screenshot%202026-06-30%20at%203.57.36%E2%80%AFPM.png)
As we flip the calendar to July, the **Hang Seng Index (HSI)** is closing out June on a distinctly defensive note. Despite sporadic attempts to find a floor, the technicals and fundamentals are flashing a clear warning: **the bears still control the narrative.**

### 🔍 Key Takeaways from the Charts & News:
![Screenshot 2026 06 30 at 3.46.44 PM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUjxRPZmgkhy1URiCUrXeTSiKBKZi6hwdmFS91pit6ioS/Screenshot%202026-06-30%20at%203.46.44%E2%80%AFPM.png)
* **Weak Recuperation:** While today's hourly chart shows a minor intraday tick upward to **22,894.59 (+0.26%)**, it is a drop in the ocean compared to the steep, cascading downtrend that dominated the second half of June.
  
* **Heavy Technical Resistance:** The HSI is firmly pinned underneath a descending channel of moving averages/bands, with the major red baseline acting as a heavy lid overhead near 23,695. The price action remains well below the key psychological support-turned-resistance blue line at **24,550**.

  
* **Fading Fundamental Catalyst:** Headline momentum confirms that Hong Kong stocks are actively giving back gains. A 0.9% slip earlier today down to the 22,819 level underscores that investors remain highly cautious. Even continued policy support hints from Beijing haven't been enough to spark a sustained trend reversal.

### 🔮 Outlook for July: A Continuation of the Bear?

The inability to stage a meaningful bounce at these multi-week lows strongly suggests that the **bearish tendency is highly likely to continue into July.** Unless buyers can orchestrate a massive, high-volume breakout above the immediate overhead dynamic resistance bands, the path of least resistance remains skewed to the downside. Traders should watch for a potential test of deeper support levels if the 22,500–22,750 zone fails to hold.

body.title: Road Trip, Hizan - Yolalan Road, Türkiye
body.body: Traveling in the middle of summer might not always be the smartest idea. Long car journeys and hot weather can be overwhelming. Luckily, our destination wasn't too far. _Yaz mevsiminin ortalarında gezi yapmak için çok akıllıca olmayabilir bazen. Uzun süren araba yolculuğu, sıcaklık bunalmaya neden oluyor. Neyse ki gideceğimiz yer çok uzak değildi._

/> Our journey is from Hizan district to Yolalan town in Bitlis. I took all the photos while driving. Hizan is a place with a lower altitude compared to the city center. Due to its special location and heavy rainfall, a significant amount of hazelnuts are grown here. After the Black Sea region, this is the largest hazelnut producing area. _Yolculuğumuz Hizan ilçesinden Bitlis'e bağlı Yolalan beldesine doğru. Tüm fotoğrafları araba seyir halinde iken çektim. Hizan il merkezine oranla rakımı düşük bir yer. Özel konumu, yoğun yağışı nedeniyle burada ciddi oranda fındık yetişir. Karadeniz bölgesinden sonra fındık en çok burada üretilir._

/> Hizan is located at a fairly low altitude. As we travel along the road, we climb towards the mountains. We climbed from an altitude of 1450 meters to 2000 meters. It's a challenging road; in winter, with heavy snowfall, vehicles get stranded. _Hizan oldukça alçakta yer alıyor. Yolda ilerlerken dağlara doğru tırmanıyoruz. 1450 metre rakımdan 2000 metre yükseltiye doğru tırmandık. Zorlu bir yol kış mevsiminde yoğun kar yağışında araçlar yolda mahsur kalıyor._

/> After climbing the challenging path, it's now time to descend. Every difficult path has beautiful things waiting for us at the end. The photos turn out better because the sunlight is clearer. The clouds are so close, almost as if they're touching the mountains. _Zorlu yolu tırmandıktan sonra şimdi de iniş vakti. Her zorlu yolun sonunda bizi bekleyen güzel şeyler var. Güneş ışınları daha net olduğu için fotoğraflar daha güzel çıkıyor. Bulutlar çok yakınımızda sanki dağlarla bitişik gibiler._

/> We're going downhill. We come across all kinds of vehicles. There weren't this many cars before. People start buying cars as soon as they save up a little money. _Aşağıya doğru iniyoruz. Karşımıza her türlü araç çıkıyor. Önceleri bu kadar araç yoktu. İnsanlar küçük birikim yaptıktan sıonra hemen araba almaya başlıyor._

/> After a challenging climb and descent, we arrived at the town of Yolalan. Yolalan is a flat, lowland area. Agriculture and livestock farming are the main sources of income for the region. There are large areas available for farming and livestock breeding. The only problem for the region seems to be healthcare services. It is 16 km from Hizan, 62 km from Bitlis, and 36 km from Tatvan. Traveling 62 km to access the best healthcare services is a major disadvantage for them. _Zorlu tırmanış, inişten sonra Yolalan beldesine geldik. Yolalan beldesi dümdüz, ovalık bir alan. Tarım ve hayvancılık bölgenin gelir kaynağı. Taırm ve hayvancılık yapmak için geniş alanlar mevcut. Bölge için tek sorun sağlık hizmetleri gözüküyor. Hizan'a 16 km, Bitlis'e 62 km, Tatvan'a 36 km mesafede. En iyi sağlık hizmeti için 62 km ilerlemek gerekiyor, onlar adına büyük dezavantaj._

/>

After the town of Yolalan, there is the village of Yolcular. From Yolcular village, if you go right, you will reach Tatvan, and if you go left, you will reach Bitlis. We chose the Bitlis road. I will share this journey with you in a few days.

_Yolalan beldesinden sonra Yolcular köyü var. Yolcular köyünden sağa doğru giderseniz Tatvan, sola doğru giderseniz Bitlis'e doğru gidersiniz. Bitlis yolunu tercih ettik. Bir kaç sün sonra bu yolculuğu sizlerle paylaşacağım._

body.title: Ein bisschen Schnee 👹🍣🎎 Mein Japan
body.body: ![IMG_9286.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EoK6itGc7DhMd37zesxN5mGntzKY2sQEqmzgxHUkCHhqStmyPMwanNiCwwP9puw8SJb.JPG) Auch im Sommer, der hier in Japan außerordentlich heiß und schwül werden kann, wird man desöfteren daran erinnert, dass es in diesem Land auch noch andere Jahreszeiten gibt. Und gerade der Winter steht wettermäßig in starkem Kontrast zu dem, was wir in diesen Wochen draußen erleben. Insbesondere die nördlichen Regionen sind im Winter ziemlich schneesicher, was für die einen vielleicht ein Segen sein mag, für viele andere aber oft eher ein großer Fluch ist. Denn gerade im Nordwesten Japans, in den Regionen am Japanischen Meer schneit es oft mehr, als einem lieb sein kann. In diesen Tagen mag diese kalte und schneereiche Jahreszeit zwar weg sein, aber ein kürzlicher Museumsbesuch hatte uns dann schnell daran erinnert, dass es letztlich ja doch nur einige Monate sind, die uns bleiben, bevor es draußen nicht mehr sonnig blau, sondern verschneit und grau sein wird. Und dass die Leichtigkeit, die einen in der letzten Zeit manchmal verwöhnt hat, dann einem ganz anderen Lebensstil weichen muss. Nun ja, glücklicherweise gibt es in der heutigen Zeit einige Hilfsmittel, die den Winter erträglicher und angenehmer machen. Angefangen von besseren Heizungen, welche in Japan aber noch viel Raum zur Optimierung bieten, bis zu industriellen Möglichkeit der Schneeräumung. Den letztendlich ist es nicht die Kälte, sondern es sind die Schneemassen, welche den Menschen im Norden das Leben schwer machen können. ![IMG_9285.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23wMeXvE8MtKSV5kqDhrTjuejdPMumA2b4yA6KxQm6yLA1yjApy3xzxUym8JUsi4BZ5gF.JPG) Ich habe uns mal ein Bild von einem Diorama mitgebracht. Dieses zeigt eine verschneite Straße in einer japanischen Kleinstadt, wobei die Schneemassen gewaltig sind. Auch wenn man es kaum glauben mag, aber so hat es bis vor fünfzig oder sechzig Jahren in vielen Städten ausgesehen, bevor es Schneepflüge und Schneeräumfahrzeuge gab. Die Straßen sehen wie Schneeschluchten aus, während auf den Dächern rund ein Meter Schnee liegt. In unserer Szene sind die Menschen damit beschäftigt, den Schnee von den Dächern zu räumen oder ihn auf die Straße hinunterzubefördern, wo er dann aufgeschichtet liegen blieb. In der Mitte oben auf diesem Schneeberg gibt es einen kleinen Pfad, auf der sich die Menschen hin- und herbewegen können, wobei sie sich dabei auf der Hähe des ersten Stockes befinden. Die Mengen an Schnee, die hier gezeigt werden, sind schon beeindruckend und machen deutlich, wie schwierig das Leben in solchen Regionen im Winter werden kann. Links und rechts der Straße gibt es vor den Häusern kleine Vordächer, die Gangi (雁木). genannt werden, und die an vielen Gebäuden in den traditionellen Schneeregionen Japans angebaut wurden. Die Dächer der Häuser werden dabei so weit nach vorne verlängert, dass entlang der Straße ein zusammenhängender überdachter Weg entsteht. Der Zweck dieser Bauweise war es, den Bewohnern auch während der schneereichen Winter ein sicheres Fortbewegen zu ermöglichen. Während sich auf den Straßen meterhohe Schneewände auftürmten, konnten die Menschen unter dem Gangi geschützt vor Schnee und Eis von Haus zu Haus, zu Geschäften oder zum Markt gelangen. In einigen Städten bildeten die Gangi oft kilometerlange zusammenhängende Wege, die nur ab und zu von Kreuzungen und Straßenmündungen unterbrochen worden. Da diese aber meist voller Schnee lagen, gab es dort oft einen kleinen Tunnel, der durch den Schnee gegraben wurde. In der heutigen Zeit wird der Schnee meist industriell geräumt und liegt nicht mehr meterhoch zwischen den Häusern auf der Straße, aber in früheren Zeiten muss das wirklich ein toller Anblick gewesen sein. Zumindest für den, der nicht unmittelbar von diesen Schneemassen betroffen war. Aber Szenen wie diese machen deutlich, welche wichtige Rolle diese Architektur für das tägliche Leben spielte. Ohne die Gangi wären viele Wege im Winter nur schwer oder gar nicht nutzbar gewesen, was dann wohl sehr oft außerhalb solcher Ortschaften der Fall war. Heute schneit es zwar in einigen Teilen Japans immer noch sehr viel, aber die Menschen haben glücklicherweise ein paar neue Hilfsmittel, um die Straßen und Wege freizuhalten. Aber auf die Dächer müssen sie manchmal trotzdem noch, denn so ein Meter Schnee auf dem Dach kann die Statik auch neuerer Holzhäuser dann doch beeinträchtigen. Der Winter mag teilweise seinen großen Schrecken verloren haben, aber immer noch sind sich die Menschen hier in Japan bewusst, dass man mit der Natur nicht spaßen sollte. Was jedes Jahr wieder von Neuem bewiesen wird... ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

body.title: 夏季水果种类多
body.body:
![img_20260614_160027-fc3b60dc137b.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/carolin77/lkt-mr0d1a0d-c4gpq1r2/img_20260614_160027-fc3b60dc137b.webp)

![img_20260614_160030-e74d938531e4.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/carolin77/lkt-mr0d1a0d-c4gpq1r2/img_20260614_160030-e74d938531e4.webp)

![img_20260614_160041-7a8ae3d97455.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/carolin77/lkt-mr0d1a0d-c4gpq1r2/img_20260614_160041-7a8ae3d97455.webp)

![img_20260614_160130-4a9b3c106370.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/carolin77/lkt-mr0d1a0d-c4gpq1r2/img_20260614_160130-4a9b3c106370.webp)

![img_20260614_155919-670f7437757b.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/carolin77/lkt-mr0d1a0d-c4gpq1r2/img_20260614_155919-670f7437757b.webp)

夏天水果真是多，层出不穷，吃不完根本吃不完，这个吃了那个又上市了，那个吃完另外一个也想吃…当然了，我还是很羡慕广东广西的小伙伴，那水果真是便宜啊，而且种类更多，想想都美哉…

上海的梅雨季节今年来的稍晚了些，但也不至于下一个月的雨吧，就一天天晴，属于是下累了，休息一天，然后继续下雨。阳台上的衣服压根晒不干，看着干了，手摸上去就是那种软趴趴的，年年如此，今年更甚。

空气的湿度已经超过90%，有时候没办法我只能家里空调开除湿来给衣服吹干，我想如果我能进化的话，现在差不多可以长腮了，在这样的气候条件下，不长腮可惜了。得亏我给我娃多备了几套夏季衣服，不然真没换洗的了。

今天又是下雨，趁下雨间隙我们到水果店买个西瓜，我们到的是佳农店，对面是百果园，百果园比佳农贵一些，品质我感觉都差不多，也不好说 要分什么水果，但是价格上是佳农这个店铺要便宜一丢的，品控说实话也是百果园好一点。

比如我今天买的阳光玫瑰，买的时候是好的，冷藏室拿出来也没看出什么问题，回家洗的时候才发现一半都是软的，真想拿回去退了，我儿子说也不是不能吃，结果他吃一点就不吃了，还是我给消灭掉的。

但是西瓜好像就无所谓，还是很甜，至于是哪里的西瓜我也不知道，好吃就行，我只知道我百果园买的麒麟瓜每次都很甜，甘美4k也很甜。西瓜我还是喜欢在佳农买的，每次都能给我切四分之一，哈哈。

title.title: Probably totally dead
title.body:
>

Have you ever killed something that didn't want to be killed? I have, many times actually. 

The Brisbane Broncos did also, last weekend when they played the Sydney Roosters. What did they kill? Well, they killed their season. 

Ok, it's not *totally dead* but to make the final eight and play in the finals they need to win eight of their remaining nine regular season games and with the competition they face, and the way they've been playing, it seems incredibly unlikely. 

Here's their results all year including last week's game against the Roosters. 

- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (0) V's Penrith Panthers (26) - What the fuck.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (32) Vs Paramatta Eels (40) - What the fucking fuck.
- Win: Brisbane Broncos (18) V's Melbourne Storm (14) - A solid comeback win.
- Win: Brisbane Broncos (26) V's Dolphins (12) - The momentum builds.
- Win: Brisbane Broncos (26) V's Gold Coast Titans (12) - A win but worrying injuries.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (31) V's North Queensland Cowboys (35) - Tough game they should have won.
- Win: Brisbane Broncos (21) V's Wests Tigers (20) - A one point win - I'll take it.
- Win: Brisbane Broncos Win: (32) V's Canterbury-Bankstown Bulldogs (12) - A dominant display.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (24) V's Sydney Roosters (38) An epic loss despite such effort.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (4) V's Manly-Warringah Sea Eagles (32) - I'm not fucken happy.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (12) V's New Zealand Warriors (42) - A lack of discipline cost the Broncos.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (26) V's St. George Illawarra Dragons (30) - I don't even know what to say.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (23) V's Gold Coast Titans (28) - A season ending loss? (Possibly)
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (6) V's South Sydney Rabbitohs (48) - I have no words.
- Loss: Brisbane Broncos (18) V's Sydney Roosters (24) - Entertaining game - Likely a  season-ending loss

**Upcoming game:**

Brisbane Broncos V's Cronulla-Sutherland Sharks

Mathematically the Broncos can still make the finals but their form has been terrible leaving them in 13th place on the ladder with the Cronulla Sharks in good form and sitting 8th. A tough game ahead I think.

title.body:

![gxMXwb7uYx3Ghhtc_IMG_8550.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/gxMXwb7uYx3Ghhtc_IMG_8550/gxMXwb7uYx3Ghhtc_IMG_8550.webp)
![XPejqSs3egA65no5_IMG_8553.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/XPejqSs3egA65no5_IMG_8553/XPejqSs3egA65no5_IMG_8553.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

从洛伽寺回到民宿已经是晚上7点多，体力全都耗光了，完全不想去餐厅吃饭，干脆点份外卖送到民宿，再买点水果，在露台上吹吹风也挺好。

我们俩都不太吃得惯泉州的美食，味道偏清淡，鲜味儿却很重。我本身就不太爱吃海鲜，于是点了云南米线和三样水果，吃完特别满足。后来吧台小哥还邀我们进去喝了两杯，微醺一下正好睡觉！

晚上才买下前往平潭的往返动车票。原本打算租车，但我俩很少开高速，又担心遇到宰客，干脆选择坐动车。虽然路上折腾些，但起码更安全。

当天往返平潭路程很远，没有合适的直达列车，需要到福州中转，来回要四个多小时，这还没算从民宿打车到泉州南站的时间。我们住在老城区，离车站、机场都不近，车程基本半小时起步。幸好没有拖家带口，不然肯定累坏！

我们早上6点就起床，不到7点打车出门，上午10点多才抵达平潭。这趟车上乘客不多，下车上完厕所，整个接送区就只剩我和朋友两个人。

又是没提前做攻略的一天，随手搜了路线，决定第一站先去北港村。一下车我直接傻眼了，周边格外荒凉，看不到人群聚集的地方，连商贩都没有，只有租电瓶车的摊位和一处公交站台。我一下子丈二和尚摸不着头脑，完全不知道接下来该往哪走。偏偏风还很大，潮湿的风直往脸上扑，闷得人难受。

这时来了一班公交车，我们没多想就直接上车，让司机师傅往前开。看到站点标注着“最美环岛路”，索性就在这里下车逛逛。

听说这里是观赏风车的绝佳点位，可当天阳光被乌云遮住，海面雾蒙蒙的，拍出来的照片全是灰调。路上还总遇到招揽拍照、推销摩托艇项目的当地人。我感觉这边开发得还不够成熟，配套设施不完善，各个景点之间距离也太远。

title.title: A Father's Day I Wish I Had, and A Birthday Worth Celebrating
title.body:
Hello Hivers!

This week was a special one because we celebrated my husband's 44th birthday, and at the same time it was also Father's Day. We didn't prepare anything expensive, but we still enjoyed the day together as a family. Sometimes simple celebrations are the ones we remember the most.

![2476.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23uR5G6BwRgjfE2tjCrzK5hPMGzRFBbVLJWXSEnvj4qdCURjTeru6oXnrUaeqJaxcA3VE.jpg)

We bought a small cake from Goldilocks and spent the afternoon at home. My husband even agreed to take lots of pictures with us. That is already something special because he is not really the type who likes taking selfies. The kids were very happy, especially our youngest who kept sitting on his shoulders while we were laughing and making funny faces.

![2482.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23y8sisuL9sXqMZiLk9sNxJmrUT1nKiCA68JxFw1G5G78MvWmtHhrZXNDwh32ZPbnjLaV.jpg)

One thing that made me really thankful this year was that my husband decided not to drink with his friends. Usually birthdays are celebrated that way, but this time he stayed with us instead. For me, that was already the best gift for our children. They had their father beside them the whole day, and I know those memories will stay with them as they grow up.

<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23wqnwyF1V9bE9UkQFjKF41ezLWXNBEaGfbmaycDY6fhNAgrXKMWGEu43uQy7D8zQAkum.jpg His mother also cooked pansit for his birthday. As our tradition, I shared some with our neighbors. I always believe that celebrations become more meaningful when we also share our blessings with others, even if it is only a simple meal. Watching my husband with our children made me think about my own life. Because I was adopted, I grew up asking about my father. Every time I asked my adoptive mother where he was, she would simply tell me that he was working. I believed that answer for many years and kept waiting, wondering when he would finally come home. As I grew older, I slowly realized that I might never know him. I don't even know his real name or what he looked like. Sometimes I wonder if we have the same smile or if I got some of my personality from him. Those are questions that may never be answered, but they still cross my mind once in a while. Maybe that is why I always tell myself that no matter what happens between me and my husband, I want our children to know their father. They know his strengths, his weaknesses, his funny side, and even the times when he makes mistakes. They have memories with him, and I think that is something very precious. Life is not perfect, and neither are we. But seeing my family together on this simple birthday reminded me that love is not always about expensive gifts or big parties. Sometimes it is just about being present, sharing a meal, taking silly pictures, and creating memories that our children will carry forever. ![2269.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23tvijH7oReGnCYGMvKxxKyHpBGAundvth9hv2oZcgtqmFimq1nka46bkTYKEfGmfZSJs.jpg) Our youngest daughter Ria made this for his father. To my husband Happy 44th Birthday, and Happy Father's Day to all the dads who continue doing their best every single day. *Thank you for reading my post* *@usagigallardo015*

title.title: Falling Clothes And Fleeting Trends: How I Left The Chase Behind — LOH #295
title.body:
Well, I've had quiet a lot of embarrassing moments in my life, and in all honesty most of those moments aren't in any way funny. I mean most of them end up leaving me feeling bad and at times cry. But then, there's this particular one that still makes me laugh anytime I remember it. I don't know why it makes me smile, because it is not that funny,but then I find myself laughing each time I think about it.


![1001196789.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23wrA5LL3KQvMv8JdiF4hfumXcrgicQ9K7iG3XeHJMrf6wVpQs4WJswyyeYp5bQApEQCb.png)


The incident happened when I was till in junior secondary school. It was a Monday morning and I had to rush to school, the day before which was a Sunday I had spoilt my belt while trying to fix it. So, I just picked up another cloth and wore it to church. I have it in mind to tell mum to get me another or to find a way to fix that so I can use it till she gets another for me. But then, I forgot. It was after I had dressed up for school and wanted to use a belt on my trousers that I remembered.



Well, I had to ongo to school. So I spent the whole day in class, I couldn't step out, anytime I need to stand up or do something I would hold my trousers with one hand so it wouldn't fall off. Then during one of the class stuffs and arguments and all, a teacher entered and I didn't notice. Everyone had kept mute except me. So, he called me out totbhe front of the class, I stylishly walked out and stood next to him.


That was how he ordered me to face the board and raise both hands up. I quickly told him I was having issues with my belt and can't leave my trousers. But I guess he didn't understand me, maybe he thought I was giving excuses and trying to avoid punishment, so he repeated what he asked me to do, this time with a frown on his face.


So, I obeyed. Immediately I raised my hands up, and my trousers gave way and slid down in front of the whole class. For what seems like a second everyone was silent. Then as if being controlled/ordered everyone erupted in laughter. Even the teacher couldn't hold his laughter. I was embarrassed that day. I felt really bad, I wished the ground would open and swallow me up. The only thing I'm happy about and maybe makes me smile anytime I remember is how I was wearing one of my newest boxers.




Also, about if I'm a fashion person. I would say once upon a time I was. Yes. There was a time I love to wear designers and I get myself almost everything and anything. I remember buying Gucci from head to toe back then, I did the same for off-white too and a few other popular designers. Anytime something comes out, I just want to be a part of it.



![1001196827.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23wCWrFHaCo3zEo7tumS62bTkquKm8RkzFh7Cn6xnwMQd6zmVWdnJmPbxLCg177bzbtsP.png)



He said it in Yoruba which was our native language, but the interpretation of what he said in English is that, *\

*


It was as simple as that, that was how my thinking changed, and since then I've stopped disturbing myself about following trends or wearing designers. Now, I wear what I like, I wear what I feel like wearing, I wear what makes me feel comfortable. As long as it's neat, it fits, and I'm comfortable in it, then I'm good to go. There's nothing wrong with fashion, I love it, I've just stopped chasing it. I like my peace.




🌹

title.title: DAO DEC Report 30/06
title.body:
It is the end of month 2 of DAO management and the day before the new vouchers and the land pack sales kick off, so a pretty good time to do another report.

In the 2 months since the DAO took over the credits.for.dec account about 744m DEC was sold, which is about 12m a day, which seems to be a relatively stable average now, which is actually not great, because the lower DEC price is counteracted by less credit spending. We are well on track that the credits.for.dec account needs to be restocked with DEC in July, but there is a good chance that a bunch of DEC will come back to the DAO through the land pack sale.

The average daily DEC income of the DAO picked up quite a lot and is now 626k, which is an increase of about 60k. The majority of which are still escalation packs. Since the increase in DEC spending by the DAO increased more the DAO now loses about 11.4m DEC a day.

The average daily DEC mint from burning SPS is about 80k DEC, so less is burned but it is still completely insignificant.

DEC burn details:
|account|total_since_2026_01_01|avg_daily|
|-|-|-|
|LP_FEES|35.873k|199k|
|$GUILD_STORE|269k|2k|
|$MARKET_LIST_FEE|0|0|
|$ENERGY|10.904k|61k|
|$WILD_PASS|37.114k|206k|
|$UNBIND_ACCOUNT|13.405k|125k|
|$UNBIND_BURN|3.793k|21k|
|$RANKED_PASS|1.386k|8k|
|$SHOP|16.904k|94k|
|$MARKET_BURN_FEE|51.859k|288k|
|$RENTAL_BURN_FEE|0|0|
|$TOKEN_RENTAL_FEE|37k|0|
|$TOKEN_RENTAL_BURN_FEE|702k|4k|
|$LAND_GRAIN_AUTOPURCHASE|0|0|
|$LAND_TC_DECBURN|517k|3k|
|$LAND_POWER_CORE_PURCHASE|5.667k|32k|
|$LAND_GRAIN_PURCHASE|0|0|
|TOTAL|178.431k|1.042k|

The burns are a bit less but still stable at about 1m DEC a day. Keep in mind the API still doesn't allow reading of all accounts, so it is likely more. With regard to the DAOs daily obligations, which comes 5500 USD per day or, at course of 0.000240 for DEC, 22.9m DEC the burn would equate to 4.3%. By not burning the DEC the DAO could reduce its daily net negative for DEC by 8.6%.

For credits the average mint per day is 3.746k, so 3746 USD a day average income for the DAO. It went down quite a bit recently, primarily the secondary market spending went down by about 300 USD to about 2.7k USD. This means the DAO is about 1.8k short of its daily obligations.

Note that the numbers would be significantly worse 2 days ago when the DEC price went down to 0.225, but a recent uptick to 0.24 skewed it a bit more positively. This is probably due to some early stocking up on DEC for the land packs.

The TL:DR:
- The DEC course is stabilizing a bit, probably due to the imminent land pack sale.
- Credit spending went down quite a lot, primarily secondary market sales in credits went down by about 10% in June.
- About 750m DEC was sold by the DAO in 2 months with the avg daily spending stabilizing around 12m. This puts the runway pre land pack sale to 50 days for liquid, 180 days if touching the last reserves (which would likely send DEC well below 0.2)
- Burns are still stable around 1m DEC a day and still do absolutely nothing other than making the DAO run out of DEC faster.

title.title: [카일의 수다#889] 일본 생활 필수품, 마이넘버 카드와 첫 병원비 환급 도전
title.body:
![IMG_0651.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZaeMxAGXu18qFC1v4yomXpwVBxMti5vtdjLD4e82ypTV/IMG_0651.jpeg)


일본에서 생활을 시작하면 가장 많이 듣게 되는 말 중 하나가 “마이넘버 카드 만드셨나요?”다.

처음에는 우리나라 주민등록증 정도로 생각했는데, 사용처는 훨씬 다양하다. 신분증은 물론이고 건강보험증으로 등록하거나 각종 행정 서비스를 이용하고, 편의점에서 주민표 같은 서류를 발급받을 때도 사용한다. 일본에서 오래 생활한다면 거의 필수 카드라고 할 수 있다.

얼마 전 치과에 갔을 때는 치료비를 전액 부담해야 했다. 입사한 지 얼마 되지 않아 회사 건강보험 정보가 아직 시스템에 반영되지 않았기 때문이다.

보험 등록이 완료되면 차액은 환급받을 수 있다고 한다. 같은 달이라면 병원에서 바로 정산해 주는 경우가 많지만, 월이 넘어가면 건강보험을 통해 별도의 환급 절차를 거쳐야 해 조금 더 번거롭다고 한다.

그래서 마이넘버 카드를 발급받자마자 병원으로 달려갔다.

그런데 또 사용할 수가 없었다.

카드를 발급받았다고 바로 건강보험증으로 사용할 수 있는 것이 아니라, 회사의 건강보험 정보와 마이넘버 카드가 연동되는 데까지 며칠에서 2~3주 정도 시간이 걸릴 수 있다고 한다.

등록 여부는 앱에서도 확인할 수 있다는데, 문제는 처음 카드를 만들 때 설정한 비밀번호가 기억나지 않는다는 것. 두 번이나 틀려 잠길까 봐 일단 후퇴했다.

다행히 회사에서는 건강보험 등록이 완료되었다는 연락이 왔다.

오늘은 영수증을 들고 다시 병원으로 가보려 한다.

과연 이번에는 무사히 환급을 받을 수 있을까.

일본 생활은 아직 서툴지만, 이런 행정 절차 하나까지도 직접 겪어 보니 조금씩 익숙해지는 기분이다. 이런 경험들이 쌓이면 언젠가는 자연스럽게 “일본에서 사는 일상”이 되어 있지 않을까.

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: June 30 2026
title.body:
Ever have one of those days where the steps just quietly add up without you noticing? The morning started the way I’ve grown to enjoy—an easy walk while the streets were still calm, followed by a light jog and a few simple exercises to wake the body up. There was no rush and no pressure to hit a certain pace. Just moving, breathing, and enjoying a peaceful start before the day got busy. Once work and daily tasks took over, I tried not to stay glued to my chair for too long. A short walk after lunch helped break up the afternoon, and another after dinner became a nice way to unwind. Those little breaks have become something I genuinely look forward to—they're less about chasing steps and more about giving myself a reset. By the end of the day, I looked at my tracker and smiled: 16k steps. The funny thing is, the biggest changes in my routine haven’t come from doing more. They’ve come from doing the simple things consistently. A walk here, a jog there, a few minutes of movement when I could have stayed seated. It doesn’t feel like much in the moment, but over time, those choices add up. What’s one small habit that’s made a bigger difference in your life than you expected? #actifit #morningwalk #jogging #dailymovement #activelifestyle

After a compromised attempt led to a fatal ambush, I restarted with a disciplined approach. I successfully thinned their ranks until an unexpected game crash halted my progress for the day. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTf9Mb8Zzy3Py7YjTHPRfqwvYKNp2sBzZCY256cvY2XJ4/screenshot_1_.png) It was time to take care of the Seraphites in that village, but the first thing I noticed was that peoples, the villagers, left their houses with their stoves on, the lingering smoke suggesting they had fled only moments prior. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZm7xh2pxUxoD8ezpqEEWgDCHyHuf5V4k5VaGDecaXm7s/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcPkyg7Sphkyp9krkg6yBMo4tmhHC7AJBp1WnwjKSuJNZ/screenshot_3_.png) Well, then we went out and noticed there were a handful of Seraphites checking around for us. Though they didn't see us yet, moving cautiously through the overgrown pathways with their bows drawn. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU33j3XTCpvrCcb6vSxEhm4enSZriMkJpDucrM4cqA3kz/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV69S59sMbYH8JVgJ47GK64CZtfuDYNQz33KdEMwpHYkx/screenshot_5_.png) I waited for that man to come close, and when he did, I just grabbed him from the shadow and I took him down in stealth, dragging his body back into the tall ferns to avoid alerting the nearby scouts. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbFfjuV1xTQRRYGfxeae4d38m6ZyFKi1ZGMS1kTRS82Hm/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV3hfKxBFioDLFqNomciNuLjMQtEuV4j49AWQQGgGj95q/screenshot_7_.png) Then I went for another Seraphite who was guarding another side. And when I decided to do it quietly, another one saw me and shot me right away, the sharp crack of a rifle echoing through the quiet settlement. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfLH2kHKPQM28WdY8WLXWJ9yRJcMK6xDzFpBGAAN6czre/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSPSQGMJde4fM9CAWoL14dsq58VoG5hRfSMdz6eVEpktB/screenshot_9_.png) Knowing my stealth already blew up, I started shooting them with my shotguns, pivoting quickly toward the nearest threat to regain control of the engagement. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfNy4cYdzAAjQ9KthZfyCJJB1Es8vWp7DVNv82Ls5sJ7T/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXEunNKAyx3FAUzCUBWZs6tv61htaQYFV1qt7Ly99gfzQ/screenshot_11_.png) And I was using mostly flame rounds that was not taking them down instantly, but burning them up. I had to be careful as more of them were coming. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWrfr68S68848RBm27tsptL6oH8ojyin1rhSEP5gMSZhS/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcoW4FQDHnLeHzasDXqbzeEtfi9FALrzM4HLHfSeAXZc4/screenshot_13_.png) Then suddenly, this heavy Seraphite with a heavy axe found me and was attacking me. And at the same time, another Seraphite joined the duel, cornering me against the wooden wall of a triangle house. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVg7tfxKp57mf3sekrY8qsfb6AtF4Go6H29jv2JrKgV4w/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmahQok8c54s5UqLdLYLGyRYQb19F2SxjkcWMQQSVkuaEw/screenshot_15_.png) Before I could dodge their attacks, one of them grabbed me from behind, and the other one was about to smash me with the big axe. But I somehow managed to escape them, just to get shot and die at the next moment. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgtJgyQhzBYopetYjoLtcLMTxKQKXHtvaK7462qP5yU5/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUqsV3CLSvwBAe5fmG9RsfBedxN1zonQrABqUAGQpPmcb/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmahkALnQKWWcsSQEJ2Gqzf6PSNhrukkUSGpmDACZtjMKd/screenshot_18_.png) I made sure to keep it stealth at the next try. And as I already knew the movements of some of them, I was doing good so far, in taking those down, them down one by one, silently, utilizing the dense vegetation to mask my advance. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW5Rg3vSKEobeHzPaMDmMcHUM6J63CnZGZcdkQTky6Vox/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWsGzTJsHQ1UKLiLreTL18M4EPUwan3X5w4ws4YUuuECu/screenshot_20_.png) Then, one of them saw me suddenly when I was going for him. And I shot him down using my silencer gun. And I waited for the heavy sniper, who started looking around for us. And when I was using the photo mode to check around, the game crashed, and I quit playing for the day. We'll check what happens next in another post. --- Image Source: In game screenshots. End of the post. Peace. --- ▶ [Watch on 3speak.tv](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=bong1011/home-of-seraphites-68)

title.title: Rich menú, carrot and Scamorza frittata and green beans/Menú completo: frittata de zanahoria y Scamorza, y judías verdes.
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT5zPWAqf1gHLUtaPeVuLjqhVqsRqJQ2yJjSFRaJzdSyk/1782803542526.jpg)

Good morning, blog friends—how are you? We’re still battling heatwaves here, but that hasn't dampened our appetites! So, here I am to share yesterday’s menu with you: a delicious frittata with carrots, scamorza cheese, and green beans! For this dish, you’ll need:

 * 3 carrots
 * 6 eggs
 * 50 grams of scamorza cheese 
* 400 grams of canned green beans 
* 6 tablespoons of oil 
* 6 tablespoons of fine salt
 * 3 tablespoons of thyme

 Let’s start with the frittata: begin by peeling the carrots and slicing them into thin rounds. Next, prepare a pot of water; once it’s boiling, cook the carrots for about twenty minutes. In the meantime, take the scamorza cheese and cut it into small pieces.

🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡

Buenos días, amigos del blog: ¿cómo están? Aquí seguimos lidiando con olas de calor, ¡pero eso no nos ha quitado el apetito! Así que aquí estoy para compartir con ustedes el menú de ayer: ¡una deliciosa frittata con zanahorias, queso scamorza y judías verdes! Para este plato necesitarán: 

* 3 zanahorias
 * 6 huevos 
* 50 gramos de queso scamorza 
* 400 gramos de judías verdes en conserva 
* 6 cucharadas de aceite 
* 6 cucharadas de sal fina
 * 3 cucharadas de tomillo 

Empecemos con la frittata: primero, pelen las zanahorias y córtenlas en rodajas finas. A continuación, pongan agua a calentar en una olla y, cuando hierva, cuezan las zanahorias durante unos veinte minutos. Mientras tanto, corten el queso scamorza en trozos pequeños.




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdk1zG7ETkWkKbFKiCK9DYSY6WE7E7THoxbN6pqt8AcGC/1782803542686.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZYk3jEPkHcsoX64isMCivmeHZDsMtcPA1ZgXzTaX2z57/1782803542953.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNjgj6ihQkuPfKjcGqwQt1VVnqtfFDWxEc9XB6CduHM5A/1782803543185.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUQyNvPdif29AKkbFnfSPpgsRQPQ1PtSusHUfuV67vjHk/1782803543421.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVcPRBEW6NVdYjS72ZxsXLSaYpwusKJvehaWSRF7qAwLU/1782803568924.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV4mBmogXNzCRtWn4JiAC2KbndniGbJSgJWMcjH6fQy6j/1782803569132.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX5HE7b8YpSkXUtadF1VQdH3edriSa8VyroaF5gYyVwgn/1782803569349.jpg)



Next, prepare a large frying pan with three tablespoons of oil; drain the canned green beans and cook them for about ten minutes, stirring frequently. Once the carrots are ready, prepare the frittata: add three tablespoons of oil to a pan, crack in the eggs, and cook over low heat. Add the carrots and stir for three minutes, then add the scamorza cheese and stir again. 

Finally, add the thyme and cook for about ten minutes. Your frittata will then be ready, accompanied by the green beans—a simple and tasty meal!

🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡🟡

A continuación, prepara una sartén grande con tres cucharadas de aceite; escurre las judías verdes en conserva y cocínalas durante unos diez minutos, removiendo con frecuencia. Una vez listas las zanahorias, prepara la frittata: añade tres cucharadas de aceite a una sartén, casca los huevos y cocínalos a fuego lento. Incorpora las zanahorias y remueve durante tres minutos; después, añade el queso scamorza y vuelve a remover. 

Por último, agrega el tomillo y cocina durante unos diez minutos. Tu frittata estará lista para servir acompañada de las judías verdes: ¡una comida sencilla y deliciosa!

title.title: SocialProgrammingError.
title.body:
While you are young or a child, honesty and rigidity come off the charts. Just true to self, and that goes on to be respected and loved and looked back on as beautiful memories.  Slowly, as we grow up, the deviation tends to happen in looking more for an outer viewpoint towards oneself. And that level of acknowledgement is maturity, or a falsely presented utopian feeling of existence.  In any form, most of the societal perspective is drawn to what is called 'nice' and 'bad', which is based on what is presented to them. The reality and presentation can have a great deviation; this gap is where our social programming fails. 
Ever wondered why some old people are rude? (or at least from a societal perspective)
Because they know things, have been through, seen things that we haven't. The checks and measures are so many that in some terms either resembles the deviation they perceived, saw, or understood. 
However, in the present world, sweetness is a new dopamine that should exist because the world has been turned cruel. Understandable, but how this has been twisted and infiltrated with a presentation of sweetness, which is just a show.

body.title: Reisefertig für Oberwiesenthal
body.body:
# Oberwiesenthal ruft: Die Motorräder werden reisefertig

![file_00000000089471f4b7524fe25f8401f1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXg3dissSkSNATcjYiB4XF55b1f4GtHVH3VEHVnXqwyg2/file_00000000089471f4b7524fe25f8401f1.png)

Der Urlaub rückt näher und langsam steigt die Vorfreude. Dieses Mal geht es für uns nach Oberwiesenthal.

Oberwiesenthal liegt in Sachsen, mitten im Erzgebirge und ganz in der Nähe der tschechischen Grenze. Viele kennen den Ort vor allem durch den Fichtelberg, den Wintersport und die schöne Berglandschaft. Für uns ist es aber vor allem ein schönes Ziel, um ein paar Tage mit den Motorrädern rauszukommen. Schöne Straßen, frische Luft, Berge und einfach mal Abstand vom Alltag.

Bevor es losgehen kann, mussten die Motorräder natürlich noch vorbereitet werden. Denn wenn Gepäck mit auf Tour geht, reicht es nicht, einfach nur die Taschen irgendwo anzubringen. Alles muss ordentlich sitzen, sicher halten und darf unterwegs nicht wackeln oder verrutschen.

![IMG_20260627_091216.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeY4mvQsNbYDzcDWKQQiw1HMrzakx83NYKKJhfwZFCBwJ/IMG_20260627_091216.jpg)


Also ging es erst einmal in die Garage. Die Halterungen wurden angebaut, angepasst und kontrolliert. Nach und nach wird aus dem normalen Motorrad wieder ein kleiner Reisebegleiter. Genau diese Vorbereitungen gehören für mich schon irgendwie zum Urlaub dazu. Man ist noch nicht unterwegs, aber im Kopf fährt man schon die ersten Kilometer.

Ein Blick unter die Sitzbank zeigt dann auch schnell, dass vor so einer Reise doch immer mehr zusammenkommt, als man zuerst denkt. Werkzeug, Befestigungsmaterial und alles, was man unterwegs lieber dabeihat, auch wenn man es hoffentlich nicht braucht.


![IMG_20260627_092413.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUw6c8UY19Z2JqhmtGXpyd1AH9FRugQPCASMbV5ZbBJbU/IMG_20260627_092413.jpg)

![IMG_20260627_093019.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVM3UGTGvHPRVwGdP5BJK623vtpBG6TwvwyFzDQE2fodK/IMG_20260627_093019.jpg)

Natürlich durfte auch eine kleine Spielerei nicht fehlen. Wir haben einen kleinen roten Schuh am Seitenständer ausprobiert. Optisch sah das wirklich witzig aus. Irgendwie hatte es Charme, fast so, als hätte sich das Motorrad schon einmal für den Urlaub fein gemacht.

![IMG_20260627_094118.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQG5rGzXfKxhXkRQYntmRbNQVbGpFFRqwL1dzaQTMC7gf/IMG_20260627_094118.jpg)


Aber so schön die Idee auch war, sicher war das Ganze leider nicht. Der Schuh war etwas zu klein und saß nicht fest genug. Nach dem Foto wurde er deshalb direkt wieder entfernt. Manchmal ist eine Idee perfekt für ein Bild, aber eben nicht für die Straße.

Jetzt gehen die Vorbereitungen weiter. Die Motorräder bekommen noch ihren letzten Check, das Gepäck muss sortiert werden und dann kann es bald losgehen. Genau diese Phase kurz vor der Tour mag ich besonders. Die Planung ist fast abgeschlossen, die Maschinen stehen bereit und die Vorfreude wächst mit jedem Tag.

Wir freuen uns auf Oberwiesenthal, auf das Erzgebirge und auf ein paar Tage mit den Motorrädern. Wenn alles klappt, wird es eine schöne Mischung aus Fahren, Abschalten und einfach mal rauskommen.

Oberwiesenthal, wir kommen bald.

---

## English Summary

Our holiday is getting closer, and this time we are heading to Oberwiesenthal in the Ore Mountains, close to the Czech border.

Before the trip starts, the motorcycles had to be prepared for the luggage. The racks and mounting points were installed and checked, because everything needs to be safe and secure on the road.

We also tried a small fun detail: a tiny red shoe on the side stand. It looked really nice and funny, but it was not safe enough because the shoe was a bit too small. So after taking the photo, we removed it again.

Now the final preparations continue. The bikes need one last check, the luggage has to be sorted, and then we are ready for a few days of riding, relaxing and enjoying the Erzgebirge.

Oberwiesenthal, we are coming soon.

Your  
Hornet on Tour

![Hornet on Tour](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSJGyDcQZpQvWoF9nAg3QUKE7b8Xq1uyiSCdLuqq2hHp2/Michael%20der%20Knipser2.jpg)

![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g023efe32b59705fa1fe004aa03f524738754f01ba5ff9c7d6b822e41e797a145708a79cf9614ed3717baa138239b64a918c9ab88544296a1a31a1c943092c47a_640.jpg)
¡Hoy fue un día genial para caminar por la ciudad! Empecé mi recorrido en el parque central, donde vi a un grupo de personas practicando yoga al aire libre. Era inspirador ver cómo se conectaban con la naturaleza mientras se estiraban y respiraban profundamente. Hablé brevemente con una mujer llamada Clara, que me contó que lleva años haciendo yoga en ese lugar y que le encanta la comunidad que se ha formado. Continué mi camino y me encontré con un mercado local que vendía productos orgánicos. Allí conocí a un joven llamado Pablo, que tenía una pequeña tienda de frutas exóticas. Me ofreció probar una especie de fruta que nunca había visto antes, ¡y estaba deliciosa! Además, me dijo que cada semana trae algo nuevo para sorprender a sus clientes. A lo largo de mi caminata, también disfruté de los murales coloridos que adornan las paredes de los edificios, cada uno con una historia única que contar. La ciudad siempre tiene algo nuevo que ofrecer, y hoy fue un recordatorio perfecto de lo que significa explorar y conectarse con otros. ¡Sin duda, un día exitoso! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: Преображение
body.body:
/>

Привет, мой дорогой друг!

Сегодня я думаю об одиночестве.  
Нет, не потому что я одинока...  
Знаешь, мне, наоборот, иногда хочется побыть одной.

Ведь именно находясь в одиночестве, в тишине мы можем услышать внутренний голос.

Посмотри на гусеницу, ведь для того, чтобы пройти преображение, ей нужно какое-то время находиться в одиночестве, в коконе.Так и мне порой, чтобы превратиться в бабочку, нужно побыть в коконе.

Побыть один на один с Богом, один на один с самой с собой. Эти периоды необходимы для каждого, иногда нужно нажать на паузу, остановиться, задуматься, прислушаться и посмотреть на мир уже другими глазами. Не как гусеница, ползающая по земле, а как бабочка, которая летает, питается нектаром с цветов. Люди смотрят на неё, восхищаются её красотой и славят Творца за то, что Он так чудесно её сотворил.

Дорогой друг, если ты сейчас живёшь в «коконе», знай, этот период пройдёт. И ты превратишься в прекрасную бабочку, славящую своего Творца.

Есть время ожидания, терпения, надежды ...

Всему своё время, мой друг!

body.title: The Lost Art of Monotasking: Reclaiming Our Attention Span
body.body:
/>

We all live in a society that praises multi-tasking. We watch YouTube videos while texting, listen to podcasts while doing work, and read emails in between conversations. What we think is productivity is quite the opposite, according to psychology.

Our brain is not designed for completing several complex tasks at once. We are merely shifting our focus and leaving a trail of \

This process depletes mental resources, creates stress, and results in superficial outcomes.

To reclaim the ancient technique of mono-tasking, which implies doing one thing at once and giving it all of your attention, is a real superpower in today's society.

Here are the changes when you pay attention to only one thing:

Focus: You get into the flow state more quickly and remain there for longer.

Relaxation: Mental clutter fades when you stop managing multiple tasks at once.

Quality: Your performance becomes noticeably better and original.

body.title: LOH Community Contest #295 ~ Trends got nothing on me
body.body:
>

***Are you a fashion enthusiast? Do you follow trends, or do you simply wear what you like and what makes you feel comfortable?***
___
___
___

<center>![1011dad6f9b942438207a1cc04dfce49.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nwaadiaha/23xAkWZdQFZAEwdVXQSw8TPG1X4aGFvgL2eP58WtpgbcssEMatoVbaW78XZSoCayN99DD.jpg)</center>

The other day I was going through a fashion blog called Pinterest, I saw beautiful fashionably styles I loved and so I saved them with the hope to recreate them because of course it is my kind of stuff, but unfortunately, I couldn't, like I changed my mind because few days after saving it in my draft as a style to recreate I started seeing them around, people started wearing it, fashion houses started using it for content, and that was how i changed my mind and decided to go for something else. 

The funny thing is that I now have friends around me who are into fashion, so it even makes it more fun when I see something and discuss it with them and then we deliberate on the stuff and how to recreate it and all the shenanigans that come with styling.

In the last one year, I have bought wedding materials for an event but at the end of the day, I couldn't wear them to the event, because I didn't sew them, not that I do not want to sew them but that the styles I choose for myself, unfortunately the event material I bought wasn't enough to get it perfectly done, so instead of sewing what at the end of the day I may likely not wear, I choose to keep the material, till when I have something better and comfortable to make that the material will be enough to sew it with. 

I ended up wearing a pair of trousers and a white shirt to most of those events because I wanted to be comfortable, simple, and myself. I do not have to look like a girl, I do not want to dress a certain \

I wear what makes me feel like myself, even though it is simple, it can not be shabby, sophisticated, poised, and elegant because that's who I am, that's my personality. Even if I get my inspiration from trends, I will also tweak it to fit my personality, to fit what I can be comfortable in. ___ ___ ___ I can love trends but I can not follow trends because I am built differently when it comes to fashion, my taste for fashion, or my kind of fashion style isn't the way the fashion trends work. I love to look simple, stylish, but most importantly comfortable in what I wear. I love to look like what I imagined in my head not what trends think I should look like, I am always of the opinion of wearing something I can run in just in case of any situation, I love to look like me, I love to wear what I like not what trends think is in vogue. For example, I do not love all these lacy dresses, so I have always said that if I were to decide to settle down someday, I won't be wearing lace on my traditional marriage day, and people do not seem to understand why, because everyone wears lace on their traditional marriage day but not me. I have turned down the bridesmaid duty because I do not like to wear lace and I do not like to wear long gowns and when I told the bride, they were not comfortable with it, so I told them, and even though they tried to change my mind, I still didn't budge about my choice. I believe in going for what I can wear, whenever I want to and however I choose to, and since I love being simple and minimalist too, it has a way of making me take decisions that work for me, and my body type not trends. I do not always love to go by the books written by trends, I do not love to play by the books written by trends, I love to play by my own book, I love to go by my own book, it is either I love it or not, I do not manage, for the grams or to look a certain way especially if it involves fashion, Nah, it is what I want or nothing. ___ ___ ___ This is my entry to [Ladies of Hive Community Contest #295](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-295) ___ ___ ___ Ps: The image used is mine ___ ___ ___

body.title: Arthur Hayes bets big on a dark-horse DeFi token — Is SYN the next hyperliquid star?
body.body:
>Crypto's favorite contrarian is back at it. Arthur Hayes, the outspoken former BitMEX chief known for moving markets with a single tweet, has just revealed a fresh $2 million bet on SYN, the native token of Synapse — a project quietly reinventing itself at the heart of the Hyperliquid ecosystem.

The move comes weeks after Hayes dumped his HYPE and NEAR holdings in early June, a decision that left plenty of investors scratching their heads given his prior enthusiasm for both. Now he's circling back, this time targeting a smaller, lesser-known name riding one of the most explosive rallies in recent memory.

>Synapse didn't start out as a derivatives play. Originally built around cross-chain messaging infrastructure, the protocol pivoted late last year toward on-chain options trading, launching Hypercall — a HyperEVM-based options exchange currently offering contracts on SPCX and the S&P 500, with broader crypto markets reportedly on the roadmap.

Hayes frames the investment as an asymmetric bet: a way to stay long on Hyperliquid's broader ecosystem without holding HYPE itself, betting that an underappreciated infrastructure piece could capture outsized upside.

>What's turning heads isn't just the bet — it's the timing. SYN has already surged more than 800% over the past month, and Hayes only confirmed his position publicly after the trade had executed. Critics on social media have been quick to label it a textbook case of \

especially given his track record of rapid strategy reversals.

Still, with a market cap hovering around $95 million, SYN remains a relatively small player, leaving room for further upside if the narrative holds. The bigger question is whether Hypercall can actually compete: rivals like Derive and Rysk Finance already command stronger recognition and liquidity in the on-chain options space.

Whether this is genuine conviction or another headline-grabbing maneuver, one thing is certain — when Arthur Hayes moves, the market watches closely.

Spring is the perfect time to witness Kashmir at its most beautiful. As millions of colorful tulips bloom at the Indira Gandhi Memorial Tulip Garden, the entire valley transforms into a breathtaking paradise overlooking the iconic Dal Lake. The Tulip Festival, usually held from late March to April, is one of the biggest attractions for nature lovers, photographers, and families visiting Srinagar.

A peaceful Shikara ride on Dal Lake is an experience you simply cannot miss. Floating through the calm waters while surrounded by snow-covered mountains, floating gardens, and traditional houseboats creates memories that stay with you forever. Nearby attractions like Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Pari Mahal, and the local Kashmiri markets make your Srinagar trip even more special.

body.title: 《主角》读完了，但忆秦娥这个主角，我始终喜欢不起来
body.body:
《主角》终于读（听）完了。

虽然它获得了茅盾文学奖，但坦白说，忆秦娥大概是我这些年读过的小说里，最让我喜欢不起来的主角。

这本书我是边看原著、边听有声书的方式读完的。原著是在当当云阅读看的，有声书则是在喜马拉雅听的。

不得不说，喜马拉雅这版配音是真的不错。既尽可能保留了原著文字的韵味，又通过陕西、河南等地方言的演绎，把人物和地域特色表现得更加鲜活，可以说是锦上添花，值得点个大大的赞。

小说的主人公忆秦娥，在戏曲艺术上无疑是功成名就，但在家庭和生活方面，却可以说是一团糟，用这个词形容一点也不过分。

读完整部小说后，我最大的感受就是：忆秦娥这个人的性格特别拧巴。

很多时候，她看起来是一副随波逐流、什么都无所谓的样子，可真正接触久了，又会发现她其实非常固执，甚至有些偏执。

忆秦娥经历了两段婚姻，而两任丈夫的结局，一个比一个惨。

第一任丈夫刘红兵，后来因为车祸失去了一条腿，残疾在家，请了个保姆照顾生活，最后却发展成整天被保姆打骂。

唉，想当初刘红兵还是个公子哥时，风光无限，不知道有多少姑娘想嫁给他。可他偏偏非忆秦娥不娶，最后也算得偿所愿。

然而后来，因为和别的女人鬼混，被忆秦娥捉奸在床，两人最终离婚。

离婚后的刘红兵索性彻底放飞自我，整天跟各种女人混在一起。结果等真正出了事，那些女人一个个都跑得无影无踪。

不过，刘红兵也并非一无是处。

至少他重感情，也重承诺。即便自己残疾了，没有收入，哪怕东拼西凑借来几十块钱，也要寄给忆秦娥，当作儿子刘忆的生活费。

他们的儿子刘忆，从出生起身体就一直不好。忆秦娥倾注了全部母爱，可最终还是没能留住这个孩子。

最让我难受的是孩子去世那一段。

刘忆从六楼坠下，书里描写得十分残酷。殡仪馆的整容师忙活了半天，最后都表示无法修复，只能拿孩子生前的一张照片遮住脸，勉强完成遗体告别。

唉……

看到这里，我心里真不是滋味。

我甚至猜测，作者应该读过余华的《活着》。不过，《主角》里不少人物的命运写得实在太惨了，看得人心里发堵。至少我读到这里的时候，只要一想到这些细节，就觉得浑身不自在。

忆秦娥的第二任丈夫石怀玉，是一位画家。

他的结局，比刘红兵更悲惨——最后选择了自杀。

事情的起因，是石怀玉创作了一幅以忆秦娥为原型的画作。虽然书中提到人物的敏感部位用树叶进行了遮挡，但忆秦娥得知后还是怒不可遏。

石怀玉举办画展时，把这幅画视为自己的代表作，也是自己最珍视的作品。

可忆秦娥二话不说，冲进画展，当着众人的面往画上泼了一大堆墨汁，直接把整幅作品毁掉了。

你说，忆秦娥这性格、这做事方式？？？

而石怀玉呢？听说自己视若生命的艺术作品被毁后，最终选择在那幅画前结束了自己的生命。

唉……

这都特么的什么情节嘛？看得人心烦意乱。

后来，当忆秦娥得知儿子刘忆出事后，便拼命从秦岭往城里赶。

这里稍微交代一下剧情。

当天，本来忆秦娥准备早点回去，是石怀玉一直挽留她，希望她晚点再走。于是，忆秦娥便认定，是石怀玉间接害死了自己的儿子，因此把所有的怨恨都发泄到了石怀玉身上。

看到这里，我是真有些纳闷。

孩子从六楼摔下去，首先不是应该追究当时看护人的责任吗？

再退一步讲，一个孩子能从六楼坠落，本身就说明平时的安全防护存在问题。最应该反思的，不应该是家长自己吗？

怎么最后却把所有责任都推到石怀玉身上？

至于忆秦娥的弟弟，更让我无语。

石怀玉上门时，他竟然直接把自己的姐夫痛打了一顿，而忆秦娥非但没有制止，反而也冲出来要找石怀玉拼命。

这一家子的逻辑，我是真理解不了。

自己看护孩子出了问题，不去反思自身责任，却把矛头全部指向别人，这到底是什么逻辑？

整本书读完，虽然它获得了茅盾文学奖，但坦白说，这位主角，我是真的喜欢不起来。

![ddreader\_20260630-142002.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYBnoGpxYaodbSE8W4DejQy6sXcLfU8rmd2XWap7B8b7s/ddreader_20260630-142002.png)

至于新的小说《死水微澜》，讲的是清末民初成都府一带发生的故事。

我刚开始读，就觉得文字十分有趣，带着浓浓的地方风味。

等读完以后，再写一篇读后感吧。

body.title: Splinterlands Season Update: Rewards, Progress & What's Next
body.body: /> Another season has come to an end and despite finishing in Gold II, the reset has sent me back to Silver I. Time to climb the ladder all over again!

>End of Season Rewards

With around 57k Glint at end of the season I had enough to build up a small collection of Gold and Legendary potions and I also opened 6 Champion Chests.

/> Using the above Soulbound rewards I have managed to level up two cards: Cullborn Revenant & Thornmaw Beserker. With the extra copies, taking the Cullborn Revenant to third level from first makes sense for the extra health and speed. Whereas the Thornmaw Beserker will gain Final Rest which is a new ability to me so I am excited to see it in use.

> With the sales of the Wailsworn Spector and the Rare scroll, my Liquid SPS rewards from 65% battle earnings and I was also able to build up my rental reserves. I keep 900 dec separate at all times to ensure any rental expansion is possible. After refilling this back to 900 dec, I was able to purchase a good number of copies for Torrent Sniper, taking me to level 3 and earning the Painforge ability which is already beginning to pay off nicely.

>

I have already begun working my way back up the ladder and I am battling away in Gold 3 right now. Which is where I hope to rebound up into the higher levels of Gold again to earn the juicier SPS rewards and Glint.

> So in order to pay off this rental, I will need to replace around ~231 dec which with 40sps to be claimed today, I should be able to do so immediately. Wins are earning me around 3 sps which is where I expect it to stay for a while which is good. The strategy of liquidating 65% of the SPS and converting it to DEC is working. My stack of SPS is continuing to grow albeit a little slower than I would like. But I do believe this is currently the correct strategy moving forward. But if you have any suggestions on what can be done to enhance my progress, I am open to feedback. My next goals are to get to 1k SPS and begin to work on my Water and Death cards so I can take advantage of my Zeddica at 5th level. Zeddica is a card I was happy to purchase as it allowed me to play out the Little League battles and with a dual element archon, it gives me more choices for low mana and high damage monsters. This has been a much shorter than usual blog but it should serve to mark my progress moving forward. Overall things are moving very positively. See you on the battlefield!

body.title: A Powerful Fire Element Attacker That Burns Enemies | Did You Know Khazi Conjurer Costs Only 2 Mana?
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image Jun 30, 2026, 10_34_55 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23vsUkUQQhFUy4pXLBf5SKUw4VeM6DS1pYejy2gCftmCTbS5Hv3ixYzYUf6wsgdbD4au1.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


The Khazi Conjurer which belongs to the Fire element is a very dangerous attacker. With its attack power, it can destroy the enemy units' lineup. It is very important that you also have offensive monster cards in your deck. 

Monster cards that are very powerful double strikers can keep a strong attack going in any mana battle, so high health or tank monsters can be destroyed quickly. The only way to destroy tank monsters is by using high attackers or high damage dealer monsters whose attack power is very high.

Today, I will talk about Khazi Conjurer whose stats, abilities and powers are excellent. First, let's talk about this monster card's visual appearance. 
![Screenshot 2026-06-30 100931.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xATSVQoov5mfp1MPB5rggvtmH3PTHj5N273qJNyLcsQzLX9ufamkRhLPwCUsAHZP3hp.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

As mentioned it belongs to the Fire element and its background is filled with flames everywhere. It is a kung-fu style monster that appears in a battle stance. In its right hand, it holds a baby dragon which it uses as its weapon. 

Whenever it wants to attack an enemy unit it releases this dragon from its hand and sends it toward the enemy so it can strike them and eliminate them from the battle with strong damage. Its visual appearance is very beautiful and I liked it a lot.

Without a doubt, this monster card's stats and abilities are also excellent. The most important thing is its mana cost. Do you know that Khazi Conjurer's mana cost is only 2?

This means you can use it effectively in almost every battle. A 2 mana monster card is a very valuable low mana card that you should definitely add to your deck so that you have better selection options in any battle. 

Also remember that the lower a monster card's mana cost is the more valuable it often becomes... We are often under the misunderstanding that high mana monster cards are always more expensive but that is not always true... Low mana cards are in higher demand because they can be selected easily in many different battles AND you will have multiple options for selecting low mana cards..

![Screenshot 2026-06-30 101005.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23wWR4xUTtiNsBb87bzR2rL9gdiLTgJP3zoqsCkdWothSXFkpiaWEXKdEACa5M1YDgZeV.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)
As mentioned earlier, this is a ranged attacker and at Level 6 it has 6 ranged attack. This means it attacks enemy units with 6 damage every round. What is the benefit of this attack?? 

Any enemy monster with 6 health or less can be eliminated with a single attack of this monster.. It has 5 health which defines its survivability. This is quite good considering its mana cost. Even so, it is better to pair it with a healer or protector unit so it can receive continuous healing and shield protection. 

It also has 5 speed which increases its attack speed and also helps enemy attacks miss more often..

Now let's talk about its two special abilities.

---
# INCENDIARY
---



![Screenshot 2026-06-30 101022.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23wWrRduepaHdFru6DKQvENLdodGPkVRGnWZV2n65DNn4LYFd4gXuXdBpRFqsdJEFxWwA.png)


The first ability is Incendiary. This ability means that when the monster attacks there is a very high chance that its attack will apply the Burn effect as well.. After Burn is applied, the affected enemy units start losing 2 health or continue losing health gradually over time. 

So, if this monster attacks with 6 damage it can also apply the Burn effect to enemy units, causing additional damage over time. This Burn effect can activate with every attack, making it extremely dangerous for the enemy.

---
# PIERCING
---

![Screenshot 2026-06-30 101027.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tknH88tyJ1SjJ8mxX1RQivHL392xob2jS7TERsKbbWbscFSd4jgWV1iCLQXVU2aMxko.png)


The second special ability is Piercing. This ability means that if the monster's attack is greater than the opponent's armor, any damage left after breaking the armor goes directly to the enemy's health. 

Piercing works like armor penetration, damaging both the armor and the health. if this monster has 6 attack and the enemy has 3 armor, the first 3 damage destroys the armor, while the remaining 3 damage goes directly to the enemy's health. 

This also helps other allied units because the armor has already been removed making it easier for them to attack the enemy's health.

These are two very dangerous abilities that make this monster extremely powerful and it can play an important role in any battle.

---
# PRICE AND RENTING
---

![Screenshot 2026-06-30 101056.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EnyoUdex7BQomeejLXq3y5bQCUYsZuNH1tgxoe7Mvyshe6C59fFzEWD1LFgeXL4cJ37.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

![Screenshot 2026-06-30 101045.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23swhwTk5ZtjN5qCxj62JVcaSqakzYCjTmUPY8kngmog3Sf1k8dPB8gUQuvnuzzF9hqrQ.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

Now let's talk about this monster card's price. 

At the starting level, this monster card is available at a very reasonable price. Depending on its level and upgrades, its price ranges from $2 to $92. 

If a player cannot afford to buy this card they can also rent it. The rental cost starts from 1 DEC per day and goes up to 41 DEC per day making it easy to rent and add to your deck.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

body.title: Even water is being tipped in the United States.
body.body:
As soon as the ball rolls on the World Cup field, the atmosphere of celebration is now in the stadiums and bars of the United States. But a large part of the international football fans who come to watch the game are suffering more than the excitement on the field. That is the famous tipping culture or the rule of giving tips in the United States. Whether you buy a bottle of water, a coffee or just a beer.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmabaFF2GDSP3AWNM7grSn98wvuvURhwo2bmRCbAEuSVSV/1782801808435.jpg)




[  scr](https://share.google/TaG7sEHjHCGJGcZcF  )

When paying the bill, you will tip twenty percent, twenty-five percent or thirty percent. For many, it is like a new game. The rules of which they do not even know. Many international fans who came to the United States for the World Cup find the American tipping culture confusing, expensive and tiring for them. They have no objection to tipping for good service. But why do they need to tip for buying a bottle of water?

It is really strange. On the other hand, Australian fans say that a large part of their budget has been spent on World Cup tickets, airfare and hotels. On top of that, they have to tip again every time they buy a drink or food. They believe that businesses should be responsible for ensuring good wages for their employees. Everyone should respect local culture. But if you add another five dollars to each drink, the cost increases very quickly. Japanese people say that tipping is not customary in Japan. According to them, food prices in the United States are already very high. Adding a tip of thirteen to twenty percent on top of that increases the cost abnormally. Many even feel that the extra money they have to pay for tips. That money could have bought another meal.

In the hospitality sector in the United States, tips are not just a courtesy, but the main source of income for many workers. Behind this is the country's strange wage structure. In many states, tip-dependent restaurant and bar workers are paid a base salary of only two.13 dollars per hour. As a result, a large part of their income comes from tips given by customers. The minimum cash wage for tipped workers in Atlanta, Georgia is two.13 dollars per hour. According to the law, if tips and basic salary combined do not reach the minimum wage of seven.25 dollars per hour, the employer has to make up the shortfall.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXKqMt6C2rJB3RLQprBU2ccz6wHZoLgbDAQApRc524BqR/1782801895369.jpg)

[  scr](https://share.google/wNhoEe9C7rCH97qpN  )


Therefore, many believe that it is difficult for workers in this sector to live without tips. However, not all states have the same rules. In California, tipped workers also receive a minimum wage of sixteen.20 dollars per hour. Which is the highest in the United States. Even then, many restaurants recommend tipping ten, fifteen or twenty percent. Although some establishments ask for twenty, twenty-five or even thirty percent tips. Which seems excessive to many. Not only customers, but also employees in the US hospitality sector are concerned about tips. They complain that many foreign tourists do not tip because they do not know the local rules.

Many bars and restaurants in New York have seen an increase in the number of European tourists on the occasion of the World Cup. But businessmen claim that a large part of them are not interested in tipping. Therefore, some establishments have already introduced a system of paying bills with a service charge, so that employees are not completely deprived of tips. Again, in many restaurants, it is seen that some tourists leave without leaving tips even after paying a large bill. In such a situation, employees politely ask if there was a problem with the service. When customers express their satisfaction, they are told that, unlike in many European countries, service charges are not automatically added to the bill in the United States.

So tipping is the norm. In the eyes of the US government, tips are a key and expected component of employee income. So while thousands of foreign fans who have come to watch the World Cup enjoy ninety minutes of excitement on the field, they have to fight another invisible battle off the field: the battle to settle tips.

body.body: /> Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing great and welcome to another #Splinterlands post. Today's session in #Splinterlands was honestly one of those small but really satisfying days. Nothing super crazy happened like pulling an expensive card or climbing leagues, but I finally achieved one of the little goals I had been working towards for several days. I finally got my Vega Top Hat. It may sound like just a cosmetic item, but honestly, customizing your avatar is one of those fun little features that makes the game feel more personal. So here's how today's adventure went.

> Like usual, I started today's session by checking the Lux's Favor Lucky Spin. I always enjoy spinning this wheel because even when you don't get something huge, it still feels exciting. There's always that small hope that maybe this time you'll get an amazing reward. Today, luck was decent. I ended up getting, +100 Sparks. Not the biggest reward possible, but honestly I wasn't disappointed at all. Because I already knew I was getting really close to buying the item I wanted from the Sparks Shop.

> After collecting my daily reward, I decided to continue progressing through the campaign challenges. Today's mission was, Battle Challenge #5. The battle had the Noxious Fumes ruleset active, which means every unit starts the battle poisoned.
> Completing Battle Challenge #5 awarded, 200 Sparks. And honestly, this reward was actually more exciting than the battle itself. Because I knew exactly what this meant.
> I immediately opened my Sparks balance. And there it was. 3,553 Sparks I literally needed just a little more than 3,500. And now I finally had enough.

> For several days now, I've been saving Sparks because there were two avatar items that I really wanted: * Vega Top Hat * Vega Background Both cost 3,500 Sparks each. Originally I wasn't sure which one I should buy first. But honestly, the top hat just looked too cool. So I went directly to the Sparks Shop and bought it. Not gonna lie, this felt way more satisfying than I expected. I know it's just a cosmetic item. But when you've been slowly collecting Sparks every day, finally purchasing the item you've been saving for actually feels like a real achievement.

> Of course, after buying the top hat, I equipped it immediately. No hesitation. And honestly, I think my avatar looks significantly better now. The purple outfit together with the Vega Top Hat actually fits really well. Now my avatar finally looks like someone who belongs in the world of #Splinterlands instead of just some random beginner character.

></center>

Now that I finally got the Vega Top Hat, I only have one major cosmetic goal left.

The Vega Background

It also costs 3,500 Sparks.

So basically I'm back to saving from the beginning.

But that's okay.

Having something to work toward actually makes daily rewards and battle challenges feel much more meaningful.

𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍
====================

Overall, today was a really enjoyable session.

I got:

*   100 Sparks from Lux's Favor
    
*   200 Sparks from Battle Challenge #5
    
*   Finally enough Sparks to buy the Vega Top Hat
    
*   A much cooler-looking avatar
    

Not every day in #Splinterlands needs huge rewards or legendary card pulls.

Sometimes achieving a small personal goal feels just as satisfying.

Now it's time to start saving all over again.

Because that Vega Background is definitely coming next.

Anyway thats it for today’s #Splinterlands grind. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

Every time antibiotics are misused, we inch closer to a world where common infections become untreatable. According to global health data, bacterial antimicrobial resistance was directly responsible for 1.27 million deaths worldwide in 2019 and contributed to 4.95 million deaths that same year. These figures highlight an urgent public health crisis that demands immediate and coordinated action. One of the most effective responses to this crisis is a practice known as Antimicrobial Stewardship.

---

Antimicrobials are therapeutic substances used to prevent or treat infections. They include antiseptics, antibiotics, antivirals, antifungals and antiparasitics.

Antimicrobials can kill microorganisms and/or prevent their growth by targeting key steps in cellular metabolism such as the synthesis of biological macromolecules, the activity of cellular enzymes, or cellular structures such as the cell wall, cell membranes.


**Difference between antibiotics, antivirals, antifungals and antiparasitic** 

Antibiotics are pharmacological agents designed to  combat bacterial infections, 
They either kill bacteria outright (bactericidal) or inhibit their growth (bacteriostatic), allowing the immune system to eliminate the infection.

Antibiotics are indicated  for infections caused by bacteria, such as pneumonia, strep throat, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and bacterial skin infections. However, antibiotics are ineffective against viruses or fungal infections.



**Antivirals**

**What Are They?**

Antivirals are drugs used to treat infections caused by viruses. Unlike bacteria, viruses are not living organisms and replicate within host cells, making them harder to target. Antivirals work by interfering with the virus’s ability to multiply and spread in the body.

Antivirals are **indicated**  viral infections like the flu (influenza), HIV, herpes, and hepatitis C. Unlike antibiotics, they don’t destroy the virus but reduce its replication to control the infection.

**Antifungals**

**What Are They?**


Medications that are used to treat fungal infections are known as antifungals. These drugs work by targeting fungal cell membranes, effectively killing the fungus or stopping its growth.



Antifungal medications are **indicated** to treat fungal infections such as athlete’s foot, ringworm, candidiasis (thrush), and more serious infections like invasive aspergillosis.



**Antiparasitics**

Antiparasitic drugs are used to treat infections caused by parasites such as protozoa and helminths. They are essential in managing diseases like malaria, trypanosomiasis, and intestinal worm infections.


---

**What Is Antimicrobial Resistance**

Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) occurs when bacteria, viruses, fungi and parasites no longer respond to antimicrobial medicines. As a result of drug resistance, antibiotics and other antimicrobial medicines become ineffective and infections become difficult or impossible to treat, increasing the risk of disease spread, severe illness, disability and death.

AMR is a natural process that happens over time through genetic changes in pathogens. Its emergence and spread is accelerated by human activity, mainly the misuse and overuse of antimicrobials to treat, prevent or control infections in humans, animals and plants.



---

**How Misuse and Overusse Drive Resistance**

The fact that bacteria develop resistance to a drug is normal and expected. But the way that drugs are used affects how quickly and to what degree resistance occurs.

Understanding how resistance develops requires examination of the specific behaviours that accelerate it;

**Treating viral infections with  antibiotics**
   
One of the most common forms of antibiotic misuse is prescribing or consuming antibiotics for viral infections,

 Taking antibiotics for a viral infection like a cold or the flu (for which antibiotics are ineffective) is an example of misuse of antibiotics.

Antibiotics treat infections caused by bacteria. But they don't treat infections caused by viruses (viral infections).
 
 For example, an antibiotic is the correct treatment for strep throat, which is caused by bacteria. But it's not the right treatment for most sore throats, which are caused by viruses.


**Incomplete antibiotic courses**
When a patient discontinues antibiotics therapy prematurely typically upon feeling better the bacteria that have not yet been eliminated are often the most resistance or harmful ones.
These surviving organisms multiply and spread, resulting in infections that  are harder to treat with the same  antibiotic in the future.

   
**Antibiotic use in agriculture and animal husbandry**

Another example is giving antibiotics to healthy animals to promote their growth and prevent disease. Antibiotic use in farm animals allows the resistant bacteria to thrive within the animals, and then the drug-resistant bacteria can be transferred to humans when they consume meat products. As a result, infections in humans harboring resistant forms of bacteria become more difficult to treat.

---

**What Is Antimicrobial Stewardship?**

Antimicrobial stewardship is a systematic approach to educate and support health care professionals to follow evidence-based guidelines for prescribing and administering antimicrobials. The education of the health workforce is of crucial importance, as they form the front line in safeguarding the effectiveness of antimicrobial medicines.

**Antimicrobial Stewardship in Healthcare Settings**
In hospitals and clinical institutions, antimicrobial stewardship programs (ASPs) are implemented by multidisciplinary teams comprising physicians, clinical pharmacists, and microbiologists. These programs include:

Conducting culture and sensitivity testing before prescribing antimicrobials to identify the specific causative organism and its susceptibility profile.

Establishing formulary restrictions that limit the use of broad-spectrum antibiotics to cases where they are clinically justified.

Implementing prior authorization protocols that require approval before certain high-risk antibiotics can be prescribed.

Conducting regular review of ongoing antimicrobial therapy to assess appropriateness and make adjustments as needed.


---
**The Role of the Public in Antimicrobial Stwardship**

The public also plays a role in antibiotic stewardship. You can help reduce the development of antibiotic resistance if you:

•	Avoid pressuring your health care provider to give you an antibiotic prescription. Ask your health care provider for advice on how to treat symptoms.


•	Wash your hands regularly with soap and water for at least 20 seconds. Clean any cuts or wounds to avoid bacterial infections that need antibiotic treatment.


•	Get all recommended vaccines. Some vaccines protect against bacterial infections, such as diphtheria and whooping cough (pertussis). Check to see if you need any vaccines before travel, too.


•	Lower your risk of getting a bacterial infection spread by food. Don't drink raw milk. Wash your hands before making food and before eating. Cook foods to a safe internal temperature.


•	Use antibiotics only as prescribed by your health care provider. Take the prescribed daily amount. Complete the entire treatment. Tell your health care provider if you have any side effects.


•	Never take leftover antibiotics for a later illness. They may not be the correct antibiotic. And they likely don't include a full treatment course.


•	Never take antibiotics prescribed for another person or let anyone else take your antibiotics.
