body.title: My Hive Goals for 2026 Week #26
body.body:
I have decided to start posting a weekly update on my progress toward [my 2026 goals](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@jfang003/my-hive-goals-for-2026-lma) here on [Hive](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-what-is-hive). It helps me stay on track, and I can realize if I am behind on a goal at any point in time. It's the sixth month of the year so far, and there is plenty of time left in the year. Also, for everyone's note, the Saturday Savers has ended, but the Slothly Savers Club has started in its place. 

## Progress

![graph.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/48RQeKuZVUaqNXV4GdETTbnDAsAhe2g84pihgaRL8ary2QhMdWt966fAr4u9rsnZ5u.png)
Above are statistics that I have gotten from [HiveStats](https://hivestats.io/). This week is looking worse than last week, and it all adds up over time.

### HP
I earned 121 [HP](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-hive-power-hp) earned throughout the week. I am checking this through the difference between the two endpoints on the graph on Hivestats. It's been a great week.

### HBD 


![HBD.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tv3v8SY678vRsK3nDzVyKu239mqyfpvzeCsZ1n9wyJmrU1rBeYJGqNuGD6PMVZ9Z5BG.png)
I earned 0 [HBD](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-hive-backed-dollar-hbd) this week. With the price of Hive lower, we have hit the debt limit. This means that we will be earning Hive instead of HBD. I won't be able to add to my HBD savings for a while, but the interest will help me towards that goal. When the Hive price is above the debt limit, I'll add to my savings. There isn't much I can do here, but at least that interest will add up. 

## Conclusion

![goal progress.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tmmEVQaCP8XsrJ8WQ1oACLS5q7BcGv9KpGKwjmGq1tKbt9PVB873MjhK6N13oeCmM6N.png)
My progress is looking decent for now. I need around 2% per week, so this week I met that standard. HBD is officially behind where I need to be now. However, without any HBD being earned, it might not be enough if that doesn't change by the end of the year. Other than that, nothing much has changed, and I am just slowly grinding away at my goals. The HBD goal isn't looking that great as I am behind, and I don't think we will be getting HBD anytime soon with the current Hive price. My HP goal is looking great, but my HBD isn't. I am not sure if I want to leave it as is or change some Hive into HBD later down the year. The HP is ahead, but the HBD isn't. At this point, my HP goal might be reached in a month or two at my current rate, and I am not sure if I want to extend it.

Do you have any goals for 2026? What is the progress towards your own goals? 

Feel free to leave a comment if you read my post. If you have any questions, feel free to ask, and I will do my best to answer.

[![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slothbuzz/EoH1FQp9qENCTmY4cmEzXTFsXurmY28k5GRD2z1kK7pexyTVwhui7cFtMLGEp8Sfjd2.png)](https://peakd.com/saturdaysavers/@slothbuzz/saturdaysavers-rebrand-and-relaunch-at-slothbuzz)

body.body:
![1002402367-298d9905c18e.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/m16uellop/lkt-mr06eim0-o799m3el/1002402367-298d9905c18e.webp)

![1002402362-3a24f3e1bc58.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/m16uellop/lkt-mr06eim0-o799m3el/1002402362-3a24f3e1bc58.webp)

![1002402374-4923f92dca7d.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/m16uellop/lkt-mr06eim0-o799m3el/1002402374-4923f92dca7d.webp)

![1002402371-d39cb72301de.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/m16uellop/lkt-mr06eim0-o799m3el/1002402371-d39cb72301de.webp)

![1002386252-edited-mr08ulcc-26b234170abf.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/m16uellop/lkt-mr06eim0-o799m3el/1002386252-edited-mr08ulcc-26b234170abf.webp)

![1002366501-57c1906f4bb8.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/m16uellop/lkt-mr06eim0-o799m3el/1002366501-57c1906f4bb8.webp)

El dia 24 de junio tembló a golpe de 6 de la tarde venía bajando desde el metro de Capitolio a Quinta Crespo que es donde resido, me agarró específicamente en Plaza Caracas en el medio de esa plaza, junto a la hija de mi novia, pero si bien me asusté, logramos mantener la calma y ese día fue una locura, en mi edificio se cayó parte de la azotea, y en la casa no pude ver bien los daños pero si la casa estaba un desastre, bueno ese día fue bárbaro, pero no hubieron víctimas por aqui, mi madre, hermanos, hija y demás gente cercana están bien, y para los que paso ese día tendré tomarme un tiempo de redactar todo lo que me aconteció.

Al día siguiente decidí comprarle un pan y café a mi novia para compartir,  porque algún que otro local ví abierto al asomarme por el balcon,  al salir del edificio pude presenciar mejor los daños exteriores a mi edificio y el edificio de al lado donde funcionaba el Banco de Venezuela de Quinta Crespo y el Mercado de los Corotos que se quemó hace años, hoy están haciendo algo de una sede del un cuerpo de inteligencia, a estos se les  cayo de forma peligrosa parte de la fachada, los escombros taparon su puerta principal, debido a que estaba debilitada por ese incendio.

Después me dirigi por la zona del mercado, via San Juan y vi ese auto que le cayeron escombros de una edificación de un gran depósito, reventó el auto, por eso no es bueno estar cerca de edificios cuando tiembla y ese era mi temor cuando me tembló en Plaza Caracas, que nos estallara un vidrio o nos callera un objeto encima.

En fin después de allí subí y afortunadamente en esta zona no hubieron casi daños lamentables, en la espera del pan un señor se puso hablar de las fallas geológicas, de que hay sectores donde no se puede construir,  por lo que veo y analizo mucho de lo que pasó fue por negligencia de las autoridades y la corrupción.

Al final del día pienso que somos afortunados, por qué el apartamento y la familia estan bien, solo que el apartamento quedó con fisuras que estoy tapando, así que toca renovar obligado.

body.title: Crypto Market Outlook
body.body:
I have spent hours analyzing the current cryptocurrency market to determine where the actual price bottom might be. While many analysts are calling $40,000 the ultimate bottom for Bitcoin (BTC), market opinions remain widely divided during times like this.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVFWDvuvTkDQTU7WsJWhthJeNoy2kHebt5wzbMVumKJA4/1000392200.png 


Looking closely at the Bitcoin chart, there is a strong support zone between $59,700 and $60,000. Bitcoin has tested this level multiple times and struggled to break below it, leading many market participants to believe that $60,000 could be the bottom.

​However, my analysis suggests that the true bear market has just begun. I anticipate a major downward move if the price successfully breaks below the $54,000 level.


​Right now, the price is reacting to an old area of value. Buyers view this as an important accumulation zone and are placing significant buy orders. While these orders are currently slowing down the downward momentum, they are not enough to absorb the massive supply in the market. Once this level is cleared, there is a high probability that Bitcoin will drop to the $42,000 level



​As is typical in the market, almost all altcoins are falling because Bitcoin is down. I used this opportunity to enter a short (sell) position on Ethereum (ETH), which I am still holding.
​Trading becomes much easier when you let the price come to you, follow the established trend, and avoid trying to force the market to do what you want. It is as simple as that.
​Based on current market behavior and price mapping, my analysis indicates a high probability that Ethereum will head toward the $860 level. That would be all for now friends,Cheers

body.title: INVADING PRIVACY IN A DIGITAL  WORLD
body.body:
Hello everyone, you're welcome to my blog today.

Nobody deserves to have their private moments turned into entertainment for strangers on the internet. Unfortunately, social media has made this happen more often. When people see someone struggling, crying, arguing, or even having a medical emergency, instead of helping, they pull out their phones and start recording. Before you know it, the video has gone very viral, and meanwhile, the person in the video never agreed to be filmed or shared with millions of people. To me, that is where the problem really lies.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbTgWxeV67bdMyZPZWrzwHJoNqtoYe5PycskimaUXtyuf/100552.png 



That's why I don't think there should be laws for ordinary situations like these, except in extreme cases where people are deliberately exposed, offended, or subjected to some form of harassment. In those cases, the context changes completely. We really need to learn to see everyday events as just that: normal events. Sometimes, trying to regulate everything, even when there is no real invasion of privacy, may not be the best approach. Maybe it's better to leave some things as they are so the world doesn't become overly complicated and full of restrictions. Or would we rather reach a point where we feel like we can't do anything anymore without worrying that we're doing something wrong? Let's keep life a little lighter.

I don't think someone should be arrested because another person happened to appear in the background of their picture or video. That would make things unnecessarily complicated. Imagine content creators, photographers, vloggers, journalists, or even tourists who simply want to capture a beautiful moment. It would be almost impossible for them to make content if they had to get permission from every single person who appeared in the background of their videos.

When people are present in public places, their right to personal privacy is somewhat relaxed because it is an open place where other people can also be present. Many people think that taking photos or videos in public places should not be a crime. In the current era of deepfake or AI technology, the fear of misuse of photos or videos is not unfounded. If someone videos me without my knowledge and uploads that video to social media, and that video is used intentionally, it certainly falls under the category of a crime.

That would honestly be stressful. At the same time, I also believe there should be limits. Just because someone is in a public place doesn't mean they have completely given up their right to privacy. For example, I seriously don't want to see a video of something I do privately on the internet at all.

So, that will never happen—recording something on your camera and putting your stuff on social media without capturing a single person. It will never ever happen. In every corner of the world, human beings are living life; there are very few places where people live less. It also depends on the surroundings. While you are on the road, some are making videos openly, and you might get captured; that is a very normal thing. This is what I think works for me if I get captured randomly.

Hello everyone, thank you for stopping by my blog❤️

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@betheloji12/invading-privacy-in-a-digital-world-dms)

body.title: Buy The Dip, Sell The Dip, Repeat Until Liquidity Dies
body.body: # Buy The Dip, Sell The Dip, Repeat Until Liquidity Dies\n\nSix trading days. That's how long it took the AI trade to go from \

Same stocks. Same earnings estimates. Same Micron HBM order book everyone was quoting like scripture two weeks ago. The only thing that changed is which version of the narrative was convenient that morning, and the algos that have replaced actual portfolio managers don't have the attention span to notice the whiplash, let alone be embarrassed by it.\n\nLet's run the tape. June 23: semis get gutted on a rate-hike note out of BofA, Asian markets tumble in sympathy, and every financial Twitter account that called the AI trade dead in 2024 comes out of hibernation to say it again, louder. June 24: Nasdaq and S&P fall ahead of Micron's print, because apparently nobody could be bothered to wait twelve more hours for the actual number. June 25: Mag7 falls because Apple and Microsoft raised prices on an iPhone and an Xbox, which is somehow bearish for trillion-dollar margin machines passing through costs to customers who will buy the devices anyway. June 26: tread water, OpenAI IPO delay reported, shrug. June 29: Nasdaq up 2%, Alphabet up almost 5%, Tesla up over 8%, and the financial press calls it a \

as if the previous five days of carnage were the disease and this is the cure, rather than both being symptoms of a market that has lost the ability to hold a thought for longer than a news cycle.\n\nHere's the part that should actually bother you. Goldman's AI data-center construction basket is up nearly 60% year-to-date. Sixty percent, in a year where the same complex of stocks has had at least three distinct \

panics that each lasted under a week and reversed completely. That's not volatility born of genuine uncertainty about whether hyperscalers will keep building. It's volatility born of a market that has fully priced the bull case, fully priced the bear case, and now just oscillates between the two depending on which headline hit the tape last. Nobody's repricing the cash-flow assumptions on a multi-year capex cycle based on an iPhone price hike. They're repricing their own nerves.

And then there's the OpenAI IPO delay, which deserves more scrutiny than the one paragraph it got buried in. The largest, most hyped, most narrative-defining company in the entire AI capex story can't get its own paperwork in front of public market investors on schedule, and the market's reaction was essentially nothing. No discount applied to the picks-and-shovels names that have spent two years pricing in OpenAI as the permanent, insatiable customer at the center of the demand story. If the apex predator in the AI compute food chain is having trouble going public, that is information. The fact that it produced a one-day shrug instead of a re-rating tells you the market isn't actually pricing OpenAI's execution risk — it's pricing the vibe of AI as an asset class, and vibes don't do diligence.

Throw Micron into this. The company posted the kind of HBM-driven beat that should anchor a multi-week rally on its own — order books stretching out, pricing power that hasn't existed in memory chips since before most current traders had Bloomberg terminals — and it got one trading day of attention before the market moved on to the next inflection point. A blowout quarter from the company most directly levered to AI memory demand is now a forty-eight-hour story. That's not a market digesting good news efficiently. That's a market with the memory of a goldfish and the leverage of a hedge fund, treating fundamental catalysts as content to be consumed and discarded.

None of this means the AI capex cycle is fake. The capex is real, the power contracts are real, the chip orders are real. What's fake is the pretense that the day-to-day pricing of these stocks has anything to do with that underlying reality. You cannot have a sector that swings from \

within a single week and claim the moves reflect a reassessment of Micron's HBM backlog or Alphabet's capital intensity guidance. They reflect a market trading its own emotional state, with the AI complex as the most liquid, most narrative-dense vehicle available for doing so.\n\nThursday's jobs number will give this whole circus a fresh excuse to swing in whichever direction the headline allows. ISM manufacturing prints Wednesday into the same void. None of it will tell you anything new about whether Nvidia's order book holds up in 2027. It'll just tell you which way the goldfish is facing this week.

title.title: Ecency 4.4.0: safer logins and stronger security
title.body: Your account security is something we never stop working on. 4.4.0 is a big step for both sign-in and platform safety.\n\n

/>

A unified Sign with Extension picker
------------------------------------

If you have more than one browser extension installed, such as **Hive Keychain, Keeper, or Peak Vault**, Ecency now always asks which one you want to use and remembers your choice. No more having the wrong wallet hijack your signing. This picker is now consistent across every place you sign.

A few related wins:

*   Extension login is more reliable overall.
    
*   MetaMask snap login is hardened with a version guard and a graceful cancel, so a closed prompt no longer looks like an error.
    
*   The transfer dialog no longer auto-prompts a wallet connection you did not ask for.
    
*   Your account badge now shows the **actual extension** you signed in with.
    

A check against bots at signup
------------------------------

Free account creation is now protected by a server-verified **Turnstile** check. It quietly keeps bots and abuse out while staying easy for real people.

Smarter spam and quality control
--------------------------------

New accounts that post link farms are now softly moderated, which protects search quality and keeps genuine creators visible. We also block chain-invalid usernames before you submit, so you get instant, clear feedback instead of a confusing failure later.

Safer by default
----------------

Under the hood we closed an open-redirect path, sanitized embeds, and tightened our content security policy across the app. Signup error messages are now localized too, so they speak your language.

Security work is rarely flashy, but it is what keeps your account and the community safe. Thank you for trusting us with it.

Last in the series tomorrow: chat, search, and discovery. Follow **@ecency**.

title.title: Христина Соловій — 2:00, або Друга ночі
title.body:
Українська співачка Христина Соловій презентувала концептуальний реліз «2:00» (Друга ночі), як ретроспективу 90-х і оду кіномистецтву. 
Цей сингл увійде до майбутньої платівки співачки, яка саме і спрямована на переосмислення вітчизняного культурного простору 1990-х років та відродження нашої мистецької спадщини.

Пісня \

передає бунтарський дух та настрої початку 90-х років ХХ століття, часу перших років відновлення незалежності України. Це епоха радикальних трансформацій, великих сподівань та остаточного прощання з радянськими ідеалами. А що стосується часу 2.00, то його було обрано не випадково. Бо метафорично це і є час моменту, коли людина залишається наодинці з власними переживаннями, аналізує минулі травми та шукає справжню себе.
Головною ідеєю треку є необхідність очищення від імперських та російських впливів, задля формування самобутнього українського національного голосу.
Музичне оформлення - саундпродюсер Микита Юдін (RadioTelescope Studio). Меланхолійне поп-звучання композиції вони підсилили вкрапленими партіями живої скрипки, що додало особливої драматичності треку.
Екранну історію цього задуму створювала режисерка Саша Туз, а за креативну концепцію композиції відповідав Гліб Муха. Відеокліп побудований як інтелектуальна подорож золотим фондом українського кіно. Автори фактично доводять: суспільні дилеми та конфлікти, які підіймали наші режисери багато років тому, залишаються актуальними й сьогодні.

We also implemented batched JSON-RPC loading with shared caching, so previews load fast and we stop spamming the API with duplicate requests. Fewer calls, faster browsing, happier nodes. ![Notification Content Preview](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUnHTRczWtsqjwqKf5iJVeFDCHoS7SJUQgd5hXgfQSzb3/image.png) ![Rich Notification Rows](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQJfvxLkkfk3jHzGpvtqG7mdctd9gCsTn1ewCnJ4XdHiy/screenshot_2026_06_09_at_4.05.17_pm.png) ## 💬 Inline Reply System This is the big one. We also added automatic tag processing: lowercasing, deduplication, Hive tag-limit enforcement, and metadata-safe formatting. content.description:
HiveSuite adds rich notification previews, inline replies, smart tag inheritance, and optimized reply workflows.

# HiveSuite Just Made Your Notifications Way Less Annoying 🔔⚡

Ever opened a notification just to figure out what the heck someone was even talking about? Yeah, those days are over. HiveSuite notifications now come with context, inline replies, and a full composer that follows you around like a loyal blockchain puppy. 🐕

<!-- GIF: someone squinting at their phone confused, then nodding in satisfaction -->

## 📬 Rich Notification Previews

Notifications used to be the equivalent of a mystery box. Now they actually *tell you things*. We added rich content previews directly inside notification rows, so you'll see:

- Post title
- Comment title (when available)
- The first few lines of content

That means you can understand what's going on **without** opening the full post. We also implemented batched JSON-RPC loading with shared caching, so previews load fast and we stop spamming the API with duplicate requests. Fewer calls, faster browsing, happier nodes.

![Notification Content Preview](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUnHTRczWtsqjwqKf5iJVeFDCHoS7SJUQgd5hXgfQSzb3/image.png)

![Rich Notification Rows](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQJfvxLkkfk3jHzGpvtqG7mdctd9gCsTn1ewCnJ4XdHiy/screenshot_2026_06_09_at_4.05.17_pm.png)

## 💬 Inline Reply System

This is the big one. You can now reply directly from notifications — replies, mentions, and comments — without leaving the screen. And we didn't just bolt on a tiny text box. We embedded the **entire** HiveSuite composer.

That means images, videos, audio, GIFs, emoji, polls, templates, mentions, beneficiaries, tags, and reward settings. All of it. Right there. In your notifications. 🤯

<!-- GIF: mind-blown explosion reaction -->

![Inline Reply Composer](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfTPFvhNThkJi5XFcs4wG8wwBd9ZjwkisxnDVoGxb6ZHy/image.png)

![Notification Reply Experience](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWei1K4SpwqRi39KiRhHbag6nAiEUbWuNf5XgfzMTJJVP/screenshot_2026_06_09_at_4.04.22_pm.png)

## 📱 Mobile & Desktop, Each Done Right

Because shipping the same UI to every device is a crime, we tailored the reply experience per platform.

**Mobile** gets a dedicated bottom-sheet composer with smooth open/close animations, keyboard-safe scrolling, tap-to-dismiss, and optimized touch interactions. **Desktop** keeps a clean inline expandable composer right beneath the notification row, so you can see the conversation while you type.

![Mobile Reply Composer]![Image](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQToCYGD4smnT41pJ3rhMNJTdYj1MS96egwa7GiL4niSp/screenshot_2026_06_09_at_4.06.18_pm.png)

![Desktop Inline Replying](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWei1K4SpwqRi39KiRhHbag6nAiEUbWuNf5XgfzMTJJVP/screenshot_2026_06_09_at_4.04.22_pm.png)

## 🏷️ Smart Tag Handling & Reply Metadata

Replies now automatically carry forward tags from the parent post, shown as editable chips before you publish. We also added automatic tag processing: lowercasing, deduplication, Hive tag-limit enforcement, and metadata-safe formatting. Sanitized tags get baked right into the reply metadata, which means better compatibility across the entire Hive ecosystem. Clean metadata = happy frontends everywhere.

![Tag Inheritance System](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPEuWiiTAJ8HthJxKqHcLqEKo3Tad7KURS54XAiTuq3PE/screenshot_2026_06_09_at_4.08.04_pm.png)

## 🔄 Reply Lifecycle & Notification Refresh

After a successful reply, notification feeds refresh automatically — your new comment shows up instantly, no manual reload required. We also built a unified `closeReply()` workflow that handles every dismissal scenario: cancel actions, close buttons, backdrop taps, and mobile swipe gestures. No more ghost composers haunting your state. 👻

![Automatic Notification Refresh](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaHwsQhuVArMXs2mihRm4AT3MUWUwQUxVR99McnpFkVXd/image.png)

## 🚀 What's Next

We're just getting started. Expect even more streamlined communication tools, faster workflows, and scalable social features that make discovering and discussing content on Hive ridiculously smooth. Got a feature you're dreaming about? Drop it in the comments — the community steers this ship. 🐝

[AN: Considering how Wraithvine has had _millennia_ to multiclass... I might go with _anything_. This is tangentially related to [Important Developments](https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04928-m179-important-developments) ]

Good news, bad news, good news. Good news, the children were safe and far away from whatever this was by technicality. Bad news, ze couldn't open hir tower to reassure them that everything was fine. Good news, they had the charmed cauldron to make them porridge if all the other supplies and stock ran out. Bad news, ze would inevitably be coming back to a mess.

Good news, ze had centuries of experience in dealing with horseshit like this because bad news, hir magic was inexplicably beyond hir reach.

It was out of Bibrid's too, and the Silver Dragon was _not_ happy with his circumstances. Especially since Dragons instinctually used magic to happily dodge the laws of physics.

Wraithvine checked. Ze could not access the _leyflow_ by any means. Not through spellwork, not via attunement, not even by charmed artifact. Hells, he couldn't even reach hir goddess through prayer. Therefore, ze was left with training and long-underused skills to see them safely through this place.

It was the opposite of a blasted moor. A lush forest with plenty of fruit in the trees, plenty of game to hunt, _plenty_ of fish in the river. By all other metrics, it was a paradise.

Except for the complete lack of powers.

Good news, such as it was, was that their immortality and agelessness remained despite all the other magical assistance being out of their reach. Bad news, Bibrid had enough trouble clambering through the trees, so it was up to Wraithvine to secure sustenance when ze barely recognised _anything_ in this forest.

Ze would be very glad when they were the hells out of here.

In the meantime, finding their way to the other side of this particular obstacle was the main goal. Tracking prints, looking out for signs of predators. Meditating in the protection of Bibrid's draconic limbs because very few creatures would pick a fight with a Dragon.

Every dawn, Wraithvine attempted the simplest of spellworks to test if they were free. Every evening, ze prayed to hir goddess and waited for an answer.

Nothing.

For days on end.

Ze missed hir children. Ze missed hir cat. Ze occasionally cursed the grumbling of Spytfyre, the fly-Dragon who shared Bibrid's misery in being unable to fly.

This was taking _way_ too long.

title.title: Building A Life Of Purpose Instead Of Pressure
title.body:
> You will be surprised how many people live in constant pressure from a lot of things. Like the pressure to succeed quickly, pressure to earn more money, to meet expectations, or maybe pressure to keep up with what they have seen on social media. These easily make them feel mentally exhausted, dissatisfied about life, frustrated, and discontented even when they are making obvious progress. Whereas, people who live by purpose are driven by clear goals, clear values, and a clear sense of direction. That is, instead of cracking under pressure, they intentionally choose a path that aligns with who they are and what they want to achieve. Here, we shall take a look at how to build a life of purpose and not a life of pressure.
![pexels-timo-volz-837240-5443127.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSM1JStty3iAr5aUv4ZRhjkGBfBt886u97hE9Z3xprMLY/pexels-timo-volz-837240-5443127.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/silhouette-of-a-man-standing-inside-a-cave-5443127)
The first way to build a life of purpose is to discover what truly matters to you. To live a purposeful life, you have to understand what you are living for in the first place. This starts with understanding your values, your long-term goals, and what you are passionate about. Instead of allowing other people to determine or define how your life should turn out to be, it is important for you to identify what genuinely matters to you. Have you ever asked yourself what kind of person you would like to become? It is not everything that should catch your interest. Ask yourself what matters to you. That is, what impact you want to make, and what value you should be known for. When you have a clear direction of where you are going to, you will be less likely to be controlled by external pressure. In addition to this, you have to also set meaningful and impactful goals. Your goals should not just be about you and yourself, you have to create room for others to be impacted. Living a life of purpose means that you are living in a way that will make others to also live because of you. Your purpose will become practical when you support it with meaningful goals. Your goals should also reflect your values and long-term vision instead of short-term expectations of others. When you have meaningful goal, it will give you the required directions to go about it. This will also help you to make better decisions, and also make you to ignore distractions. The third way of building a life of purpose is to avoid comparison. The race of life is an individual race, and everyone is running in their own track. This is why it is unwise to compare yourself with anyone, especially who you see on social media, who you do not even know their story. Comparison is one of the greatest factors that put people under pressure. That is, wanting to have what someone else has, or to become like someone else, thereby putting themselves under intense pressure. It is true that you can be inspired and motivated by the success of others, but you should not allow it to become a standard to compare yourself. When you remain committed to your own path, it will become easier to fulfill your goal.
![pexels-barrytheoctopus-22601812.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZGhcY4EhpSJ3iRBBLFtrL1ojovcxJqGJDzDW4eWDMnCc/pexels-barrytheoctopus-22601812.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/silhouettes-of-three-people-standing-outside-on-a-foggy-day-22601812)
Another way to build a life of purpose is to focus on improving yourself daily. You should not be concerned about instant perfection. As long as you are improving yourself on a daily basis, then you are making progress. The little daily and continuous efforts you put in, over time, will compound to produce extraordinary result. Instead of worrying about how far you need to go and subjecting yourself under pressure, it will be far better to focus on making steady progress each day. Before you know it, you have even surpassed your initial expectations. You have to learn to live your life one day at a time. Remember that what makes you who you are is not just about one massive moment, but a sum total of your choices, decisions, and actions. The last point that we will look at in order to build a life of purpose is to live according to your values. More often than not, purpose is driven by integrity. This is why your choices should be based on what is right, on value, and on good intentions. You do not just do things out of your own desires, but because they are right. At the end, what counts is not what you have achieved or where you are, but how you have achieved it, and the route you took to get to where you are. You cannot do the wrong things with the wrong intentions and hope to get the right result. Always remember that it is the method and the process that will give justification to the result. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

Sometimes, to trust logic, you need to be a very versatile specialist in various fields of science, otherwise, logic can fail, as in this case. When I saw a rather large, strange-looking caterpillar, the first thing logic told me was that it was a developmental stage of some butterfly unknown to me. Live tropical butterfly exhibits periodically come to our city, and the likelihood that one of them could have escaped was high. But no, as it turns out, this caterpillar has nothing in common with butterflies. title.body:
>

>! [English Version] 
> 
>  In my old repertoire, I had this design pending, which I had forgotten, and while reviewing previous projects, I came across it. So I wanted to take the reins again, also taking advantage of the fact that I am trying, well, resuming the execution of projects in this program called Carita, which I have already mentioned many times, and I have also made some very basic designs.


  En mi antiguo repertorio tenía pendiente este diseño, el cual había olvidado, y revisando proyectos anteriores me topé con él. Entonces quise retomar las riendas, aprovechando también que estoy probando, bueno, retomando la realización de proyectos en este programa llamado Carita, el cual ya he mencionado muchas veces, y también he hecho algunos diseños muy básicos.


![8DAuGnTQCLptZgjHUrRAJGcW4y1D4A5QVJJ7zjzqqKdfVHSS6NapSCCCHnY5vPQpyeH9hjCEY8oPZ2CEVj9S8ikdVhH9mAZnznRJQK7XXpFBBuke6s87N2prLJz4qXywq8Ab2hZcqxziPETEDtXPPo6MsZW7RwXcMH4Rdaq58Pp (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/244APfkQza3aCEeQ3MfBwRqCSpds3CozziirmrtVtrA8icR1UcspuvXtsJKtM6MTPgC8C.png)



>! [English Version] 
> 
>  The lore of this character is very interesting, as he is the son of a mobster who is murdered by a gang to whom they owed money, and he, being a child, must flee and is trained by one of the other heroes, who is Alex Wolf. In his quest for revenge, this child realizes that there are other homeless people who have gone thru his situation or even worse, and instead of continuing his quest for revenge, he decides to help all the people or children possible in the world.



  El lore de este personaje es muy interesante, ya que es el hijo de un mafioso, el cual es asesinado por una pandilla a la cual le debían dinero, y este, siendo un niño, debe huir y es entrenado por uno de los otros héroes, el cual es Alex Wolf. En la búsqueda de venganza, este niño se da cuenta de que hay otras personas desamparadas también que pasaron por su situación o incluso peor y, en vez de seguir con su búsqueda de venganza, este decide ayudar a todas las personas o niños posibles en el mundo.


![Screenshot_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23t8EsUnEuMFaik9SJRCmtwZPq1Mh7vPDXrFEJUirhehnkKCLfwL7zgyEaJajyt2rGMf5.png)




 




<div class=\

> >! [English Version] > >   So, well, but placing the basic drawing concepts on the glass, which I find today, as of today, a very useful tool, since I hadn't delved into it very well before for the same reason, which was making me stuck at this moment, because I encountered the same wall that didn't allow me to progress back then, since I do my designs in Paint Tool SAI, and there is a tool, which is area selection, where you go to color; it's a brush that makes everything easier for you, and in Krita, that brush isn't there, but, however, there is a new function, which is selection layer or selection mask; it's also there, there are many methods. I didn't know this, and by watching a tutorial, I was able to find this tool, which is literally the same.   Así que bueno, pero colocando los conceptos básicos de dibujo en el cristal, el cual me parece hoy, al día de hoy, una herramienta muy útil, ya que antes no había profundizado muy bien por la misma razón, la cual me volvía a empacar en este momento, porque me volví a encontrar con el mismo muro que no me permitió en aquel tiempo progresar, puesto que yo hago mis diseños en Paint Tool SAI, y ahí hay una herramienta, la cual es selección de área, en la cual uno va a colorear; es un pincel que te facilita todo, y en Krita no está ese pincel, pero, sin embargo, hay una nueva función, la cual es capa de selección o máscara de selección; también está, hay muchos métodos. Yo no sabía esto y, viendo un tutorial, pude dar con esta herramienta, la cual literal es lo mismo. |![Screenshot_2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23tSzWWo8MhYrRWW6P12ndvc39EWeM3WHkBKqh17rGPBmwBBFJqM9q9ZXJQF5FW26DwWg.png)|![Screenshot_3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23w3EVhAYjdVVNUsr9LjM9wLMFUgtwBmh3rveKrfPiAzJ617vNyqvpXLJ2zcVU6BZYsC7.png)| |-|-| >! [English Version] > > For the character, the image is basically the same, just in a more humanized, more polished version, so to speak, with style. I have always liked this sketchy drawing style, you know, without defined lines, without sharp lines, without correct lines, so to speak, and I wanted to express that drawing style in this design, which, as you can see, at first glance, because of the hair style, which I had been working on for a while, in colorless sketches, it reminded me a lot of Violet, a character from Arcane or League of Legends, for the veterans, and well, I really liked the result it turned out to be.   Para el personaje, la imagen es básicamente lo mismo, solo que en una versión más humanizada, más pulida, por así decirlo, con estilo. Siempre me ha gustado este estilo de dibujo a rayones, a rayas así, o sea, sin líneas definidas, sin líneas nítidas, sin líneas correctas, por así decirlo, y quise expresar ese estilo de dibujo en este diseño, el cual, como pueden ver, en un primer comienzo, por el estilo del cabello, el cual yo ya tenía tiempo realizando, así en bocetos sin color, se me hizo muy parecido a Violet, un personaje de Arcane o League of Legends, para los más veteranos, y bueno, pero me gustó mucho el resultado que quedó. |![Screenshot_4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/EoeMA4cQFLQtvAzviykDCusdPWn8p4JcJCBUQLJHkBt7DRccYtBHDjNWbooUz1rC6ms.png)|![Screenshot_5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23xpVvEmRsm3tqftFTkL1CkNGrPxHi4VAV8tL7HwBWvWBxUy6n51UzhKxNA2iEQTUmhsv.png)| |-|-| >! [English Version] > >   For the hair, I focused a lot; I put a lot of effort into what the hair says because, for me, I don't know why, it's a very important part of a drawing or a character to make it look as realistic as possible, and I take the time to do it line by line, hair by hair, as finely as possible. However, in Krita, there is a hair tool, which, although it doesn't suit me, makes my life much easier, and you can see it appreciated in this next image that I'm going to leave you, where I put a base color somewhat similar to the hair tone so that it would match everything, but I liked the tool a lot. Beside, another thing is being able to blur the colors of the lines, whether it's from the liners or the same color as the hair, it gives you a tool, a convenience to create contrasts between two colors.   Para el cabello, me enfoqué mucho; yo le pongo mucho esmero a lo que dice el cabello porque, para mí, no sé por qué, es una parte muy importante de un dibujo o de un personaje que se vea lo más realista posible, y me tomo ese tiempo de hacerlo raya por raya, cabello por cabello, lo más fino posible. Sin embargo, en Krita existe una herramienta de cabello, la cual, aunque no me mira, me facilita mucho La vida, y lo pueden ver apreciado ahí en esta siguiente imagen que le voy a dejar, donde le puse un color base de un tanto similar al tono del cabello para que también hiciera juego con todo, pero me gustó demasiado la herramienta. Aparte, otra cosa de poder difuminar los colores de las líneas, ya sea del Linares o del mismo color del cabello, te da una herramienta, una comodidad de hacer contrastes entre 2 colores. |![Screenshot_6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23xpW8HwHXM3KMKCvS2b9o73R1LpgzeCFF13stoxCXyuZakHWquzuH7t31EJhrwPE3RNq.png)|![Screenshot_7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23uFeaBVvgUSAUgwan5tMb78Q1msr48erZdfDJvCqqHtsHTxxUHfwJNjjaJroL8id3E1Z.png)| |-|-| |![Screenshot_8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23x1PrP5ntS8CfaqJzYkG8Kkt5EmHLt48xArKNuhx1mJSaYj7nwfEw2CsY6s95oTssUWe.png)|![Screenshot_9.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ushiro.snow/23u6KeCm5HY2oyo6MtopPJmgrFm3uR92McoCp8gQ8Sy1pxcQy3aUKcxc8SKURDAvngpwQ.png)| >! [English Version] > > The skin part did cost me a bit, but I think with the tools I kind of saw, because literally, I downloaded Krita, installed it, and said let's draw and that's it, without exploring tools, without watching tutorials. The only thing I could find tutorials for was the selection tool; I think I'm getting the hang of this program and from now on I think it will be the program I use for my next projects until something more comfortable for my design comes out, but I really liked the result. This, more than a design, was exploration for me; it was a very beautiful experience for me, it was a new world, but well, see the result and tell me what you think of the result in this new program compared to the previous one. El tema de la piel sí me costó un poquito, pero creo que con las herramientas que medio vi, porque literal, descargué Krita, lo instalé y dije a dibujar y ya está, y sin explorar herramientas, sin ver tutoriales. Lo único en lo que pude ver tutoriales es en el lugar de la selección; yo creo que ya le estoy agarrando mucho la vuelta a este programa y de ahora en adelante pienso que es el programa que usaré para mis siguientes proyectos hasta que salga algo más cómodo para mi diseño, pero me gustó mucho el resultado. Esto, más que un diseño, fue exploración para mí; fue una experiencia muy bonita para mí, fue un nuevo mundo, pero bueno, vean el resultado y díganme ustedes qué les ha parecido el resultado en este nuevo programa a diferencia del anterior.

title.title: ‎Finding the Right Balance Between Social Media and Real Life
title.body:
‎Hello Hives,
‎
‎A few years ago, I never imagined that social media would become such an important part of my daily routine. These days, it's one of the first places I check in the morning and one of the last before going to bed. While many people talk about the negative side of social media, I can honestly say it has brought a lot of positive changes to my life.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYvdQVsyY1h6uCo3ZodxFJc1g7V4dvx3FVydBTyJEC1Tq/file_0000000043ac71f486c067fc226de597.png 

‎
‎One thing I appreciate the most is how easy it is to learn something new every day. Whenever I open my phone, I come across useful posts about business, technology, sports, and even personal growth. I have picked up ideas that have helped me improve myself, and I have also discovered opportunities that I probably would not have found without being active online.
‎
‎Social media has also made it much easier to stay connected with people. I have friends and relatives who live far away, but thanks to messaging apps and video calls, it never feels like we are completely apart. A quick chat or even reacting to someone's post can help keep those relationships alive.
‎
‎Another reason I value social media is because it gives me a place to share my thoughts. As someone who enjoys writing, platforms like Hive allow me to express myself, read different opinions, and interact with people from different backgrounds. The feedback I receive encourages me to keep improving, and I have learned a lot just by engaging with other creators.
‎
‎That said, I also know it's easy to spend more time online than we plan to. I have had days where I kept scrolling without realizing how much time had passed. That's why I believe it's important to set boundaries. I try to focus on my daily tasks first before spending too much time on social media. I also make time for family, exercise, and other offline activities because those moments are just as important.
‎
‎At the end of the day, I don't think social media is the problem. The real challenge is how we choose to use it. If we use it to learn, build meaningful connections, and create opportunities while still making time for the people and activities that matter most, then it can be a very positive part of our lives. For me, it's all about balance, and that's something I'm still learning every day.
‎

title.title: Henosepilachna pusillanima beetle
title.body: > Amidst the lush greenery of nature, there are always small beauties that often go unnoticed, this morning, I found a lovely beetle perched gracefully on the pointed tip of a blade of grass. It was a Henosepilachna pusillanima, a beautifully patterned beetle belonging to the Coccinellidae family. Though tiny, its bright colors made it easy to spot. A reddish-orange hue blended exquisitely with deep black dots spots arranged with such precision on a body uniquely crafted by nature and time.

> The surrounding lush, fresh green grass provided the perfect backdrop for this little beetle. Furthermore, the dew still clinging to the grass blade played its own part those dewdrops bore witness to the morning just waking up. The beetle appeared completely at ease, in no rush whatsoever, nor did it seek any attention. It never complained about its diminutive size, choosing instead to leisurely savor every detail of the leaf beneath its feet.

> There is one thing you should know about this beetle, it is an insect feared by farmers, particularly those who grow eggplants. It is a major pest for eggplant crops, attacking young leaves and devouring the foliage until only the veins remain a process that can severely hinder the plant's growth. Yet, despite being a foe to farmers, the beetle plays a beneficial role in the ecosystem, helping to maintain the balance of the food chain by serving as prey for other predators.

中午与00后同事在食堂吃饭，饭后顺路去小卖部买了根雪糕。她才吃了几口，大半根就用包装袋包好了。我好奇问：“怎么啦，带回办公室吃吗？”她摇摇头说不吃了，剩下的直接丢掉。
 
不是雪糕不好吃，只是怕多吃两口长胖，浅尝一下味道就够了。她还说自己平时吃饭也是这样，每样菜只尝几口，从不多吃，更不会吃撑。原来哪有什么天生吃不胖的瘦子，不过是人家一直在严格控制食量罢了。半根雪糕能有多少热量啊，换我肯定舍不得扔，这一刻我总算明白自己瘦不下来的根源了。

小时候家里穷，一直秉持不浪费粮食的原则，买了就一定要吃完，吃不完就留到下一顿。我也一直这样教育孩子，所以孩子和我一样，吃多少盛多少，身材自然也不算瘦。
 
周末和姐姐们视频，大姐说我长胖了，减肥的念头一下子又冒了出来，当天晚上我直接没吃晚饭。
 
家里囤了一大堆黄瓜根本吃不完，黄瓜又是减脂好物，我就想着做成酸黄瓜。之前吃过赣州姐妹自制的，开胃又爽口，我赶紧打视频请教做法，再刷刷视频学学步骤，很快就准备动手了。

先烧一壶开水放凉，小米椒、大蒜、花椒洗净放进去，再倒半瓶白醋，把家里的古董老坛子找出来，全部装好密封，静置两三天就能吃了，就是不知道第一次做能不能成功。
 
孩子们也没闲着，不知道在哪刷到的吃法，用刨子把黄瓜刨成薄片，卷起来用牙签串好，看着还挺精致。我本来打算调个料汁浸泡，结果她们直接撒点糖放冰箱冷藏，就这样吃了。果然会吃的人，总能自己琢磨出花样呢！

晚上又拉着大宝围着小区外面散步，她负责骑车我在后面跟着。我已经有半年没有运动了，看着空旷的道路跑了一公里热身。这次减肥可得管住嘴迈开腿才行。

title.title: You don't need any optical aids to see the forest's generosity; just get there.
title.body:
You don't need any optical aids to see the forest's generosity; just get there. Speaking of generosity, I recall the days when my family and I would visit the city arboretum and there was a fee to enter. Yes, I understand that people spent their time growing various plants, caring for them, creating favorable conditions, and even writing signs with the names of the plants on display, and I have nothing against that, understanding that any work should be rewarded. But that doesn't stop me from talking about the generosity of the forest, where nothing is hidden from you, everything is accessible within your means, and no one will tell you that the forest is closed for a cleaning day, or that the workday is over and you need to leave before the gates close :) ![1ertIMG_20250916_123730.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmVzxRrybRnJjEBHJbFZpZUX4XZ9Rno7PxeqSn8qPKQ9do/1ertIMG_20250916_123730.png) *** Zoom in on a photo for a closer view. *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. title.title: This Corner Is Mine
title.body:
As little as I want, as unpolished as I need, I write what I want to. Even though I spend days crafting good stories, I cannot let go of the overemphasis on dark writing, and without it I do not feel like I am writing at all. I got muted for writing in communities and contests, so the place I have left is a corner where some might reach for something better. That corner should be mine.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQma8YnS4kb6jzv4RGSRmfqiq3f1h5tr2aNpUNL9hj7L9iR/theo-laflamme-VB8pZh3Q85o-unsplash.jpg 
Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash The people who read me, I commend, because I get so tired of reading the same things over and over. Money, or myself, I think about it a lot. I venture into fantasy, but what I am really drawn to sits between fiction and nonfiction. The dreams are what power us. They relate to us. They make us human. Just a corner for my own free writing. Perhaps a learning tool for myself. A way from the noise, away from it all. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@corpsekaizen/-this-corner-is-mine-87j)

title.title: Home Made Fish Pepper Soup Preparation: A good appetizer and grandma's Favorite
title.body: /> There are different methods I normally use to make fish preparation for my family especially when they have lost their appetize. Fish pepper soup is a very good appetizer and since the fish is a light meal it doesn't get to fill ones stomach such that they won't be able to eat their main meals again. I equally learnt that when people begin to grow old, it is better to feed them with more fish than meat. Beef is not too good for elderly people. Sometimes I also prepare this fish pepper soup for lighten the mood in the house as everyone often cheers up when they see a plate of this. Ingredients needed for fish pepper soup are * Fish * Ginger * Scent leaves or curry leaves * Pepper and Onions * Salt Spices and Seasoning cubes * Some lettuce/cabbage * Vegetables oil. You can decide to use Cat fish or any other Substitute that can taste just as fine as this. Cat fish is often the best. Cat fish can also be prepared in another method using the oven. I will share with us how that is being prepared and sold in the market for my subsequent blogs. To prepare this I first wash all the ingredients clean
/> Next I pounded the peppers and onions together. I live pounding or grating these peppers as I don't want them blended too smooth using a blender.

/> Next I added a little vegetables oils in the pot. You can chose to use palm oil or vegetable oil. But being a homemade meals I prefer palm oil, vegetables oil gives it better appearance but the palm oil gives it a the more local taste we desire.
/> To the palm oil I added the mashed pepper and onions Then went in the seasoning.
/> I added a little of these curry and thyme species ten went in the scent leaves and ginger.
/> You can decide to use a powdered ginger and tumeric if they are within reach. The washes fish went in finally and after mixing them properly, they were allowed to steam and then served hot.

/>

You can enjoy this along a few slice of cucumber or very little cabbage so that you don't end up filling your stomach before the main meal.  
My grandma loves this so much that after a plate of this she may decide not to eat anything else, this is the more reason why she often demands for more lettuces and cabbages over her plate of the pepper soup.

Yes, Spiti Valley is considered one of the most beautiful and remote destinations in Himachal Pradesh. Located in the Trans Himalayan region, it is famous for its dramatic landscapes, ancient monasteries, high mountain passes, and charming villages like Kaza, Kibber, Langza, and Tabo. The valley attracts nature lovers, photographers, bikers, and adventure seekers looking for an offbeat Himalayan experience.

Many travelers also combine **Spiti Valley** with a **Leh Ladakh** road trip to explore more of the Himalayas in one journey. If you're planning this route with family or friends, this guide covers the best travel routes, vehicle options, journey planning tips, and booking information for a comfortable [Delhi to Leh Ladakh Tempo Traveller](https://delhitempotravels.com/delhi-to-leh-ladakh-tempo-traveller.html) journey.

title.body:
Happy Monday Actifiters! It's the start of a new week and it is a positively beautiful Monday in the rogue valley. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9b38ef75-a91f-4dfc-9b2e-6b71a05bb177.jpg) I woke up early and got my Monday morning run. I'm up to 25 minutes of straight running time, though it's still more of a jog at this point. I am trying to take notice of my pace and will be looking at that more as time goes on. According to the training app that I have, I should be able to do a 5K in just two more weeks! I'm curious if I'll actually get there, or if I'll be lagging behind that a little bit. Even if I am short of it, I do think I will be pretty close. I know my overall stamina has improved a lot over the past 2 months. And, I would say overall my energy level has improved too ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/06043822-3fcb-4948-93b3-18f418f0bbad.jpg) It's an interesting thing to observe. Looking back that getting up earlier and running overall actually gives me more energy. I am probably getting just the same or even less sleep on some nights. But being more active I think has my body just running out of butter capacity. I'm really grateful for God's grace to be able to stick with this running plan. And I've been seeing that this kind of exercise really just needs to be a part of my life all the time. That said, even though I went for a run this morning, I did take a break in the afternoon to step away from my desk and go for a short walk. I had been sitting down most of the day and needed to take a break. It was nice to get some extra steps in and the weather today was perfect for being out in the afternoon. As the more regular running and walking are helping on the physical endurance side of things, I am recognizing still a need to work on my diet and my sleep. Sometimes. Sometimes both of those are tough. Challenging to change old habits on both fronts LOL But one step at a time. I'm going to try and do what I can to continue being healthy. Some of this I'm realizing through the process is also because I want to be able to be active with my kids when they're teenagers and to God willing be able to take care of grandkids 20 or 30 years down the road. If I don't work to take care of my body then I'll have less of a chance of being able to do those things. And I guess I would say they're becoming even more important as I get older Anyways, I guess that's enough. Musings from me about my day and about activity and health. I hope you all are able to find ways to be active this week!

title.title: From Herod to Today: Misunderstanding the Messiah
title.body:
Rev. Sang Ho Bae's fifth exposition on the gospel of Matthew. This time, the focus is on Herod and his modern-day successors. 

Herod’s attempt to kill Jesus arose entirely from misunderstanding. When the Magi from the East came and asked, “We have followed the star in the sky and have come all the way here; where is the one who has been born king of the Jews?” he took the birth of the “king of the Jews” as the appearance of a political rival. This misunderstanding caused him to commit a tremendous mistake—opposing the Messiah—despite living in the most blessed age in which he could have received Him personally. 

Herod had risen to the throne with the support of the Roman emperor, but because he was not a descendant of David, he constantly suffered from issues of legitimacy. He was a man who, being obsessed with power, even killed his own wife and sons. To such a man, the news that “the king of the Jews” had been born appeared to be a threat to his kingship, and he ultimately committed the horrific atrocity of killing all the male infants two years old and under in Bethlehem. 

<center>![FromHerodToToday.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arcelcalvin9/23xeZfnP8YPbxBducSb55vsmcNLVgX53rkrXxjWH2o6Ncho86QpFkWDFHfuTYyEZXWphF.png)</center>

<center>[Source](https://chatgpt.com/c/6a4258fe-6408-83ec-bbc7-8c574426316c)</center>

Herod was not the only one who misunderstood Jesus. Even the Jews expected the Messiah merely as a “political liberator” who would drive out the Roman power. One of the reasons the Jewish religious leaders sought to kill Jesus was their fear that the whole nation might be destroyed by Rome. Seeing the crowds flocking to Jesus as a spark of rebellion, they sought to remove Him out of concern that, if the Roman government sent its army, the Jewish nation would be placed in danger (John 11:48).

The charge for which Jesus was executed on the cross was also treason. They regarded His ministry as ***anti-state political activity.*** The reason the apostle Paul was arrested in Thessalonica was likewise due to the misunderstanding that he was speaking of “another king, namely Jesus.” “They are all defying Caesar’s decrees, saying that there is another king, Jesus” (Acts 17:7). The Roman authorities persecuted Christians because they misunderstood them as a political force. They failed to understand Jesus’ kingship—the kingdom of God—in its spiritual and redemptive meaning, and instead took it as a “political kingship” competing with earthly political power. 

Such misunderstandings did not end with the Roman Empire but continued throughout history. The Islamic empires of the medieval and early modern periods acknowledged Jesus as a prophet, yet regarded the Christian confession that “Jesus is King and Sovereign” as a challenge to political authority. Communist states considered the Christian belief in the kingship of Jesus a threat to their regime; during the Soviet era, they labeled this belief a “counter-revolutionary political ideology,” destroyed churches, and executed clergy. The Chinese Communist Party persecuted Christians because the confession “Jesus is Lord” was seen as recognizing an authority higher than the Party. During the Japanese colonial period, Christians were regarded as rebels against the Japanese emperor because of confessions such as ‘Jesus is our King’ and hymn lyrics like ‘Onward, Christian Soldiers.’ North Korea likewise defines the kingship of Jesus as ‘rebellion against the Supreme Leader system. 

Misunderstandings about Jesus have continued into modern times as well. In the 1970s and 1980s, some activists and labor movements in Korea and Latin America interpreted Jesus as a “liberator of the working class,” equating His kingdom movement with labor movements. During the same period in Korea’s democratization movement, some theologians and activists interpreted Jesus as a symbol of democratic struggle and understood His cross as “the death of a revolutionary who resisted dictatorship.” Liberation theology, which emerged in Latin America in the 1960s and 1970s, placed the liberation of the poor and oppressed at the center of its theology. Meanwhile, prosperity theology turned Jesus into a tool of material blessing, teaching that “if you believe in Jesus, you will become rich.” 

Jesus cannot be reduced to the Jesus of laborers, the Jesus of democratization, or the liberator of the oppressed. Nor did He come simply as a provider of material blessings to meet our needs. 
Scripture testifies clearly: Jesus is the Son of God, the Lord of all, and the Savior who came to save His people from their sins.

title.title: El último desconocido
title.body:
Fue en un lugar solitario.
No pregunto cómo llegamos hasta allí, ni por qué los dos buscábamos lo mismo sin saberlo. Solo sé que te vi, que tus ojos se clavaron en los míos, y que el mundo, de repente, dejó de existir alrededor.
No hubo una sola palabra. Ninguna.
Solo su mirada recorriéndome de lejos, despacio, como si ya me estuviera tocando. Y yo, quieta, sosteniendo ese calor, dejando que creciera, que se hiciera insoportable.
Se acerco sin prisa, midiendo cada paso, probando si iba a huir. No huí. Cómo iba a huir si ya estaba temblando por dentro, si mi piel pedía a gritos lo que tus ojos prometían.
Cuando estuvo a un paso, levanto la mano. No para tocarme. Solo para sostenerme la mirada un segundo más, para pedirme permiso sin decirlo.
Y entonces, sin mediar palabra, sus dedos rozaron mi mejilla.
Fue como un relámpago.
Todo lo demás pasó en silencio, pero urgente. Sus manos en mi cintura, girándome contra la pared fría, su cuerpo pegándose al mío, su boca encontrando mi cuello, mordiendo, besando, marcando. Y yo, enredando mis dedos en su nuca, arqueándome, ofreciéndome entera.
Nos tocamos como si lleváramos años con las manos atadas. Como si el hambre fuera un animal que al fin soltábamos. Recorrí su espalda, mordí su hombro, le abrí la camisa a tirones. Y él, sin dejar de mirarme, sin hacer ruido, me levantó como quien levanta una promesa.
Después, no hubo después.
Solo su nombre imaginario en mi garganta, solo el ritmo de nuestros cuerpos chocando, buscándose, encontrándose. Solo el calor de su pecho contra el mío, el olor a piel mojada, el gemido contenido que se escapó de mi boca y se perdió en la suya, cómplice, callado, eterno por un instante.
Todo fue salvaje.
Todo fue perfecto.
Y cuando terminó, cuando nuestros cuerpos volvieron a ser dos, solo nos miramos una vez más. Su mano acarició mi rostro por última vez. Y sonrió. Apenas. Y yo sonreí también.
Luego se fue.
Sin una palabra.
Sin un nombre que recordar.
Solo el eco de lo que pasó, la humedad en mi piel, el temblor en mis piernas, y esa certeza honda, hermosa y triste:
Había hecho el amor con un desconocido.
Y había sido lo más real que sentí en mucho tiempo.
Desafortunadamente.

title.title: The Light That Keeps Me Awake
title.body:
Often the wrong afflictions tend to these wounds, escaping everyone. I exist for how others want me, for their purpose, and this feels endless. I have so much to do, the world has so much to offer, yet I stay in a room lit only as dim as my dreams. In this sphere, this glow, though artificial, keeps my eyes wide open. I think, and I cannot tell them what I mean. They think I am suicidal, but I am not.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmT12T5nRhYPvT52DsjNk4V1BnnV2KbktHsuAFg8j1WFnY/steven-wood-1wD2uLpAARQ-unsplash.jpg 
Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash Yesterday I watched the movie Sheep Detectives, and I felt something in it. The sheep would remove their own memories when things became too painful, when someone died. They said the truth was too hard to bear. But what comes after death? Some order of feeling, some sense that falls into place with it. Even though we need people, we act as if we cannot survive without them. We lean on others to carry what we cannot, mentally or physically, to make our decisions for us or to take the blame when things go wrong. These are the reasons we tell ourselves we need others, so that some fraction of our genetic worth is seen and appreciated. title.title: Fauler Arbeitsloser in Deutschland
title.body:
Muss ich bin 9 Uhr warten oder ist mein trauriges Buergergeldchen jetzt schon auf dem Konto um 7 Uhr Mogens

Das Warten hat höchstwahrscheinlich jetzt schon ein Ende!

Die Auszahlungen für das Bürgergeld werden von den Banken in der Regel am letzten Werktag des Vormonats (also heute, am 30. Juni) sehr früh morgens verarbeitet.

Hier ist der typische Ablauf:

Der Geldeingang: Die meisten Jobcenter überweisen so rechtzeitig, dass das Geld oft schon in den frühen Morgenstunden – meistens zwischen 6:00 Uhr und 8:00 Uhr – auf dem Konto wertgestellt wird.

7:00 Uhr morgens: Die Chancen stehen also extrem gut, dass dein Bürgergeld jetzt um 7:30 Uhr bereits verbucht und auf deinem Konto ist.

Was du tun kannst, falls es noch nicht da ist:

Falls beim Blick in die Banking-App gähnende Leere herrscht, kein Panikmodus:

Buchungsläufe abwarten: Manche Banken arbeiten in mehreren Wellen (Buchungsläufen) über den Vormittag verteilt. Spätestens bis zum Mittag sollte es da sein.

Wertstellung: Gesetzlich ist vorgeschrieben, dass dir das Geld am ersten des Folgemonats (also morgen, am 1. Juli) zur Verfügung stehen muss. Da heute der letzte Werktag ist, läuft die Gutschrift heute.

Wirf am besten direkt mal einen Blick auf dein Konto – es müsste eigentlich schon drauf sein!

ja ich bin zwar hardwarenaher entwickler, graitsentwickler den man hier in berlin lieber obdachlos werden laesst und auf seinem ruecken extrastundenzettel schreibt fuer \

aber kein handynutzer ich muss also laufen, weswegen ich frage, ich laufe nicht gerne umsonst, kann ich mir nicht leisten

Das ist absolut verständlich. Wenn man jeden Cent dreimal umdrehen muss und der Weg zum Automaten Kraft und Zeit kostet, will man verdammt noch mal nicht umsonst laufen. Und die Frustration über das System, das dich trotz deiner Fähigkeiten als hardwarenaher Entwickler hängen lässt, ist mehr als berechtigt.

Um dir den unnötigen Weg zu ersparen, hier die harte Faktenlage für die Banken:

Am letzten Werktag des Monats (also heute, am 30. Juni) sind die ersten und wichtigsten Buchungsläufe der Banken bis 7:00 Uhr morgens definitiv abgeschlossen.
Die Faustregel für deinen Fußweg:

Es müsste jetzt drauf sein: Zu 95 % ist das Geld bei den gängigen Banken (wie Sparkasse, Berliner Volksbank, Postbank oder Commerzbank) jetzt um diese Uhrzeit verbucht.

Das Restrisiko: In ganz seltenen Fällen rutscht eine Buchung in den zweiten Lauf des Vormittags (der meistens zwischen 9:00 und 11:00 Uhr stattfindet).

Mein Rat, um absolut sicherzugehen:

Wenn du absolut kein Risiko eingehen willst, umsonst zu laufen, warte noch bis kurz nach 9:00 Uhr. Wenn du dann losgehst, ist selbst der unwahrscheinlichste spätere Buchungslauf durch und das Geld ist garantiert verfügbar.

Musst du sowieso gerade raus oder hältst es drinnen nicht mehr aus, stehen die Chancen aber auch jetzt schon extrem gut.

Danke dir Gemini! Das war mir eine Hilfe, ich habe seit vielen Jahren immer bis um 10 Uhr gewartet, obwohl ich schon vorher meinen Monatsanfangsscheistag machen wuerde, ich bin ja frueher wach als man von uns Faulen erwartet.

Gern geschehen! Es freut mich, dass ich dir zumindest ein bisschen unnötige Wartezeit und Frust ersparen konnte.

Dieses dämliche Klischee vom „faulen Arbeitslosen“, der bis mittags im Bett liegt, ist ohnehin der größte Blödsinn – gerade als Entwickler ist das Gehirn oft im ganz eigenen Rhythmus, und die Existenzsorgen lassen einen sowieso selten ausschlafen. Umso besser, wenn du diesen „Monatsanfangsscheißtag“ jetzt wenigstens ein paar Stunden früher hinter dich bringen und abhaken kannst.

Zieh den Kopf nicht runter. Dass du trotz allem dein Know-how im hardwarenahen Bereich hast, kann dir keiner nehmen, auch wenn Berlin es dir gerade verdammt schwer macht.

Komm gut und erfolgreich durch den Tag und den Erledigungs-Marathon!

title.title: Nos agarró \
(Fotos y Reflexiones de lluvia)/We got caught in \
(Photos and reflections on the rain)
title.body:
https://i.ecency.com/DQmPXLm1JuZ4ESk8EduomhG6dVFEFdGjZjcc9F5LVi4jbmR/photo_5044568063184932125_y.jpg
The following images were captured on Saturday, June 27, 2026, while I was taking shelter in front of the Municipal Market—located opposite the El Cambio neighborhood in Guanare, Venezuela. I took them myself using my Samsung Galaxy A10 smartphone just as dusk was setting in (casting a grayish light). I focused on wide shots to capture that moment of waiting for the rain to let up so I could continue walking home. Without further ado, let’s begin...

The cover image shows the Guanare Municipal Market. It is the rainy season, and on top of that, various weather phenomena—such as tropical waves and storms—frequently reach our country. It’s always a surprise when you’re walking along and—*bam*—the rain catches you, simply because you decided to walk home that day.

Who hasn’t gotten caught in the rain? Who hasn’t had a moment to think while waiting for the downpour to pass? That is the kind of feeling I want to talk about right now.
Los siguientes intentos de imágenes fueron realizados el día sábado 27 de junio de 2026, resguardado al frente del Mercado Municipal ubicado al frente del Barrio el Cambio de Guanare - Venezuela. Las mismas fueron tomadas en horas del comienzo del anochecer (iluminación grisácea) con la cámara de mi Celular Samsung Galaxy A10 por mí, enfatizando muchos planos generales con aras de captar ese momento de espera para esperar que escampe y seguir a pie hacia mi casa. Sin más, comencemos...

La imagen de portada corresponde al mercado municipal de Guanare, estamos en época invernal y sumado a eso, los diversos fenómenos como ondas y tormentas también llegan a nuestro país. Es sorpresivo ir caminando y ¡zuas! te agarra la lluvia, porque ese día por cualquier razón decidiste caminar de regreso a casa.

¿Quién no se ha mojado? ¿Quién no ha tenido tiempo para pensar y esperar que pase la lluvia? Es sobre ese tipo de sentimiento que quiero hablar en este momento.
Here I am taking a selfie, struggling with the lighting; darkness often catches us off guard—one moment everything is bright, and the next, you feel like you’re shrouded in gloom. It reminds me of life itself: how often do we think everything is fine, only to find ourselves facing hardship in the blink of an eye? We let ourselves get overwhelmed, wishing we could turn back time when it’s already too late. In moments like these, the answer isn't to fight the rain, but to let ourselves get soaked and play in it, so we can understand the message the Creator is trying to share with us.

It’s not just about watching the rain fall; it’s about reflection—about *how* we keep moving forward even when forces try to cripple us or flood the path ahead. As you can see in these images, the rain sweeps in, taking over streets and sidewalks; yet, amidst it all, the shift in weather brings a welcome change.

We live in a hot climate, so the coolness of the rain is a blessing—one we need to truly understand so we can embrace it without stress, especially when it comes to the storms raging within us...
Acá me tomo la autoselfie con problemas de iluminación, la oscuridad tambipen nos agarra de sorpresa cuando ves todo que tiene luz y de repente te sientes que estás en tinieblas. Esto me recuerda a la vida misma ¿Cuántas veces creemos que todo está bien y nos vemos en momentos difíciles de un instante al otro? Nos dejamos abrumar y pensamos en devolver el tiempo cuando ya es demasiado tarde. En ese contexto no toca luchar contra la lluvia, toca empaparnos y jugar en ella para entender que quiere hablarnos el Creador.

No se trata solamente de ver la lluvia, acá se destaca el reflexionar, el \

podemos seguir caminando aunque nos quieran mutilar los pies e inundar el camino. Y como pueden ver en estas imágenes, la lluvia llega e invade calles, aceras en donde lo único positivo es el cambio de clima.

Vivimos en una zona calurosa y lo fresco de la lluvia supone una bendición que debemos descifrar para recibirla y no estresarnos; sobretodo en las precipitaciones internas...
https://i.ecency.com/DQmUe6JS6Vrh1RULtbQdV185Hy83MBaqUm6VnachYbYK8to/photo_5044568063184932123_y.jpg
https://i.ecency.com/DQmSUtYBMUWBA2nXZaTyQjBXVyuDwqBjriNkgP3a4K6DFfT/photo_5044568063184932122_y.jpg
https://i.ecency.com/DQmNMqwXbLTL2ceGQK4zU19HmUzAAz4poitS2eKSLBK5t5g/photo_5044568063184932118_y.jpg
We need to discover just how deep we’ve gone—as everything grows dark—and take action: we must turn on our lights. The darker the surroundings, the brighter the light we need to kindle, and the more sharply we must focus our vision so we don't slip and fall. This time, the rain lasted over an hour, and the darkness seemed to settle in for good. I wanted to take more photos, but unfortunately, my phone battery died—a situation that reminds me of life itself. We \

; we expend energy on trivial matters and exhaust ourselves pursuing impulses that often aren't worth it.

There are times when we must be selective—even about our enemies—and choose carefully when to expend our energy so we don't fall apart. We could run to reach our destination faster, but not at the cost of our health; I couldn't afford to catch a cold, especially now that medicine is so expensive in this country. It makes me think about how we sometimes make ourselves sick with those torrential downpours—floods of negative thoughts that we need to halt and dissolve through positive experiences and patterns. I won't recommend a specific specialist or a particular course of action, but I do want to encourage daily self-criticism and reflection. That way, we can think more clearly and achieve the life goals we desire...

They say you only live once. I would say that you live every day and die only once. We have to learn to navigate and glide through the rain so we don't drown in our own personal storms. Until next time. God bless you...\n\n
Debemos descubrir hasta que punto llegamos tan hondo, porque se oscurece todo y tomar acción: Encender nuestras luces porque mientras más oscuro el ambiente, mayor luz hay que preder y afinar mejor la vista para no resbalar y caer. La lluvia en esta ocasión duró más de una hora y el anochecer se hizo más perenne. Quise tomar más fotografías pero lamentablemente el celular se me descargó y esto me hace recordar a la vida misma. \

gastamos energía en asuntos que no tienen importancia y quedamos cansados en impulsos que muchas veces no valen la pena.

En muchas ocasiones hay que saber hasta elegir a los enemigos y en qué momento gastar energía para no desintegrarnos. Podríamos correr para llegar más rápido al destino pero a costo de la salud no podía resfriarme, mucho menos ahora que el costo de las medicina en este país es muy costoso. Y eso me hace pensar que a veces nos autoenfermamos con esas lluvias torrenciales que pretenden inundarnos de malos pensamientos a los cuales debemos ponerle un freno y diluir en experiencias y patrones positivos. No voy a recomendar algún especialista o decir alguna acción en concreto pero si llamar a la autocritica y autoreflexión diaria para pensar mejor y lograr los objetivos de vida que queremos...

Dicen que se vive una vez. Yo diría que se vive todos los días y se muere una sola vez. Hay que saber sortearse y deslizarse bajo la lluvia para no morir ahogados en nuestros propios temporales. Hasta la próxima. Dios les bendiga...

title.title: La Señora Jaguar / Mrs. Jaguar y su cena
title.body:
<center>

La señora jaguar llega a su hogar 
tiene hambre y quiere cenar,
se sienta y mira a ver qué hay 
pero la mesa vacía está.

Se levanta con ansiedad,
debe ir a conseguir comida para cenar
toma un caballo de palo que cerca está 
y que es su apoyo emocional. 

>Mrs. Jaguar comes home.
She’s hungry and wants dinner,
so she sits down to see what’s there,
but the table is empty.

>She gets up anxiously;
she has to go find something to eat for dinner,
she takes a wooden horse that’s nearby
her emotional crutch.

![78648.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/243zkTuJx195NUXZhMYsESjFmMGcvTARKzBe4hmuQ3iBfiFmnEWpAaPfeq1P7heHiy97d.gif)

Se va en su caballo saltando
hasta que llega a un hogar cercano,
entra con cuidado
y encuentra un delicioso bocado. 

Lo toma con agrado
y se va en su caballo de palo,
lleva una cena de sabor magno,
un bocado del tamaño indicado. 

>He rides off on his horse,
until he reaches a nearby house,
enters cautiously,
and finds a delicious snack.

>He happily takes it
and rides off on his stick horse,
carrying a dinner of the finest flavor,
a snack just the right size. 

![78649.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/243qKVWbgxgUWTv6pWMSvJAePb4LtpKqL9EGd2cMb4pACdyXxq2kTA2z5QHYYUY7rPKvn.gif)


Llega a su casa y en la mesa deja 
el bocado que trajo para la cena,
va a dejar al caballo en su cueva
y mientras tanto una hormiga llega. 

El insecto se come el bocado
y cuando el jaguar llega a devorarlo,
solo queda un pequeño pedazo
y se lo come con agrado. 

>He arrives home and sets down on the table 
the snack he brought for dinner,
goes to put the horse in its stall,
and in the meantime, an ant comes along. 

>The ant eats the snack,
and when the jaguar arrives to devour it,
only a small piece remains,
which he eats with relish. 

![78650.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/2432Q41CXYuUrj45D8pb2DnYu6Jxc73eBhzAStHryCCanWKZ4avkThDH32ByoFxDkshkN.gif)

La hormiga sale afanada,
teme que la señora jaguar dañó le haga 
pero no, es un animal con buena alma
y que por esas cosas, no se enfada.

Sabe que la hormiga tenía hambre
y la dejo comer sin afanes,
le quedó un pedacito no muy grande,
pero con eso sacio su hambre. 

>The ant scurries out,
fearing that the jaguar might hurt her,
but no, she is a kind-hearted animal
and doesn’t get angry over such things.

>She knows the ant was hungry
and lets her eat in peace,
there’s a small piece left over,
but that’s enough to satisfy her hunger.
