title.title: Masking and Compositing in Kdenlive for Creative Video Editing
title.body:
As you become more comfortable with Kdenlive, you will eventually reach a point where simple cuts and effects are no longer enough. This is where masking and compositing become valuable. These tools allow you to combine multiple clips, hide parts of a video, and create visual effects that would otherwise require more advanced editing software.

While the techniques may seem complicated at first, they are built on a few simple ideas.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNbhUnYJuJqmcZTPUgL9uYVM8gcBN7ZhZxieoFrFRDzEH/ChatGPT%20Image%20Jun%2030,%202026,%2010_02_44%20AM.png 

## What Is Masking

A mask allows you to choose which parts of a clip remain visible and which parts are hidden.

Instead of editing the entire frame, you only work with the area inside the mask.

Masks can be used to:

* Blur a person's face.
* Hide license plates.
* Reveal part of another clip.
* Create split screen effects.
* Add selective color correction.

Once you understand masking, many creative editing possibilities become available.

## Understanding Compositing

Compositing is the process of combining two or more clips into a single image.

Imagine placing one video above another on the timeline.

Using a composition, Kdenlive decides how those two clips interact with each other.

This technique is used for picture in picture videos, overlays, titles, and many other effects.

## Working With Multiple Tracks

Most compositing work begins with multiple video tracks.

Place the background video on the lower track.

Then place the second clip or image on a track above it.

Once both clips are aligned, you can apply a composition or effect to determine how they blend together.

Keeping your timeline organized becomes increasingly important as projects become more complex.

## Creating a Simple Picture in Picture Effect

One of the easiest compositing techniques is picture in picture.

Place your main video on the first track.

Add another video above it.

Apply the **Transform** effect to the upper clip and reduce its size.

Move it into one corner of the frame.

This is commonly used for tutorials, gaming videos, interviews, and reaction videos.

## Using Blend Modes

Kdenlive includes several blend modes that change how two clips interact.

Some common options include:

* Screen
* Overlay
* Multiply
* Addition

Each blend mode creates a different visual result.

Try applying each one while previewing the video to understand how they affect the final image.

Small adjustments to opacity often improve the result.

## Applying Masks

Many effects in Kdenlive can be limited to a specific area using masks.

For example, instead of blurring the entire image, you can blur only a face.

Likewise, you can brighten a subject without affecting the background.

Using masks gives you much greater control over your edits.

## Animate Masks With Keyframes

Masks become even more powerful when combined with keyframes.

Suppose a person walks across the screen.

By adding keyframes, the mask can follow the person's movement throughout the clip.

Although this requires more work, it produces much cleaner results than using a fixed mask.

## Organize Your Timeline

Projects involving masks and multiple layers can become difficult to manage.

Use descriptive names for tracks whenever possible.

Group related clips together and keep overlays on separate tracks.

A well organized timeline makes editing faster and reduces mistakes.

## Avoid Common Mistakes

New editors often create masks that are too sharp.

Adding a slight feather around the edges usually produces a much more natural blend.

Another common mistake is stacking too many effects on a single clip.

If your project becomes difficult to manage, simplify the effect stack before adding new adjustments.

## Practice With Small Projects

The best way to learn masking is through simple exercises.

Try creating a picture in picture video.

Blur a moving object.

Reveal one image through another.

Combine text with animated backgrounds.

Each small project will help you become more comfortable with working on multiple layers.

title.title: ¡Una tarde diferente en #LaMasRicaTeta! 🍦 [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
>
Bienvenidos! 🙋🏻‍♀️
¡Hola amigos!! Espero que estén muy bien, por aquí, nos encontramos un poco mejor, y tenemos salud que es lo importante, bueno, como ya sabrán todo lo que ha sucedido nos ha tenido a todos con el corazón en la boca, por lo que hoy, haciendo unas diligencias, pasamos cerca de La Mas Rica Teta y pensamos, por qué no ir un momento?? Lo pensamos un poco, ya que al igual que muchos venezolanos estamos en modo \

por este sentimiento de culpa al saber que muchos están bajo los escombros o sufriendo en general, y la verdad no se va a esfumar rápido ese sentir, es el sentir, dolor, angustia de todos los venezolanos... Aun así, también es de entenderse, que debemos seguir adelante, no olvidando, sino siguiendo brindando apoyo, por lo que al final dijimos que si, iríamos por un helado y disfrutaríamos de un pequeño momento diferente fuera de redes sociales. Pedimos dos combinaciones que nos encantan, sunday de nutella y prestigio (chocolate + coco), debo decir que ambos estaban deliciosos, aunque mi elección me gusto más, yo amo el coco y el combinarlo con chocolate siempre me ha parecido una maravilla de Dios, el clima estaba fresco, y aunque todos los que estábamos allí teníamos caras largas de preocupación, disfrutamos de un rico helado, en un lindo ambiente, distraídos la mente un poco y fue bonito. Me despido enviándoles un fuerte abrazo, hasta pronto!.
ENGLISH

Welcome! 🙋🏻‍♀️
Hello friends!! I hope you're all doing well. We're feeling a bit better here, and we have our health, which is the most important thing. Well, as you know, everything that's happened has had us all on edge, so today, while running some errands, we passed by La Mas Rica Teta and thought, why not go in for a bit? We thought about it for a while, since, like many Venezuelans, we're in \

mode because of this feeling of guilt knowing that so many are under the rubble or suffering in general. And the truth is, that feeling isn't going to disappear quickly; it's the feeling, the pain, the anguish of all Venezuelans... Even so, it's also understandable that we must keep going, not forgetting, but continuing to offer support. So in the end, we said yes, we would go for an ice cream and enjoy a little bit of something different away from social media. We ordered two combinations we love: Nutella sundaes and Prestige (chocolate and coconut). I must say, both were delicious, although I preferred my choice. I love coconut, and combining it with chocolate has always seemed like a miracle to me. The weather was cool, and although everyone there had long, worried faces, we enjoyed some delicious ice cream in a lovely atmosphere, taking our minds off things for a bit, and it was nice. I'm signing off with a big hug, see you soon!.

---


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ4sDTrzWmxmHMWWXnjB92Q3TcrJ5svTd64jFUcMkGm3m/img_20260629_081044_664.jpg)

---

Transportation is an important part of our daily lives. Whether we are going to work, school, the market, or visiting friends and family, we all depend use one means of transportation or the other And we choose a particular means base on different reasons.
‎
‎People move from one place to the other using different means  and they have different and favourite means in which they prefer as their favorite means of transportation.
‎
‎When i was in school back then, we were taught different means of transportation and then we choose our favorite means base on the fastest and safest.  It was always sweet then . But now adays  base on the economy, we decide our favorite means by how much is in our pocket and how safe the means is. 
‎
‎These days my favorite means is by road, using car. And it's so because that's what I can afford for now, although now adays I limit my movement because the country is not that safe any longer. If the traveling Is not that important I don't go for it.
‎
‎So for now traveling by road is the favorite means and that's base on condition and also it allows me travel base on my own schedule, but  for flight, the airline company fix time for you. With time traveling by air will be the favorite because I think it's the fastest and safest, but cost is not that friendly at the moment. And another thing is that i am scared of water so using water is out of the game for me. The last time i traveld by water , i didn't like the experience. So i am not seeing myself trying it again anytime soon.
‎
‎Be that as it may, I know that other means of transportation have their own good and bad side. Air travel is the fastest option especially when it has to do with  long distances journey, trains can be comfortable and also safe if it is available but not that fast.
‎
‎So tell me whats your favourite means of transportation  and why ? You can make use of the comment section.

title.title: ‎World Cup Shocker! Paraguay's Grit Ends Germany's Dream in a Night Nobody Expected ‎
title.body:
‎If someone had told me before kickoff that Germany would be heading home after losing to Paraguay on penalties, I probably would not have believed it. Football has a funny way of reminding us that reputation means very little once the whistle blows.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQma4qdDEzg7qboaqWoRjbiyzkuggaDTGsjZbCY34EbAvF4/GettyImages-2283925383-scaled-e1782776012375-1024x683.jpg 

‎[Source](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/football/game/germany-vs-paraguay/lsbd71J48EFnBNE9/)
‎
‎Germany controlled possession for long spells, but possession alone doesn't win football matches. Paraguay came into the game with a clear plan, defended with discipline, and made every opportunity count. Julio Enciso's first-half goal gave them belief, while Germany looked strangely flat despite seeing more of the ball.
‎
‎To their credit, Germany fought back. Kai Havertz found the equaliser and gave fans hope that the four-time world champions would eventually take control. They also thought they had found a dramatic winner late in extra time, only for VAR to rule out Jonathan Tah's header after a controversial foul decision. Whether you agree with the call or not, it was one of those moments that completely changed the mood of the game.
‎
‎The penalty shootout was full of tension. Germany have always had a reputation for being one of the strongest teams from the penalty spot for many years, so seeing them struggle was surprising. Orlando Gill became Paraguay's hero with two huge saves, while Jonathan Tah's miss opened the door for José Canale to seal one of the biggest upsets of this World Cup.
‎
‎I also felt for Kai Havertz. He didn't hide after the defeat and accepted responsibility, even apologising to the fans. That kind of honesty is rare in football today. Still, one player should not carry the blame for a result like this. Germany looked below their usual standards throughout the match, especially in the first half, where they enjoyed plenty of possession but created very little.
‎
‎For Paraguay, this victory was not about luck. It was built on teamwork, resilience, and belief. They defended bravely, stayed organised under pressure, and never lost confidence, even when Germany equalised. Their celebrations at the final whistle showed exactly what this result meant to the players and their supporters.
‎
‎I believe that this match is another reminder of why the World Cup is so special. Every tournament delivers at least one unforgettable upset, and this one will be remembered for a long time. Paraguay have earned their place in the next round, while Germany are left with serious questions about their future.
‎
‎As a football fan, nights like this are why I love the game. They prove that no team is unbeatable and that determination can sometimes overcome history, quality, and expectations. Congratulations to Paraguay on a famous victory, as they have truly written one of the stories of the tournament so far.

title.title: Creating Procedural Stars in GLSL
title.body:
Stars appear everywhere in digital graphics.

Game collectibles.

Achievement badges.

Navigation icons.

Holiday decorations.

Particle effects.

At first glance, a star looks much more complicated than a circle or a polygon.

In reality, a star is simply another procedural shape built from mathematics.

Once you understand how it works, you'll be able to create stars with different numbers of points, animate them, and combine them with other procedural shapes.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbvv29cnWKLHiNurVH4nPWo9MsiJn9DpkxegxbPVSZato/ChatGPT%20Image%20Jun%2030,%202026,%2009_55_13%20AM.png 

## What Makes a Star?

A regular polygon has sides that all extend the same distance from the center.

A star is different.

Some points extend farther away.

Others stay closer to the center.

Instead of using one radius, we'll alternate between two.

A large radius.

A small radius.

Repeating those two values creates the familiar star shape.

## Starting from the Center

As in previous lessons, begin by centering the UV coordinates.

```glsl
vec2 p = vUv - 0.5;
```

Now every calculation happens relative to the middle of the screen.

## Finding the Angle

Each pixel also has a direction.

```glsl
float angle = atan(p.y, p.x);
```

The angle tells us where the pixel lies around the center.

We'll use that angle to decide whether the pixel belongs to a long point or a short point.

## Measuring the Distance

Next, measure the distance from the center.

```glsl
float radius = length(p);
```

This gives every pixel its distance from the middle.

## Creating Alternating Points

Suppose we want a five pointed star.

That means ten alternating sections.

Five long.

Five short.

```glsl
float points = 5.0;

float section = floor(

angle /

(3.14159 / points)

);
```

Every other section will use a different radius.

## Switching Between Two Radii

The `mod()` function helps us alternate.

```glsl
float edge = mix(

0.18,

0.30,

mod(section, 2.0)

);
```

Even sections become short.

Odd sections become long.

Together they create the outline of a star.

## Turning It into a Shape

Compare the distance against the chosen edge.

```glsl
float star =

1.0 -

smoothstep(

edge,

edge + 0.01,

radius

);
```

Pixels inside the edge become visible.

Everything outside remains black.

## Complete Shader

```glsl
#ifdef GL_ES
precision mediump float;
#endif

varying vec2 vUv;

void main(){

    vec2 p = vUv - 0.5;

    float angle = atan(p.y, p.x);

    float radius = length(p);

    float points = 5.0;

    float section = floor(

        angle /

        (3.14159 / points)

    );

    float edge = mix(

        0.18,

        0.30,

        mod(section, 2.0)

    );

    float star =

        1.0 -

        smoothstep(

            edge,

            edge + 0.01,

            radius

        );

    gl_FragColor = vec4(vec3(star),1.0);

}
```

This creates a simple procedural star without importing any textures.

## Changing the Number of Points

Three pointed star.

```glsl
points = 3.0;
```

Four pointed star.

```glsl
points = 4.0;
```

Six pointed star.

```glsl
points = 6.0;
```

Eight pointed star.

```glsl
points = 8.0;
```

Changing one number completely changes the appearance.

## Making Longer Points

Increase the larger radius.

```glsl
0.35
```

The points become longer.

Decrease it.

```glsl
0.25
```

The star becomes softer.

## Adding Colour

Stars look much better with colour.

```glsl
vec3 color = vec3(1.0,0.85,0.2) * star;

gl_FragColor = vec4(color,1.0);
```

Try gold.

Blue.

Purple.

Red.

Every colour gives a different feeling.

## Rotating the Star

Simply rotate the angle.

```glsl
angle += uTime;
```

The star now spins continuously.

## Adding a Glow

Reuse what we learned earlier.

```glsl
color += vec3(0.2) *

smoothstep(

0.12,

0.0,

radius

);
```

The center becomes brighter, making the star appear to glow.

## Where Are Procedural Stars Used?

Stars appear in many graphics.

* Collectibles.
* Achievement badges.
* Navigation icons.
* Holiday effects.
* Decorative backgrounds.
* Motion graphics.
* User interface elements.
* Particle systems.
* Magical effects.
* Procedural artwork.

Most begin with exactly the same idea we learned today.

## Try These Experiments

Create a six pointed star.

Create an eight pointed star.

Rotate the star.

Add a glow.

Animate its size.

Combine it with a circle.

Experiment with different colours.

## A Small Challenge

Can you create these effects?

* A spinning golden star.
* A glowing magical star.
* Two overlapping stars.
* A colourful badge.
* A rotating loading icon.

Every challenge builds on techniques you've already learned throughout this series.

## What We Learned

Today we created procedural stars by alternating between two radii while moving around the center of the screen.

Using angles, distance, and a little bit of mathematics, we generated one of the most recognizable procedural shapes.

This technique can be expanded into many decorative graphics and animated effects.




Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@hey2d/creating-procedural-stars-in-glsl-gxr)

title.title: A falta de gobierno, hay un pueblo La fuerza del venezolano ​EN: In the Absence of Government, There is a People The Strength of Venezuelans
title.body:
>
https://elpais.com/ciencia/2026-06-25/cien-anos-de-energia-tectonica-liberada-en-segundos-por-que-los-terremotos-de-venezuela-han-sido-tan-destructivos.html

Hoy el día me tomó sin energía y cada vez más triste, intentando sentirme agradecida y plena. En un país donde muchos aún están luchando por vivir y otros ya no lo lograron, sentarme a comer mi desayuno, estar en casa a pesar de los daños y compartir con mi familia es un absoluto lujo por el cual me siento muy agradecida. Sin embargo, hay una tristeza profunda que ocupa mi corazón por todo lo que está sucediendo; es algo en lo que ningún venezolano ha dejado de pensar desde el 24 de junio. Es un sentimiento nacional. Nuestro gentilicio realmente ha estado a la altura: aun sin recursos y, quizás, con la mayoría de las personas con solo un café en el estómago y sin saber cómo afrontar esta situación, lo siguen haciendo de todos modos.

​Today caught me with no energy and feeling increasingly sad, even as I try to feel grateful and fulfilled. In a country where many are still fighting to survive and others didn't make it, sitting down to eat breakfast, being at home despite the damage, and sharing with my family is an absolute luxury for which I am deeply grateful. However, there is a profound sadness filling my heart because of everything that is happening; it is something that no Venezuelan has stopped thinking about since June 24th. It is a national sentiment. Our people have truly risen to the occasion: even without resources and perhaps with most having only a cup of coffee in their stomachs, not knowing how to face this situation, they keep doing it anyway.

​El venezolano siempre se ha caracterizado por dar hasta lo que no tiene, y esta no ha sido la excepción. A falta de gobierno, hay un pueblo unido. No se imaginan la cantidad de insumos que se han recaudado. A pesar de haber sido el epicentro del terremoto, Yaracuy, gracias a Dios, no sufrió pérdidas mayores en comparación con La Guaira o Caracas, donde hay miles de personas que lo perdieron todo, y donde un apartamento o una casa fue lo de menos. Aún están rescatando a personas con vida de entre los escombros, y es allí donde empiezan los milagros. Aunque todo este proceso ha sido entorpecido por el gobierno, hemos recibido ayuda de muchos otros países; ha sido increíble el apoyo y el conocimiento que están transmitiendo a nuestros jóvenes.

​Venezuelans have always been known for giving even what they don't have, and this time has been no exception. In the absence of a government, there is a united people. You cannot imagine the amount of supplies that have been collected. Despite being the epicenter of the earthquake, Yaracuy, thank God, did not suffer major losses compared to La Guaira or Caracas, where thousands of people lost everything, and where an apartment or a house was the least of their worries. They are still pulling living people out from under the rubble, and that is where the miracles begin. Although this entire process has been hindered by the government, we have received help from many other countries; the support and knowledge they are sharing with our youth has been incredible.

​Están pasando muchísimas cosas y el terremoto no es lo único malo; también está la gente. La maldad sigue rondando las calles. Lamentablemente, se han llevado a varios niños —por no decir otra palabra— y eso me tiene muy consternada. Aunque podemos brindar mucha ayuda, si no existe una organización estricta junto con los \

competentes, ocurren este tipo de situaciones que nos desgarran aún más el alma. Saber que existe tanta maldad y sentir, de alguna forma, que les fallamos a esos niños que no sabemos dónde están, hace que sea imposible no tener el alma destruida.\n\n​So many things are happening, and the earthquake isn't the only bad thing; there is also the people. Evil is still roaming the streets. Sadly, several children have been taken—to put it mildly—and that leaves me deeply dismayed. While we can be of great help, if there is no strict organization alongside the competent \

these kinds of situations happen, tearing our souls apart even further. Knowing that such evil exists and feeling, in a way, that we failed those children whose whereabouts are unknown, makes it impossible not to have a broken soul.

​No tengo cabeza para nada más. No hay forma de que disfrute de algo sin sentirme culpable; no sé cómo dejar de sentirme culpable por algo que no es mi responsabilidad. Los venezolanos hacen lo que pueden con lo que tienen, e incluso con lo que no tienen. Lo cotidiano se volvió un lujo.

​I don't have the headspace for anything else. There is no way for me to enjoy anything without feeling guilty; I don't know how to stop feeling guilty for something that is not my fault. Venezuelans do what they can with what they have, and even with what they don't have. Everyday life has become a luxury.

title.title: Greed, Convenience / Tuesday / Early Evening
title.body:
![IMG_20260630_094425.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPARDhLWPgodUk3gTSBrmTYDwN4mW1nbt1PYJucwAJrtg/IMG_20260630_094425.jpg)

### Greed, Convenience
People don't realize they're being controlled by money. Families are broken because of it. If it is not money literally, it is either land or other material things. Money isn't actually the problem; it is greed that has grown within a person's heart.
When you are rich or wealthy, people want to be with you for potential financial gain. Again, they are driven by a desire for money. They won't care about you if you have nothing because many people only seek convenience.
Such people are dangerous to spend time with. They are not genuine and only care about themselves. It is easy to spot this kind of person. They may not realize what they are doing is wrong, but their actions reveal who they truly are. When you distance yourself from them, they will start to talk nonsense about you.

### Tuesday 
It's gloomy most of the time today, and there's been rainshower earlier. However, it feels so hot like summer. There's a typhoon coming and hopefully it will weaken. May it won't pull the monsoon winds which can cause rains. 

### Early Evening 
It's already early evening, and breezy. It's a great time for a walk in the Capitol Beachfront. Hopefully, the projects under construction will be finished because dust is currently the problem there.

title.title: Death
title.body:
We hardly speak about death as if it is real,
as if it isn’t quietly woven into the fabric of our lives.

But death is not a choice we make,
it is a certainty we meet often unprepared.

And then I remember the words of the Holy Book,
calling us to live with diligence and obedience
not just for today, but for what comes after.

The fear of dying should not push us into misery,
but into meaning.

Because this life…
is not the whole story
it is only a part of it.

title.title: Drawing Regular Polygons in GLSL: Creating Triangles, Hexagons, and More
title.body:
If you're new to the series or would like to catch up on the fundamentals, you can find every previous lesson, along with a summary of what each tutorial covers, here:

**[GLSL Beginner Series: A Journey from Your First Shader to Procedural Animation](https://ecency.com/@hey2d/glsl-beginner-series-a-journey-from-your-first-shader-to-procedural-animation-alj?referral=hey2d)**

In the previous tutorial, we learned how to create rounded rectangles using mathematics instead of textures. By combining simple functions, we built one of the most common shapes used in modern user interfaces.

Today we're going to leave circles and rectangles behind and learn how to create our first regular polygon.



If you look around in games and digital art, you'll notice that not every shape is a circle or a rectangle.

Hexagonal grids.

Triangular patterns.

Octagonal icons.

Stars.

Many of these graphics begin with regular polygons.

A regular polygon is simply a shape where every side has the same length and every corner is evenly spaced.

The exciting part is that we can generate them mathematically.

There is no need to import an image.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRdnYwH5iXqsibKUU5n7wsWnaZEL2VrK6V5sWygePjj5a/ChatGPT%20Image%20Jun%2030,%202026,%2009_47_45%20AM.png 

## What Makes a Polygon?

A circle looks the same no matter which direction you measure it.

A polygon is different.

Instead of having an infinite number of sides, it only has a fixed number.

Three sides create a triangle.

Four create a square.

Five create a pentagon.

Six create a hexagon.

The number of sides completely changes the shape.

## Starting from the Centre

First, move the coordinate system so the centre of the screen becomes `(0.0, 0.0)`.

```glsl id=\

vec2 p = vUv - 0.5;
```

We'll use this centred position throughout the shader.

## Measuring the Angle

Every point has both a distance and a direction.

GLSL provides the `atan()` function to calculate the direction.

```glsl id=\

float angle = atan(p.y, p.x);
```

The angle tells us where the pixel is around the centre.

Imagine drawing lines from the centre like the hands of a clock.

Every pixel belongs to one of those directions.

## Measuring the Distance

We also need to know how far the pixel is from the centre.

```glsl id=\

float radius = length(p);
```

Together, the angle and the radius describe every pixel around the centre.

## Dividing the Circle

Suppose we want a hexagon.

A full circle contains approximately `6.28318` radians.

A hexagon has six sides.

Each side therefore occupies one sixth of the circle.

```glsl id=\

float sides = 6.0;
```

Now the shader knows how many edges to create.

## A Simple Polygon Function

Here's a compact polygon calculation.

```glsl id=\

float polygon = cos(

floor(

0.5 +

angle /

(6.28318 / sides)

)

*

(6.28318 / sides)

-

angle

)

*

radius;
```

Although it looks complicated, the idea is simple.

The angle is snapped into evenly spaced directions.

That creates flat edges instead of a smooth circle.

## Turning It into a Shape

Use `smoothstep()` to create a visible edge.

```glsl id=\

float shape =

1.0 -

smoothstep(

0.28,

0.29,

polygon

);
```

You now have a procedural polygon.

## Complete Shader

```glsl id=\

sides = 8.0;
```

One number creates an entirely different shape.

## Adding Colour

Colour the polygon just like any other procedural object.

```glsl id=\

vec3 color = vec3(0.25,0.8,1.0) * shape;

gl_FragColor = vec4(color,1.0);
```

Try different colours to see how the appearance changes.

## Animating the Polygon

Rotate it over time.

```glsl id=\

angle += uTime;
```

Now the polygon slowly spins.

This simple animation appears in many loading indicators and interface animations.

## Combining Polygons

Remember what we learned earlier.

Shapes are just numbers.

That means we can combine polygons with circles or rectangles.

```glsl id=\

float finalShape = polygonShape + circle;
```

Or subtract one.

```glsl id=\

float finalShape = polygonShape - circle;
```

The possibilities continue to grow with every new shape we learn.

## Where Are Regular Polygons Used?

Regular polygons appear in many places.

* Hexagonal grids.
* Game icons.
* Sci fi interfaces.
* Loading animations.
* Abstract artwork.
* Technical diagrams.
* Badges.
* Decorative backgrounds.
* Motion graphics.
* Procedural logos.

Learning polygons opens the door to a huge range of procedural designs.

## Try These Experiments

Create a triangle.

Create a pentagon.

Create an octagon.

Rotate the shape.

Combine two polygons.

Change the colour.

Observe how changing a single value completely transforms the result.

## A Small Challenge

Can you create these effects?

* A spinning triangle.
* A glowing hexagon.
* A rotating octagon.
* Two overlapping polygons.
* A colourful procedural badge.

Each challenge builds directly on everything you've learned so far.

## What We Learned

Today we learned how to create regular polygons by dividing a circle into evenly spaced sections.

By combining angles, distance, and a few mathematical functions, we generated shapes with any number of sides.

This technique is used throughout procedural art, game development, and motion graphics.




Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@hey2d/-drawing-regular-polygons-in-glsl-creating-triangles-hexagons-and-more-em2)

title.title: Бретань, Франція, пляжі і собаки
title.body: Вражаюча різниця у відношенні до домашніх улюбленців у нас і у Франції. Та й у всій цивілізованій Європі, мабуть, порядки космічно далекі у своєму прогресивному та людяному підході до утримання четвероногих друзів.\nТак само космічно далекими від нашого є поняття \

у Бретані.\nЩо ми звикли уявляти під цим словом? Правильно: тапчани з лежачими на них засмагальниками, пісок з заритими у нього сигаретними бичками, в якому діти будують свої піщані фортеці... Ну по крайній мірі пісок десь може і чистий, але основне - на пляжі люди мають купатися, а потім лежати і засмагати.\nВ Бретані поняття \

включає в себе далекі подорожі та всілякі активності. Тому що берег Атлантичного океану, що омиває цю частину Франції, знаходиться під постійними величезними за масштабом припливами і відпливами. І вода тут ну дуже холодна: навіть влітку часто можна побачити людей в екіпіровці як для походів. Часто - людей, що займаються шведською ходою. І досить вільно тут гуляють люди із собачками, але тримають улюбленців на повідку. 
І, повірте, ні екстриментів собачих тут не буває, ні тим більше - людських. Як і сміття немає, бо ніхто не смітить. І все це - абсолютно безкоштовно!
Ну а про собак це взагалі окрема історія.
Їх тут дуже люблять. І створюють для власників всі умови, щоб собачки росли активними, здоровими і розвинутими в плані соціальному. Але й вимог до власників тварин тут дуже багато. Наприклад, ви не зможете просто так піти і в ту ж хвилину купити цуценя. Навіть взяти його з притулку не зможете, не пройшовши перевірку у вигляді співбесіди, кілька ознайомлювальних консультацій з утримання, випробовувального терміну і оплати, яка буває більшою, ніж у нас вартість породистого пса.
Ось так, тому і немає у Бретані ні кішок бездомних, ні бродячих собак.
Бо ЛЮДСЬКИЙ підхід до їх життя.

> *Пляжі, де дозволено перебування з собаками, набирають популярності в Бретані. Наслідуючи приклад регіону Пеї-Бігуден, де через рік після Пенмарк'ха місто Гільвінек відкриває своє узбережжя для собак на повідках з 1 червня по 30 вересня з 20:00 до 10:00, Лешіагат тепер робить те саме. Собаки їм дякують.* [цитата](https://www.letelegramme.fr/finistere/le-guilvinec-29730/cest-lendroit-le-plus-safe-en-termes-de-sante-animale-les-plages-bretonnes-souvrent-aux-chiens-carte-7073527.php)

title.title: Parasite: A Masterclass in Genre-Bending Cinema
title.body:
/>The movie “Parasite” directed by Bong Joon-ho is literally a cinematic miracle. From the very beginning, it is a hilarious black comedy where an impoverished family fools its way into the luxurious residence of an affluent family. However, at the midway point, one sound of the doorbell destroys everything, turning the story into a claustrophobic horror.

This movie impresses with the structural empathy that is built throughout the story. The Parks are not villains since they do not know anything about life beyond their walls due to their overwhelming wealth. The Kims are not villains either, but only people who learn to adapt to their circumstances.

The genius of the production design lies in its use of the vertical plane as a metaphor for class struggle:

Upper Mansion: Overfilled with light and representing blissful ignorance.

Semi-basement: Damp and suffocating and representing systemic injustice.

With its perfect pacing, great cinematography and numerous metaphors, the movie accomplishes the most amazing cinematic feat: it keeps you riveted in your chair while reflecting on modern capitalism.

title.title: Creating Rounded Rectangles in GLSL
title.body:
If you're new to the series or would like to catch up on the fundamentals, you can find every previous lesson, along with a summary of what each tutorial covers, here:

 [GLSL Beginner Series: A Journey from Your First Shader to Procedural Animation](https://ecency.com/@hey2d/glsl-beginner-series-a-journey-from-your-first-shader-to-procedural-animation-alj?referral=hey2d) 

In the previous tutorial, we learned how to create procedural rectangles using only UV coordinates and the `step()` function. Together with circles, rectangles gave us two powerful building blocks for creating procedural graphics.

Today we're going to combine those ideas to build one of the most common shapes found in modern interfaces.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmd5UiBvqM1KkuC1oJdxhK8M5Uo8DeBCMdoTDwJeDoWNa1/ChatGPT%20Image%20Jun%2030,%202026,%2009_44_05%20AM.png 

Open almost any application on your computer or phone.

Buttons have rounded corners.

Search bars have rounded corners.

Cards, menus, notifications, and dialog boxes all have rounded corners.

They feel softer and more modern than ordinary rectangles.

Instead of importing an image, we're going to build this shape entirely with mathematics.

## Why Rounded Rectangles?

A rectangle is useful, but its sharp corners can sometimes look harsh.

Rounded rectangles solve that problem while keeping the same overall shape.

Because they're generated procedurally, we can change their size, corner radius, colour, and animation at any time.

## Starting with a Rectangle

We'll begin with the rectangle we created in the previous lesson.

```glsl
vec2 uv = vUv;
```

Instead of checking four edges directly, we'll use a slightly different approach.

We'll measure the distance from the rectangle itself.

## Centering the Coordinates

Move the origin to the centre of the screen.

```glsl
vec2 p = uv - 0.5;
```

Now the middle of the rectangle is `(0.0, 0.0)`.

Positive values move right and up.

Negative values move left and down.

This makes the calculations much easier.

## Using `abs()`

The `abs()` function returns the positive version of a number.

```glsl
abs(-0.4)
```

becomes

```glsl
0.4
```

This allows us to treat every corner of the rectangle the same way.

```glsl
vec2 q = abs(p);
```

Now every corner behaves identically.

## Defining the Rectangle Size

Choose the half size of the rectangle.

```glsl
vec2 size = vec2(0.25, 0.15);
```

This means the rectangle extends

* `0.25` units left and right.
* `0.15` units up and down.

Changing these values changes the size of the rectangle.

## Adding Rounded Corners

Now choose a corner radius.

```glsl
float radius = 0.08;
```

This value controls how round the corners become.

A small radius creates subtle curves.

A large radius creates a pill shaped button.

## Measuring the Corner Distance

Now combine everything.

```glsl
float d = length(max(q - size + radius, 0.0)) - radius;
```

This line looks complicated.

Let's break it down.

`q - size`

Measures how far each pixel is outside the rectangle.

`max(..., 0.0)`

Ignores pixels already inside the rectangle.

`length()`

Measures the distance to the nearest corner.

Finally,

```glsl
-radius
```

moves the edge inward to create rounded corners.

Although the formula is compact, each part performs one simple job.

## Turning the Distance into a Shape

Now use `smoothstep()`.

```glsl
float rect = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.01, d);
```

Pixels inside the rounded rectangle become white.

Everything else becomes black.

## Complete Shader

```glsl
#ifdef GL_ES
precision mediump float;
#endif

varying vec2 vUv;

void main(){

    vec2 p = vUv - 0.5;

    vec2 q = abs(p);

    vec2 size = vec2(0.25, 0.15);

    float radius = 0.08;

    float d = length(max(q - size + radius, 0.0)) - radius;

    float rect = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.01, d);

    gl_FragColor = vec4(vec3(rect), 1.0);

}
```

With only a few lines of code, we've created a clean rounded rectangle without importing a texture.

## Changing the Corner Radius

Try different values.

```glsl
radius = 0.02;
```

Almost square corners.

```glsl
radius = 0.12;
```

Soft rounded corners.

```glsl
radius = 0.18;
```

A capsule shape.

Changing one number completely changes the appearance.

## Adding Colour

Colour works exactly as before.

```glsl
vec3 color = vec3(0.25, 0.75, 1.0) * rect;

gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
```

You can create buttons, cards, and panels using any colour you like.

## Animating the Corners

Let's animate the radius.

```glsl
float radius = 0.06 + sin(uTime) * 0.03;
```

The corners smoothly become sharper and rounder over time.

This demonstrates that procedural geometry is completely dynamic.

## Creating a Button

Add a soft glow.

```glsl
vec3 color = vec3(0.2, 0.8, 1.0) * rect;

color += vec3(0.15) * smoothstep(0.15, 0.0, d);
```

The rectangle now looks much closer to a modern interface button.

## Where Are Rounded Rectangles Used?

Rounded rectangles appear almost everywhere.

Some common examples include

* Mobile app buttons
* Search bars
* Cards
* Login panels
* Dialog boxes
* Notification windows
* Video player controls
* Progress bars
* User interface panels
* Dashboard widgets

Once you notice them, you'll see them in nearly every application you use.

## Try These Experiments

Create a thin button.

Create a square with rounded corners.

Create a capsule.

Animate the corner radius.

Combine a rounded rectangle with a glowing circle.

Experiment with different sizes and colours.

## A Small Challenge

Can you create these effects?

* A glowing button.
* A search bar.
* A rounded notification card.
* A pulsing capsule.
* A row of animated buttons.

Each one can be created by changing only a few numbers.

## What We Learned

Today we combined ideas from previous tutorials to create rounded rectangles entirely with mathematics.

By using `abs()`, `length()`, and `smoothstep()`, we generated a shape that appears throughout modern interface design.

Rounded rectangles are one of the most useful procedural shapes you'll ever build.



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@hey2d/creating-rounded-rectangles-in-glsl-bhv)

title.title: Parking Crisis in Delhi: Why Car Elevators Are the Answer for Multi-Storey Homes
title.body:
![Parking Crisis in Delhi Why Car Elevators Are the Answer for Multi-Storey Homes.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/953f67fc5e68798a91aa25e6f1b15d5e8f2522180223f2c8f1ef7dcf235872f8)

Delhi's growing population and rising number of vehicles have created a serious parking challenge, especially in residential areas. Homeowners with multi-storey houses often find it difficult to manage parking efficiently while preserving valuable space.

A car elevator is an innovative and space-saving solution designed to address this issue. Also known as an automobile elevator or vehicle elevator, it allows vehicles to move safely between different floors without the need for long ramps. This helps maximize available space and improves overall parking management.

Modern car lift systems are equipped with advanced safety features, smooth operation, and reliable performance. title.title: A helping hand for Tommy
title.body:
> Hoy mi post es para pedir ayuda, una mano amiga en este momento difícil, ya que literalmente nos quedamos sin nada para emergencias y estoy sumamente preocupada. Desde el día del terremoto mi gato quedo bastante afectado, no le paso nada físicamente pero su actitud cambio bastante, a pesar de eso los dos días siguientes estuvo “normal” solo mas nervioso de lo usual… Pero ayer el tercer día desde la tragedia amaneció muy extraño. 


> Today's post is to ask for help, a helping hand in this difficult time, as we literally have nothing left for emergencies and I'm extremely worried. Since the day of the earthquake, my cat has been quite affected; he wasn't physically hurt, but his behavior changed a lot. Despite that, for the next two days he was \

just more nervous than usual… But yesterday, the third day since the tragedy, he woke up very strange. ![IMG_20260629_094420_359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vhoFScaQfMYuU74d8NzNh3TTpNqwoT8Yos1BRsgmhgGCvNyKVC6nDGTkKFpmDtfrdnx.jpg)

>Desde que me desperté sentí que algo no andaba bien ya que el no me recibió, siempre me da los buenos días cuando salgo del cuarto, esta vez se quedo acostado la cosa me preocupo aun mas cuando lo llame y vi su actitud indiferente, no era normal ese comportamiento y la cosa que me termino de hacer entrar en pánico fue cuando le vi sus ojitos, sus parpados internos le cubrían la mitad del ojo, me asuste muchísimo. >From the moment I woke up, I felt something was wrong because he didn't greet me. He always says good morning when I leave the room, but this time he stayed in bed. I became even more worried when I called him and saw his indifferent attitude. That wasn't normal behavior, and what really made me panic was when I saw his eyes. His inner eyelids were covering half of his eye. I was terrified. ![IMG_20260628_095505_548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/Eos1KrLEJeaxtdxWbQ7eCVtxjcVn5VfoEq5QqMN2NC4N4En18XPEAw3Bm2KQ2k8JQeG.jpg)

>Mi esposo dice que el esta bien que solo estoy paranoica pero NO, el no esta bien, su comportamiento es anormal, no juega, no bebe agua no come, ayer paso todo el dia sin comer ni tomar agua tuve que acercarle las cosas y motivarlo a comer, al menos pudo hacerlo y por unas horas se mejoro bastante, incluso esta mañana quiso jugar conmigo, sus ojos se veían un poco mejor. Pero en el trascurso del día se fue apagando de nuevo, lleva mucho rato sin comer por mas que intento que lo haga, no ha tomado agua y siento que su pelaje cambio, se ve un poco mas opaco al igual que sus bigotes mas caídos, estoy extremadamente triste y preocupada. > My husband says he's fine, that I'm just paranoid, but NO, he's not fine. His behavior is abnormal; he doesn't play, he doesn't drink water, he doesn't eat. Yesterday he went all day without eating or drinking; I had to bring things to him and encourage him to eat. At least he managed to eat, and for a few hours he improved quite a bit. He even wanted to play with me this morning, and his eyes looked a little better. But as the day went on, he faded again. He hasn't eaten in a long time, no matter how much I try to get him to. He hasn't drunk water, and I feel like his fur has changed; it looks a little duller, and his whiskers are drooping. I'm extremely sad and worried. ![IMG_20260628_190632_790.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23zkpQiWuZ7SSZjC7scprHA4c3Np3q5YHpb67rxn2d8UgpsQjSYkzTBtgeJKBaozNJm7N.jpg) ![IMG_20260629_074132_203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23wC9VJswVPV26NVGnw8CGj4FEaZr8PAtxfdhwbXaSQJTnxqwWxwkAk5Wf7nnSy9615TZ.jpg)

>¿Habrá una posibilidad de que el terremoto le haya causado algún daño emocional? No lo sé, pero siento que tiene algo malo o que va más allá de eso y necesito que lo vea un especialista para poder sentirme mas tranquila, me siento muy culpable por pedir dinero para poder llevarlo al veterinario sabiendo que hay muchas personas peor que yo en este momento, pero tampoco puedo evitar sentir tanto dolor por tantas cosas malas que han pasado seguidas, de verdad que me siento totalmente devastada y esta situación no ayuda en nada, ahora tambien estoy sumamente nerviosa por mi querido Tommy no se si seré capaz de aguantar otro golpe o que algo malo de pase a algunos de los miembros de mi familia, te pido tu apoyo para poder visitar el veterinario lo mas pronto posible cualquier ayuda es bienvenida, actualmente la consulta esta en $30 asi que ese seria el presupuesto para poder llevar a mi gatito y ver que problema tiene. > Is there a possibility the earthquake caused him some emotional trauma? I don't know, but I feel like something is wrong with him, or that it's something deeper, and I need him to see a specialist so I can feel more at ease. I feel so guilty asking for money to take him to the vet, knowing there are many people worse off than me right now, but I also can't help feeling so much pain because of all the bad things that have happened one after another. I truly feel completely devastated, and this situation isn't helping at all. Now I'm also extremely nervous for my beloved Tommy. I don't know if I'll be able to handle another blow or if something bad happens to any of my family members. I'm asking for your support so I can take him to the vet as soon as possible; any help is welcome. Currently, the consultation costs $30, so that would be the budget to take my kitten and see what's wrong with him. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tGTmUL2HcM6btGbws43WP384W1EY2wn5jowQ8kZCPBh4P4YvqwmCbPAYy1zUEK46uue.png) ![IMG_20260629_212640_356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/Eq9SMiZkRVYtvEruybyKQaYX68dPZoN2vmy3NREaJp1WuKi77P9d8z69zq13nSH4x6m.jpg)

title.title: A Day of Creativity, Celebration and Learning Shared by Parents and Children Together
title.body:
![1000214228.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48Z7RLVdscd2V4mN4AjQW1wx7WaiGNtH9c6GxzaWjLi8G9NqHGujSneuWrTzLX2q2J.png)


Hello everyone! 

I hope you're all having a wonderful Tuesday.

Today, I want to share one of my experiences as a mother. I realized that being a parent in daycare is not only about bringing our children to school every day. We also have a responsibility to help our teachers whenever there are school activities.


![1000214147.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tbnkiuryoGuEhTq1JYoPFW9XiN5jxFuuzszVJbL1nYKxEtmgfkX9b4L6zZMf5GAm8Ze.jpg)


Recently, we had a classroom beautification activity at our daycare school. Since there are many students and they are still very active and playful, we know that our teacher cannot do everything alone. That is why we, the parents, volunteered to help. Nowadays Teachers are so busy in many tasks and they need the helping hands especially as parents. 


![1000214140.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wXBnjgbGdYHhaxC44kiwUoib1PW7D1CohmajZPjsFBzUrG5iCtot1Q3h3cydztJ7pBr.jpg)

![1000214138.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xepBnJheGpNPaepnbxpKNu56zy9XTgpwYByVY1LgAqSLaMV6dfuPg2FYpnQ41HDJ1eQ.jpg)

One of our projects was making a floor mat for the classroom. We wanted the room to look cleaner and more comfortable for the children. While some parents worked on placing the floor mat, others removed weeds around the school. Some also went to the garden to gather grass to make the surroundings look good and clean. 


![1000214142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23yJG8oUptmnPJtgSzsGYoKbzjCBU8pawgu8ZKCXPxrXGKagG1t3MtdogzhuNe6xMtycD.jpg)


I was happy to see that everyone had something to do. No one complained, and we all helped in our own way. It made the work easier and faster because we worked together. 



![1000212429.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/242DX8GxtxZfjY8qWmMmPRBv1nanbtZQ2cy9rVo9ibSvLLx2XTK4jiLVoNWp1qzLHZbL4.jpg)

The day became even more special because it was also one of the children's birthdays. Instead of giving expensive gifts, the classmates each brought a flower for the birthday celebrant. It was simple but meaningful. The birthday family also prepared bread and juice for the children, and everyone enjoyed the small celebration. They enjoy singing a happy birthday song. 


![1000213938.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23ynWT9GmwqxxLyG3nkszS3CBGtHv7YGLs2FAUjRLcWrVTrGXgJPyTdjtJ6Je19xvzmwt.jpg)


While we were busy helping outside, the children were also busy inside the classroom. They made their own name tags. Some chose colorful designs, while others made simple and neat ones. It was nice to see each child using their own creativity. They were excited to show their finished name tags to us.


![1000211412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/2423zKUSUQR5bFgDugGYwd2CgfuvBrkK2YASuBETqjkotFh6LcxwEHzvgs6Lc29hRNmyG.jpg)


As a mother, moments like this remind me that learning does not only happen inside the classroom. Children also learn by seeing their parents help, cooperate, and support their school. They learn that working together is important and that everyone can contribute in simple ways.

I am thankful that I was able to join this activity. It was another opportunity to spend time with my child, help our teacher, and meet other parents. Small efforts from each parent can make a big difference for our children. Also our friendship goes stronger and we build a camaraderie towards others. 

![1000213951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uQxeRXwgDGTwtc1ngyVPjt1MJXrnmCRto7xG6U47bib7phoLHjy6HVGDG7quMU1Qfet.jpg)



Thank you for reading my story. These are my own pictures, edited in Canva.

Have a nice day, everyone!

title.title: CALL ME A TIME TRAVELER OR SEER... YOU'RE RIGHT 👍
title.body:
The Seer Prophet as a Time Traveler

There is a dimension of the seer gift that is rarely named.

Not just seeing. Not just discernment. Something far more disorienting than either of those.

The seer prophet exists simultaneously in more than one moment. They do not merely predict the future. They experience it before it arrives.

In 1 Samuel 9, Saul comes looking for his father's lost donkeys. But before he can even form the question, Samuel already carries the answer. As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, do not worry about them, they have been found. Then Samuel does something even more remarkable. He tells Saul exactly what will happen as he walks away. When you leave me today you will meet two men near Rachel's tomb. Then you will go on until you reach the great tree of Tabor where three men going up to worship God at Bethel will meet you there.

Samuel was not guessing. He was not reading signs. He was standing in a moment that had not yet happened in the natural realm and describing it as though he had already witnessed it.

That is prophetic time travel.

The seer does not only see forward. The seer is pulled forward.

Jeremiah experienced the other dimension of this gift. Jeremiah 4:19. Oh my anguish my anguish. I writhe in pain. Oh the agony of my heart. My heart pounds within me I cannot keep silent.

What was Jeremiah feeling. The destruction of Jerusalem. But Jerusalem had not yet fallen. The Babylonians had not yet arrived. The temple still stood. Yet Jeremiah's heart was already shattered by what he could see coming. His grief was real. His pain was real. But the event was still in the future.

He was living emotionally in a time that had not yet arrived naturally.

Elisha carried this same dimension in a different expression. 2 Kings 6:12. The king of Syria discovered that Elisha knew the words spoken in his own bedroom, in private, before any messenger had carried them. The counsel of a king whispered behind closed doors was already known to a prophet standing somewhere else entirely. Distance was not a barrier. Time was not a barrier. The seer was already present in a room he had never physically entered.

This is one of the most isolating realities of the seer gift. You feel what others do not yet see. You grieve before the loss arrives. You rejoice before the breakthrough manifests. You carry the weight of future moments while standing in the present. And because no one around you has yet seen what you are already feeling, the experience can leave you profoundly alone in a crowded room.

This is why secular culture cannot make sense of the seer. This is why even religious systems struggle to contain him. The seer is not bound by linear time the way most people are. He sees the end from the beginning. He feels outcomes before decisions are made. He carries knowledge that has not yet been revealed naturally. And when he speaks, it often sounds impossible.

Until time catches up.

Seer prophet, understand this. You are not broken because you feel things others do not feel. You are not confused because you see things others do not see. You are not unstable because you carry knowledge of moments that have not yet arrived.

You are functioning the way God designed you to function.

The seer is a time traveler in the spirit. You do not only observe the future. You step into it. You hear it. You feel it. You carry it.

And when the moment finally arrives in the natural realm, you recognize it.

Because you have already been there.

title.title: El tiempo de Dios es perfecto Venezuela 🙏🇻🇪
title.body: >Hola y buenas noches a ustedes,son justo las 11:33 pm, momento en el que estoy comenzando a escribir,no tengo sueño,la verdad los momentos en que estamos viendo aquí en Venezuela no so buenos tiempos,desde mi ubicación del país les cuento que el temblor se sintió fuerte,y la señal quedó en estática, pero no fue un daño tan grande solo sentimos la sacudida,mi familia y yo estamos bien.** # > **

>Es la primera vez que comparto mis palabras aquí,y quisiera que no fuera en momentos tan angustiosos como los días que venimos pasando desde el 24 de junio,creo que ese día no se borrara de la memoria de lo venezolanos, pienso que deberíamos dar a conocer como hemos afrontado cada uno nuestra situación.** # --- **

>La distancia de dónde me ubico es de 5 horas en auto para llegar a la Guaira,por lo que solo queda ayudar con donaciones,y palabras de aliento para las personas afectadas,es muy lamentable ver como se pierde un hogar en cuestión de segundos,es algo que es difícil de creer, desde ese día no he dejado de seguir las noticias,se que no es recomendable, pero la necesidad de saber cómo va la situación es necesario.** # --- **

>Y es difícil no sentir empatía,no se cómo hay personas tranquilas con este grandísimo desastre.Eso no me ha dejado dormir,y creo que así estamos más de uno , porque las calles están en silencio,casi no se oyen las voces de las personas,es como un silencio parecido al de un velorio. No es para menos,ya que desde hace tiempo que no pasa una gran tragedia,y ver cómo muchas personas perdieron a un ser querido,o la cantidad de fallecidos,no es fácil de digerir. Pienso en los problemas que hemos vivido todos los venezolanos y en como hemos salido adelante, pero está vez el problema ganó la batalla,eso pensé en un momento.** # --- **

>Pero pidamos la revancha por los caídos, porque no es justo que no hagamos honor dándonos por vencidos, sigamos adelante así como siempre lo hemos hecho,solos en la batalla, porque si observamos bien,la tierra sigue girando,y si ella no se detiene aún recibiendo daños, porque debemos detenernos nosotros? Cómo venezolana que conoce muy bien lo que estamos viviendo,te mando mis palabras de fuerza, porque se que no es fácil,se lo que es perder a nuestros seres queridos y se por lo que hemos vivido, confiemos en las manos de dios.** # --- *

>El tiempo de Dios es perfecto,y todo lo cura.* # --- # *

title.title: RECIPE: Exquisite carrot cake with cinnamon and coconut (Eng-Esp)
title.body: <center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23yJNy6kJ8a7fJg33jWESRQ4LLjTdVXZ98FpgkcCDyXPb2Tafq1fWYjqyLpschM8brLVx.png)</center>\n\n* Good evening, dear Hivers! I hope you’re all doing great. Here is the appetizing dessert I prepared today for a snack with my family... Let's put on our aprons and make a \

.\n\n>* Buenas noches queridos hivers, espero se encuentren genial! A continuación, comparto con ustedes el apetitoso postre que preparé hoy para merendar con mi familia... Pongámonos el delantal para realizar un \

.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23ywyUaZCwpU4mJfuNrZToWNqk5jU8sto8qKimBcu5T4oepRgtbykFPqvBFNp1mCY5X3U.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23y8yr8gcaDVvCyHwk7tuLpghWWfgs87fTvPdscnt97ccLb6sBx498DtKd6RrpnE463vQ.png)</center>

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* Place 4 eggs in a bowl and beat at high speed until they become frothy and double in volume. Add 1/4 cup of sunflower oil, 2 tablespoons of vanilla extract, and 1/2 cup of brown sugar or powdered sweetener (as needed).

>* Incorporamos en un bowl 4 huevos, batimos a máxima potencia hasta que tomen una textura espumosa y dupliquen su tamaño. Añadimos 1/4 taza de aceite de girasol, 2 cucharadas de esencia de vainilla y 1/2 taza de azúcar morena o edulcorante en polvo (cantidad necesaria). 

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23yJT4gCrXgjMMHSqSteDgbKDEm8v9cJKkeUojjFKSU1e76rue2y6Edq1F8dsFFJNKdA8.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23x1HpyAqppJKWmiYULJ67AJxZeBqZPGwudkmNe6X9bn8YqxLXuK9PYyAQud4NbiNAACR.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xerUJsLRaVpLemrgw4Nv4kjgqyj6jR32ZkFKud5utiHs6zt2rWiJargWZFYvAiYBoym.png)</center>

* In this step, add 1 cup of wheat flour, 1 teaspoon of baking powder, a pinch of salt, and 1 heaping teaspoon of ground cinnamon (all previously sifted)... Beat at \

speed until well combined.\n\n>* En este paso, colocamos 1 taza de harina de trigo, 1 cucharadita de polvo de hornear, pizca de sal y 1 cucharadita colmada de canela en polvo (previamente tamizado)... Batimos a velocidad \

hasta integrar bien.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EoCmSNdwqgynkzcxWPrehbaqtC8rCZQag4WP9vDfFaEC5XBCqLsGfEdd2pKaU6vGmcL.png)</center>

* We add the carrot—grating it on the coarse side... Then we add the shredded coconut; this ingredient will provide a slightly rustic texture that I’m sure you’ll love!

>* Incorporamos la zanahoria, rallamos por el lado grueso... Agregamos el coco rallado, este ingrediente aportará una textura ligeramente rústica que estoy segura amarán!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23vsav6sxkR7Z5zh7WhHSq1TqCfaby85o8vc1mdvue2G8KUz3dJA3GdXNuQjC5tCpZ8g1.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/242YGes367UWiNUiUWdq6Y18czJJhxhCNUvEsaGXdtqZT76DxmRAzdrtLpfDmSLJSdy2y.png)</center>

* Grease and flour a baking dish, then pour in our delicious mixture. Bake at 180°C for 50 minutes, or until done.

>* Enmantequillamos y enharinamos un envase refractario, colocaos nuestra suculenta mezcla. Horneamos a 180° durante 50 minutos o hasta comprobar que está listo.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EogPjTks2bdsvQ1HVJWTAJFnmJpEg8kriGh1p5hy7SGaFMivJvGrpbbaQScnkekLL7c.png)</center>

* Our appetizing cake is ready; we wait a few minutes before unmolding it.

>* Nuestro apetitoso bizcocho está listo, esperamos unos minutos para desmoldar.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xenQAiWQfPbWysCb9Pnce1Sed3jmkvqWhAJoKWYiMdqQzgB9RzyS8RpQyGQzXWWAjgV.png)</center>

* Friends, here is a wonderful snack idea for you... You’re going to love the incredibly delicious texture!
Thank you so much for visiting my blog; I hope you enjoyed the process. I’m sure this cake will become one of your favorite desserts!

>* Amigos, a continuación les presento una maravillosa forma de merendar... Disfrutarán de una textura MUY sabrosa!
Muchas gracias por visitar mi blog, espero hayan disfrutado el proceso, estoy segura que este pastel se convertirá en uno de sus postres favoritos!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23ywyUaZCwpU4mJfuNrZToWNqk5jU8sto8qKimBcu5T4oepRgtbykFPqvBFNp1mCY5X3U.png)</center>

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71782780906.0349169) Hey everybody! Today was the day I worked the fireworks stand for our church. That little squirrel is hiding in the log as he’s afraid…..very afraid! 🙀 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71782780985.474234) This 18’+ trailer is parked at the fairgrounds in Lynden, Washington as it is every year. The sale is to raise money for the youth program at the church and is the biggest fundraiser for the year! In mine and @silvertop’s past life in Ohio-we were somewhat masters of fireworks. There was one year most of our stuff were 250 footers or 125 footers! They were definitely professional grade, and we loved every minute of it! Fast forward to Washington state and our property. Two of the many trees located on our property we dated were mere seedlings when Christopher Columbus landed in America! Can you say a 250’ + Roman candle should that tree go up in flames? 😳 Too many cedar and fir trees to shoot off fireworks here! Alas, our pyro days were over! 😔 Fireworks have changed. They still have the big boys but just what is a Robo Bat or a Pooping Dog anyway?! Take a look at the offerings of this stand! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71782781431.8848782) That’s Amanda there in the picture. We work two volunteers at a time and the gal who was to work with me was a no show. Not sure why-she confirmed last night. I just hope everything is okay with her. Amanda hung out for an hour or so, but had just worked her own 2 hour stint as I arrived. Eventually she got to go leaving me mostly on my own. Not a real problem but when a customer said they wanted something specific, I’d have to ask them to point it out as I generally didn’t know what they were talking about, lol! It all worked out and I made some nice sales. At 4 PM, my replacement showed up and I was free to go. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71782781686.784709) I understand they still need shift workers on Saturday. Not sure if I’m going to do that as I’ve got some things that need doing then. We’ll see. Here’s Cot sleeping before the upcoming fireworks storm this weekend. He does not like it! Our neighbor, despite living in a cedar and fir tree forest is having a party which we’ve been told will be ‘Bigger and better’ than last year’s. We weren’t too happy then; I doubt we will be happy about it this year. It would be too late should we need the fire department! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71782782182.747696) That’s it for today. Take care and enjoy the rest of your day wherever you are! 🙏🌏🙏 👣🐑☕️🎆🎇😎👍😁😳🙀🌙🥱😴 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71782782325.024942) BSB 1Peter 3:8-13 Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble. Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing. For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech. He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it. For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.” Who can harm you if you are zealous for what is good? 🙏🌹

title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g7ea6c15c3ae74e2d1d0c3cd96e05bfa65893e4d8d29f2cf875309f310eb8fe7e24bc1b1af19a50f5fd95544df274ef557be708783dbcb3a850693b24d35d991b_640.jpg)</center>

***

当然可以！以下是一个关于自然的博客主题建议，使用Markdown格式：

```markdown
# 探索四季的变迁

四季的变化是自然界中最迷人的现象之一。每个季节都有其独特的魅力和特点，让我们一同深入探索这四个不同的季节。

## 春天：复苏与新生

春天是万物复苏的季节，树木发芽，花朵绽放。这个季节象征着新的开始和希望。

- **气候**：温暖而湿润
- **代表花卉**：樱花、郁金香、迎春花
- **活动建议**：
  - 参加春游，享受大自然的美丽
  - 在家中种植花草，感受种植的乐趣

## 夏天：热情与活力

夏天是阳光明媚的季节，适合户外活动和旅行。人们常常在海滩、山野间享受阳光。

- **气候**：炎热而干燥
- **代表活动**：游泳、露营、烧烤
- **活动建议**：
  - 计划一次海滩度假，享受阳光与海浪
  - 在公园举办野餐，与朋友共享美好时光

## 秋天：丰收与宁静

秋天是丰收的季节，树叶变色，空气中弥漫着丰收的气息。这个季节让人感受到宁静与沉思。

- **气候**：凉爽而干燥
- **代表活动**：采摘水果、观赏红叶
- **活动建议**：
  - 参加当地的丰收节，体验农田的乐趣
  - 在森林中徒步旅行，欣赏秋天的美丽景色

## 冬天：沉静与反思

冬天是一个沉静的季节，白雪覆盖大地，万物似乎都在休息。这个季节给予我们反思的时间。

- **气候**：寒冷而干燥
- **代表活动**：滑雪、温泉
- **活动建议**：
  - 在雪地中滑雪或打雪仗，享受冬季运动的乐趣
  - 在家中享受温暖的饮品，阅读一本好书，进行深思熟虑的反思

## 结语

四季的变化让我们感受到自然的神奇与美丽。无论是春天的生机、夏天的活力、秋天的宁静，还是冬天的沉静，每个季节都有其独特的魅力。让我们珍惜每一个季节，感受自然的魅力吧！
```

希望这个主题能够激发你的灵感，帮助你创作出精彩的自然博客文章！

title.title: DIY paper organizer
title.body:
**Hi everyone!**

Welcome to my new blog. Hope you all are doing great. Few days ago,  I decided to do some diy but I was not getting the time. But today I decided to take out some time and made an oganizer. So today I am here  to share the organizer that I made. First I will share the final look then I will share the steps. But unfortunately some steps were deleted but I tried to explain i well hope you will understand it.

**First see the final look** 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQat7EUTc1ZHuLcX6HWb6rKwXfFn4GT21vJ7QRGA8ypN9/1782791757023.jpg)

**Here I am sharing the materials that I used**

Yellow color paper 
Scissors 
Scale
Pencil
Glue

**Step by step procedure:**

First I took paper and cut it into 15cmx15cm piece. I made three pieces like this. Then, I took one paper and fold it diagonally. Then, I opened and folded it to another diagonal. Then, I opened it. And folded this paper from the corners. Then, folded it from the sides and opened it. Then, folded it from the sides and opened it. Then, I folded it like the steps that I showed and made box. Like this I made three boxes. Then, I took paper and cut it in rectangular pieces and made sticks out of it.

![June 2026 Blogs.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wMjGH1JAzLdnFsF31umdmgKiRy8pQpxEMQszCFsNZw18iRg32BeLWdkEiFyNVg7wyjX.png)

***Today I want to share one of the places we visited for an overnight staycation. Our family stayed at <u>\

in Albay</u>, and it turned out to be a wonderful choice for our small celebration.*** It is a cozy place that is perfect for a bed and breakfast experience, family gatherings, special occasions, and even intimate events.

![IMG_4417.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wgaouHwFEFNuEg7pYGKjvQygTU6ZoodUZsu8dYvzAg4q6ajhvMido7dZ4BNpkt7gkk2.jpeg)

![IMG_4437.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23vi4AHV7BNDQqr3Wzyc4kDRXyN6PvehfuKexHiyHoCocbE4VVW6ucbSviUN1QY49V8sK.jpeg)

***When we arrived, we immediately noticed how beautiful and well-maintained the property was.*** ***The ambiance was peaceful, and the design gave us a relaxing vacation vibe.*** We explored the place before settling into our room. The first and second floors were beautifully decorated, with clean and comfortable spaces that made us feel welcome. ***Every corner was simple yet elegant, making it a nice spot to take photos and enjoy the surroundings.***

![IMG_4390.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/242DNytL3WNnVnR4i3ZUyAfvMQoeboyWATrr4viCBK9TxwwQ4DyPai5wyePkafPvC1QMX.jpeg)

![IMG_4517.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23ywKTiw4WKCwyL1P3hrEkhtpxME2dDUGxri7icRrT6oMtZYkzW7cKgAkhR542b62g7K3.jpeg)

On the third floor, there was a mini swimming pool where guests could cool off and relax. There were also tables and chairs on the side, perfect for family meals and small celebrations. ***It was a great area to spend quality time together while enjoying good food and conversations. I could imagine it being a lovely venue for birthdays, reunions, and simple gatherings.***

![IMG_4511.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/Ep7v9cTpQfmuF7Jxz5aCc6cABgHUSUmCqx67nW4S71rnuJpdCShkLU3pmYgTqBJm5ox.jpeg)

![IMG_4512.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EppKgwKogGTNgV1PibRcqPjvNddo4T9TXKgDrQMvJ2fgWtngcAsV38ZyeoTKmU6oh6J.jpeg)

![IMG_4513.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EpT47uVQggnJMcbD3nEXkNGYM8UvXs9iVc7ab3nshxY8kCtMZeFcAZecUS8QZbzNGWX.jpeg)

![IMG_4514.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EpVCbg7qkBGPcdUktY1MUAT5vhWvj69XzwuiyVLufP9wmiHYMsQ9W6RayVTnA7kdKpw.jpeg)

***The room we booked was surprisingly spacious. It had a comfortable living room with a sofa set and a television where we could relax together. The bedroom had four beds, giving everyone enough space to rest comfortably after a long day.*** There was also a clean bathroom and a mini kitchen, which made our stay even more convenient since we could prepare light snacks and drinks whenever we wanted.

![IMG_4416.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EoEstiQRKkD4WM8K5WegQdfDbtAMXhzS5MbH7sbPmxHaCF2zEvsKxtJsGrYZrKyw5Zc.jpeg)

![IMG_4392.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EpCBLGehUjvdpP6rxnJPnGC9vsyH6YNqedF1bzz3u9kA9zk1xZEYnK5NekNJZFA24TW.jpeg)

![IMG_4393.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/Ep1bDs7gmcSeGuoKQu5NwmKX2K6AX4kTC99UyUzSrKL1Guazd4DcmqLVrJp1aMTMdDV.jpeg)

![IMG_4394.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EpGUbkf44SRfDpbs6fQ39LK4punAYTeH8cChPTUuVvZWF5VDsHBZSHd4ncDaZFREs2j.jpeg)

***What made our stay even better was the kindness of the staff.*** They greeted us warmly, answered our inquiries politely, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our stay. ***Their friendly attitude made us feel welcome and added to the overall pleasant experience.***

![IMG_4518.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23xyZaJDVMQE7pdb1bafxAu4AMhF8jr7eBxw8TurQv3QdSvKg7VRcehNvC6jV8TDhPSVT.jpeg)

![IMG_4517.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23ywKTiw4WKCwyL1P3hrEkhtpxME2dDUGxri7icRrT6oMtZYkzW7cKgAkhR542b62g7K3.jpeg)

***Our overnight stay at <u>\

</u> was indeed memorable for all of us.*** It was a relaxing place where we enjoyed each other's company, shared delicious meals, and created wonderful family memories. ***I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and peaceful staycation in Albay. It is a hidden gem that offers comfort, good service, and a warm atmosphere that families will surely appreciate.***

***And that's it for today's blog! Thank you so much for dropping by and taking the time to read my simple life story. This means a lot to me! I hope you enjoyed it and see you on my next one. Have a nice day ahead to all of us.***😍

***These photos were mine and taken with my iphone13pro and the lead image was edited through Canva.***✍️👩‍💻

**Lots of love,
LJ**💗

title.title: Los 18 de mi princesa | My Princess's 18th Birthday
title.body: > Cada día de vida es suficiente motivo para agradecer y hoy agradezco la fortuna de estar con mi hija este día, 29 de junio de 2026, cuando cumple sus 18 años. Teníamos algunos planes que quedaron a un lado por la situación que vive nuestro país, que nos recuerda lo vulnerables que somos y lo valioso que es dormir cada noche en nuestras camas. Aún en medio de la tormenta, no puedo menos que agradecer por la vida de cada persona que amo. En días como estos es difícil sonreír sin sentirse culpable, pero también es evidente que la simple cotidianidad es un tesoro invaluable. Cuántas personas no quisieran hoy que sus problemas fueran tener que levantarse temprano, preparar el desayuno, llevar a los niños a la escuela, ir a trabajar, ingeniárselas para alargar el presupuesto y un largo etcétera. Pero hoy celebro la vida de mi hija, así que me permito cambiar el tono y compartir lo que en realidad hicimos.

> Every day of life is reason enough to be grateful, and today I’m grateful for the good fortune of being with my daughter on this day, June 29, 2026, her 18th birthday. We had some plans that had to be put on hold because of the situation our country is going through, which reminds us how vulnerable we are and how precious it is to sleep in our own beds every night. Even in the midst of the storm, I can’t help but be grateful for the lives of every person I love. On days like these, it’s hard to smile without feeling guilty, but it’s also clear that the simple routines of daily life are an invaluable treasure. How many people today would wish that their problems were just having to get up early, make breakfast, take the kids to school, go to work, figure out how to stretch the budget, and so on. But today I’m celebrating my daughter’s life, so I’m going to shift gears and share what we actually did. ***
https://images.hive.blog/DQmQSFQVu8NyAqNPYp9c5NcPLD1x7Bhw2QZGiwckQ59iWj9/1782792060404.jpg
***

> En primer lugar, le preparé el desayuno que ella eligió: Empanadas de queso. Un pequeño detalle que le hizo sentir atendida. Su regalo fue una franela de su equipo favorito de F1, ella no se lo esperaba y su papá y yo disfrutamos mucho ver su cara de sorpresa. También me pidió que la llevara a la peluquería a cortarse el cabello, porque tenía las puntas muy quemadas y fue algo que pospuse por mucho tiempo.

> First, I made her the breakfast she chose: cheese empanadas. It was a small gesture that made her feel special. Her gift was a T-shirt from her favorite F1 team; she wasn’t expecting it, and her dad and I really enjoyed seeing the look of surprise on her face. She also asked me to take her to the hair salon to get her hair cut, because her ends were really split—something I’d been putting off for a long time. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmaHyn9RmNYica83kQnGBx3yAJZUyWqU1RvvmXhW5rtXPS/1782788511927.jpg
***

> Mi esposo le dejó elegir lo que quería almorzar, fuimos a un restaurant de comida criolla donde pudo comer algo que le gusta mucho: Cachapa con queso. De postre tuvo brownie con helado. Queríamos consentirla, hacerle sentir que su día era especial y creamos un oasis para ella.

> My husband let her choose what she wanted for lunch, so we went to a Creole restaurant where she got to eat something she really loves: cachapa with cheese. For dessert, she had a brownie with ice cream. We wanted to spoil her, make her feel like her day was special, and create an oasis just for her. ***
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaAVaeMwxXgjTCVpW4n5kYoednsh3porJmbbUBzZYntQG/1782788556899.jpg
***

> Su prima y su abuela le hicieron un pastel de cumpleaños, así que en la noche fuimos a casa de mi suegra, donde cada año nos reunimos para celebrar la vida de cada miembro de la familia, conversando un rato y finalmente repartiendo el pastel. El ambiente era triste, pero cada quien hizo su mejor esfuerzo para no arruinar el breve momento en el que nos reunimos.

> Her cousin and her grandmother baked her a birthday cake, so that evening we went to my mother-in-law’s house, where we gather every year to celebrate the lives of each family member, chatting for a while and finally sharing the cake. The atmosphere was somber, but everyone did their best not to spoil the brief moment we spent together. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmVdmh98FZcXrW47tMGXvyoZrsRFyuiehsG4LHeLwV12LP/1782788698364.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png

> Y de esta manera celebramos la vida de mi hija que arriba a sus 18 años, con la conciencia del valor que tiene despertar cada día y poder ver el rostro de quienes amamos. A ustedes, gracias por haberme acompañado a través de estas letras.

> And so we celebrate my daughter’s 18th birthday, mindful of how precious it is to wake up each day and see the faces of those we love. To all of you, thank you for joining me through these words. ***
https://images.hive.blog/350x350/https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmNTSoQ7tHfuKVDmksrsS9RzBg8HAqYnXghQXaHbi7Yt/image.png Thank you very much
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png
