title.title: There Is Still Beauty in the Midst of Chaos [🇬🇧ENG/SPA🇻🇪]
title.body:
# <center>There Is Still Beauty in the Midst of Chaos</center>

|<center>English</center>|<center>Español</center>
|-|-|
------
<div class=\

> My greetings and respect to everyone on the Hive Blockchain. I have spent these past few days navigating a sea of emotions that I have wanted to talk to you about. To be honest, as a Venezuelan, it hurts me deeply to see the situation that is happening in my country. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbUDepqWxufW6n4xbDtg1kuiWkPhh2AT1S63iZSbzUt1A/1782790806089.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNX8pJmyh7AiPGx5Gr9XXwPYwSnT98MmXPrrByGxA8YQi/1782790806205.jpg) https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=owls-eye/xvpp8oww # News comes and news goes, as the waves of the sea but above all, hope is rekindled when we hear about a rescue — about one or more survivors of the catastrophe that occurred on June 24th. It left entire cities of my country devastated, families separated, missing people, displaced people everywhere, people without homes and without shelter sleeping on the streets. There are constant and prolonged power outages throughout the national territory, the collapse of the public and private health system, and restaurant and supermarket chains forcing their employees to come to work even knowing that more than 60% of the employees on the payroll were affected in one way or another by the devastating earthquake. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVD9f5NY23cwYV9FnGhapBrhrzZ6s3YZndf4Fn1rniazD/1782791027549.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY5zZ4Crh93H3UiMMUBrj9FHU7D9cXRB8btE16j9LGu3f/1782791027656.jpg) # In certain places where these restaurants and supermarkets are located, the structure of the buildings was compromised. These employees work under the constant danger that the probability of another aftershock could end up causing a tragedy in my city. This leads me to think: is it normal for there to be so much chaos in the world? To be completely honest, beyond the world, the universe is based on the law of chaos and order. We and what we are going through in our country, Venezuela, are a micro-fraction of the chaos that exists within the universe. And yet, it still does not stop hurting... ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTucpM3PcdsTQin3GN95N3Dwbnw9cEFkjPQ9ihMEbDax2/1782791150001.jpg) # But also, within the order established by nature, which is very wise, we can find infinite beauty. We can appreciate it at first sight because it bears the indelible signature of the Great Architect of the Universe. In his wisdom, he placed in us the will to survive, to overcome obstacles, to be resilient, and to rise again. To help others, because that is what makes us human — kindness and love for our neighbor. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYcR4fiexiqFnq644NP5rBaxnXmj2PKy6oBM7cwDHW9Dp/1782791251382.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmahGMUHbVwv9m3ptbGHfjHVK7YjHSaceDaG4scXc6M8xw/1782791251448.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS7JuKeLju93VeWF7kUkHbaa9jwY9HSsWECqLVAXmic97/1782791251533.jpg) # I write these lines hoping that each one of you will keep them in your minds and make them your own. That every day we can learn to be better, and that no matter our nation, creed, race, height, or weight, we understand that none of us is different from the other, nor is above the other. That there is no reason to deny doing good to those who need it, and that we always live doing all things with love. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTkihYr4TiCyG8seUv7yHSSFkgSx5546K8JSnft4ZGRhd/1782791330198.jpg) # I hope this reflection was completely to your liking. Stay tuned for upcoming publications.

> Mis saludos y respetos para todos en la Blockchain de Hive. He pasado estos últimos días atravesando un mar de emociones de las cuales he querido conversar con ustedes. Si les soy sincero, como venezolano me duele mucho la situación que está aconteciendo en mi país. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc1BCkQuYvsGGrUnbBjdktZpBdb4zz1REZ16xuqUC8tyH/1782791516981.jpg) # Noticias van y noticias vienen, como las olas del mar pero sobre todo la esperanza se aviva cuando se escucha de un rescate, de uno o más sobrevivientes de la catástrofe que ocurrió el pasado 24 de junio. Dejó ciudades enteras de mi país devastadas, familias separadas, desaparecidas, damnificados por doquier, gente sin hogar y sin refugio durmiendo en las calles. Constantes y prolongadas fallas eléctricas a lo largo del territorio nacional, colapso del sistema de salud pública y privada, cadenas de restaurantes y supermercados obligando a sus empleados a acudir a trabajar aún sabiendo que más del 60% de los empleados que aparecen en nómina fueron afectados de una y otra manera por el devastador terremoto. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbVYCmj6ZYXpVcigf2fzSwfXjGyvRWruc4vxQeWTFjhWB/1782791795894.jpg) # En ciertos lugares en donde se encuentran ubicados estos restaurantes y supermercados, la estructura de las edificaciones fueron comprometidas. Dichos empleados trabajan bajo el peligro constante de que las probabilidades de otra réplica que pueda acontecer termine causando una tragedia en mi ciudad. Lo que me lleva a pensar en que: ¿es normal que exista tanto caos en el mundo? Para ser completamente honesto, si, de hecho más allá del mundo el universo está basado en la ley del caos y el orden. Nosotros y lo que estamos pasando en nuestro país Venezuela somos una micro fracción del caos que existe dentro del universo. Y sin embargo, aún así no para de doler... ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXLjBajUp19A1zz1qbFdqPiZdNu3y1mY6xxnHadC92aY5/1782791852764.jpg) # Pero también dentro del orden establecido por la naturaleza la cual es muy sabia, podemos encontrar belleza infinita. La cual podemos apreciarla a simple vista ya que lleva la firma indeleble del Gran Arquitecto Del Universo. El cual en su sabiduría puso en nosotros la voluntad de sobrevivir, de superar los obstáculos, de ser resilientes y de levantarnos de nuevo, de ayudar a los demás, porque eso es lo que nos hace humanos — la bondad y el amor a nuestro prójimo. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWMbontt3xEMEXECG8u5rHYhTU7BXLa6wLzTv92EzHtm7/1782791898423.jpg) # Escribo estas líneas, esperando que cada uno de ustedes las guarden en su mente, y las hagan suyas. Que cada día podamos aprender a ser mejores, y que seamos de la nación, credo, raza, estatura o peso que sea, entendamos que ninguno de nosotros es diferente al otro, ni está por encima del otro. Que no hay por qué negarnos a hacer el bien a quien lo necesita, y que siempre vivamos haciendo todas las cosas con amor. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXabAFZ4jhqsgCVgabaWR6Ncw19ARY3cRtmRY2uEPWmwx/1782791940875.jpg) # Espero que esta reflexión haya sido de su completo agrado. title.title: The most beautiful rock: flint or chert (Eng - Esp)
title.body: contest. To find a candidate, I traveled to another municipality in the state in search of natural settings where I could find rocks. We stopped in the Montes municipality, in a mountainous area; there were several rocks, but this one caught my eye due to its layers and sharp edges. After exploring the site and taking several photographs, we spoke with some local residents who explained that this rock is used to manufacture porcelain and has other applications across various industrial sectors.\n\nIt is known as flint or chert and is a sedimentary rock of chemical and organic origin. It forms primarily through the accumulation and compaction of silica derived from marine organisms and chemical precipitation, resulting in a very hard, compact structure. Its composition includes a mixture of minerals such as microcrystalline quartz, chalcedony, and opal. It is typically found as nodules within limestone or marl formations, and its color ranges from light tones to dark shades of black, gray, and brown. Historically, it has been highly valued; striking it against other hard materials produces sparks—hence the name \
—and it was the primary material used in prehistoric times to fashion cutting tools and weapons.

> **

title.title: Content creators must be professional and not harm others.
title.body: # Hello ## How are you all?

> A blessed day for all of us. I miss you all. I hope you're all well. Nowadays, so many content creators are emerging. The number of creators is increasing day by day, and competition in the digital world is getting fiercer. Content creators must think intelligently and sharply to produce unique, well-loved work. They must also be adept at assessing what's popular and what people need so they'll search for their videos. ![pexels-camera-1869430_1920.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZBcz5Zdy8Nw64hbqgtJSUSpSeRNUzdV9zne4dNzU2EGK/pexels-camera-1869430_1920.jpg) https://pixabay.com/id/photos/kamera-telepon-gadis-tangan-1869430/ Is it logical for them to take pictures or videos of other people in open fields and use them as content without their permission? I believe this is a violation that must be strictly regulated by social media administrators. Besides, there are news reports that some are allowed to take pictures of others without censorship or permission from them. I would be annoyed if my face suddenly appeared in a film, even briefly and in passing. Especially if they zoomed in on my face, I would definitely be angry. Filming in public places is a beautiful thing, especially in busy scenes that show city activity and even crowded tourist spots. However, as I said earlier, not everyone is comfortable with cameras, and they will feel disturbed when the camera is pointed at them, making others uncomfortable. However, filming and photographing in public places is unique and sought after by content creators. As technology advances, I believe all faces can be filtered, focusing the camera on only one person and blurring the others. There must be a way to promote their content without harming or disturbing others. We also appreciate the hard work of those who strive to create the best content and entertain their audience, but often people misinterpret the content. Creators don't fully understand the privacy of codes of ethics and licensing. They focus solely on one goal: ensuring their content is on FYP, ignoring the risks and privacy of their content. We often see them creating indecent videos in pursuit of popularity. Although some social media platforms have banned inappropriate videos and content that violates human rights and pornography, which are immediately removed by the apps, many still violate these rules, especially women who often create inappropriate videos indoors. If the uploaded video is deemed spam and immediately removed, they will find other ways to satisfy their pornographic desires, such as live broadcasts or video chats. There is no prohibition on making videos in public places, but don't involve those who are busy and unaware that you are recording them. They may become angry when they realize they are in your content. On the other hand, if your content is purely about you and not about someone passing by, just by chance, passing by behind the screen, I think that's normal and won't harm them even if their face is clearly captured in your content. In fact, the world is getting more beautiful with With the abundance of content creators, in addition to the abundance of entertainment videos that can accompany and entertain us every day, news about problems and events is increasingly rapid and can be seen minutes after the event, some even broadcasting it live. This is very different from going back a little before monetization and content creators could only access the news the next day through TV if it was national news and through newspapers if it was regional news. The point is, we respect and honor each other, just act according to existing norms.

title.title: [ESP-ING] Prayer for Venezuela
title.body: > Uno realmente quiere ayudar con muchas cosas en esta tragedia que embarga a Venezuela, llevar comida, medicina, ropa, alimentos, ayudar en la zona de desastre entre muchas cosas, pero bien es cierto que si uno no está capacitado para socorrer no debe estar allí en esos lugares donde ta hay personal que está ayudando, países que nos han tendido una mano y lo están haciendo muy bien, y estamos muy agradecidos. Por otro lado la ayuda de alimentos ha sido bastante satisfactoria, tanto así que hasta la han desperdiciado, al igual que la ropa y artículos de primera necesidad, lamentablemente hay muchos que están aprovechando lo que se lleva a los damnificados y se los roban, esto está pasando en varios estados del país y es preocupante ver tanta miseria de parte de muchos Venezolanos que se aprovechan de la situación.

> Otra cosa preocupante es que se están robando a los niños, hay niños que han sido rescatados y llevados a hospitales, y luego los padres lo buscan o familiares y no los consiguen se los han llevado, otros siendo abusados, esto lo que da es tristeza, rabia y hasta ganas de desaparecer a toda esa basura de personas, pero lo más que puedo hacer en mis fuerzas es orar por mi país.

>


Me considero una persona de fe, y por ello creo que Dios puede escuchar nuestras oraciones y cambiar el panorama de Venezuela, traer consuelo a quienes lo necesitan, traer paz a este país, ayudar a los rescatistas dándole fuerzas par salvar a muchas personas, y seguir sosteniendo la vida de las personas que están bajo el suelo atrapados para que puedan ser rescatadas, y claro ayudar a tantos niños que lo necesitan.

Por ello fuimos a un sector de nuestro estado a llevar oración, esperanza para nuestro país,  orar abre las puertas de los cielos y eso s lo que más necesitamos  así que fue un tiempo donde nos unimos muchas personas a pedir por tantas personas, además allí también estaban familias que tienen aún a sus familiares en la Guaira esperando un milagro, y que mejor, que llevar esa esperanza orando a Dios por todas esas peticiones.

This fills me with sadness, anger, and even the urge to wipe out all those scum of people, but the most I can do on my own is pray for my country. > >I consider myself a person of faith, and that’s why I believe that God can hear our prayers and change the situation in Venezuela—bringing comfort to those who need it, bringing peace to this country, helping the rescue workers by giving them the strength to save many people, and continuing to sustain the lives of those trapped underground so they can be rescued—and, of course, helping the many children who need it. > >That’s why we went to a neighborhood in our state to offer prayer and hope for our country. > I stopped for awhile and feel the moment. That moment became so precious to me as I did a short but silent meditation. It's a perfect way to end and release the worries of the day.

> Moving forward while walking, made me realized today that nature has its own way to remind us the beauty of life. That these beautiful skies were a great reminder of how precious to create a positive thoughts in life.

>As the clouds drifted so beautifully, and the sunlight slowly faded in. A small visible moon slowly taking over. 

It was such a calming mood I experienced on that day.
And then I slowly headed home, appreciating the beautiful discoveries revealed by God's creation. Sometimes all we need was just to make a first step, to experience the light, and quiet moment as we lifted ourselves towards thinking some positive thoughts.


A simple looking at the scattered clouds in a beautiful blue sky somewhat made my day. And this would be all for now and see you in my next discovery blog journey..Bye👋🤗🙂

links.title: Lettuce, potato, and corn salad served with a grilled chicken breast fillet seasoned with turmeric and oregano.[Esp-Eng]
links.body:
>    
<hr>
Feliz y bendecido inicio de semana, un gusto compartir una vez más con ustedes, hoy les quiero compartir una alternativa para un almuerzo nutritivo y balanceado se trata de una ensalada de lechuga, papas y maíz servida con filete de pechuga a la plancha con cúrcuma y orégano un plato delicioso, fácil de preparar y muy saludable aquí les dejo el paso a paso de esta sencilla receta.

>Happy and blessed start to the week! It’s a pleasure to share with you once again. Today I’d like to share an option for a nutritious and balanced lunch: a salad made with lettuce, potatoes, and corn, served with grilled chicken breast seasoned with turmeric and oregano. It’s a delicious, easy-to-prepare, and very healthy dish. Here’s the step-by-step guide to this simple recipe.

<hr>


![1000609719.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoEsRYvWRQvP7wuQFxLSr9euKSECNCbYf1vJB6TbRU8zSqPkLgNa2Yy15UTZE5ZWawC.jpg)


<hr>

# <center> *INGREDIENTES/INGREDIENTS* </center>

<div class = \

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eokd9vvzfL7899Dmuh8jCftCysonmGC9myhj4ScSS6xq4dubc4DPy8xgfNNgJjGAZsE.jpg Para la ensalada: - Lechuga - 2 o 3 papas - 1 zanahoria - Maíz dulce - Cebolla - Cilantro - Mayonesa - Mostaza - Sal al gusto Para el filete de pollo: - 3 filetes de pechuga - 1 cucharadita de cúrcuma - 1/2 cucharadita de ajo en polvo - Orégano - 1 cucharada de aceite de oliva - Sal y pimienta al gusto For the salad: >- Lettuce >- 2 or 3 potatoes >- 1 carrot >- Sweet corn >- Onion >- Cilantro >- Mayonnaise >- Mustard >- Salt to taste For the chicken fillets: >- 3 chicken breast fillets >- 1 teaspoon turmeric >- 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder >- Oregano >- 1 tablespoon olive oil >- Salt and pepper to taste
#
*PREPARACIÓN/PREPARATION*
Para preparar la ensalada lo primero que haremos es lavar y pelar la zanahoria y las papas, la cortamos en dados, ponemos a cocinar primero la zanahoria por aproximadamente 5 minutos y luego le agregamos las papas y cocinamos hasta que ablande, escurrimos y dejamos enfriar. >To prepare the salad, the first thing we’ll do is wash and peel the carrots and potatoes, dice them, cook the carrots first for about 5 minutes, then add the potatoes and cook until tender, drain, and let cool.
![1000609765.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EokezQjnmXNwqFComQR8bzSowBro5Ht71nT8oynrb7cfnQKuzcYqVNKqDAcVcSbCsgY.jpg)
Lavamos y desinfectamos la lechuga con vinagre enjuagamos y picamos y la colocamos en un bol, le agregamos las papas y zanahoria, le añadimos el maíz, la cebolla y cilantro picado finamente. >Wash and disinfect the lettuce with vinegar, rinse it, chop it, and place it in a bowl. Add the potatoes and carrots, then add the corn, onion, and finely chopped cilantro.
![1000609771.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoK7JXwXcgdcVcMmM51pj4cy9Dm5yTjLQeCZ5REjZDP4guCFAhravvfWAUTvX982SAE.jpg)
Aderezamos la ensalada con mayonesa, mostaza y sal mezclamos y listo. >Dress the salad with mayonnaise, mustard, and salt, mix it all together, and it's ready.
![1000609780.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoEryLwWxL5Xum44iwEcDum61U5ARgi7JufWJ8F3XpQYDWpcZdTwehfxNthxRsmB1s2.jpg)
Para preparar el pollo colocamos en un bol pequeño el aceite de oliva, la sal, la cúrcuma, el ajo en polvo y orégano y mezclamos. >To prepare the chicken, place the olive oil, salt, turmeric, garlic powder, and oregano in a small bowl and mix them together.
![1000609785.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eo8Vn4WGJtfz5cPaC2VpKho37qBQ3yaqGcDJjaFVQj7JUcXiovdKKAQeKrVw1KqgRR9.jpg)
Le untamos esta mezcla sobre los filetes y dejamos reposar para que agarre sabor. >We spread this mixture over the fillets and let them sit so they absorb the flavor.
![1000609789.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EpQyF3JRH7nYrL2y9qPc75o8K3kwoxkvPJDQY62CWeFL9rBp8NqquxUi6wFJGcajFGQ.jpg)
En una plancha ligeramente engrasada ponemos los filetes y cocinamos hasta que doren por ambos lados. >Place the fillets on a lightly oiled griddle and cook until they are golden brown on both sides.
![1000609796.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoiWcDAavZuMZ8rjy6fFg7y2FGzENobbU6Vy7ZG74DqgLP2LkgAkTJLCqntKxg7REYY.jpg)
Una vez lista la ensalada y el pollo servimos yo combiné con aguacate para disfrutar de un almuerzo balanceado. >Once the salad and chicken are ready, we serve them—I paired mine with avocado to enjoy a balanced lunch.
![1000609726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eoc9SZMEKmWuZTv4AdpTBYvx9LhqUExmgCUrkWzm5y2HnVEwtPxVxKom4TpGgrqLWBv.jpg)
Espero que esta sencilla receta que les comparto el día de hoy sea de su completo agrado hasta la próxima y muchas bendiciones. >I hope you really enjoy this simple recipe I'm sharing with you today. Until next time, and many blessings.

links.title: Apple Said Yes. I Wasn't Expecting That.
links.body:
Sometimes life surprises you, and every now and then, it does so in a good way.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWRgTscn119p4rZ32JJ2Jnjb1kPVd2gHAau9zPJe9cnrZ/image.png)

Truth be told, I was fully expecting Apple to reject the newest update to Snapie Mobile. I mean, the moment you add wallet functionality, you're kind of asking for extra scrutiny. But guess what? Nope.

Just a few minutes ago, I found myself staring at an email saying the update had been approved.

*\

* I thought to myself.

Not a single question. Not a single request for clarification. No pushback whatsoever.

Well, well, well.

I'm certainly not going to look a gift horse in the mouth, so I immediately pushed the release.

\

I hear you asking. I see you typing. I sense you thinking.

Well, it means that if you're an Apple user, as of right now—yes, right now—you can update your Snapie Mobile app to the newest version.

Triple yes. Double hell yeah.

I mentioned a few days ago that I've been slowly adding features to Snapie Mobile while also cleaning things up and making the experience more intuitive. That said, I don't think it's a good idea to turn it into a mirror of Snapie.io.

Why?

Because too much ranch sauce ruins the pizza.

When Snapie Mobile first launched, the goal was simple: give new users the easiest and quickest way to get started. Almost no learning curve. I think it accomplished exactly that.

I'd like it to stay true to that mission instead of becoming the app that tries to do absolutely everything.

That doesn't mean development is slowing down, though. I fully intend to add Google and Apple sign-in as well, because those changes follow the same philosophy:

Reduce friction.

Make onboarding easier.

Let people get to the fun part faster.

At any rate, what are you waiting for?

Go update—or download—Snapie Mobile, you *Malus domestica* supporter.

See you in Snapie land.

—MenO

Así que échale ganitas, preciosa, que esa alma tan hermosa se merece todo lo bonito, y nada de amores a medias, que ese corazonzote sólo pasa una vez en la vida. 

English 

Even when you have those little slumps, I want you to know that you’re enough; even if you love to doubt what an amazing woman you are, I swear there’s no one like you in the entire universe; even if things don’t always go as you hope, don’t get discouraged because something much better might already be on its way. So go for it, sweetheart—that beautiful soul of yours deserves all the best things in life, and no half-hearted romances—a heart as big as yours only comes along once in a lifetime.

links.title: Stomper's Story, To the beat of the rhythm
links.body:
Greetings ladies and gentlemen, all are welcome. Friends, I've just finished my new story. I wrote it for you and intend to share it here, as usual. Today's character is Stomper, a drummer who loses something, something very important that changed him forever. But despite everything, something he built remained by his side. If you want to know what it's about, well, you know the answer is in the story. Let's begin. I hope you enjoy it.

> Saludos damas y cabañeros, todos son bienvenido. Amigos acabo de terminar mi nueva historia, la he escrito para ustedes y tengo la intensión de compartirla acá como es costumbre. El personaje de hoy es Stomper, el es un baterista que pierde algo, algo muy importante que lo cambió para siempre. Pero a pesar de todo algo que construyó estuvo a su lado. Si quieren saber de que se trata pues ya saben la respuesta está en la historia, comenzamos, espero que les guste.

<div class=\

> ![1773599666153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23xKvGS7m6iSnPG8UPDgHKZjGvo2tezm2MeG7GGuDF4Jpyq3grwQ3Gd12e1FfM7afzbYm.jpg) Image created by me in canva Stomper is a drummer with an outstanding career, having built his sound from the ground up, laying each brick to create the ladder he climbed to become who he is today. When he started, he was just an inexperienced boy, playing at home with a spoon on top of his mother's pots. His parents knew he had a hidden talent and always supported him. He didn't have the money for formal musical training, so what he learned in the beginning was through his own skill and his constant drive to improve. At a very young age, he joined his classmates to form a small band that played after school. This was his first taste of music. But he didn't have his own drum kit; he relied on one the school lent him. But at that time, it was enough for them. However, that band didn't last. Each of the members went their separate ways and ended up doing everything but music. Only Stomper knew that his future lay in playing the drums. > Stomper es un baterista de destacada trayectoria, ha sabido construir su carrera desde los cimientos, poniendo cada ladrillo para crear la escalera por la que fue escalando hasta llegar a quien es en el presente. Cuando empezó no era más que un muchacho sin experiencia, tocaba en la casa con una cuchara encima de las ollas de su madre. Sus padres supieron que dentro del había un talento escondido y por eso siempre lo apoyaron. No tenía dinero para grandes estudios musicales así que lo que aprendió en el inicio fue por pericia propia y porque intentaba superarse cada vez más. > Siendo muy joven se unió a sus compañeros de clase para formar un pequeño grupo de música que tocaba al salir de la escuela. Este fue su primera probada de lo que era la música. Pero no tenía batería propia, dependía de una que le prestaba la escuela para tocar. Pero en ese momento para ellos era suficiente. Pero ese grupo no prosperó, cada uno de los integrantes tomó rumbos diferentes y terminaron dedicándose a todo menos a la música, solo Stomper sabía que su futuro estaba en tocar la batería.

> ![bbc-creative-MQDoyldbbpA-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23tvbzpDU8UaVu2CHM68LWUf86EYU2pnLtN9iRy7QPUbgyjvrvhP7sZ6UiaGiVwxgzD7Y.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) When he found himself alone, he didn't get discouraged; on the contrary, that's when he worked even harder to find his place. But it was difficult. In his town, there wasn't much of a musical culture, so there weren't any bands he could join or be a part of. He and his parents moved to the capital city to seek their fortune, hoping he could find something there. But it wasn't easy; finding something there was hard too. The first bands he auditioned rejected him for being too young, and others because he didn't have a name or any prior experience. Stomper had to make many sacrifices until he finally found his ideal band. It was a band of young people like him, but they already had some experience. When they saw how well he played, they accepted him and made him part of the group. They gave him a new drum set, and that's how it all began. In a short time, he went from being an amateur to a professional in the band. But he became something more: a loyal friend, someone he could rely on through thick and thin. He always made a point of listening to his teammates and making them feel comfortable. He was, as they say, the life of the party. > Cuando quedó solo no se desanimó, al contrario fue cuando más se esforzó por buscar su lugar. Pero le costó mucho, en su pueblo no había mucha cultura musical así que no había ningún grupo al que unirse o del que ser parte. Junto a sus padres se mudaron a la capital del país para buscar suerte y fortuna, tenía la esperanza de que ahí pudiera encontrar algo. Pero no fue tan fácil, también le costó encontrar algo. Los primeros grupos que fue a ver lo rechazaron por ser demasiado joven y otros porque no tenía un nombre o historial previo. Stomper tuvo que hacer muchos sacrificios hasta que al final dio con su grupo ideal. > Era una banda de jóvenes como el, pero ellos si ya tenían cierta experiencia. Cuando vieron que tocaba tan bien lo aceptaron y lo hicieron parte. Le dieron una batería nueva y así fue como comenzó todo. En poco tiempo pasó de convertirse en un amateur a ser un profesional dentro de la banda. Pero se convirtió en algo más, en un amigo fiel, en alguien en quien se podía confiar en las buenas y en las malas. Siempre se preocupó por escuchar a sus compañeros y en hacerlos sentir lo mejor posible. Es como dicen era el alma de la fiesta.

> ![josh-hild-4NQgIXAHRBg-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/244ohKfKH7tdiBVUZh3zM8nk3KiM7ADV63BFS9nyE2Y3TuokRCBmmJhDEJ8Zu3g9HktCH.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) His role changed little; he went from being just a drummer to almost the leader. He shared his creative vision for the band's songs, and the others always listened to him. His vision was vital to the band's success. Together, they became a renowned band, the envy of many. New generations wanted to be like them. Stomper's youth flew by, but he made the most of every day, never wasting a moment. Every day was an opportunity to grow, to improve, and to become a better person. It's true that it took a lot to get there, but the effort was well worth it. But when Stomper was at this peak, his greatest moment, tragedy struck, the one that would change him forever. It all happened so fast, and there was no time to react. At home, while his wife Dorothy was cleaning, she slipped on the wet floor. The full force of her body hit her hand. The pain was immediate and intense. He started arguing, but not with Dorothy; it was with himself for not being careful and walking on the wet floor. But there was nothing more to be done; they went to the doctor. That's where they told him his hand was fractured and that the bone would take time to repair. But that wasn't the worst part. It wouldn't be the same as before; he might be partially paralyzed. That devastated him, as he thought he'd never play again. And indeed, that's what the doctor confirmed. After the operation, the muscles and bone would be partially paralyzed for life. He fell into a deep depression and no longer wanted to live or eat; he couldn't imagine life without his drums. > Su rol fue cambiando poco, pasó de ser solo un simple baterista a ser casi el líder, compartía su visión creativa de las canciones de la banda y los demás siempre lo escuchaban. Su visión fue vital para el éxito de la banda. Llegaron juntos a ser una banda de renombre y la envidia sana de muchos. Las nuevas generaciones querían ser como ellos. La juventud para Stomper pasó volando pero aprovechó cada día al máximo, no perdió tiempo nunca. Cada día fue para crecer, para mejorar y para ser mejor persona. Es cierto que costó mucho para llegar hasta aquí, pero valió mucho el esfuerzo. > Pero cuando Stomper estaba en este, que era su gran momento ocurrió la tragedia, la que lo cambiaría para siempre. Todo sucedió rápidamente y no hubo tiempo para reaccionar. En la casa mientras su mujer Doroty limpiaba resbaló en el piso mojado. Toda la fuerza de su cuerpo chocó contra su mano. El dolor fue inmediato y fuerte. El se puso a discutir, pero no con Doroty, era con el mismo por no tener cuidado y haber caminado sobre el piso mojado. Pero ya no había nada que hacer, fueron al médico. Ahí fue donde le dijeron que su mano había quedado fracturada y que la reparación del hueso tomaría tiempo. > Pero eso no era lo peor, era que no quedaría como la tenía antes, posiblemente quedaría parcialmente paralizada. Eso lo destruyó ya que pensó que no iba a tocar más. Y en efecto eso fue lo que le confirmó el médico. Luego de la operación efectivamente los músculos y el hueso quedarían parcialmente paralizados de por vida. El entró en depresión y ya no quería vivir ni comer, no podía tener una vida sin la batería.

> ![umit-bulut-qbTC7ZwJB64-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23u63Kx1dcfY7CzaamvGZ7Vdp8YjFAUMytcccwyku1bqzH3g3g8yf1d1nBXrZKbqpcQw7.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) He told his bandmates to find someone else, someone who could actually play. The band analyzed his request, and it didn't make sense to them; he couldn't be replaced, he was the heart and soul of the band. But since it wasn't an emotional issue but a physical one, they waited until he fully recovered before deciding what to do. When he recovered, he tried to play while they watched. And it turned out he could still play, but very slowly and with one hand doing everything. The band saw this as an opportunity to help him; they wouldn't abandon him. From now on, the band would adapt to Stomper's rhythm and create songs based on what he could play. It wouldn't be easy, but they loved him dearly and were willing to do it for him. Stomper earned this through his dedication and his constant desire to help the other members of the group; now they were giving back just a little of what he had given. A little while later, they started playing again. The style changed, but they were still as good as before, and now even closer. Stomper's life changed forever, but when you're surrounded by good people, problems fade into the background. Success awaits them. > Les dijo a sus amigos de banda que se buscaran a otro, alguien que si pudiera tocar. La banda se puso a analizar lo que el pedía y no tenía sentido para ellos, el no podía ser reemplazado era el alma de la banda. Pero dada que no se trataba de problemas emocionales sino físicos ellos esperaron hasta que se recuperara por completo antes de tomar una decisión sobre lo que se iba a hacer. Cuando se recuperó intentó tocar mientras ellos miraban. Y resulta que aún podía tocar, pero muy despacio y con una mano principal para todo. > La banda vio así una oportunidad de ayudarlo, no lo dejarían solo. A partir de ahora la banda se adaptaría al ritmo de Stomper y se crearían las canción en base a lo que el podía tocar. No sería fácil pero ellos lo querían mucho y estaban dispuestos a hacerlo por el. Stomper se ganó esto por su dedicación y su deseo siempre de ayudar a los demás del grupo, ahora ellos le estaban devolviendo solo un poco de lo mucho que el dio. Un poco después comenzaron a tocar de nuevo, el estilo cambió pero seguían siendo tan buenos como antes, pero ahora aún más unidos. La vida de Stomper cambió para siempre pero cuando estás rodeado de gente buena los problemas pasan al segundo plano. El éxito los espera.

> ![Captura de pantalla (2478).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23xAcFvCj7mgKq1Ej7RKuVxAV3kEuGFYfJxMnwL7Muh4AfHLZX3AMQ2cAkmABSa1b4MEQ.png) # [Join](https://risingstargame.com) hive's most incredible game, Rising Star , today. **Don't miss the opportunity to become a Rising Star**.

links.title: Tasty baked pork 🍖 Sabroso cerdo horneado.
links.body:
>
Sabroso cerdo horneado🍖 La carne de cerdo es versátil para su cocción; en esta oportunidad lo cocine horneado, anteriormente lo cocinaba en parrilera pero después descubrí que al horno queda jugoso. Ahora mi forma preferida de preparar cerdo es horneado.
Delicious Baked Pork 🍖 Pork is versatile for cooking; this time I baked it. I used to grill it, but then I discovered that it stays juicy when baked. Now my favorite way to prepare pork is baked.

>
Necesito tres ingredientes para preparar cerdo horneado; en esta ocasión utilice 300 gramos de cerdo; sal y oregano al gusto.
I need three ingredients to prepare baked pork; on this occasion I used 300 grams of pork; salt and oregano to taste.

>
Colocamos el cerdo en una bandeja; sazonamos con sal y oregano.
We placed the pork on a tray; we seasoned it with salt and oregano

>
Tapamos la bandeja con papel de aluminio y metemos al horno por 50 minutos a 150 grados.
We cover the tray with aluminum foil and put it in the oven for 50 minutes at 150 degrees.

>
Pasado 25 minutos sacamos del horno y quitamos el papel de aluminio y volvemos a meter al horno por 25 minutos mas.
After 25 minutes, we take it out of the oven, remove the aluminum foil, and put it back in the oven for another 25 minutes.

>
Finalmente obtenemos cerdo al horno jugoso y sabroso. GRACIAS POR LEER.
Finally, we get juicy and flavorful roast pork. THANKS FOR READING.

>

links.title: 🌿 From a Small Start to a Beautiful Plant My Lucky Gold‑Dust Dracaena That Finally Grew Strong
links.body:
![1000036588.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23xetLuM38B56D7wEaoC8E6Qy6TZvkfxX5oQgocxbb5Yr3z7kxNxUNPuyMykAaunRCJYa.png)


Many people say having this plant at home brings good luck and positive energy. That is exactly why I decided to grow it. I heard it is nice to have around so I thought of giving it a try. Now I am really happy because finally it has grown tall and strong.
 

![1000036594.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23u6BsyYG96WaYLb6iwLeF5VQwdAF7u8WHbvN635etnwWnureZj29DXB8GHADefUnrSs9.png)

This plant is called Gold-Dust Dracaena sometimes also known as Japanese Bamboo. It looks very lovely with long smooth leaves marked with soft green and yellow spots all over. Its stems stand straight and neat giving it a simple but graceful look that fits any corner of the house.
 

![1000036595.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23xAc4r3uhM4BHuqFDZP6H3ENmicHhrvZHmPYL14JZ4HraFuX9yM6UfGQKTzU7V2WQqia.png)

When I first got it it was just tiny and thin barely reaching my hand. It looked fragile and I had to be careful not to damage it. I wanted to see if I could help it grow properly so I paid close attention right from the start.
 
![1000036590.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23yd8EF4Uw6mZwJ1KSNbjVXKejBMk9AnHvbi8sxvSDq5R2hbfkqJxBwmFGTwpfBSS12e3.png)


I placed it in a spot with soft light not under direct hot sun because it does not like too much heat. I only water it when the soil feels dry never too much so the roots stay safe. It does not need fancy care just simple and regular attention.
 

![1000036592.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23ynWgAMDWEFentBQAFXcmb6cfYHUM6sed5cRFrEBvcxUZV7B924hYp92Jty52XC8Etyp.png)

Slowly week after week new leaves started to appear. They grew bigger brighter and fuller each time I checked. Seeing it change little by little felt very rewarding. Before I knew it it was no longer a small seedling but a healthy full plant.
 

![1000036593.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/23y8x31hbA99LM97FsPnHnC7fKMsojKaJGztT4ujWxwWnCk4cYrovNGSYpPzKw621HeNE.png)

Aside from the belief that it brings good fortune it also helps clean the air inside. It takes away dust and bad smells making our home feel fresher and lighter. It stays green all year round and does not easily get sick which makes it easy to love.
 

![1000036589.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/piyaanggtiu/242hYsezxzh1gaNwZitCGfZSFYx9mcVmnYN2zqzvzLYo3EwubALVqcY4rQzVJPjUgLTWo.png)

Every time I look at it I feel calm and proud. It reminds me that with patience and simple care good things will grow. Friends and neighbors also say it looks beautiful and will surely bring blessings. This plant has become a wonderful addition to our home.

links.title: Encuentro de talentos  || La vida después de la tormenta: 10 años de haber abrazado mi proceso (Mi historia con el cáncer de mama) [Esp-Eng]
links.body:
<center> 
### ❣️_Hola amigos de hive!_❣️ 

>### ❣️_Hello friends of hive!_❣️ 
</center>
<hr>
<div class=\

>
Esta es mi participación en este encuentro de talentos donde nuestra amiga @angelica7 nos invita a escribir sobre el tema \

. Hoy me detengo a mirar atrás y ver la mujer que soy ahora. Con el corazón lleno de gratitud, quiero contarles una de las etapas que transformó por completo mi vida. Fue en el año 2016 cuando me diagnosticaron cáncer de mama; ese año quedó grabado en mi memoria no por la oscuridad, sino por la luz que encontré en medio de ese proceso. 

Les cuento que no es nada agradable escuchar esa palabra por primera vez es como si el mundo se detuviera de golpe y por tu mente pasa toda tu vida en una sola película, te haces  miles de preguntas y el miedo te invade. Aunque  eso que viví fue algo temporal la verdad es que ese proceso es duro, vas viendo como tu  estado físico se deteriora poco a poco por los tratamientos, se te cae el cabello, las pestañas, las cejas, bajas de peso por  la falta de apetito, en fin todo lo que ese tratamiento conlleva. No les voy a mentir hubo día grises, días de cansancio absoluto y de lágrimas en silencio. Sin embargo, hoy, una década después, no recuerdo ese proceso desde el dolor, sino desde el aprendizaje y el amor.


El cáncer me enseñó que se necesita mucha fuerza para aceptar que necesitamos ayuda para enfrentar ese proceso, que una de las cosas más importante es tener mucha fe en Dios para abrazar cada día sus altas y sus bajas. Durante este proceso, mi familia y mi fe fue ese motor que me ayudó a salir adelante desde la vulnerabilidad. Su apoyo fue esa fuerza silenciosa que me transmitían en cada paso del tratamiento; fueron el combustible para no rendirme. Aprendí a valorar el aquí y el ahora, a entender que el tiempo vuela y que la vida es un regalo demasiado hermoso como para darlo por sentado.

Este proceso que dolió en el cuerpo y en el alma, en realidad me regaló una nueva perspectiva de la vida para vivirla con más vibras positivas, con más paciencia y con las ganas de seguir construyendo sueños, de emprender, de reír y de amar con todo el corazón. Hoy miro mis cicatrices y veo la prueba viviente de que, los que pasamos por este proceso, somos más fuertes de lo que creemos. Por eso hoy le agradezco tanto a Dios por  no soltarme de su mano y darme el regalo de dejarme vivir y disfrutar, junto a mi hijo, los pequeños placeres cotidianos. Gracias a esa fe inquebrantable, hoy puedo gozar de una estabilidad emocional y espiritual, rodeada de las personas que más me quieren.

Así que, amigo mío, si estás pasando por cualquier proceso de dolor, enfermedad u otra dificultad, debes saber que el dolor físico o el miedo pueden ser temporales; lo que importa es la capacidad de renovarte, de no rendirte; en cambio, confía en Dios, aférrate a Él y a lo que amas, y prepárate para cerrar ese capítulo para poder volar aún más alto. La vida está hecha para disfrutarla, y debemos estar agradecidos por todo lo que nos sucede, por insignificante que pueda parecer.
<hr>



![Delicious eggplant, tomato and sesame salad (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23xpCytfLTG3mkgUsk8EUh8KuLFyyyoMuUyduiGsBVq5pKTta9PBizaueGeWuPH6CmFRa.jpg)

<hr>
<div class=\

> >This is my contribution to this gathering of talented individuals, where our friend @angelica7 invites us to write on the topic “The Process.” Today, I’m taking a moment to look back and see the woman I am now. With a heart full of gratitude, I want to tell you about one of the stages that completely transformed my life. It was in 2016 when I was diagnosed with breast cancer; that year is etched in my memory not because of the darkness, but because of the light I found in the midst of that process. >Let me tell you, it’s not at all pleasant to hear that word for the first time—it’s as if the world suddenly comes to a halt and your whole life flashes before your eyes like a movie; you ask yourself thousands of questions, and fear takes hold of you. Although what I went through was temporary, the truth is that the process is tough. You watch as your physical condition gradually deteriorates because of the treatments; your hair, eyelashes, and eyebrows fall out; you lose weight due to a lack of appetite—in short, everything that comes with that treatment. I’m not going to lie to you—there were dark days, days of utter exhaustion, and days of silent tears. However, today, a decade later, I don’t remember that process through the lens of pain, but rather through the lens of learning and love. >Cancer taught me that it takes a lot of strength to accept that we need help to face this process, and that one of the most important things is to have deep faith in God so that we can embrace each day’s ups and downs. Throughout this journey, my family and my faith were the driving force that helped me move forward despite my vulnerability. Their support was that silent strength they conveyed to me at every step of my treatment; they were the fuel that kept me from giving up. I learned to cherish the here and now, to understand that time flies and that life is too beautiful a gift to take for granted. >This process, which hurt both my body and my soul, actually gave me a new perspective on life—one that allows me to live with more positive energy, more patience, and a desire to keep building dreams, to take on new ventures, to laugh, and to love with all my heart. Today, when I look at my scars, I see living proof that those of us who have gone through this process are stronger than we realize. That’s why today I’m so grateful to God for never letting go of my hand and for giving me the gift of being able to live and enjoy, together with my son, the small pleasures of everyday life. Thanks to that unshakable faith, today I can enjoy emotional and spiritual stability, surrounded by the people who love me most. >So, my friend, if you’re going through any kind of grief, illness, or other hardship, you should know that physical pain or fear may be temporary; what matters is the ability to renew yourself, to not give up; instead, trust in God, hold on to Him and to what you love, and get ready to close that chapter so you can fly even higher. Life is meant to be enjoyed, and we should be grateful for everything that happens to us, no matter how insignificant it may seem.
![7805b3c1-acfe-4839-9a71-f7453f247fda.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23wgWDMwotrQ5XKfSvjJvhfmoVAkKq7abrtLTPcxXvyAQLp1WYCGkQmTZxpg4DD9oqLd6.jpeg)|![IMG_2729.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/242NqQWZQBZDb2Jnvo1UjXWn2qDwPBwKFA8cVVzYnspr7WN1UfPLpbBVWa2B8SWwz2GuM.jpeg) -|- ![128764fc-f5dd-424a-a1dc-266d0427091d.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23xpAccEpKpnybyD5QWmmAfVBJfE3bekhAxXh17QV3EnKEFGo8DMSHGcpsYsT8V5FCJLU.jpeg)|![9f424491-4a19-4811-8201-8f3c37f8ff57.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23qrHpMrBpLF55SDDaKZBJ4cAWw8TcvvfDpV34xhLy2a8MZEWH5gvMJB6YA9mtm7fXuMC.jpeg) --- ![ggifupdate.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/SD9NuiQZ-g-gif-update.gif) --- ###### ***

links.title: Máu báo thai có khi nào là dấu hiệu cần đến bệnh viện ngay?
links.body:
# **Máu báo thai có khi nào là dấu hiệu cần đến bệnh viện ngay?**

Máu báo thai có khi nào là dấu hiệu cảnh báo nguy hiểm cần đến bệnh viện ngay hay không là thắc mắc của nhiều phụ nữ trong giai đoạn đầu mang thai. Thông thường, máu báo thai là hiện tượng sinh lý xuất hiện khi phôi thai bám vào niêm mạc tử cung để làm tổ. Tuy nhiên, không phải mọi trường hợp ra máu trong thai kỳ sớm đều là máu báo thai. Một số dấu hiệu bất thường có thể liên quan đến các biến chứng sản khoa cần được thăm khám và xử trí kịp thời. Bài viết dưới đây sẽ giúp bạn nhận biết đặc điểm của máu báo thai bình thường, những dấu hiệu nguy hiểm cần đến bệnh viện ngay và các nguyên nhân có thể gây ra tình trạng ra máu bất thường.

**▶️▶️▶️ Tham khảo thêm:**

<https://phenikaamec.com/bh-mau-bao-thai.html>

<https://www.deviantart.com/sonyasaran/journal/Trieu-chung-benh-tieu-duong-can-xet-nghiem-gi-1349305653>

\-

## **Đặc điểm của máu báo thai bình thường**

Những đặc điểm thường gặp gồm:

*   Lượng máu ít: Chỉ vài giọt hoặc vài vệt nhỏ trên quần lót hay giấy vệ sinh, không chảy thành dòng.

*   Kéo dài ngắn ngày: Thường xuất hiện từ vài giờ đến khoảng 1 đến 3 ngày rồi tự hết.

Ngoài ra, máu báo thai thường có màu hồng nhạt, đỏ nhạt hoặc nâu nhạt, không kèm cục máu đông và ít khi gây đau bụng đáng kể.

## **Những dấu hiệu cần đến bệnh viện ngay**

Không phải mọi trường hợp ra máu trong giai đoạn đầu thai kỳ đều là máu báo thai. Trước các biểu hiện dưới đây, thai phụ không nên chủ quan hoặc tự theo dõi tại nhà.

*   Ra máu đỏ tươi nhiều: Lượng máu tương đương hoặc nhiều hơn kỳ kinh nguyệt, phải thay băng vệ sinh thường xuyên.

*   Có máu cục: Xuất hiện các cục máu đông lớn hoặc mô bất thường lẫn trong máu.

*   Đau bụng dữ dội: Đau quặn vùng bụng dưới, đau tăng dần hoặc đau lệch một bên bụng.

*   Chóng mặt, ngất: Cảm giác hoa mắt, choáng váng, mệt lả hoặc mất ý thức có thể là dấu hiệu mất máu hoặc biến chứng thai kỳ.

*   Sốt hoặc khí hư bất thường: Sốt, khí hư có mùi hôi, màu vàng xanh hoặc ngứa rát vùng kín có thể liên quan đến tình trạng nhiễm trùng.

## **Các nguyên nhân có thể gây ra máu bất thường**

Tình trạng ra máu bất thường trong giai đoạn đầu thai kỳ có thể xuất phát từ nhiều nguyên nhân khác nhau.

*   Thai ngoài tử cung: Phôi thai làm tổ ngoài buồng tử cung, thường gây ra tình trạng ra máu kéo dài kèm đau bụng dữ dội một bên. Đây là tình trạng cấp cứu sản khoa cần được xử trí sớm.

*   Dọa sảy thai: Ra máu âm đạo kèm đau bụng hoặc đau lưng có thể là dấu hiệu cảnh báo nguy cơ sảy thai trong những tuần đầu.

*   Viêm nhiễm phụ khoa: Viêm âm đạo, viêm cổ tử cung hoặc các bệnh lý phụ khoa khác có thể gây chảy máu âm đạo kèm khí hư bất thường, ngứa rát và khó chịu vùng kín.

## **Kết luận**

Máu báo thai có khi nào là dấu hiệu cần đến bệnh viện ngay hay không phụ thuộc vào đặc điểm ra máu và các triệu chứng đi kèm. Máu báo thai bình thường thường có lượng rất ít, kéo dài ngắn ngày và không gây đau nhiều. Ngược lại, nếu ra máu đỏ tươi nhiều, có cục máu đông, đau bụng dữ dội, chóng mặt hoặc sốt, thai phụ cần được thăm khám ngay để loại trừ các biến chứng nguy hiểm như thai ngoài tử cung hoặc dọa sảy thai. Nếu có bất kỳ dấu hiệu bất thường nào trong giai đoạn đầu thai kỳ hoặc cần tư vấn về sức khỏe sinh sản, hãy liên hệ Bệnh viện Đại học Phenikaa để được các bác sĩ chuyên khoa thăm khám, theo dõi và hỗ trợ kịp thời.



---

links.title: A stroll along Arismedi Avenue, along the riverbanks (Eng/Esp)
links.body:
> I began this walk on Arismendi Avenue; from this side, you can see Guaiquerí Park, but the view is different from the usual one, which is from the city center. Large trees stand majestically, and some of their branches hang over the Manzanares River, forming a natural canopy. The riverbed is bordered by massive retaining walls that channel the flow along much of its course.
![1000123264.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eoc6V7Ws2V1k2Qow9yfDnPs1vC7g5nCt1jesGfsGk8kHD6FjBBGf4dwxP6N1DSHf6z9.jpg)
![1000123275.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpEHqpDBBbJc1KkYeE5YJ8CDpRn3TUJc7NVGmT8XzjX1Rkz322pa67G8fkumqFiNVg4.jpg)
I walked along the riverbanks, following Pedro Elías Aristiguieta Avenue. It was late afternoon, and the cool breeze contrasted with the sun’s rays. There were several people on the street enjoying the tranquility of watching the water from beneath the shade of the trees. Although the river has been dredged due to the water crisis that has been affecting the state for the past four months, there is still some flow thanks to the sporadic rains that have fallen in recent days.
![1000123265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoeE1xNHitfw7JyWHHy6YFQU4XnjaDo7y3FCwSPUejSeEmMVyUWxnGUfwtEpAPCkDjM.jpg)
![1000123263.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EowFhnzzgdpJUnVaiizFpQ537mxQQjBbqmXZiNpA4RTKDYPZ345FFW7fWkCFMYpbVfB.jpg)
The paved path that runs along the river is shaded, making for a pleasant stroll. From here, you can see the footbridges decorated with vertical stripes in a variety of bright colors that connect the sidewalk to Guaiquerí Park, but they are all out of use because the metal structure is severely corroded and, therefore, unsafe.
![1000123277.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EqmfVsgm5FxiBcvg5efVtnqQvsJGXbYEpu4YxbKrNV77Xm47rg4hycVpxZ8iRf4PipQ.jpg)
![1000123272.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoAaJvkJgtoEbZSfjgCjiBa8AfhPBRGZcQBUVxMxXyEbAQCTxAcc8rBsM49GaWF6S6C.jpg)
During this walk, I stopped to admire the upper part of the Santa Inés Church, with its bell tower standing out against the horizon. In addition, several alleys off this avenue lead to the Historic District, providing a shortcut to quickly reach the church and other points of interest, such as the Casa Ramos Sucre and the San Antonio de la Eminencia Castle.
![1000123274.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Ep7tgmEwWcU5S3eEauAR84Q5i6DRzgR6V4qP2XVdQmPbm6SesUdpcb7EohXA51AWJUY.jpg)
![1000123266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eq5FTxXicao11o73kcePzmYgPBc2kQHnFUwzEDhPydHKMfP6pwZTmhdR4CFZMNWVrvq.jpg)
On this side of the sidewalk, there are several spots to rest and chat; you usually see older people sitting facing the river, talking about the good old days, the Cumana of yesteryear, and what life was like before technology transformed everyday life. I mention this because I just sat down to rest for a while in front of the bus stop for Cumanacoa, and there I heard that before the telephone, lovers would send each other letters written with pen and paper—letters that took months to travel from one place to another, which only intensified their passion. It was undoubtedly a different era—an analog one that held its own charm for those who experienced it fully. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Empecé este recorrido en la Avenida Arismendi, desde este lado se observa el parque Guaiquerí, pero se tiene una perspectiva distinta a la habitual, que es desde el centro de la ciudad. Grandes árboles se levantan imponentes y algunas de sus ramas cuelgan hacia el río Manzanares formando un techo natural. El cauce del río está delimitado por muros de contención macizos que canalizan el caudal durante gran parte de su recorrido.
![1000123264.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eoc6V7Ws2V1k2Qow9yfDnPs1vC7g5nCt1jesGfsGk8kHD6FjBBGf4dwxP6N1DSHf6z9.jpg)
![1000123275.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpEHqpDBBbJc1KkYeE5YJ8CDpRn3TUJc7NVGmT8XzjX1Rkz322pa67G8fkumqFiNVg4.jpg)
Caminé por las riberas del río, bordeando la avenida Pedro Elías Aristiguieta. Era de tarde, la brisa estaba fresca contrastando con los rayos del sol. Había varias personas en la calle disfrutando de la tranquilidad que genera observar las aguas bajo las sombras de los árboles. Si bien el río ha sido dragado debido a la crisis hídrica que afecta al estado desde hace cuatro meses, aún se aprecia cierto caudal debido a las esporádicas lluvias que se han presentado en los últimos días.
![1000123265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoeE1xNHitfw7JyWHHy6YFQU4XnjaDo7y3FCwSPUejSeEmMVyUWxnGUfwtEpAPCkDjM.jpg)
![1000123263.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EowFhnzzgdpJUnVaiizFpQ537mxQQjBbqmXZiNpA4RTKDYPZ345FFW7fWkCFMYpbVfB.jpg)
El camino pavimentado que bordea el río está sombreado, lo que hace que el paseo sea agradable. Desde acá se aprecian las pasarelas decoradas con franjas verticales, de colores vivos y variados, que comunican la acera con el parque Guaiquerí, pero todas están en desuso debido a que la estructura metálica presenta mucha corrosión y, por lo tanto, no es segura.
![1000123277.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EqmfVsgm5FxiBcvg5efVtnqQvsJGXbYEpu4YxbKrNV77Xm47rg4hycVpxZ8iRf4PipQ.jpg)
![1000123272.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EoAaJvkJgtoEbZSfjgCjiBa8AfhPBRGZcQBUVxMxXyEbAQCTxAcc8rBsM49GaWF6S6C.jpg)
En este recorrido me detuve a contemplar la parte alta de la iglesia Santa Inés, con su campanario destacando en el horizonte. Además, diversos callejones frente a esta avenida nos conducen al Casco Histórico, lo que constituye un atajo para trasladarse de forma inmediata hacia la iglesia y otros lugares de interés como la Casa Ramos Sucre y el Castillo San Antonio de la Eminencia.
![1000123274.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Ep7tgmEwWcU5S3eEauAR84Q5i6DRzgR6V4qP2XVdQmPbm6SesUdpcb7EohXA51AWJUY.jpg)
![1000123266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eq5FTxXicao11o73kcePzmYgPBc2kQHnFUwzEDhPydHKMfP6pwZTmhdR4CFZMNWVrvq.jpg)
En este lado de la acera se encuentran varios lugares para descansar y conversar, por lo regular se aprecian a personas de la tercera edad sentados frente al río hablando de sus buenos tiempos, de la Cumaná de antaño y de cómo era todo antes de que la tecnología transformara lo cotidiano, lo digo porque justamente me senté a descansar un rato frente a la parada que va para Cumanacoa y allí escuché que antes del teléfono los enamorados se enviaban cartas con papel y lápiz, que tardaban meses en llegar de un lugar a otro y eso intensificaba la pasión, sin duda era otra época, una analógica que tenía su encanto para quienes la disfrutaron con intensidad. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

links.title: Damit, summer is upon us... - My Actifit Report Card: June 28 2026
links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b515aac2-498e-46c3-bf23-bf4d905515fd.jpg) Hey Actifitters, We had several things to do yesterday and with a late start as usual on weekends, this didn't leave much time for activity. But we tried to keep it as usual with Kaia and Le Chat first exploring together. Funny how it was the opposite from the previous day, with Le Chat following Kaia everywhere. These two always crack us up! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a69efd9c-dad4-43bb-850d-bef2c1e5a8de.jpg) We then headed to the small forest of course. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1d0acd89-2e65-4714-b18f-f671685d9b8a.jpg) As soon as we entered, I saw these two big bucks just chilling a little further. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/77ba7ed6-55fa-4401-b413-5760baa30382.jpg) Kaia didn't notice right away, so that gave me time to catch a few close up photos. But finally a third one I hadn't seen before started to worry about us and moved. That's when Kaia saw all of them and as you could expect, chaos ensued! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b737df36-1ddf-4a37-86a7-d99eb9c5d0dc.jpg) Kaia came back a few minutes later, not successful in her chase, but clearly not giving up. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6c0f5542-f9f1-4700-8e04-26f8bfeafb9b.jpg) They were long gone though and we could finish our loops in the forest without any more chases. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a5c39783-0b70-4de1-9af4-aac0c0f2e0e5.jpg) Waiting for us at the edge as often, Le Chat seemed very upset about something when we came back. I think some birds were taunting her and she didn't find it funny at all! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2d7bddf0-56a2-4c1f-aa9e-625ea701326a.jpg) Our final loop in the neighborhood was even shorter than the last few days, because we were already late and Kaia seemed to limp more as well. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9ed0d45a-3598-4001-a63b-4bb6544c639b.jpg) We then went for a great BBQ at a friend's place. They have a swimming pool in their subdivision and it was surprisingly empty, especially after 7pm. I tried to refuse the fact summer is here, because I really don't like summer, but that swimming session followed by the first real aperitif/BBQ of the season, that was great! Bonus with the Moon showing up from behind the haze. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b59a61bc-ca98-4551-b3e1-561881a6b15c.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0f292c5b-93ea-4955-8491-0cf752daf096.jpg) And that was it to conclude the day and the weekend. We've been lucky the past couple of weeks or so, with mild temperatures during the day and quite cool ones at night. It helped me trying to pretend there wouldn't be any summer at all, but this week, it all changes, extreme heat warnings are everywhere and we will get the same kind of dangerous heat Europe has been experiencing. Oh well... As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow. PS: between the new Actifit version not counting steps and swimming not adding steps either, my final step count looks quite low. It wasn't that much of a lazy day though.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@manuvert/actifit-manuvert-20260630t033745110z)_

links.body:
>

**<center>ESPAÑOL</center>**
 
Hoy comparto mi visita a la redoma \
, situada en la intersección de la avenida Gran Mariscal, la avenida Fernández de Serpa y la calle Sucre. Cerca de allí se alza un edificio, también conocido como \

, que destaca por su llamativo diseño, sus cornisas y sus ventanas; a pocos metros se encuentra esta conocida redoma, caracterizada por sus vistosas líneas de colores. También está ubicada muy cerca del estadio Delfín Marval y de un muro con coloridos murales que se extienden hacia la calle Sucre y la escuela República Argentina. La redoma es de color azul y cuenta con diversos bancos, formaciones rocosas y árboles grandes, así como con senderos pavimentados con baldosas de caico y terracota; en su base, hay una fuente centrada en una escultura con forma de copa.

>

**<center>ENGLISH</center>**
 
Today I am sharing my visit to the \
roundabout, located at the intersection of Gran Mariscal Avenue, Fernández de Serpa Avenue, and Sucre Street. Nearby stands a building—also known as \

—that stands out for its striking design, cornices, and windows; just a few meters away lies this well-known roundabout, distinguished by its eye-catching colorful lines. It is also situated very close to the Delfín Marval Stadium and a wall featuring colorful murals that extend toward Sucre Street and the República Argentina School. The roundabout is blue and features various benches, rock formations, and large trees, as well as walkways paved with *caico* tiles and terracotta; at its base, there is a fountain centered around a sculpture of a goblet. ![RLC (16).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqHyWG8HnuZyQmfvsnnSoGGfNJ2CVB2zsGjuHa2gu6uCdFntFvnFucYxb4hnXkfbkWu.jpeg) ![RLC (17).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eou7mfiKkMcqSYkGPNFo9ZqVnmrF1W7h9d1CdbuSNKFr1ggGzyetQf9kXjwqPPsayHq.jpeg) ![RLC (18).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqBbDaB9X7tqzPobdc4m1X7EchuiViFz2KwXWYUrrinyZoErnEkySmj5KrEeDa7zgsn.jpeg) ![RLC (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep1WrpMbgiDTXVbYBgUib2WikRFJUa7J5fSiUjE38LwJSSs2MYZA9rVgNvYuqPujsaa.jpeg) ![RLC (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoK6Mi2pSdGaJFygVpdKRVr7BH4Ui73QqNZDvhVx1mecs5TR3gTKsn7FTtXVb64yd7u.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> En una zona de esta glorieta vemos bancos algunos azules y otros con una combinación de azul, verde, naranja y amarillo, junto a una palmera. A continuación, se aprecia la parte posterior y la fuente triangular; también son visibles los murales y una vista parcial de la escuela República Argentina. La siguiente fotografía muestra detalles de la fuente en su nivel inferior, las pasarelas superiores, el túnel que conduce al nivel superior de la fuente y los canales por donde fluye el agua. Luego se presenta una vista de la disposición de la glorieta: las pasarelas forman una estrella, con bancos situados en sus cuatro puntas. Junto a ellos hay grandes rocas pintadas de amarillo y azul. A continuación, vemos los murales y la pasarela que bordea la fuente. Después se muestra la avenida Fernández de Cepa, que se cruza con la avenida Gran Mariscal en esta glorieta; aquí se pueden ver los bancos, rocas pintadas con los colores amarillo, azul y rojo de la bandera venezolana, y árboles de Neem que refrescan el ambiente de la plaza. Por último, se ofrece una vista completa de la glorieta, incluyendo los árboles y palmeras que la adornan.

> In one area of this traffic circle, we see benches—some blue, others featuring a mix of blue, green, orange, and yellow—along with a palm tree standing beside them. Next, we have a view of the rear section and the triangular fountain; the murals and a partial view of the República Argentina school are also visible. The following photograph shows details of the fountain at the lower level, the upper walkways, the tunnel leading to the fountain's upper tier, and the channels where the water flows. Next is a view of the traffic circle's layout: the walkways form a star shape, with benches positioned at the four points. Beside them are large rocks painted yellow and blue. We then see the murals and the walkway running alongside the fountain. Following that is a view of Fernández de Cepa Avenue, which intersects with Gran Mariscal Avenue at this circle; visible here are the benches, rocks painted in the yellow, blue, and red of the Venezuelan flag, and neem trees that provide a cooling effect for the plaza. Finally, there is a full view of the traffic circle, including the trees and palm trees that adorn it. ![RLC (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpJXa61LczbNPrXAr6m1PPwfktKQ52tLx3JVwZzFeCLZwVtfMKaXF4y5XJg9drTaMcK.jpeg) ![RLC (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpC9yRmgyUPunKbiMtKVvdony3kzmQVoUf93qmr6ZAXDUyDWm2rm9XBLhSTk86CB56K.jpeg) ![RLC (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eq5DbJXcQZ4MBSuCLfWYhpts35h36ECfk2obdREUF8h1SNtyNojJqSnraiHnXvopA4Q.jpeg) ![RLC (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoyNZwmjTeH52NRmbsRMxXNGz3kwzpLqN1y3S1TYFFtujRXV7kdSJYwqGkvmLa8m4PW.jpeg) ![RLC (14).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpzyfLjQLb8z7BLNmCyq8jEv2Bnq5juUVFm7u6V5RnvtVftdHunNJfBoA4pZWhSUHAH.jpeg) ![RLC (15).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpVAaofqDTwPtQCYNMEvbQBjCvp351BpuwFSyj6AXoc4ui3Rjn7555S3jEMvxUMb8yA.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

>


La siguiente fotografía muestra la estructura en forma de \

—con sus hermosos colores— y la vegetación circundante; la fuente se encuentra actualmente seca, tal vez debido a la temporada de sequía o a trabajos de mantenimiento en la glorieta. También se aprecia una vista de la avenida Fernández de Serpa, los bancos dispuestos a un lado, el pavimento de baldosas de caico y un sendero que conduce hacia la fuente. Los bancos presentan un diseño llamativo: un soporte en forma de L sin respaldo. Al otro lado, vemos jardineras, senderos y dos bancos situados en el borde de la glorieta, seguidos por una vista de la estructura de la copa y los muros azules que la separan de los jardines, los bancos y las plantas. Esta estructura se ubica en la sección más baja de la glorieta, con un desnivel de unos 70 centímetros, y se pueden ver plataformas situadas junto a las jardineras. La última fotografía muestra la estructura de la copa en el centro de la glorieta, con dos palmeras al frente, bancos a los lados y la vegetación del entorno; realmente me gustaron el diseño y los colores vibrantes. Gracias por acompañarme en este recorrido.

structure—with its beautiful colors—and the surrounding plants; the fountain is currently dry, perhaps due to the dry season or ongoing maintenance on the traffic circle. We also see a view of Fernández de Serpa Avenue, benches along one side, the *caico* tile paving, and a walkway leading toward the fountain. The benches feature a striking design: an L-shaped support without a backrest. On the other side, we see planters, walkways, and two benches situated at the edge of the traffic circle, followed by a view of the cup structure and the blue walls separating it from the gardens, benches, and plants. It sits in the lower section of the traffic circle—dropping down about 70 centimeters—and we can see platforms positioned beside the planters. The final photograph shows the cup structure at the center of the traffic circle, with two palm trees in front, benches on the sides, and the surrounding vegetation; I really liked the design and vibrant colors. links.title: Deliciosa chuleta de cerdo frita [ESP/ENG]
links.body: # Deliciosa chuleta de cerdo frita [ESP/ENG]\n\n<div class=\

>

Hola amigos del buen comer y que dedican una parte de su tiempo para leer mi contenido que presento en la comunidad de @hivefood. comunidad de la cual me siento muy contenta de ser parte de ella. Hoy les voy a compartir una deliciosa receta que prepare para  el almuerzo para que mi hija llevara su almuerzo para su guardia del día de hoy en el hospital como para mi esposo y yo que estábamos en casa. Los invito a que sean bienvenidos a mi blog.

![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/241tfhn9N8N3q4thVTca4jrAsE887zg72GTYQg4QGU7uuAyL4hFkJrkY9UQKCriqsphsA.jpg)

Les comento que la receta que prepare hoy para el almuerzo en familia fue: una deliciosa chuleta de cerdo frita, acompañada de ensalada de pepino, cebolla y tomate, arroz amarillo, crema de verdura y de tomar un delicioso jugo de lechosa.

![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpGTC51ck6G45pKbQmSygtxFiwjpmqk61mkdCgbuRgJ9YuR5zhEcsRmXVGpp5BKdKhR.jpg)

La textura de esta carne blanca estaba super tierna, jugosa, blanda y con un sabor muy rico. La crema de ocumo de raíz, super buena, el plátano dulce super rico y el arroz bastante suelto, las fotos lo dicen por si solo.

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eonmw3TTc39Q3j9Vd3dZ4pM1g5ijKLYqJAWoAC5QF1djqij7WVgUJ6si9gTWchsjKbv.jpg)

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoyPXLQg28GfwwLncn5nmRJ64qN12FWar58RmrpoETXFDMmzJFEDbMSJnpDF2qcQv8Z.jpg).

Este tipo de receta es muy fácil de preparar, cualquiera por muy principiante que sea les va a quedar muy rica, al igual que la sopa, quedo de sabor muy deliciosa y de textura, esponjosa 100 %.

![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpVEuKFeMoyJHxxqzpAsuorwX4uoKjrQ6ger7Ei38BCb46xPGXPRduYPNQLsrf81xTf.jpg)

 Ahora paso a dictarle los ingredientes y a mostrarle la forma en que prepare todo este almuerzo.

# Ingredientes
* 4 chuletas de cerdo
* 2 cucharadas de orégano entero
* salsa de soya, 4 ajos triturados
*- Sal y pimienta
* aceite para freír
* 4 Ocumos
* 1 pepino, 1 tomate y 1 tomate maduro
* Aceite para freír
* 1/2 cucharada de leche
* 1 taza de arooz
* 1 cucharada de margarina

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoyQYdTHFgqFAzi728tT5jquQvvTvzP5yKxFz7oLXjZDXeQXeiyDcqzSP7drPwCqGvh.jpg)

# Procedimiento

Lo primero que hice fue lavar muy bien con abundante agua las chuletas de cerdo, sazonarla con orégano, salsa de soya, ajo triturad, sal y pimienta al gusto. Luego busque un caldero, le coloque aceite e inicie el proceso de freír de una en una cada chuleta, espere que doraran y listo .

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc7TUpYLvWbyDKpkooJ17oZDn88z9Tm8nZegf4aP9wuoB8txAkrpGGmzxKsgqBXDeH.jpg)

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoyPXLQg28GfwwLncn5nmRJ64qN12FWar58RmrpoETXFDMmzJFEDbMSJnpDF2qcQv8Z.jpg)

Este suculento almuerzo lo deguste con jugo natural de lechosa, el cual cae muy bien al estomago. Así mismo lo acompañe con arroz amarillo, plátano sancochado, ensalada de pepino , cebolla y tomate y una rica crema de ocumo criollo.

![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpGTC51ck6G45pKbQmSygtxFiwjpmqk61mkdCgbuRgJ9YuR5zhEcsRmXVGpp5BKdKhR.jpg)

Ahora bien, esto ha sido todo por los momentos , espero sea de su agrado y nos vemos en una próxima presentación, con el favor de Dios.

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva
* Texto traducido con Deepl

> # English Version # Delicious Fried Pork Chop

> Hello, fellow food lovers who take the time to read my posts on the @hivefood community—a community I’m very happy to be a part of. Today I’m going to share a delicious recipe I made for lunch—both for my daughter to take to her shift at the hospital today and for my husband and me, who were at home. I invite you to join me on my blog. ![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/241tfhn9N8N3q4thVTca4jrAsE887zg72GTYQg4QGU7uuAyL4hFkJrkY9UQKCriqsphsA.jpg) I’d like to tell you that the recipe I prepared today for our family lunch was: a delicious fried pork chop, served with a cucumber, onion, and tomato salad, yellow rice, vegetable soup, and a delicious papaya juice to drink. ![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpGTC51ck6G45pKbQmSygtxFiwjpmqk61mkdCgbuRgJ9YuR5zhEcsRmXVGpp5BKdKhR.jpg) The texture of this white meat was incredibly tender, juicy, and soft, with a very rich flavor. The taro root purée was amazing, the sweet plantain was delicious, and the rice was nice and fluffy—the photos speak for themselves. ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eonmw3TTc39Q3j9Vd3dZ4pM1g5ijKLYqJAWoAC5QF1djqij7WVgUJ6si9gTWchsjKbv.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoyPXLQg28GfwwLncn5nmRJ64qN12FWar58RmrpoETXFDMmzJFEDbMSJnpDF2qcQv8Z.jpg). This type of recipe is very easy to make; even complete beginners will find it turns out delicious. Just like the soup, it has a wonderful flavor and a 100% fluffy texture. ![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpVEuKFeMoyJHxxqzpAsuorwX4uoKjrQ6ger7Ei38BCb46xPGXPRduYPNQLsrf81xTf.jpg) Now I’ll list the ingredients and show you how I prepared this entire lunch. # Ingredients * 4 pork chops * 2 tablespoons whole oregano * soy sauce, 4 crushed garlic cloves * Salt and pepper * oil for frying * 4 Ocumos * 1 cucumber, 1 tomato, and 1 ripe tomato * Oil for frying * 1/2 tablespoon of milk * 1 cup of arooz * 1 tablespoon of margarine ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoyQYdTHFgqFAzi728tT5jquQvvTvzP5yKxFz7oLXjZDXeQXeiyDcqzSP7drPwCqGvh.jpg) # Instructions First, I washed the pork chops thoroughly with plenty of water, then seasoned them with oregano, soy sauce, minced garlic, and salt and pepper to taste. Next, I took a pot, added oil, and began frying the chops one by one, waiting until they were golden brown—and that’s it! ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc7TUpYLvWbyDKpkooJ17oZDn88z9Tm8nZegf4aP9wuoB8txAkrpGGmzxKsgqBXDeH.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoyPXLQg28GfwwLncn5nmRJ64qN12FWar58RmrpoETXFDMmzJFEDbMSJnpDF2qcQv8Z.jpg) I enjoyed this delicious lunch with fresh papaya juice, which is very easy on the stomach. I also had it with yellow rice, boiled plantains, a cucumber, onion, and tomato salad, and a delicious creole taro soup. ![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpGTC51ck6G45pKbQmSygtxFiwjpmqk61mkdCgbuRgJ9YuR5zhEcsRmXVGpp5BKdKhR.jpg) Well, that’s all for now. I hope you enjoyed it, and I’ll see you in my next post, God willing. * Photos taken with an iPhone 8 Plus * Cover designed with Canva * Text translated with Deepl Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@morepina/deliciosa-chuleta-de-cerdo-frita-espeng-4g4)

links.title: 旷世大才卫鞅
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![1tYnxskYsqNRL7uy_48226.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrpointp/images/1tYnxskYsqNRL7uy_48226/1tYnxskYsqNRL7uy_48226.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

我最近一直在看历史剧《大秦帝国之裂变》，这是一部质量极高、让人看完内心满是震撼的历史正剧。目前我已经看完大半剧情，彻底被卫鞅与秦孝公嬴渠梁这对君臣CP圈粉。
 
这篇文章，我想以卫鞅，也就是商鞅为主角展开分享。秦国变法图强，固然离不开秦孝公毫无保留的信任与支撑，但真正撑起整场变法、大刀阔斧改造秦国根基的核心人物，必然是卫鞅。
 
纵观历史长河，历朝历代的变法者层出不穷，其中最常被后世拿来讨论的两个人，便是卫鞅与王莽。
 
王莽一直被网友戏称为“穿越者”，原因就在于他的改革思想极度超前。他推行的王田制，将全国土地收归国有、禁止私人买卖，理念近似如今的土地公有制。他改革货币体系，试图打破传统金属货币的现状，摸索类似纸币的信用货币模式。可这些改革最终全部失败，根本原因在于，西汉末年的社会基础，根本承载不了他过于理想化的构想。
 
说到底，王莽只是一位脱离现实的空想家。他的改革大多照搬周朝某些制度，所谓的“穿越者”，只是网友们的戏称。反观卫鞅的变法，不追求虚无缥缈的大同理想，所有政策都紧贴时代背景，精准直击战国乱世的社会痛点，做其他国都不愿意做的事情。
 
剧集过半，我终于明白为什么有的网友说看完这部剧满心震撼。举个例子，变法推行中期，太子（未及冠）触犯新法、滥杀数十人，公然破坏变法大局。卫鞅变法的核心便是法治至上、一视同仁。为维护新法权威、捍卫法治底线，卫鞅依法惩治太子的两位老师，其中一位是秦孝公亲兄长（和秦孝公关系很好）。

此时秦孝公身在深山、毫不知情，卫鞅便顶着民乱压力、不顾权贵权势，果断执法。而秦孝公归来之后，非但没有怪罪卫鞅惩处自己的亲人，反而主动将太子流放。君臣二人的这番操作翻遍历史书也真不到几例。
 
也正因如此，我才由衷感慨，卫鞅与嬴渠梁是千古难遇的天作之合。一人以身入局，倾尽毕生心血推动变法革新；一人倾尽举国之力，无条件信任、支撑变法。若无这场彻底的变法，就没有秦国的富国强兵，更不会有后来一统天下的强秦。
 
只是知晓了卫鞅最终的结局，令人惋惜啊。倘若秦孝公再坚持几年，春秋战国的历史进程，也会是另一番结局了。

---
