links.title: Here are all the details you need to know about “Visions of Verico”
links.body:
>

<center> **Best regards Splinterlovers** 💚</center>

Tomorrow, June 30, “Visions of Verico” will be released—the first official card set that will introduce the first lineage cards to the plots of land in “Praetoria,” however, these are not just any cards; rather, they are worker cards that will be very useful for the management, administration, and production on the plots, which will bring about a complete paradigm shift in this game mode.

That’s why in this post we’re going to take a closer look at the “Pre-sale,” the cards’ features and mechanics, and why you should participate if you’re an active player in the “Land Plots” game mode—which, little by little with each update, is becoming much more integrated with the actual battle gameplay. After all, these cards may be intended solely for working the land, but there could be some changes coming to enhance the cards in all existing sets, so stay tuned.

**In any case, this post isn't meant to highlight the other cards, but rather to explain all the details of the presales and why this is important, so I ask that, if you want to know what all this is about, you stick around until the end of this post:**

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23u5vePV5iwFG29wh3uQfdDbYigwRfxyEFNhfbBe6JWiCDCHhc7xegwdPbFz6WwpcF4cR.png)

## <center>Pre-sale and Package Details</center>
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

Okay, for those who haven't been paying attention, in this section I'll explain everything you need to know about the pre-sale for \

which takes place tomorrow. It was announced about 20 days ago, along with details on the cards, abilities, and many other aspects that I'll summarize in this post. Later, in upcoming posts, I'll go into much more detail for anyone who has questions. In the meantime, let’s get to the information:

**As I said, the “Pre-sale” starts tomorrow, and here are all the details you need to know if you want to participate:**

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>Pre-sale Details</center>

* **Availability or Number of Packages:** Starting tomorrow and for the remainder of the presale—which is expected to last throughout the month of July—only a total of 250,000 packages will be sold, so I see that, in a way, this will be a fairly small number.

* **The Contents:** One thing we didn't know until now was how many cards the “Visions Of Verico” packs would contain, and this is the first time I've seen that there will be quite a few—each pack will contain a total of about 20 worker cards, which, I must say, look spectacular.

* **The Price:** One great thing is that the packs are affordable, which could be a good opportunity to build a competitive deck of worker cards that allow you to effectively manage, administer, and/or produce your resources. Each pack costs $2 (2,000 Credits per pack), USDC, or, alternatively, DEC.

---

***Note: One really nice thing is that if you use DEC, you'll receive a 5% bonus that applies to the value of your purchase, so it's obviously much better to use DEC for your purchases to take advantage of that 5%.***

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23u5vePV5iwFG29wh3uQfdDbYigwRfxyEFNhfbBe6JWiCDCHhc7xegwdPbFz6WwpcF4cR.png)

## <center>Card Features and Mechanics</center>

https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

In this section, I’ll go over all the characteristics of these cards, such as their rarities, the versions we’ll see, some details on how to use them, and a little more. The goal isn’t for you to walk away from this post with 100% knowledge of how the cards work and how to use them—I think we’ll all get to that point once we’re in “Praetoria” and put them to work. The idea is to have the information and understanding of the abilities so you’ll know what to do when the opportunity arises after the pre-sale ends and we have the cards.

**So, what you need to know right now is that each card has up to 6 abilities that are unlocked as you level up; these abilities are:**

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>Worker Card Abilities</center>

* **Toil & Kin:** This is a lineage-based skill that increases efficiency.

* **Rationing Lite:** This ability reduces resource consumption; however, it does not apply to plots with more than 20,000 base PP, so you should keep this in mind before devising a strategy.

* **Alteration (Skins Factory):** This is a skill that lets you obtain some cosmetic items and generally doesn't affect the work on the plots or their workers at all, but basically what it does is generate \

—or, as I said, some cosmetic items that can be applied to the cards. * **Glint Recovery (Glint Bombs):** This is one of the most appealing features of all—you have the chance to randomly generate GLINTS when you receive certain types of bombs. I guess we'll see what the bombs look like when the game launches, but the important thing is that you can earn GLINT. * **Dark Discount:** This feature offers some exclusive discounts—we don't have any specific details about them yet, but they could be quite interesting. * **Fortune Seeker:** This is a skill that is unlocked when one of the common cards reaches its maximum level; it allows you to participate in weekly raffles for cards that we could call “Premium.” --- **Other Features** This set of cards comes in several versions; even though they are all “Common,” these versions are: * **Regular Foil** * **Gold Foil** * **Black** * **Gold Arcane** * **Black Foil Arcane** On the other hand, these cards cannot be used in “Conflicts”; specifically, you cannot use them to win cards in “Escalation Conflicts,” and they carry the same weight in “Collection Power” as the “Arcana Conclave” edition. --- https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYoUgCugij9Zc9YqZStweXGkczF99nE2M3751EwFvhAF/image.png ##
Conclusion
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif Here’s everything you need to know to prepare for the new set of worker cards specialized in land plots, which will usher in a new era of management, production, and administration of resources and other items in this game mode. If you have any questions, feel free to ask, but it won’t be long before this begins—remember, there are only 250,000 packs available.
https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhowii/23t74jP9PwnQVm1xvGFRSWNw9CX8dtyaB4fPKB2YqhBL6VuzewvG9Sd3Ft2qNL4scwN2L.gif
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/AJhYgvAA2jMdAtev45LxeeeYzzVqonoQgjHfk865cC9GnBW1MVqFA5B5cJ6BKaa.gif ### **I invite everyone to join Splinterlands, the best game based on chains of blocks, full of adventures, battles, and strategies where you will have fun and get rewards according to your league**
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/Eoc6Yq8EJ2L35tJnQyXixtVnvmKBsf6xNX4yVaZQfn4SPonejdcZVSUfs2LcNi53bp4.png ---  https://i.postimg.cc/d02nBjTg/banner-doradas.gif

这次三亚旅行，我最期待的就是在亚龙湾美高梅酒店入住的两天。九年前来三亚，我住的是亚龙湾喜来登，这次我特意选择了美高梅。这家酒店主打潮玩风格，也特别适合亲子出游，我这次先和同事来踩踩点，嘻嘻！

我和同事一起预订的豪华海景房，房型包含两大两小的早餐，房价一千四百多一晚，两晚总共两千八百多元。我们AA分摊下来，价格在我的接受范围内，而且这个房价包含了超多酒店权益，有出海海钓、泳池音乐现场、高空滑索，还赠送酒店旅拍服务，整体性价比很高。来亚龙湾度假，一定要住一线海景房，才能感受到满满的度假氛围，所以这个价格我完全可以接受。

我们从三亚湾全季酒店退房后，打车前往亚龙湾，一路上都特别期待新的酒店。抵达美高梅后，整体的入住服务体验很不错。一楼大堂有专属的欢迎仪式，还有工作人员带着鹦鹉互动，特别适合逗小朋友。最搞笑的是，大堂的婴儿车里竟然有一只可爱的小马尔济斯。

因为房间还在打扫，我们就在大堂简单逛了一会儿。站在大堂就能望见远处的大海和酒店的泳池设施，视野特别好。大堂里不仅有下午茶区域，居然还有一家体彩店，不愧是赌王旗下的酒店，特色十足。

等待结束后终于可以办理入住，门童直接帮我们把行李送到了房间。最让人惊喜的是，工作人员免费帮我们升级成了至尊海景房。房间在六楼，推开阳台门就能直面绝美海景，特别开心。

房间空间宽敞，配套设施也很齐全。虽然是老牌酒店，但整体的奢华质感依旧在线。房间里配备了高端日系洗护护肤品，还有胶囊咖啡机这类精致小家电，细节做得很到位。最贴心的是，酒店还提供可以免费使用的沙滩包啊沙滩鞋等用品，非常方便。

每次入住体验不错的酒店，我们都会先在酒店里玩一个多小时。哈哈！酒店这么香，何必还去外面玩啊？

body.title: (ESP/ENG) Mini donas mundiales con decoración cristal 🍩 // Mini donuts from around the world with crystal decorations 🍩
body.body: > ¡Hola hola espero se encuentren muy bien! Cómo bien saben tengo mi emprendimiento de mini donas y dulces; es una de las cosas que más hago, trato de mejorar cada día para ofrecer mejores productos y resultados a mis clientes... Hace unos pocos días atrás me hicieron una solicitud de mini donas con temática del mundial de fútbol; sinceramente primero me coloque las manos en la cabeza porque no tenía ni idea de cómo lograrlo... Luego de pensarlo mucho, logré idear un plan para las decoraciones para que fueran acordé a la temática solicitada. La base de la mini dona es la misma de vainilla ya que me parece que es la acerta y fácil de combinar con otros sabores, colores y texturas. Con mis mini donas listas, empecé el procedimiento para decorarlas, de chocolate tipo bitter y chocolate blanco el cual pinte de algunos colorantes para chocolate para darle más vida a las mini donas mundialistas. Realmente quedaron muy lindas y acordes a la temática... ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP7RSyAidQDYcTg5mg7Cabb74yaD6AYLzyWAJNNKjHiQA/1782769389878.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdogj1nnyKpn4FU32uRRS4tsQzPQSndGVMjQiJfnQfcrQ/1782769390027.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdzbXnkmCb4QatNtHUr1V9d7ZvBioj4NErZcnCu9z3iFA/1782769390193.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWFDT1Yn19seLTYmQJWPWsG64jacQ8oTNC7ZjevL5ZKzz/1782769390321.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdPUePUCTyXEbWwAfVo6aVDNavSQ8AnUCh3PngDRusLs8/1782769390483.jpg) Pero algo que realmente me invente y gusto muchísimo fue este súper toping que aplique a algunas mini donas, se trata de **Decorado Cristal** que no es más que azúcar pintada con colorante alimenticio súper facil y versátil; que sirve para decorar galletas tortas, pies entre otras cosas.. Para lograr esta azúcar cristal solo debemos colocar en un recipiente de vidrio bien limpio y seco 4 cucharadas de azúcar y 2 gotas de colorante de tu preferencia; con ayuda de una cuchara mezclar bien, luego colocar la tapa al frasco y agitar con mucha fuerza hasta lograr un color parejo; luego pasamos un recipiente o plato limpio y dejamos secar el azúcar durante 3hrs, así estará lista para ser usada... ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU5vkr14p6iHXT3vmcJJ6XT4QbjEkuBpX3DCL5NQmz2jL/1782770016552.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNaqiQ9VEVT87mJN41qHVk9G5UJ2KVCgN1Ko7gEr3YScb/1782770016693.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXRiA7WD1qe1RJUcrQg5GmZsb6rTWbfyTGQE19UoLTp2H/1782770016813.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmchtiAcwtbAsRXybeSTTgHQ76DE1PFDZAQkohvdcFLd4h/1782770016929.jpg) Me encanto el resultado final, las llame *Mini donas Cristal* las verdes quedaron como el césped de la cancha de fútbol; súper lindas y originales... Espero que este truquito les sea de utilidad para decorar sus dulcitos... Me despido, un abrazo para todos... **Portada editada con Canva** **Fotografías de mi propiedad** **Traductor DeepL** ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfPSG6Nm8oB1sPFT2mYWPSN5UbkuFVUCbJXw47Lromorz/1782674985166.png) Hi there, I hope you’re all doing great! As you know, I run my own business making mini donuts and sweets; it’s one of the things I do most often, and I try to improve every day to offer better products and results to my customers... A few days ago, I received a request for mini donuts with a World Cup theme; honestly, at first I threw my hands up in the air because I had no idea how to pull it off... After thinking about it a lot, I came up with a plan for the decorations so they’d match the requested theme. The base of the mini donut is vanilla, since I think it’s the best choice and easy to pair with other flavors, colors, and textures. With my mini donuts ready, I began decorating them using dark chocolate and white chocolate, which I colored with some chocolate food coloring to bring the World Cup-themed mini donuts to life. They really turned out very cute and true to the theme... ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP7RSyAidQDYcTg5mg7Cabb74yaD6AYLzyWAJNNKjHiQA/1782769389878.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdogj1nnyKpn4FU32uRRS4tsQzPQSndGVMjQiJfnQfcrQ/1782769390027.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdzbXnkmCb4QatNtHUr1V9d7ZvBioj4NErZcnCu9z3iFA/1782769390193.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWFDT1Yn19seLTYmQJWPWsG64jacQ8oTNC7ZjevL5ZKzz/1782769390321.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdPUePUCTyXEbWwAfVo6aVDNavSQ8AnUCh3PngDRusLs8/1782769390483.jpg) But something I actually came up with myself and really loved was this awesome topping I added to some mini donuts—it’s called **Crystal Icing**, which is simply sugar colored with food coloring. It’s super easy and versatile, and you can use it to decorate cookies, cakes, pies, and more. To make this crystal sugar, simply place 4 tablespoons of sugar and 2 drops of your favorite food coloring in a clean, dry glass container. Mix well with a spoon, then put the lid on the jar and shake vigorously until the color is even. Next, pour the mixture into a clean bowl or plate and let the sugar dry for 3 hours—then it’ll be ready to use... ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU5vkr14p6iHXT3vmcJJ6XT4QbjEkuBpX3DCL5NQmz2jL/1782770016552.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNaqiQ9VEVT87mJN41qHVk9G5UJ2KVCgN1Ko7gEr3YScb/1782770016693.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXRiA7WD1qe1RJUcrQg5GmZsb6rTWbfyTGQE19UoLTp2H/1782770016813.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmchtiAcwtbAsRXybeSTTgHQ76DE1PFDZAQkohvdcFLd4h/1782770016929.jpg) I loved the final result—I called them *Mini Cristal Donuts*. The green ones looked just like the grass on a soccer field; they’re super cute and original... I hope this little trick comes in handy for decorating your treats... That’s all for now—hugs to everyone... **Cover edited with Canva** **Photos are my own** **DeepL Translator**

Hello @holozing community!


After many attempts, I managed to bring some of what I do in traditional art into the digital realm, although it took me longer than I’d hoped – I don’t think Shinaara is the best choice for a quick drawing process – but I think I pulled it off. I reserved tones, used contrast and minimal hatching, and learnt how to use a new brush.

I hope you like my piece
